definition: Emphatic particle inna with suffix -hu: verily he/it; introduces a nominal clause with its subject in the accusative.
notes: After verbs of knowing read annahu 'that he'.

definition: Imperative masculine singular of nahá (yanhá), to forbid or restrain; here 'restrain thy soul'. Root n-h-y.
usage: 'Restrain', as in the Hidden Words' call to restrain the soul from its desires.
notes: Second Hidden Words context: thumma inha nafsaka 'then deny thyself'.

definition: Preposition: from, away from, about; after verbs of turning away (a‘raḍa ‘an) marks what is turned from.
Noun, plural of ‘abd: servants, worshippers; in these texts humankind as servants of God. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: God's servants, i.e. humankind, as in عباد الله 'the servants of God'; a very frequent form of address in the Writings.

definition: Noun: earth, land, ground; the world. Root ’-r-ḍ.
usage: The earth or land, as in اهل ارض 'the peoples of the earth' and ارض اقدس 'the Most Holy Land'; often paired with سماء 'heaven'.
notes: Arabic word common in elevated Persian; "pisarán-i arḍ" O Sons of Earth.

definition: Conditional particle: if, were it that (hypothetical or contrary-to-fact condition).
notes: With wa-: even if. Often followed by la- in the apodosis.

definition: Adverbial phrase, ka- 'like' + dhálika 'that': thus, in this way; frequent closing formula.
usage: 'Thus', a frequent closing formula, as in کذلک نزّل الامر 'Thus hath the command been sent down'.
notes: As in kadhálika naṣaḥnákum 'Thus have We counselled you'.

definition: Particle inna 'verily' with suffix -ná 'we': verily we; introduces a nominal clause with subject in the accusative.
notes: Common in Quranic quotations and the Aqdas; after verbs of knowing read anná 'that we'.

definition: Plural of áyah: verses of scripture; signs, tokens, wonders. Root '-y-y.
usage: The verses revealed by the Manifestation and also signs of God in creation; آیات الله "the verses of God", which Bahá'u'lláh presents as the chief proof of His mission.
notes: In the Arabic Hidden Words (áyát at-tawḥíd) the sense is signs or tokens.

definition: Arabic independent pronoun, second person masculine plural: you (all).
notes: Here within Arabic phrases set in the Persian Hidden Words.

definition: Noun: sky, heaven; figuratively a lofty spiritual realm. Root s-m-w.
usage: In the Writings often figurative, as in سماء قدس 'heaven of holiness' and سماء البیان 'heaven of utterance'; also the heaven of a former Revelation.

definition: Noun: a verse of scripture; a sign or token. Arabic áya, plural áyát. Root '-y-y.
usage: In the Writings both a revealed verse and a sign of God, as in آیات الله 'the verses of God' or 'the signs of God'; in the Íqán often این آیه 'this verse'.

definition: Passive participle: mentioned, recorded, aforesaid; with داشتن 'to relate'. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Common in the Writings for 'mentioned' or 'aforesaid', as in لوح مذکور 'the said Tablet'; مذکور داشت 'he related'.

definition: Noun: earth, land, ground; the world as dwelling of humankind. Root '-r-ḍ.
usage: Very frequent, often paired with the heavens: السموات و الارض 'the heavens and the earth'; اهل الارض 'the peoples of the earth'.

definition: Noun: people, mankind, the populace in general.
usage: The ordinary Persian word for people in the Writings, often paired with the Arabic ناس 'the people'.

definition: Noun, plural of ma‘ná: meanings, inner significances, spiritual realities. Root ‘-n-y.
usage: In the Writings usually the inner, spiritual meanings behind outward words, as in اسرار معانی 'mysteries of inner meaning' and شموس معانی 'suns of inner meaning'.

definition: Noun with article: the command, the matter; in the Writings the Cause of God. Root '-m-r.
usage: In the Writings usually 'the Cause', the Faith itself, as in امر الله 'the Cause of God'; also God's command, as in حسب الأمر 'as bidden', or simply a matter.
notes: In Persian context حسب الأمر means 'as commanded'.

definition: Imperative of qála, to say: "Say!", the Qur'anic formula introducing words to be proclaimed. Root q-w-l.
usage: In the Writings قل introduces what God bids His Manifestation proclaim, rendered "Say:", as in قل یا اهل الکتاب "Say: O people of the Book".

definition: Preposition bi- 'with, in, by' joined to the relative pronoun má 'what, that which'.
Plural of ‘álim, learned man: the learned, the religious scholars or clergy. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Íqán the divines who opposed each Manifestation, as in علمای عصر 'the divines of the age'; Shoghi Effendi renders it "divines" or "doctors".
notes: Written with the izáfih -yi before a following noun or pronoun.

definition: Noun, oblique plural of ‘álam 'world': the worlds, all creation. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Chiefly in the Qur'anic formula ربّ العالمین 'the Lord of the worlds'; in the Aqdas also all the peoples of the world, as in محیطاً علی العالمین.

definition: Emphatic lám (la-) prefixed to the pronoun huwa 'he': verily he is; used after inna.
usage: In the Writings chiefly in the formula انّه لهو ... 'verily He is the ...', as انّه لهو المقتدر القدیر 'He, verily, is the Mighty, the All-Powerful'.

definition: Of or pertaining to divine oneness (aḥadíyyat); divine, of the One God. Root a-ḥ-d.
usage: Very frequent in the Íqán and Persian Hidden Words as an epithet of God's realm, e.g. اسرار احدیّه 'the mysteries of God', بحر احدیّه 'the ocean of divine oneness'.
notes: Persian form of Arabic aḥadíyya, often rendered simply 'divine'.

definition: Noun with article: man, the human being, humankind. Root '-n-s.
usage: Best known from the address یا ابن الانسان 'O Son of Man' in the Arabic Hidden Words; also humanity in general.
notes: Genitive after ابن.

definition: Noun: wisdom, sagacity; also philosophy and the wise purpose behind something. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: In the Writings usually divine wisdom, as in حکمت لدنّی 'divine wisdom' ("the seeds of My divine wisdom"); also the wise purpose behind God's laws.

definition: Conjunction meaning "then, thereafter", marking sequence in time or in order of actions.
Collective noun: people, mankind, men in general. Root n-w-s (also linked to ins).
usage: Very common for 'the people' or 'men'; یا ایها الناس 'O people', and in the Íqán for those who failed to recognize the Manifestation.
notes: Case varies: an-násu (subject) in the Íqán quotation, an-nása (object) in the Hidden Words.

definition: Particle negating a verb in the past sense; governs the jussive, as in ان لم 'if not'.
notes: In ان لم تحبّنی 'if thou lovest Me not' the jussive follows.

definition: Plural of ṣáḥib: companions, associates, people of; also disciples of a Prophet. Root ṣ-ḥ-b.
usage: In the Writings the companions or followers of a Prophet or of the Báb; also "people of", as in اصحاب مدین بقا 'the companions of the City of Eternity'.

definition: Demonstrative pronoun, masculine singular, distal: that; refers to something just mentioned.
Verb: imperative or present 2nd plural of farmúdan, honorific "to deign, command"; used as a courteous light verb (ta’ammul farmá’íd "ponder").
usage: Deign, be pleased to; courteous light verb, as in ta'ammul farmá'íd 'ponder ye' and mulláḥaẓih farmá'íd 'observe'.
notes: Normalized from فرمائید. With a noun it forms a polite command: "ponder", "consider".

definition: Noun: holiness, sanctity, purity; common in izáfih phrases such as "the path of holiness". Root q-d-s.
usage: Holiness or sanctity, as in سبیل قدس 'the path of holiness', روح القدس 'the Holy Spirit' and ارض اقدس 'the Most Holy Land'.

definition: Noun: knowledge, recognition, gnosis, especially knowledge of God. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: Knowledge or recognition, above all recognition of God and His Manifestation, the first duty in the Aqdas; also mystical gnosis (عرفان).
notes: Arabic ma‘rifa with Persian final -t.

definition: Adjective and divine name: mighty, glorious, precious; in Persian also dear. Root ‘-z-z.
usage: A divine name, 'the Mighty', as in العزیز الحمید and العزیز الحکیم; in Persian عزیز also means 'dear'.
notes: Frequent divine epithet in Qur'ánic quotations.

definition: Adjective (Arabic feminine form agreeing with broken plurals): holy, sanctified, of holiness. Root q-d-s.
usage: Holy, of holiness; in phrases like نفوس قدسیه 'holy souls' and کلمات قدسیه 'holy words'.
notes: Feminine agreement with plurals such as hayákil, maẓáhir.

definition: Noun, plural of samá’ 'sky, heaven': the heavens. Root s-m-w.
usage: 'The heavens', usually paired with الارض in the phrase السموات والارض 'the heavens and the earth', meaning all creation.
notes: Often paired with al-arḍ 'the earth'; genitive as-samáwáti after fí.

definition: Particle iyyá with 2nd-person plural suffix: beware (warning); also the object pronoun "you".
usage: Warning formula "beware!", as in ایاکم ان ... "beware lest ye ..."; frequent in the Kitáb-i-Aqdas.
notes: Iyyákum an ... = beware lest ye; in "waffaqana'lláhu wa iyyákum" it simply means "and you".

definition: Plural noun of bayán: statements, utterances, explanations, words. Root b-y-n.
usage: In the Writings the utterances or words of the Manifestation, as in بیانات مبارکه 'the blessed utterances'; also explanations and statements.

definition: Noun: a people, tribe or nation; one's own folk. Root q-w-m.
usage: Frequent in the vocative یا قوم 'O my people' spoken by the Prophets to their nations; in Persian passages simply 'the people'.

definition: Present perfect 3rd plural of namúdan, 'to do, to make; to show'; here a light verb after an Arabic verbal noun.
usage: The Writings use namúdan where modern Persian uses kardan, as in اقبال نمودن 'to turn towards' and ادراک نمودن 'to apprehend'.

definition: Noun: sovereign, king, lord; also sovereignty, dominion. Root s-l-ṭ.
usage: Often a title of God or of a divine attribute, as in سلطان البقاء 'the Sovereign of Eternity'; in the Arabic Hidden Words سلطان الغنی 'the Lord of wealth'; also earthly kings (سلاطین).

definition: Preposition fí 'in' with attached pronoun -hi: in it, in him, therein.
Adverbial phrase (Arabic ma‘a 'with' + dhálika 'that'): nevertheless, in spite of this.
usage: Frequent in the Íqán to introduce a reproach, 'and yet' or 'notwithstanding'.
notes: Written as one word in the source (مع‌ذلک).

definition: Past progressive of نمودن 'to do, make, show'; mostly a light verb forming compound verbs with nouns.
usage: In the Íqán a frequent light verb after Arabic nouns, as in تکذیب مینمودند 'they denied' and تضرّع مینمودند 'they supplicated'.
notes: Written without the joiner: می‌نمودند.

definition: Noun with article: the book; the scripture, the revealed Book. Root k-t-b.
usage: Refers to revealed scripture; اهل الکتاب 'the people of the Book' (Jews and Christians), and in the Aqdas الکتاب is often the Most Holy Book itself.

definition: Active participle of fáza: attaining, winning, partaking of; used with شدن or گشتن "to attain". Root f-w-z.
usage: In the Writings usually فائز شدن "to attain unto", e.g. the presence (لقا), the Beauty or recognition of God; Shoghi Effendi renders it "attain".
notes: Written فائز; the ی stands for the hamza seat.

definition: Preposition li- 'to, for' with the suffix -kum 'you (pl.)'; má lakum 'ye have no'.
Active participle of nazala, descending; with shudan, to be sent down, revealed. Root n-z-l.
usage: In the Writings نازل شدن means 'to be revealed', of verses and Tablets, e.g. آیات نازل شده 'the verses revealed'; also of blessings 'sent down'.

definition: Verbal noun: turning away, aversion, rejection. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: In the Íqán the people's turning away from each new Manifestation, often paired with اعتراض 'protest' and انکار 'denial'.
notes: Not to be confused with a‘ráḍ, plural of ‘araḍ 'accident'.

definition: Persian bi- 'in' + qism 'kind, manner' + indefinite -í; in بقسمی که 'in such a way that, so that'. Root q-s-m.
usage: Introduces a result clause, بقسمی که 'in such wise that', as in بقسمی که بالمرّه فراموش نمودی 'so that thou hast wholly forgotten'.

definition: Preposition li- 'for, to' plus man 'whoever, he who': for him who, unto whoever.
usage: Common in blessings such as طوبی لمن 'blessed is he who' and فهنیئاً لمن 'well is it with him who'.
notes: In Íqán لمن المحبرین is la-min 'surely among', a different reading.

definition: Noun: meaning, sense; the inner reality of a thing as opposed to its outward form. Root ‘-n-y.
usage: In the Íqán the inner meaning of scripture, as in معنی آن 'the meaning thereof'; plural معانی 'inner meanings', 'mysteries'.

definition: Proper noun: Jesus, son of Mary, the Messiah; the Arabic and Qur'anic form of the name.
usage: In the Íqán a chief example of a Manifestation rejected by the divines of His day; often حضرت عیسی 'Jesus' or روح الله 'the Spirit of God'.

definition: Anyone, any person; with a negative verb "no one, none". Arabic aḥad with Persian indefinite -í. Root ’-ḥ-d.
usage: Common in the Persian Writings with a negative, as in احدی را مقبل نیافتم 'I found none that had turned unto Me'.

definition: Preposition 'at, with, in the possession of' with suffix 'him/Him'. Root ‘-n-d.
usage: Often of God, as in و عنده امّ الکتاب 'and with Him is the Mother Book' (Qur'an 13:39), quoted in the Íqán.

definition: The Furqán, 'the Discriminator', a name of the Qur'an; also anything distinguishing truth from falsehood. Root f-r-q.
usage: In the Íqán the usual name for the Qur'anic dispensation, as in شریعت فرقان 'the law of the Qur'án', rendered 'the Qur'án'.

definition: Passive of nazzala: was sent down, was revealed (of divine verses). Root n-z-l.
usage: Standard verb for divine revelation, as in هذا ما نزّل من جبروت العزّة 'This is that which hath descended from the realm of glory'.
notes: May also be read active nazzala 'He sent down'.

definition: Noun: truth, reality, right; as al-Ḥaqq a name of God, the True One. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: 'Truth, right'; as الحق a name of God, the True One, and in phrases like کلمة الحق 'the word of truth'.
notes: Accusative al-ḥaqqa in both Qur'anic quotations; in Persian prose al-Ḥaqq often means God.

definition: Noun: sea, ocean; figuratively a boundless store of knowledge or grace. Root b-ḥ-r.
usage: Sea, ocean; in the Writings figuratively the boundless ocean of God's knowledge, grace or utterance, as in baḥr-i ‘ilm 'ocean of knowledge'.
notes: Shoghi Effendi often renders it "ocean".

definition: Noun: place, location, abode; "maḥall giriftan" to take up one's abode. Root ḥ-l-l.
usage: A place or abode; used of the heart as the abode of the Beloved.

definition: Verb (form IV, past): he wished, willed, intended. Root r-w-d.
usage: To will or desire, as in من اراد 'whoso desireth' and of God's will, ما اراد 'what He willeth'.
notes: man aráda whoso desireth; past tense with general present sense after man.

definition: Noun: utterance, speech, eloquent exposition; also the Bayán, the Báb's Book. Root b-y-n.
usage: Utterance or exposition, as in بحر البیان 'ocean of utterance'; also the Bayán, the Báb's Book.
notes: Yá Ibn al-Bayán = O Son of Utterance; ahl al-Bayán = people of the Bayán.

definition: Noun: sky, heaven; plural samáwát. Root s-m-w.
usage: Heaven, sky; literally and as the heaven of the divine Will or of religion, as in سماء المشیة 'the heaven of the Will'.
notes: Written السّمآء in the texts.

definition: Noun: essence, substance, jewel; the quintessence of a thing. Arabicized from Persian gawhar.
usage: 'Essence', the innermost reality of a thing; in Hidden Words addresses such as 'O Essence of Desire!'; also a jewel or gem.
notes: In Hidden Words addresses: 'O Essence of Desire!', 'O Essence of Negligence!'. Plural javáhir.

definition: Noun: time, moment, while; "fí kulli ḥín" at all times. Root ḥ-y-n.
usage: Time, moment; common in في کل حین "at all times" and في هذا الحین "at this moment".

definition: Perfect of shudan 'to become', third person plural: they have become; also a passive auxiliary.
notes: Written with a joiner as شده‌اند.

definition: Noun qadr 'measure' with indefinite -í: a little, somewhat, for a while. Root q-d-r.
usage: Typically in قدری تأمّل 'ponder awhile' or 'reflect a little'.

definition: Noun: nearness, closeness, especially spiritual nearness to God. Root q-r-b.
usage: Spiritual nearness to God, as in گلهای قرب 'the flowers of nearness' and سرادق قرب 'the pavilion of nearness'; opposed to بعد 'remoteness'.

definition: Arabic verb, imperfect of shá'a: he wills, wishes, pleases. Root sh-y-'.
usage: Frequent in Qur'anic formulas such as یفعل اللّه ما یشاء 'God doeth whatsoever He willeth' and من یشاء 'whomsoever He willeth'.

definition: Contraction of ‘an 'from, away from' and má 'what': from what, from that which.
Conjunction: but, however; literary lengthened form of ولی and لیکن.
Arabic particle: when (of past time), since, because; also introduces a sudden event.
notes: Here in Arabic quotations, e.g. و ما رمیت اذ رمیت 'thou didst not throw when thou threwest'.

definition: Noun: desire, passion, selfish caprice; (in Persian also) air. Root h-w-y.
usage: Selfish desire opposed to the will of God, as in ای پسر هوی 'O Son of Passion' and هوی و هوس 'passion and desire'.
notes: Arabic hawá; Persian pronunciation havá.

definition: Verb massa, to touch or befall; here third feminine singular subjunctive with the suffix -ka "thee". Root m-s-s.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words used of trials touching the soul, as in ان تمسّک ذلّة "if abasement befall thee".
notes: After ان (if) the verb is subjunctive/jussive.

definition: Verbal noun of tamassaka (form V): holding fast to, clinging to, adhering to. Root m-s-k.
usage: In the Writings تمسّک (جستن/نمودن) means to hold fast to God's Cord (حبل الله), His Book or His Covenant; rendered "cleave to", "hold fast".

definition: Plural of jawhar: gems, jewels; essences, the innermost reality of things. Root j-w-h-r.
usage: In the Writings both 'gems' and 'essences', as in جواهر علمی 'the gems of My knowledge' and جوهر الجواهر 'the Essence of essences'.

definition: Noun: a reported saying of the Prophet or the Imams; also a story, discourse. Root ḥ-d-th.
usage: In the Íqán usually 'tradition', the Islamic ḥadíth cited beside Qur'anic verses; plural احادیث 'traditions'.

definition: Defective verb of negation: is not, there is not. Root l-y-s.
usage: Common in Arabic passages, as in انّه لیس منّی 'he is not of Me' and لیس کمثله شیء 'nothing is like unto Him'.

definition: Active participle of malaka: owner, possessor, master, sovereign lord. Root m-l-k.
usage: In the Writings a divine title in construct phrases: مالک الأسماء 'the Lord of Names', مالک الأدیان 'the Lord of all religions', مالک الأنام 'the Lord of mankind'.

definition: Plural of martaba: ranks, degrees, stages, grades of a progression. Root r-t-b.
usage: In the Writings the degrees or stations of spiritual attainment or of existence, as in مراتب وجود 'the grades of existence'.

definition: Conjunction (ka + má): as, just as, in the same way that.
Noun/adjective: one, the One (a divine name); after a negative, anyone. Root a-ḥ-d.
usage: As a divine name it marks God's absolute oneness, as in بساط قدس احد 'the court of holiness of the One'; in Arabic phrases often 'anyone', as in احد فی البلاد 'any one in the land'.
notes: In the Arabic Hidden Words context (بمعرفة احد) it means 'anyone'.

definition: Objection, protest, opposition; cavilling against someone. Form VIII verbal noun, root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: In the Kitáb-i-Íqán the people's objection to each new Manifestation, as in اعتراض نمودند 'they cavilled'.

definition: Beatitude formula 'blessedness, happy is'; followed by li- 'to'. Root ṭ-y-b.
usage: Opens beatitudes throughout the Writings: طوبی للمقبلین 'Blessed are they that turn unto Him', طوبی لمن 'Well is it with him who'.

definition: Preposition عن 'from, away from, about' with the suffix 'him/it'.
notes: Often after verbs of turning away: اعرضت عنه 'thou hast turned away from it'.

definition: Noun: the moon. Root q-m-r.
usage: In the Kitáb-i-Íqán the sun and moon of prophecy are symbols, e.g. of the divines or of prayer and fasting, as in شمس و قمر 'the sun and moon'.

definition: Noun rabb, lord, with suffix -kum 'your (plural)'; genitive here. Root r-b-b.
usage: 'Your Lord'; frequent in the Arabic Writings, as in ربکم الرحمن 'your Lord, the All-Merciful'.

definition: Verbal noun: returning, going back, recourse; rujú‘ kardan/namúdan "to return". Root r-j-‘.
usage: Return, recourse; rujú‘ kardan 'to return, turn to', and in the Íqán the 'return' (rij‘at) of the Prophets in spirit.

definition: Preposition ‘alá "upon" with 3rd masculine singular suffix -hi: upon him, upon it, against him.
usage: Common in blessings such as علیه السلام 'upon him be peace' and علیه بهاء الله 'upon him be the Glory of God'.

definition: Determiner/pronoun: all, every, the whole of.
notes: Written here with the izáfih hamza split off (hamiy-i).

definition: Plural noun: allusions, signs, hints, indications. Root sh-w-r.
usage: Allusions and hints, paired with عبارات 'words', as in 'explicit words and allusions' of the Scriptures.

definition: Noun: tongue; language, speech. Root l-s-n.
usage: Tongue, language; as in لسان عظمت 'the Tongue of Grandeur', the voice of the Manifestation.

definition: Noun: tablet, board; a revealed Tablet or epistle; the Preserved Tablet. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: A revealed 'Tablet', the usual term for an epistle of Bahá'u'lláh or 'Abdu'l-Bahá, as in لوح احمد 'Tablet of Aḥmad'; also the Preserved Tablet (لوح محفوظ).
notes: Conventionally transliterated Lawḥ even in Persian. Plural alváḥ.

definition: Adverb: ever; with a negative verb, never.
Arabic interrogative adverb: how? in what way?
Plural of ḥadíth: reported sayings of the Prophet Muḥammad and the Imams; traditions. Root ḥ-d-th.
usage: In the Íqán the 'traditions' of Islam, often paired with روایات, cited as prophecies of the new Manifestation.

definition: Noun: knowledge, learning, science. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Both divine knowledge and human learning, as in جوهر العلم 'the essence of knowledge' and the tradition العلم حجاب الأکبر 'knowledge is the most grievous veil'.
notes: In the Íqán quotation فی العلم read fi'l-‘ilm.

definition: Verbal noun (form V): reflection, meditation, pondering. Root f-k-r.
usage: The Writings repeatedly call for تفکّر, reflection on God's signs and tests; the Arabic imperative تفکّروا 'ponder ye' is common in the Aqdas.

definition: Noun used as preposition: according to, in accordance with, as in حسب الامر 'as commanded'. Root ḥ-s-b.
Verb: to think, deem, suppose, reckon. Root ḥ-s-b.
usage: Appears in Qur'anic quotations such as أ حسب الناس 'Do men think...'.

definition: Noun, plural of ‘alámat: signs, marks, tokens. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Íqán chiefly the foretold signs of the coming Manifestation, as in علامات ظهور 'the signs of the Revelation'.

definition: Noun: place of rest, dwelling, seat, abode. Root q-r-r.
usage: In the Writings an abode or seat, as in مقرّ یافتن 'to take up one's abode' and مقرّ سلطنت 'the seat of sovereignty'.

definition: Active participle: one who confesses or acknowledges something. Root q-r-r.
usage: In the Íqán often paired with مذعن, as in مقرّ و مذعنند 'they acknowledge and confess'.

definition: Verb, present of شدن: they become, they are (also forms the passive). Persian.
Relative adjective from huwíyya "He-ness": pertaining to the divine Essence or Identity; a philosophical and Sufi term.
usage: In the Writings هویّت denotes God's hidden Essence; the Manifestations are called شموس هویّه "Suns of the divine Identity" and جواهر هویّه its gems.
notes: Derived from the pronoun هو "He"; no regular triliteral root.

definition: Preposition ilá 'to, toward' with the suffix -hi 'him, it'.
Noun: good-pleasure, divine approval; the garden of Paradise. Root r-ḍ-w.
usage: In the Hidden Words 'Paradise', as in اهل رضوان 'people of Paradise'; also the Garden of Riḍván and the Festival of Bahá'u'lláh's Declaration.

definition: Noun, plural of shams 'sun': suns; figuratively luminaries. Root sh-m-s.
usage: In the Íqán often the Manifestations of God as Suns of truth, as in شموس حقیقت 'Suns of Truth' and شموس علم 'suns of knowledge'.

definition: Noun: going astray, error, misguidance; the opposite of hidáyat 'guidance'. Root ḍ-l-l.
usage: Spiritual error, paired with or opposed to هدایت 'guidance', as in سراج ضلالت 'the lamp of error'.

definition: Victory, mastery, prevailing; with نمودن 'to prevail, to overcome'. Root gh-l-b.
usage: Used of the self or passion gaining the mastery, and of God's or the Prophets' ascendancy, as in غلبه نماید 'should prevail'.

definition: Noun: the unseen, the hidden realm beyond perception; absence. Root gh-y-b.
usage: Frequent for the hidden divine realm, as in عالم غیب 'the invisible world' and غیب منیع 'the impenetrable Mystery'; contrasted with شهود 'the visible'.
notes: Read ghayb-i before an izáfih.

definition: Noun, plural of haykal: temples, bodies, forms; persons as vessels of a spirit. Root h-y-k-l.
usage: In the Writings 'temples', bodies or human forms, as in هیاکل خلد 'the denizens of the eternal paradise' and هیاکل الهیّه 'the divine Temples' (the Manifestations).

definition: Fragment of the Persian vocative particle ای "O", split from its ی in this text's spelling.
notes: Here written ا ی for ای, as in ای صاحب دو چشم 'O thou possessor of two eyes'.

definition: Arabic interrogative hamza introducing a yes/no question: "is it that...?", "do you...?"
notes: Written separately here, as in أ تحبّ ان تموت 'wouldst thou die...?' and أ فرأیت 'hast thou seen?'.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV: informing, giving news; with نمودن/کردن 'to inform'. Root kh-b-r.
usage: Used with نمودن or کردن, as in اخبار نمائید 'inform', 'give tidings'.
notes: Context here is the verbal noun ikhbár; the plural akhbár 'traditions' is listed separately.

definition: Plural of khabar: reports, news; in religious usage the traditions (hadith) of the Prophet and Imams. Root kh-b-r.
usage: In the Íqán paired with احادیث: احادیث و اخبار 'traditions and sayings', the Islamic traditions about the Day of God.

definition: Verbal noun: taking, receiving, acquiring; used in Persian with نمودن 'to take'. Root a-kh-dh.
usage: In the Íqán often of taking knowledge or guidance from a source, as in اخذ ننمودند 'they did not acquire'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): he took, seized; of God, to punish, overtake. Root a-kh-dh.
usage: In Qur'anic quotations of God's chastisement: اخذهم اللّه بذنبهم 'God seized them for their sins'.

definition: Plural of ism: names, especially the divine names and attributes. Root s-m-w.
usage: Frequent in phrases like مالک اسماء 'the Lord of Names' and ملکوت اسماء 'the Kingdom of Names', the realm of divine attributes.

definition: Adjective and divine name: wise, all-wise, one possessing wisdom and sound judgement. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: Divine name 'the All-Wise', often paired with others, as in العزیز الحکیم 'the Mighty, the All-Wise'.
notes: Frequent closing formula innahu la-huwa ... al-ḥakím.

definition: Noun with article: existence, being; the whole of creation. Root w-j-d.
usage: Existence, being, the whole of creation; in phrases such as malakút al-wujúd 'the kingdom of being'.
notes: In the address yá ibna’l-wujúd "O Son of Being".

definition: Noun, plural of nafs "self, soul" with suffix -kum "your": your selves, yourselves. Root n-f-s.
usage: Means 'yourselves, your souls', often in exhortations to purify or examine oneself.
notes: Genitive here (fí khalqi anfusikum); accusative anfusakum after a verb.

definition: Noun (form V verbal noun): manifestation, revelation, effulgence of light. Root j-l-w.
usage: The effulgence or self-revelation of God in His Manifestations and in creation, as in تجلّی الهی 'divine effulgence'; a key term in the Íqán.

definition: Noun: religion, faith; in Arabic also judgement (yawm ad-dín). Root d-y-n.
usage: Religion, as in دین الله 'the religion of God'; in Arabic also judgement, as in یوم الدین 'the Day of Judgement'.

definition: Active participle: returning, going back; with shudan 'to return'. Root r-j-‘.
usage: Returning; with شدن 'to return', and راجع به 'concerning'.

definition: Noun: might, glory, honour, preciousness. Root ‘-z-z.
usage: 'Glory, might', frequent in divine titles and phrases such as قلم عزّ 'the Pen of Glory' and the address ای پسر عزّ 'O Son of Glory'.
notes: 'qalam-i-‘izz' the Pen of Glory; 'ای پسر عزّ' O Son of Glory.

definition: Noun: heedlessness, negligence, unawareness. Root gh-f-l.
usage: Heedlessness of God and His Revelation, a major spiritual fault in the Writings; in phrases such as خواب غفلت "the sleep of heedlessness".

definition: Noun: wealth, riches, self-sufficiency, independence of all save God. Root gh-n-y.
usage: Wealth or riches, and spiritually independence of all save God; the Hidden Words contrast worldly غنا with poverty in God, as in 'O ye rich ones'; الغنی is a divine name 'the Self-Sufficient'.
notes: Persian spelling of Arabic ghiná’.

definition: Preposition fí 'in' with suffix -há 'it, her': in it, therein.
Noun: the Resurrection, the Day of Judgement. Arabic qiyáma, root q-w-m.
usage: In the Íqán the Resurrection is the appearance of the next Manifestation of God; روز قیامت 'the Day of Resurrection'.

definition: Passive participle (form II), feminine: sent down, revealed (of words, verses or a table). Root n-z-l.
usage: Used of revelation, as in کلمات منزله 'the revealed words', آیات منزله 'the revealed verses' and مائدهٔ منزله 'the heavenly food sent down'.
notes: Persian izáfih may follow (منزلهٔ).

definition: Noun: rank, station, standing; بمنزلهٔ 'as, in the place of'. Root n-z-l.
usage: Mostly in بمنزلهٔ / بمنزلة 'as, like unto', e.g. بمنزلة البصر 'as sight'.
notes: Same letters as munazzalih 'revealed'; context decides.

definition: Present tense of guftan 'to say', third person plural: they say, they are saying.
Noun: unbelief, infidelity, denial of God or His Messenger. Root k-f-r.
usage: In the Writings the denial of the Manifestation, opposed to ایمان 'faith'; e.g. کفر و ضلالت 'unbelief and error'.

definition: Adjective and divine name: the All-Knowing, He who knows all things. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: A divine name closing many verses, as in العلیم الحکیم 'the All-Knowing, the All-Wise' and العلیم الخبیر 'the All-Knowing, the All-Informed'.
notes: Case ending varies: al-‘Alími after a genitive, al-‘Alímu as subject.

definition: Plural noun used only in construct: those possessed of, people of.
usage: Qur'anic formula یا اولی الأبصار 'O ye that have eyes to see' and یا اولی الألباب 'O men of understanding'.
notes: Genitive/accusative of أولو; read with the article as úli'l-abṣár.

definition: Persian conjunction: although, even though, even if.
Noun: dust, earth, soil; by extension man's lowly origin. Root t-r-b.
usage: In the Writings 'dust', man's humble origin, as in ای پسر تراب 'O Son of Dust'; also the earth as a mirror of the divine light.

definition: Noun (Arabic verbal noun): love, affection. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: Frequent in the Hidden Words, e.g. ای پسر حبّ 'O Son of Love', حبّ الله 'the love of God'.

definition: Verb, 2nd plural present subjunctive or imperative of shudan 'to become'; forms compound verbs.
usage: Forms compound verbs such as راجع شوید 'return ye' and داخل شوید 'enter ye'.

definition: Noun: face, countenance, aspect; by extension the person himself, used reverentially. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: A reverential term for a Manifestation of God, as in طلعت موعود 'the promised Countenance' or آن طلعت بیمثال 'that peerless Beauty'; also طلعت اعلی for the Báb.
notes: Shoghi Effendi renders it variously as Countenance, Beauty or Person.

definition: Noon, midday; also the midday prayer (فریضهٔ ظهر). Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: In the Íqán the midday hour or the noon prayer, e.g. از صبح تا ظهر 'from morn till noon'.
notes: Not to be confused with ẓahr 'back' or ẓahara 'appeared'.

definition: Form I verb: he/it appeared, became manifest, came forth. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: Very common in the Aqdas of the appearance of the Manifestation or His Cause, e.g. ظهر الوعد 'the Promise hath appeared'.

definition: Preposition: at, with, in the presence of; with مِن it means 'from (the presence of)'.
usage: In the Aqdas almost always in من لدن 'from', as in من لدن مالک الرقاب 'from the Lord of all men'.

definition: Preposition li 'to, for' with the suffix -hum 'them'; with a noun it expresses possession, 'they have'.
notes: In لهم قلوب لا یفقهون بها 'they have hearts with which they understand not' (Qur'an 7:179).

definition: Aforementioned, mentioned above; Arabic feminine form agreeing with a plural noun in Persian. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Frequent in the Íqán after plural nouns, as in علامات مذکوره 'the aforementioned signs'.

definition: Noun: subject, topic, matter under discussion; literally 'thing sought'. Root ṭ-l-b.
usage: In the Íqán 'the theme' or 'the subject', as in از مطلب دور ماندیم 'we have strayed from our theme'.

definition: Verbal noun: preventing, hindering, forbidding, withholding. Root m-n-‘.
usage: In the Íqán of divines who hindered the people from the Manifestation, often with از: منع ایشان از 'keeping them from'.

definition: Present tense of ámadan, to come: comes, is coming, will come.
Plural of arḍ, earth or land: the earths; with as-samáwát it denotes all creation. Root '-r-ḍ.
usage: 'The earths'; paired with السموات in the phrase 'the heavens and the earths' denoting all creation.
notes: Shoghi Effendi usually renders 'the heavens and the earth'.

definition: Noun: broken plural of nafs: souls, selves, persons. Root n-f-s.
usage: Souls, selves, persons; often of people generally, as in anfus-i zakiyyih 'pure souls'.

definition: Elative adjective: more, most, the majority of; "akthar-i kutub" most books. Root k-th-r.
usage: Most or the majority, as in اکثر ناس 'most people', often describing those who remained heedless.

definition: Adjective (Arabic feminine of báqí): enduring, abiding, everlasting. Root b-q-y.
usage: Everlasting, as opposed to فانی 'perishing'; of God's everlasting dominion, bounties and the abiding Word.
notes: Arabic feminine agreement used with Persian nouns.

definition: Preposition bi- with demonstrative dhálika: by, with or to that; thereby, thereof.
notes: Sháhidun bi-dhálika = a witness thereto.

definition: Noun in construct, written without alif between two names: son of. Root b-n-y.
usage: 'Son of' in names, as in عیسی بن مریم 'Jesus son of Mary'.
notes: As in ‘Ísá bin Maryam, Músá bin ‘Imrán.

definition: Verb, imperfect 2nd person singular of kána 'to be' with energetic -anna: thou shalt surely be. Root k-w-n.
notes: Energetic form, often after la‘alla or la-.

definition: Genitive of dhú: possessor of, endowed with; "dhi'l-Jalál" the Lord of glory.
usage: In divine titles such as ذی الجلال "the Lord of Glory" and ذی العرش "the Lord of the Throne".
notes: Before the article the vowel is shortened (dhi'l-).

definition: Adjective from aṣ-Ṣamad 'the Eternal, Self-Subsisting': eternal, divine. Root ṣ-m-d.
usage: Eternal or divine, derived from the divine name الصّمد; found in phrases such as عنایات صمدانی 'eternal bounties' and قدرت صمدانی 'divine power'.

definition: Preposition: at, with, in the presence of; min ‘ind 'from (someone)'. Root ‘-n-d.
usage: Common in من عند الله 'from God' and عند الله 'in the sight of God'.

definition: Adjective: heedless, unaware, negligent. Active participle of ghafala; root gh-f-l.
usage: Heedless of God or of His Day; از ... غافل 'heedless of', and the Arabic plural الغافلین 'the heedless'.

definition: Noun: city, town. Root m-d-n.
usage: A city, often figurative, as in مدینهٔ قدسیّه 'the holy city' or مدینهٔ ایقان 'the City of Certitude'; also Medina, the Prophet's city.

definition: Proper noun: Medina, the city of the Prophet Muḥammad in Arabia.
usage: In the Kitáb-i-Íqán's accounts of the Prophet's life, the city of Medina.

definition: Passive participle: written, inscribed, set down in lines. Root s-ṭ-r.
usage: Used of what is recorded in the Tablets or the Books, often paired: مذکور و مسطور 'recorded and inscribed'.

definition: Noun: amount, quantity, measure; چه مقدار 'how much, how many'. Root q-d-r.
usage: In the Íqán often in چه مقدار 'how many', stressing the number of afflictions or enemies.

definition: Negative imperative of نهادن 'to put, place'; از دست منه 'do not let it slip from your hand'.
Arabic preposition من 'from, of' with the pronoun 'him, it'.
notes: Common in the Arabic of the Aqdas and in quotations in the Íqán.

definition: Adverb: still, yet; with a negative verb, not yet. Persian.
Persian adverb: as if, apparently, it seems; also adjective "eloquent, speaking".
Adjective: eternal without beginning, pre-existent; from azal 'eternity past'. Root a-z-l.
usage: In the Writings an attribute of God and of the Manifestation, as in جمال ازلی 'the eternal Beauty'; paired with ابدی 'everlasting'.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV amkana: possibility, contingency; with the article, the contingent world, all created things. Root m-k-n.
usage: In the Writings الامکان and عالم امکان denote the world of creation, all that is other than God, e.g. من فی الامکان 'all who are in the realm of being'.
notes: After fí it is read fi'l-imkán.

definition: Noun: justice, equity, fairness. Root ‘-d-l.
usage: Above all in بیت العدل 'the House of Justice', the supreme Bahá'í institution ordained in the Aqdas; also justice as a divine attribute and a social principle.

definition: Noun with article: the tablet, board; a revealed epistle. Plural alwáḥ. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: In the Writings a Tablet, a revealed letter of Bahá'u'lláh; in the Aqdas هذا اللوح 'this Tablet' is the Aqdas itself; also اللوح المحفوظ 'the Guarded Tablet'.

definition: Án 'moment, instant' with the indefinite -í: a single moment, an instant.
usage: Common in phrases such as آنی نیست 'not for a moment' and بآنی 'in an instant'.

definition: The emphatic particle inna with the 1st person suffix: verily I, truly I am.
usage: Very common in divine speech, e.g. انّی انا اللّه 'Verily, I am God'.

definition: Preposition bi- with al-ḥaqq: in truth, with truth, rightly; also 'by the Truth', i.e. God. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: A frequent formula in the Writings, e.g. نزّل بالحق 'sent down in truth'; الحق alone often names God.

definition: Oath formula: the oath particle ta- with Alláh, 'by God!'.
usage: An emphatic Qur'anic oath, as in Aqdas قل یا ایها الکذّاب تاللّه 'Say: O lying one! By God!'.
notes: The ta- of oath is used only with the name of God.

definition: Perishing, transitory, mortal; feminine form agreeing with a plural noun. Root f-n-y.
usage: Contrasts the perishable world with the abiding, as in اموال فانیه 'mortal riches'; opposite باقیه 'abiding'.

definition: Preposition: at, with, in the presence of, in the sight of.
usage: Frequent in the Aqdas: من لدی 'from', لدی الله 'in the sight of God', لدی العرش 'before the Throne'.

definition: Adjective: covered, veiled, hidden, concealed. Root s-t-r.
usage: Common for hidden realities and mysteries: مستور ماندن 'to remain hidden', مستور نمودن 'to conceal'.

definition: Noun: company, assembly, community of people, used in address. Root ‘-sh-r.
usage: Used in addresses, as in یا معشر العلماء 'O concourse of divines'.

definition: Negative past participle of shudan, to become; with ast omitted it means 'has not become' or 'has not been'.
notes: Used as a perfect: ẓáhir nashudih 'has not appeared'.

definition: Verb (form VII, impersonal): it is fitting, it behooves, one ought. Root b-gh-y.
usage: It behooves, one ought; frequent in counsels: yanbaghí li-kulli nafsin 'it behooveth every soul'.
notes: Usually followed by an "that" + subjunctive.

definition: Noun, plural of fi‘l: deeds, acts, actions. Root f-‘-l.
usage: Deeds and actions, often paired with اقوال 'words', as in the call for deeds to match words.

definition: Noun, double plural of amr (via umúr): matters, affairs, things. Root ’-m-r.
usage: Matters or affairs; a double plural common in older Persian, now considered incorrect for امور.
notes: Persian double plural.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): fairness, equity, justice, impartiality. Root n-ṣ-f.
usage: Fairness or equity, highly praised in the Writings; often paired with عدل and urged on seekers, as in 'the eye of fairness'.
notes: Ay pisar-i inṣáf = O Son of Justice.

definition: Interjection: yes, indeed; affirms or resumes an argument.
notes: Arabic balá; Persian reading balí.

definition: Noun: truth, truthfulness, sincerity. Root ṣ-d-q.
usage: 'Truthfulness, sincerity', praised as the foundation of all virtues and often paired with وفا 'faithfulness'.
notes: Paired with vafá 'faithfulness'.

definition: Verb, Form I past: he knew, recognized. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: To know or recognize; in the Writings especially recognition of God and His Manifestation, as in من عرف نفسه فقد عرف ربه "he who hath known himself hath known his Lord".
notes: Man ‘arafa nafsahu faqad ‘arafa rabbahu: he who hath known himself hath known his Lord.

definition: Noun: fragrance, scent, sweet savour. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: Fragrance, a frequent image for the spiritual influence of the Revelation, as in عرف القمیص "the fragrance of the Garment".
notes: Common in the Aqdas, e.g. "‘arf qamíṣí" the fragrance of My garment.

definition: Perfect third plural of farmúdan 'to command, deign'; honorific auxiliary: (they) have said or done.
usage: Honorific verb used for the deeds and sayings of the Manifestations and holy souls, as in فرموده‌اند 'They have said'; stands in for گفتن or کردن.
notes: Honorific substitute for kardan with a noun, e.g. iráda farmúdih-and 'have intended'.

definition: Preposition fí 'in' with suffix -ka 'thee': in thee, within thee.
Noun nafs 'self, soul' with suffix -ka 'thy': thyself, thine own self. Root n-f-s.
usage: نفس is the self or soul, often the selfish self to be renounced, as in أعرض عن نفسک 'turn away from thyself'; also 'person'.

definition: Arabic demonstrative pronoun, feminine singular: this; also used with non-human plurals.
Adjective (Arabic feminine form): clear, evident, manifest. Root w-ḍ-ḥ.
usage: Qualifies proofs and signs, as دلائل واضحه 'clear proofs'.

definition: Noun, plural of áyah with article: the verses, the signs (of God). Root ’-y-y.
usage: In the Writings both revealed verses and divine signs; منزل الآیات 'the Revealer of verses' is a title of God.
notes: Case varies: al-áyáta (accusative) in the Qur'anic quotation, al-áyáti (genitive) in the Aqdas.

definition: Noun: place of standing, station, rank, spiritual degree. Root q-w-m.
usage: In the Writings a spiritual station or rank, as in مقام محمود 'the praiseworthy station'; also a sacred spot or shrine.

definition: Divine name: the Guardian, the Protector, the One who watches over and prevails over all. Root h-y-m-n (quadriliteral).
usage: A divine attribute, typically in the pair المهیمن القیوم 'the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting'.

definition: Arabic demonstrative pronoun: those (people), plural of dhálika; often opens a Qur'anic clause.
usage: Frequent in Qur'anic quotations in the Íqán, as in اولئک لهم عذاب "for them is a chastisement".
notes: Written اولئک; the و is not pronounced.

definition: Demonstrative adjective 'this kind of, such', from این 'this' and گونه 'kind, manner'.
Adjective and noun: false, vain, null; falsehood as opposed to ḥaqq, truth. Root b-ṭ-l.
usage: Often paired with حق: حق از باطل 'truth from falsehood'; گمان باطل 'vain imaginings'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with, by, in' plus Arabic nár 'fire'. Root n-w-r.
usage: Nár is fire, often the fire of passion or of the love of God, as in نار امل و شهوت 'the fire of desire and lust' and نار محبّت 'the fire of love'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with, by, in, for' joined to the demonstrative hádhá 'this' (masculine singular).
Rank, degree, station, standing. Root r-t-b.
usage: Used of the degree or station of souls, as in رتبهٔ ناس 'the station of the people'.

definition: Noun: rejection, refusal, refutation; also returning. Root r-d-d.
usage: In the Íqán the rejection of the Prophets, e.g. رد و تکذیب 'repudiation and denial'; رد نمودن 'to reject'.

definition: Noun: a great tent, pavilion or canopy, as of a king. Root s-r-d-q.
usage: In the Writings the heavenly pavilion or tabernacle, as in سرادق خلد 'the pavilion of eternity', and the Pavilion of God's glory or Cause.

definition: Heavens, skies; plural of samá’. Root s-m-w.
usage: Often symbolic in the Íqán, as in سموات رحمت 'the heavens of mercy'; also سموات و ارض 'the heavens and the earth'.

definition: Noun: year; Arabic loan used in formal Persian, especially with numbers. Root s-n-w.
usage: In the Íqán counting the duration of dispensations, as in هفتصد سنه 'seven hundred years'.

definition: Noun: thing, anything, something; in کلّ شیء 'all things, everything'. Root sh-y-’.
usage: Very frequent in کلّ شیء 'all things', e.g. علی کلّ شیء قدیر 'hath power over all things'.
notes: Here spelt شئ in the text; nominative/genitive shay’in in recitation.

definition: Adjective: outward, external, visible, literal, as opposed to inner. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: In the Íqán contrasts the outward (ظاهری) with the inner meaning, as in شمس ظاهری 'the outward sun'.

definition: Plural of ‘abd, servant or worshipper, with suffix -í 'my'. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: 'My servants', God's address to humanity; the Hidden Words and Aqdas often open with یا عبادی 'O My servants'.

definition: Noun: throne, especially the divine Throne; seat of sovereignty. Root ‘-r-sh.
usage: Throne, especially the divine Throne; also a seat of sovereignty and, figuratively, the Manifestation's station.

definition: Arabic adverbial phrase used in Persian: in truth, in reality, verily. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: Arabic phrase used in Persian to mean 'in truth, in reality'.
notes: Joined phrase fí + al-ḥaqíqa; Persian final -ih.

definition: Noun: acceptance, consent; with kardan/farmúdan "to accept". Root q-b-l.
usage: Acceptance, especially of the Manifestation and His Cause, as in قبول امر 'acceptance of the Cause'; also God's acceptance of deeds.

definition: Adjective: holy, sacred, of holiness. Root q-d-s.
usage: Holy, as in نفحات قدسی 'holy breezes' and فردوس قدسی; frequent in mystical imagery of the Writings.
notes: Ḥamámih-yi qudsí = the Dove of holiness.

definition: Particle: perhaps, haply, so that; followed by a verb in these texts.
Noun: will, volition; especially the Primal Will of God. Root sh-y-’.
usage: 'Will', especially the Primal Will (مشیّت اولیه) of God, the first emanation through which creation comes into being; as in فم مشیّت 'the mouth of the Divine Will'.
notes: 'fam-i-mashíyyat' the mouth of the Divine Will.

definition: Noun nafs (self, soul) with 3rd-person masculine suffix: his self, himself. Root n-f-s.
usage: Self, soul; as in the tradition من عرف نفسه "he who hath known his own self"; also used reflexively, "himself".
notes: Accusative nafsahu in "‘arafa nafsahu".

definition: Negative present of shudan 'to become': does not become, is not; also 'cannot be done'.
notes: Written نمی‌شود.

definition: Present perfect of gashtan 'to become, turn': they have become, they have been.
usage: A common auxiliary in Persian passages, e.g. محروم گشته‌اند 'have been deprived'.

definition: Verb: imperfect subjunctive of kána, 'to be'; here after an 'that'. Root k-w-n.
usage: Very common; ینبغی ان یکون 'it behoveth ... to be'.
notes: In the Íqán question أ یکون read the indicative yakúnu.

definition: Imperative plural of form VIII ittaqá: fear, be mindful of, guard yourselves. Root w-q-y.
usage: Mostly in the formula اتّقوا اللّه 'Fear God', a Qur'anic exhortation; related تقوی means fear of God, piety.

definition: Plural of thamar: fruits; figuratively results, fruits of deeds or of a tree. Root th-m-r.
usage: Usually figurative: the fruits of the divine Tree or of faith, as اثمار باقیه 'everlasting fruits'.

definition: Proper noun: Adam, the first man and first Prophet; in Persian also 'human being'.
usage: In the Hidden Words in پسران آدم 'children of Adam'; in the Íqán Adam opens the cycle of Prophets, as in عهد آدم 'the days of Adam'.

definition: Elative adjective: greatest, mightiest, most great. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: A key Bahá'í epithet, as in الاسم الاعظم 'the Most Great Name' and السّبب الأعظم 'the mightiest instrument'.

definition: Verbal noun: appearance, manifestation; the coming of a Manifestation of God, a Revelation. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: In the Writings the advent of a Manifestation of God, rendered 'Revelation' or 'Manifestation', as in اسرار الظهور 'the mysteries of Revelation'.

definition: Plural of ‘abd: servants, slaves, especially the servants of God, i.e. mankind. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: In the Writings العباد often means people in general as God's servants; rendered "the servants", "men" or "others", as in بعین العباد "through the eyes of others".

definition: Noun: grace, bounty, unmerited favour; also excellence. Root f-ḍ-l.
usage: In the Writings God's grace and bounty, as in فضل الله 'the grace of God' and کوثر الفضل 'the Kawthar of grace'.

definition: Plural of nabí, prophet: the Prophets. Root n-b-’.
usage: In the Íqán the Prophets of God collectively, e.g. انبیای قبل 'the Prophets of old', all reflecting one divine Reality.

definition: Adjective (feminine form in agreement): new, unprecedented, wondrous. Root b-d-‘.
usage: Describes the newness of revelation, as in معانی بدیعه 'wondrous meanings'; the related بدیع also names the Badí‘ era and calendar.

definition: Verbal noun of form II waḥḥada: declaring God to be one; the doctrine of divine unity. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: The oneness of God and its confession, as in کلمهٴ توحید 'the word of divine unity' and خمر توحید 'the wine of divine unity'; also the unity of the Manifestations.

definition: The Torah, the Law of Moses; by extension the Hebrew Scriptures.
usage: In the Íqán the Book of Moses, cited alongside the Gospel and the Qur'án.

definition: Noun jam‘ with indefinite -í: a group, a number of people. Root j-m-‘.
usage: In narratives a company of people, e.g. جمعی اصحاب 'a number of His companions'.

definition: Noun: a letter of the alphabet; a word, speech or talk. Root ḥ-r-f.
usage: In the Writings a letter or word, as in حرف اوّل 'the first letter'; also حروف حیّ 'the Letters of the Living', the Báb's first disciples.
notes: In the Íqán context (قادر بر حرف و تکلّم) it means 'speech'.

definition: Contentment, satisfaction, acquiescence; also good-pleasure, approval. Root r-ḍ-w.
usage: Both God's good-pleasure (رضای حق 'the good-pleasure of God') and the soul's contentment with His will, as in مدینه رضا 'the city of contentment'.

definition: Noun: injustice, oppression, tyranny, wrongdoing. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: Usually 'tyranny' or 'oppression', as in رعایای ظلم 'the subjects of tyranny' and the call to the oppressors to stay their hands.

definition: Collective noun: clouds, especially white clouds. Root gh-m-m.
usage: In the Íqán the 'clouds' of the Day of Judgment, interpreted as veils and trials; also clouds of bounty: غمام مکرمت.

definition: Conjunction: because, since; followed by a noun or pronoun suffix in the accusative.
Conjunction: when, after (with a past verb); with a jussive it means 'not yet'.
notes: Quranic quotation farartu minkum lammá khiftukum.

definition: Emphatic la- plus negative má in the answer of law or lawlá: would not.
notes: Hadith lawláka la-má khalaqtu al-afláka 'but for Thee I would not have created the spheres'.

definition: Preposition li- "for, to" plus kull "every, all": for every, to each. Root k-l-l.
Passive participle form VIII: afflicted, stricken, beset; with "shudan" to become afflicted or fall prey. Root b-l-w.
usage: Afflicted or beset, as in مبتلا شدن 'to fall prey' to tests, ills or heedlessness.

definition: Adjective (form IV passive participle): firm, fast, secure; as adverb firmly. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: Firm, secure; of steadfastness in the Covenant and of the clear, decisive verses (محکمات) as opposed to the ambiguous ones.

definition: Plural of maṭla‘: dawning-places, daysprings, places of rising. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: Daysprings or dawning-places, especially of the Manifestations, as in مطالع امر 'Daysprings of the Cause'.
notes: Used of the Manifestations of God.

definition: Plural noun: contingent beings, created things (that may or may not exist). Root m-k-n.
usage: Contingent beings, all created things, as against God the necessary Being (واجب الوجود).

definition: Preposition min 'from, of' with suffix -kum 'you (plural)': from you, of you.
Noun: temple, body, frame, form; the human temple. Root h-k-l.
usage: Temple, body; used of the human temple and of the Manifestation's person, as in هیکل الله "the Temple of God"; also the Súriy-i-Haykal.

definition: Abstract noun from ákhir 'last': the quality of being the Last, a divine attribute paired with awwaliyyat. Root ’-kh-r.
usage: The divine attribute of being the Last, paired with اوّلیّت 'firstness'; the Kitáb-i-Íqán applies both to the Manifestations, who are at once first and last.

definition: Noun ism 'name' with Persian indefinite -í 'a name'; in Arabic, ismí 'My name'. Root s-m-w.
usage: In the Writings often the Name of God or of the Manifestation, as in اسم اعظم 'the Most Great Name'.
notes: In the Arabic Hidden Word (علی اسمی) it is Arabic ismí 'My name'.

definition: Noun: names, plural of ism 'name'; especially the divine names and attributes. Root s-m-w.
usage: The divine names and attributes, as in ملکوت الأسماء 'the Kingdom of names' and اعراش الأسماء 'the thrones of the names'.
notes: Genitive al-asmá’i in the Aqdas context.

definition: Noun: majesty, glory, sublimity. Root j-l-l.
usage: A divine attribute, as in ذو الجلال 'the Lord of Glory' (Qur'anic ذو الجلال و الإکرام), often paired with جمال 'beauty'.
notes: After ذی it is read dhi'l-jalál.

definition: Noun: wisdom, sound judgment, philosophy; also hidden purpose. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: Frequent in phrases like اسرار الحکمة 'the mysteries of wisdom' and جواهر الحکمة 'the gems of wisdom'; also the wise purpose of God.

definition: Noun with article: the world, creation; plural al-‘álamín 'the worlds'. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Aqdas often of the human world, as in نظم العالم 'the order of the world'; ربّ العالمین 'Lord of the worlds'.
notes: Genitive al-‘álami in both contexts.

definition: Noun, plural of ‘álim: the learned, religious scholars, clergy. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Writings usually the Muslim clergy, rendered 'the divines', often criticized for rejecting the Manifestation; as in یا معشر العلماء 'O concourse of divines'.

definition: Active participle, form VIII: the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent; divine name. Root q-d-r.
usage: Divine name in closing formulas such as انّه لهو المقتدر المهیمن القدیر 'He verily is the Omnipotent, the Help in Peril, the Almighty'.

definition: Noun: dominion, sovereignty, kingdom; the earthly realm as opposed to malakút. Root m-l-k.
usage: In the Writings الملک is this world or sovereignty, contrasted with ملکوت "the Kingdom"; الملک للّه "the Kingdom is God's".

definition: Noun: king, sovereign; with the article a divine name, "the King". Root m-l-k.
usage: As a divine name الملک "the King", e.g. in الملک العزیز.

definition: Particle of correction or emphasis: 'nay, rather, but'; introduces the true statement after a denial.
Verbal noun of form II faṣṣala: detailed account, elaboration, the particulars. Root f-ṣ-l.
usage: In the Íqán often in چنانچه تفصیل آن در ... مذکور 'as the details thereof are recorded in ...'.

definition: Noun: recording, inscription, registration; with shudan/kardan 'to be recorded, to record'. Root th-b-t.
usage: In the Hidden Words ثبت شده 'hath been inscribed' of what the Pen has written on the Tablet.

shift: Here: the living body, the mortal frame contrasted with the soul. Today: mostly a corpse.
definition: Noun: body, physical frame; in modern Persian mostly a corpse. Root j-s-d.
usage: The mortal body, contrasted with the soul, as in این جسد فانی 'this mortal frame'.

definition: Guarding, preserving, protecting; also memorizing. With نمودن/فرمودن 'to protect'. Root ḥ-f-ẓ.
usage: Used of God's protection of man, e.g. ترا حفظ فرمودم 'I have guarded thee', and of guarding God's laws and trust.

definition: Noun: story, narrative, account; the act of relating. Root ḥ-k-y.
usage: Used for recounting past events, as in حکایت نمودن 'to relate'.

definition: Noun: religious law, the revealed path and its ordinances. Root sh-r-‘.
usage: In the Writings the law and ordinances of a Dispensation, as in شریعت مرتفعه 'the exalted law' of the Gospel or the Qur'an.

definition: Numeral "a hundred thousand", often used hyperbolically for "countless".
usage: Used hyperbolically, as in از صدهزار جان درگذرند 'they would lay down a hundred thousand lives'.

definition: Noun: ritual prayer, the obligatory prayer; Qur'anic spelling with wáw. Root ṣ-l-w.
usage: In the Writings the obligatory prayer, as in the Aqdas law of الصلوة 'the obligatory prayer'; in the Íqán listed with fasting (صلوة و صوم) as laws of every dispensation.

definition: Adjective: of the unseen, hidden, invisible, mysterious, divine. Root gh-y-b.
usage: In the Hidden Words of hidden meanings and divine bounties: معانی غیبی 'hidden meanings', بخششهای غیبی 'heavenly bounties'.

definition: Accusative of faḍl used adverbially: as a bounty, out of grace, as a favour. Root f-ḍ-l.
usage: Often فضلاً من عنده 'as a bounty from His presence'; fadl is God's grace or bounty.

definition: Plural of fáḍil: learned or accomplished men, scholars. Root f-ḍ-l.
usage: In the Íqán paired with divines, as in علما و فضلا 'divines and men of learning'.

definition: Passive participle of ḥabba: beloved, dear; as al-Maḥbúb the Beloved, God. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: 'Beloved'; as the Beloved, God or the Manifestation, the object of the lover's longing, as in محبوب عالمیان 'the Beloved of the worlds'.

definition: Active participle (form IV): informing, indicating; with bar "pointing to, signifying". Root sh-‘-r.
usage: Indicative, signifying; mush‘ir bar 'pointing to', said of verses or signs that indicate a truth.

definition: Active participle form IV: one who turns away, rejects; the opposite of muqbil. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: One who turns away from the Manifestation, the opposite of مقبل 'one who turns towards'; معرضین 'the rejecters'.

definition: Passive participle: forbidden, prevented, withheld, debarred. Root m-n-‘.
usage: Debarred or deprived, especially of God's bounty or recognition; also 'forbidden' in matters of law.

definition: Verb, present 3rd sing. of gardídan: becomes, turns; auxiliary forming the passive.
usage: From گردیدن 'to become'; very common as an auxiliary forming passives, e.g. ظاهر میگردد 'is made manifest'.
notes: Ẓáhir mígardad = is made manifest.

definition: Noun: point, dot; centre, focal point. Root n-q-ṭ.
usage: Point, centre; also the Primal Point (نقطهٔ اولی), a title of the Báb.

definition: Verb kána 'to be', perfect 1st person plural: we were; with inná it states a timeless fact. Root k-w-n.
notes: 'inná kunná shuhadá’' verily We are witness.

definition: Verb, Form I imperfect 3rd masc. sing.: he does, acts. Root f-‘-l.
usage: Echoes the Qur'anic یفعل ما یشاء "He doeth whatsoever He willeth", a phrase affirming God's sovereignty.
notes: Yaf‘alu'lláhu má yashá': God doeth whatsoever He willeth.

definition: Jussive of kána 'to be', mostly after lam: lam yakun 'was not, there was not'. Root k-w-n.
usage: Appears mostly in لم یکن 'was not', in phrases about God such as لم یکن معه من شیء 'nothing was with Him'.

definition: Verbal noun: guarding oneself against, shunning, avoiding. Root ḥ-r-z.
usage: In the Íqán with جستن: احتراز جستن 'to shun, hold aloof from' the Manifestation.

definition: Adjective: another, other; feminine of ákhar. Root '-kh-r.
usage: Common in مرّة اخری 'once again, a second time' and شمس اخری 'another sun'.

definition: Adjective, feminine of azalí: eternal, without beginning, pre-existent. From azal 'eternity without beginning'.
usage: Qualifies divine realities: حمامات ازلیّه 'the Doves of eternity', هیاکل ازلیّه 'eternal Temples', جمال ازلی 'the eternal Beauty'.

definition: Verb form IV: to turn away, turn aside from, shun. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: In the Writings turning away from God or His Manifestation, the opposite of اقبل 'turned towards'; من اعرض 'whoso turneth away'.

definition: Adjective used as a divine name: the All-Informed, All-Aware. Root kh-b-r.
usage: A Qur'anic name of God; in the Aqdas often in العلیم الخبیر 'the All-Knowing, the All-Informed'.

definition: Noun: creation, the act of creating; created beings, people. Root kh-l-q.
usage: In the Writings creation or created things, as in له الخلق و الأمر 'His is the creation and the command'.

definition: Noun: might, glory, honour, exaltation. Root ‘-z-z.
usage: Frequent in phrases like جبروت العزّة 'the Kingdom of glory' and سرادق العزّة 'the tabernacle of glory'.

definition: Noun: divine revelation, inspiration communicated to a prophet. Root w-ḥ-y.
usage: In the Writings the Revelation of God through His Manifestation, as in قلم الوحی "the Pen of Revelation" and مطلع الوحی "the Dayspring of Revelation".

definition: Prepositional phrase 'like, in the manner of', from bi- 'with' and mithl 'likeness'. Root m-th-l.
Imperfect 2nd person masculine plural of ‘alima: you know. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Frequent in Qur'anic formulas: ان کنتم لا تعلمون 'if ye know it not'; فسوف تعلمون 'ye shall soon know'.

definition: Demonstrative pronoun, feminine (also used for broken plurals): that, those.
usage: Common in quotations, as in تلک الرسل 'those Messengers' and تلک الأیّام 'those days'.

definition: Present perfect 3rd plural of justan 'to seek'; in تمسّک جستن 'to cling to, lay hold on'.
usage: In the Íqán mostly in the compound تمسّک جستن 'to cling to', of those who hold to the sayings of men.

definition: Generosity, munificence, bounty. Root j-w-d.
usage: A divine attribute; in the Hidden Words the address ای پسر جود 'O Son of Bounty', and الکرم و الجود 'generosity and bounty'.

definition: Noun ḥarf with indefinite -í: a letter, a word, a single utterance. Root ḥ-r-f.
usage: Literally 'letter'; in the Writings also حروف حی 'Letters of the Living', and figuratively a mere word or name.

definition: Noun: sealing, seal, conclusion; in religious use the Seal of the Prophets. Root kh-t-m.
usage: In the Íqán ختم انبیا 'the Seal of the Prophets' (Muhammad), whose meaning Bahá'u'lláh explains; طلعت ختم 'the Countenance of the Seal'.

definition: Essence, self, very being; in Arabic constructs also "possessor of". Root dh-w-t.
usage: Often of God's unknowable Essence, as in ذات احدیّه 'the Divine Essence'; in Arabic ذات بینکم 'your mutual relations'.

definition: Noun: scent, fragrance, odour; figuratively a trace or hint. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Often figurative: the fragrance of the spirit or of divine knowledge, as in رائحهٔ روحانی 'a spiritual fragrance'.

definition: Noun: lote-tree; the Divine Tree, symbol of the Manifestation of God. Root s-d-r.
usage: From the Qur'anic سدرة المنتهی 'the Lote-Tree beyond which there is no passing'; in the Writings the Manifestation, as in سدرهٔ ربّانیّه 'the divine Tree'.

definition: Imperative of shudan: become, be; often forms compound verbs, as وارد شو 'enter'.
Noun: owner, possessor, master, companion; before a noun 'one having', e.g. ṣáḥib-kitáb 'possessor of a Book'. Root ṣ-ḥ-b.
usage: 'Possessor, master'; in phrases like صاحب امر 'Lord of the Cause' and صاحب کتاب 'possessor of a Book'.
notes: Hidden Words: 'O man of two visions'.

definition: Noun: darkness, gloom; figuratively error and ignorance. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: Darkness; figuratively error and ignorance, contrasted with the light (núr) of guidance.

definition: Noun: torment, punishment, chastisement. Root ‘-dh-b.
usage: Torment or chastisement, as in عذاب الیم 'grievous torment', often in Qur'anic allusions.

definition: Noun, plural of ‘alámat: signs, tokens, marks. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Signs and tokens, especially the signs of the Day of God and of the Promised One's advent discussed in the Íqán.
notes: Also spelled علائم.

definition: Verb (form I perfect): he won, succeeded, attained; with bi-: attained unto. Root f-w-z.
usage: Of attaining success or salvation, as in فاز بلقاء الله 'attained the Presence of God'.

definition: Proper noun: Pharaoh, title of the kings of Egypt; in the Íqán the opponent of Moses.
usage: Pharaoh, the archetype of the proud tyrant who opposed Moses.

definition: Present stem and imperative of farmúdan 'to command'; used honorifically as auxiliary with nouns: mulaḥaẓih farmá 'consider'.
usage: Used as a courteous auxiliary in place of کن 'do', as in ملاحظه فرما 'consider', in addresses and supplications.
notes: Courteous substitute for kun 'do'.

definition: Preposition fí + relative má: in what, in that which, concerning what.
Perfect verb: he decreed, ordained, judged; also fulfilled, settled. Root q-ḍ-y.
usage: Used of God's decree, as in قضی الامر 'the matter was decreed'; also of things fulfilled or ordained.
notes: In kadhálika qaḍá/quḍiya the passive reading quḍiya 'was decreed' is also possible.

definition: Preposition li- 'for, to' with aḥad 'one, anyone'. Root a-ḥ-d (w-ḥ-d).
usage: In laws such as لیس لاحد ان 'none hath the right to', 'it is not for anyone to'.

definition: Verbal noun: meeting, encounter; attaining someone's presence. Root l-q-y.
usage: Chiefly لقاء الله 'attainment unto the Divine Presence', which the Íqán explains as attaining the presence of God's Manifestation.

definition: Noun: water. Arabic, used in elevated Persian. Root m-w-h.
usage: Often figurative, as in ماء الحیوان 'the water of life'; in the Aqdas مآء governs the laws of ablution and bathing.

definition: Active participle form VIII: veiled, screened, hidden from sight. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: Describes souls veiled from recognizing the Manifestation of God, as محتجب ماندن 'to remain veiled'.

definition: Passive participle of form X: derived, inferred, understood; مستفاد شدن 'to be gathered'. Root f-y-d.
usage: In the Íqán in از ... مستفاد میشود 'it is gathered from...', introducing the sense of a verse or tradition.

definition: Passive participle: appointed, designated, fixed, specified. Root ‘-y-n.
usage: Usually 'appointed' or 'fixed', as in معیّن فرمودن 'to ordain, appoint'.

definition: Preposition من with suffix ها: from it, from her, of it.
Present tense of دادن "to give": they give; in compounds such as نسبت دادن "impute", حرکت دادن "move".
Noun: prophet, one who brings tidings from God. Root n-b-'.
usage: In the Writings the Prophets of God; the Íqán treats them as Manifestations of one Reality, as in نبیّ بعد 'the Prophet to come'; pl. انبیا.

definition: Negative simple past, third plural, of shudan 'to become'; as auxiliary it forms passives: they were not, did not become.
Verb, negative present perfect 3rd plural of namúdan 'to do, to make'; auxiliary in compound verbs.
usage: Forms negative compounds such as ادراک ننموده‌اند 'have not understood'.

definition: Adjective váḍiḥ 'clear, evident' with the enclitic -ast 'is': it is evident. Root w-ḍ-ḥ.
Cup, goblet, chalice. Root k-’-s.
usage: A frequent image of divine knowledge or love, e.g. کأس جمال باقی 'the cup of the everlasting Beauty', کأس العلم 'the cup of knowledge'.

definition: Verb: they were; past of kána 'to be', also an auxiliary with the imperfect: they used to. Root k-w-n.
usage: Frequent in Qur'anic quotations, e.g. کانوا به یستهزئون 'they laughed it to scorn'.

definition: Verb, past 3rd person plural: they disbelieved, denied the truth. Root k-f-r.
usage: Common in Qur'anic quotations, as in الّذین کفروا 'they that disbelieve' or 'the infidels'.

definition: Perfect 2nd person masculine plural of kána "to be": you were; after in "if you are". Root k-w-n.
usage: Common in Qur'anic quotations, as in ان کنتم صادقین 'if ye be truthful'.

definition: Noun: harm, hurt, molestation, persecution. Root ’-dh-y.
usage: In the Íqán of the persecution the Prophets suffered, often paired with ایذا.

definition: Plural of روح: spirits, souls. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Common for human souls, often paired with افئده 'hearts' or اجساد 'bodies'.

definition: Verbal noun: mockery, ridicule, scorn. Root h-z-’.
usage: In the Íqán describes the people's treatment of the Prophets, as in سخریه و استهزاء 'derision and ridicule'.

definition: Noun: power, might, ability; divine omnipotence. Root q-d-r.
usage: 'Power, might', especially divine omnipotence, as in ملکوت القدرة 'the kingdom of power'.
notes: Genitive in bi-lisáni al-qudrati and bi-anámili al-qudrati.

definition: Noun with article: plural of qalb: hearts. Root q-l-b.
usage: Hearts; the heart is the seat of faith and knowledge, as in muqallib al-qulúb 'Turner of hearts'.

definition: Noun with article: light, radiance. Root n-w-r.
usage: Light, a pervasive image for divine revelation and guidance, as in نور الله 'the Light of God'.
notes: Yá Ibna’n-Núr O Son of Light (genitive).

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): spending, expending, giving away one's means. Root n-f-q.
usage: Spending one's means in the path of God; generosity and giving to the poor for God's sake.

definition: Abstract noun: firstness, being the First (a divine attribute). Root '-w-l.
usage: The divine attribute of being the First, paired with آخریت 'lastness' in discussions of the Manifestations in the Íqán.
notes: Paired with ákhiríyyat, Lastness.

definition: Verbal noun (form V): reflection, careful consideration; with kardan or ikhtiyár kardan 'to ponder'. Root '-m-l.
usage: Reflection; readers are often urged to ponder (تأمل نمایند) a proof or verse.

definition: Verbal noun (form II): alteration, perversion; especially corruption of a scriptural text. Root ḥ-r-f.
usage: In the Kitáb-i-Íqán 'corruption' of the scriptures; Bahá'u'lláh explains that the earlier Books were corrupted in meaning, not in their text.
notes: With shudan: to be corrupted.

definition: Plural of ḥadd: limits, boundaries; ordinances or bounds set by God. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: Limits; in the Aqdas the ordinances of God (حدود الله "the ordinances of God"); also the limitations of the human world.

definition: Noun: seal, signet ring; Khátam an-Nabiyyín 'Seal of the Prophets', a title of Muḥammad. Root kh-t-m.
usage: In the Writings chiefly خاتم النّبیّین 'the Seal of the Prophets', a title of Muḥammad whose meaning the Kitáb-i-Íqán explains; also a seal or signet.

definition: Preposition or noun: below, other than, besides; dún-i dhálik 'other than that, and the like'. Root d-w-n.
usage: In the Writings دون الله 'other than God'; in the Íqán و دون ذلک 'and the like'.

definition: Noun rabb 'Lord' with suffix -hu 'his': his Lord. Root r-b-b.
usage: From the tradition من عرف نفسه فقد عرف ربّه 'He hath known God who hath known himself' and the verse لقآء ربّه 'the meeting with his Lord'.

definition: Noun (collective): rabble, riffraff, the base populace. Root r-‘-‘.
usage: Almost always in the pair همج رعاع 'the foolish rabble', for the ignorant who follow the clergy.

definition: Noun: question, inquiry, request. Root s-'-l.
usage: Common word for a question or inquiry; سؤال نمودن 'to ask'.

definition: Noun: doubt, uncertainty, misgiving; شبهه نمودن 'to doubt'. Root sh-b-h.
usage: In the Íqán the doubts of those who question clear proofs, as in شکّ و شبهه 'doubt and misgiving'.

definition: Noun: breast, bosom, heart; also the front, beginning or head of something. Root ṣ-d-r.
usage: In the Writings often the breast as the seat of the heart, to be sanctified or expanded, as in صدر مقدّس 'a sanctified breast'.

definition: Adjective: dark, full of darkness; spiritually benighted. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: Describes spiritual darkness, as in لیل ظلمانی 'the darksome night' and غبار تیرهٴ ظلمانی 'the dark dust'.

definition: Noun: greatness, grandeur, majesty. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: In the Writings the majesty of God and of His Cause, as in عظمت امر "the greatness of the Cause".

definition: Preposition ‘inda 'with, in the possession of' with the suffix -kum; má ‘indakum 'what ye possess'.
usage: Often in ما عندکم 'that which ye possess', contrasted with what is with God (ما عند الله).

definition: Perfect 3rd person masculine plural of qála: they said. Root q-w-l.
usage: Common in Qur'anic quotations in the Íqán, e.g. انّ الّذین قالوا ربّنا الله 'they who say: Our Lord is God'.
notes: The final alif is orthographic and not pronounced.

definition: Adjective (Arabic 'does not cease'): everlasting, unfading, eternal. Root z-w-l.
usage: An epithet of God and His Manifestation, as in محبوب لایزال 'the immortal Beloved' and سلطان لایزال 'the everlasting King'.

definition: Adjective: subtle, fine, delicate, refined; gracious; as a divine name the Subtile. Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: Subtle, refined or pure, as in گوش لطیف 'an attentive ear' and خمر باقی لطیف 'the pure and everlasting wine'; also the divine name اللطیف 'the Subtile'.

definition: Bounded, limited, finite, restricted. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: Used of finite human souls and of the few, fleeting days of this world (ایّام محدوده).

definition: Passive participle: provided with sustenance, granted a portion. Root r-z-q.
usage: In the Writings being granted a share of divine bounty, as in مرزوق گشتن 'to partake of'.

definition: Preposition: with, together with, in company with.
notes: In من اراد ان یأنس مع اللّه 'He who would commune with God'.

definition: Established, appointed, fixed; with داشتن or کردن "to ordain, appoint". Form II, root q-r-r.
usage: In the Hidden Words with داشتن: برای تو مقرّر داشتم 'I have ordained for thee'.

definition: Collective noun: assembly, council, concourse, a people's notables. Root m-l-’.
usage: In addresses یا ملأ الارض 'O peoples of the earth', یا ملأ الانشاء 'O peoples of the world'; also الملأ الاعلی 'the Concourse on High'.

definition: Noun ملک 'dominion, kingdom, possession' with the suffix 'my'. Root m-l-k.
usage: HW: انت ملکی و ملکی لا یفنی 'Thou art My dominion and My dominion perisheth not'.

definition: Adjective: shining, luminous, radiant. Root n-w-r.
usage: Describes light, milk, hearts and tablets, as in اللوح المنیر 'the luminous Tablet'.

definition: Past continuous, third person plural, of guftan 'to say': they used to say, they were saying.
Noun: gnats, small flies; figuratively the worthless rabble, especially in hamaj ra‘á‘. Root h-m-j.
usage: Gnats; figuratively the worthless rabble, in hamaj ra‘á‘ 'the rabble', used of those who follow blindly.
notes: Exact rendering in Shoghi Effendi's Íqán not confirmed.

definition: Adjective: evident, visible, manifest; "huvaydá shudan" to become manifest.
usage: Manifest or evident, as in هویدا شدن 'to become manifest'.

definition: Verb, imperative masculine plural of kána: be ye. Root k-w-n.
usage: Opens many exhortations in Bahá'u'lláh's Arabic writings, 'be ye' (just, generous, detached), as in the Arabic Hidden Words.

definition: Imperative pl. of dhakara: remember ye, make mention of, celebrate. Root dh-k-r.
usage: A call to remember or make mention of God, as in اذکروا الله 'remember God'.
notes: After wa- read wa-dhkurú.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): applying a term to something; also release, unrestrictedness. Root ṭ-l-q.
usage: Applying a name or term to something (اطلاق شده 'has been applied'); also unrestrictedness, as against تقیید.
notes: Íqán: iṭláq-i-shumús 'the term suns is applied'.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): acknowledgment, confession, avowal. Root q-r-r.
usage: 'Acknowledgment, avowal', used of recognizing and confessing faith in the Manifestation of God.

definition: Plural of baṣar: eyes, sight; "ulu'l-abṣár" men of insight. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: Eyes, sight; in phrases such as اولی الابصار "men of insight" and لا تدرکه الابصار "no vision taketh in Him".

definition: Verbal noun (form VIII): power, might, ability. Root q-d-r.
usage: Divine might, as in the attribute المقتدر and phrases such as ذو الاقتدار 'Lord of might' and بالقدرة والاقتدار 'with power and might'.

definition: Verbal noun of ansha’a 'to bring into being': creation, origination; the created world. Root n-sh-’.
usage: In the Aqdas ملأ الانشاء 'concourse of creation' and جبین الانشاء 'brow of creation'.

definition: Noun: days, plural of yawm 'day'; also times, an age. Root y-w-m.
usage: Days, and by extension the age of a Manifestation; فی الأیّام 'in the days', تلک الأیّام 'those days'.
notes: After فی read fi'l-ayyám.

definition: Relative pronoun plural الّذین joined to the pronoun هم: those who, they who.
notes: A characteristic joined spelling of الّذین هم in the Writings.

definition: Noun: the sun. Root sh-m-s.
usage: A chief symbol of the Manifestation of God, as شمس الحقیقة 'the Sun of Truth'; the Íqán interprets the sun of the prophecies as the Manifestations.

definition: Noun with article: the Throne, especially the Throne of God. Root ‘-r-sh.
usage: In the Writings God's Throne or the seat of His Manifestation; یا ابن العرش 'O Son of the Throne'; مالک العرش 'Lord of the Throne'.

definition: Adjective and divine name: the Forgiving, He who forgives much. Root gh-f-r.
usage: A divine name closing verses of the Aqdas, as in انّه لهو الغفور الکریم 'He, verily, is the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Generous'.

definition: Divine name: the Self-Subsisting, the Ever-Abiding upholder of all. Root q-w-m.
usage: Divine name, as in کلمة الله المهیمن القیوم 'the word of God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting'; also linked with اسمی القیوم 'My Name, the Self-Subsisting'.

definition: Plural of nabí: prophets. Root n-b-’.
usage: Chiefly in خاتم النّبیّین "the Seal of the Prophets" (Qur'an 33:40), the title of Muhammad whose meaning the Íqán explains.

definition: Noun: command, ordinance; also matter, affair. Root a-m-r.
usage: In the Writings usually 'the Cause', as in امر الله 'the Cause of God'; also God's command or simply a matter.

definition: Arabic elative akthar 'more, most' with Persian -í: most, the greater part (of). Root k-th-r.
Preposition bi- 'to, into' plus dast 'hand': into the hand of, by means of.
Preposition bi- 'by, through' + ‘ináyat 'favour, loving care, grace'. Root ‘-n-y.
usage: Common in بعنایت الهی 'through divine grace' or 'by the grace of God'.

definition: Bi- 'to' plus gháyat 'utmost': extremely, exceedingly, to the utmost degree.
Noun: servant, slave; humble self-reference meaning 'I'.
usage: In the Íqán Bahá'u'lláh refers to Himself as این بنده 'this Servant'; also man as the servant of God.

definition: Verb, present subjunctive 2nd person singular of didan (stem bín): that thou see, behold.
notes: Here after تا 'so that': تا جمالم بینی 'that thou mayest behold My beauty'.

definition: New, fresh; renewed. Everyday Persian adjective.
usage: Of spiritual renewal, as in حیات تازه 'new life' bestowed by the Sun of Truth.

definition: Verbal noun of form II: surrender, submission, resignation to God's will. Root s-l-m.
usage: Paired with رضا as a spiritual station: مدینهٔ رضا و تسلیم 'the city of contentment and submission'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): you (pl.) know, recognize. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: Frequent in the formula لو انتم تعرفون 'if ye but knew'.

definition: Imperative plural: reflect, meditate, ponder. Root f-k-r.
usage: A frequent exhortation, as in تفکروا یا اولی الأفکار 'ponder, O men of reflection'.

definition: Verbal noun of form II of m-y-z: distinguishing, discernment; with dádan or yáftan 'to distinguish / be distinguished'. Root m-y-z.
usage: 'Discernment, distinguishing'; used of telling truth from falsehood, as in تمیز دادن 'to distinguish'.
notes: Arabic tamyíz; Persian pronunciation tamíz. In everyday Persian also 'clean'.

definition: Noun: place, room, abode; jáy giriftan/guzídan "to take up abode".
usage: Place, abode; jáy giriftan 'to take up abode', as of love dwelling in the heart.
