definition: Noun ḥubb "love" with 1st person suffix -í: my love. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: 'My love', God speaking, as in the Hidden Words: حبی حصنی 'My love is My stronghold'.

definition: Noun: carrying, bearing, burden; with namúdan/farmúdan "to bear, carry". Root ḥ-m-l.
usage: Bearing or carrying; of bearing trials, a trust or a burden, in compounds like حمل نمودن 'to bear'.

definition: Noun and preposition: surroundings; around, about. Root ḥ-w-l.
usage: Around; frequent in images of circling the Cause, as in طائفین حول 'those who circle around'.
notes: Arabic ḥawla; also ḥawl = might, power (see bi-ḥawlihi).

definition: Preposition/noun: behind, the back; also successor (khalaf). Root kh-l-f.
usage: 'Behind', as of veils or a screen; as خَلَف also 'successor'.

definition: Noun rabb 'Lord' with suffix -him 'their' (genitive): their Lord. Root r-b-b.
usage: 'Their Lord', common in Qur'anic quotations and in Bahá'u'lláh's Arabic, as in عند ربّهم 'with their Lord'.

definition: Noun raḥmah (mercy, compassion) with 1st-person suffix: my mercy. Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: God's mercy, as in the Hidden Words and in سبقت رحمتی "My mercy hath surpassed".

definition: Verbal noun: raising, lifting; in Persian with namúdan or kardan 'to remove, resolve'. Root r-f-‘.
usage: Raising or lifting up, and in Persian removal, as in رفع اختلاف 'removal of differences'; also God's raising up of His Cause.

definition: Formula 'Glorified be God'; in Persian prose an exclamation of wonder or dismay. Root s-b-ḥ.
usage: In the Íqán an exclamation of astonishment, rendered 'Gracious God!'; in prayers and verses praise, 'Glorified be God'.

definition: Verb: perfect of shá’a, 'to will, to wish'. Root sh-y-'.
usage: Common in formulas: فمن شآء فلیقبل و من شآء فلیعرض 'whoso willeth, let him turn; whoso willeth, let him turn aside', and یفعل ما یشآء 'He doeth whatsoever He willeth'.
notes: After man 'whoso' the perfect has present meaning.

definition: Persian verb, 1st plural present subjunctive of shudan 'to become', used in compound verbs: (that) we become.
Active participle: seeker, one who seeks or desires; also student. Root ṭ-l-b.
usage: The seeker after truth or after the Beloved; paired with مطلوب 'the object sought'.

definition: Noun, plural of ẓuhúr: manifestations, appearances, revelations. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: In the Íqán the successive manifestations of God's grace and Self in the Prophets, as in ظهورات احدیّه.

definition: Noun: number, count, amount. Root ‘-d-d.
usage: In the Aqdas also numerical values of letters, as in علی عدد الزّآء 'according to the number of Z'.

definition: Noun: presentation, humble petition; with کردن 'to say respectfully, to submit'; also breadth. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: عرض کرد 'he said (to a superior)', used for speech addressed to God or a Prophet.
notes: Polite verb of speech toward a superior.

definition: Noun ‘ináya with suffix "my": My care, favour, providence. Root ‘-n-y.
usage: In the Writings عنایت is God's loving providence and bounty; بلائی عنایتی "My calamity is My providence".

definition: Noun: difference, distinction, separation. Root f-r-q.
usage: In the Íqán also a mystical stage, the station of distinction (فرق) as opposed to oneness (اتّحاد).

definition: Active participle of qadara: able, capable, powerful; al-Qádir, the All-Powerful, is a divine name. Root q-d-r.
usage: In the Writings both 'able' and a name of God, 'the Omnipotent'.

definition: Noun qawl 'saying' with suffix -hu 'his': His saying; introduces a quoted verse. Root q-w-l.
usage: In the Íqán introduces a cited verse or tradition, as in و قوله 'and His words'.

definition: Purpose particle li- with takúna, subjunctive of kána 'to be': that thou mayest be. Root k-w-n.
usage: Frequent in the Arabic Hidden Words: لتکون لی امیناً 'that thou mayest be My trustee', لتکون فیّ فانیاً 'that thou mayest die in Me'.

definition: Meeting, encounter; attainment of the presence of God. Root l-q-y.
usage: In the Íqán a key term: لقاءاللّه 'attainment unto the Presence of God', explained as meeting His Manifestation.

definition: Conjunction (li + an + lá): so that not, lest.
usage: Common in the Hidden Words, e.g. لئلا یفتخر احد علی احد 'that no one should exalt himself over the other'.
notes: Written لئلّا; the hamza seat is normalized to ی in the search form.

definition: Verb, present perfect 3rd person plural of mándan: they have remained, been left, stayed.
notes: Written with a joiner as مانده‌اند; in دور مانده‌اند 'have remained far (from)'.

shift: Here: detached from all save God, immaterial. Today: single, unmarried; also abstract.
definition: Stripped, bare; detached from worldly attachments; abstract, immaterial. Feminine agreeing with a plural. Root j-r-d.
usage: Of souls detached from all save God, as in انفس مجرّده 'detached souls'.
notes: In modern Persian مجرّد usually means "single, unmarried".

definition: Active participle of form IV: pointing to, indicating, giving evidence of; used with بر. Root d-l-l.
usage: Common in the Íqán: مدلّ بر 'indicative of, testifying to', of verses and traditions that point to a truth.

definition: Adjective: famous, renowned, well known. Root sh-h-r.
usage: In the Íqán of renowned divines or well-known accounts.

definition: Plural of maṭlab: topics, matters, questions, things sought. Root ṭ-l-b.
Passive participle of ‘arafa: known, well-known, famous; as a noun, what is recognized as good. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: 'Well-known'; also, in the Qur'anic sense, what is recognized as good, as in امر به معروف 'enjoining the good'.
notes: Hidden Words: 'O ye that are foolish, yet have a name to be wise'.

definition: Passive participle: opened, open. Root f-t-ḥ.
usage: Opened, open; used of the gates of grace or knowledge being opened.

definition: Pronoun man "I" with enclitic copula -am: I am, it is I.
Pronoun man "I, me" + copula -í "thou art": thou art of me.
usage: In the Persian Hidden Words God tells man that he is His, belonging to Him ('thou art of Me').
notes: shams-i samá-yi quds-i maní thou art the sun of the heaven of My holiness.

definition: Preposition min "from" + -í "me": from me.
notes: Arabic Hidden Words reading.

definition: Adjective: unassailable, inaccessible, impregnable, exalted. Root m-n-‘.
usage: Inaccessible, exalted beyond reach; of God or His station, as in مقام منیع 'inaccessible station'.

definition: Verbal noun: descent, coming down; of verses, being revealed. Root n-z-l.
usage: Descent; of scripture, revelation, as in نزول آیات 'the revelation of verses'.
notes: nuzúl yáft 'was revealed'.

definition: Noun: share, portion, lot. Root n-ṣ-b.
usage: 'Share, portion', as in نصیب بردن 'to receive a share', used of partaking of divine grace or being deprived of it.
notes: naṣíb burdan: to partake, receive a share.

definition: Negative past 3rd plural of namúdan (to do, make, show): they did not.
usage: Negative past of نمودن, the formal equivalent of کردن "to do", very common as an auxiliary in the Writings.
notes: Light verb after a noun: "idrák nanamúdand" they did not comprehend.

definition: Noun: speech, word, discourse; the Word of God. Root k-l-m.
usage: Speech or word, often the Word of God, as in کلام الله 'the Word of God' and کلمات مکنونه 'the Hidden Words'.

definition: Past participle of guftan 'to say': said; as a noun, a saying or utterance.
Past participle of yáftan, 'to find, to obtain'; with a noun it forms passive-like compounds (زینت یافته 'adorned').
usage: Frequent in compounds such as اطّلاع یافتن 'to be informed' and ظهور یافتن 'to appear'.
notes: Often short for the perfect یافته است.

definition: Arabic verb, imperfect of amara with suffix -kum: he commands you, bids you. Root '-m-r.
usage: In the Aqdas for God's commands: اتّبعوا ما یأمرکم به ربّکم 'follow what your Lord biddeth you'.

definition: Verb: to judge, rule, decree, ordain. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: Common in the formula یفعل ما یشاء و یحکم ما یرید 'He doeth whatsoever He willeth and ordaineth whatsoever He pleaseth'.

definition: Verb, passive imperfect of ra’á 'to see': is seen, is beheld. Root r-’-y.
usage: In ربّ ما یری و ما لا یری 'Lord of the seen and the unseen'.
notes: Read passive yurá here; the active yará 'he sees' is also common.

definition: Verb: he bears witness, testifies, attests. Root sh-h-d.
usage: Common in testimonies, as in یشهد بذلک 'thereto beareth witness'.

definition: Verb, form I imperfect: he/it appears, becomes manifest. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: Used of the appearance of signs and of the Manifestation, as in the Gospel verse حینئذ یظهر علامة ابن الانسان 'then shall appear the sign of the Son of man'.

definition: Abstract noun from aḥad "one": absolute oneness, the divine Unity. Root ’-ḥ-d.
usage: In the Writings the transcendent oneness of God, as in سلطان احدیّت "the Sovereign of the divine Unity" and مرایای احدیّت "mirrors of the divine Unity".

definition: Verb: 'We desired, We willed', form IV of r-w-d, with the royal 'We' of divine speech.
Plural of fu’ád, the heart, the inmost heart: hearts. Root f-’-d.
usage: In the Writings the heart as seat of spiritual perception, e.g. افئدهٔ منیره 'illumined hearts', often beside قلوب and ارواح.
notes: Spelled افئده; the search form writes ئ as ی.

definition: Noun, plural of qawl: words, sayings, statements. Root q-w-l.
usage: Often contrasted with deeds, as in the Hidden Words' اقوال و افعال 'words and deeds'.

definition: Plural of dín 'religion, faith' with the article: the religions; also the followers of religions. Root d-y-n.
usage: In the title مالک الأدیان 'the Lord of all religions'; in the Aqdas also the followers of the faiths, as in تعاشروا مع الأدیان 'consort with the followers of all religions'.

definition: Name, noun; designation. Root s-m-w.
usage: Common in phrases such as الاسم الأعظم 'the Most Great Name' and الاسم المخزون 'the hidden Name'.

definition: Plural of shay': things, all created things. Root sh-y-'.
usage: E.g. احب الأشیاء عندی الانصاف 'The best beloved of all things in My sight is Justice'.
notes: Broken plural, diptote.

definition: Noun, plural of lawḥ with the article: the tablets, slates; revealed writings. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: In Bahá'í usage لوح is a Tablet revealed by Bahá'u'lláh or the Báb; الالواح 'the Tablets', as in یحمله الألواح.

definition: Mankind, all creatures, people; collective noun. Root ’-n-m.
usage: In divine titles such as ربّ الأنام 'the Lord of mankind' and مولی الأنام 'the Lord of all men'.

definition: Plural of wahm: fancies, illusions, vain imaginings. Root w-h-m.
usage: Paired with الظنون: الظنون و الاوهام 'idle fancies and vain imaginings', the illusions that veil from truth.

definition: Noun: gold, with the definite article. Root dh-h-b.
usage: HW: بالنّار نمتحن الذّهب و بالذّهب نمتحن العباد 'Gold We test with fire, and with gold We test Our servants'.

definition: Noun with article: the ritual prayer, obligatory prayer. Root ṣ-l-w. Spelled with wáw in Qur'anic orthography.
usage: The obligatory prayer; in the Aqdas the Bahá'í obligatory prayer, as in الصلوة نور 'prayer is light'.

definition: Adjective and divine name: rich, self-sufficient, independent of all; al-Ghaní, the All-Possessing. Root gh-n-y.
usage: 'The All-Possessing, Self-Sufficient'; God is الغنی independent of all creation, as in Qur'anic غنی عن العالمین.
notes: In sulṭán al-ghiná the same letters read al-ghiná 'riches'.

definition: Adjective with article: impregnable, unassailable, inaccessible; a divine attribute. Root m-n-‘.
usage: Inaccessible, impregnable; a divine attribute, as in al-‘azíz al-maní‘ 'the Mighty, the Inaccessible'.

definition: Noun with article: passion, selfish desire, caprice. Root h-w-y.
usage: Selfish desire or passion, the opposite of God's will, as in the call to forsake الهوی 'idle desire'.

definition: Noun: certainty, certitude. Root y-q-n.
usage: Certitude, the seeker's goal in the Kitáb-i-Íqán (Book of Certitude, from the same root), as in عین الیقین 'the eye of certitude'.
notes: ‘ilmu'l-yaqín "knowledge of certitude", ‘aynu'l-yaqín "eye of certitude".

definition: Noun amr with 3rd masc. suffix: his command, his cause, his affair. Root '-m-r.
usage: 'His Cause' or 'His command', as in امره المبرم 'His irrevocable command'; amr is the usual word for the Cause of God.
notes: Genitive amrihi in maṭla‘ amrihi (Aqdas).

definition: Broken plural of umma: nations, peoples, religious communities. Root '-m-m.
usage: Nations, peoples, the religious communities of past Dispensations, as in امم قبل 'the peoples of old'.

definition: Verb, imperative of anzala (form IV): send down, reveal. Root n-z-l.
usage: 'Send down', in prayers asking God to send down His bounty, as in the Qur'anic رَبَّنا انزل علینا مائدة 'O our Lord, send down upon us a Table'.
notes: In the prayer 'rabbaná anzil ‘alayná má’idatan' O our Lord, send down upon us a Table.

definition: Verb, perfect 3rd person masculine singular (form IV): he sent down, revealed. Root n-z-l.
usage: 'He sent down, revealed', used of God revealing His verses and Books, as in ما انزل الله 'what God hath sent down'.
notes: Same spelling as the imperative.

definition: Noun: intimacy, familiarity, loving companionship. Root '-n-s.
usage: Intimacy and loving communion, especially with God or among the friends; in phrases such as انس با حق "communion with God".
notes: Not to be confused with ins (mankind).

definition: Pronoun íshán 'they, them' with the enclitic ast 'is': (it) is theirs, rests with them.
notes: Dar dast-i íshán-ast 'is in their hands'.

definition: Noun: harm, objection; lá ba’sa 'there is no harm', i.e. it is permissible. Root b-’-s.
usage: In the Aqdas لا بأس 'there is no harm' or 'it is no sin', marking something as permitted.

definition: Noun or adjective: the inner, hidden side; inward meaning; opposite of ẓáhir. Root b-ṭ-n.
usage: Paired with ظاهر: در ظاهر ... در باطن 'outwardly ... inwardly'; also the inner meaning of scripture.

definition: Preposition bi- with rawḥ: with joy, ease, refreshment. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: In the fixed phrase بالرّوح و الرّیحان 'with joy and radiance', from Qur'an 56:89, describing how to remember God and treat others.
notes: Read rawḥ 'joy, repose', not rúḥ 'spirit', in this phrase.

definition: Adjective: dazzling, brilliant, resplendent; evident. Root b-h-r.
usage: Often paired with ظاهر: ظاهر و باهر 'manifest and resplendent'.

definition: Preposition bi 'by, in' with the plural of áyah: by, in or with the verses or signs. Root ’-y-y.
usage: Appears in Qur'anic quotations, لم تکفرون بآیات اللّه 'why disbelieve ye in the signs of God', and in بآیات نازله 'by the revealed verses'.

definition: Noun: beginning, origin, the starting point. Root b-d-’.
usage: In the Íqán paired with ختم 'seal': the station of 'beginning' and 'end' shared by all the Prophets.

definition: Plural of badí‘a: wonders, novel and marvellous things. Root b-d-‘.
usage: In phrases like بدایع نغمات 'wondrous melodies' and بدایع امور 'the wondrous events'.

definition: Persian bi "with, to" plus dhikr: mention, remembrance, praise. Root dh-k-r.
usage: ذکر in the Writings is the remembrance or mention of God, as in ذکر الله "the remembrance of God".

definition: Contraction of تو را: 'thee, to thee', the 2sg pronoun with the object marker را.
Imperative masculine plural of form V tamassaka: hold fast, cleave to (with bi-). Root m-s-k.
usage: In the Aqdas تمسّکوا باوامر الله 'hold fast unto the ordinances of God'; also of material means, تمسّکوا بحبل الاسباب.

definition: Verbal noun: calling a liar, denying, rejecting as false. Root k-dh-b.
usage: The rejection of a Prophet as an impostor, as in تکذیب نمودند 'they denied (Him)'.

definition: Adjective (active participle of jáza): permissible, allowed, lawful, fitting. Root j-w-z.
usage: Usually negated, جایز نه 'is not permitted' or 'is not meet'.

definition: Past participle of jastan 'to seek'; in compounds such as تمسّک جسته 'having clung to'.
notes: Appears in compound verbs: تمسّک جستن 'to cling', اعراض جستن 'to turn away'.

definition: Noun: limit, boundary, extent; a legal penalty (pl. حدود). Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: In the Writings حدود الله 'the ordinances (limits) of God'; زیاده از حد 'beyond measure'.

definition: Noun: gathering, assembling; the gathering of the dead on the Day of Resurrection. Root ḥ-sh-r.
usage: In the Íqán paired as حشر و نشر 'resurrection and judgment', terms that Bahá'u'lláh interprets spiritually.

definition: Third person plural of خواستن "to want"; before a short infinitive it forms the future: "they will".
Present subjunctive of دادن 'to give'; in compounds: قرار دهد 'place', رو دهد 'come to pass'.
Noun: return; the eschatological Return of holy figures at the end of time. Root r-j-‘.
usage: In the Íqán the 'return' of prophets, explained as the return of their attributes in a new Manifestation.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): she/it returned. Root r-j-‘.
usage: In Arabic passages: الی خزائن امرها رجعت 'unto the treasuries of His Cause they returned'.

definition: Plural of rawḍa: gardens, meadows. Root r-w-ḍ.
usage: Used figuratively, as in ریاض قلوب 'the meads of the hearts'.

definition: Noun and adjective: pure, cool, limpid water; a clear sweet draught. Root z-l-l.
usage: 'Pure, limpid water'; an image of the water of divine knowledge or life, as in زلال سلسبیل.
notes: Also used in literary Persian (zulál-i ḥikmat).

definition: Noun: plural of subḥa: splendours; in the hadith kashf subuḥát al-jalál "the rending of the veils of glory". Root s-b-ḥ.
usage: Veils of glory; from the hadith kashf subuḥát al-jalál 'the rending of the veils of glory', the barriers that hide divine truth.

definition: Noun sabíl "path, way" with suffix -í: my path; "fí sabílí" in My path. Root s-b-l.
usage: 'My path', God speaking, as in فی سبیلی 'in My path'.

definition: Particle placed before an imperfect verb marking the future: will, shall, soon.
Noun: shore, bank, beach. Root sh-ṭ-'.
usage: Shore, as in شاطی البحر 'the shore of the sea' in images of the ocean of divine knowledge.
notes: Also spelled شاطئ.

definition: Past participle of shanídan 'to hear': heard; forms perfect tenses and serial verbs.
Verbal noun: witnessing, presence; the visible, manifest world as opposed to ghayb 'the unseen'. Root sh-h-d.
usage: 'The visible world', in عالم شهود contrasted with عالم غیب 'the unseen world'; also witnessing or direct presence.
notes: ‘álam-i-shuhúd: the visible world.

definition: Persian plural of ṣáḥib: owners, possessors, people endowed with. Root ṣ-ḥ-b.
usage: Possessors, people endowed with; used in vocatives like ای صاحبان چشم "O ye that have eyes".
notes: Ay ṣáḥibán-i húsh u gúsh: O ye that have minds and ears.

definition: Noun: path, way; aṣ-ṣiráṭ al-mustaqím 'the straight Path' (Qur'anic). Root ṣ-r-ṭ.
usage: The path of God, as in صراط مستقیم 'the straight Path'; in the Writings the Path is the Cause and the Manifestation of God.

definition: Noun: horn, trumpet blown on the Day of Resurrection. Root ṣ-w-r.
usage: In the Íqán the Trumpet of the Resurrection, interpreted as the Call of the new Manifestation; نفخ فی الصور 'the trumpet is blown'.

definition: Plural of ṣúrat: forms, images, outward shapes. Root ṣ-w-r.
usage: Often contrasted with inner meanings or realities (معانی، حقائق).
notes: Second reading; not the one in the sample contexts.

definition: Noun: narrowness, straitness; distress, oppression. Root ḍ-y-q.
usage: In the Íqán's Gospel quotation من بعد ضیق تلک الأیّام 'immediately after the oppression of those days', explained as the people's spiritual privation.

definition: Active participle: rising, dawning (of the sun or a light); modern Persian mostly 'fortune'. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: With گشتن/شدن 'to rise', of the Sun of Truth or guidance dawning from the horizon.

definition: Plural of ṭal‘at: faces, countenances, appearances. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: Used of the Manifestations of God, as طلعات قدسیه 'the holy Countenances'.

definition: Verb, perfect 3rd fem. sing. of ẓahara: appeared, became manifest. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: In Arabic quotations in the Íqán, e.g. منها ظهرت الأشیاء 'from it all things appeared'.

definition: Noun: justice, equity, fairness. Root ‘-d-l.
usage: A central principle in the Writings, as in طراز العدل 'the ornament of justice'; contrasted with ظلم 'tyranny'.

definition: Verb, form I perfect: he pardoned, forgave; with عن, exempted from an obligation. Root ‘-f-w.
usage: In the Aqdas, عفا الله عن 'God hath exempted' marks exemptions from laws such as fasting and prayer.

definition: Preposition ‘alá "on, upon" with the suffix -há "her, it": upon it, over it.
Adjective: rich, self-sufficient, independent of need. Root gh-n-y.
usage: In the Writings God is الغنیّ 'the Self-Sufficient'; man is created rich in spirit, as in خلقتک غنیّاً 'I created thee rich'.

definition: Noun: open space, expanse, atmosphere; figuratively a realm or domain. Root f-ḍ-w.
usage: In the Writings a figurative spiritual space, as in فضای قدس 'the realm of holiness'.

definition: Indefinite pronoun or adjective: such-and-such, so-and-so.
usage: In the Íqán فلان علامت 'such-and-such a sign', mocking those awaiting literal signs.

definition: Noun: passing away, extinction, transience; in Sufi usage annihilation of the self in God. Root f-n-y.
usage: The transient world, as in دیار فنا 'the realm of mortality', or self-effacement; usually contrasted with بقا 'permanence'.

definition: Content, satisfied; with شدن 'to be content with'. Root q-n-‘.
usage: In the Hidden Words of those content with the transient, e.g. بتراب فانی قانع 'content with mortal dust'.

definition: Arabic phrase 'has not ceased', used adverbially: eternally, ever, from time immemorial. Root z-y-l.
usage: Frequent in the pair لم یزل و لا یزال 'from everlasting to everlasting', describing God and His bounty.
notes: Written with a joiner (لم‌یزل).

definition: Preposition li 'to, for' with the suffix 'me': to me, for me, mine.
notes: Spoken by God in the Hidden Words: لتکون لی امیناً 'that thou mayest be My trustee'.

definition: Commanded, charged, appointed to a task; an official agent. Root ’-m-r.
usage: With شدن or گشتن 'to be commanded', as of the Prophets bidden to deliver God's Message.

definition: Relational adjective: of or pertaining to Muḥammad. Root ḥ-m-d.
usage: In phrases such as جمال محمّدی 'the Beauty of Muḥammad' and شمس نبوّت محمّدی 'the Sun of Muḥammad's Prophethood'.

definition: Plural of مرآة 'mirror', with izáfih ی. Root r-’-y.
usage: In the Íqán the Manifestations and their followers as mirrors of God: مرایای احدیّه 'the mirrors of the divine Unity'.

definition: Noun: one time, once; with numbers, times. Root m-r-r.
usage: Used in counts, as in خمساً و تسعین مرّة 'ninety-five times', and مرّة اخری 'once again'.

definition: Proper noun: Mary, mother of Jesus; ‘Ísá ibn Maryam 'Jesus, son of Mary'.
usage: Mary, mother of Jesus; mentioned in the Íqán in the account of Christ's birth and its trials.

definition: Passive participle (form II): granted, acknowledged, undisputed, recognized. Root s-l-m.
usage: Acknowledged, undisputed; used of what is accepted by all, e.g. 'it is acknowledged that ...'.
notes: Not muslim "Muslim" in these contexts.

definition: Noun, plural of mashriq: places of sunrise, daysprings, easts. Root sh-r-q.
usage: Daysprings or dawning-places, as in مشارق الوحی 'the daysprings of revelation' and مشرق الاذکار 'the Dawning-place of the Praise of God'.

definition: Noun: walking, gait; with namúdan "to walk". Root m-sh-y.
usage: Walking; figuratively conduct and way of life, as in مشی نمودن 'to walk (in a path)'.

definition: Passive participle: the one worshipped, the Object of adoration, God. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: The Object of adoration, God, as in معبود عالمیان; also used of false objects of worship.

definition: Passive participle: non-existent, annihilated; with shudan 'to perish, pass away'. Root ‘-d-m.
usage: Non-existent, annihilated; of those who perished, or of all things as nothing before God.

definition: Passive participle (form II): decreed, ordained, destined. Root q-d-r.
usage: 'Ordained, destined', used of what God has decreed, for example a station or reward appointed for the faithful.

definition: Adjective (feminine of munír): shining, luminous, enlightened. Root n-w-r.
usage: Luminous, enlightened; describes hearts, souls and minds illumined by the Revelation, as in قلوب منیره "illumined hearts".
notes: Arabic feminine agreeing with a broken plural (af'idih-yi munírih).

definition: Plural of mawjúd: existing things, beings, all creation. Root w-j-d.
usage: All created things, as in جمیع موجودات 'all beings'; often in passages on creation reflecting the names of God.

definition: Noun: place, location, abode. Root k-w-n.
usage: Often paired with لامکان 'the placeless realm', contrasting the world of space with the spiritual realm.

definition: Noun: person, individual; used as a counter after numbers (دو نفر 'two persons'). Root n-f-r.
Noun: valley, vale; figuratively a stage or realm. Root w-d-y.
usage: Figurative realms such as وادی ضلالت 'the vale of error'; the Seven Valleys (هفت وادی) use it for stages of the mystic journey.

definition: Active participle: arriving, attaining, united with. Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: Mystical term for one who has attained the goal or union with the Beloved.

definition: Active participle used as noun: unbeliever, infidel, one who denies God. Root k-f-r.
usage: In the Íqán the label clerics gave to followers of each new Prophet; مؤمن و کافر 'believer and infidel'.

shift: Here: a throne of divine sovereignty (Qur'anic). Today: a chair, seat, or the heated korsi table.
definition: Noun: seat of authority, throne (Qur'anic); modern sense chair. Root k-r-s.
usage: In the Writings a throne of divine sovereignty, echoing the Qur'anic 'Throne-verse'.

definition: Noun: sufficiency, adequacy; competence; with کردن 'to suffice'. Root k-f-y.
notes: کفایت میکند 'sufficeth'; کف کفایت 'the competent hands'.

definition: Noun: Kawthar, the river of abundance in Paradise (Qur'an 108); any heavenly stream. Root k-th-r.
usage: In the Writings a symbol of divine grace and knowledge, as in کوثر حیوان "the water of life" and کوثر معانی "the Kawthar of inner meanings".

definition: Interrogative adverb 'when?'; تا کی 'how long?, until when?'.
Arabic conjunction 'so that, in order that', taking the subjunctive.
Imperfect 3rd person masculine singular of dhakara: he mentions, remembers, recites; in rulings, let him recite. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Dhikr is the remembrance of God; in the Aqdas یذکر خمس مرات بسم الله 'let him repeat five times "In the Name of God"'.

definition: Verb, 3rd plural present of ra’á 'to see': they see, they shall see. Root r-’-y.
usage: In the Íqán's Arabic Gospel quotation و یرون ابن الانسان آتیاً 'and they shall see the Son of man coming'.

definition: Persian noun: water; also lustre, honour in idioms.
usage: Often figurative in the Writings: آب حیات 'the water of life', آب تلخ 'bitter water'.
notes: Search form of آب with the madda removed.

definition: Arabic noun: father; construct forms abú, abí, abá. Root ’-b-w.
usage: In the Aqdas of the duties of fathers, as in کتب علی کلّ اب تربیة ابنه 'Unto every father hath been enjoined the instruction of his son'.
notes: Arabic reading in the Aqdas.

definition: Plural of ibn: sons, children; figuratively people characterized by something. Root b-n-y.
usage: Used in addresses: ای ابناء غرور 'O Children of Vainglory', ای ابناء غفلت 'O Children of Negligence', یا ابنآء الانسان.

definition: Verb: he came, arrived; with bi- to bring. Root '-t-y.
usage: In the Aqdas of the coming of a person, news or the promised Day, e.g. اتی الوعد 'the promise is come'.
notes: Final alif maqṣúra written ی.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV: counting, enumerating, reckoning. Root ḥ-ṣ-y.
usage: Used in phrases of inexhaustibility, as in زیاده از حدّ احصا 'beyond reckoning'.
notes: Persian spelling of احصاء without the final hamza.

definition: Differences, disagreements, divergences; plural of ikhtiláf (form VIII verbal noun). Root kh-l-f.
usage: In the Íqán of the conflicts among peoples at the appearance of each Manifestation and of apparent differences in the Words.

definition: Verbal noun of form VIII: rising, height, loftiness; also lifting away, removal. Root r-f-‘.
usage: سدرهٔ ارتفاع 'the lofty Tree'; in the Íqán also the lifting away (abrogation) of rules and customs.
notes: Íqán context ارتفاع قواعد means removal or abolition.

definition: Verbal noun: agitation, anxiety, turmoil, perturbation. Root ḍ-r-b.
usage: HW: در فقر اضطراب نشاید 'In poverty be not troubled'; in the Íqán of turmoil among believers.

definition: Imperative plural: do, act, carry out, observe (commandments). Root ‘-m-l.
usage: In the Aqdas: اعملوا حدودی حبّاً لجمالی 'Observe My commandments, for the love of My beauty'.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV abda‘a: original creation, bringing forth from nothing; the created world. Root b-d-‘.
usage: 'Original creation'; in the Writings the world of creation brought forth by God, as in عالم الابداع.
notes: Phrase man fí al-ibdá‘ 'all in creation'.

definition: Noun with article: plural of ḥukm: laws, ordinances, rulings. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: Laws, ordinances; used of the laws of God revealed in the Aqdas, as in aḥkám Alláh 'the ordinances of God'.

definition: Noun with article: horizon; "al-ufuq al-a‘lá" the Most Exalted Horizon. Root '-f-q.
usage: Horizon; الافق الاعلی 'the Most Exalted Horizon' designates the station of Bahá'u'lláh's revelation.
notes: Genitive after fí.

definition: Noun: creation, created beings, mankind. Root b-r-’.
usage: Creation, all created beings or mankind, as in the Qur'anic خیر البریّة 'the best of creatures'.
notes: Genitive after málik.

definition: Noun: life, especially everlasting life (máʼ al-ḥayawán, water of life); in Persian also animal. Root ḥ-y-y.
usage: Life, especially eternal life, as in ماء الحیوان 'water of life'.
notes: Rúḥ al-ḥayawán = the breath of life.

definition: Plural active participle (genitive): the wrongdoers, oppressors, unjust. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: Wrongdoers, oppressors, a frequent Qur'anic term, as in القوم الظالمین 'the wrongdoing people'.
notes: Quranic formula alá la‘natu’lláhi ‘ala’l-qawmi’ẓ-ẓálimín.

definition: Adjective: great, mighty, tremendous; al-‘Aẓím is a divine name. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: 'Great, mighty'; al-‘Aẓím is a divine name, as in النبأ العظیم 'the Great Announcement' and الاسم الاعظم 'the Most Great Name' from the same root.
notes: Genitive al-‘aẓími here.

definition: Plural (oblique) of gháfil: the heedless, negligent. Root gh-f-l.
usage: The heedless, those unaware of God; common in من الغافلین "of the heedless".

definition: Verbal noun: saying, word, speech, statement. Root q-w-l.
usage: Saying or word, as in القول الحق 'the true word'; in the Aqdas often introducing a command, قل 'Say'.
notes: Fí awwali'l-qawl 'My first counsel'.

definition: Passive participle: hallowed, holy, sanctified. Root q-d-s. Bayt al-Muqaddas: Jerusalem.
usage: In بیت المقدس 'the Holy House', Jerusalem; also of what is sanctified above all description.

definition: Verb: passive perfect 2nd plural of amara, 'to command': ye were commanded. Root '-m-r.
usage: In the Aqdas ما امرتم به 'that whereunto ye have been bidden'.

definition: Noun, plural of nafs with suffix -him: their souls, themselves. Root n-f-s.
usage: Reflexive 'themselves' or 'their souls', as in فی انفسهم 'within themselves'.

definition: Plural of amr: commands, ordinances, injunctions. Root '-m-r.
usage: Divine commandments, as اوامر الله 'the commandments of God'.

definition: Noun, plural of walí: friends of God, saints, chosen ones; also guardians. Root w-l-y.
usage: In the Íqán God's chosen ones, often the Imams, beside the Prophets in انبیا و اولیا 'Prophets and chosen ones'.
notes: The final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Preposition بـ with إذن 'permission, leave': by leave of, with the permission of. Root ’-dh-n.
usage: Frequent in باذن الله 'by God's leave' and باذن علما 'with the sanction of the divines'.

definition: Preposition ب with العدل: with justice, justly. Root ‘-d-l.
usage: Justice is a central Bahá'í principle; یأمر الناس بالعدل 'biddeth men be just'.

definition: Adverb from Arabic bi'l-marra: altogether, utterly, completely. Root m-r-r.
Adjective: great, large, important; بزرگ دانستن 'to magnify, deem great'.
Preposition bi- 'with' plus ṭiráz: embroidered border, ornament, adornment. Root ṭ-r-z.
usage: In the Aqdas زیّنوا انفسکم بطراز الاعمال 'adorn yourselves with the ornament of goodly deeds'; also the Tablet of Ṭarázát (Ornaments).

definition: Preposition bi- plus ‘arṣih 'open court, arena, realm'. Root ‘-r-ṣ.
usage: Common in phrases such as عرصهٔ ظهور 'the realm of manifestation' and عرصهٔ وجود 'the arena of existence'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'to, into' + ma‘árij, plural of mi‘ráj 'ladder, ascent'; the heights. Root ‘-r-j.
usage: The spiritual ascents of the soul, as in بمعارج عزّ یقین اندرآ 'ascend to the heights of the glory of certitude'.

definition: Present perfect of búdan 'to be': they have been.
Preposition bi- with kalima: with, by or in a word. Root k-l-m.
usage: کلمة in the Writings is often the creative Word of God, as in کلمة الله 'the Word of God'.

definition: Verb, form VIII, 2nd person plural jussive/subjunctive: (that/do not) follow. Root t-b-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas لا تتّبعوا ما عندکم من الاوهام 'follow not your idle fancies'.

definition: Being realized, coming true, fulfilment; verification. Form V verbal noun, root ḥ-q-q.
usage: In the Íqán of prophecies being fulfilled, as in تحقّق این امور 'the fulfilment of these things'.

definition: Verbal noun of form V: disposal, control, possession, interference with property. Root ṣ-r-f.
usage: Of control or dominion, as in قبضهٔ تصرّف 'the grasp of his power', or meddling with another's possessions.

definition: Arabic verb: He is exalted, high above; used as a doxology after God's name. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: In formulas like سبحانه و تعالی عمّا یشرکون 'glorified and exalted be He above what they associate with Him'.

definition: Verbal noun: allusion, hint, implicit indication. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: In the Íqán the implied meaning of a verse, as in تلویح این بیان 'the import of this utterance'.

definition: Verbal noun of form V of k-l-m: speaking, utterance; with farmúdan or namúdan 'to speak'. Root k-l-m.
usage: 'Speaking, utterance'; used of the Manifestation's speech, as in تکلم فرمودن 'to speak'.

definition: Verb: subjunctive of kána "to be", 3rd feminine or 2nd masculine singular. Root k-w-n.
Verb kána "to be", subjunctive 2nd person masculine plural: that ye be. Root k-w-n.
Noun: majesty, glory, grandeur. Root j-l-l.
usage: The majesty and glory of God, often paired with جمال 'beauty'; close in sense to بهاء 'glory', the Greatest Name.
notes: ‘arsh-i jalál the throne of glory.

definition: Noun ḥujjat with Persian indefinite -í: a proof, an argument, a testimony. Root ḥ-j-j.
usage: Proof or testimony, as in Íqán arguments on the proof of the Manifestation; حجّت الله 'the Proof of God'.

definition: Double plural of ḥadd: bounds, limitations (of human nature). Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: Limitations, the bounds of the human or created condition.

definition: Adjective: silent, extinguished; with kardan: to put out, quench, silence.
usage: 'Silent, extinguished', in the Hidden Words with کردن of quenching a light, as in خاموش مکن 'quench not'.
notes: 'kh. makun' quench not.

definition: Noun: wine; in mystical usage the wine of spiritual intoxication. Root kh-m-r.
usage: Wine; in the Writings mostly the mystic wine of the Revelation, as in خمر البیان "the wine of utterance"; actual wine and intoxicants are forbidden.

definition: Perfect of dádan 'to give', third plural: they have given; with nisbat 'they have imputed'.
notes: Written داده‌اند.

definition: Adjective or adverb: correct, sound, whole; properly, rightly, carefully.
Noun: proofs, evidences; broken plural of dalíl. Root d-l-l.
usage: The proofs of a Manifestation's truth, as in دلائل محکمهٔ متقنه 'conclusive and irrefutable proofs'.
notes: Written دلائل in the text.

definition: Persian noun: breath, breathing; also moment.
usage: Figurative breath of lovers or of the Holy Spirit; دم عیسی 'the breath of Jesus' is a classic image.

definition: Noun: blood. Arabic, used in Persian. Root d-m-y.
usage: Used in accounts of martyrdom, as in دم آن حضرت 'His blood'.

definition: Noun: the world, this life, worldly things. Root d-n-w.
usage: Usually the material world and its vanities as against the spiritual, as بندهٔ دنیا 'bondslave of the world'.

definition: Adjective, feminine of rabbání: lordly, divine, of the Lord. Root r-b-b.
usage: Frequent in the Íqán in phrases such as سدرهٔ ربّانیّه 'the divine Lote-Tree' and سماء عزّت ربّانیّه.

definition: Noun: canopy, carpet or couch (Qur'anic); in mystical usage a lofty height near God. Root r-f-f.
usage: In the Writings a lofty celestial height, as in رفرف امتناع 'the heights of inaccessibility'.

definition: Plural of riváya: transmitted reports, traditions (of the Prophet and Imams). Root r-w-y.
usage: Paired with احادیث 'traditions' in the Íqán, which interprets the Shí‘í traditions.

definition: Noun: headship, leadership, authority. Root r-’-s.
usage: In the Íqán حبّ ریاست "love of leadership" is named as a cause of the divines' rejection of the Manifestations.

definition: Noun: rein, halter; figuratively control, authority over a people. Root z-m-m.
Noun (Arabic sáḥa): courtyard, open court, precinct; figuratively presence or realm. Root s-w-ḥ.
usage: In the Writings the court or presence of God, e.g. ساحت قدس 'the holy court'; in the Hidden Words ساحت هستی 'the realm of being'.

definition: Relative adjective from subḥán 'glory, praise': divine, glorious, holy. Root s-b-ḥ.
usage: Qualifies God's voice or power, as in ندای سبحانی 'the divine call'.

definition: Verbal noun of sa’ala: question, asking, request. Root s-’-l.
usage: Generally 'question' or 'asking'; in the Íqán Bahá'u'lláh explains that a question may be put not by tongue and speech but by inner condition.

definition: Drinking. Root sh-r-b.
usage: In the Íqán with akl 'eating': اکل و شرب 'eating and drinking', of human limitations of the Prophets.
notes: Also read sharb.

definition: Form I verb: he drank, quaffed. Root sh-r-b.
usage: Frequent in imagery of drinking divine wine or knowledge, e.g. من شرب رحیق الانصاف 'whoso hath drunk the choice wine of fairness'.

definition: Noun: half, part, region; used adverbially: towards, in the direction of. Root sh-ṭ-r.
usage: From Qur'an 2:144 فولّ وجهک شطر المسجد الحرام 'turn thy face towards the Sacred Mosque'; also 'region', as in شطر العراق.

definition: Adjective ṣádiq 'true, truthful' with -ast 'is': is true, holds true. Root ṣ-d-q.
notes: Written joined (صادق است).

definition: Pure, clean, undefiled; ritually or morally pure. Root ṭ-h-r.
usage: In the Hidden Words of the inner state, as in قلب طاهر 'a pure heart'.

definition: Active participle: unable, incapable, powerless, helpless. Root ‘-j-z.
usage: Of human powerlessness to describe the Manifestation or to answer proofs: عاجز و قاصر 'powerless and inadequate'.

definition: Noun: sign, token, mark, portent. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Íqán of the signs of the Return: علامت ابن الانسان 'the sign of the Son of Man'.

definition: Adjective and divine name: knowing, All-Knowing, Omniscient. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Paired with other names, as in من لدن علیم حکیم 'from One Who is All-Knowing, All-Wise'.

definition: Conjunction fa- 'then, so' plus conditional in 'if'.
notes: Quranic quotation fa-in istaṭa‘ta 'if thou canst'.

definition: Conjunction fa- plus emphatic inna: for verily, since indeed; followed by a noun in the accusative.
notes: fa-inna ash-shamsa qad irtafa‘at 'for the sun hath risen'.

definition: Noun: child, son, offspring.
usage: Child, son; also figuratively in address, as farzandán 'children' of the spirit.
notes: In "ای فرزند کنیز من" "O Son of My Handmaid".

definition: Noun: separation, division; also chapter, season; "faṣl kardan" to separate. Root f-ṣ-l.
usage: Separation, chapter or season; in mystical passages separation from the Beloved, contrasted with وصل 'union'.

definition: Noun, plural of lu’lu’: pearls. Root l-’-l-’.
usage: Pearls, a frequent image for divine verses and hidden meanings, as in لآلی حکمت 'pearls of wisdom'.
notes: Written لآلئ.

definition: Noun liqá' with izáfih: meeting, encounter, attainment of the presence (of God). Root l-q-y.
usage: Attainment unto the Presence, as in لقاء الله 'the Presence of God', interpreted in the Íqán as meeting the Manifestation.

definition: Noun: night. Root l-y-l.
usage: Night, often paired with نهار 'day'; also figurative for the darkness of heedlessness.

definition: Passive participle: veiled, screened, shut out. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: 'Veiled', a key term in the Íqán for those shut out from recognizing the Manifestation by veils of learning, attachment or prejudice.

definition: Adjective (feminine of muḥkam): firm, solid, well-founded; of verses, perspicuous. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: Firm, well-founded; of verses, آیات محکمه "perspicuous verses", in contrast to متشابهات "allegorical" ones.

definition: Plural of mushrik: one who joins partners with God; polytheist, idolater, infidel. Root sh-r-k.
usage: Those who join partners with God; in the Writings it also denotes those who reject the Manifestation of their age.

definition: Plural active participle of aqbala: those who turn towards; the believers who accept the Manifestation. Root q-b-l.
usage: In the Writings those who have turned to the Manifestation and accepted His Cause, opposed to معرضین 'those who turn away'.

definition: Noun: lord, master; also patron, friend. Root w-l-y.
usage: A title of God, as in مولی العالمین 'the Lord of the worlds' and مولی الأنام 'the Lord of mankind'.
notes: Before the article read mawla'l-.

definition: Persian verb, negative 3rd plural present subjunctive of shudan: (that) they not become.
Plural of naghmah: melodies, songs, notes. Root n-gh-m.
usage: The melodies of the Mystic Dove or Nightingale, symbols of the Revelation, as نغمات ورقاء.

definition: Verb, present perfect 2nd pl. of namúdan 'to do, make'; auxiliary in compound verbs.
usage: In the Writings namúdan replaces the everyday kardan in compound verbs, e.g. اقامت نموده‌اید 'ye have dwelt'.
notes: Written as one word in the source (نموده‌اید).

definition: Negative past participle of نمودن 'to do, make'; used as a light verb in compounds.
Adjective هویدا 'evident, manifest' with است: is evident, is plain. Persian.
usage: Often paired with ظاهر, as in ظاهر و هویداست 'manifest and evident'.

definition: Feminine of wáḥid: one, single, the same. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: In the Writings stresses unity, as in کنفس واحدة "as one soul".

definition: Noun: flight, flying; پرواز کردن 'to fly, soar'.
usage: In the Writings the soul's soaring in the heaven of holiness, as in در هوای قدس پرواز کن 'soar in the atmosphere of holiness'.

definition: Plural of pisar: sons, boys, children.
usage: In the Persian Hidden Words as a form of address, ای پسران ... 'O Sons of ...', parallel to the Arabic یا ابناء.

definition: Adjective (active participle): complete, perfect, entire. Root k-m-l.
usage: As in حجّت کامل 'the proof is perfect'.

definition: Noun: pride, arrogance, haughtiness. Root k-b-r.
usage: Paired in the Íqán with غرور in کبر و غرور 'pride and vainglory', a veil from recognizing the Manifestation.

definition: Kull 'all' with the suffix -há: all of it, all of them (fem. or non-human plural). Root k-l-l.
Noun: being, existence, the created world. Root k-w-n.
usage: In the Íqán عرصهٔ کون 'the realm of being'; plural اکوان 'the worlds of existence'.
notes: Persian pronunciation kown.

definition: Verb, simple past 3rd person plural of guftan: they said.
Imperfect of naṭaqa "to speak, utter": he speaks. Root n-ṭ-q.
usage: In the Aqdas of God or His Manifestation speaking, as in الّذی ینطق بین السّموات و الأرض 'He Who speaketh betwixt earth and heaven'.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV: origination, creation from nothing; also the created world. Root b-d-‘.
usage: In the Íqán often 'the world of being' or 'creation', as in مشرق ابداع 'the dayspring of creation'.

definition: Arabic verb (form VIII) imperative: follow ye! Root t-b-‘.
usage: Qur'anic: یا قوم اتّبعوا المرسلین 'O my people! Follow the Sent Ones'.

definition: Arabic verb (form VIII): they followed. Root t-b-‘.
usage: Aqdas: بما اتّبعوا الظّنون و الأوهام 'for they followed idle fancies and vain imaginings'.

definition: Plural of jasad: bodies, corpses. Root j-s-d.
usage: In the Íqán the 'dead' bodies of the spiritually lifeless.

definition: Elative of ḥabíb: dearer, most beloved. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: 'Most beloved'; as in the Hidden Words 'the best beloved of all things in My sight is justice' (احب الاشیاء).
notes: In the second context read uḥibbu 'I love, I desire' (uḥibbu an akúna maḥbúban).

definition: Noun: plural of arḍ: lands, grounds, earths. Root ’-r-ḍ.
usage: Lands, earths; ordinary word for lands or territories.

definition: Noun: pre-eternity, beginningless eternity; "dhát-i azal" the eternal Essence. Root '-z-l.
usage: Beginningless eternity, often paired with ابد 'endless eternity'; ذات ازل 'the eternal Essence' and صبح ازل 'the morn of eternity'.

definition: Elative adjective: more, greater in amount. Root z-y-d.
usage: More, greater; in comparisons such as ازید از 'more than', with numbers and durations.
notes: yá azyad or more.

definition: Imperative pl. of sami‘a: hear ye, hearken, listen. Root s-m-‘.
usage: A summons to hearken to God's call, as in اسمعوا ندائی 'hearken to My call'.

definition: Verb, form IV perfect 3rd fem. sing.: it shone, rose shining. Root sh-r-q.
usage: Shone forth, of the sun of Revelation or the earth, as in اشرقت الارض 'the earth shone' (Qur'án 39:69).

definition: Elative adjective: more evident, more manifest. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: 'More manifest', used in comparisons such as اظهر من الشمس 'more evident than the sun'.

definition: Verb, perfect form IV: he made manifest, revealed. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: 'He made manifest, revealed', used of God manifesting His Cause or His Beauty through His Messenger.
notes: Same spelling as the elative.

definition: Verb, Form I imperfect 1st sing.: I say. Root q-w-l.
usage: I say, introducing a statement; in the Writings often after ان "that I should say".
notes: Subjunctive after an: "an aqúla lahu" that I should say to him.

definition: Adjective: last, final; al-yawm al-ákhir 'the Last Day'. Root ’-kh-r.
usage: Last or final, chiefly in الیوم الآخر 'the Last Day', which the Writings identify with the Day of the new Manifestation.

definition: Plural of rabb: lords, masters; Rabb al-Arbáb 'Lord of lords'. Root r-b-b.
usage: In ربّ الارباب 'the Lord of lords', a title of God; ما للتراب و ربّ الارباب 'what hath dust to do with the Lord of lords?'

definition: Noun: deeds, works, actions; plural of ‘amal. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: Deeds as the fruit of faith; لا تجعلوا الأعمال شرک الآمال 'Make not your deeds a snare wherewith to entrap the object of your aspiration'.
notes: Genitive or accusative according to context.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): justice, equity, fair-mindedness. Root n-ṣ-f.
usage: In the Writings justice or fair-mindedness, the impartial judgement needed to recognize truth; Hidden Words: 'The best beloved of all things in My sight is Justice'.

definition: Adjective: first, foremost, earliest. Root '-w-l.
usage: As a divine name الاول 'the First'; also الخلق الاول 'the first creation'.

definition: Noun with article: beauty, comeliness; especially divine Beauty. Root j-m-l.
usage: God's or the Manifestation's Beauty; جمال مبارک 'the Blessed Beauty' and جمال قدم 'the Ancient Beauty' are titles of Bahá'u'lláh.

definition: Noun: freedom, liberty. Root ḥ-r-r.
usage: In the Aqdas liberty must be bounded by God's commandments: 'true liberty consisteth in man's submission unto My commandments'.

definition: Noun: this lower world, worldly life. Root d-n-w.
usage: The transient world as opposed to the spiritual, as in کنوز الدّنیا 'the treasures of the world'.

definition: Noun: peace, safety, greeting of peace. Root s-l-m.
usage: Often a closing formula: و السّلام "and peace", السّلام علی من اتّبع الحقّ "peace be upon him who followeth the truth".

definition: Noun: knowledge, recognition, gnosis; mystical knowledge of God. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: In the Writings spiritual knowledge and recognition of the Manifestation, as in بحر العرفان 'the ocean of true understanding'.

definition: Noun: greatness, grandeur, majesty. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: Usually 'majesty', as in قباب العظمة 'the canopy of majesty' and ربّ العظمة 'the Lord of majesty'.

definition: Passive participle used as noun: the beloved one; in the Writings God or His Manifestation. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: A frequent title of God, as in عرف المحبوب 'the fragrance of the Beloved'.

definition: Form VIII participle of kh-y-r: chosen, free to choose; as a divine attribute, acting by sovereign choice.
usage: A divine name closing verses of the Aqdas, as in الواحد المختار 'the One, the Unconstrained'.

definition: The place of sunrise, the East. Root sh-r-q.
usage: In quotations such as و للّه المشرق و المغرب 'To God belong the East and the West'.

definition: Noun: the Kingdom, the celestial realm of dominion. Root m-l-k.
usage: The Kingdom of God, as in ذی الملک و الملکوت 'Lord of the seen and the unseen' and ملکوت الاسماء 'the Kingdom of names'.

definition: Noun: view, sight, spectacle, place of viewing; with the article 'the Vision, the Scene'. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: In the Hidden Words یا ابن المنظر الأعلی 'O Son of the Wondrous Vision'; in the Aqdas المنظر الأکبر 'the Most Great Scene' (Bahá'u'lláh's place of revelation).

definition: Preposition ilá "to, toward" with suffix -ka "you (masc. sg.)": to you, toward you.
notes: In فأرجع البصر الیک 'turn thy sight unto thyself' the suffix is reflexive.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV: causing to grow, making plants sprout. Root n-b-t.
usage: Figurative of the growth of wisdom and faith in a pure heart, as in انبات نماید 'cause to spring forth'.

definition: Plural of نجم: stars. Root n-j-m.
usage: In the Íqán the falling stars of prophecy are the divines: سقوط انجم 'the falling of the stars'.

definition: Plural demonstrative with relative -í: those (who), those (which).
Plural noun in the nominative, always in construct: possessors of, people endowed with, e.g. ulu'l-albáb 'men of understanding'.
usage: 'Possessors of', in Qur'anic phrases like اولو الالباب 'men of understanding' and اولو العزم.
notes: Accusative/genitive form ulí; the first و is not pronounced.

definition: Preposition bi- "with, by" plus anwár, plural of núr "light". Root n-w-r.
usage: With lights; anwár 'lights' is frequent of divine lights of the Manifestation, as in anwár al-wajh 'the lights of the Countenance'.

definition: Preposition bi- "with, by" plus jamí‘ "all, the whole of". Root j-m-‘.
usage: 'With all', as in بجمیع اسماء 'with all the names'.

definition: Adverbial phrase (bi + rástí "truth"): truly, verily.
usage: Truly, verily; Persian equivalent of Arabic إنّ, opening solemn statements, as in براستی میگویم 'verily I say'.

definition: Preposition bi- with riḍván: to or into paradise, the garden of good-pleasure. Root r-ḍ-w.
usage: Riḍván is paradise or the garden of good-pleasure; in Bahá'í usage also the garden where Bahá'u'lláh declared His mission.
notes: Persian bi- here means to, into.

definition: Preposition, bi- + súy 'direction': towards, to.
Noun: raising, sending; resurrection of the dead; sending of a Prophet. Root b-‘-th.
usage: 'Resurrection' or the raising up of a Prophet; the Íqán interprets the resurrection as the spiritual quickening brought by a new Manifestation.

definition: Noun: some, a part, a portion of. Root b-‘-ḍ.
Preposition bi 'by, with, for' plus ‘ilm 'knowledge, learning'. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Combines بـ with علم 'knowledge'; the Writings speak of knowledge both human and divine, as in علم لدنّی 'divine knowledge'.
notes: Ma‘rúf bi-‘ilm 'known for learning'; rendered 'yet have a name to be wise'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with, through' plus ‘ayn 'eye' in construct. Root ‘-y-n.
usage: In the Hidden Words بعینک لا بعین العباد 'through thine own eyes and not through the eyes of others'.

definition: Phrase: by himself, in itself, of its own accord (bi + nafs + -hi). Root n-f-s.
usage: In the Íqán بنفسه لنفسه 'by itself and for itself', of the Sun of Truth, which is self-manifest.

definition: Preposition bi- with núr 'light': with, by or into the light. Root n-w-r.
usage: Light as guidance, as in بنور تقی 'to the light of piety'.

definition: Construct plural of ibn 'son': sons of, tribe of, as in بنی هاشم 'the sons of Háshim'. Root b-n-y.
usage: Used in tribal and national names, as بنی اسرائیل 'the children of Israel'.

definition: Noun bayán with indefinite -í: an utterance, a statement, an explanation. Root b-y-n.
usage: بیان in the Writings is utterance or exposition, also the Báb's book, the Bayán.

definition: Adjective: unfading, imperishable, everlasting; Persian بی 'without' with Arabic zavál 'decline'. Root z-w-l.
usage: Common with spiritual dominion, as in ملک بی‌زوال 'imperishable dominion'.
notes: Written without the joiner: بی‌زوال.

definition: Verbal noun, form II: stripping, detachment from all save God. Root j-r-d.
usage: A Sufi term used for spiritual detachment, as in جواهر التجرید 'the essence of detachment'.

definition: Verb ḥazina, to grieve, be sad; here second singular present "thou grievest". Root ḥ-z-n.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words as کیف تحزن "how canst thou grieve" and لا تحزن "grieve not".

definition: Verbal noun: adorning, embellishment; تزیین یافتن 'to be adorned'. Root z-y-n.
Verbal noun of form V ta‘aqqala: understanding, rational reflection; with farmúdan or raftan, to ponder. Root ‘-q-l.
usage: In the Íqán the reader is urged to تعقّل فرمائید 'ponder' the meaning of the verses.

definition: Noun, plural of talvíḥ: allusions, hints, intimations. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: In the Íqán the allusions hidden in the words of the Manifestations.

definition: Imperative masculine plural of form V tawajjaha: turn towards, face. Root w-j-h.
usage: In the Aqdas a call to turn to God, as in توجّهوا الی اللّه 'turn unto God'; also used of facing the Qiblih.

definition: Form I verb já’a 'he came' with object suffix -kum: he came to you. Root j-y-’.
usage: In Qur'anic quotations, e.g. قد جآءکم بالبیّنات 'he hath come to you with clear tokens'.

definition: Active participle: sitting, seated. Root j-l-s.
usage: In the Íqán of the Manifestations: بر تراب جالس 'seated upon the dust', yet established on the throne.

definition: Proper noun: Gabriel, the archangel of revelation.
usage: In the Íqán the angel of revelation who brought the verses to Muhammad; the Writings interpret him as the Holy Spirit of revelation.
notes: Written جبرئیل in the source.

definition: Flowing, course, current; being in force or carried out (of a command). Root j-r-y.
usage: With یافتن or داشتن of a law or rule taking effect.

definition: Perfect 1st person plural of ja‘ala 'to make, appoint, ordain'; divine 'We'. Root j-‘-l.
usage: In Qur'anic quotations and the Aqdas, as in ما جعلنا القبلة 'We appointed not the Qiblih'.

definition: Plural of جاهل: ignorant people. Root j-h-l.
usage: Often contrasted with علما 'divines': علما و جهّال 'the learned and the ignorant'.

definition: Noun jahd with indefinite -í: an effort, a striving; jahdí namúdan = to strive. Root j-h-d.
usage: Common in exhortations, as in جهدی نمائید 'strive ye'.

definition: Noun: heat, warmth; fervour, ardour. Root ḥ-r-r.
usage: 'Heat'; often spiritual fervour, as in حرارت محبة الله 'the heat of the love of God'.

definition: Noun: account, reckoning; the Day of Reckoning. Root ḥ-s-b.
usage: Reckoning; the Day of Reckoning (yawm al-ḥisáb), which the Writings interpret as the coming of the new Manifestation.

definition: Noun: dust, earth, soil; "ay pisar-i khák" O Son of Dust.
usage: Dust or earth, a symbol of humility and mortal nature; ای پسر خاک 'O Son of Dust' is a frequent address in the Hidden Words.

definition: Noun, plural of khazína/khizána: treasuries, storehouses. Root kh-z-n.
usage: Treasuries, of God's knowledge or of the earth, as in خزائن علم 'treasuries of knowledge'.
notes: Written خزائن.

definition: Noun: the contrary, opposite; disagreement; bar khiláf-i = contrary to. Root kh-l-f.
usage: The contrary, as in بر خلاف 'contrary to'; also disagreement or opposition.

definition: Abstract noun/adjective (fem.): lordship, divine sovereignty. Root r-b-b.
usage: Lordship, the station of divine sovereignty, often paired with عبودیت 'servitude'.

definition: Noun: doubt, suspicion, misgiving. Root r-y-b.
usage: 'Doubt', often in the Qur'anic formula لا ریب فیه 'there is no doubt in it', applied to the certainty of the Revelation.

definition: Adjective/noun (Arabicized Persian sádah): plain, simple, unmixed; pure essence. Plural sawádhij.
usage: Pure, unmixed essence; used in phrases like ساذج قدس "the essence of holiness", rendered "quintessence".
notes: Ay sádhaj-i havá: O Quintessence of Passion.

definition: Perfect verb sa’ala 'he asked, requested' with suffix -ka 'thee'. Root s-’-l.
usage: Used where a questioner asks of the Author, as in سألک 'he asked thee'; also in prayers, اسألک 'I beseech Thee'.
notes: After idhá the perfect has present sense: 'when he asks thee'.

definition: Active participle: traveller, wayfarer on the spiritual path; sálik shudan 'to tread the path'. Root s-l-k.
usage: The wayfarer on the spiritual path, central to the Seven Valleys and the Kitáb-i-Íqán, as in سالک سبیل 'the wayfarer on the path'.

definition: Noun: Salsabíl, a fountain of Paradise named in the Qur'an; any sweet, pure, flowing water.
usage: A symbol of the living waters of divine utterance, as in سلسبیل قدس 'holy Salsabíl'.

definition: Noun: year. Root s-n-w.
usage: سنة السّتّین 'the year sixty' (AH 1260, the year of the Báb's declaration); تفکّر ساعة خیر من عبادة سبعین سنة 'One hour's reflection is preferable to seventy years of pious worship'.
notes: In فی سنة السّتّین read sanati.

definition: Noun (collective): trees, a tree. Root sh-j-r.
usage: Often the divine Tree, as in شجر عزّ منیع 'a Tree of lofty glory'; compare سدرة 'the Lote-Tree'.

definition: Present perfect of shanídan 'to hear', third person plural: they have heard.
Verb, present perfect 2nd pl. of shanídan 'to hear': you have heard.
notes: Written as one word in the source (شنیده‌اید).

definition: Adjective: satanic, devilish, of Satan. Root sh-ṭ-n.
usage: In the Writings the lower, self-centred promptings, as in خیال شیطانی 'satanic fancy'.

definition: Double plural of sha’n: affairs, conditions, attributes. Root sh-’-n.
usage: In the Íqán, worldly attachments and conditions, as in شئونات عرضیه 'earthly things'.

definition: Noun: voice, sound. Root ṣ-w-t.
Adjective (feminine): good, pure, goodly, wholesome. Root ṭ-y-b.
usage: Echoes Qur'anic phrases such as کلمة طیّبة 'a goodly word' and بلدة طیّبة 'a goodly land'.

definition: Double plural (Arabic ẓunún plus Persian -át) of ẓann: suppositions, idle fancies, vain imaginings. Root ẓ-n-n.
usage: In the Íqán the 'idle fancies' of the divines, often paired with اوهام 'vain imaginings'.
notes: Double plurals like this are typical of 19th-century Persian.

definition: Noun, Persian plural of ‘álamí: the people of the world, all creatures. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: As in عالم و عالمیان 'the world and its peoples'.

definition: Plural of ‘álí 'high, exalted': the exalted ones; in Qur'an 38:75 the exalted angels. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: The dwellers of the celestial realms, as in اهل عالین and ملأ عالین 'the Concourse on high'.

definition: ‘Ilm 'knowledge' with the 1st person suffix: My knowledge. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words God speaks of جواهر علمی 'the gems of My knowledge'.

definition: Preposition ‘alá with suffix -ná: upon us, on us, against us.
Preposition ‘inda 'with, at, in the possession of' with the suffix 'us'.
usage: In divine speech من عندنا 'from Our presence'; ما عندنا 'what we possess'.

definition: Preposition ‘inda "with, at, in the possession of" with -hum "them": what they have.
notes: In نبذوا ما عندهم 'they cast away that which they possess'.

definition: Noun: rancour, malice, hidden hatred. Root gh-l-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words: دل را از غل پاک کن 'Purge thy heart from malice'.

definition: Active participle as divine name: Creator, Originator. Root f-ṭ-r.
usage: In the Qur'anic title فاطر السّماء و الأرض 'the Creator of the heavens and the earth'.

definition: Noun: item, point, clause, passage of a text. Root f-q-r.
Preposition and adverb: above, over, beyond. Root f-w-q.
notes: fawqa kulli shay’ 'above all things'.

definition: Noun: the Qiblih, direction faced in prayer; point of adoration. Root q-b-l.
usage: The Qiblih, the direction of prayer; in the Aqdas the Qiblih is the Shrine of Bahá'u'lláh, and figuratively the point of adoration.

definition: Noun qulúb (plural of qalb, heart) with Persian suffix -shán "their". Root q-l-b.
usage: Hearts; the heart (قلب) is the seat of spiritual perception in the Writings.

definition: Active participle: shining, gleaming; evident, manifest. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: Evident, shining; as in واضح و لایح 'clear and manifest', of truths and proofs.
notes: Written لائح.

definition: Adjective: from the presence of God (min ladun), divinely given, innate. Root l-d-n.
usage: Divinely given knowledge, as in علم لدنی 'knowledge from God's presence', from Qur'an 18:65.
notes: Ḥikmat-i ladunní = divine wisdom.

definition: Conjunction, li- + dhá: therefore, for this reason.
Preposition li- 'for, to' with suffix -há 'her, it': for it; also 'she has, she may' (lahá an).
Preposition li + wajh (face): for the sake of; "li-wajhi'lláh" for the sake of God. Root w-j-h.
usage: For the sake of, as in لوجه الله "for the sake of God", the purity of motive the Writings call for.

definition: Noun phrase (má 'what' + siwá 'other than'): all things other than God, the world. Root s-w-y.
usage: All that is other than God; the Writings call for detachment from ما سوی الله 'all save God'.

definition: Noun: touchstone for testing gold; a criterion or test. Root ḥ-k-k.
usage: In the Íqán God Himself is محک و میزان 'the touchstone and the balance' by which truth is tested.

definition: Adjective: acknowledging, assenting, submissive; active participle of adh‘ana. Root dh-‘-n.
usage: In the Íqán مذعن و مقرّ 'acknowledging and confessing', and بامر او مذعن 'submissive to His Cause'.

definition: Persian past participle of murdan 'to die': dead, lifeless.
usage: Spiritual deadness, as in دل مرده 'a dead heart', دلهای مرده 'lifeless hearts'.

definition: Passive participle form II: honoured, ennobled, privileged; with فرمودن: to bestow, endow. Root sh-r-f.
usage: Often مشرف شدن 'to be honoured with', as with attaining the presence of the Manifestation.

definition: Passive participle used as noun: the beloved, the one loved passionately. Root ‘-sh-q.
usage: In the Hidden Words the Beloved sought by the lover (عاشق), a Sufi image for God.

definition: Arabic preposition مع 'with' plus pronoun 'him, it'.
Active participle, form VIII: honoured, proud, glorying in. Root f-kh-r.
usage: With خلع, as in بخلع غنا مفتخر 'honoured with the robe of wealth'.

definition: Plural of maqám: stations, ranks, spiritual stages. Root q-w-m.
usage: In the Writings the stations of the Manifestations, e.g. مقام توحید "station of unity" and مقام تفصیل "station of distinction"; also stages of the mystic path.

definition: Noun maqám 'station, place, rank' with the indefinite -í; در مقامی 'in one sense, in one instance'.
usage: In the Writings 'station', especially the stations of the Manifestation; در مقامی ... در مقامی 'in one sense ... in another'.

definition: Active participle of form IV aqbala: one who turns towards, draws near; the one who accepts. Root q-b-l.
usage: In the Writings the soul who turns to God and accepts His Manifestation, contrasted with معرض 'the one who turns aside'.

definition: Contraction of min 'from' and má 'what': from that which, of what.
End, utmost limit; in sidrat al-muntahá the Lote-Tree of the uttermost boundary (Qur'an 53:14). Root n-h-y.
usage: Almost always in سدرهٴ منتهی / سدرة المنتهی, the Divine Lote-Tree beyond which there is no passing, a symbol of the Manifestation of God.

definition: Preposition min 'from, of, than' with the suffix -ka: from thee, than thou.
Active participle form VIII: guided, rightly guided. Root h-d-y.
usage: With گشتن or شدن 'to be guided', e.g. بانوار شمس هدایت مهتدی میشدند.

definition: Noun, plural of mawqi‘: places, sites, positions, seats. Root w-q-‘.
usage: In the Íqán مواقع حکمت صمدانی 'the seats of eternal wisdom', of the Manifestations; also مواقع الأمر 'the stations of the Cause'.

definition: Hidden, concealed, treasured up, as a pearl in its shell. Root k-n-n.
usage: Of hidden mysteries and treasured knowledge, as in سرّ مکنون 'the hidden mystery' and در خزائن عصمت مکنون 'hidden in the treasuries of infallibility'.

definition: Impersonal 'one can, it is possible', present stem of توانستن with mí-.
Persian verb دادن 'give', past continuous: they used to give, were giving.
usage: With بشارت: بشارت میدادند 'they announced the glad-tidings'.

definition: Past continuous or conditional of shudan: they were becoming; would have become.
Feminine active participle of nazala, to descend; in Persian prose 'revealed' (of verses). Root n-z-l.
usage: In Persian prose 'revealed', of verses sent down by God, as in آیات نازله 'the revealed verses'.
notes: Arabic feminine agreement with a plural noun (áyát-i názilih).

definition: Noun: plural of najm: stars. Root n-j-m.
usage: Stars; in the Íqán interpreted as the divines (‘ulamá) whose stars fall at the Day of Judgement.

definition: Noun: lamentation, wailing; paired with nawḥih "weeping". Root n-d-b.
usage: Lamentation, often paired with نوحه 'wailing' in descriptions of grief.

definition: Verb, imperfect 1st person plural of ra’á: we see. Root r-’-y.
usage: God speaking: 'We see', of His witnessing the deeds and states of His servants.
notes: Qur'an 2:144 "qad nará" We have seen.

definition: Plural of nisbat: attributions, imputations, charges laid against someone. Root n-s-b.
usage: Imputations or charges, as in false accusations laid against the Prophets or the Báb.

definition: Plural noun: Christians (Nazarenes). Root n-ṣ-r.
usage: Christians, the followers of Jesus, often cited in the Íqán alongside the Jews.

definition: Adjective: pertaining to the self or passions; carnal, selfish. Root n-f-s.
usage: 'Selfish, carnal', in phrases such as هوای نفسانی 'selfish desire', the passions of the lower self that veil the soul.
notes: havá-yi nafsání: selfish desire.

definition: Past 1st plural of namúdan (to do, make, show): we did, we made.
usage: Formal equivalent of کردیم "we did"; also "we showed".
notes: Light verb: "iktifá namúdím" we contented ourselves.

definition: Negative present of namúdan 'to do, show', third plural; auxiliary: they do not (do).
notes: Written نمی‌نمایند; namúdan is more literary than kardan.

definition: Noun: wailing, lamentation, mourning for the dead. Root n-w-ḥ.
usage: In the Hidden Words the Concourse on high raise نوحه و ندبه 'wailing and lamentation'.

definition: Negative past participle of yáftan 'to find'; with a noun 'has not been ...' (ظهور نیافته 'has not appeared').
notes: Short for the perfect نیافته است.

definition: Noun: falsehood, lie, untruth. Root k-dh-b.
usage: Contrasted with صدق 'truth', as in صدق از کذب 'truth from falsehood'.

definition: Particle: how many, how much; exclamatory 'how many a ...!' followed by من.
Verb, perfect 1st sing. of kána 'to be': I was. Root k-w-n.
usage: In the Hidden Words کنت فی قدم ذاتی 'I was in My immemorial being'.
notes: In the Qur'anic quotation (قد کنت فینا) it is read kunta 'thou wast'.

definition: Noun: group, band, company of people.
Verb, present of گفتن: they say. Persian.
Verb raja‘a, to return, revert; here "it reverts". Root r-j-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas inheritance laws, of shares that revert to the offspring or the House of Justice.

definition: Verb: 'he wills, desires, intends', form IV of r-w-d.
usage: Common in the formula یفعل ما یشاء و یحکم ما یرید 'He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth'.

definition: Passive imperfect of ‘arafa 'to know': he/it is known; subjunctive after an. Root ‘-r-f.
notes: In لا یعرف ذلک الّا اولو الالباب it is active ya‘rifu, 'none knoweth this save'.

definition: Verb, 3rd singular present of qa‘ada 'to sit'; also 'to sit idle'. Root q-‘-d.
usage: In the Aqdas of sitting for devotions, and of idleness in من یقعد و یطلب 'he who sitteth idle and beggeth'.

definition: Subjunctive of mana‘a 'to prevent, hold back, withhold' with the suffix -kum 'you'. Root m-n-‘.
usage: In Aqdas warnings ایّاکم ان یمنعکم ... 'Beware lest ... deter you', e.g. from recognizing the Source of Revelation.

definition: Form I imperfect of nafa‘a 'to benefit' with suffix -kum: it benefits you. Root n-f-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas of knowledge and commands that profit mankind: ما ینفعکم 'such as shall profit you'.

definition: Verb form VIII: he followed, obeyed. Root t-b-‘.
usage: In the formula السلام علی من اتبع الحق 'peace be upon him who followeth the truth'; Aqdas اتبع امر مولاه.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV: producing, bringing about, originating. Root ḥ-d-th.
usage: With شدن or کردن 'to be produced, to produce', as in احداث میشود 'is generated'.
notes: Not the plural aḥdáth 'events, youths'.

definition: Reasoning, argumentation, adducing proof. Form X verbal noun, root d-l-l.
usage: With نمودن 'to argue, adduce proof', often of the divines arguing against the Manifestation.

definition: Verbal noun of form X: arrogance, haughty disdain, pride. Root k-b-r.
usage: Of the pride with which people reject the Manifestation, paired with افتخار 'vainglory'.

definition: Plural of اسم 'name', with izáfih ی. Root s-m-w.
usage: Usually of the divine names and attributes: صفات و اسمای الهی 'the attributes and names of God'.

definition: Plural of shajar: trees. Root sh-j-r.
usage: Figurative, as in اشجار رضوان 'the trees of My garden'; souls are trees that must bear fruit.

definition: Plural of sharír, evil or wicked person: the wicked. Root sh-r-r.
usage: 'The wicked'; contrasted with the righteous (ابرار), with warnings against the company of the wicked.
notes: Hidden Words: 'the company of the ungodly increaseth sorrow'.

definition: Noun: plural of ṣafí: the pure, the chosen ones, saints. Root ṣ-f-w.
usage: The pure, the chosen ones; the saints and sincere servants of God, often paired with awliyá.

definition: Verb form IV, perfect 3rd masculine singular: he turned towards, drew near, accepted. Root q-b-l.
usage: 'He turned towards' God or His Manifestation, i.e. accepted the Faith; من اقبل 'whoso hath turned towards'.
notes: Ṭúbá li-man aqbala Blessed is he who hath turned.

definition: Elative adjective: less, least, fewest. Root q-l-l.
usage: Less, least; often in اقلّ من آن 'less than a moment' and of the least of God's servants.
notes: aqall-i qalílí a very few.

definition: Plural of ḥál: states, conditions, circumstances. Root ḥ-w-l.
usage: States and conditions, as in فی کل الاحوال 'in all circumstances'.
notes: Fí kulli al-aḥwál = in all circumstances.

definition: Noun: root, origin, foundation; plural uṣúl. Root '-ṣ-l.
usage: Root, origin, principle; plural اصول, as in اصول and فروع 'fundamentals and branches'.
notes: Aqdas: clinging to the branch and heedless of the Root.

definition: Noun, plural of lubb 'kernel, heart, mind': minds, understanding. Root l-b-b.
usage: 'Minds, understanding', in the Qur'anic address یا اولی الالباب 'O ye of understanding'.
notes: yá úli’l-albáb: O ye of understanding.

definition: Plural of amr: affairs, matters, things. Root '-m-r.
usage: Affairs, matters; as in فی جمیع الامور "in all matters".
notes: Accusative after inna.

definition: Feminine of awwal 'first'; al-úlá 'the first (life), this world', paired with al-ukhrá. Root ’-w-l.
usage: Feminine of اوّل; in الحیاة الاولی 'the first life, this world', set against الآخرة 'the life to come'.
notes: Fi'l-úlá wa fi'l-ukhrá 'in this world and the next'.

definition: Plural of awwal 'first': the ancients, those of old, forefathers. Root a-w-l.
usage: In ربّکم و ربّ آبائکم الاولین 'your Lord and the Lord of your fathers of old', a Qur'anic phrase.

definition: Elative adjective: greatest, most great; also most grievous. Root k-b-r.
usage: In titles and phrases such as الاسم الأکبر 'the Most Great Name' and the tradition العلم حجاب الأکبر 'knowledge is the most grievous veil'.

definition: Adjective: wondrous, new, unprecedented, incomparable; a divine name. Root b-d-‘.
usage: A divine attribute, as in العزیز البدیع 'the Mighty, the Wondrous'; بدیع also names the Bahá'í (Badí‘) calendar and era.

definition: Noun: proof, demonstration, decisive evidence. Root b-r-h-n.
usage: Paired with الحجة: الحجة و البرهان 'the testimony and the proof'.

definition: Noun, plural of balad with article: the lands, countries, cities. Root b-l-d.
usage: Common in من فی البلاد 'those in the land', all people.

definition: Noun: piety, godliness, fear of God. Root w-q-y.
usage: A standard virtue in the Writings, as in البرّ و التّقوی 'righteousness and piety'.

definition: Verbal noun, form II: affirming the oneness of God; divine unity. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: Central term for the unity of God and of His Manifestations, as in مظاهر التوحید 'the Manifestations of Divine Unity'.

definition: Intensive adjective: most merciful; with the article a divine name. Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: A divine name, as in الرّحمن الرّحیم "the Compassionate, the Merciful" and الغفور الرّحیم "the Forgiving, the Merciful".

definition: Noun: sign, mark, token. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Íqán the signs foretold for the appearance of the Promised One.

definition: Feminine elative of a‘lá: highest, most exalted, supreme. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: Echoes Qur'anic کلمة الله هی العلیا; in the Aqdas صفاتنا العلیا 'Our exalted attributes' and کلمة الله العلیا.

definition: Noun: the unseen, the hidden, what is beyond perception. Root gh-y-b.
usage: The unseen world and divine mystery, as in عالم الغیب 'the invisible realm' and فی الغیب 'in the Invisible'.

definition: Arabic numeral: a thousand; also the name of the letter alif. Root ’-l-f.
usage: In traditions quoted in the Íqán, as الف فاطمه 'a thousand Fáṭimas' and الف آدم 'a thousand Adams'.
notes: In the Aqdas also الف سنة 'a thousand years'.

definition: Paradise, the highest garden of heaven.
usage: Common in images such as اعلی الفردوس 'the loftiest Paradise' and ورقات الفردوس 'the leaves of Paradise'.
notes: A loanword of Persian origin in Arabic.

definition: Adjective: all-powerful, omnipotent; a name of God. Root q-d-r.
usage: In closing formulas such as انه لهو المقتدر العزیز القدیر 'He, verily, is the Almighty, the All-Glorious, the All-Powerful'.

definition: Adjective: ancient, eternal, without beginning; as a divine attribute 'the Ancient'. Root q-d-m.
usage: In the Writings an attribute of God, as in مولیکم القدیم 'your Lord, the Ancient of Days', and of His Revelation (جمال القدم 'the Ancient Beauty').

definition: Nights; broken plural of layla. Root l-y-l.
usage: In the Aqdas on lands where the nights and days grow long, for the times of prayer and fasting.

definition: Noun: water, the element; figuratively life-giving grace. Root m-w-h.
usage: Literal in the Aqdas ablution laws; figurative in ماء الحیوان 'the water of life' and the Gospel 'born of water and of the Spirit'.
notes: In the Aqdas context accusative al-má’a.

definition: Divine name: the Giver, the Bestower. Root ‘-ṭ-w.
usage: Aqdas: انّه لهو المعطی الوهّاب 'He, verily, is the Giver, the Bountiful'.

definition: Passive participle: that which is intended, the purpose; as a title, the One Desired, God. Root q-ṣ-d.
usage: In the Aqdas a divine title, as in من لدی المقصود 'from the Desired One'; also 'what is intended'.

definition: Feminine active participle of quadriliteral haymana: dominant, presiding over, holding sway; with ‘alá. Root h-y-m-n.
usage: 'All-dominating, preeminent'; describes God's sovereignty or the Revelation presiding over all things.
notes: Case varies: nominative after nafsuhu, genitive after mashíyyatihi.

definition: Noun with article: death. Root m-w-t.
usage: Death; in the Íqán interpreted spiritually as unbelief, with life as faith.

definition: Noun, plural of nafs with article: souls, selves, persons. Root n-f-s.
usage: Souls or persons; النفوس الزکیة 'pure souls'.
notes: Nominative as subject of taḍṭaribu.

definition: Noun: the whole, all, everyone. Root k-l-l.
usage: The whole, all; as in the affirmation that all (الکلّ) are His servants and return to Him.

definition: Adjective: painful, grievous, sore. Root '-l-m.
usage: Grievous, as in Qur'anic عذاب الیم 'grievous chastisement'.
notes: ‘Adhábun alím = a grievous torment. Not al-yamm (the sea).

definition: Noun amr 'command, cause, affair' with Persian suffix -ash 'his'. Root '-m-r.
usage: 'His Cause'; امر is usually the Cause of God, as in امر الله.

definition: Noun, plural of amr 'command' with suffix -í 'my': My commandments. Root ’-m-r.
usage: 'My commandments', used in the Aqdas of the laws of Bahá'u'lláh, which He calls the choice Wine and the lamps of His providence.

definition: Plural of walí: friends of God, saints, guardians; in Shí‘ih usage the Imams. Root w-l-y.
usage: Friends of God and saints; in Shí‘ih contexts the Imams; rendered "chosen ones" in the Íqán.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): harming, tormenting, persecution. Root ’-dh-y.
usage: Persecution and harm inflicted on the Prophets and believers, often paired with ظلم and اعتساف.
notes: Persian spelling of Arabic ídhá’.

definition: Noun: respect, regard; dar bárih-yi 'concerning, about, with regard to'.
usage: Usually in در بارهٔ 'concerning, with regard to'.

definition: Phrase bi + ism + -í: in My name, by My name. Root s-m-w.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words ان یکون افتخارک باسمی لا باسمک 'thy glory should be in My name, not in thine'.

definition: Persian ba- 'by, with' + Arabic ism 'name' + indefinite -í: by a name.
Adverb, from Arabic bi'l-akhara: finally, at last, in the end. Root '-kh-r.
Preposition bi 'to, with' joined to ánchih 'that which, whatever'.
notes: Written بآنچه with madda in the original.

definition: Preposition bi with ayádí, plural of yad: by or with the hands. Root y-d-y.
usage: In the Hidden Words بأیادی القوّة 'with the hands of power'.
notes: Before the article read bi-ayádi'l-.

definition: Persian بـ 'to' with بعضی 'some, certain ones'. Root b-‘-ḍ.
Preposition: except, other than, but. Persian.
Persian bi plus ḥukm: by the decree of, according to the ruling of. Root ḥ-k-m.
Verb: 'gives, bestows; forgives', present of بخشیدن.
Noun: carpet, spread, mat; figuratively a domain, a banquet spread, or a seat of honour. Root b-s-ṭ.
usage: Often figurative: بساط قرب 'the court of nearness', بساط باقی 'the domain of eternity'.

definition: Past participle of bastan 'to bind, tie': bound, closed; with bih 'dependent on'.
Subjunctive 3rd person plural of shanídan 'to hear': that they hear, should they hear.
Baṣar 'sight, eye' with the 1st person suffix: My sight. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words بصرک بصری 'thine eye is Mine eye'. In Persian ذی بصری 'anyone possessed of sight'.

definition: Persian preposition bi- 'to' with ‘álam: to the world or realm. Root ‘-l-m.
