usage: عالم 'world, realm' is common: عالم شهود 'the visible world', عالم غیب 'the invisible world'.
notes: Persian ب joined to the noun.

definition: Adverbial phrase, literally 'in its very self': exactly, precisely, the very same.
usage: In the Íqán it draws exact parallels between past and present: بعینه در این زمان 'even so in this day'.
notes: In the Aqdas بعینه means 'with his own eye'.

definition: Prefix ba/bi "to, with" + qatl "killing, slaying"; in بقتل رسانیدن "to put to death". Root q-t-l.
Preposition bi- with liqá’ 'meeting, encounter, attainment to the presence'. Root l-q-y.
usage: لقاء الله 'attainment unto the Presence of God', which the Íqán explains as recognizing His Manifestation.

definition: Verbal noun: reaching, attainment; also maturity, coming of age. Root b-l-gh.
usage: In the Íqán of attaining the goal or the Beloved: بلوغ بمحبوب; in law, the age of maturity.

definition: Preposition bi- with maẓáhir, plural of maẓhar: to or with the places of manifestation, the Prophets. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: مظاهر قدسیه 'the holy Manifestations' are the Prophets of God.

definition: Persian bi- 'to, by' plus Arabic naẓar 'sight, view': bi-naẓar ávardan 'bring into view', bi-naẓar rasídan 'come to notice'.
usage: 'To view'; in phrases such as بنظر آمدن 'to seem' and بنظر رسیدن 'to come to notice'.

definition: Preposition bi- "with, by" plus havá "desire, passion" (also "air"), here with izáfih. Root h-w-y.
usage: With desire; havá 'desire, passion' is used of selfish desire (havá-yi nafs) to be renounced.

definition: Adverb/preposition: out, outside; "bírún á" come forth.
usage: 'Out, outside', as in بیرون آ 'come forth'.

definition: Adjective (bí "without" + mithál "likeness"): matchless, peerless, incomparable.
usage: Peerless, matchless; of God and His beauty, as in جمال بیمثال 'peerless Beauty'.

definition: Preposition bayna with dual suffix -humá: between the two of them.
Preposition bi- 'with, to' joined to yak 'one'.
Noun: clear exposition, elucidation, explanation. Root b-y-n.
usage: 'Clear exposition', echoing the Qur'anic description of the Book as تبیان لکلّ شیء 'an exposition of all things'.

definition: Verbal noun, Form II: limiting, restricting, setting bounds. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: Limitation; used of human attempts to limit God's grace or Revelation, which the Writings reject.

definition: Verbal noun (form V): bewilderment, perplexity, wonder. Root ḥ-y-r.
usage: Bewilderment, the Valley of Wonderment (وادی حیرت) in the Seven Valleys; also amazement before God's signs.

definition: Verbal noun: making particular, specifying, singling out, assigning exclusively. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: In the Íqán with دادن: تخصیص دادن 'to single out, distinguish'.

definition: Numeral: nine (form used with masculine nouns). Root t-s-‘.
usage: Nine and nineteen recur in the Aqdas laws, e.g. تسعة مثاقیل 'nine mithqáls' and تسعة عشر مثقالاً 'nineteen mithqáls'.
notes: In تسعة عشر 'nineteen' it is indeclinable tis‘ata ‘ashara.

definition: Verbal noun (form II): singling out, isolation; Sufi term for detachment and solitude of the heart with God. Root f-r-d.
usage: Paired with توحید 'unity' and تجرید 'detachment', as in اثمار تفرید 'the fruits of singleness'.
notes: Sufi sequence tawḥíd, tafríd, tajríd.

definition: Verb: to prevent, hinder, withhold; here with object pronoun 'you'. Root m-n-‘.
notes: After ایاکم ان 'beware lest'.

definition: Noun: narrowness, straitness; hence hardship, distress, affliction.
usage: In the Íqán it explains Gospel 'tribulation' (ضیق).

definition: Verb: thou desirest, lovest, inclinest to. Root h-w-y.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words of selfish desire to be renounced, as in انه نفسک عمّا تهوی 'deny thyself that which thou desirest'.

definition: Active participle جالس 'sitting' with Persian copula -and: they are seated. Root j-l-s.
Noun: side, direction; از جانب "from, on behalf of". Root j-n-b.
usage: In the Writings often از جانب "from (God)", as in از جانب ربّ العالمین "from the Lord of the worlds".

definition: Noun: dung-beetle, scarab; proverbially averse to fragrance. Root j-‘-l.
usage: In the Íqán a figure for those repelled by the fragrance of holiness, beside the bat (خفّاش) that shuns the light.

definition: Verb: 'he made, appointed, ordained; set'. Root j-‘-l.
usage: Very common: جعله الله 'which God hath made/ordained'.

definition: Perfect 1st person singular of ja‘ala: I made, rendered, placed. Root j-‘-l.
notes: In جعلت نفسک دانیة it is 2sg ja‘alta 'thou hast made (abased) thyself'.

definition: Verb ja‘ala 'to make, appoint, place' with suffix -hu 'it, him': He made it. Root j-‘-l.
Noun ḥáṣil 'result, yield, product' with indefinite -í: any result. Root ḥ-ṣ-l.
usage: In negative phrases such as جز ... حاصلی نبخشید 'yielded naught but ...'.

definition: Accusative of ḥubb 'love', used adverbially: out of love, for the love of. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: In phrases like حبّاً لی 'for love of Me' and حبّاً لجمالی 'from love of My beauty'.

definition: Plural of ḥamáma: doves. Root ḥ-m-m.
usage: A symbol of the Manifestations or holy souls, e.g. حمامات قدسی 'holy doves', حمامات ازلیه 'the Doves of eternity'.
notes: Not to be confused with حمّامات 'baths' in the Aqdas.

shift: Here: life, as in the water of life (کوثر حیوان). Today: an animal.
definition: Noun: animal; in older and Qur'anic usage also life, living. Root ḥ-y-y.
usage: In کوثر حیوان 'the water of life' (Hidden Words) it means life; elsewhere 'animal' or 'beast'.
notes: Modern Persian uses it only for 'animal'.

definition: Being the Seal; finality, the station of the Seal of the Prophets (خاتم النّبیّین). Root kh-t-m.
usage: In the Íqán Bahá'u'lláh shows that sealship (ختمیّت) and beginning (بدئیّت) are equally true of every Manifestation.

definition: Noun: error, mistake, sin, fault. Root kh-ṭ-’.
usage: Error or sin, as in بغیر از خطا سبیلی نخواهند 'they seek no path but error'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): I created thee. Root kh-l-q.
usage: HW: عرفت حبّی فیک فخلقتک 'I knew My love for thee, therefore I created thee'.

definition: Past of dáshtan, to have; with muqarrar forms 'I ordained, I appointed'.
notes: In مقرّر داشتم the verb is a compound with muqarrar.

definition: Past participle of dánistan, to know: having known, knowingly; with ast omitted 'has known' or 'has deemed'.
usage: 'Having known'; in the Writings often 'having deemed', as in sufficient دانسته 'considered sufficient'.

definition: Noun: guidance, indication; dalálat kardan/namúdan "to guide, lead". Root d-l-l.
usage: Guidance, indication; dalálat namúdan 'to lead, guide', as of guiding souls to God.

definition: Noun: gold. Root dh-h-b.
usage: Gold, often figurative of something refined by tests, like gold in fire.
notes: Not the verb dhahaba "went" here.

definition: Noun (only in construct): possessor of, endowed with, having.
usage: Possessor of; in divine names like ذو الجلال 'Lord of Glory' and ذو الفضل العظیم 'possessed of great bounty'.
notes: Nominative of dhú/dhá/dhí.

definition: Adjective and adverb: free, gratis; freely, without cost.
usage: Freely, without cost; of divine grace given freely, as in grace bestowed ráygán.

definition: Noun rabb 'Lord' with suffix -ná 'our'. Root r-b-b.
usage: 'Our Lord', the opening of many prayers and Qur'anic invocations.
notes: Genitive after bismi: bismi rabbina’l-‘alíyyi’l-a‘lá.

definition: Noun: foot, leg. Root r-j-l.
usage: 'Foot', as in the call to unity to walk 'with the same feet' (تمشون علی رجل واحدة).
notes: 'tamshúna ‘alá rijlin wáḥidah' walk with the same feet.

definition: Noun: man, adult male. Root r-j-l.
usage: 'Man', a common word, as in رجال 'men', sometimes used of the men of God or of the House of Justice.
notes: Same spelling as rijl 'foot'.

definition: Noun: mark, trace, outline; custom, manner; "ism u rasm" name and description. Root r-s-m.
usage: Trace, mark; also custom; in phrases like اسم و رسم "name and description".

definition: Plural of rasm: customs, rules, conventions, ways. Root r-s-m.
usage: Customs and conventions, often outworn human customs set against divine law, as in رسوم و عادات 'customs and habits'.

definition: Noun riḍá 'good-pleasure, contentment' with suffix -í 'My': My good-pleasure. Root r-ḍ-w.
usage: God's good-pleasure is the goal of the believer, as in رضاء الله 'the good-pleasure of God'.

definition: Noun: a narrated tradition, report; narration. Arabic riwáya, root r-w-y.
usage: In the Íqán a reported Islamic tradition, as in روایت کمیل 'the tradition of Kumayl'.

definition: Persian verb, 3rd singular present subjunctive of raftan 'to go': (that) he go; with nouns, 'be done'.
Persian noun: river, stream.
Plural of zukhruf: ornaments, gilded trappings, vain embellishments. Root z-kh-r-f.
usage: Earthly vanities, often زخارف دنیا 'the vanities of the world'.

definition: Adjective sákin 'dwelling, still' with copula -and: they dwell, they reside. Root s-k-n.
Adjective: heavenly, celestial, revealed from heaven. Root s-m-w.
usage: Often of scripture, as in کتب سماوی 'heavenly Books' and الواح سماوی 'heavenly Tablets'.

definition: Noun سوی 'other than' with suffix: what is other than Him, all else.
usage: In the honorific روح ما سواه فداه 'may the souls of all else be a sacrifice for Him', said of the Báb.

definition: Noun: poet, one who composes verse. Root sh-‘-r.
usage: In the Íqán recalls the charge that Muhammad was شاعر مجنون "a mad poet" (Qur'an 37:36).

definition: Noun: condition, stipulation, requirement. Root sh-r-ṭ.
usage: In the Íqán the conditions of the true seeker (شرایط سالک).

definition: Noun: revealed religious law, sacred law; the code of a religion. Root sh-r-‘.
usage: The revealed law of a dispensation; cf. شریعت 'law, Dispensation'.

shift: Here: a stream, a watering place. Today: religious law, the shari'a (شریعت).
definition: Noun: watering place, stream; also religious law, a Dispensation. Root sh-r-‘.
usage: In the Íqán شریعهٔ فیض 'the stream of grace'; the related شریعت is the religious law of a Dispensation.
notes: Modern usage mostly 'religious law'.

definition: Persian plural of ṣaḥrá 'desert, open plain, wilderness', with the linking -y- of the izáfih. Root ṣ-ḥ-r.
usage: Figurative in the Íqán, as in صحراهای بعد 'the wilderness of remoteness'.
notes: Final ی is the izáfih linker.

definition: Plural of ṣaḥífa: leaves, scrolls, sacred books. Root ṣ-ḥ-f.
usage: Paired with kutub: کتب و صحف 'Books and Scriptures', صحف الهیّه 'divine Scriptures'.

definition: Noun: bird, birds (collective). Root ṭ-y-r.
usage: An image of the soul, e.g. طیر غافل 'a heedless bird'; طیر نار 'bird of fire' circling a lamp, i.e. a moth.

definition: Verbal noun: flying, flight. Root ṭ-y-r.
usage: In the Writings the soaring of the soul, as in در هوای نفسانی طیران نمائی 'soar in the realm of self'.

definition: Lover, one passionately in love. Root ‘-sh-q.
usage: In mystical passages the lover (عاشق) seeking the Beloved (معشوق), as in کدام عاشق 'what lover'.

definition: Preposition ‘an 'from, about' with suffix 'you' (plural).
notes: With عفا 'pardon': عفونا عنکم 'We have absolved you from'.

definition: Plural noun: the common people, the masses, laymen (as opposed to the learned). Root ‘-m-m.
usage: In the Íqán contrasted with علما: believers from among the common people versus learned deniers.

definition: Relational adjective from ‘Ísá: of Jesus, Christian.
usage: In the Íqán جمال عیسوی 'the beauty of Jesus'.

definition: Noun: bed, couch, bedding. Root f-r-sh.
usage: 'Bed, couch'; occurs in the Aqdas in laws on the household and in images of rest.
notes: Hidden Words: 'the couch of heedlessness'.

definition: Noun: separation, parting, especially from the beloved. Root f-r-q.
usage: Separation, especially from the Beloved; contrasted with waṣl 'union' in the Hidden Words.

definition: Verb farmúdan, past 1st singular: I commanded, I did; honorific auxiliary, here with takallum "I spoke".
usage: Honorific auxiliary in compound verbs used by the Manifestation, as in تکلم فرمودم 'I spoke'.

definition: Noun faḍl "grace, bounty" + -í "my": my grace, my bounty. Root f-ḍ-l.
usage: God's grace and bounty, freely given and not earned, as in بفضلی 'by My grace' in the Arabic Hidden Words.
notes: In Persian contexts -í can be the indefinite suffix: a bounty.

definition: Particle fa- with qad: then indeed, for verily (emphasising a completed act).
notes: Man ‘arafa nafsahu fa-qad ‘arafa rabbahu.

definition: Broken plural of faqír: the poor, the needy. Root f-q-r.
usage: The poor; also the spiritually poor before God, contrasted with اغنیا 'the rich'.

definition: Conjunction fa- 'then' + li- 'for' + -hu 'him': then it is for him; with an + verb: he may, he should.
Adverbial phrase: to some degree, in the least, somewhat; in short.
usage: In the least, to some degree; in negative clauses "not in the least".

definition: Adjective: near, close; before numbers 'about, nearly'. Root q-r-b.
usage: Near, and before numbers 'nearly'; spiritually nearness to God, as in قرب 'nearness'.

definition: Noun: cage, especially a bird-cage; figuratively the body or the self.
usage: In the Hidden Words the cage of self and the world: قفس بشکن 'break thy cage'.

definition: Verb: perfect 2nd singular masculine of qála, 'to say'. Root q-w-l.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse quoted in the Íqán: لئن قلت انّکم مبعوثون من بعد الموت 'if thou say, ye shall surely be raised after death'.
notes: After la’in the perfect has conditional present meaning.

definition: Verb: perfect 1st singular of qála, 'to say': I said. Root q-w-l.
usage: In narrated traditions: قلت جعلت فداک 'I said: may I be thy ransom'.

definition: Noun: shirt, garment, robe. Root q-m-ṣ.
usage: Often figurative, as in قمیص یوسف 'the garment of Joseph', emblem of the Manifestation's fragrance; قمیص جدید 'a new garment'.

definition: Compound noun 'no-place': the realm beyond space, the spiritual world. Root k-w-n.
usage: Mystical term for the spiritual realm, as ابواب لامکان 'the gates of the Placeless'.

definition: Adjective from Arabic lá yazál 'never ceasing': everlasting, eternal, imperishable. Root z-w-l.
usage: In the Íqán in phrases like شمس لایزالی 'the everlasting Sun'.

definition: Particle لعلّ 'perhaps, so that' with pronoun 'you (pl.)'.
notes: Qur'anic formula, as in لعلّکم تذکّرون 'haply ye will take heed'.

definition: Conditional particle لولا 'were it not for' with suffix: but for Thee.
usage: From the tradition لولاک لما خلقت الافلاک 'But for Thee, I would not have created the heavens'; ساحت لولاک is the realm of the Prophet's station.
notes: In Persian HW used as a name for the exalted court of the Beloved.

definition: Past tense of ماندن "to stay, remain": they remained; with محروم "they remained deprived".
Noun: table spread with food; heavenly food. Root m-y-d.
usage: In the Íqán the 'heavenly table' or food sent down from heaven (Qur'an 5:114), a figure for divine knowledge.

definition: Noun of place from bada’a: origin, starting point, source. Root b-d-’.
usage: God or the Manifestation as source, e.g. مبدء و معاد 'the Beginning and the Return'; علم را از مبدء و معدنش 'knowledge from its source and wellspring'.

definition: Passive participle: spread out, extended; detailed. Root b-s-ṭ.

shift: Here: taking up, undertaking a matter (e.g. its mention). Today: molesting, harassing, interfering.
definition: Active participle of form V ta‘arraḍa: engaging with, taking up a matter; in modern Persian 'molesting, harassing'. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: In the Íqán in متعرّض ذکر ... شدن 'to undertake the mention of', usually negated.

definition: Interrogative: when?; with الی 'until when, how long'.
usage: In the Hidden Words الی متی 'how long'.

definition: Matthew, the Evangelist and his Gospel.
usage: In the Íqán سفر اوّل که منسوب به متّی 'the first Gospel, attributed to Matthew'.

definition: Relative adjective (feminine form): of Muḥammad, Muḥammadan. Root ḥ-m-d.
usage: In the Íqán شمس محمدیه 'the Muḥammadan Sun', i.e. the Revelation of Muḥammad.

definition: Comparative adjective: firmer, stronger, more steadfast. Root ḥ-k-m.
Cities; broken plural of madína. Root m-d-n.
usage: Metaphorical, as in مداین معرفت و حکمت 'the cities of divine knowledge and wisdom'.
notes: Normalized spelling of مدائن.

definition: Feminine active participle of form IV: indicating, bearing evidence; used with بر. Root d-l-l.
usage: In the Íqán: اخبار مدلّهٔ بر 'traditions testifying to', verses that point to the Day of God.
notes: Feminine agreement with a plural noun, Arabic style.

definition: Noun: mirror. Root r-’-y.
usage: A frequent image: مرآت قلب 'the mirror of the heart', to be cleansed of the dust of self.

definition: Noun: man, male person; also a brave person.
Past of murdan, to die: he died.
Passive participle of sadda: closed, shut, blocked. Root s-d-d.
usage: 'Closed, blocked'; often of the gate of knowledge or grace, e.g. the claim that the gate of revelation is مسدود.

definition: Active participle (form IV), feminine: shining, radiant, rising. Root sh-r-q.
usage: Shining, rising; used of the dawning lights of revelation (anwár-i mushriqih).

definition: Noun: lamp, light; "miṣbáḥ-i aḥadíyyih" the Lamp of divine unity. Root ṣ-b-ḥ.
usage: A lamp, symbol of the Manifestation or of divine light, as in مصباح احدیه 'the Lamp of divine unity'.

definition: Noun (form III verbal noun): opposition, contention, dispute. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: Opposition and disputation, especially against the Manifestation; the Writings forbid contention and dispute.

definition: Noun: mine, source, place of origin; mineral. Root ‘-d-n.
usage: Mine or source, as in معدن علم 'mine of knowledge' and the gem-mine imagery of the Hidden Words.

definition: Noun: ladder, ascent; specifically Muḥammad's night ascension to heaven. Root ‘-r-j.
usage: Ascent; the Night Ascent of Muḥammad, and figuratively the soul's ascent toward God.

definition: Noun: west; place or time of sunset. Root gh-r-b.
usage: 'The West', usually paired with مشرق 'the East', as in مشرق و مغرب 'East and West', meaning the whole world.
notes: Paired with mashriq 'east'.

definition: Passive participle: seen, observed, considered. Root l-ḥ-ẓ.
usage: Observed, perceived; used in the formal phrase ملحوظ شدن "to be noticed".
notes: Malḥúẓ uftád it was noticed.

definition: Contraction of min 'from' and man 'who': from him who, of those who.
Passive participle: looked at; intended, meant, in view. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: In the Íqán of the meanings منظور 'intended' by a verse.

definition: Preposition min 'from, of' with suffix -hum 'them': of them, from among them.
notes: Common in Qur'anic quotations: فریق منهم 'a party of them'.

definition: Passive participle: named, called, designated. Root w-s-m.
usage: With نمودن/شدن 'to name, be named', as in موسوم به سلمان شد 'was named Salmán'.

definition: Noun: generosity, noble deed, bounty. Root k-r-m.
usage: Divine bounty, as غمام مکرمت 'the clouds of bounty'.

definition: Noun: middle, midst; with izáfih 'between, among'.
Noun: balance, scales; criterion or standard of judgement. Root w-z-n.
usage: In the Writings the divine Balance by which all are weighed, as in القسطاس الأعظم 'the Most Great Balance'; also a standard of knowledge.

definition: Active participle: looking, beholding, regarding; with شدن 'to consider'. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: ناظر بایام قبل شوید 'consider the former days'.

definition: Negative subjunctive of دادن "to give": (that) he not give; in ترجیح ندهد "not prefer".
Negative past participle of دیدن 'to see': 'unseen; not having seen'.
Negative past participle of shinídan 'to hear': not having heard; also a perfect with the auxiliary left out.
Verb, negative present perfect 3rd plural of shinídan 'to hear'; with a scent, 'to smell'.
usage: With رائحه 'fragrance', as in رائحهٔ ایمان نشنیده‌اند 'have not inhaled the fragrance of faith'.

definition: Noun of single instance: a breath, puff, blast (as on a trumpet). Root n-f-kh.
usage: In the Íqán the blast on the trumpet of the Day of Resurrection, interpreted as the call of the Manifestation; also نفخهٔ روح القدس 'the breath of the Holy Spirit'.

definition: Negative past continuous of shudan 'to become': was not becoming; in conditionals 'were not'.
Negative past of نمودن, the formal light verb: he/she did not (do), with a preceding noun.
usage: Formal auxiliary in the Íqán, as in اجابت ننمود 'answered not'.

definition: Proper noun: Noah, the prophet of the Flood.
usage: In the Íqán an example of a Prophet whose people mocked Him for 950 years.

definition: Núr "light" with suffix -hu "his": his light. Root n-w-r.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse یأبی اللّه الّا ان یتمّ نوره 'God desireth only to perfect His light', quoted in the Íqán.
notes: Nominative after لیثبت; accusative núrahu after یتمّ.

definition: Negative past of گشتن 'to become'; with فائز 'attained not'.
Persian verb گشتن 'become, turn', negative past participle: not having become.
usage: Used as an auxiliary: فائز نگشته 'not having attained'.

definition: Negative present subjunctive of yáftan: does not find, may not attain.
Negative present perfect, third person plural, of yáftan 'to find, obtain': they have not found or attained.
usage: Of those who have not found or attained, as in the Íqán's lament for souls who did not attain recognition.

definition: Verb: negative past 3rd singular of ámadan "to come": did not come, did not arrive.
usage: Did not come; ordinary verb form.

definition: Noun: the month of April (Syriac Nisan); its spring rains, figuratively bounteous showers of grace.
usage: The April rains, figuratively bounteous showers of grace, as in ابر نیسان 'the April cloud'.

definition: Noun: perishing, ruin, death. Root h-l-k.
usage: Perishing, spiritual or physical ruin, the fate of those who turn away from God.

definition: Verb (form I perfect): he found, perceived, came upon. Root w-j-d.
usage: Of finding or perceiving, as in finding the fragrance of God or one's Beloved.
notes: With ‘arf (fragrance): perceived, inhaled.

definition: Noun: union, reunion with the beloved. Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: Union with the Beloved, the lover's goal, opposed to فراق or هجر 'separation'.

definition: Noun: fancy, illusion, vain imagining. Root w-h-m.
usage: 'Vain imagining, illusion', often plural اوهام, used of idle fancies and superstitions that veil people from the truth.
notes: Plural avhám.

definition: Adjective: great, large, grave. Root k-b-r.
usage: Great, grave; also in the divine name الکبیر "the Great".

definition: Perfect verb: it sufficed, is enough; kafá bi'lláh 'God sufficeth'. Root k-f-y.
usage: It suffices, as in the formula کفی بالله 'God sufficeth', found in prayers and verses of reliance on God.

definition: Noun: word, utterance, saying; here with the izáfih marker. Root k-l-m.
usage: Often the creative Word of God, کلمة الله; in the Hidden Words also a goodly word, کلمهٴ طیّبه.

definition: Noun: handmaid, slave-girl, female servant.
usage: In the Persian Hidden Words in the addresses ای پسر کنیز من and ای فرزند کنیز من 'O Son of My Handmaid!'.

definition: Persian noun گروه 'group, company' with indefinite -í: a group, some people.
Plural of gul 'flower, rose' with izáfih: the flowers of, the roses of.
usage: Imagery of the garden: گلهای قرب 'the roses of nearness'.

definition: Noun: hand; figuratively power, might. Root y-d-y.
usage: In the Writings often figurative, as in ید قدرت 'the hand of power'.

definition: Verb: he reads, recites. Root q-r-’.
usage: Used in the Aqdas of reciting verses in place of prayer.

definition: Verb, form I imperfect: he says, speaks. Root q-w-l.
usage: In Qur'anic quotations, as in والله یقول الحق 'God speaketh the truth'.

definition: Noun: right hand, right side; also oath. Root y-m-n.
usage: In the Writings یمین قدرت "the right hand of power" is a figure of God's might.

definition: Plural of ab 'father' with -kum: 'your fathers, forefathers'. Root '-b-w.
usage: Echoes the Qur'anic رب آبائکم الأوّلین 'the Lord of your forefathers'.
notes: Case varies: ábá’ukum (nom.) in the Íqán quotation, ábá’ikum (gen.) in the Aqdas.

definition: Feminine relative adjective from Aḥmad, a name of the Prophet Muḥammad: of Aḥmad, Muḥammadan. Root ḥ-m-d.
usage: In the Íqán شمس احمدیّه 'the Sun of Aḥmad', the Revelation of Muḥammad.

definition: Noun, plural of adná 'lowest': the lowly, common people. Root d-n-w.
usage: Paired with اعالی, as in اعالی و ادانی 'high and low'.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV adh‘ana: submission, acknowledgment, assent. Root dh-‘-n.
usage: In اذعان کردن 'to acknowledge', often paired with اقرار 'confession'.

definition: Idhn 'permission, leave' with -hi: His permission. Root ’-dh-n.
usage: In the formula الّا بعد اذنه 'save after His leave'.

definition: Imperative: remember! mention! make mention of. Root dh-k-r.
usage: A frequent address in the Aqdas, اذکر 'Call thou to mind'; ذکر الله 'the remembrance of God'.

definition: Verbal noun of form X: smelling, inhaling a fragrance. Root sh-m-m.
usage: Used of perceiving spiritual fragrances, as in استشمام کند 'inhale the fragrance'.

definition: Being occupied, engaging in something; employment. Form VIII verbal noun, root sh-gh-l.
usage: With نمودن 'to busy oneself with', as of those occupied with scheming and hypocrisy.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV: leading astray, misguiding. Root ḍ-l-l.
usage: Of the divines who lead the people astray; اضلال کردن 'to lead astray'.

definition: Arabic verb (form VIII): he became aware of, was informed of. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: Aqdas: ما اطّلع بها الّا اللّه 'none knoweth it save God'.

definition: Plural of a‘lá: the highest, the eminent, people of high rank. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: Paired with ادانی, as in از اعالی و ادانی 'high and low'.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV a‘ána: help, assistance; i‘ánat namúdan 'to assist'. Root ‘-w-n.
usage: 'Help, assistance'; used of aiding the poor or the Cause, as in اعانت فقرا.

definition: Elative of qaríb: nearer, nearest, closest. Root q-r-b.
usage: Nearer, nearest; as in nearer than one's life-vein, of God's nearness.

shift: Here: origination, God's creation without precedent. Today (Arabic): invention.
definition: Verbal noun form VIII with article: invention, origination, creation without precedent. Root kh-r-‘.
usage: Origination or creation without precedent, used of God's creative act, as in عالم الاختراع.

definition: Noun (feminine of ákhir "last"): the hereafter, the world to come. Root ’-kh-r.
usage: The hereafter, often paired with الدنیا, as in الدنیا والآخرة 'this world and the next'.

definition: Feminine of ákhar: the other, the latter; also the next life. Root '-kh-r.
usage: The other; in الآخرة 'the next life' and النشأة الاخری 'the other creation'.
notes: Al-qiyámat al-ukhrá = the other Resurrection.

definition: Broken plural of rúḥ: spirits, souls. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Spirits, souls, as in عالم الارواح 'the world of spirits'.
notes: In rúḥu’l-arwáḥ 'Spirit of Spirits'.

definition: Noun, plural of azal 'beginningless eternity'; azal al-ázál: from all eternity. Root ’-z-l.
usage: 'Eternities', in the phrase ازل الآزال 'from all eternity', describing the beginningless existence of God.
notes: Genitive al-ázáli.

definition: Plural of sabab: causes, means, requisites. Root s-b-b.
usage: Means and causes; the Writings speak of God as مسبب الاسباب "the Causer of causes" and of using material means.

definition: Elative of saní: most sublime, most resplendent, loftiest. Root s-n-w.
usage: Most sublime or loftiest, as in الافق الاسنی 'the most sublime horizon' and other descriptions of the realm of God.

definition: Plural of fu’ád: hearts, the inmost hearts. Root f-’-d.
usage: The inmost heart; in اولو الافئدة 'they that are endowed with understanding hearts'.

definition: Noun: verse of scripture; sign. Root '-y-y.
usage: الی آخر الآیة 'to the end of the verse'; in the Aqdas هذه الآیة 'this verse', which must not be interpreted otherwise than revealed.
notes: Accusative al-áyata in the Aqdas (یأوّل هذه الآیة).

definition: Noun: sight, eyesight, the eye; insight. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: Sight and vision, as in بمنزلة البصر للبشر 'as sight unto man'.

definition: Verbal noun: permanence, everlasting life, subsistence. Root b-q-y.
usage: Opposed to فناء 'evanescence'; everlasting life in God.

definition: Verbal noun: clear exposition, eloquent utterance, explanation. Root b-y-n.
usage: In the Aqdas in شمس الحکمة و التبیان 'the Sun of wisdom and utterance'.

definition: Noun: dust, earth, soil. Root t-r-b.
usage: Often a figure of lowliness, as in علی التّراب 'upon the dust'.

definition: Divine name: the One who ever turns in mercy to the repentant. Root t-w-b.
usage: Closes passages on repentance and pardon, as in انّه هو التّوّاب 'He is the Ever-Forgiving'.

definition: Adjective: praiseworthy; with the article a divine name, "the All-Praised". Root ḥ-m-d.
usage: A divine name, usually paired as العزیز الحمید "the Almighty, the All-Praised".

definition: Adjective: pure, unmixed, sincere, absolute. Root kh-l-ṣ.
usage: In the Aqdas العدل الخالص 'pure (strict) justice'.

definition: Noun: mention, remembrance; recitation of God's names; also Scripture. Root dh-k-r.
usage: اهل الذکر (Qur'an 16:43) 'the people of the Remembrance', those with knowledge; in the Aqdas the recitation of God's praise.

definition: Noun, plural of rasúl: messengers, apostles. Root r-s-l.
usage: In the Qur'anic تلک الرسل فضّلنا بعضهم علی بعض 'Some of the Apostles We have caused to excel others'.

definition: Plural of shahr 'month' with the article: the months. Root sh-h-r.
usage: In the Aqdas of the nineteen months of the Badí‘ calendar, as in الأیام الزائدة عن الشهور 'the days in excess of the months'.

definition: Fasting, the fast. Root ṣ-w-m.
usage: In traditions quoted in the Íqán: الصّوم ضیآء 'fasting is light'; in Bahá'í law the Nineteen-Day Fast.

definition: Active participle: manifest, apparent, outward; a name of God. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: From Qur'an 57:3 الاول و الآخر و الظاهر و الباطن 'the First and the Last, the Seen and the Hidden'.

definition: Noun, plural of ẓann: suppositions, conjectures, vain imaginings. Root ẓ-n-n.
usage: Paired with اوهام: الظّنون و الأوهام 'idle fancies and vain imaginings'.

definition: The All-Knowing; intensive form of ‘álim and a name of God. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Closes Aqdas verses, as in انّه لهو العزیز العلّام 'He, verily, is the Mighty, the All-Knowing'.

definition: Plural of ‘ilm: sciences, branches of knowledge, learning. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Aqdas both learning that blinds (من غرّته العلوم 'whom learning hath made proud') and useful sciences to be studied (العلوم ما ینفعکم).

definition: Noun: the cloud; the realm of divine hiddenness above all knowing. Root ‘-m-y.
usage: In the address یا ابن العماء 'O Son of the Supreme!' in the Arabic Hidden Words.

definition: Intensive adjective and divine name: the Most Bountiful, ever-gracious. Root f-ḍ-l.
usage: In the Aqdas, انّه لهو الفضّال الکریم 'He, verily, is the Bountiful, the All-Generous'.

definition: Plural of faqír, poor or needy: the poor; mystically, those wholly in need of God. Root f-q-r.
usage: 'The poor'; in the Writings both the materially poor, entrusted to the rich, and those wholly in need of God.
notes: Qur'an 35:15 antum al-fuqará’u ilá Alláh.

definition: Noun with article: kinship, relationship; dhawu’l-qurbá "kindred, relatives". Root q-r-b.
usage: Kindred; in dhawu'l-qurbá 'kindred, relatives', as in Aqdas provisions for relatives.

definition: Noun with article: the moon. Root q-m-r.
usage: The moon, often symbolic in prophecies (sun, moon and stars) as interpreted in the Kitáb-i-Íqán.
notes: Nominative as subject.

definition: Noun: strength, power, might. Root q-w-y.
usage: Power or might, as in the formula لا حول ولا قوّة إلا بالله 'there is no power nor strength save in God'.

definition: Noun: rising, resurrection; yawm al-qiyámah = the Day of Resurrection. Root q-w-m.
usage: The Resurrection, as in یوم القیامة; interpreted in the Íqán as the advent of the new Manifestation.

definition: Active participle of form VI used as a divine name: the Most Exalted, the Most High. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: 'The Most Exalted', a divine name, often in phrases like الملک المتعال.

definition: Passive participle: praised, praiseworthy; al-maqám al-maḥmúd the praiseworthy station. Root ḥ-m-d.
usage: 'Praiseworthy', in the Qur'anic المقام المحمود 'the praiseworthy station'; related to the name Muḥammad.

definition: Passive participle of dhakara: mentioned, aforesaid. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Aforementioned; used in the Aqdas when referring back to a law or item.

definition: Plural of malik: kings, sovereigns; malik al-mulúk 'King of kings'. Root m-l-k.
usage: Kings, chiefly in the Aqdas's address یا معشر الملوک 'O concourse of kings' and in the Tablets to the kings.

definition: Adjective: shining, luminous, light-giving. Root n-w-r.
usage: A frequent epithet, e.g. المنظر المنیر 'the luminous Spot', الکتاب المنیر 'the luminous Book'.

definition: Noun: dead person, the deceased. Root m-w-t.
usage: صلوة المیت 'the Prayer for the Dead', the only congregational prayer retained in the Aqdas.

definition: Noun (feminine): dove, pigeon (literally 'the ashen-grey one'); a poetic bird. Root w-r-q.
usage: A symbol of the Holy Spirit or the Manifestation singing, as in نغمة الورقاء 'the melody of the Dove'.

definition: Active participle plural: unbelievers, deniers, infidels. Root k-f-r.
usage: Common in Qur'anic quotations about those who rejected the Prophets.

definition: Adjective, feminine elative of kabír: the greatest, the most great. Root k-b-r.
usage: In the Aqdas العصمة الکبری 'the Most Great Infallibility' of the Manifestation.

definition: Noun: word, utterance; the creative Word of God. Root k-l-m.
usage: In the Writings often the divine Word, as in کلمة الله 'the Word of God'.

definition: Noun: religious community, people following a prophet; (modern) nation. Root '-m-m.
usage: امت انجیل 'the people of the Gospel', امت فرقان 'the people of the Qur'an'.

shift: Here: inaccessibility, the unattainable heights of the spiritual realm. Today: refusal, abstention.
definition: Verbal noun of form VIII imtana‘a: being unattainable, inaccessible; modern sense refusal, abstention. Root m-n-‘.
usage: In the Writings describes the inaccessible heights of the spiritual realm, as in رفرف امتناع قرب "the exalted heights of nearness".
notes: Modern Persian امتناع usually means "refusal".

definition: Plural of maṭar 'rain': rains, showers. Root m-ṭ-r.
usage: In the Íqán figurative, as in امطار رحمت 'showers of mercy'.

definition: Plural of mawj: waves, billows. Root m-w-j.
usage: Often of the ocean of divine utterance, e.g. امواج بحر 'the waves of the ocean'.

definition: Noun, plural of mál: possessions, wealth, property. Root m-w-l.
Noun ahl 'people, family; those worthy of' with the Persian suffix -ash 'its, his'. Root ’-h-l.
usage: اهل in the Writings: the people of something (اهل بهاء 'the people of Bahá') or those worthy of it.

definition: Intention, resolve, aim; also melody. آهنگ ... نمودن 'to set out for'.
usage: In the Hidden Words آهنگ مقام خود نمائی 'set out for thine own station'.
notes: Modern sense is chiefly 'melody, tune'.

definition: Noun: elixir, the philosopher's stone that turns base metal into gold.
usage: In the Íqán the divine Elixir that transforms souls, as in اکسیر الهی 'the divine Elixir'.
notes: From Greek via Arabic.

definition: Noun, plural of áyah 'sign, verse' with the suffix 'our': Our signs, Our verses.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse سنریهم آیاتنا فی الآفاق 'We will show them Our signs in the world'.

definition: Days (plural of yawm) with suffix -hi "his": his days. Root y-w-m.
usage: As in لقاء اللّه فی ایّامه 'attainment unto the presence of God in His Days'.

definition: Pronoun ایشان 'they' with the copula -and 'are'.
Plural of امام: leaders; the Shí‘ih Imams. Root ’-m-m.
usage: In the Íqán usually the Imams: ائمّهٔ دین 'the Imams of the Faith'.

definition: Preposition bi- with asbáb, plural of sabab: means, causes, worldly goods and trappings. Root s-b-b.
usage: In the Writings asbáb are the material means and trappings of the world.

definition: Noun báṭin 'inside, inner reality' with suffix -hu 'its'. Root b-ṭ-n.
usage: 'Its inner reality'; contrasted with ظاهر 'outward', in discussions of the inner meanings of scripture.
notes: In the Íqán context read báṭinih, feminine adjective 'inner' (samá’-i báṭinih).

definition: Adjective (feminine): inward, hidden, inner. Root b-ṭ-n.
usage: Inward, hidden; used of inner meanings of scripture (ma‘ání-yi báṭiníyyih), contrasted with ẓáhir 'outward'.

definition: Active participle, feminine: reaching, perfect, consummate; "ḥikmat-i bálighih" consummate wisdom. Root b-l-gh.
usage: Consummate or far-reaching, as in حکمت بالغه 'consummate wisdom' and حجت بالغه 'conclusive proof'.

definition: Phrase bi "by" + amr "command" + -hi "his": by his command. Root ’-m-r.
usage: By His command; God creates and decrees بامره, and in Bahá'í usage امر also means His Cause.

definition: Persian bi- with ḥarf (letter, word) and indefinite -í: with or by a single letter. Root ḥ-r-f.
usage: Ḥarf 'letter, word'; e.g. by a single letter of God's Word; also حروف حی 'Letters of the Living'.

definition: Broken plural of baḥr: seas, oceans. Root b-ḥ-r.
usage: Seas, usually figurative: seas of knowledge, meaning or grace.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with, to' + ḥayát 'life'. Root ḥ-y-y.
usage: 'With life', as in بحیات باقیه 'with everlasting life', the spiritual life conferred by faith.
notes: bi-ḥayát-i-báqiyih: with everlasting life.

definition: bi + khila‘ (plural of khil‘ah): robes of honour. Root kh-l-‘.
usage: Robes of honour; figuratively the spiritual garments God bestows, as in خلع اثبات "robes of affirmation".
notes: Read as robes of affirmation contrasted with the garment of negation.

definition: Adjective/noun: bad, evil, ill; bad ma-shinaw 'hear no evil'.
usage: The everyday word for bad or evil; in the Hidden Words, بد مبین و بد مشنو 'see no evil and hear no evil'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with' plus dídih 'eye, sight'.
usage: Common in بدیدهٔ بصیرت 'with the eye of discernment'.

definition: Imperative of bar-dáshtan, 'to lift, to take up; to withdraw'.
usage: قدم برداشتن 'to take a step'; دست برداشتن 'to withdraw one's hand, give up'.

definition: Noun burhán 'proof' with indefinite -í and است: (it) is a proof. Root b-r-h-n.
usage: Proof of the Cause, as in برهانیست واضح 'a clear proof'.

definition: Preposition bi 'to' with sáḥat 'courtyard, court, precincts'. Root s-w-ḥ.
usage: The court of God's holiness or presence, as ساحت قدس 'the court of holiness'.

definition: Preposition bi with shams: by, with or as the sun. Root sh-m-s.
usage: In the Íqán sun and moon (شمس و قمر) are symbols of religious leaders and laws.

definition: Persian بـ with Arabic عدم 'non-existence, absence, lack'. Root ‘-d-m.
usage: عدم also means non-being, opposed to وجود 'existence'.

definition: Preposition ب with plural of ‘aql: to, by or with minds, intellects. Root ‘-q-l.
Adjective: far, distant, remote; improbable. Root b-‘-d.
Prepositional phrase 'by/through the grace of', from bi- and faḍl 'grace, bounty'. Root f-ḍ-l.
usage: Common in بفضل الله 'by the grace of God'.

definition: Noun: town, city, land, country. Root b-l-d.
usage: In the Íqán a city or land, e.g. از بلد اخراج نمودند 'they expelled Him from the city'.

definition: Noun balad 'town, land' with Persian indefinite -í: a city, a land. Root b-l-d.
Preposition bi- 'with, by, in' + lisán 'tongue, language'. Root l-s-n.
usage: بلسان القدرة 'with the tongue of power'; in Persian 'in a language', as بلسان دیگر 'with another tongue'.
notes: In the Íqán read Persian-style bi-lisán.

definition: Bi- 'to, at' plus maqám 'station, rank': to/at the station or degree. Root q-w-m.
Adverbial phrase: in no way, by no means (with a negative verb).
notes: Mixes Persian هیچ with Arabic وجه 'aspect'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'to, with' and vujúd 'existence, being'.
usage: In بوجود آمدن 'to come into being'; وجود also means 'existence' and 'the world of being' in the Writings.

definition: Present subjunctive 3sg of وزیدن "to blow" (of wind): that it may blow.
usage: Of divine breezes, as in نسیم رحمتی بوزد 'that a breeze of mercy may waft'.

definition: Preposition bi 'with, by' joined to چشم 'eye'.
usage: Figurative 'with the eye of', as in بچشم علم الیقین 'with the eye of certain knowledge'.

definition: Persian verb گفتن 'say', present subjunctive: that he say.
Adjective: without share, deprived, bereft.
Persian bí- 'without' plus Arabic ḥijáb 'veil': without veil, openly, unveiled.
usage: 'Unveiled'; used of truth or beauty shining without veils, as in the divine Beauty appearing بی‌حجاب.

definition: Preposition bi- plus yaqín "certainty": with certainty, assuredly. Root y-q-n.
usage: With certainty; yaqín 'certainty' is the goal of the Kitáb-i-Íqán ('Book of Certitude').

definition: Verb akhadha "to take, seize", imperfect 3rd feminine singular with -kum: (it) seizes you. Root '-kh-dh.
notes: lá ta’khudhukumu’l-aḥzán sorrows shall not seize you.

definition: Adjective: dark, gloomy, obscure.
usage: Dark; often figurative, of hearts darkened by self and heedlessness, contrasted with روشن 'radiant'.

definition: Verb (form IV, 2nd sing. jussive) of aḥabba: you love. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: Of loving, as in the Hidden Words counsel 'if thou lovest Me'.
notes: In tuḥibba nafsí = If thou lovest Me.

definition: Verb, perfect 3rd masc. sing.: he left, abandoned. Root t-r-k.
usage: He left, abandoned; e.g. of one who forsakes God's command.
notes: Quranic má taraka ‘alá ẓahrihá 'He would not leave on its back'.

definition: Noun: leaving, abandoning; with kardan 'to forsake, give up'. Root t-r-k.
usage: Abandonment; ترک کردن 'to forsake', often of forsaking the world or self.

definition: Verb, imperfect 2nd person masculine plural of shahida: ye witness, bear witness. Root sh-h-d.
usage: 'Ye witness, bear witness', used of the believers testifying to the truth of God's Cause.

definition: Verbal noun, Form II: expression, designation; interpretation of dreams. Root ‘-b-r.
usage: Expression, designation; تعبیر شده "has been designated"; also interpretation of dreams.
notes: Ta‘bír yáftih has been designated.

definition: Jussive (after lá) of fariḥa 'to rejoice, be glad': rejoice not. Root f-r-ḥ.
usage: Usually in the prohibition لا تفرح 'rejoice not', warning against delight in worldly things or the sorrows of others.

definition: Verbal noun: being split, cleft asunder. Root f-ṭ-r.
usage: In the Íqán تفطّر سماء 'the cleaving of the heaven', a sign of the Hour, interpreted as the annulment of the former religion.

definition: Verbal noun: turning over, transforming, changing completely. Root q-l-b.
usage: In the Íqán, of the transforming power of the Word of God: تقلیب شدن 'to be transformed'.

definition: Arabic verb, jussive of kána 'to be': (thou) be; with لا, 'be not'.
Noun: mountain, mount. Root j-b-l.
usage: In sacred place names, as جبل فاران 'Mount Paran'.

definition: Verb, past 3rd pl. of justan 'to seek'; light verb in compounds like احتراز جستن 'to avoid'.
notes: Here احتراز جستند 'they shunned'.

definition: Verb: he is great, exalted; used as a doxology after God's name. Root j-l-l.
usage: In formulas such as جلّ و عزّ 'magnified and glorified be He' and جلّ جلاله.

definition: Verb, form II passive: was defined, was fixed, was prescribed. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: In the Aqdas for what is fixed by law, as in فیما حدّد فی الکتاب 'as prescribed in the Book'.
notes: Could also be read active ḥaddada 'He prescribed'.

definition: Plural of ḥadd with suffix "my": My limits, laws, ordinances. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: In the Writings حدود are God's laws, as in اعمل حدودی "Walk in My statutes" and تلک حدود الله "these are the ordinances of God".
notes: In Persian prose (Íqán) the same letters can be حدودی "certain laws" with indefinite ی.

definition: Proper noun: Ḥusayn, the third Shí‘ih Imám, son of ‘Alí, martyred at Karbilá.
usage: In the Íqán حسین بن علی 'Ḥusayn son of ‘Alí', whose return is foretold.

definition: Accusative of ḥaqq used adverbially: truly, verily; also a due share or right. Root ḥ-q-q.
notes: In the Aqdas ثمّ عیّنوا للامین حقّاً it means 'a share' for the trustee.

definition: Noun ḥaqq 'right, claim, truth' with -í 'my': My right, My claim. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: In the Hidden Words حقّی علیک کبیر 'My claim on thee is great'.

definition: Abstract noun from ḥaqq: truth, truthfulness, validity. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: In the Íqán of a Revelation or a Book: شهادت بر حقّیّت آن 'testimony to its truth'.

definition: Ḥamza, uncle of Muḥammad, titled سیّد الشّهدآء 'Prince of Martyrs'.
usage: Cited in the Íqán as one whom faith transformed, contrasted with Abú-Jahl.

definition: Noun ḥín with indefinite -í: a time, a moment; در حینی که 'while'. Root ḥ-y-n.
Adjective: pure, sincere, unmixed. Root kh-l-ṣ.
usage: In the Writings sincerity of heart, as in تقوای خالص 'stainless piety' and دوستان خالص 'sincere friends'.

definition: God; the form of خدا used before izáfih or as a literary variant.
usage: As in خدای واحد شاهد است 'the one God is My witness'.

definition: Verbal noun: going out, coming forth, departure, emergence. Root kh-r-j.
usage: Paired with دخول 'entering'; خروج از بطن امّ 'issuing from the mother's womb'.

definition: Plural: created beings, creatures, mankind. Root kh-l-q.
usage: In the Íqán the people at large, e.g. حساب خلایق 'the reckoning of the people'.

definition: Present perfect of dánistan: they have known, they have considered or deemed.
Present tense, third person plural, of dánistan 'to know': they know, consider, deem.
usage: 'They know, deem'; often of people's false judgments, as in what they deem knowledge.

definition: Verb: past 1st plural of dakhala "to enter". Root d-kh-l.
usage: We entered; ordinary verb, as of God or the Manifestation entering a place.

definition: Noun/interjection: regret, alas; "dirígh dáshtan" to withhold, begrudge.
usage: 'Alas', a lament over heedlessness; دریغ داشتن 'to withhold, begrudge'.

definition: Noun, plural of dushman: enemies, foes.
usage: Enemies, especially of God and His Cause; Bahá'u'lláh counsels love and forbearance even towards them.

definition: Imperative pl. of wada‘a (yada‘u): leave ye, abandon, forsake. Root w-d-‘.
usage: 'Leave ye', of abandoning vain desires and what people possess, as in دعوا ما عندکم.
notes: Not da‘aw (they called).

definition: Noun dalíl 'proof, evidence, guide' with indefinite -í. Root d-l-l.
usage: A proof; the Íqán sets out the proofs (دلیل و برهان) of the Manifestation's truth.

definition: Past participle of damídan 'to breathe, blow; to sprout, dawn'.
usage: 'Blown, breathed', used of the trumpet blast (نفخ صور) of the Day of God, and of the dawn breaking.
notes: With shudan: was blown (into the trumpet).

definition: Preposition dún (below, other than) with 1st-person suffix: other than me.
usage: In phrases like ما دونی "all else besides Me", contrasting God with all created things.

definition: Noun: progeny, descendants, offspring. Root dh-r-r.
usage: Progeny or descendants, as in ذرّیّة آدم 'the offspring of Adam'.

definition: Adjective from dhahab 'gold': golden, of gold. Root dh-h-b.
usage: In the Íqán's alchemical image of copper reaching مقام ذهبی 'the state of gold', a figure for spiritual transformation.

definition: Noun dhikr 'mention, remembrance' with suffix -hu: His mention, His remembrance. Root dh-k-r.
usage: In the formula جلّ ذکره 'exalted be His mention', written after the name of God.

definition: Noun: head; also top, chief. Root r-'-s.
usage: The head, as in رأس مبارک 'the blessed head'; عین رأس 'the outward eye'.

definition: Noun: the office of messenger, apostleship, prophetic mission; also a message. Root r-s-l.
usage: The station of the Messengers of God, distinguished in the Íqán from the station of essential unity.

definition: Verb, perfect of raḍiya: to be content, pleased; to choose for. Root r-ḍ-y.
usage: In the Hidden Words of contentment with what God wills.
notes: In the second context (رضیت لک ما رضیت لنفسی) read raḍítu 'I chose'.

definition: Noun, plural of rá’iḥah: scents, fragrances, sweet savours. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: In the Writings fragrances of the spirit, as in روائح قدس 'holy fragrances'.
notes: Normalized from روائح.

definition: Plural of rayḥán: sweet-smelling herbs, flowers. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Metaphor for spiritual fruits, as in ریاحین حکمت 'the hyacinths of wisdom'.

definition: Active participle of zála: passing away, vanishing, perishable. Root z-w-l.
usage: Contrasted with باقی "abiding", as in کلام من هرگز زایل نمیشود "My words shall never pass away".
notes: Written زائل.

definition: Verb: 'he adorned, embellished', form II of z-y-n.
notes: In the second context passive zuyyina 'hath been adorned' (قد زیّن اوّلها).

definition: Plural of sál 'year': years; adverbially, for years.
Verbal noun: reviling, abusing, cursing. Root s-b-b.
Noun sabíl 'path, way, road' in the indefinite accusative. Root s-b-l.
usage: سبیل الله 'the path of God'; here from Qur'an 7:146 لا یتّخذوه سبیلاً 'they will not take it for their way'.

definition: Plural of sukhan 'word, speech' in construct: the words of.
Noun: lote-tree; the Divine Lote-Tree, symbol of the Manifestation of God. Root s-d-r.
usage: سدرة المنتهی 'the Sadratu'l-Muntahá, the Tree beyond which there is no passing'; سدرة البهاء 'the Lote-Tree of Glory'.
notes: Construct state, final -at pronounced.

definition: Noun, Persian plural of siráj 'lamp' with izáfih: lamps (of). Root s-r-j.
usage: In the Íqán سراجهای عقل و فؤاد 'the lamps of reason and understanding'; سراج is a frequent image for the light of the spirit.

definition: Happy, fortunate, blessed; in religious usage one destined for felicity, opposite شقی. Root s-‘-d.
usage: Paired with شقی, as in تمیز میدهد سعید را از شقی 'He distinguisheth the blessed from the wretched'.

definition: Plural of sulṭán: kings, sovereigns, rulers. Root s-l-ṭ.
usage: Literal of earthly kings, and figurative of the Manifestations, as in سلاطین وجود 'the sovereigns of existence'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): we heard. Root s-m-‘.
usage: Qur'anic: سمعنا و اطعنا 'we have heard and obeyed', and سمعنا و عصینا 'we have heard and rebelled'.

definition: Noun used as preposition with 'my': other than me, besides me. Root s-w-y.
usage: God speaking: ان تطلب سوائی لن تجد 'if thou seekest another than Me, thou shalt never find'.
notes: Final letter is the 1sg suffix; hamza seated on yá.

definition: Noun: sword; Arabic word used in literary Persian. Root s-y-f.
usage: 'Sword'; the Writings abolish holy war and replace the sword with the sword of the tongue and of wisdom.

definition: Verb: present perfect 2nd plural of shudan "to become": you have become.
usage: Have become; ordinary verb form.
notes: Normalized from شده‌اید.

definition: Noun, plural of sharíṭa/sharṭ: conditions, requisites, signs. Root sh-r-ṭ.
usage: Conditions or requisites, as in the conditions laid down for the true seeker in the Kitáb-i-Íqán.

definition: Noun, plural of sharí‘at: religious laws, dispensations. Root sh-r-‘.
usage: Religious laws and the successive dispensations of the Manifestations, renewed in each age.
notes: Written شرائع.

definition: Persian plural of shams (sun) with izáfih: suns; figuratively the Manifestations. Root sh-m-s.
usage: Suns, figuratively the Manifestations of God, as in Íqán discussions of the 'sun' in prophecy.

definition: Noun/adjective (accusative): witness, one who testifies; also martyr. Root sh-h-d.
usage: Witness, as in کفی بالله شهیدا 'God sufficeth as a witness'; also martyr.
notes: Formula wa kána’lláhu ‘alá má aqúlu shahídan.

definition: Noun: tumult, passion, ecstatic fervour; also adjective 'salty'.
usage: 'Fervour, ecstatic passion', used of the rapture of lovers of God, as in شور و شوق 'fervour and longing'.

definition: Noun: yearning, eager longing, desire. Root sh-w-q.
usage: Yearning, especially the soul's longing for God; often paired with ذوق "rapture" or in شوق لقا "longing for reunion".

definition: Noun: power, majesty, glory, pomp. Root sh-w-k.
usage: Power and majesty, as in شوکت و اقتدار; used of earthly pomp and of the majesty of the Cause.

definition: Noun shay’ 'thing' in the indefinite accusative: a thing, anything. Root sh-y-’.
usage: In the saying ما رأیت شیئاً الّا و قد رأیت الله فیه 'I perceive no thing save that I perceive God within it'.

definition: Plural (oblique) of ṣádiq: truthful ones, men of truth. Root ṣ-d-q.
usage: In the Qur'anic formula ان کنتم صادقین 'if ye be truthful'.

definition: Adjective, feminine of ṣáfí: pure, clear, limpid. Root ṣ-f-w.
usage: Purity of springs or bodies, as in عیون صافیه 'pure springs'.

definition: Plural of ṣadr: breasts, bosoms, hearts. Root ṣ-d-r.
usage: Seat of inner knowledge, as صدور منیره 'luminous breasts'.

definition: Verbal noun: issuing, proceeding from, being revealed or promulgated. Root ṣ-d-r.
usage: Of laws or words issuing from the Manifestation.

definition: Noun: red wine; in mystical poetry the wine of divine love. Root ṣ-h-b.
usage: In the Íqán spiritual wine, as in صهبای ایمان 'the wine of faith'.

definition: Noun: fasting, the religious fast. Root ṣ-w-m.
usage: A religious ordinance; in the Aqdas the Fast is prescribed, paired with الصّلوة 'obligatory prayer'.

definition: Adjective (Arabic feminine form): outward, external, apparent. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: Contrasts the outward with the inner meaning, as in علوم ظاهریه 'outward learning'.

definition: Noun: supposition, conjecture, opinion, suspicion. Root ẓ-n-n.
usage: In the Writings ظنّ is idle fancy contrasted with یقین "certitude", often paired as ظنّ و گمان "idle fancies and vain imaginings".

definition: Noun ẓuhúr 'appearance, manifestation' with indefinite -í: 'a Revelation, a Dispensation'. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: In the Writings the appearance of a Manifestation of God, a Revelation or Dispensation, as in ظهور الله 'the Revelation of God'.
notes: In Arabic (Aqdas فی ظهوری) it is ẓuhúrí 'My Revelation'.

definition: Active participle of ‘arafa: knowing, cognizant; as noun, a gnostic, a mystic knower of God. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: In the Íqán with shudan 'to come to know'; in Sufi usage the ‘árif is the knower of God.

definition: Adjective: high, exalted; in polite address 'your (exalted)'. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: In the Íqán نظر عالی 'your exalted notice', addressed to the questioner.

definition: Feminine of ‘álí 'high, lofty, exalted', used in Persian with plural nouns. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: With plural nouns: صفات عالیه 'exalted attributes', شموس عالیه 'lofty suns'.

definition: Form I verb ‘arafa 'to know, recognize': you (pl.) knew. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: In هل عرفتم 'Know ye' and لو عرفتم 'if ye but knew'.

definition: Verbal noun: ascent, rising; ascension of the soul or of a Manifestation. Root ‘-r-j.
usage: عروج کن 'soar'; بعد از عروج 'after His ascension'.

definition: Numeral: ten, in compound numbers 11 to 19, as in تسعة عشر 'nineteen'. Root ‘-sh-r.
usage: In the Aqdas mostly in تسعة عشر 'nineteen', the number of the Bahá'í calendar, Ḥuqúqu'lláh and dowry, as in تسعة عشر مثقالاً 'nineteen mithqáls'.

definition: ‘Aṣr "age, epoch, era" with indefinite -í: an age. Root ‘-ṣ-r.
usage: Of each age or Dispensation, as in در هر عصری 'in every age'.

definition: Noun: protection, immunity from sin and error, infallibility; also chastity. Root ‘-ṣ-m.
usage: اهل عصمت 'the people of infallibility' (the Imams); the Writings speak of the Most Great Infallibility (عصمت کبری) of the Manifestation.

definition: Noun: gift, bestowal; with فرمودن/نمودن 'to bestow'. Root ‘-ṭ-w.
usage: Of God's bestowals, as in عطا و احسان 'bounty and favour'.

definition: Noun: sign, mark, token. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: HW: لکلّ شیء علامة و علامة الحبّ الصبر 'For everything there is a sign. The sign of love is fortitude'.

definition: Preposition ‘inda 'with, in the presence of' plus -í 'me': with Me, in My sight. Root ‘-n-d.
usage: 'With Me, in My sight'; in phrases like عندی 'in My sight', stating what God holds dear.

definition: Noun: end, limit, utmost degree; dar gháyat "extremely". Root gh-y-y.
usage: Utmost, end; in dar gháyat 'extremely' and gháyat-i quṣvá 'the utmost goal'.

definition: Noun: dust, fine dust in the air. Root gh-b-r.
usage: Dust, figuratively the dust of self and worldly attachment that obscures the heart's mirror.

definition: Noun: setting (of the sun or stars), sunset, decline. Root gh-r-b.
usage: Setting, of the sun; a figure for the passing of a Manifestation or the decline of a religion, opposite of طلوع 'rising'.

definition: Noun ghaná' with izáfih: wealth, riches, self-sufficiency. Root gh-n-y.
usage: Wealth or self-sufficiency, especially God's independence of all, as in غنای الهی.
notes: Distinct from ghiná' (singing).

definition: Noun: rain, abundant rain. Root gh-y-th.
usage: Rain, abundant rain, figurative for divine grace and bounty.

definition: Adjective: free, disengaged, unconcerned; at leisure. Root f-r-gh.
usage: 'Free, detached', as in فارغ باش 'be thou free', of detachment from all save God.
notes: fárigh básh: be thou free.

definition: Formula: fidá' (ransom, sacrifice) + "him"; "... fidáh" may ... be a sacrifice for him. Root f-d-y.
usage: Devotional formula after a holy name, as in روحی له الفداء "may my soul be a sacrifice for Him".

definition: Adverb/preverb: down, downward; furú giriftan 'to enshroud, overwhelm'.
usage: Preverb meaning down, as in فرو گرفتن 'to overwhelm' and فرو رفتن 'to sink'.

definition: Arabic noun fi‘l 'deed, action' with Persian suffix -shán 'their'. Root f-‘-l.
Noun: jurists, doctors of religious law; plural of faqíh. Root f-q-h.
usage: Paired with علما 'divines', the religious leaders who opposed the Manifestations of God.
notes: Final ی is the izáfih glide (فقهای زمان).

definition: Arabic conjunction fa 'then, so' with negation lá: then not, nay.
Noun: celestial sphere, orbit, heaven; also fortune. Root f-l-k.
usage: Figurative heavens, as فلک سموات معدلت 'the heaven of justice'.

definition: Verbal noun: attainment, triumph, success. Root f-w-z.
usage: In the Writings attaining God's grace or presence; فوز اکبر 'the supreme triumph'.

definition: Noun, plural of qabr: graves, tombs. Root q-b-r.
usage: Often figurative, as in قبور غفلت 'graves of heedlessness' from which souls are raised.

definition: Adjective قلیل 'few, little' with indefinite ی: a few. Root q-l-l.
usage: الّا قلیلی 'save a few'; اقلّ قلیلی 'but a very few'.

definition: Imperative plural of qáma, to stand, rise: "Arise!"; with علی "arise to". Root q-w-m.
usage: In the Aqdas a call to action, as in قوموا علی خدمة الأمر "Arise to serve the Cause" and قوموا علی نصرة امری "Arise to assist My Cause".

definition: Compound preposition 'for the sake of, because of'; لأجل آنکه 'because, inasmuch as'.
Perfect 3rd person masculine singular of láḥa (yalúḥu): appeared, shone forth, gleamed. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: In the Aqdas of a dawning luminary: لاح نیّر الفضل 'the Day-Star of grace hath shone forth'.

shift: Here: shining, manifest, evident. Today: a bill (draft law) or memorandum.
definition: Active participle (feminine): shining, manifest, evident. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: In the Íqán describing clear statements, as in بیانات واضحهٔ لائحه.
notes: Written لائحه; modern لایحه usually means a bill or draft law.

definition: Preposition li- 'for, to' + jamál 'beauty' + -í 'my': for My beauty. Root j-m-l.
usage: جمال in the Writings is the divine Beauty, often Bahá'u'lláh: جمال قدم 'the Ancient Beauty', جمال مبارک 'the Blessed Beauty'.

definition: Fine, subtle, delicate, gentle. Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: Common epithet of divine waters and gifts, e.g. عطیّهٔ لطیفه 'this gentle gift'.

definition: Oath formula: by My life! Root ‘-m-r.
usage: A frequent oath in the Aqdas, لعمری 'By My life!'.

definition: Verbal noun: cursing, execration. Root l-‘-n.
usage: In the Íqán paired as سبّ و لعن 'reviling and cursing', of those who hide their enmity.

shift: Here: idle, vain (speech), as in کلام لغو. Today: cancellation, annulment.
definition: Idle, vain, futile (speech); also annulled, void. Root l-gh-w.
usage: As in کلام لغو 'idle words'.
notes: In modern Persian chiefly "cancellation" (لغو کردن 'to cancel').

definition: Noun: word, term, expression, utterance. Root l-f-ẓ.
usage: In the Íqán when explaining symbolic terms: لفظ سماء 'the term heaven'.

definition: Emphatic لَ plus فی 'in': surely in.
usage: Qur'anic: انّنا لفی شکّ 'we are in doubt'.

definition: Verbal noun liqá’ with 'his': meeting him, encounter with him, attaining his presence. Root l-q-y.
usage: لقاء الله 'attainment unto the Divine Presence' is in the Íqán the recognition of the Manifestation.

definition: li- 'for' plus nafs 'soul, self' plus -ka 'thy': for thyself. Root n-f-s.
usage: 'For thyself'; as in the Hidden Words' call to choose for thyself what thou choosest for Me.

definition: Preposition li- "for" with 3rd feminine plural pronoun: for them (women); expresses permission or right.
Passive participle: despairing, hopeless, without hope. Root y-'-s.
usage: Despairing; the Writings counsel believers never to be مأیوس of God's mercy.

definition: Conjunction (negative optative of búdan): lest, may it not be that.
Passive participle (form IV): firmly decreed, irrevocable, inescapable. Root b-r-m.
usage: Irrevocable, as in قضای مبرم 'irrevocable decree' and امر مبرم.

definition: Passive participle form IV (fem.): firmly established, conclusive. Root t-q-n.
usage: Conclusive, firmly established, as in ادلهٔ متقنه 'conclusive proofs'.

definition: Passive participle (form IV), feminine: established, affirmed, fixed. Root th-b-t.
usage: 'Established', as in احکام مثبته 'established laws', of ordinances confirmed in Scripture.
notes: aḥkám-i-muthbatih: established laws.

definition: Noun: mithqál, a unit of weight (about 3.6 g in Bahá'í reckoning); weight. Root th-q-l.
usage: A unit of weight used in the Aqdas for dowry, fines and Ḥuqúqu'lláh; 19 mithqáls of gold or silver.
notes: Accusative of specification after a numeral.

definition: Active participle (form III): one who strives or struggles; the spiritual striver. Root j-h-d.
usage: One who strives in the path of God; the Kitáb-i-Íqán opens its description of the true seeker with شخص مجاهد 'the striving soul'.

definition: Noun: glory, honour, majesty. Root m-j-d.
usage: Divine glory, e.g. خزائن مجد 'treasuries of glory'.

definition: Adjective: verified, established, certain; feminine of muḥaqqaq. Root ḥ-q-q.
Noun, plural of makhzan: storehouses, treasuries, repositories. Root kh-z-n.
usage: Figurative, of the Manifestations as مخازن علوم ربّانی 'the treasuries of divine knowledge'.

definition: Adjective: different, diverse, various. Root kh-l-f.
Noun mardum with the restrictive -í: the people who, those people that.
Noun plural: gilded falsehoods, idle tales, vain words. Root z-kh-r-f.
usage: In the Íqán of the clergy's baseless traditions and interpretations.

definition: Active participle, form X: one who asks for an explanation; with شدن 'to inquire'. Root f-s-r.
Passive participle of satara, to veil: hidden, concealed, veiled. Root s-t-r.
usage: Used of the Cause or mysteries kept hidden until revealed, as in قد کان مستوراً فی حجب الغیب "had been hidden behind the veils of the unseen".

definition: Adjective مشغول 'busy, occupied' with -and 'they are': 'they are occupied'. Root sh-gh-l.
Plural of ma‘dan: mines, minerals; figuratively sources, repositories. Root ‘-d-n.
usage: Literal 'minerals' and figurative 'mines' or 'repositories' of divine attributes, e.g. معادن اسماء.

definition: Passive participle, feminine plural: counted, numbered, hence few. Root ‘-d-d.
usage: Qur'anic ایّاماً معدودات 'a set number of days', used in the Aqdas of the Fast.

definition: Plural of mu‘riḍ, active participle of a‘raḍa 'to turn away': those who turn aside, reject. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: Those who turn away from the Manifestation of God, opposed to مقبلین 'those who have turned towards Him'.

definition: Powerful, mighty, all-capable; a divine name. Root q-d-r.
usage: A frequent divine name in the Aqdas, e.g. من لدن مقتدر قدیر 'from One Who is Potent and Mighty'.

definition: Plural of malak: angels. Root m-l-k.
usage: In the Íqán interpreted as holy souls endowed with spiritual power.
notes: Written ملائکه; the hamza seat is normalized.

definition: Noun of place: spring, fountainhead, source. Root n-b-‘.
usage: In the Íqán knowledge must be drawn from its منبع 'source', the Manifestation.

definition: Restricted, confined, limited (to, with به). Form VII participle, root ḥ-ṣ-r.
usage: In the Íqán the sun and moon of the prophecies are not confined (منحصر) to the visible sun and moon.

definition: Passive participle: abrogated, annulled, superseded (of a law or scripture). Root n-s-kh.
usage: Of laws superseded by a new Revelation, as in منسوخ نمیشود 'shall never be annulled'.

definition: Adjective: impregnable, lofty, inaccessible, exalted. Root m-n-‘.
usage: HW: اثمار بدیعهٴ منیعه 'wondrous and exalted fruits'.

definition: Passive participle: described, qualified by, characterized by. Root w-ṣ-f.
Active participle of form IV ayqana: certain, firmly convinced, assured. Root y-q-n.
usage: 'Assured, firm in faith'; describes the steadfast believer, as in قلوب موقنین 'the hearts of the assured'.

definition: Verb: past continuous 3rd plural of ávardan "to bring"; with várid "to inflict upon".
usage: Would bring; with várid ávardan 'to inflict upon', as of afflictions inflicted on the Prophets.

definition: Verb dádan "to give", past progressive 3rd singular: was giving, used to give.
notes: bishárat mídád was announcing glad-tidings.

definition: Verb, present 3rd person singular of dádan: gives; forms compounds such as akhbár mídahad "informs".
usage: Common verb 'gives', forming compounds such as خبر میدهد 'informs, tells of'.

definition: Noun: inclination, desire, liking, tendency. Root m-y-l.
usage: Inclination or desire; often of following one's own desires, as in میل نفس.

definition: Past progressive of gashtan 'to become, turn': was becoming, used to become.
Adjective: fiery, of fire. Root n-w-r.
usage: 'Fiery', as in نفس ناری 'the fiery self', the passionate, rebellious lower self, contrasted with the luminous (نوری).
notes: nafs-i-nárí: the fiery self.

definition: Negative past 3rd sing. of bakhshídan (to give, grant): did not give; "thamarí nabakhshíd" bore no fruit.
usage: Did not give; in phrases like ثمری نبخشید "bore no fruit".

definition: Perfect third masculine plural of nabadha 'to throw away, discard': they cast away. Root n-b-dh.
usage: Used of those who cast away the Book of God, as in نبذوا کتاب الله ورائهم 'they cast the Book of God behind their backs'.

definition: Noun: prophethood, the station of a Prophet. Root n-b-’.
usage: In the Íqán شمس نبوّت 'the Sun of Prophethood', i.e. Muḥammad.

definition: Relative adjective from nuḥás 'copper': of copper, coppery. Root n-ḥ-s.
usage: In the Íqán's image of the elixir that transmutes مادّهٔ نحاسی 'copper' into gold.

definition: Noun: manner, way, mode; also grammar. Root n-ḥ-w.
usage: In phrases like بهر نحو 'in whatever manner' and این نحو 'this kind'.

definition: Verb form IV: to want, desire, intend; here 'we desire'. Root r-w-d.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse لا نرید منکم جزاءً 'we desire from you no recompense'.

definition: Verb, form II perfect: to send down, to reveal. Root n-z-l.
usage: Of God's revelation of verses; cf. تنزیل 'revelation'.
notes: In the Aqdas (قد نزّلت فی صلوة المیت) read passive nuzzilat 'have been revealed'.

definition: Verb: We sent down, We revealed. Root n-z-l.
usage: The divine 'We' of revelation, as in ممّا نزّلنا علی عبدنا 'that which We have sent down to Our servant'.

definition: Verbal noun: abrogation, annulment (of a law); also copying. Root n-s-kh.
usage: The annulment of former laws by a new Revelation, as in نسخ احکام 'the abrogation of laws'.

definition: Negative present perfect of شدن "to become": they have not become; with واقف "they have not understood".
notes: Written نشده‌اند.

definition: Noun: blessing, favour, prosperity, bounty. Root n-‘-m.
notes: In the Íqán context it is part of the name Ni‘matu'lláh.

definition: Verbal noun of nahá: forbidding, prohibition; with namúdan or kardan, to forbid. Root n-h-y.
usage: Paired with امر: امر باوامر و نهی از مناهی 'enjoining the commandments and forbidding what is forbidden'.

definition: Verb, passive past 2nd plural of nahá 'to forbid': ye have been forbidden. Root n-h-y.
usage: In the Aqdas اجتنبوا عمّا نهیتم عنه 'avoid that which ye have been forbidden'.

definition: Proper noun: Háshim, great-grandfather of Muḥammad and ancestor of the Banú Háshim clan.
usage: In traditions about the Qá'im: یظهر من بنی هاشم صبیّ 'a youth shall appear from the House of Háshim'.

definition: Separation, abandonment, remoteness from the beloved. Root h-j-r.
usage: Paired with فراق or بعد, as in بیابانهای هجر و فراق 'the wastes of remoteness and separation'.

definition: Adverb: likewise, just so; همچنان که 'just as'.
Active participle (Arabic feminine agreeing with a plural): arriving; of traditions, transmitted, handed down. Root w-r-d.
usage: In اخبار وارده 'the traditions handed down', alongside آیات نازله 'the revealed verses'.

definition: Wajh "face, countenance; self, sake" with -ka "your": your face, yourself. Root w-j-h.
usage: Wajh is often the Face of God, and لوجه اللّه 'for the sake of God'; here اتّکالک علی وجهی لا علی وجهک 'rely on Me, not on thyself'.

definition: Plural of vujúd: beings, existences, entities. Root w-j-d.
usage: In the Íqán of the Manifestations: وجودات قدسیّه 'these sanctified Beings'.

definition: Noun: dove, grey pigeon; in the Writings the Holy Spirit or the voice of the Manifestation. Root w-r-q.
usage: Common in نغمات ورقاء 'the melodies of the Dove', the heavenly voice of Revelation.

definition: Noun: middle, centre; fí wasaṭ = in the midst of. Root w-s-ṭ.
usage: In فی وسط الزوال 'to the zenith' of the sun.

definition: Noun: union, joining, reunion; opposite of faṣl 'separation'. Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: 'Union' with the Beloved, the goal of the mystic lover, opposed to هجر and فصل 'separation'.

definition: Noun: prophethood, the office of a prophet (payghambar "prophet" + abstract -í).
usage: Prophethood; the office of a prophet, e.g. the claims of prophethood discussed in the Íqán.

definition: Noun chashm "eye" with indefinite -í: an eye, one eye.
Ordinal adjective: fourth.
Adjective (active participle): sufficient, adequate. Root k-f-y.
usage: Sufficient, adequate; of proofs or testimony being enough.

definition: Interrogative adverb: where; rhetorically, how could, by no means.
Past participle of kashídan 'to draw, pull, stretch': drawn, extended, laid out.
usage: 'Drawn, stretched', as in شمشیرهای کشیده 'drawn swords', and with suffering in رنج کشیده 'having endured hardship'.
notes: shamshírhá-yi kashídih: drawn swords.

definition: Plural of káfir: unbelievers, infidels. Root k-f-r.
usage: Unbelievers who rejected the Prophets; rendered "infidels".

definition: Noun: treasure, hidden hoard. Root k-n-z.
usage: Treasure, recalling the Tradition کنت کنزاً مخفیاً 'I was a hidden treasure'; also earthly treasure.

definition: Imperative of guzáshtan 'to put, place': place, set; qadam guzár 'set foot, step'.
usage: In قدم گذار 'set thy foot', of the spiritual journey.

definition: Present subjunctive 3rd singular of guzáshtan (guzárdan), 'to put, to place, to set'.
usage: قدم گذاردن 'to set foot, to step forth'.

definition: Persian verb, 3rd plural present perfect of guzashtan 'to pass; give up': they have passed by, forsaken.
Subjunctive of gardídan 'to become, turn', first person plural: (that) we become.
Verb, past 3rd sing. (and past stem) of guftan 'to say'.
notes: In خواهند گفت it is the stem of the future.

definition: Verb: that he complete, perfect, fulfil. Root t-m-m.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse quoted in the Íqán: یأبی الله الّا ان یتمّ نوره 'God willeth not but to perfect His light'.

definition: Verb, form I imperfect: he finds, obtains. Root w-j-d.
usage: من لم یجد المآء 'whoso findeth no water'.

definition: Verb ḥalla, to be lawful, permitted; here "it is lawful". Root ḥ-l-l.
usage: In Aqdas laws, e.g. لا یحلّ الاقتران "marriage is not permitted".

definition: Verb: 'he hears, listens', imperfect of sami‘a. Root s-m-‘.
notes: Subjunctive yasma‘a after an; indicative yasma‘u elsewhere.

definition: Imperfect 3rd person masculine singular of ‘alima: he knows. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Qur'an 3:7, cited in the Íqán: ما یعلم تأویله الّا الله 'none knoweth the interpretation thereof except God'.

definition: Verb, 3rd plural present of qála 'to say'. Root q-w-l.
Imperfect of mashá 'to walk, go': he walks, goes along. Root m-sh-y.
Form I imperfect of náḥa 'to lament, mourn, wail'. Root n-w-ḥ.
usage: In the Gospel prophecy quoted in the Íqán: و ینوح کلّ قبائل الأرض 'and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn'.

definition: Verb: he guides, leads. Root h-d-y.
usage: In Qur'anic phrases such as ان الله لا یهدی 'God guideth not'.

definition: Noun, Arabic plural of ab: fathers, forefathers. Root a-b-w.
usage: In the Íqán تقلید آباء و اجداد 'blind imitation of fathers and forefathers', a chief veil against recognising the Manifestation.

definition: Affliction, trial, tribulation; being tested. Form VIII verbal noun, root b-l-w.
usage: Of tests and trials, as in تنگی و ابتلا 'oppression and tribulation'.

definition: Verbal noun of form VIII: trial, affliction, tribulation. Root b-l-w.
usage: Of the trials of the Prophets, as in ابتلای انبیا 'the afflictions of the Prophets'.
notes: Final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Persian آب 'water' with the suffix -ash 'its'; آبش دادن 'to water it'.
Proper noun: Abú Jahl, a leading Meccan opponent of Muḥammad.
usage: In the Íqán contrasted with Ḥamzih as a sign of disbelief.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV atamma: completing, finishing, bringing to an end. Root t-m-m.
usage: 'Completion'; as in اتمام حجت 'completing the proof', establishing God's argument beyond doubt.
notes: In the Aqdas inside Arabic: ba‘da itmám as-sujúd.

definition: Verb (form VIII): imperative plural: avoid, shun, keep away from. Root j-n-b.
usage: Shun, avoid; in Aqdas commands to shun forbidden things.

definition: Noun, plural of jadd: grandfathers, ancestors, forefathers. Root j-d-d.
usage: Forefathers, often in criticism of blind imitation of the ways of one's ancestors.

definition: Verb (form IV, past): he surrounded, encompassed. Root ḥ-w-ṭ.
usage: To encompass; of God's knowledge, mercy or power encompassing all things, as in احاط بکلّ شیء.

definition: Plural of ḥabíb: friends, loved ones, beloved companions. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: The friends or loved ones; in Bahá'í usage the believers, as in احباب الهی 'the friends of God'.

definition: Verbal noun form IV: doing good, beneficence, kindness. Root ḥ-s-n.
usage: Beneficence, kindness; God's bounty to His servants and the good deeds enjoined on believers.

definition: Verbal noun (form VIII): brevity, conciseness, abridgment. Root kh-ṣ-r.
usage: 'Brevity', used by the author when abbreviating an argument, as in باختصار 'briefly'.

definition: Verb, Form I imperfect 1st sing.: I seal, conclude. Root kh-t-m.
usage: To seal or conclude, as in closing a passage; related to خاتم النبیین "Seal of the Prophets".

definition: Perfect third feminine singular of akhadha 'to take, seize' with suffix -hu 'him'. Root ’-kh-dh.
usage: Used of a state or force seizing someone, as in اخذته الغفلة 'heedlessness seized him'; also God's seizing of the wrongdoers.

definition: Verbal noun of adbara: turning one's back, retreat; also adversity. Root d-b-r.
usage: Opposite of اقبال 'turning towards'; in the Íqán the turning away of some believers when tested.

definition: Noun: religions; broken plural of dín 'religion'. Root d-y-n.
usage: Religions or dispensations, as in سموات ادیان 'the heavens of the religions' and Aqdas اهل الأدیان 'the followers of religions'.

definition: Noun, plural of dhikr: mentions, remarks; remembrances, praises of God. Root dh-k-r.
usage: In the Íqán 'these remarks/references'; in the Aqdas remembrances of God, as in مشرق الاذکار 'Dawning-place of the Praise of God'.

definition: Verb form VIII: to rise, be raised, be exalted. Root r-f-‘.
usage: Of the Voice or Cause of God, as ارتفع ندائه 'His Voice hath been raised'.

definition: Verb, form VIII perfect 3rd fem. sing.: rose, was raised up. Root r-f-‘.
usage: In the Hidden Words انّ الشّمس ارتفعت فی وسط الزّوال 'the sun hath risen to the zenith'.

definition: Verb imperative: return ye; refer ye, turn ye. Root r-j-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas, believers are told to refer (ارجعوا) to what has been revealed, or to the Centre of the Cause.

definition: Noun ارض 'earth, land' with suffix: my earth, My land. Root '-r-ḍ.
usage: اذکرنی فی ارضی لأذکرک فی سمائی 'Make mention of Me on My earth, that in My heaven I may remember thee'.
notes: In Persian contexts هر ارضی 'every land' (indefinite ی).

definition: Accusative of azal "eternity without beginning", used adverbially: from all eternity. Root ’-z-l.
usage: Paired with ابد and قدیم to describe the eternity of God's kingdom.

definition: Plural of ism 'name': names. Root s-m-w.
Verbal noun of form X istad‘á: earnest request, entreaty; with namúdan, to request, beseech. Root d-‘-w.
Verb, form VIII past 2nd singular: thou didst busy thyself, occupy thyself. Root sh-gh-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words اشتغلت بعیوب عبادی 'busy thyself with the faults of others'.

definition: Elative of sharíf 'noble': nobler, noblest, most eminent. Root sh-r-f.
usage: In the Íqán انسان اشرف و اکمل مخلوقات 'man, the most noble and perfect of created things'.

definition: Form IV verb: it shone, rose, dawned upon. Root sh-r-q.
usage: In the Hidden Words اشرق علیک النّور 'the light hath shone on thee'; after li- read ushriqa 'that I may shine'.

definition: Plural of shay': things; here with the Persian izáfih ending. Root sh-y-'.
usage: E.g. اشیای ظاهره 'outward things'.
notes: Arabic اشیاء with the hamza replaced by the izáfih ی.

definition: Noun, plural of ṣafí 'chosen, pure friend' with the suffix 'his': His chosen ones. Root ṣ-f-w.
usage: In the Hidden Words فلیسمع کلمات اصفیائه 'let him give ear to the words of His chosen ones'.
notes: Written اصفیائه in the source.

definition: Roots, principles, fundamentals; plural of aṣl. In theology the fundamental doctrines (اصول دین). Root ’-ṣ-l.
usage: As in مسائل اصول الهیّه 'questions of the divine fundamentals'.

definition: Perfect 2nd person singular of form IV a‘raḍa 'to turn away from' (with ‘an). Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: Turning away from God or His Manifestation, the opposite of اقبال; کیف اعرضت عنه 'how hast thou turned away from it'.

definition: Plural of عصر: ages, epochs. Root ‘-ṣ-r.
usage: Often paired: اعصار و قرون 'ages and centuries'.

definition: Verbal noun: making heedless, misleading, beguiling. Root gh-f-l.
Plural of ghaní 'rich' (Persian spelling without final hamza): the rich, the wealthy. Root gh-n-y.
usage: 'The rich'; the Hidden Words admonish the rich (یا اغنیاء) to care for the poor in their midst.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): outpouring, bestowal, shedding of light or grace. Root f-y-ḍ.
usage: Outpouring, bestowal; used of the outpouring of divine grace (fayḍ) upon creation.

definition: Verb uftádan, past 3rd singular: fell, happened; "malḥúẓ uftád" it was observed.
usage: Means 'fell, happened'; also an auxiliary, as in ملحوظ افتاد 'it was observed'.

definition: Noun (form VIII verbal noun): fabrication, false accusation, slander. Root f-r-y.
usage: Slander, false accusation or imposture; opponents charged the Manifestations with inventing lies against God.
