notes: Persian spelling of iftirá’.

definition: Elative adjective: most upright, straightest, firmest. Root q-w-m.
usage: Most upright, as in Qur'anic التی هی اقوم; of the straightest path or firmest cause.

definition: Abstract noun: oneness, divine unity. Root '-ḥ-d.
usage: Divine oneness, the absolute unity of the Godhead, as in سماء الاحدیة 'the heaven of oneness'.

definition: Noun, plural of ḥuzn 'sorrow': sorrows, griefs. Root ḥ-z-n.
usage: 'Sorrows', used of the griefs of the Manifestation and of His lovers, as in بحر الاحزان 'the ocean of sorrows'.

definition: Plural of luṭf: favours, kindnesses, bounties. Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: God's favours and kindnesses; in phrases such as الطاف الهی "divine favours".

definition: Plural of ama: handmaids, maidservants. Root ’-m-w.
usage: Handmaidens, in the Writings the women believers, as in اماء الرّحمن 'the handmaidens of the All-Merciful'.

definition: Plural of umma: nations, peoples, religious communities. Root a-m-m.
usage: The peoples and nations of the world, as in حفظ الامم 'the security of its peoples'.

definition: Adjective: trustworthy, faithful, reliable. Root '-m-n.
usage: روح الأمین 'the Faithful Spirit' (Gabriel); in the Aqdas النّاصح الأمین 'the faithful Counsellor'.

definition: Verbal noun (form VII): expansion, cheerfulness, delight. Root b-s-ṭ.
usage: In the pair بالفرح و الانبساط 'with joy and gladness'.

definition: Verbal noun form VII: being cut off; detachment from all save God. Root q-ṭ-‘.
usage: A key spiritual virtue in the Writings: detachment from all save God, as جناحی الانقطاع 'the wings of detachment'.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV: certitude, firm conviction. Root y-q-n.
usage: Certitude of faith; the title Kitáb-i-Íqán, 'The Book of Certitude'.

definition: Adjective and noun: inward, hidden; as a divine name, the Hidden. Root b-ṭ-n.
usage: In الظّاهر و الباطن 'the Manifest and the Hidden'; also the inner meaning of scripture, opposed to ظاهر.

definition: Active participle: the Everlasting, the Abiding; divine name. Root b-q-y.
usage: Divine name; the contrast فانی/باقی 'perishable/abiding' runs through the Hidden Words.

definition: Noun: sea, ocean. Root b-ḥ-r.
usage: In the Writings بحر is a frequent image of divine knowledge and revelation, "the ocean"; also the sea parted for Moses.

definition: Plural of baḥr 'sea, ocean': seas, oceans. Root b-ḥ-r.
usage: In the superlative بحر البحور 'the Ocean of oceans', a title of the Manifestation.

definition: Plural of balad: countries, lands, cities. Root b-l-d.
usage: In the Aqdas, houses of worship are to be raised فی البلدان 'throughout the lands'.

definition: Noun: house, dwelling; the sacred House of pilgrimage. Root b-y-t.
usage: In the Aqdas حجّ البیت 'pilgrimage to the House' (of the Báb in Shiraz or Bahá'u'lláh in Baghdad); also بیت العدل 'House of Justice'.

definition: Plural of bayyina 'clear proof, evident sign' with the article. Root b-y-n.
usage: Qur'anic term for the evidences brought by prophets, as in آتینا عیسی بن مریم البیّنات 'We gave Jesus son of Mary clear signs'; in the Aqdas مطلع البیّنات 'the Dawning-place of clear tokens'.

definition: Plural of jáhil: the ignorant, the foolish. Root j-h-l.
usage: In من الجاهلین 'among the ignorant' and سنن الجاهلین 'the ways of the foolish'.

definition: Plural of jawhar: jewels; essences, substances.
usage: In جوهر الجواهر 'the Essence of Essences', a title of the Manifestation.
notes: Jawhar comes from Persian gawhar.

definition: Active participle: ruler, judge; as a divine name 'the Ruler'. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: Opens the Aqdas: بسمه الحاکم علی ما کان و ما یکون 'In the name of Him Who is the Supreme Ruler over all that hath been and all that is to be'.

definition: Veils, screens; a plural of ḥijáb. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: Of veils between the soul and God, as in فأفرغ نفسک عن الحجبات 'cleanse thyself of the veils'.

definition: Feminine elative of ḥasan: the most beautiful, most excellent. Root ḥ-s-n.
usage: In الاسماء الحسنی 'the most excellent names' of God: باسمائنا الحسنی 'Our most excellent names'.

definition: Adjective fem. of احمر: red, crimson. Root ḥ-m-r.
usage: In the Crimson Ark, السّفینة الحمراء, and الرّکن الحمراء 'the Crimson Pillar'.

definition: Verbal noun: entering, going in. Root d-kh-l.
usage: In the Aqdas of bathing: الدخول فی ماء 'entering water'.

definition: Noun: humiliation, abasement, lowliness. Root dh-l-l.
usage: 'Abasement'; contrasted with glory (عزّة), as in passages on choosing abasement for the sake of God.
notes: Genitive after min in the Hidden Words; nominative adh-dhillatu in the Aqdas.

definition: Verbal noun with article: returning, going back. Root r-j-‘.
usage: Return, going back; ordinary sense of returning.

definition: Noun with article: decline, cessation; the sun's passing the zenith, noon. Root z-w-l.
usage: Decline or cessation, and the sun's passing the zenith (noon), relevant to the time of obligatory prayer.
notes: HW "fí wasaṭi’z-zawál" at high noon; elsewhere "passing away".

definition: Noun: way, path, road. Root s-b-l.
usage: The way or path, especially سبیل الله 'the path of God'; also ابن السبیل 'the wayfarer'.

definition: Noun: secret, mystery, hidden truth. Root s-r-r.
usage: Mystery or hidden truth, as in سرّ الله 'the Mystery of God', a title of 'Abdu'l-Bahá; also the inner secret.

definition: Plural active participle (genitive): the thankful, grateful. Root sh-k-r.
usage: The thankful, in closing formulas like من الشاکرین 'among the thankful'.

definition: Noun: path, way; the Bridge over hell on the Day of Judgment. Root ṣ-r-ṭ.
usage: 'The Path', the Qur'anic صراط مستقیم 'straight Path' and the Bridge of the Day of Judgment; in the Writings the path of God's Cause.

definition: Verbal noun: fasting, the Fast. Root ṣ-w-m.
usage: The Fast, one of the laws of the Aqdas, kept in the month of ‘Alá'.

definition: Verbal noun: going astray, error. Root ḍ-l-l.
usage: Error and straying from the path, set against هدی 'guidance', as in الضّلال المبین 'manifest error'.

definition: Plural of luṭf 'kindness, favour' with -hi 'His': His favours, His graces. Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: God's loving favours, often paired with رحمة 'mercy' or عنایات 'bounties'.

definition: Proper noun: aṭ-Ṭúr, the Mount, Mount Sinai where God spoke to Moses.
usage: Symbol of revelation: افق الطّور 'the horizon of the Mount'; انّ الطّور یطوف حول مطلع الظّهور 'the Mount circleth round the Dayspring of Revelation'.

definition: Noun: glory, might, honour. Root ‘-z-z.
usage: Of divine glory, as in سرادق العزّ 'the Tabernacle of glory' and ایادی العزّ 'the hands of glory'.

definition: Plural of ‘aql: minds, intellects, understandings. Root ‘-q-l.
usage: Often stressing that minds cannot comprehend God's Essence.

definition: Adjective used as a divine name: the High, the Exalted. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: A name of God; in ربّنا العلیّ الأعلی 'our Lord, the Exalted, the Most High'.
notes: Genitive al-‘alíyyi.

definition: Noun: delusion, vain deception; pride, conceit. Root gh-r-r.
usage: In the Writings worldly delusion and pride, as in ابناء الغرور 'children of vain glory'.
notes: Modern Persian ghurúr means pride.

definition: Noun: clouds, white clouds. Root gh-m-m.
usage: Qur'anic فی ظلل من الغمام 'in the shadows of the clouds', interpreted in the Íqán as things that veil people from the Manifestation.

definition: Adjective: single, unique, peerless; with the article a divine name. Root f-r-d.
usage: A divine name, as in اللّه الفرد الخبیر "God, the Single, the All-Informed".

definition: Verbal noun: killing, murder; in devotional texts martyrdom. Root q-t-l.
usage: In the Aqdas forbidden: حرّم علیکم القتل 'ye have been forbidden to commit murder'.

definition: Noun: eternity without beginning, antiquity, pre-existence. Root q-d-m.
usage: In titles of Bahá'u'lláh: جمال القدم 'the Ancient Beauty', مالک القدم 'the Lord of eternity'.

definition: Noun: people, folk, a community. Root q-w-m.
usage: Often in Qur'anic phrases such as القوم الظّالمین 'the people of tyranny'.

definition: Noun: refinement, delicacy, fineness, cleanliness. Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: In the Aqdas the law of cleanliness and refinement: تمسّکوا بحبل اللّطافة 'Hold ye fast unto the cord of refinement'.

definition: Outcome, final end, ultimate destination. Root ’-w-l.
usage: In the Aqdas هذا المآل الّذی کان امل المقرّبین 'this ultimate end, the hope of the near ones', contrasted with اموال 'riches'.
notes: Spelled المأل in the text; not al-mál 'wealth'.

definition: Wealth, property, possessions. Root m-w-l.
usage: Common elsewhere in the Writings, e.g. in laws on inheritance and Ḥuqúqu'lláh.

definition: Noun of place: beginning, origin, starting point. Root b-d-'.
usage: In مالک المبدء و المآب 'the Lord of the Beginning and the End' (origin and return).
notes: Hamza written on the line.

definition: Passive participle of form IV: firmly settled, binding, irrevocable. Root b-r-m.
usage: Of God's decree, as in بامره المبرم 'by His irrevocable command'.

definition: Manifest, clear; the one who makes things plain. Form IV of b-y-n and a name of God.
usage: In closing formulas such as انّه لهو المبین الحکیم 'He is the Expounder, the All-Wise'; also کتاب مبین 'a perspicuous Book'.

definition: Active participle plural of form IV: the sincere, those pure in devotion. Root kh-l-ṣ.
usage: In the Aqdas: المخلصون یرون حدود الله ماء الحیوان 'the sincere see God's laws as the water of life'.

definition: Noun: ink. Root m-d-d.
usage: HW: فاجعل المداد من جوهر الفؤاد 'make thine ink of the essence of thy heart'.

definition: Passive participle plural: those sent, the Messengers or Apostles of God. Root r-s-l.
usage: In Qur'anic quotations, as in جعلنی من المرسلین 'made me one of His Apostles'.

definition: Feminine active participle of form IV ashraqa: shining forth, dawning, radiant. Root sh-r-q.
usage: 'Shining, dawning'; describes the light or Day of God, as in الشمس المشرقة 'the shining sun'.

definition: Active participle (form VIII), plural: transgressors, aggressors. Root ‘-d-w.
usage: Transgressors, aggressors; Qur'anic term for those who exceed God's bounds.

definition: Passive participle with article: that which is known, the object of knowledge. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: 'That which is known', paired with العالم 'the knower' in discussions of divine knowledge.
notes: Genitive after ilá.

definition: Noun of place: abode, seat, resting place. Root q-r-r.
usage: Abode or seat; of the Spot where the Manifestation dwells and of God's exalted seat.
notes: Here the Qiblih after the Ascension.

definition: Active participle (form VIII): inaccessible, unattainable; impossible; divine epithet. Root m-n-‘.
usage: Divine epithet 'the Inaccessible', as in the formula الممتنع المنیع; of God's unknowable essence.

definition: Passive participle: born; newborn child. Root w-l-d.
usage: Born; the newborn child, in laws on birth and childhood.
notes: Íqán, Gospel quotation: 'Where is He that is born King of the Jews?'

definition: Noun: fire; hellfire. Root n-w-r.
usage: 'The Fire', hellfire, interpreted in the Writings as remoteness from God, set against الجنّة 'Paradise' as nearness to Him.

definition: Noun: help, aid, victory. Root n-ṣ-r.
usage: Divine help and victory; the Writings link نصرت امر "aiding the Cause" to good deeds and character rather than conflict.

definition: Noun: blessing, bounty, grace, favour. Root n-‘-m.
usage: God's bounty and favour, as in النّعمة الکبری 'the most great bounty'.

definition: Noun: soul, self; the lower self or ego; also a person. Root n-f-s.
usage: Often the lower self, paired with الهوی 'desire', as in النفس و الهوی 'self and passion'; elsewhere the soul.

definition: Noun: the Arabic letter há (ه), numerical value five.
usage: In the Aqdas the intercalary days are مظاهر الهآء 'the embodiments of the letter Há' (Ayyám-i-Há).

definition: Active participle plural of háma: those who wander distraught, infatuated or bewildered. Root h-y-m.
usage: In the Aqdas of those lost in their passions: من الهائمین 'of them that wander distraught'.

definition: Adjective: stained, defiled, polluted, tainted.
usage: Hearts defiled by desires, as بآمال و آرزو آلوده 'defiled with desire'.

definition: Noun with article: the promise, the appointed fulfilment. Root w-‘-d.
usage: In the Aqdas the fulfilled promise of the Advent, as in جاء الوعد 'the Promise hath come'.

definition: Adjective and divine name: the Bestower, the All-Bountiful. Root w-h-b.
usage: Closes verses of the Aqdas, as in العزیز الوهّاب 'the Mighty, the All-Bountiful'.

definition: Abstract noun: divinity, Godhead. Root '-l-h.
usage: Paired with ربوبیت 'Lordship', as in مصدر الوهیت کبری 'the Source of supreme Divinity'.

definition: Name of the letter ک (K), numerical value 20; used as an abbreviation.
usage: In the Aqdas ارض الکاف و الرّآء "the land of Káf and Rá" (Kirmán), and in the inheritance table of letters.

definition: Plural of kitáb 'book': books, Scriptures. Root k-t-b.
usage: In the Aqdas the Bayán's command to blot out books (محو الکتب) is annulled.

definition: Noun: speech, discourse, utterance; also theological dialectic. Root k-l-m.
usage: In the Aqdas بحر الکلام 'the ocean of utterance'; also disputation in المجادلة فی الکلام.

definition: Preposition ilá 'to' with suffix -ná 'us': unto Us.
Preposition and adverb: in front of, before, facing. Root ’-m-m.
notes: Not imám 'leader' here.

definition: Trust, something entrusted; trustworthiness. Root ’-m-n.
usage: In the Hidden Words the poor are God's trust: فقرا امانت منند 'the poor in your midst are My trust'; trustworthiness is a chief Bahá'í virtue.

definition: Plural of makán: places, locations. Root k-w-n.
Noun amr 'matter, affair, command, Cause' with the suffix 'thy'.
usage: In the Hidden Words فکّر فی امرک 'Ponder upon thine own state'; elsewhere امر الله 'the Cause of God'.

definition: Hope, expectation, longing; often worldly desire. Root ’-m-l.
usage: Paired with passion, as in نار امل و شهوت 'the fire of desire and lust'.

definition: Perfect of amina 'to be safe, secure'. Root ’-m-n.
usage: In the Hidden Words: من دخل فیه نجا و امن 'whoso entereth therein is safe and secure'.

definition: Perfect of form IV ámana 'to believe' (with bi-). Root ’-m-n.
usage: من آمن بالله 'he who believeth in God'; ایمان and مؤمن come from the same root.
notes: Íqán quotation of Qur'an 2:177.

definition: Arabic verb (form IV): we have believed. Root ’-m-n.
usage: Qur'anic: ان یقولوا آمنّا و هم لا یفتنون 'that they say "We believe" and are not tested'.

definition: Adjective umídvár (hopeful) with 1pl copula: we hope, we are hopeful.
Verbal noun of form VIII intaẓara: waiting, expectation, anticipation. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: 'Waiting, expectation'; especially the expectation of the Promised One by the followers of past religions.

definition: Verb (form IV): past "he sent down, revealed" plus suffix -hu "it, him". Root n-z-l.
usage: Revealed it; anzala 'sent down' is the standard verb for revelation (tanzíl).

definition: Verb naẓara, imperative masculine plural: look, behold, consider. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: 'Look ye, consider', a frequent call to reflect on signs and proofs.

definition: Noun, plural of nahr: rivers, streams. Root n-h-r.
usage: Rivers, an image of paradise and of flowing divine grace, echoing the Qur'anic جنّات تجری من تحتها الانهار.

definition: Past participle of ávardan: brought; with bijá, performed, carried out.
usage: From آوردن 'to bring'; in بجا آوردن 'to perform, carry out' (e.g. obligations, prayer).
notes: Written without madda in the normalized form.

definition: Adjective (fem.): first, primary; maqám-i-avvalíyyih 'the first sense'. Root '-w-l.
usage: First, primary, as in مقام اولیه 'the first station' or sense.

definition: Elative adjective: more or most perfect, complete. Root k-m-l.
usage: 'Most perfect', used of the most complete form of a thing, as of the Manifestation as the most perfect mirror of God.

definition: Plural áyát (verses, signs) with 3rd-person masculine suffix: his verses. Root '-y-y.
usage: His verses, the revealed Word as proof of the Manifestation.
notes: Dalíluhu áyátuhu: His proof is His verses.

definition: Plural of áya 'sign, verse' with Persian indefinite -í: (certain) verses. Root ’-y-y.
usage: Signs or verses; in the Writings revealed verses and the signs of God, as in آیات الله 'the verses of God'.

definition: Verbal noun: preferring others above oneself; self-sacrifice, laying down. Root a-th-r.
usage: Selfless sacrifice, as in جان ایثار کردن 'to lay down one's life' in the path of God.

definition: Noun: hands, plural of yad 'hand'; also power, agency. Root y-d-y.
usage: ایدی القدرة 'the hands of power'; عمّا فی ایدی النّاس 'of that which men possess'.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV) of adhá: harming, persecution, injury. Root '-dh-y.
usage: Persecution of the Prophets, as in ایذای مردم 'the people's persecution'.
notes: The final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Adverb: this much, so much, to this extent.
Preposition bi with áthár, plural of athar: by or with the works, traces, writings. Root ’-th-r.
usage: آثار in the Writings is the works or Writings, as in آثار اللّه 'the works of God'.

definition: Preposition بـ with اختلاف 'difference, divergence': according to the varying, owing to differences in. Root kh-l-f.
usage: Also in the Arabic of the Aqdas: باختلاف مقادیرهما 'according to their severity'.

definition: Preposition ب with idrák: by or to the perception, comprehension. Root d-r-k.
Persian bi plus irádih: by or through the will of. Root r-w-d.
usage: اراده in the Writings is the Will of God, often linked with مشیّت "the Primal Will".
notes: Followed by izáfih.

definition: Abstract noun: inwardness, hiddenness, the quality of being 'the Hidden'. Root b-ṭ-n.
usage: In the Íqán, with اوّلیّت، آخریّت، ظاهریّت 'Firstness, Lastness, Manifestness', attributes shared by all the Manifestations.

pos: prep. + verbal noun (form VIII) with izáfih
definition: Persian bi- 'by' plus iqtiḍá, requirement, exigency: in accordance with the requirements of. Root q-ḍ-y.
usage: In the Íqán باقتضای وقت 'according to the exigencies of the time'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with' plus aqvál 'words, sayings'. Root q-w-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words باعمال ... نه باقوال 'with deeds, not with words'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with' + al-bayyinát 'clear proofs, evident signs'. Root b-y-n.
usage: Qur'anic phrase of messengers who came بالبیّنات 'with clear proofs'.

definition: Bi- 'with, in' plus alladhí 'that which, he who'.
bi- with al-‘aẓama: with majesty, in grandeur. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: In بالعظمة و الاقتدار 'in majesty and power'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with' and faraḥ 'joy, gladness'. Root f-r-ḥ.
usage: In the Aqdas بالفرح و الأنبساط 'with joy and gladness', of the Intercalary Days.

definition: Bi "with, by" + anna "that" + -hu "he": that he (is).
notes: In descriptions of God, as in بأنّه هو الأوّل و الآخر 'that He is the First and the Last'.

definition: Preposition bi- with anna 'that' and suffix 'they': 'because they, in that they'.
Preposition ب with انّ 'that' and the suffix 'I'.
notes: After اعلم: اعلم بأنّی 'know that I'.

definition: Persian ب 'in' + آن 'moment' + indefinite ی: in a single instant.
usage: In the Íqán: بآنی طیّ فرمائی 'traverse in an instant'.

definition: Preposition bi- with ahl: to or with the people of, those possessing. Root ’-h-l.
usage: اهل ذکر 'the people of the Remembrance' and اهل البهاء 'the people of Bahá'.

definition: bi- 'in, by' plus áyát (plural of áyah 'sign, verse') plus -hi 'His'. Root '-y-y.
usage: 'In His verses'; of belief in or denial of God's revealed verses, the main proof of the Manifestation.

definition: Preposition bi- "to, with" plus íshán "they, them".
Preposition bi- with ímán "faith, belief". Root '-m-n.
usage: Faith or belief, as in بایمان فائز شدن 'to attain unto faith'.

definition: Phrase bi + bayán "utterance, explanation, exposition". Root b-y-n.
usage: بیان is utterance or exposition, God's revealed word, and also the title of the Báb's book, the Bayán.

definition: Preposition bi- with plural of ta'yíd: through confirmations, divine assistance, support. Root '-y-d.
usage: Through the confirmations of God, as in تأییدات الهی 'divine confirmations' promised to those who serve the Cause.

definition: bi- 'by' + jamál 'beauty' + -am 'my'; oath formula. Root j-m-l.
usage: 'By My Beauty', an oath in God's voice; جمال 'Beauty' also denotes Bahá'u'lláh (جمال مبارک, جمال قدم).

definition: Preposition bi- + ḥabl 'rope, cord': to the cord. Root ḥ-b-l.
usage: 'To the cord', in the command to hold fast to the cord (حبل) of God or of material means, echoing Qur'an 3:103.
notes: 'tamassakú bi-ḥabli’l-asbáb' hold fast unto the cord of material means.

definition: bi + ḥudúd (limits, bounds). Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: By the limitations; of minds held back by human limits from recognizing the Truth.

definition: Preposition bi + ḥarf 'letter, word'. Root ḥ-r-f.
usage: Letter or word; the Writings speak of حروف the letters, including حروف حیّ 'Letters of the Living'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'to, with' plus Ḥaqq 'the Truth, God': unto God; also 'truly'. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: In Persian Writings حق often means God, 'the True One'; بحق 'unto God', as in توکّل بحق 'reliance upon God'.

definition: Persian bi- 'with, to' + khil‘at 'robe of honour'. Root kh-l-‘.
usage: خلعت هستی 'the robe of being'; خلعت پیغمبری 'the robe of prophethood'.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with khayál 'fancy, imagination': with or to fancy. Root kh-y-l.
usage: Vain imaginings opposed to truth, as in بخیال شیطانی 'to satanic fancy'.

definition: Noun: appearance of a new circumstance; in Shí'í theology God's alteration of a foretold decree. Root b-d-w.
usage: In the Íqán the doctrine of badá', the postponement or change of a promised event.

definition: Abstract noun: the quality of being first or the beginning. Root b-d-’.
usage: In the Íqán with ختمیّت 'finality', for the Manifestations being at once the first and the last.

definition: Preposition بـ with ذات 'essence, self, very being'. Root dh-w.
usage: In the Writings ذات often the unknowable divine Essence; in بذات الصّدور 'what is in the breasts'.

definition: Preposition ب with ذکر 'remembrance' and suffix: by the mention or remembrance of Him. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Echoes Qur'an 13:28 الا بذکر الله تطمئن القلوب; ذکر is remembrance or mention of God.

definition: Plural of برادر: brothers, brethren.
Verb: 'they raised, brought forth', past of برآوردن; فریاد برآوردن 'to cry out'.
Noun: lightning, flash; in modern Persian also electricity. Root b-r-q.
usage: In the Hidden Words چون برق 'like lightning'.

definition: Noun: coldness, coolness. Root b-r-d.
Preposition bi- + zakhárif, plural of zukhruf 'gilding, ornament': vain embellishments. Root z-kh-r-f.
usage: زخارف قول 'specious talk', زخارف دنیا 'the vanities of the world'.

definition: Very, much, exceedingly; also 'enough'.
Adverb: many a, often; ای بسا 'how many a'.
usage: In the Hidden Words بسا سحرگاهان 'How often... at the break of dawn'.

definition: Verb, simple past 3rd person plural of bastan 'to bind, fasten'; with افترا 'to fabricate a calumny'.
notes: In افترا بستند 'the calumnies they had fabricated'.

definition: Bi "with, by" + sulṭán "authority, sovereignty, power". Root s-l-ṭ.
usage: Sulṭán in the Writings is sovereignty or dominion, as in یحکم کیف یشاء بسلطان 'He ruleth as He willeth by virtue of a sovereignty...'.

definition: Preposition bi 'to' joined to ṣubḥ 'morning, dawn'. Root ṣ-b-ḥ.
usage: Figurative dawn of knowledge or certitude, as in صبح منیر ایقان 'the shining morn of certitude'.

definition: Preposition ب with a double plural of ظنّ: suppositions, idle fancies. Root ẓ-n-n.
usage: Of the vain imaginings the people cling to: متمسّک بظنونات 'clinging to idle fancies'.

definition: Preposition ba‘d with 'his': after him, after it; من بعده 'after him'.
Noun ba‘ḍ 'part, some' plus -hum 'them'; accusative here: some of them. Root b-‘-ḍ.
notes: Qur'an 2:253 'Some of the Apostles We have caused to excel others'.

definition: Preposition bi- plus ‘illat "cause": because of, owing to. Root ‘-l-l.
usage: Because of, owing to; ordinary causal expression.

definition: Adjective (Arabic feminine in Persian agreement): far, distant, remote. Root b-‘-d.
usage: Distant or remote, as in بلاد بعیده 'distant lands'.

definition: Phrase bi + fársí: in Persian, in the Persian language.
usage: In Persian; Bahá'u'lláh notes when He writes or explains something in Persian, as in the Persian Hidden Words.

definition: Subjunctive 3rd sing. of farmúdan: (if He) should say or declare; honorific verb of speaking or commanding.
usage: Honorific verb of saying or commanding used of God, Prophets and dignitaries, as in 'should He say'.

definition: Subjunctive 3rd pl. of farmúdan 'to command'; honorific 'say, declare'.
usage: Honorific 'say, declare'; فرمودن replaces گفتن for God and His Manifestations.

definition: Preposition bi- + qaṭrih 'drop' + indefinite -’í: with or by a drop. Root q-ṭ-r.
usage: 'By a drop', in the contrast of a drop with the ocean of God's bounty, which a single drop can quicken.
notes: Spelled ه‌ئی in the source; indefinite after silent h.

definition: bi + qiyám (rising, standing up, arising). Root q-w-m.
usage: Rising, arising; used of the rise of the Qá'im and of believers arising to serve, قیام بر امر "arising to serve the Cause".

definition: Noun: trial, affliction, calamity (Arabic balá’). Root b-l-w.
usage: Trials and afflictions, often borne for God, as in بلایا 'tribulations' and the Hidden Words' 'My calamity is My providence'.

definition: Preposition bi with negative lá: without; bi-lá ḥawla wa lá quwwata 'without might or power'.
Preposition bi- 'to' plus liqá’ 'meeting, encounter, presence'. Root l-q-y.
usage: لقاء الله 'the Presence of God', attained, according to the Íqán, through recognition of His Manifestation.

definition: Preposition bi with shortened interrogative ma: with what? by what? why?
notes: Shortened from bi-má in questions.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with ma‘rifat 'knowledge, recognition'. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: Recognition of God through His Manifestations, as in معرفت اللّه 'the knowledge of God'.

definition: Preposition bi 'to' with manzil 'stopping place, destination, abode'. Root n-z-l.
usage: The goal of the mystic journey; منزل also stage of the path.

definition: Preposition bi with mawáqi‘, plural of mawqi‘: to or at the places, seats, stations. Root w-q-‘.
usage: In the Íqán, e.g. مواقع عزّ 'the seats of glory'.

definition: Preposition بـ with نسبت 'relation, attribution, ascription'. Root n-s-b.
usage: نسبت دادن means 'to ascribe, attribute'.

definition: Preposition ب with نفس 'self' and suffix: with or through My Self, by Me. Root n-f-s.
usage: In the Hidden Words God speaks of اقبالک بنفسی 'thy turning unto Me' and اکف بنفسی 'be content with Me'.

definition: Persian bi plus ham: together; in بهم رسیدن "to come about, arise, occur".
Prepositional phrase 'by means of, because of', from bi- and vásiṭih 'means, intermediary'. Root w-s-ṭ.
Preposition bi- 'with, by, in' with the suffix -ka: with thee, by thee, toward thee.
Preposition bi- plus kitáb 'book, scripture'. Root k-t-b.
usage: Kitáb is the revealed Book, as in کتاب جدید 'a new Book'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'by, to, with' + kudám 'which (one)'.
Present subjunctive of guftan 'to say': (that/if) thou say.
Plural of biyábán with izáfih: deserts, wildernesses.
usage: Figurative, e.g. بیابانهای هجر و فراق 'the wastes of remoteness and separation'.

definition: Verb, present subjunctive 3rd person singular of yáftan: that he find, attain.
Plural of bayán "utterance, exposition" with indefinite or relative -í: utterances (which...). Root b-y-n.
usage: Bayán in the Writings is the Word of God and its exposition, and the title of the Báb's book.

definition: Noun: house, dwelling; indefinite accusative. Root b-y-t.
usage: In the Aqdas both a house in law (من احرق بیتاً 'whoso burneth a house') and the House of God (بیت).

definition: Preposition ب with ید 'hand': by, with or through the hand of. Root y-d-y.
usage: HW: بید ملاطفت غرس نمودم 'planted with the hand of loving-kindness'; Aqdas بید امین 'to a trustworthy hand'.

definition: Preposition bi- with yad (hand) and 'his': in his hand, in his power. Root y-d-y.
usage: Formulas like بیده ملکوت کل شیء 'in Whose hand is the kingdom of all things'.

definition: Persian bí- 'without' plus shumár 'number': countless, innumerable.
usage: 'Countless'; used of God's bounties and of multitudes, as in نعمای بی‌شمار.

definition: Adjective: useless, fruitless, vain (bí "without" + fá’idih "benefit").
usage: Useless, vain; ordinary adjective.
notes: Normalized from بی‌فائده.

definition: Verb afzúdan "to increase", present 3rd singular with bi-: increases, adds to.
Adjective (bí "without" + ma‘ní "meaning"): meaningless, senseless.
usage: Meaningless; of words or deeds without reality, idle and vain talk.

definition: Plural of bayyinah: clear proofs, evident signs. Root b-y-n.
usage: Clear proofs, evident signs of the Prophets, as in آیات بیّنات.
notes: Qur'ánic term.

definition: Preposition bayna 'between' with suffix -hum 'them'. Root b-y-n.
Preposition bayna 'between, among' with suffix -kum 'you (plural)'.
Verbal noun, Form II: interpretation, especially inner or allegorical interpretation of scripture. Root '-w-l.
usage: Inner, allegorical interpretation of scripture; the Íqán explains the تأویل of prophetic texts.

definition: Passive imperfect of talá 'to recite': it is recited. Root t-l-w.
usage: Used of the recitation of verses, as in تتلی علیهم آیات الله 'the verses of God are recited unto them'.

definition: Verbal noun: renewing, renewal, restoration. Root j-d-d.
usage: The renewal of religion in each age; also of renewing a garment or a covenant.

definition: Verb: jussive 2nd plural of ja‘ala 'to make, to set'; with lá 'do not make'. Root j-‘-l.
usage: لا تجعلوا 'make not': لا تجعلوا انفسکم ملعب الجاهلین 'make not yourselves the playthings of the ignorant'.

definition: Arabic verb, imperfect of raja‘a: (it) returns, reverts. Root r-j-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas inheritance laws: shares ترجع الی بیت العدل 'shall revert to the House of Justice'.

definition: Verb: to see, behold; here 'that thou mayest see'. Root r-'-y.
Verbal noun: shaking, quaking; agitation, wavering. Root z-l-z-l.
usage: In the Íqán the wavering of believers at a test, as in تزلزل و اضطراب 'commotion and consternation'.

definition: Numeral: ninety (genitive/accusative form of tis‘ún). Root t-s-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas خمساً و تسعین مرّة 'ninety-five times' and in the dowry and wealth limits.

definition: Verb, form I imperfect: thou seekest, requestest. Root ṭ-l-b.
usage: لا تطلب معیناً سوائی 'seek not any other helper but Me'.

definition: Verb ẓahara, to appear, become manifest; here third feminine singular. Root ẓ-h-r.
Verbal noun: wonder, astonishment, amazement; تعجّب نمودن 'to marvel'. Root ‘-j-b.
Verb: 'thou marvellest', jussive after in 'if'. Root ‘-j-b.
usage: Qur'an 13:5 و ان تعجب فعجب قولهم 'if thou marvellest, marvellous is their saying'.

definition: Imperfect 2nd person masculine plural of ‘aqala: you understand, comprehend. Root ‘-q-l.
usage: In the formula لو انتم تعقلون 'if ye but understood'.

definition: Verb, form V jussive 2nd singular: search, investigate. Root f-ḥ-ṣ.
usage: In the Hidden Words لا تفحص عن غیری 'seek not another than Me'.

definition: Imperfect 2nd person masculine plural of faqiha 'to understand, comprehend'. Root f-q-h.
usage: In the Aqdas refrain لو انتم تفقهون 'if ye but understood'.

definition: Form I imperfect of qatala 'to kill': you (pl.) kill. Root q-t-l.
usage: In Qur'anic quotations on the rejection of the Prophets: فریقاً تقتلون 'some ye slay'.

definition: Verbal noun form II: decree, foreordaining, destiny. Root q-d-r.
usage: تقدیر الهی 'the divine decree'.
notes: In modern Persian it also means 'appreciation'.

definition: Noun, plural of taqdír 'ordaining, destiny': decrees, ordinances. Root q-d-r.
usage: In تقدیرات ربّانی 'the divine decrees', set against human devices.

definition: Of the eye: to be cool, i.e. delighted, solaced (idiom with ‘ayn). Root q-r-r.
usage: HW: لتقرّ به عینک 'that thine eye may be cheered thereby'; Aqdas تقرّ الأبصار 'eyes are gladdened'.
notes: Subjunctive after لـ in the Hidden Words; indicative taqarru in the Aqdas.

definition: Perfect of tamma 'to be complete, be fulfilled, come to an end'. Root t-m-m.
usage: کذلک تمّت النعمة 'thus hath the bounty been fulfilled'; in the Aqdas of the days of giving being ended.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): it passes, passes by, goes away. Root m-r-r.
usage: Aqdas: تمرّ ایّام حیوتکم کما تمرّ الأریاح 'the days of your life pass away as the winds pass'.

definition: Verbal noun: stopping, staying, tarrying, pausing. Root w-q-f.
notes: In the Aqdas context it is the Arabic verb tawaqqafa 'it ceased'.

definition: Imperfect, second person masculine plural, of form IV ayqana: you are certain, you believe firmly. Root y-q-n.
usage: 'Ye are certain'; Qur'anic style, in appeals to those who are certain of God's signs.
notes: Pause form of túqinúna at verse end.

definition: Verbal noun (form V): trust in God, reliance, resignation. Root w-k-l.
usage: Trust in God, reliance; a key spiritual quality, as in tavakkul bar khudá 'reliance on God'.

definition: Adjective: dark, murky, dim.
usage: Dark or murky, often of hearts or eyes darkened by heedlessness.

definition: Ordinal adjective: second; other. Root th-n-y.
usage: Second; also 'another, a second such', as in having no second (ثانی ندارد).

definition: Járí (flowing, current, in force) with ast: is current, is in force, applies. Root j-r-y.
usage: Current, in force; of laws and divine bounty flowing and applying in every age.

definition: Noun: omnipotence, dominion; in mysticism the realm of divine power. Root j-b-r.
usage: Dominion; in mystical cosmology the realm of divine power, named with ملکوت and لاهوت.

definition: Verb ja‘ala 'to make, appoint', perfect 1st person plural with suffix -hu: We have made it. Root j-‘-l.
usage: 'We have made it', in God's voice, of appointing or ordaining something, as in جعلناه 'We made it' a sign or a law.

definition: Noun: effort, exertion, striving; "jahd kunid" strive ye. Root j-h-d.
usage: Effort, striving; in exhortations such as جهد کنید "strive ye".

definition: Present third singular of justan 'to seek': (he) seeks.
usage: Seeking, especially the seeker after truth; also جستجو 'search'.

definition: Present stem júy- of justan 'to seek': they seek, they would seek.
Noun: beloved, dear friend. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: In the Íqán the address ای حبیب من 'O my friend', and حبیب خود for Muhammad, God's Beloved.

definition: Noun, accusative indefinite: a letter (of the alphabet); a word. Root ḥ-r-f.
usage: As in العلم سبعة و عشرون حرفاً 'Knowledge is twenty and seven letters'.

definition: Noun: calamity, thunderbolt, fiery punishment (Qur'án 18:40); also read ḥisbán 'supposition, fancy'. Root ḥ-s-b.
notes: Uncertain: the HW phrase نار حسبان is rendered 'infernal fire'; in the Íqán context (از حسبان ظاهر و بحسبان راجع) a wordplay on ḥisbán 'vain fancy' and ḥusbán 'fiery torment' seems intended.

definition: Noun: regret, sorrow, longing; حسرت بردن 'to envy'. Root ḥ-s-r.
usage: In the Hidden Words in laments such as زهی حسرت 'alas, what regret'.

definition: Honorific noun حضرت 'presence, holiness' with است 'is'; آن حضرت means 'He' of a holy person.
usage: حضرت is the standard honorific for God, the Prophets and holy figures, as in حضرت باری 'God, the Creator'.
notes: Contraction of حضرت است.

definition: Plural of ḥikáyat: stories, narratives, accounts. Root ḥ-k-y.
usage: حکایات انبیا 'accounts of the Prophets'.

definition: Accusative of ḥukm: judgment, wisdom, authority. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: Here in the Qur'anic words of Moses فوهب لی ربّی حکماً "my Lord hath given me wisdom".

definition: Plural of ḥakím: wise men, sages, philosophers. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: In the Writings the sages or philosophers, often listed with علما "the learned" and عرفا "the mystics".

definition: Noun: wisdom; a wise purpose or reason behind a decree. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: In the Writings God's wisdom and the wise purpose of His acts; in the Aqdas فی ظهوری لحکمة 'in My presence there is a wisdom'.

definition: Persian plural of ḥikmat: wisdoms, wise purposes, divine dispensations. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: حکمت in the Writings is divine wisdom and also prudence; حکمتهای بالغه 'consummate wisdom'.

definition: Noun ḥukm 'rule, law, decree' with -ash 'its, his'. Root ḥ-k-m.
Adjective: wise; as a divine name the All-Wise; in Persian also sage, physician. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: A divine name, often in من لدن علیم حکیم 'from Him Who is All-Knowing, All-Wise'.

definition: Where, wherever; من حیث لا یشعر 'whence he perceiveth not', i.e. unawares.
Adverb: at that time, then. Root ḥ-y-n.
notes: Written حینئذ; the hamza seat is normalized.

definition: Noun: service. Root kh-d-m.
usage: In the Aqdas قوموا علی خدمة الأمر 'Arise to serve the Cause'; service to the Cause is a central Bahá'í ideal.

definition: Imperative plural of akhadha "to take": take ye! Root ’-kh-dh.
usage: Aqdas commands, as in خذوا ما یکون اقرب الی اللّطافة 'choose that which is nearer to refinement'.

definition: Noun: bat, the creature that shuns daylight. Root kh-f-sh.
usage: In the Íqán an image of those who flee the light of the divine Sun.

definition: Noun: everlastingness, eternity; paradise (جنّة الخلد). Root kh-l-d.
usage: HW: سرادق خلد 'the pavilion of immortality', هیاکل خلد برین 'the denizens of the exalted paradise'.

definition: Passive past 2sg of khalaqa: you were created. Root kh-l-q.
usage: HW: فاصعد الی ما خلقت له 'ascend unto that for which thou wast created'.

definition: Past 1sg of khalaqa: I created. Root kh-l-q.
usage: In the hadith لولاک لما خلقت الافلاک 'But for Thee I would not have created the spheres'.

definition: Verbal noun khalq 'creation, creating' plus -ka 'thy'. Root kh-l-q.
usage: 'Thy creation'; in God's address to man, as in the Hidden Words 'I loved thy creation, hence I created thee'.
notes: Íqán context has nominative khalquka 'Thy creatures'; elsewhere may read khalaqaka 'He created thee'.

definition: Noun khalq "creation, creatures" plus 1st-person suffix -í "my". Root kh-l-q.
usage: My creatures; God speaking of His creation.

definition: Noun: the sun; figuratively a Manifestation of God.
usage: The sun, figuratively a Manifestation of God, as in خورشید حقیقت 'the Sun of Truth'.

definition: Verb, present perfect 2nd person plural of dádan: you have given.
usage: Common verb 'you have given'; also an auxiliary in compound verbs.
notes: bi-bád dádih-íd ye have cast to the winds.

definition: Compound noun: the Abode of Peace; epithet of Baghdad, also of paradise.
usage: Abode of Peace; an epithet of Baghdad, where Bahá'u'lláh lived, and also of paradise.

definition: Past 3rd pl. of dáshtan 'to have'; forms compound verbs (ḥuḍúr dáshtand 'were present').
Imperative and present stem of dánistan 'to know': know, regard as.
usage: 'Know, regard as', as in غنیمت دان 'count as a prize', urging the reader to value the present day.
notes: ghanímat dán: count as a prize, treasure.

definition: Noun: knowledge, learning (from dánistan, to know).
usage: Knowledge, learning; the Writings praise دانش and the arts and sciences that benefit mankind.

definition: Verbal noun: entering, entry. Root d-kh-l.
usage: Entering, as in دخول در امر 'entering the Cause' or into the city of certitude.

definition: Subjunctive of dar-ámadan 'to come in, enter': that he may enter.
Present subjunctive 2nd singular of dar-ámadan, 'to enter, to come in'.
notes: Written درآئی in the text.

definition: Persian noun: enemy, foe.
usage: Contrasted with دوست 'friend', as in دشمن مرا دوست خود گرفته‌اید 'ye have taken My enemy for your friend'.

definition: Noun: claim, pretension; also lawsuit. Root d-‘-w.
usage: Often the false claims of the learned or of pretenders, as دعوی شبانی 'claim to be shepherds'.

definition: Verbal noun: burial, interment; دفن کردن 'to bury'. Root d-f-n.
Noun plural: indications, signs, evidences, implications. Root d-l-l.
usage: In the Íqán paired with اشارات 'allusions' for the signs of the Day of Resurrection.

definition: Noun دنیا 'world, worldly life' in construct: the world of. Root d-n-w.
usage: دنیای فانیه 'the perishable world'.

shift: Here: good fortune, abiding dominion. Today: government, the state.
definition: Noun: fortune, prosperity, dominion; in modern Persian "government, state". Root d-w-l.
usage: In the Persian Hidden Words دولت is good fortune or abiding dominion, as in دولت ابدی "everlasting dominion".

definition: Noun: blood-money, indemnity, legal fine paid as compensation. Root w-d-y.
usage: In the Aqdas the fine for adultery and the indemnity for injury, paid to the House of Justice.

definition: Past participle of dídan 'to see': seen; with shud, was seen. As a noun dídih also means 'eye'.
notes: Not here the noun dídih 'eye'.

definition: Verb, present perfect 2nd plural of dídan 'to see'.
Persian dígar 'other' with indefinite -í: another one, someone else.
Taste; in mystical usage spiritual tasting, delight, rapture. Root dh-w-q.
usage: Paired with شوق: ذوق و شوق 'rapture and longing'.
notes: Modern sense is 'taste, flair, enthusiasm'.

definition: Oblique plural of dhú: possessors of, people of; ذوی القربی 'kindred, near relatives'.
usage: Qur'anic ذوی القربی 'the kindred', in counsels on spending wealth.

definition: Active participle plural: returning ones. Root r-j-‘.
usage: From the Qur'anic formula انّا للّه و انّا الیه راجعون 'unto God we belong and unto Him we return'.
notes: Here an Arabic phrase inside Persian (الیه راجعون).

definition: Truthful ones, those who speak the truth; plural of راستگو.
usage: Persian rendering of Qur'anic صادقین, as in اگر هستید راستگویان 'if ye be truthful'.

definition: Comparative of rásikh 'firm, deep-rooted' with Persian -tar. Root r-s-kh.
usage: With محکمتر: محکمتر و راسختر 'firmer and more steadfast' in the Cause of God.

definition: Adjective: satisfied, content, willing, consenting. Root r-ḍ-y.
usage: Of contentment with God's will; with شدن 'to be content'.

definition: Plural of ráya: banners, standards, flags. Root r-y-y.
usage: Figurative, as in رایات فتنه 'banners of sedition'.

definition: Past tense, first person singular, of ra’á 'to see': I saw, I beheld. Root r-’-y.
usage: 'I saw'; in Arabic passages describing a vision or perception.
notes: Persian ráyat 'banner' has the same letters.

definition: Noun: lordship, divine sovereignty and providence. Root r-b-b.
usage: Lordship, divine sovereignty; in the Íqán the station of Lordship (rubúbíyyat) is distinguished from servitude (‘ubúdíyyat) in the Manifestations.

definition: Noun: return, coming back. Root r-j-‘.
usage: Return, related to رجعت 'return', the spiritual return of the Prophets and saints explained in the Kitáb-i-Íqán.

definition: Noun: stoning (as punishment); pelting. Root r-j-m.
usage: Stoning; in the Íqán the fate of past prophets at their people's hands, and Satan is called الرجیم 'the stoned'.

definition: Noun: pure, choice wine; sealed nectar.
usage: Choice sealed wine, as in الرحیق المختوم 'the choice sealed wine' of divine revelation.
notes: Accusative raḥíqa in context.

definition: Noun: deliverance, salvation, prosperity.
usage: Salvation, deliverance, the true prosperity of the soul.

shift: Here: of outward form, nominal (paired with اسمی). Today: official, formal.
definition: Adjective from rasm 'trace, form, description': pertaining to outward form; in modern Persian 'official'. Root r-s-m.
usage: 'Of outward form', paired with اسمی 'of name' for what is outward and nominal only; in modern Persian رسمی means 'official'.
notes: Paired with ismí 'of name'.

definition: rasúl (messenger, apostle) + Persian indefinite -í: a messenger. Root r-s-l.
usage: A Messenger of God; رسول is used of the Prophets sent with a Book.

definition: Noun rashḥ 'drop, oozing' with indefinite -í: a drop. Root r-sh-ḥ.
usage: A drop or trickle, used figuratively of a drop from the ocean of divine knowledge or grace, as in رشحی از بحر 'a drop from the ocean'.

definition: Noun: companion, friend; ar-Rafíq al-A‘lá 'the Most Exalted Companion', the realm on high. Root r-f-q.
usage: In رفیق اعلی 'the Most Exalted Companion', the realm of God; elsewhere simply 'companion'.

definition: Adjective: delicate, fine, subtle; feminine of raqíq. Root r-q-q.
Noun: symbol, sign, mystery, hidden meaning. Root r-m-z.
usage: Hidden meanings and mysteries, as in رمز معانی 'the mystery of inner meanings'.

definition: Noun: face, surface; in رو دادن 'to happen, occur'.
Proper noun: Rúzbih, the Persian name of Salmán the Persian before Islam.
usage: In the Íqán Rúzbih passes from teacher to teacher awaiting the Prophet, an example of true seeking.

definition: Noun, plural of ra’ís: heads, chiefs, leaders. Root r-’-s.
usage: In the Íqán of religious leaders opposing the Prophets, as in رؤسای عهد 'the leaders of the age'.
notes: Normalized from رؤسای; the final ی is the izáfih glide.

definition: Adjective روشن 'bright' with ی; as a noun روشنی 'light, brightness'. Persian.
usage: صبح صادق روشنی 'that true and radiant morn'; روشنی بخشد 'giveth light'.

definition: Noun: time, period, age. Root z-m-n.
Noun: woman; wife; زن و فرزند 'wife and children'.
Noun: cessation, decline, passing away; also the sun's decline from the zenith, noon. Root z-w-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words لا زوال 'imperishable'; in the Aqdas من زوال الی زوال 'from noon to noon'.
notes: In the Aqdas context it means noon.

definition: Adjective or adverb: more, excessive. Root z-y-d.
Noun: ornament, adornment, embellishment; زینت یافتن 'to be adorned'. Root z-y-n.
Form II imperative: adorn, embellish (ye). Root z-y-n.
usage: In the Aqdas زیّنوا انفسکم بطراز الأعمال 'adorn yourselves with the ornament of goodly deeds'.

definition: Noun: cupbearer, wine-server; in mystical poetry the giver of divine love. Root s-q-y.
usage: E.g. ساقی خلد 'the cupbearer of immortality'.

definition: Active participle plural: travellers on a path; in Sufi usage mystic wayfarers. Root s-l-k.
usage: In the Íqán سالکین سبیل ایمان 'those who tread the path of faith', in the passage on the true seeker.

definition: Questioner, one who asks; also a beggar. Root s-’-l.
usage: The Kitáb-i-Íqán addresses its inquirer, as in ای سائل 'O questioner'.
notes: Normalized from سائل.

definition: Plural of sabíl: ways, paths, roads. Root s-b-l.
usage: سبل الراضین 'the ways of them that are content'; in the Íqán سبل حق 'the ways of truth'.

definition: Persian adjective: hard, difficult, severe, grievous.
usage: In the Íqán of afflictions grievous to the Prophet: سخت است بر تو 'grievous unto thee'.

definition: Noun: mockery, ridicule, derision. Root s-kh-r.
Noun: word, speech, saying, discourse.
usage: 'Word, speech'; frequent in the Persian Writings for the word of God or human speech, as in سخن حق.

definition: Noun (literary): angel of revelation, heavenly messenger; a divine call or voice.
usage: Heavenly voice, angel of revelation; in poetic usage the divine messenger or call (surúsh-i ghaybí 'the unseen herald').

definition: Noun sirr "secret, mystery" with suffix -í: my secret, my mystery. Root s-r-r.
usage: 'My mystery', God speaking; سرّ 'mystery' is a frequent term for hidden spiritual reality.

definition: Noun sarír "bed, couch, throne" + -ka "thy". Root s-r-r.
usage: A bed, couch or throne; in the Writings also the throne of a king or of God.
notes: qum ‘an sarírika arise from thy bed.

definition: Noun: line of writing, row. Root s-ṭ-r.
usage: A line of writing, e.g. 'a single line' of revealed verses.
notes: Dar saṭr-i hashtum = in the eighth line.

definition: Adjective from sulṭán: royal, sovereign. Root s-l-ṭ.
usage: Royal, sovereign; e.g. of God's sovereignty.

definition: Noun salṭanat 'sovereignty, dominion' with indefinite -í: a sovereignty. Root s-l-ṭ.
usage: 'A sovereignty', from سلطنت 'dominion', used of earthly kingship and of the true sovereignty of the Manifestation.

definition: Noun: poison; "samm-i qátil" deadly poison. Root s-m-m.
usage: Poison; figuratively of harmful things, as in سم قاتل "deadly poison".

definition: Feminine adjective (Arabic-style agreement): heavenly, celestial; kutub-i samáviyya 'heavenly Books'. Root s-m-w.
usage: Heavenly, as in کتب سماویه 'the heavenly Books' and شرایع سماویه 'divine laws'.

definition: Noun samm 'poison' with Persian indefinite -í: a poison. Root s-m-m.
Passive past of sammá 'to name': he or it was named, was called. Root s-m-w.
usage: In the Aqdas کذلک سمّی لدی العرش 'thus hath it been named before the Throne'.

definition: Noun plural: hyacinths (sunbul); also ears of grain (sunbula).
usage: In the Persian Hidden Words سنبلات علم و حکمت 'the hyacinths of knowledge and wisdom'.

definition: Noun, plural of sunna: ways, customs, ordinances, laws. Root s-n-n.
usage: God's ordinances against human custom: سنن اللّه 'the ordinances of God', سنن الجاهلین 'the ways of the ignorant'.

definition: Adjective: easy, simple, smooth. Root s-h-l.
Noun: evil, badness, harm; سوء حال 'wretched state'. Root s-w-’.
notes: Genitive sú’i in both contexts.

definition: Noun: a chapter of the Qur'an or of Bahá'u'lláh's Writings. Root s-w-r.
usage: Used for chapters of the Qur'an, as in سورهٔ هود 'the Súrih of Húd', and for titles of Bahá'u'lláh's Tablets.

definition: Verbal noun: travelling, journey, wandering; with کردن 'to traverse'. Root s-y-r.
usage: Also the mystic journey, as in سیر و سلوک 'the spiritual journey'.

definition: Persian noun: branches, boughs, a mass of branches.
Noun: comb; also shoulder; شانه نمودن 'to comb'.
notes: Here 'comb' (گیسوی مشکینم شانه نمائی 'comb My musk-scented locks').

definition: Noun sha’n 'matter, state, rank' with -him: their matter; fí sha’nihim, concerning them. Root sh-’-n.
usage: In the Íqán فی شأنهم 'concerning them' introduces Qur'anic verses; شأن is also 'station, rank'.

definition: Noun: wine, drink. Root sh-r-b.
usage: Mystical wine of divine love or knowledge, as in شراب باقی 'the immortal wine'.

definition: Noun: nobility, honour, eminence, distinction. Root sh-r-f.
usage: In the Íqán of the distinction conferred on the Manifestations or on man, as شرافت کبری 'supreme honour'.

definition: Polytheism, ascribing partners to God; the opposite of tawḥíd. Root sh-r-k.
usage: In the Writings any setting of something beside God, including attachment to self, e.g. ابحر شرک 'the seas of idolatry'.

definition: Adjective: wretched, damned, miserable; the opposite of سعید 'blessed'. Root sh-q-w.
usage: In the pair سعید و شقی 'the blessed and the wretched'.

definition: Verb, present subjunctive 3rd person singular of shumurdan: that he count, regard as.
notes: In غیبت را ضلالت شمرد 'regard backbiting as grievous error'.

definition: Past participle of شمردن "to count, reckon, consider": counted, deemed.
usage: As in غنیمت شمرده 'deeming it a boon'.

definition: Present subjunctive of شمردن 'to count, reckon, regard as'.
Arabic شمس 'sun' with the Persian indefinite ی: a sun, any sun. Root sh-m-s.
usage: In the Íqán شمس is the Manifestation of God; هر شمسی 'every sun'.

definition: Past participle of shinákhtan, to know or recognize: known, recognized.
Present subjunctive, second person singular, of shinídan 'to hear': (that) thou hear.
usage: '(That) thou hear'; in calls to hear the divine voice with the inner ear.

definition: Verb: past 2nd plural of shinídan "to hear".
usage: You heard; ordinary verb form.

definition: Noun, plural of shahíd: martyrs, witnesses; here in izáfih before a following word. Root sh-h-d.
usage: Martyrs or witnesses; شهدا often refers to the martyrs of the Faith, as in شهدای امر.
notes: Persian izáfih form of shuhadá.

definition: Noun: lust, carnal desire, appetite. Root sh-h-w.
usage: Lust, carnal desire; the Writings warn against following desire and passion (هوی و شهوت).

definition: Noun: boy, youth, young man. Root ṣ-b-w.
usage: Boy, youth; e.g. in references to youths and education, or to the Báb's youth.

definition: Numeral: hundred.
Arabic ṣirf 'pure, sheer, utter' + Persian -ast 'is'. Root ṣ-r-f.
usage: 'Utter, sheer', as in معدوم صرف 'utter nothingness', describing the nothingness of creation before God.
notes: ma‘dúm-i-ṣirf: utter nothingness.

definition: ṣaríḥ (explicit, clear) + abstract -í: explicitness; "bi-ín ṣaríḥí" so explicitly. Root ṣ-r-ḥ.
usage: Explicitness; in phrases like باین صریحی "so explicitly", stressing that a text is clear.

definition: Noun: making, workmanship, creation, handiwork. Root ṣ-n-‘.
usage: God's handiwork and creation, as in صنع الهی 'divine handiwork'.

definition: Noun: light, brightness, radiance. Root ḍ-w-’.
usage: Brightness or light, as of the sun, ضیاء الشمس.

definition: Noun: seekers, plural of ṭálib. Root ṭ-l-b.
usage: The Íqán's 'true seeker' (طالب صادق); طالبین کؤوس ایقان 'they that seek the cups of certitude'.

definition: Active participle: circling, going round (as in circumambulation). Root ṭ-w-f.
usage: With حول 'around': طائف حول 'circling around' a holy centre, an image of devotion.

definition: Verbal noun: transgression, rebellion, overflowing of bounds. Root ṭ-gh-y.
usage: Paired with ضلالت 'error' for the opposition to the Prophets.

definition: Verbal noun in the accusative of purpose: seeking, in quest of. Root ṭ-l-b.
usage: In the phrase طلباً لرضائی 'seeking My good pleasure'.

definition: Abstract noun: the quality of being manifest or outward. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: In the Íqán with اوّلیّت، آخریّت، باطنیّت: firstness, lastness, outwardness and inwardness of the Manifestations.

definition: Plural of ẓulla: canopies, overshadowing coverings. Root ẓ-l-l.
usage: Qur'an 2:210 فی ظلل من الغمام 'in the shadows of the clouds'.
notes: The same letters read ẓallala 'He overshadowed' in Qur'an 2:57.

definition: Plural of ẓann: surmises, conjectures, idle fancies. Root ẓ-n-n.
usage: In the Íqán ظنون are the vain imaginings that veil people from the truth.

definition: Noun ẓuhúr 'appearance, manifestation' with -hi 'his': 'His appearance, His Revelation'. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: In the Aqdas مظهر ظهوره 'the Manifestation of His Revelation'.

definition: Plural of ‘ádat: habits, customs, usages. Root ‘-w-d.
usage: In the Íqán آداب و عادات 'customs and habits' that each new Revelation changes.

definition: Noun, Persian plural of ‘áshiq 'lover'. Root ‘-sh-q.
usage: The mystic lovers of God in the Persian Hidden Words.

definition: Noun: open courtyard, arena, field; figuratively a realm or sphere. Root ‘-r-ṣ.
usage: In عرصهٔ غیب 'the realm of the unseen' and عرصهٔ کون 'the realm of being'.

definition: Form I verb ‘arafa 'to know, recognize': I knew. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: عرفت حبّی فیک فخلقتک 'I knew My love for thee, therefore I created thee'.
notes: Also ‘arafta 'thou knewest' in the same Hidden Word.

definition: Imperative form II: magnify! glorify, hold great. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words: یا ابن الانسان عظّم امری 'O Son of Man! Magnify My Cause'.
notes: In العظم after it read al-‘iẓam 'greatness'.

definition: Noun: bone (pl. عظام). Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: Aqdas یحیی به کل عظم رمیم 'every mouldering bone is quickened', echoing Qur'an 36:78.

definition: Verb, past 1st person plural: We pardoned, exempted. Root ‘-f-w.
usage: In the Aqdas of laws God has lifted, as in قد عفونا عنکم صلوة الآیات 'We have absolved you from the Prayer of the Signs'.

definition: Back, rear; behind, after; از عقب "from behind, in its wake". Root ‘-q-b.
usage: HW: هر غنا را فنا از عقب 'every wealth is followed by extinction'.

definition: Feminine relational adjective of ‘ilm: pertaining to knowledge or learning. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: حجبات علمیّه 'the veils of learning' that the Íqán says must be rent.
notes: Feminine agreement after a plural, Arabic style.

definition: Preposition عن 'from, about' with the suffix 'her/it'.
notes: کانوا عنها غافلین 'they were heedless of them'.

definition: Preposition ‘an with 'them': from them, about them.
Preposition ‘an 'from, of, away from' plus -ka 'thee'; ghaníyyun ‘anka 'independent of thee'.
notes: Addressing the feminine land of Ṭá the first context reads ‘anki.

definition: Noun: food, nourishment (here with izáfih). Root gh-dh-w.
usage: Food, nourishment; figuratively spiritual food, as in ghadhá-yi rúḥ 'food of the spirit'.

definition: Noun: absence, concealment, occultation (of the Imám). Root gh-y-b.
usage: Absence or concealment, especially the occultation of the Twelfth Imám in Shí‘ih belief.

definition: Noun ghayr "other than" + -hu "him": other than him.
usage: Other than Him, in affirmations of God's oneness, as in لا اله غیره 'there is no God but Him'.
notes: Qur'anic "má lakum min iláhin ghayruhu".

definition: Persian use of Arabic ghayruhu after a list: and so on, et cetera.
notes: Persian context "nashr va ḥisáb va ghayrih".

definition: Verb (form I perfect, fem.): it diffused, spread, wafted (of fragrance). Root f-w-ḥ.
usage: Of fragrance diffusing, as in فاحت نفحات 'the fragrances have wafted'.

definition: fa- 'so' + imperative of raja‘a 'return, turn back' (transitive). Root r-j-‘.
usage: 'Then turn' or 'refer', in calls to return to God or to refer back to a verse.
notes: HW: fa’rji‘i’l-baṣara ilayka 'turn thy sight unto thyself'.

definition: Noun: interval, distance, separation. Root f-ṣ-l.
usage: 'Distance, interval', used both literally and of the gulf between creature and Creator.

definition: fa (then) + inna (verily) + ná (we): then verily we.
Imperative plural of naẓara 'to look' with fa 'so': look ye, consider. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: A call to consider and reflect, as in فانظروا 'look ye then', often before an example from past dispensations.

definition: Fa- 'so' plus bi’sa 'how evil is', the Arabic verb of blame. Root b-’-s.
usage: Qur'anic formula فبئس ما 'evil indeed is that which…', closing a rebuke.

definition: Noun: opening; victory, conquest. Root f-t-ḥ.
usage: Victory for the Cause, and the opening of the gates of grace or knowledge.

definition: Verb: passive perfect of fataḥa, 'to open': was opened. Root f-t-ḥ.
notes: Aqdas context: فتح کلّ باب منیف 'every lofty door hath been opened'; could also be read active fataḥa.

definition: Conjunction fa with subḥána: so glorified, exalted be (God). Root s-b-ḥ.
usage: In فسبحان اللّه 'Glorified be God', often followed by عمّا یصفون 'above what they describe'.

definition: Verbal noun: loss, absence, being bereft of. Root f-q-d.
Noun, plural of faqíh: jurists, doctors of religious law. Root f-q-h.
usage: In the Íqán with علما 'divines', the clergy who opposed each new Manifestation.

definition: Noun: mouth. Root f-w-h.
usage: In the Writings figurative, as in فم مشیّت 'the mouth of the divine Will'.

definition: Conjunction ف with من: so whoever, whoso then.
usage: فمن شاء فلیقبل 'whoso willeth, let him turn'.

definition: Noun: understanding, comprehension; فهم نمودن "to understand". Root f-h-m.
Oath formula: fa- 'and', wa 'by', alladhí 'Him who'; فوالّذی نفسی بیده 'by Him in Whose hand is my soul'.
Intensive adjective from fáḍa: overflowing, most bountiful; al-Fayyáḍ, the All-Bountiful, a name of God. Root f-y-ḍ.
usage: In the Íqán فیض فیّاض 'the grace of the All-Bountiful'.

definition: Arabic adverbial phrase 'in the instant': immediately, at once. Root f-w-r.
Noun: stature, figure, height of a person. Root q-w-m.
usage: Poetic, of the beloved's form; in the Íqán the robe of utterance is too short for its luminous stature.

definition: Perfect 3rd feminine singular of qáma 'to rise, stand, take place'. Root q-w-m.
usage: In the tradition اذا قام القائم قامت القیامة 'When the Qá'im ariseth, the Resurrection is come'.

definition: Plural of qabíla: tribes. Root q-b-l.
usage: In the Gospel prophecy ینوح کلّ قبائل الأرض 'all the tribes of the earth shall mourn'.

definition: Noun: grasp, grip, handful; control. Root q-b-ḍ.
usage: در قبضهٔ قدرت او 'in the grasp of His power'.

definition: Preposition qabl 'before' with the suffix 'you' (plural).
usage: In من قبلکم 'those who were before you', of past peoples.

definition: Quds "holiness, sanctity" with -am "my": my holiness. Root q-d-s.
usage: As in ساحت قدسم 'My court of holiness'.

definition: Feminine relational adjective of qidam 'pre-existence': eternal, ancient, without beginning. Root q-d-m.
usage: Of the Manifestations: مطالع قدمیّه 'the daysprings of ancient glory'.

definition: Noun: retaliation in kind, legal retribution, punishment. Root q-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: In the Íqán of the Jewish law of punishment for adultery referred to Muḥammad.

definition: Noun: divine decree, destiny, judgment. Root q-ḍ-y.
usage: قضای الهی 'the divine decree'; often paired with قدر.

definition: Noun: drop (of liquid). Root q-ṭ-r.
usage: 'Drop'; contrasted with the ocean, as in a drop of the ocean of divine bounty.

definition: Noun qalb "heart" plus suffix -ka "thy". Root q-l-b.
usage: Thy heart; often in the Hidden Words, of the heart as God's dwelling.

definition: Noun qamíṣ "shirt, robe" with suffix -í: my garment. Root q-m-ṣ.
usage: 'My garment', God speaking; the قمیص 'garment, robe' alludes to Joseph's shirt and to the robe of the Manifestation.
notes: HW "anta qamíṣí" Thou art My robe.

shift: Here: powers, faculties of the soul and of nature. Today (Arabic): forces, especially armed forces.
definition: Noun, plural of quwwa: powers, forces. Root q-w-y.
usage: Powers or faculties of the soul and of nature; in modern Arabic قوات usually means (armed) forces.

definition: Noun qawl (word, saying) with -ishán (their): their word, their saying. Root q-w-l.
usage: Qawl 'word, saying', of people's sayings set against God's Word.

definition: Broken plural of lu’lu’: pearls. Root l-'-l-'.
usage: Pearls, figurative for words of wisdom, as in لئالی الحکمة 'pearls of wisdom'.

definition: Preposition li- + anfus 'selves' + -kum: for yourselves. Root n-f-s.
usage: 'For yourselves', as in exhortations to choose for others what one chooses for oneself.

definition: Conjunction li-anna (because) with 1st-person suffix: because I.
Preposition li 'for, to' + ahl 'people, family, followers'. Root ’-h-l.
usage: Used in addresses and phrases such as لاهل البهاء 'for the people of Bahá'.
notes: Yanbaghí li-ahli'l-Bahá’ 'it behoveth the people of Bahá'.

definition: Arabic participle lá’iḥ 'shining, evident' with Persian -ast 'is': is manifest. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: Often paired as واضح و لائح 'clear and evident'.

definition: Adjective: worthy, fit, deserving. Root l-y-q.
usage: اشجار بی‌ثمار لایق نار 'fruitless trees are fit for the fire'.

definition: Particle li- 'so that' with subjunctive of kána: so that ye may be. Root k-w-n.
usage: Common in لتکونوا من الشّاکرین 'that ye may be of the thankful'.

definition: Preposition with pronoun: from Our presence, from Us, as من لدنّا. Root l-d-n.
usage: Divine speech: من لدنّا 'from Our presence', of wisdom or bounty sent by God.

definition: Preposition li with dhikr and 1st sing. suffix: for My remembrance, mention or praise. Root dh-k-r.
usage: In the Aqdas a house built لذکری 'for My praise' is a Mashriqu'l-Adhkár.

definition: Noun, plural of laṭífah: subtleties, subtle essences, delicate realities. Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: In the Íqán of subtle attributes that cannot reach the divine Essence.
notes: Normalized from لطائف.

definition: Noun: curse, damnation. Root l-‘-n.
usage: الا لعنة الله علی القوم الظالمین 'the curse of God be upon the wicked'.

definition: Emphatic la- with qisṭás: balance, scales; the just balance (Qur'an 17:35).
usage: In the Aqdas the Book is the unerring balance among men, as in انّه لقسطاس الحقّ "this is the unerring Balance".
notes: qisṭás is probably a loanword (Greek); la- is emphatic.

definition: Noun of place maṭla‘ 'place of rising, dayspring' with li- 'for, to'. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: A title of the Manifestation, as in مطلع الوحی 'the Dayspring of Revelation' and مطلع الأمر 'the Dayspring of the Cause'.
notes: In هذا لمطلع الوحی the prefix is emphatic la- (la-maṭla‘u 'verily the Dayspring').

definition: Preposition li- 'to, for' with the suffix -ná: to us, for us; we have.
Preposition li- 'for' plus nafs 'self, soul' with -í: for Myself. Root n-f-s.
Purpose li- + yaṣrifú, subjunctive of ṣarafa 'to spend, expend', + -há 'it, them'. Root ṣ-r-f.
notes: Aqdas: the trustees of the House of Justice are to expend such shares on orphans, widows and the general good.

definition: Form I verb: he died. Root m-w-t.
usage: In the Aqdas inheritance laws: من مات و لم یکن له ذرّیة 'should one die leaving no offspring'.

definition: Active participle: shaken, trembling, unsteady. Root z-l-z-l.
usage: Of the pillars of the earth and of wavering souls, with شدن 'to be shaken'.

definition: Active participle of form VI: exalted, transcendent. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: In the Writings of God and His Word, as in کلمهٔ متعالی 'the exalted word'.

definition: Awakened, alerted, warned, taking heed. Form V participle, root n-b-h.
usage: With شدن 'to take heed', as of heeding the counsels in the Tablets.

definition: Active participle of form VI: successive, continuous; of traditions, widely transmitted. Root w-t-r.
usage: قرنهای متواتره 'successive centuries'; آیات متواتره 'numerous verses'.

definition: Adjective: born; with شدن 'to be born'. Root w-l-d.
usage: Of the birth of Jesus and of being 'born of the spirit'.

shift: Here: one who establishes or proves the truth. Today: positive (مثبت, mosbat).
definition: Active participle: that which proves or establishes, confirmer. Root th-b-t.
usage: In the Íqán God or His verses establish the truth: مثبت الحق بآیاته 'He establisheth the truth by His verses'.
notes: Modern Persian mosbat 'positive' is the passive form.

definition: Noun mathal 'likeness, parable, state' plus -hu 'his'. Root m-th-l.
usage: 'His likeness'; in phrases like لیس کمثله شیء 'nothing is like unto Him', of God's incomparability.
notes: In the second context read mithluhu 'his like, one equal to him'.

definition: Verbal noun (form III): striving, earnest effort, struggle. Root j-h-d.
usage: Striving, earnest effort; in the Íqán the seeker's striving (mujáhadih) on the path of God.

definition: Passive participle: made, fabricated, invented, spurious. Root j-‘-l.
usage: Spurious or fabricated, as of forged traditions or invented beliefs.

definition: Passive participle (form II, feminine): covered, invested; glorified. Root j-l-l.
usage: Glorious, majestic; an honorific epithet in phrases such as a glorious verse or a glorious land.
notes: subuḥát-i mujallalih the veils of glory.

definition: Noun: love, affection. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: Love, as in محبة الله 'the love of God', a constant theme of the Writings.

definition: Active participle form VIII: needy, in need of; with shudan 'to need'. Root ḥ-w-j.
usage: Needy, dependent; all things are in need of God, Who is غنی 'self-sufficient'.

definition: Plural of maḥrúm 'deprived, debarred'. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: 'The deprived', those debarred from God's grace or from recognizing His Day.

definition: Passive participle of ḥasaba: counted, reckoned, regarded as. Root ḥ-s-b.
usage: Reckoned, accounted as; in محسوب شدن "to be counted as".

definition: Noun maḥall 'place, spot' with indefinite -í: a place. Root ḥ-l-l.
usage: Place or position; also محلّ 'room, occasion' in idioms such as محلّ ندارد 'it has no place'.

definition: Verbal noun: opposition, contradiction, disagreement. Root kh-l-f.
usage: In the Íqán اعلام مخالفت 'the standards of opposition' raised against the Manifestation.

definition: Passive participle of khazana: stored, treasured, hidden. Root kh-z-n.
usage: Often paired with مکنون: مکنون و مخزون 'hidden and treasured'.

definition: Active participle (form VIII), feminine: raised, exalted, established. Root r-f-‘.
usage: Of laws and religions raised up, as in شریعت مرتفعه 'the established law'.

definition: Active participle form VIII: one who commits (a sin or act); مرتکب شدن 'to commit'. Root r-k-b.
Passive participle, feminine: pleasing, acceptable, approved. Root r-ḍ-y.
usage: In the Íqán often negated: غیر مرضیّه 'unseemly'.

definition: Passive participle: raised, elevated, exalted. Root r-f-‘.
usage: In جعله الله ... مرفوعاً 'which God hath exalted'.

definition: Passive participle: gilded, falsely embellished; hence vain, specious. Root z-kh-r-f.
usage: حرف مزخرف 'idle talk'.
notes: Modern Persian مزخرف is a coarse 'nonsense'.

definition: Active participle of form X istaráḥa: at rest, at ease, relieved. Root r-w-ḥ.
Passive participle (feminine): hidden, concealed, veiled. Root s-t-r.
usage: In the Íqán the hidden meanings of Scripture, as in معانی مستوره.

definition: Passive participle of saṭara: written, inscribed, recorded; accusative as predicate of kána. Root s-ṭ-r.
usage: An Aqdas formula, کذلک کان الامر ... مسطورا 'thus hath it been inscribed', echoing Qur'an 17:58.

definition: Adverb (accusative of passive participle): certainly, undoubtedly. Root s-l-m.
Noun: niche for a lamp, lamp-holder; from the Light Verse (Qur'an 24:35).
usage: Figurative in the Íqán: مشکاة قلب 'the niche of the heart' where the lamp of the spirit is kindled.

definition: Companionship, keeping company. Root ṣ-ḥ-b.
usage: In the Hidden Words مصاحبت ابرار 'the company of the righteous'.

definition: Plural of maṣlaḥa: interests, welfare, considerations of benefit. Root ṣ-l-ḥ.
usage: Aqdas مصالح العباد 'the interests of the people'.

definition: Active participle of form II: one who confirms or attests the truth. Root ṣ-d-q.
usage: In مصدّق شدن 'to acknowledge as true', of believing in the scriptures; in the Qur'an each Messenger is مصدّق of what came before.

definition: Absolute, unconditional, unrestricted. Form IV passive participle, root ṭ-l-q.
usage: As in فضل مطلق 'absolute grace' and غیب مطلق 'the absolute Unseen'.

definition: Passive participle: sought, desired; the object of the quest, the Beloved. Root ṭ-l-b.
usage: Paired with طالب: میان طالب و مطلوب 'between the seeker and his desire'.

definition: Noun: return, the hereafter, resurrection; یوم معاد 'Day of Return'. Root ‘-w-d.
usage: In يوم معاد 'the Day of Resurrection', understood in the Writings as the Day of the new Manifestation.

definition: Plural of mi‘raj: ascents, stairs, degrees of ascent. Root ‘-r-j.
usage: Figurative, as in اعلی معارج ایمان 'the loftiest heights of faith'.

definition: Feminine of ma‘naví 'spiritual, inner, of meaning', relative adjective of ma‘ná. Root ‘-n-y.
usage: 'Spiritual'; as in کمالات معنویه 'spiritual perfections', contrasted with material (جسمانیه).
notes: 'the mystic Dove'.

definition: Active participle (form IV), indefinite accusative: helper, aid, supporter. Root ‘-w-n.
usage: Helper, supporter; God as helper of His servants.

definition: Active participle form III: differing, contrary, opposed to. Root gh-y-r.
usage: Contrary or at variance with, as in مغایر رضای الهی 'contrary to God's good pleasure'.

definition: Passive participle: understood, comprehended; as noun meaning, concept. Root f-h-m.
usage: Understood; as a noun the meaning or concept; in the Íqán of what is gathered from a verse, as in مفهوم میشود 'it is understood'.

definition: Passive participle: cut off, severed, withheld. Root q-ṭ-‘.
usage: Cut off, as in being cut off from grace or the cessation of divine bounty (fayḍ maqṭú').

definition: Noun/adjective: salt; salty water. Root m-l-ḥ.
usage: Salt, salt water, contrasted with عذب 'sweet water', a Qur'anic image (25:53).
notes: Quranic milḥun ujáj 'salt and bitter'.

definition: Adjective, feminine form: of the earthly kingdom, earthly, terrestrial. Root m-l-k.
usage: 'Earthly', of the world of mulk, contrasted with ملکوت 'the Kingdom'; as in عوالم ملکیّه 'the earthly worlds'.
notes: ‘aválim-i-mulkíyyih: the earthly worlds.

definition: Noun: king, sovereign (intensive of malik). Root m-l-k.
usage: King, Sovereign; a divine title, as in الملیک المقتدر "the Omnipotent King".

definition: Participle (form VIII): distinguished, set apart, excellent. Root m-y-z.
usage: Distinguished or set apart, as in souls distinguished by their deeds.

definition: Preposition min 'from, of' with -ná 'us': from us, of us.
Active participle muntaẓir 'waiting, expecting' (form VIII of n-ẓ-r) with Persian -and 'they are'.
Noun: utmost limit, end, extremity. Root n-h-y.
usage: As in منتهای نیستی 'the utmost nothingness'; compare سدرة المنتهی 'the Lote-Tree beyond which there is no passing'.
notes: The final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Passive participle: dependent upon, conditional on, bound to. Root n-w-ṭ.
Active participle of form IV: deadly, destructive, perilous. Root h-l-k.
Active participle: humiliating, disgraceful. Root h-w-n.
usage: Qur'anic formula عذاب مهین 'a shameful chastisement'.

definition: Plural of mawrid: places of arrival; cases, instances, occasions. Root w-r-d.
usage: موارد هلاکت 'perils of death'; در همهٔ موارد 'on all occasions'.

definition: Persian mawjúd "existing, present" with -and "they are": they exist, they are present. Root w-j-d.
Passive participle: imagined, imaginary, illusory. Root w-h-m.
usage: In the Íqán the imaginary Resurrection of literal interpretation, as in قیامت موهوم.

definition: Noun of place from kataba: school, place of writing and learning. Root k-t-b.
usage: In the Aqdas Bahá'u'lláh says He entered مکتب المعانی و التبیان 'the school of inner meaning and explanation', denying human schooling.

definition: Negative imperative 2nd singular of kardan 'to do'; with a noun forms 'do not ...'.
usage: As in خاموش مکن 'quench not'.

definition: Past progressive 3rd singular of ámadan 'to come'; with an adjective 'proved, turned out to be'.
Present tense of dídan 'to see': thou seest.
Past continuous of جستن 'to seek': they were seeking; with nouns, احتراز میجستند 'they shunned'.
Verb, present 3rd person singular of khástan: wants, wishes; impersonally, requires.
notes: In قدری انصاف میخواهد 'a measure of fairness is needed'.

definition: Present 1sg of رفتن "to go": I go, I am going.
usage: In the Íqán Christ's words من میروم و بعد میآیم 'I go away and come again'.

definition: Present 2nd person plural of فرمودن, the courteous verb 'to say, to do'.
usage: Honorific auxiliary: مشاهده میفرمائید 'ye behold', چه میفرمائید 'what say ye'.

definition: Persian honorific verb فرمودن, past continuous: he would command, say, do (of an exalted person).
usage: Used for the actions and words of Prophets: نهی از مناهی میفرمود 'forbade what is forbidden'.

definition: Present of guzashtan: passes, elapses (of time).
Present tense, third person plural, of gardídan 'to turn, become': they become; auxiliary with adjectives.
usage: 'They become'; auxiliary used with adjectives, as in منقطع میگردند.

definition: Verb: present 1st singular of guftan "to say".
usage: I say; ordinary verb form.

definition: Verb justan "to seek", negative past 3rd plural; with tamassuk "they did not hold fast".
Noun: star. Root n-j-m.
usage: Star; in the Íqán stars symbolise the divines and the laws of a dispensation, darkened at the Manifestation's coming.

definition: Noun najm (star) with Persian indefinite -í: a star. Root n-j-m.
usage: Star; stars in prophecy are interpreted in the Íqán as the divines or leaders.

definition: Negative present subjunctive 3rd sing. of justan 'to seek'.
notes: nafád najúyad 'shall not be exhausted'.

definition: Verb, negative present 3rd person plural of justan 'to seek': they seek not.
usage: 'They seek not', of the heedless who do not search for the truth.

definition: Independent pronoun, 1st person plural: we.
Noun: call, cry, summons. Root n-d-w.
usage: The divine Call, as in نداء الله 'the Call of God' summoning humanity to the new Revelation.

definition: Present of dhakara: We mention, recount, make mention of. Root dh-k-r.
usage: In the formula کذلک نذکر لکم 'Thus do We recount unto you'.

definition: Verb: imperfect 1st plural of ra’á 'to see' with suffix -ka: we see thee. Root r-'-y.
usage: In the Qur'anic words of Noah's people ما نراک الّا بشراً مثلنا 'we see in thee but a man like ourselves'.

definition: Persian verb, negative 3rd singular present subjunctive of rasándan 'to bring, cause to reach'.
Negative past participle of rasídan 'to arrive, reach': not having reached.
Preposition nazd 'near, with' with 3rd pl. suffix: with them, in their view.
Verb: We sent it down, We revealed it. Root n-z-l.
usage: The divine 'We' of revelation, as in قد نزّلناه علی قدرک 'We have revealed it according to thy capacity'.

definition: Plural of nasama: breaths, gentle breezes. Root n-s-m.
usage: نسمات جود 'the breezes of bounty'.

definition: Noun: breath, gentle breeze. Root n-s-m.
usage: In the Writings the breeze of God's Revelation, as in نسمة اللّه "the breeze of God" and نسمة الرّحمن "the breeze of the All-Merciful".

definition: Verb: 'we hear', imperfect 1pl of sami‘a, here the divine 'We'. Root s-m-‘.
Noun: help, aid, divine succour; victory. Root n-ṣ-r.
usage: نصر الله 'the help of God'; the Íqán recounts the promised 'victory' delayed to test the companions.

definition: Noun, plural of ni‘mah: blessings, bounties, favours. Root n-‘-m.
usage: As in نعم باقیه 'everlasting bounties'.

definition: Particle of affirmation: yes.
Imperfect 1st plural of ‘ádha 'to take refuge': we take refuge. Root ‘-w-dh.
usage: Almost always in the formula نعوذ باللّه 'we take refuge with God', i.e. 'God forbid', used in Persian too.

definition: Negative subjunctive of farmúdan, the honorific 'to do, say, deign'.
usage: Farmúdan is used for actions of God and the Holy Ones.

definition: Noun, accusative indefinite: a soul, a person; self. Root n-f-s.
usage: Aqdas من قتل نفساً 'whoso deliberately taketh another's life'.

definition: Relative adjective (Arabic feminine agreeing with a plural): of the self, carnal, egoistic. Root n-f-s.
usage: In the Writings the lower self, as in حجبات نفسیّه 'the veils of self'.

definition: Veil, face-covering, mask. Root n-q-b.
usage: In کشف نقاب 'casting off the veil', i.e. revealing one's beauty.

definition: Noun: point, dot; figuratively the source or centre. Root n-q-ṭ.
usage: العلم نقطة 'knowledge is a single point'; نقطة البیان 'the Point of the Bayán', title of the Báb.

definition: Plural of نقش: images, imprints, engravings. Root n-q-sh.
usage: In the Íqán of the imprints of acquired learning on the heart that must be cleansed away.

definition: Present 1pl of alqá: we cast, we impart, we lay before. Root l-q-y.
usage: God speaking: نلقی علیک من اسرار الحکمة 'We impart unto thee of the mysteries of wisdom'.

definition: Noun: ritual obligatory prayer, Arabic ṣalát.
usage: Obligatory prayer; the Aqdas prescribes the Bahá'í obligatory prayer (صلوة), in Persian commonly نماز.

definition: Verb: past 2nd plural of namúdan "to show, do"; a formal light verb (rujú‘ namúdíd "you returned").
usage: You did; formal light verb namúdan, used where everyday Persian has kardan.

definition: Verb dánistan "to know", negative present 1st singular: I do not know.
Verb, negative past progressive 3rd person plural of namúdan: they did not (do); auxiliary in compound verbs.
usage: Auxiliary in compound verbs, e.g. اقبال نمینمودند 'they did not turn (towards)'.

definition: Negative present 3rd pl. of kardan: they do not do or make; auxiliary of compound verbs.
Verbal noun (accusative, cognate object): prohibition, forbidding. Root n-h-y.
usage: Prohibition, often paired with امر 'command'.

definition: Noun núr 'light', indefinite accusative. Root n-w-r.
usage: 'A light', used of the light of God and of His Revelation, as in نورا 'as a light' to the world.
