definition: Present perfect 3rd plural of navishtan (to write): they have written.
usage: They have written; often of authors or divines who wrote commentaries.

definition: Noun: sleep, slumber. Root n-w-m.
usage: Sleep, often heedlessness, set against awakening, as in نوم غفلت 'the sleep of heedlessness'.

definition: Negative past participle of kardan 'to do, make': not done; in compound verbs 'having not…'.
Noun: idol, beauty; in poetry the beloved.
usage: In mystical Persian the Divine Beloved: ذکر نگار 'the mention of the Loved One'.

definition: Persian verb, negative 3rd singular past of uftádan 'to fall'; with eye, 'did not behold'.
Proper noun: Abel, son of Adam.
usage: In the Íqán named with قابیل 'Cain'.

definition: Active participle used as noun: guide, one who leads aright. Root h-d-y.
usage: Al-Hádí 'the Guide' is a name of God.

definition: Active participle: pouring down heavily, of rain. Root h-ṭ-l.
usage: In the Íqán غیث هاطل 'pouring rain' as a figure for afflictions raining upon the Prophets.

definition: Noun: intelligence, understanding, consciousness. Persian.
usage: ای صاحبان هوش و گوش 'O ye that have minds to know and ears to hear'.

definition: Plural of haykal with suffix "your": your bodies, your persons, temples. Root h-k-l.
usage: هیکل in the Writings means body or temple; in the Aqdas of the believers' bodies.

definition: Noun haykal 'temple, form, body' with indefinite -í. Quadriliteral root h-y-k-l.
usage: In the Writings the human temple of the Manifestation; also any form or body.

definition: Interjection of grief or regret: woe, alas.
usage: In the Hidden Words وای وای 'Alas! Alas!'.

definition: Noun wajh 'face, countenance' with -hu 'his'. Root w-j-h.
usage: In the Hidden Words لأنّ وجهه وجهی 'for his face is My face'.

definition: Noun: aspect, direction, ground; az vajhih 'on the ground of, by virtue of'. Root w-j-h.
Past 3rd singular of vazídan 'to blow' (of wind or breeze).
usage: Of spiritual breezes in the Writings, as نسیم انقطاع 'the breeze of detachment'.

definition: Plural of pidar 'father' in construct: the fathers of.
Noun: advice, counsel, admonition; پند گرفتن 'to take warning'.
usage: E.g. پند گیرید 'take ye heed'.

definition: Noun: front, court, the presence of a king.
usage: In در پیشگاه حضور معبود 'in the court of the presence of the Adored One'.

definition: Remedy, means, way out; چاره نیست "there is no escape".
Persian plural of káfir: unbelievers, infidels. Root k-f-r.
usage: Of those who rejected the Prophets and their sayings.

definition: Adjective, fem.: complete, whole, full. Root k-m-l.
usage: Aqdas: الف سنة کاملة 'a full thousand years'; سنة کاملة 'one whole year'.

definition: Past 3sg feminine of kána: she or it was. Root k-w-n.
Intensive form of kádhib: great liar, impostor. Root k-dh-b.
usage: 'Great liar, impostor'; used of false claimants and of those who deny the Manifestation.

definition: Verb: present perfect 3rd plural of kardan "to do, make"; a light verb.
usage: Have done; light verb with nouns.
notes: Normalized from کرده‌اند.

definition: Noun: generosity, nobility, bounty. Root k-r-m.
usage: Generosity or bounty, often of God's bounteous favour.

definition: Verb (form I, past): he disliked, loathed, was averse to. Root k-r-h.
usage: To loathe or be averse to, as in the Qur'anic ولو کره المشرکون 'though the idolaters detest it'.
notes: Qur'an "wa law kariha'l-káfirún" though the infidels abhor it.

definition: Noun: palm, hand. Root k-f-f.
usage: Palm or hand; e.g. 'the palm of His might', or holding something in one's hand.
notes: Kaff-i sáqí = the hand of the Cupbearer.

definition: Noun: waist, belt; kamar bastan 'to gird up one's loins'.
usage: Waist; کمر بستن 'to gird up one's loins', to resolve to serve.

definition: Noun, plural of kanz 'treasure': treasures. Root k-n-z.
usage: 'Treasures', of God's hidden treasures, echoing the tradition 'I was a hidden treasure' (کنت کنزاً مخفیاً).
notes: Genitive kunúzi after min.

definition: Arabic plural kahanah of káhin: soothsayers, diviners, priests. Root k-h-n.
usage: Soothsayers and diviners, contrasted with true Prophets.
notes: In the Íqán Nimrod summons the soothsayers.

definition: Adjective: old, worn, ancient, outdated.
usage: Old, worn out; often of outworn ideas and customs that must be cast aside.

definition: Plural of ka’s: cups, chalices. Root k-’-s.
usage: Cups or chalices of divine wine, knowledge or love, as in کؤوس معانی 'cups of inner meanings'.

definition: Present subjunctive of guzáshtan 'to put, place': they place; qadam guzárand 'they set foot'.
usage: In قدم گذارند 'set foot' in the realms of holiness.

definition: Present subjunctive 3rd singular of gardándan, 'to turn; to make, to cause to become'.
usage: With an adjective it is causative: فائز گرداندن 'to cause to attain'.

definition: Persian verb, 2nd plural present perfect of gashtan 'to become': ye have become.
Past tense of gushúdan 'to open', third person singular; زبان گشودن 'to begin to speak'.
Verb, present perfect 3rd pl. of guftan 'to say': they have said.
notes: Written as one word in the source (گفته‌اند).

definition: Verb: comes to them. Root ’-t-y.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse ما یأتیهم من رسول الّا کانوا به یستهزئون 'no Messenger cometh unto them but they laugh Him to scorn'.

definition: Verb, form I imperfect subjunctive with suffix: (lest) it seize thee. Root '-kh-dh.
usage: لئلّا یأخذک الظّمأ 'lest thirst overtake thee'.

definition: Persian noun: power, ability, courage (to do something).
notes: The final ی is the izáfih: یارای انکار "power to deny".

definition: Verb: 'they have found, obtained', present perfect of یافتن; تربیت یافتن 'to be reared'.
Imperfect 3rd person masculine singular of form II bayyana: he makes clear, explains, expounds. Root b-y-n.
usage: In the Aqdas کذلک یبیّن الله 'thus doth God make plain ...'.

definition: Verb, form V: to move, stir. Root ḥ-r-k.
Subjunctive of dakhala 'to enter, go in'. Root d-kh-l.
usage: In the Íqán from John 3:5, لا یقدر ان یدخل ملکوت اللّه 'cannot enter into the kingdom of God'.

definition: Passive imperfect of sa’ala 'to ask': he is asked, called to account. Root s-’-l.
usage: In the formula لا یسئل عمّا شآء 'He shall not be asked of whatsoever He willeth' (cf. Qur'an 21:23).

definition: Verb, subjunctive after an: to drink. Root sh-r-b.
usage: Aqdas ان یشرب ما یذهب به العقل 'to drink that which robbeth him of his reason'.

definition: Verb, present 3rd person singular: perceives, is aware. Root sh-‘-r.
usage: In the Qur'anic من حیث لا یشعر 'without perceiving it'.

definition: Imperfect of ‘abada "to worship, serve": he worships. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse quoted in the Íqán: أ تنهانا ان نعبد ما یعبد آباؤنا 'forbiddest thou us to worship what our fathers worshipped?'.

definition: Jussive of form VIII i‘taraḍa 'to object, oppose, protest' (with ‘alá). Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: In the Aqdas prohibitions: لا یعترض احد علی احد 'let no one contend with another'.
notes: After ان (second context) it is subjunctive ya‘tariḍa.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): they know, recognize. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: تعالی عمّا هم یعرفون 'exalted above what they know'.

definition: Present of a‘ṭá: gives, grants. Root ‘-ṭ-w.
usage: In the prophecy القمر لا یعطی ضوئه 'the moon shall not give her light'.

definition: Imperfect, third person masculine singular, of wa‘aẓa 'to admonish, exhort' plus -kum 'you (plural)'. Root w-‘-ẓ.
usage: 'Admonishes you'; Qur'anic formula of God admonishing His servants.
notes: Formula kadhálika ya‘iẓukum 'thus ... exhorteth you'.

definition: Verb: imperfect 3rd masculine plural of ‘amila "to do, work". Root ‘-m-l.
usage: They do; frequent in Qur'anic-style phrases such as bimá kánú ya‘malún 'for what they did'.

definition: Verb ghasala "to wash", subjunctive 3rd masculine singular: that he wash. Root gh-s-l.
usage: Used in laws of ablution and washing in the Kitáb-i-Aqdas.

definition: Verb, passive imperfect 3rd person singular: is covered, veiled, obscured. Root gh-sh-w.
usage: To be covered or veiled, as with darkness; echoes Qur'anic imagery of the enshrouding night and of veiled eyes.
notes: With lá: cannot be veiled; also rendered "fadeth not".

definition: Verb (form I imperfect subjunctive) of ghafara: to forgive, pardon. Root gh-f-r.
usage: Forgiveness by God, as in an یغفر الله لکم 'that God may forgive you'.

definition: Verb form IV imperfect 3rd masc. sing. + -kum: makes you rich, suffices you. Root gh-n-y.
usage: To enrich or suffice you; God promises to enrich those who are in need.

definition: Verb, imperfect subjunctive form VIII: to boast, glory, exalt oneself. Root f-kh-r.
usage: 'To boast', in admonitions that no one should exalt himself over another, as in لئلّا یفتخر 'lest any should glory'.
notes: After li-allá 'lest'.

definition: Verb, Form I imperfect passive: it is accepted. Root q-b-l.
usage: Is accepted; of deeds accepted by God, as in لا یقبل "shall not be acceptable" without recognition of the Manifestation.

definition: Imperfect of qadara 'to be able': he is able, can. Root q-d-r.
usage: He is able, as in لا یقدر احد 'none is able'; used of human powerlessness before God.

definition: Present of form III nádá: he calls aloud, proclaims, cries out. Root n-d-w.
usage: The Divine call, e.g. الروح ینادی من الملکوت 'the Spirit calleth from the Kingdom'.

definition: Verb: imperfect of nazala, 'to descend, come down'. Root n-z-l.
usage: Of blessings or sovereignty descending from God; compare نزّل and انزل 'to send down, to reveal'.

definition: Arabic verb, imperfect of naṣaḥa with -kum: he counsels, admonishes you. Root n-ṣ-ḥ.
usage: In the Aqdas closing formulas such as کذلک ینصحکم 'thus counselleth you' the Pen or the Counsellor.

definition: Verb: to look, behold; to wait for, expect. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse هل ینظرون الا ان یأتیهم الله 'What can such expect but that God should come down to them'.

definition: Noun, Persian plural of yahúd: the Jews.
Verb: it suffices him. Root k-f-y.
usage: In the Aqdas, of the brief prayer that suffices one unable to perform the full prayer.

definition: Plural of ab 'father' in construct: fathers, forefathers of. Root '-b-w.
usage: آبای خود 'their fathers'.

definition: Plural of ab "father" with suffix "our": our fathers, our forefathers. Root ’-b-w.
usage: In Qur'anic quotations of peoples who clung to the ways of their fathers, as in انّا وجدنا آبائنا علی امّة.

definition: Plural of baḥr 'sea': seas, oceans. Root b-ḥ-r.
usage: Often figurative, as in ابحر احسان 'oceans of bounty'.

definition: Plural of badan 'body' with -kum: your bodies. Root b-d-n.
usage: In the Aqdas laws of cleanliness, e.g. تنظیف ابدانکم 'cleansing your bodies'.
notes: As object of yaḍurru it is accusative abdánakum.

definition: Elative: most hateful, most detested. Root b-gh-ḍ.
usage: In the Aqdas ابغض النّاس عند اللّه 'the most despised of men in the sight of God'.

definition: Noun ibn 'son' in the accusative with suffix -hu 'his'. Root b-n-y.
usage: In the Aqdas law of education: تربیة ابنه و بنته 'the instruction of his son and daughter'.

definition: Following, obedience to. Root t-b-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas الحرّیة فی اتّباع اوامری 'True liberty consisteth in man's submission unto My commandments'.
notes: Spelled the same as atbá‘ 'followers'.

definition: Verb form VIII: he took, adopted, took for himself. Root '-kh-dh.
usage: Qur'an 45:23 من اتخذ الهه هواه 'him who taketh his own desire as his god'.

definition: Verb, form VIII, past 3rd person plural: they took, adopted, chose. Root a-kh-dh.
usage: In the Aqdas اتّخذوا التّقوی 'have chosen the fear of God'.

definition: Imperative plural of talá "to recite": recite ye! Root t-l-w.
usage: Aqdas: اتلوا آیات اللّه فی کلّ صباح و مساء 'Recite ye the verses of God every morn and eventide'.

definition: Active participle of atá 'to come', indefinite accusative: coming. Root ’-t-y.
usage: In the Gospel prophecy quoted in the Íqán: یرون ابن الانسان آتیاً علی سحاب السماء 'they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven'.

definition: Noun: permission, leave, authorization. Root j-w-z.
usage: Íqán: باذن و اجازهٔ علمای عصر 'with the sanction and leave of the divines of the age'.

definition: Past of ijtama‘a: gathered, came together, accumulated. Root j-m-‘.
Verbal noun of form VIII ijtahada: exertion, diligent effort; in law, independent reasoning. Root j-h-d.
usage: 'Striving'; also ijtihad, independent juristic reasoning of the Shí‘í clergy, which the Writings discuss critically.
notes: Paired jahd va ijtihád 'effort and striving'.

definition: Noun: plural of jasad "body" plus suffix -hum "their". Root j-s-d.
usage: Their bodies; ordinary noun, used of physical bodies.

definition: Verb ja‘ala, imperative masculine plural: make, place, set. Root j-‘-l.
usage: 'Make ye, set ye', a frequent imperative in counsels.

definition: Noun: appointed term, the hour of death. Root ’-j-l.
usage: The appointed term, especially the hour of death; each soul and nation has its اجل.
notes: ṣayyád-i ajal the fowler of death.

definition: Verbal noun (form VIII): contention, disputation, protest by argument. Root ḥ-j-j.
usage: Contention or protest by argument, of those who disputed with the Prophets.

definition: Verbal noun form IV iḥdáth 'bringing into being, originating' + -í 'my'. Root ḥ-d-th.
usage: Originating, bringing into being; of God's creative act.
notes: Reading and Shoghi Effendi's wording not confirmed for this Hidden Word.

definition: Elative adjective: better, best, most excellent. Root ḥ-s-n.
usage: 'Most excellent', as in the Qur'anic احسن الخالقین 'the most excellent of Makers'; also 'best', as in احسن الاعمال 'the best of deeds'.
notes: 'aḥsanu’l-kháliqín' the most excellent of Makers.

definition: Adjective: red. Root ḥ-m-r.
usage: Red; in the Writings in کبریت احمر "red sulphur", the philosopher's stone, and in symbolic "crimson" imagery.
notes: Kibrít-i aḥmar red sulphur, the proverbially rare philosopher's stone.

definition: Perfect (form VIII): to differ, disagree, be divided. Root kh-l-f.
usage: Used of peoples differing over the Revelation; the Writings condemn اختلاف 'discord' and call for unity.

definition: Past tense akhadha 'he took, seized' with -hum 'them': he seized them. Root a-kh-dh.
usage: Qur'anic اخذهم الله بذنوبهم 'God seized them for their sins'; Aqdas اخذهم سکر الهوی 'the intoxication of passion hath seized them'.

definition: Verb: perfect of akhadha, 'to take, to seize', with suffix -kum 'you'. Root '-kh-dh.
usage: Aqdas: ء اخذکم سکر الهوی 'Hath the intoxication of passion seized you?'.

definition: Arabic verb, imperative of dakhala: enter, go in. Root d-kh-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words: ادخل علی البساط 'enter into the court', i.e. the divine presence.

definition: Arabic verb, form IV imperative: put in, insert, bring in. Root d-kh-l.
usage: Hidden Words: ادخل یدک فی جیبی 'Put thy hand into My bosom'.

definition: Verbal noun form IV: perception, comprehension; with indefinite -í 'any comprehension'. Root d-r-k.
Verb, imperfect 1st sing. of da‘á with 2nd masc. suffix: I call, summon or invite thee. Root d-‘-w.
usage: In the Hidden Words ادعوک الی البقاء 'I call thee to eternity'.

definition: Noun اراده 'will, volition' with the suffix 'his'. Root r-w-d.
usage: In the Writings often the divine Will, closely linked with مشیّت.
notes: Written without the joiner: اراده‌اش.

definition: Verbal noun, form IV: will, wish, intention. Root r-w-d.
usage: اگر ارادهٴ جمالم داری 'if thou seekest My Beauty'; also God's Will.
notes: Final letter written as U+06D5 in the source.

definition: Verb ra'á, to see; first singular present with suffix -ka: I see thee. Root r-’-y.
Cardinal number 'four'. Root r-b-‘.
Arabic numeral arba‘a 'four', used in Persian after a plural noun. Root r-b-‘.
usage: In the Íqán اناجیل اربعه 'the four Gospels', فصول اربعه 'the four seasons'.

definition: Verbal noun: ascent, rising, progress. Root r-q-y.
usage: With فرمود, of Jesus' ascension to heaven in the Íqán.

definition: Perfect 1st plural of form IV aráda 'to will, intend, desire' with -hu 'it'. Root r-w-d.
usage: In the Aqdas of the divine purpose behind the laws: ما اردناه لکم 'what We have desired for you'.

definition: Form I imperative of rafa‘a 'to raise': raise, lift up. Root r-f-‘.
usage: In the Hidden Words ارفع رأسک عن النّوم 'lift up thy head from slumber'.

definition: Comparative/superlative of rafí‘: higher, loftier. Root r-f-‘.
usage: In the Íqán اعلی و ارفع 'higher and loftier'.

definition: Plural of ríḥ: winds. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: E.g. اریاح الشبهات 'the winds of doubt'.

definition: Verbal noun of form X: asking for explanation, inquiring. Root f-s-r.
usage: With شدن or نمودن 'to be asked, to inquire'.

definition: Form VIII of s-w-y: to be level; with علی "to be seated, established upon (a throne)".
usage: Echoes the Qur'anic استوی علی العرش 'He mounted the Throne'; here ما استوی اللّه علی عرش 'God would not have been established upon the throne'.

definition: Perfect 2nd person plural of form X: to be arrogant, disdain proudly. Root k-b-r.
usage: Qur'an 2:87 quoted in the Íqán: whenever a Messenger came 'ye swelled with pride', rejecting some and slaying others.

definition: Proper noun: Isráfíl, the archangel who sounds the trumpet of the Resurrection.
usage: In the Íqán: صور اسرافیل 'the trumpet of Isráfíl', interpreted as the call of the Manifestation.

definition: Plural of saṭr: lines of writing. Root s-ṭ-r.
usage: In HW headings: در سطر ... از اسطر قدس 'in the ... of the most holy lines'.

definition: Plural of sifr 'book, scripture': books of the Bible; also plural of safar 'journey'. Root s-f-r.
usage: 'Books, scriptures', especially the books of the Bible; also 'journeys'.

definition: Elative: lower, lowest, nethermost. Root s-f-l.
usage: Lowest, nethermost; as in asfal-i sáfilín 'the lowest of the low' or the nethermost fire.

definition: Elative asfal "lowest" with -kum: the lowest among you. Root s-f-l.
Noun: Islam; submission to God. Root s-l-m.
usage: Islam, the religion of Muhammad; also literally 'submission to God'.

definition: Plural of ásmán: heavens, skies.
usage: Heavens, skies; both literal and the 'heavens' of prophecy interpreted symbolically in the Íqán.

definition: Broken plural of ism 'name' with suffix -hum 'their'. Root s-m-w.
usage: Names; e.g. the names of those whom God mentions.
notes: Written اسمائهم.

definition: Elative adjective: easier. Root s-h-l.
usage: 'Easier', used in the Aqdas of the ease of God's laws and their facility for the believers.

definition: Verb, Form VIII past: it became doubtful, was confused (for someone). Root sh-b-h.
usage: Became confused or doubtful; used of matters misconceived by the learned.

definition: Elative of shadíd: stronger, more intense, most severe. Root sh-d-d.
usage: Stronger or more severe, as in اشدّ عذاب 'the most severe torment'.

definition: Plural of shaqí: the wretched, the damned, the wicked. Root sh-q-w.
usage: In the Íqán the persecutors of the Prophets; opposite of سعدا 'the blessed'.

definition: Noun: months, plural of shahr. Root sh-h-r.
usage: In the Aqdas laws of waiting periods: تسعة اشهر معدودات 'nine full months'.
notes: Nominative ashhurun in the second context.

definition: Arabic imperative plural of shakara with -hu: give thanks to Him. Root sh-k-r.
usage: In the Aqdas: اشکروه فی العشی و الإشراق 'give thanks unto Him at eventide and dawn'.

definition: Plural of iṣba‘ 'finger' with pronoun 'their'. Root ṣ-b-‘.
usage: In the Qur'anic image یجعلون اصابعهم فی آذانهم 'they thrust their fingers into their ears'.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV: insistence, persistence, importunity. Root ṣ-r-r.
Elative adjective: clearer, more explicit, more emphatic. Root ṣ-r-ḥ.
Verbal noun, form VIII: steadfast patience, endurance. Root ṣ-b-r.
usage: Paired with صبر 'patience'.

definition: Plural of ṣafíy: the pure, the chosen ones, God's elect. Root ṣ-f-w.
usage: In the Writings the chosen ones of God, often with انبیا "the Prophets" and اولیا "the saints".
notes: Final ی is the izáfih.

definition: Noun aṣl 'root, origin, foundation' with -há 'its'. Root '-ṣ-l.
usage: Qur'an 14:24 کشجرة طیّبة اصلها ثابت 'like a goodly tree, its root firmly fixed'.
notes: In the Aqdas accusative aṣlahá.

definition: Relative adjective from aṣl 'root, origin': original, fundamental, principal. Root ’-ṣ-l.
usage: In the Íqán مقصود اصلی 'the primary purpose' of creation, the knowledge of God.

definition: Verb, form VIII: was agitated, trembled, was thrown into turmoil. Root ḍ-r-b.
Perfect of form IV aḍalla 'to lead astray, cause to err' with -hu 'him'. Root ḍ-l-l.
usage: From Qur'an 45:23 و اضلّه اللّه علی علم, which the Íqán interprets.

definition: Plural of ṭayr: birds. Root ṭ-y-r.
usage: Image of the Manifestations or holy souls: اطیار عرش باقی 'birds of the eternal Throne'.

definition: Verbal noun form IV: repeating, restoring, bringing back. Root ‘-w-d.
usage: With نمودن 'to repeat'.

definition: Verbal noun of form VIII: attention, care, heed. Root ‘-n-y.
usage: In اعتنا ندارد 'pays no heed'.
notes: Persian spelling without the final hamza.

definition: Enemies (plural of ‘aduww) with -hi "his". Root ‘-d-w.
usage: In the tradition quoted in the Íqán: اکثر اعدائه العلماء 'most of His enemies will be the divines'.
notes: Normalized from اعدائه.

definition: Perfect 3rd person plural of form IV a‘raḍa 'to turn away from' (with ‘an). Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: Of those who turned away from the Manifestation; opposite of اقبلوا 'turned unto'.

definition: Elative اعلی 'highest' with the suffix 'your'. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: In a tradition of the signs of the Day: یجعل اعلاکم اسفلکم 'He shall make your highest your lowest'.

definition: Imperative of ‘alima: know, be aware. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Opens many statements: اعلم بأنّی 'Know thou that I'.

definition: Elative of ‘álim: more or most learned, most knowing. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Aqdas من اعلم العلماء 'among the most learned of the divines'.

definition: Plural of ‘amal 'deed, work' plus -kum 'your (plural)'. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: 'Your deeds'; in admonitions that deeds are weighed by God and must accord with words.
notes: Nominative a‘málukum in the Aqdas context.

definition: Noun: plural of ‘ayn: eyes. Root ‘-y-n.
Verb form VIII imperative masculine plural: seize as spoil, take advantage of, make the most of. Root gh-n-m.
usage: 'Seize ye, make the most of' an opportunity, such as the days of God.

definition: Noun, plural of ghaní: the rich, the wealthy. Root gh-n-y.
usage: The rich; the Hidden Words address the rich ones on earth (اغنیای ارض), urging care for the poor.
notes: Final ی carries the izáfih: aghniyá-yi.

definition: Present subjunctive 3rd pl. of uftádan: (lest) they fall.
usage: From افتادن 'to fall'.
notes: Bi-halákat uftand = fall into perdition.

definition: Noun (Persian, poetic): wail, lamentation, cry of grief.
usage: Lamentation, wail, often paired with ناله in the laments of the lover.

definition: Noun ufuq 'horizon' with suffix -hi 'its': its horizon. Root ’-f-q.
usage: 'Its horizon', in the imagery of the Sun of Truth rising above the horizon (افق) of God's will.

definition: Plural of falak: celestial spheres, heavens, firmament. Root f-l-k.
usage: The heavens, celestial spheres; in imagery of the spheres and the heavens of divine knowledge.

definition: Noun: lie, falsehood, slander. Root ’-f-k.
usage: Falsehood or slander, as in the opponents' charges of افک against the Manifestation.

definition: Past of form IV aqbala: thou hast turned towards, drawn near. Root q-b-l.
usage: اقبال is turning to God and accepting His Cause; opposite of اعرض 'turned away'.

definition: Verb: perfect 2nd plural of aqbala, 'to turn towards, to approach'. Root q-b-l.
usage: Turning to God (اقبال) is a central idea: اذا اقبلتم الی اللّه 'when ye have turned unto God'.

definition: Arabic verb, form IV perfect: they turned towards, drew near, accepted. Root q-b-l.
usage: إقبال 'turning to' the Manifestation is a key Bahá'í virtue: الّذینهم اقبلوا الیه 'they who have turned unto Him'.

definition: Arabic verb, form IV imperative plural: turn ye towards, draw near. Root q-b-l.
usage: Aqdas: اقبلوا الی الملکوت 'turn ye unto the Kingdom'.

definition: Verb form VIII: to be content, be satisfied with. Root q-n-‘.
Noun: family, kin, household, people of. Root ’-w-l.
usage: In phrases like آل محمّد 'the family of Muḥammad' and مؤمن آل فرعون 'the believer of the family of Pharaoh'.

definition: Verbal noun: glorification, reverence; majesty. Root j-l-l.
usage: In doxologies such as ذی العظمة و الاجلال 'Lord of grandeur and majesty'.

definition: Plural of ḥijáb: veils, coverings. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: انّا خرقنا الأحجاب 'We have rent the veils asunder'.
notes: Uncommon plural of حجاب (usual حجب).

definition: Plural of ḥajar: stones, rocks. Root ḥ-j-r.
Verbal noun: disagreement, discord, dissension; difference. Root kh-l-f.
usage: In the Writings discord and division among the people, which the Faith seeks to remove.

definition: Verbal noun of form VIII ikhtára: choice, option, free will. Root kh-y-r.
usage: In the Aqdas laws of marriage and divorce, لها الاختیار 'she is free to choose'.

definition: Noun, oblique plural of ákhir 'last': the later ones, later generations. Root ’-kh-r.
usage: Paired with الأوّلین, as in کتب الأوّلین و الآخرین 'the books of former and later generations'.
notes: The first Aqdas context may read al-ákharín 'the others'.

definition: Plural of akhsar, elative of khásir 'loser': the greatest losers, the lost. Root kh-s-r.
usage: In من الأخسرین 'among the lost', of those who reject God's Word.

definition: Plural of adab: manners, courtesy, proper conduct. Root ’-d-b.
usage: In the Aqdas طراز الآداب 'the ornament of courtesy' / 'good conduct'.

definition: Noun: good manners, courtesy, propriety; also literature. Root '-d-b.
usage: Aqdas شأن الادب و الوقار 'the bounds of courtesy and dignity'; courtesy is much praised in the Writings.

definition: Noun, plural of armalah: widows. Root r-m-l.
usage: In the Aqdas fines are to be spent by the Trustees of the Merciful on الأیتام و الارامل 'orphans and widows'.

definition: Steadfastness, uprightness, constancy. Form X verbal noun, root q-w-m.
usage: A key Bahá'í virtue; Aqdas کونوا مظاهر الاستقامة 'Be ye the embodiments of steadfastness'.

definition: Plural of sirr: secrets, mysteries, hidden truths. Root s-r-r.
usage: لآلی الاسرار 'the pearls of mysteries'; common for the hidden meanings of the Word.

definition: Plural of سوق: markets, streets. Root s-w-q.
usage: Qur'anic objection: یأکل الطّعام و یمشی فی الأسواق 'eateth food and walketh in the streets'.

definition: Verbal noun: being occupied, engaging in, employment. Root sh-gh-l.
usage: Aqdas: الاشتغال بامر من الامور 'to engage in some occupation'; work is worship.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV aṣbaḥa: daybreak, dawn; fáliq al-iṣbáḥ 'Cleaver of the daybreak'. Root ṣ-b-ḥ.
usage: 'Daybreak'; in the divine title فالق الاصباح 'Cleaver of the daybreak' and in timings of prayer.

definition: Noun with article: plural of ṣulb: loins, backbones; figuratively lineage, the unborn. Root ṣ-l-b.
usage: Loins; figuratively lineage and the unborn generations.

definition: Verbal noun form VIII with article: agitation, disquiet, dismay. Root ḍ-r-b.
usage: Agitation or dismay, used of the disquiet that seizes peoples at the advent of a Manifestation.
notes: Nominative as subject.

definition: Noun (verbal noun): calm, tranquillity, assurance. Root ṭ-m-’-n.
usage: Tranquillity and assurance of heart, attained through the remembrance of God and through certitude.
notes: Written الاطمئنان.

definition: Elative adjective: purest; divine epithet the Most Pure. Root ṭ-h-r.
usage: Most Pure, as a divine epithet and in epithets such as القلم الاطهر.

definition: Verbal noun form IV: turning away, aversion, rejection. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: Turning away, rejection of God's Cause, opposed to اقبال 'turning toward'.
notes: Not a‘ráḍ 'accidents'.

definition: Noun, plural of ‘íd 'feast, festival': feasts. Root ‘-w-d.
usage: 'The festivals', used in the Aqdas of the Holy Days, as in اعظم الاعیاد 'the Most Great Festival' (Riḍván).

definition: Plural of ghaní: the rich, the wealthy. Root gh-n-y.
usage: The rich; the Hidden Words address them, as in یا ابناء الاغنیاء and urge them to care for the poor.

definition: Plural of ufuq: horizons, regions of the world. Root ’-f-q.
usage: Horizons and regions of the world; the Manifestation is the Dayspring and the Cause spreads to all الآفاق.

definition: Plural of falak: the celestial spheres, the heavens. Root f-l-k.
usage: In the tradition لولاک لما خلقت الافلاک 'But for Thee, I would not have created the heavens'.

definition: Noun: thoughts, reflections; plural of fikr. Root f-k-r.
usage: In the address یا اولی الأفکار 'O men of thought', 'O ye who reflect'.
notes: After اولی read uli'l-afkár.

definition: Noun: opium (a loanword from Greek).
usage: Named in the Aqdas among forbidden things: حرّم علیکم ... الأفیون.

definition: Verbal noun form VIII: acquiring, earning a living; (in the Qur'án) committing. Root q-r-f.
Elative adjective: farthest, remotest; المسجد الأقصی 'the Farthest Mosque' in Jerusalem. Root q-ṣ-w.
Noun, plural of laḥn: melodies, tunes, tones of chanting. Root l-ḥ-n.
usage: In the Aqdas بأحسن الألحان 'in the most melodious of tones', of chanting the verses.

definition: Dual of amr: the two matters, the two extremes. Root '-m-r.
usage: ابتغوا امراً بین الأمرین 'seek ye a middle course between the two extremes'.

definition: Plural of mayyit: the dead. Root m-w-t.
Plural of núr 'light': lights. Root n-w-r.
usage: As in یا ملأ الأنوار 'O Concourse of Light' and نور الأنوار 'the Light of lights'.

definition: Plural of wasakh: dirt, filth, grime. Root w-s-kh.
usage: In the Aqdas laws of cleanliness: آثار الاوساخ 'traces of dirt'.

definition: Noun: door, gate; chapter, section. Root b-w-b.
usage: In the Íqán heads its two parts (الباب المذکور فی بیان ...); as a title, the Báb ('the Gate'), Herald of Bahá'u'lláh.

definition: Noun: piety, righteousness, goodness; (barr) dry land is a different word. Root b-r-r.
usage: From Qur'an 2:177 لیس البرّ ان تولّوا وجوهکم 'It is not righteousness that ye turn your faces'.

definition: Hatred, intense enmity. Root b-gh-ḍ.
usage: Paired with ḍaghína 'rancour': الضّغینة و البغضآء 'rancour and animosity'.

definition: Noun: trial, affliction, tribulation. Root b-l-w.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words المحب الصادق یرجو البلاء 'The true lover yearneth for tribulation'.

definition: Noun, plural of bayt: houses, dwellings. Root b-y-t.
usage: In the Aqdas دعوا البیوت 'forsake your houses'; بیوت also means houses of worship.

definition: Name of the Arabic letter ت (tá), numerical value 400 in the abjad system.
usage: In the Aqdas inheritance law: علی عدد التّاء و الفاء 'according to the number of tá and fá' (400 and 80).

definition: Verbal noun of form II: stripping bare, detachment from all save God. Root j-r-d.
usage: Mystical virtue: جواهر التجرید 'the essence of detachment'; مکتب التجرید in the Aqdas.

definition: Noun: piety, fear of God, godliness. Root w-q-y.
usage: HW: بجوهر التّقی 'with the essence of godliness'.

definition: Dual of thaqal: the two weighty things; in Qur'anic usage men and jinn. Root th-q-l.
usage: In the Íqán the hadith انی تارک فیکم الثقلین 'I leave amongst you my twin weighty testimonies'.
notes: In HW the sense is men and jinn, all beings.

definition: Noun: one third (fraction). Root th-l-th.
usage: 'One third'; appears in the Aqdas in laws of inheritance, fines and Ḥuqúqu'lláh calculations.
notes: Also read thuluth.

definition: Noun with article: dual of thuluth "a third": two thirds. Root th-l-th.
usage: Two thirds; used in the Aqdas inheritance and other laws.

definition: Noun with article: the pre-Islamic age of ignorance; also ignorance, barbarism. Root j-h-l.
usage: The pre-Islamic Age of Ignorance (Jáhilíyyah), or ignorance and barbarism generally.
notes: Genitive after amr.

definition: Noun: omnipotence, the realm of divine power (Jabarút). Root j-b-r.
usage: Jabarút, the realm of divine power among the realms of mystical cosmology (ملک، ملکوت، جبروت، لاهوت); also God's omnipotence.
notes: málik al-jabarút Lord of the Kingdom of Power.

definition: Noun: hell, blazing fire. Root j-ḥ-m.
usage: Hell or blazing fire, paired with the garden of paradise; in Bahá'í understanding a spiritual state of remoteness from God.
notes: Háwiyat al-jaḥím = the abyss of hell.

definition: Noun: recompense, requital, penalty. Root j-z-y.
usage: Recompense, requital, as in یوم الجزاء 'the Day of Reckoning'.

definition: Noun, plural of jihah 'side, direction': directions, quarters. Root w-j-h.
usage: 'Directions, quarters', as in جمیع الجهات 'all directions'.

definition: Noun: love. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: Love, especially love for God; as in the Hidden Word "the love of Me", حبی حصنی "My love is My stronghold".
notes: Min ṭíni'l-ḥubbi from the clay of love.

definition: Noun: proof, decisive argument, evidence. Root ḥ-j-j.
usage: Proof, especially the proof of God, as in حجّة الله 'the Proof of God'; the Kitáb-i-Íqán names the revealed verses as the supreme proof.

definition: Noun: limit, boundary; a legal restriction or prescribed penalty. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: In the Aqdas رفع حکم الحدّ 'removed the restriction', e.g. on clothing and beards; حدود الله 'the limits or ordinances of God'.

definition: Noun: silk. Root ḥ-r-r.
usage: In the Aqdas: a shroud of silk or cotton (اثواب من الحریر او القطن), and the wearing of silk is permitted (احلّ لکم لبس الحریر).

definition: Noun: reckoning, account, judgement. Root ḥ-s-b.
usage: The divine reckoning, as in سریع الحساب 'swift in reckoning'; Hidden Words: تقوم علی الحساب 'stand to give account'.

definition: Plural of ḥaqíqah: realities, truths, essences. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: In حقیقة الحقایق 'the Truth of Truths', a title of the Manifestation.

definition: Noun with article: truth, reality, essential nature. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: In the Writings شمس الحقیقة 'the Sun of Truth', a title of the Manifestation of God.
notes: In idáfa read al-ḥaqíqati.

definition: Noun: rule, judgement, authority; ordinance, law. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: In the Writings both a divine ordinance and authority, as in یرجع الحکم الی الأغصان 'authority shall pass to the Aghṣán'.

definition: Noun: life. Root ḥ-y-y.
usage: روح الحیاة 'the spirit of life'.

definition: Noun: time, moment; فی الحین "at once, forthwith". Root ḥ-y-n.
Noun: sealing, seal; end, conclusion. Root kh-t-m.
usage: In the Íqán the discussion of 'the Seal' (خاتم النبیّین 'Seal of the Prophets'), and of beginning (بدء) and end (ختم).

definition: Plural of khaṭí’a: sins, transgressions. Root kh-ṭ-’.
usage: In the Íqán, quoting the Gospel: یغفر الخطایا 'to forgive sins'.

definition: Noun: dominion, sovereignty, turn of fortune; modern 'state'. Root d-w-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words هذه الدّولة الباقیة 'this everlasting dominion'.
notes: Modern Arabic usually 'state, government'.

definition: Intensive form from d-y-n: the Requiter, the Judge; a divine name.
usage: A divine name in the Aqdas, as in لمن دان باللّه الدّیان 'for him who believeth in God, the Lord of Judgement'.

definition: Plural of dhi’b: wolves. Root dh-’-b.
usage: In the Aqdas the false leaders who prey on the flock: الذّئاب الّذین ظهروا بالأثواب 'the wolves who have appeared in sheep's clothing'.

definition: Noun: the letter rá' (R); in the Aqdas used for its numerical value and in coded place-names.
usage: ارض الکاف و الراء 'Land of Káf and Rá' (Kirmán); عدد الراء 'the number of Rá' (200).

definition: Noun: rest, ease, comfort, repose. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: In the Hidden Words ما قدّر لک الرّاحة الّا باعراضک عن نفسک 'Rest is not destined for thee save by turning away from thyself'.

definition: Those firmly rooted, well-grounded; plural of rásikh. Root r-s-kh.
usage: Qur'an 3:7, quoted in the Íqán: الرّاسخون فی العلم 'those well-grounded in knowledge'.

definition: Active participle plural of raqada 'to sleep': sleepers, the heedless. Root r-q-d.
usage: Figurative of the spiritually heedless: لا تکن من الراقدین 'be not of them that sleep'.
notes: In the genitive here after من.

definition: Noun: mercy, compassion. Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: HW: المذنب الی الرّحمة 'the sinner to mercy'; frequent in رحمة من عنده 'a mercy from Him'.

definition: Noun: messenger, Apostle; with the article usually the Prophet Muḥammad. Root r-s-l.
Adjective: high, exalted, lofty. Root r-f-‘.
usage: 'Exalted, lofty'; describes God's station or the heights of the spirit, as in المقام الرفیع.
notes: In the inheritance verse ‘adad ar-rafí‘ is the abjad value of the word (360).

definition: Noun with article: plural of raqaba "neck"; in málik ar-riqáb "Lord of all men". Root r-q-b.
usage: Necks; in málik ar-riqáb 'Lord of all men', a title of God.

definition: Noun: the letter záy (z), numerical value 7 in abjad reckoning.
usage: The letter záy, used in abjad numerology and in allusions with letter values.
notes: Aqdas inheritance: divided "according to the number of Z".

definition: Noun: time, age, epoch. Root z-m-n.
usage: Time or age; of this age and the signs of the time of the end.

definition: Proper noun: az-Zawrá' (the crooked one), a traditional name of Baghdad. Root z-w-r.
usage: A traditional name of Baghdad, used for Bahá'u'lláh's place of exile, as in ارض الزوراء.

definition: Plural active participle (genitive): hearers, those who listen. Root s-m-‘.
usage: Hearers, those who listen to the Word of God.

definition: Verbal noun of sajada: prostration, bowing down. Root s-j-d.
usage: 'Prostration', in the Aqdas's laws of prayer, as in the prostration to be made upon any clean surface.

definition: Noun: lote-tree; the Sadratu'l-Muntahá, symbol of the Manifestation; the Burning Bush. Root s-d-r.
usage: The Divine Lote-Tree, السدرة المنتهی, symbol of the Manifestation of God.

definition: Plural of sulṭán: sovereigns, kings; sulṭán as-saláṭín 'King of kings'. Root s-l-ṭ.
usage: Sovereigns, as in سلطان السّلاطین 'King of kings', a title of God.

definition: Verbal noun of sa’ala: asking, questioning; a question. Root s-’-l.
usage: In the Aqdas حرّم علیکم السؤال فی البیان, the Bayán's prohibition of asking questions, which Bahá'u'lláh lifts.

shift: Here: those who perceive, are aware (from sha'ara). Today (Arabic): poets.
definition: Plural of shá‘ir, 'one who perceives, is aware' (from sha‘ara 'to perceive'); not 'poets' here. Root sh-‘-r.
usage: In the Aqdas ان انتم من الشّاعرین 'if ye be of them that perceive'.

definition: Verbal noun: witnessing, presence; the visible world as opposed to الغیب 'the unseen'. Root sh-h-d.
usage: In the pair الغیب و الشّهود 'the unseen and the seen'.

definition: Active participle: truthful, sincere, true. Root ṣ-d-q.
usage: As in المحب الصادق 'the true lover' and عاشق صادق 'sincere lover'.

definition: Active participle plural with article: the humbled, the abased, the abject. Root ṣ-gh-r.
usage: Qur'anic, in من الصّاغرین 'of the abased'.

definition: Noun, plural of ṣadr: breasts, hearts, inmost selves. Root ṣ-d-r.
usage: Qur'anic formula بذات الصّدور 'what is in men's breasts'.

definition: Verbal noun: striking, beating; also a kind or sort. Root ḍ-r-b.
usage: In the Aqdas law on injuries: الشّجاج و الضّرب 'wounding and beating'.

definition: Name of the letter ط (Ṭ), numerical value 9; used as an abbreviation.
usage: In the Aqdas ارض الطّآء "the land of Ṭá" is Ṭihrán; also in the inheritance table of letters.

definition: Noun: tyranny, transgression, rebellious excess. Root ṭ-gh-y.
Elative of laṭíf: subtler, finer, more gracious; most subtle. Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: In the Aqdas, of God: الطف من کلّ لطیف 'more subtle than any subtle one'.
notes: Not the article al- with a noun; the alif is the elative prefix.

definition: Noun: divorce. Root ṭ-l-q.
usage: Its conditions are set out in the Aqdas, which discourages it.

definition: Noun: purity, cleanness, ritual purity. Root ṭ-h-r.
usage: In the Aqdas Bahá'u'lláh abolishes ritual uncleanness: انغمست الأشیاء فی بحر الطّهارة 'all things were immersed in the sea of purification'.

definition: Good, pure, wholesome, fragrant. Root ṭ-y-b.
usage: In البلد الطّیّب 'the good land' (Qur'an 7:58) and العمل الطّیّب 'goodly deeds'.

definition: Abstract noun: servitude, servitude to God. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: Aqdas حبل العبودیة 'the cord of servitude'; servitude to God is called true liberty.

definition: Collective noun: non-Arabs, especially Persians. Root ‘-j-m.
usage: In حمامات العجم 'Persian baths' (Aqdas) and in Islamic traditions about the Qá'im.

definition: ‘Iráq, the land of Mesopotamia; Bahá'u'lláh's place of exile in Baghdad (1853–1863).
usage: In شطر العراق 'the region of ‘Iráq', where the Íqán was revealed.

definition: Noun: resolve, determination, firmness of purpose. Root ‘-z-m.
usage: In اولو العزم 'the Prophets endowed with constancy', those who brought a Book.
notes: Read as ulu’l-‘azm in the phrase.

definition: Plural of عقیدة: beliefs, creeds, doctrines. Root ‘-q-d.
usage: In Persian compounds: مختلف العقاید 'of divers beliefs'.

definition: Noun: deed, act, work. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: The Writings stress deeds over words, as in العمل الطیب 'a goodly deed'.

definition: Plural of ‘álam 'world': worlds, realms. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: 'Worlds'; as in the worlds of God, spiritual realms beyond this world.

definition: Noun with article: plural of ‘ayn: eyes; also springs. Root ‘-y-n.
usage: Eyes, also springs; ordinary noun.

definition: Noun, plural of ghulám with article: boys, youths; male slaves. Root gh-l-m.
usage: Youths or servants; الغلمان are the youths of paradise in Qur'anic imagery; the modern sense 'slaves' is dated.
notes: Aqdas: trading in slaves "be they men or women".

definition: Noun: the letter fá (ف), numerical value 80.
usage: The letter fá; letters and their numerical values are used symbolically in the Writings.
notes: Used in the Aqdas inheritance shares.

definition: Plural of fá'iz: those who attain, win or succeed. Root f-w-z.
usage: Those who attain or are victorious, as in من الفائزین 'among them that have attained'.
notes: Min al-fá'izín = among them that have attained.

definition: Noun: trial, temptation, sedition, strife. Root f-t-n.
usage: Trial, sedition, strife; God's tests of the believers, and the discord they must shun.

definition: Noun: abomination, indecency, shameful deed. Root f-ḥ-sh.
usage: 'Indecency, abomination', in Qur'anic-style prohibitions of shameful deeds.

definition: Noun: the Furqán, "that which distinguishes" truth from falsehood; a name of the Qur'án. Root f-r-q.
usage: A name of the Qur'án, "the Criterion"; the Íqán calls the Qur'án the Furqán.

definition: Verbal noun: separation, division; in marriage law, final separation. Root f-ṣ-l.
usage: Separation or division; in Aqdas laws on marriage and divorce, and in یوم الفصل 'the Day of Separation'.

definition: Noun: silver. Root f-ḍ-ḍ.
usage: In the Aqdas الذهب و الفضة 'gold and silver', e.g. vessels of gold and silver.

definition: Noun: success, prosperity, salvation. Root f-l-ḥ.
usage: Spiritual success or salvation: اقداح الفلاح 'the chalices of salvation'; it is also the word of the call to prayer.

definition: Intensive adjective: overflowing, abundantly bountiful; a divine name. Root f-y-ḍ.
usage: A divine attribute, as in المعطی الفیّاض 'the Giver, the Bountiful'.

definition: Active participle 'he who arises'; title of the promised Mahdí of Shí'ah Islam. Root q-w-m.
usage: The Promised One of Shí'ah Islam, fulfilled in the Báb, as قائم آل محمد 'the Qá'im of the family of Muḥammad'.

definition: Noun, plural of qabílah with article: the tribes. Root q-b-l.
usage: In the Aqdas ناحت القبائل 'the tribes lamented', echoing the Gospel.
notes: Nominative al-qabá’ilu.

definition: Noun: the direction faced in prayer. Root q-b-l.
usage: In the Aqdas the Qiblih is fixed on Bahá'u'lláh (and after Him His resting-place); the Íqán discusses the change of Qiblih in Islam.

definition: Plural of qabr: graves, tombs. Root q-b-r.
usage: Qur'an 35:22 و ما انت بمسمع من فی القبور; the spiritually dead are those in the graves.

definition: Noun: decree, destiny, divine ordinance. Root q-d-r.
usage: In the Aqdas مالک القدر "the Lord of Destiny", a title of God.

definition: Verbal noun: reading, recitation (of scripture). Root q-r-'.
usage: In the Aqdas لا تغرّنکم کثرة القرائة 'pride not yourselves on much reading'.
notes: Spelled with ئ for standard قراءة.

definition: Noun: night, the hours of darkness. Root l-y-l.
usage: In the Aqdas فی اللیل و النهار 'by night and by day'.

definition: Noun: place of return, final destination. Root ’-w-b.
usage: In مالک المبدء و المآب 'the Lord of the Beginning and the Return'.

definition: Active participle of malaka with the article: the Owner, the sovereign Lord. Root m-l-k.
usage: In the Aqdas address to the kings: قد اتی المالک 'He Who is the sovereign Lord of all is come'.

pos: passive participle fem. with article (form III)
definition: Blessed. Root b-r-k.
usage: In البقعة المبارکة 'the blessed Spot' and الأرض المبارکة 'the blessed land'.

definition: Active participle plural form VI: those who overstep bounds, transgressors. Root j-w-z.
usage: Aqdas لا تکونن من المتجاوزین 'be not of them that transgress'.

definition: Active participle of form VI with the article: the Exalted, the Most High. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: A divine name, as in الواح اللّه المتعالی 'the Tablets of God, the Most Exalted'.

definition: Love, affection. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: Aqdas on marriage: انّا لمّا اردنا المحبّة و الوداد 'desiring love and amity...'.

definition: Plural of madína: cities, towns. Root m-d-n.
usage: لیفتح المدن 'to open the cities'; المدن و القری 'cities and villages'.

definition: Plural of مسکین: the poor, the needy. Root s-k-n.
usage: Aqdas: الفقراء و المساکین 'the poor and the needy'.

definition: Active participle: straight, upright, right. Root q-w-m.
usage: Qur'anic الصراط المستقیم 'the straight path'.

definition: Noun of place from sajada: mosque, place of prostration. Root s-j-d.
usage: 'Mosque'; as in المسجد الاقصی and المسجد الحرام, and in Aqdas laws on houses of worship.
notes: al-masjid al-ḥarám 'the Sacred Mosque'; al-masjid al-aqṣá 'the Farthest Mosque'.

definition: Noun with article: plural of mashriq: places of sunrise, easts, dawning-places. Root sh-r-q.
usage: Easts, dawning-places; in mashriq (pl. masháriq) 'dawning-place' of revelation, as in mashriq al-waḥy.

definition: Noun, plural of ma‘ná with article: meanings, inner significances. Root ‘-n-y.
usage: Meanings or inner significances, contrasted with outward words; a key term in the Kitáb-i-Íqán's call to grasp the inner meanings of scripture.

definition: Passive participle as noun: the known; what is fitting, decent, right. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: What is right and fitting, as in the Qur'anic الامر بالمعروف 'enjoining what is right'; in the Aqdas conduct according to propriety.

definition: Noun of place: the West, place of sunset. Root gh-r-b.
usage: The West, paired with المشرق 'the East'; e.g. the call reaching East and West.

definition: Plural active participle form IV: those who turn toward God, the faithful. Root q-b-l.
usage: Those who turn toward God, the believers who accepted the Cause, opposed to المعرضین.

definition: Noun: assembly, council, concourse; al-mala’ al-a‘lá the Concourse on High. Root m-l-’.
usage: 'Concourse, assembly', chiefly in الملأ الاعلی 'the Concourse on High', the company of holy souls in the spiritual worlds.
notes: Spelled with alef and hamza in the source.

definition: Plural of mumkin: contingent beings, created things; possibilities. Root m-k-n.
usage: Contingent beings, all created things, in contrast to the necessary Being of God.

definition: Plural active participle (form VIII): those who wait, expect. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: Those awaiting the promised one; the Kitáb-i-Íqán shows how those who waited rejected Him when He came.

definition: Active participle of antana: stinking, fetid, foul-smelling. Root n-t-n.
usage: In the Aqdas رائحتها المنتنة 'their fetid smell', of the old Persian public baths.

definition: Noun (passive participle of form VIII): the utmost limit, furthest end. Root n-h-y.
usage: Nearly always in سدرة المنتهی, the Lote-Tree beyond which there is no passing, symbol of the Manifestation of God.

definition: Active participle plural (form IV): the just, the fair-minded. Root n-ṣ-f.
usage: In the refrain لو انتم من المنصفین 'if ye be of the fair-minded'.

definition: Plural of mayyit: the dead. Root m-w-t.
usage: Often the spiritually dead, as in دع الموتی لیدفنوا الموتی 'Let the dead bury their dead'.

definition: Passive participle with article: the promised; the Promised One. Root w-‘-d.
usage: In the Writings the Promised One of all religions, fulfilled in Bahá'u'lláh: ظهر الموعود 'the Promised One hath appeared'.

definition: Noun: gift, bestowal, bounty. Root w-h-b.
usage: In doxologies paired with الافضال 'grace', as in ذی ... الموهبة و الافضال.

definition: Verbal noun, form III: unveiling, mystic disclosure, intuitive vision. Root k-sh-f.
usage: میدان المکاشفة و العرفان 'the arena of mystic insight and understanding'.
notes: Rendering not confirmed against the authorized translation.

definition: Passive participle of kanna: hidden, concealed, treasured. Root k-n-n.
usage: In the Writings of hidden treasures and knowledge, as in حبّی المکنون "My hidden love" and العلم المکنون "the hidden knowledge".

definition: Active participle: one who counsels sincerely, adviser. Root n-ṣ-ḥ.
usage: A divine title in the Aqdas: الناصح الأمین 'the Counsellor, the Faithful'.

definition: Sound masculine plural of nabí: the Prophets. Root n-b-’.
usage: A tradition quoted in the Íqán: امّا النبیّون فأنا 'As to the Prophets, I am they'.

definition: Noun, plural (no singular of same root): women. Root n-s-w.
usage: In the Aqdas laws on women's exemptions, as in عفا اللّه عن النّسآء.

definition: Noun: order, arrangement, system; also stringing pearls, verse. Root n-ẓ-m.
usage: In the Aqdas قد اضطرب النّظم من هذا النّظم الأعظم 'the world's equilibrium hath been upset through this Most Great World Order'.
notes: The first النظم is the world's order (equilibrium), the second the New World Order.

definition: Plural of na‘l: sandals, shoes. Root n-‘-l.
usage: In the Aqdas صفّ النّعال, the place by the door where shoes are left, the lowest seat.

definition: Noun: daytime, day (as opposed to night). Root n-h-r.
usage: In فی اللیل و النهار 'by night and by day'.

definition: Noun: sleep, slumber. Root n-w-m.
usage: In the Hidden Words ارفع رأسک عن النّوم 'Lift up thy head from slumber'.

definition: Inspirations; plural of ilhám (form IV verbal noun). Root l-h-m.
usage: In the Íqán divine knowledge proceeds from the inspirations of the true Sovereign, unlike satanic learning.

definition: Adjective and divine name: the One, the Single. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: Divine epithet: الله الواحد المختار 'God, the One, the Unconstrained'; الفرد الواحد 'the Single, the One'.

definition: Plural of لوح 'tablet' with indefinite ی: some tablets, writings, epistles. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: لوح is the usual word for a Tablet of Bahá'u'lláh; here alváḥí chand 'a few epistles' written against the Prophet.

definition: Active participle: clear, plain, evident. Root w-ḍ-ḥ.
Feminine elative of wathíq 'firm, sure': firmest; in al-‘urwat al-wuthqá 'the firmest handle'. Root w-th-q.
usage: In العروة الوثقی 'the firmest handle', the Qur'anic image of firm faith, applied to the Covenant.

definition: Adjective and divine name: loving, affectionate (al-Wadúd). Root w-d-d.
usage: Loving; the divine name al-Wadúd 'the All-Loving'.

definition: Noun with article: mankind, creatures, all people. Root w-r-y.
usage: Mankind or all creatures, as in یا ملأ الوری 'O concourse of mankind'.
notes: Mawla’l-wará the Lord of all men.

definition: Noun: union, reunion with the beloved. Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: Union with the Beloved, a Sufi theme taken up in the Hidden Words and Seven Valleys, contrasted with فراق 'separation'.

definition: Noun: threat, warning of punishment. Root w-‘-d.
usage: Threat of punishment, paired with الوعد 'promise' in Qur'anic style.
notes: Yawm al-wa‘íd = the Day of Threatening.

definition: Noun: dignity, gravity, composure. Root w-q-r.
usage: Dignity, composure, enjoined on believers, as in بالوقار 'with dignity'.

definition: Arabic al-wuqú‘ 'occurrence' + Persian -ast 'is'; muḥaqqaq al-vuqú‘: certain to occur. Root w-q-‘.
usage: 'Occurrence', as in محقّق الوقوع 'certain to occur', of prophecies sure to be fulfilled.

definition: Plural (nominative) of káfir: unbelievers, infidels. Root k-f-r.
usage: The unbelievers; Qur'anic usage, rendered "the infidels".

definition: Noun: generosity, nobility, bounty. Root k-r-m.
usage: Generosity and bounty, chiefly of God, as in بحر الکرم 'the ocean of generosity'.

definition: Noun: laziness, sloth, idleness. Root k-s-l.
usage: In the Aqdas paired with البطالة 'idleness and sloth', and لا تأخذکم الکسالة 'let not sloth overtake you'.

definition: Noun: stars, plural of kawkab. Root k-w-k-b.
usage: In the Íqán's Gospel quotation و الکواکب تتساقط من السّمآء 'and the stars shall fall from heaven', interpreted as the divines of a former dispensation.

definition: Arabic preposition ilá 'to' with the 3rd plural pronoun: to them, unto them.
Collective noun: the Jews. Root h-w-d.
Noun imtiḥán 'test, trial' with Persian plural -há and izáfih. Root m-ḥ-n.
usage: Divine tests that sift the faithful, a recurring theme of the Íqán.

definition: Noun, plural of mithl, with 'its/their': the like of them, similar things. Root m-th-l.
usage: و امثالها 'and the like'.

definition: Plural of maraḍ: illnesses, diseases. Root m-r-ḍ.
Passive of amara, to command: thou wast commanded; may also be read umirtu "I was commanded". Root ’-m-r.
usage: In the Qur'anic فاستقم کما امرت "be steadfast as thou hast been bidden".
notes: In the Aqdas context ما امرت به the reading is umirtu "I was bidden".

definition: Past participle of آمرزیدن: forgiven, pardoned (especially by God).
Noun amr 'command, cause, matter' with -ná: Our Cause, Our command. Root ’-m-r.
usage: A tradition in the Íqán: انّ امرنا صعب مستصعب 'Our Cause is grievous, perplexing'; and Qur'an 54:50 و ما امرنا الّا واحدة.
notes: After wa-má it is nominative amruná.

definition: Verb amara 'to command' with -kum 'you': We have commanded you. Root ’-m-r.
Noun amr 'command, cause, affair' in the genitive with -há 'its, her'. Root ’-m-r.
usage: In the Writings usually 'the Cause' or God's command, as in امر الله 'the Cause of God'.

definition: Persian plural of amr 'matter, affair, thing'.
notes: Second Íqán context: پست‌ترین امرها 'the most worthless of things'.

definition: Passive of amara 'to command': they were commanded. Root ’-m-r.
usage: In فیما امروا به 'in that whereunto they have been bidden'.

definition: Plural of amín: trustees, faithful ones. Root '-m-n.
usage: Aqdas امناء الرحمن 'the Trustees of the Merciful', the members of the House of Justice.

definition: Verb, form IV, past 3rd person plural: they believed. Root a-m-n.
usage: In الّذین آمنوا 'they who believe'; آمنوا بآیاته 'believed in His signs'.

definition: The dead; plural of mayyit. Root m-w-t.
usage: Of the spiritually dead, as in از اموات محسوبند 'they are accounted among the dead'.

definition: Noun: hope, expectation, that which one longs for.
usage: شجرهٔ امید 'the tree of hope' cut down by the sword of rebellion.

definition: Noun: commander, prince; حضرت امیر 'the Commander (of the Faithful)', the Imam ‘Alí. Root ’-m-r.
usage: In the Íqán حضرت امیر refers to the Imam ‘Alí.

definition: Pronoun ánán (those, they) with 3pl copula: they are, those are.
Past tense, third person feminine singular, of form VIII intahá 'to end, reach the limit'; with ilá 'arrive at'. Root n-h-y.
usage: 'Ended, led to'; with الی 'culminated in', as in all things lead back to God.

definition: Verb (form VIII) "it ended"; written after a quotation to mean "end of quotation". Root n-h-y.
usage: End of quotation; written after a quotation, rendered 'end of quotation' or left untranslated.

definition: Verbal noun form IV: warning, admonition. Root n-dh-r.
usage: Warning or admonition, often paired with بشارت 'glad tidings' as the twin roles of the Prophets.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): sending down, revealing. Root n-z-l.
usage: The sending down of revelation from God, as in انزال آیات 'the revelation of verses'.

definition: Imperative pl. of naṣara: help ye, aid, give victory to. Root n-ṣ-r.
usage: A call to help or assist the Cause, as in انصروا امر الله; in Bahá'í teaching victory comes through deeds and teaching, not the sword.

definition: Imperative masc. sing. of naṭaqa: speak, utter. Root n-ṭ-q.
usage: 'Speak!', a common command to proclaim the Cause.

definition: Verbal noun (form VII): non-existence, extinction, disappearance. Root ‘-d-m.
usage: 'Extinction, non-existence', of what is doomed to perish or pass away.

definition: Plural anfus (souls, persons) + Persian -í: those souls who. Root n-f-s.
usage: Souls, persons; نفوس and انفس mean "people, souls" in the Writings.

definition: Verbal noun (form VII): ending, expiry, lapse (of time). Root q-ḍ-y.
usage: The ending of a set time, as in انقضاء مدّت 'the expiry of the term' in Aqdas laws.

definition: Verbal noun inqiṭá‘ 'being cut off; detachment from all save God' with indefinite -í. Root q-ṭ-‘.
usage: A central virtue in the Writings: انقطاع 'detachment' from the world and self.

definition: Verb: perfect 3rd plural of inqaṭa‘a, 'to be cut off, to detach oneself'; with ilá, to devote oneself wholly to. Root q-ṭ-‘.
usage: Detachment (انقطاع) from all save God: الّذینهم انقطعوا الیه 'they who have detached themselves and turned unto Him'.

shift: Here: upheaval, turmoil, overturning. Today: a revolution.
definition: Verbal noun (form VII): overturning, upheaval, turmoil; modern Persian 'revolution'. Root q-l-b.
usage: Upheaval and turmoil in the world or among believers.

definition: Verbal noun form VIII: concern, earnest effort, zeal. Root h-m-m.
Noun, plural of amr 'command' with 3rd masc. suffix: His commandments. Root ’-m-r.
usage: In the Aqdas of God's laws, often with احکام 'ordinances'.

definition: Verb: I deposited, entrusted, placed within. Root w-d-‘.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: اودعت فیک جوهر نوری 'I have placed within thee the essence of My light'.

definition: Verb, present perfect of آوردن: they have brought. Persian.
usage: بلایا وارد آورده‌اند 'have inflicted afflictions'.
notes: Written آورده‌اند; joiner removed in the form.

definition: Plural of walí with suffix "his": His friends, saints, chosen ones. Root w-l-y.
usage: In the Writings اولیا are God's chosen ones or saints; in the quoted tradition His loved ones abased in His day.

definition: Adjective: acquired, gained by effort, as opposed to innate. Root k-s-b.
usage: In the Íqán علوم اکتسابی 'acquired learning', contrasted with divinely inspired knowledge.

definition: Verbal noun of form VIII iktafá: being content with, making do with; with namúdan and bi-, to suffice oneself with. Root k-f-y.
Verbal noun ikmál 'completing' with -há 'its'. Root k-m-l.
usage: In the Aqdas, Naw-Rúz as the feast after the completion of the Fast.

definition: Plural of kanaf 'side, shelter': sides, quarters, regions. Root k-n-f.
usage: In اطراف و اکناف 'from every side, far and near'.

definition: Subjunctive of kána 'to be': (that) I be. Root k-w-n.
usage: In the Hidden Words اکون فیک باقیاً 'that I may live in thee'.

definition: Plural of yad: hands; also favours. Root y-d-y.
usage: ایادی الالطاف 'the hands of bounty'; ایادی امرالله 'Hands of the Cause of God'.

definition: Pronoun base iyyá with 'thee'; as a warning, 'beware!'; with ان and a verb 'beware lest'.
usage: In the Aqdas ایّاک ان یمنعک الغرور 'Beware lest pride keep thee back'.

definition: Bringing into being, creation. Form IV verbal noun, root w-j-d.
usage: In سلطان ایجاد 'the Sovereign of creation'.

definition: Plural of yad 'hand' with suffix 'their'. Root y-d-y.
usage: ید الله فوق ایدیهم 'the hand of God is above their hands' (Qur'an 48:10).

definition: Adverb: also, likewise, again. Root ’-y-ḍ.
Relational adjective, feminine form: of faith, pertaining to belief. Root ’-m-n.
usage: In the Íqán حیات ایمانیه 'the life of faith'.

definition: Plural of imám 'leader, one who leads prayer': leaders, imams. Root '-m-m.
usage: 'Leaders, imams'; in the Íqán and Aqdas often the Imams or religious leaders who opposed the Manifestation.
notes: Normally spelled أئمّة.

definition: Noun: verse of scripture; sign, token. Root ’-y-y.
usage: Verse, sign; áyát are both verses of revelation and signs of God, a proof the Íqán stresses.
notes: Final ە with izáfih hamza as written in the source.

definition: Noun báb "door, gate" with Persian indefinite -í: a door.
usage: 'A door'; باب 'gate' is also the title of the Báb, the Gate of God.

definition: Adjective (active participle): decisive, absolute, utter. Root b-t-t.
usage: Utter, absolute, decisive; as in an utter negation or a decisive ruling.
notes: Paired with baḥt or ṣirf for emphasis.

definition: Preposition bi- with plural of janáḥ (wing): with or on the wings. Root j-n-ḥ.
usage: On the wings, as in 'soar with the wings of detachment'.
notes: Ṭárú bi-ajniḥat al-íqán = soared on the wings of certitude.

definition: bi- 'with, in' + aḥsan, elative of ḥasan 'good': best, most beautiful. Root ḥ-s-n.
usage: 'In the best', as in باحسن الالحان 'with the most beautiful melodies'.

definition: Preposition bi- + aḥkám, plural of ḥukm 'law, ordinance'. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: 'With laws', of the ordinances (احکام) of God, especially those revealed in the Aqdas.

definition: Plural of bád (wind) with -há, in izáfih: the winds of.
usage: The winds of; in imagery of the winds of tests or of divine grace.

definition: Plural of bádiyih 'desert, wilderness' with izáfih: deserts of. Root b-d-w.
usage: Deserts and wildernesses, used figuratively in the Hidden Words of the wastes of remoteness from God.
notes: Written بادیه‌های.

definition: Noun: rain.
usage: In the Íqán باران نیسان 'the April rain', a figure for divine bounty.

definition: Persian bi- 'to, into' + Arabic arḍ 'earth, land, ground'. Root '-r-ḍ.
usage: In the Íqán's imagery ارض قلوب 'the soil of hearts' and ارض هدایت 'the land of guidance'.

definition: Persian verb, 3rd singular past of báridan 'to rain': it rained, showered down.
Preposition bi 'according to, with' and isti‘dád 'capacity, readiness, aptitude'. Root ‘-d-d.
usage: The receptive capacity of souls or things to receive divine bounty.

definition: Preposition bi with asrár, plural of sirr: with, of or by the mysteries. Root s-r-r.
usage: اسرار 'mysteries' of divine knowledge recur in the Íqán.

definition: Persian بـ 'to' with آسمان 'sky, heaven'.
usage: In the Íqán discussed figuratively, as the heaven of the Cause or of knowledge.
notes: Normalized from بآسمان.

definition: Preposition ب with plural of ṣáḥib: to the companions, followers. Root ṣ-ḥ-b.
Persian bi plus i‘ánat: with the help or assistance of. Root ‘-w-n.
usage: باعانت غیبی "through the assistance of the unseen" is a typical phrase.

definition: Preposition bi- with i‘ráḍ 'turning away, rejection'. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: In the Writings اعراض is the rejection of the Manifestation; معرضین 'those who have turned aside'.

definition: Persian bi- 'by, with' plus af‘ál, plural of fi‘l: by deeds, through actions. Root f-‘-l.
usage: The Hidden Words contrast guidance once by words (باقوال) with guidance now by deeds (بافعال).

definition: Preposition bi- plus afwáh 'mouths' (plural of fam) with -him 'their'. Root f-w-h.
usage: Qur'anic یریدون ان یطفئوا نور اللّه بأفواههم 'they desire to put out God's light with their mouths'.

definition: Active participle of baqiya 'to remain': abiding, lasting, everlasting. Root b-q-y.
usage: Contrasted with فانی 'mortal', as in لتکون فیّ فانیاً و اکون فیک باقیاً.

definition: Báqí 'remaining, lasting' with -st 'is': is still remaining, lasts. Root b-q-y.
bi- with al-báṭil: with falsehood, vanity. Root b-ṭ-l.
usage: Used in the Persian Hidden Words address ای پسر رماد, literally 'O son of ashes'.

definition: Preposition bi- with birr: righteousness, piety, kindness. Root b-r-r.
usage: In the Aqdas یأمرکم بالبرّ و التّقوی 'biddeth you observe righteousness and the fear of God'.

definition: Bi "with, in" + al-khulúṣ "sincerity, purity of motive". Root kh-l-ṣ.
usage: Aqdas: اقرب بالخلوص و التّقوی 'more conducive to sincerity and godliness'.

definition: Preposition bi- with al-‘ilm 'knowledge, learning'. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Aqdas law of education: تربیة ابنه و بنته بالعلم و الخطّ 'instruct son and daughter in learning and writing'.

definition: Preposition ب with the article and عمل 'deed, action'. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: Aqdas: فاز بالعمل فی رضاه 'attained unto deeds pleasing to Him'.

definition: Preposition bi- with al-qulúb, plural of qalb: with the hearts. Root q-l-b.
bi- 'to, with' plus al-laṭáfah 'refinement, cleanliness, delicacy'. Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: 'With refinement'; the Aqdas enjoins لطافة, cleanliness and refinement in all things.
notes: Aqdas: 'Hold ye fast unto refinement under all conditions'.

definition: Preposition bi- "with" plus al-má’ "the water".
usage: With water; ordinary noun, as in Aqdas laws on washing.

definition: Preposition bi- with article and mawadda "love, affection". Root w-d-d.
usage: Love or affection, used in counsels to consort with all peoples in love and fellowship.
notes: amarakum bi’l-mawaddati fí dhawi’l-qurbá commanded you to show kindness to your kindred.

definition: Phrase bi + al-wa‘d "the promise": wafá bi'l-wa‘d to fulfil the promise. Root w-‘-d.
usage: In الوفاء بالوعد 'faithfulness to the promise', and of God's promise fulfilled in His Day.

definition: Persian bi- with amr (matter, command) and indefinite -í: to or with some matter. Root '-m-r.
usage: Amr 'matter, command' with indefinite -í: 'to some matter'; amr is also the usual word for the Cause of God.

definition: bi- 'in, with' + amvál, plural of mál: wealth, possessions. Root m-w-l.
usage: Riches, wealth; often in warnings against attachment to worldly possessions.

definition: Preposition bi- + intihá 'end, conclusion'. Root n-h-y.
usage: 'To the end', as in بانتها رساندن 'to bring to an end', used of concluding a discourse or an age.
notes: bi-intihá rasándan: to bring to an end.

definition: bi (by, with) + ánhá (those, them).
Preposition bi + ahwá’ (plural of hawá 'desire, passion, whim') + -kum 'your'. Root h-w-y.
usage: Desires and passions, set against the will of God, as in اتّباع الهوی 'following idle desire'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with, by' plus avámir, plural of amr 'command': with the commandments. Root a-m-r.
usage: اوامر الله 'the commandments of God', often paired with احکام 'ordinances'.

definition: Preposition bi 'with' + iklíl 'crown, wreath, garland'. Root k-l-l.
usage: زینوا رؤسکم باکلیل الأمانة و الوفآء 'adorn your heads with the garland of trustworthiness and fidelity'.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with áyát 'verses, signs' and indefinite -í: with or in verses.
usage: Áyát are verses of revelation and signs of God; آیات اللّه 'the verses of God'.

definition: Preposition bi 'with' and aydí, plural of yad 'hand', with pronoun 'their'. Root y-d-y.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse فویل للذین یکتبون الکتاب بأیدیهم 'woe to those who write the Book with their own hands'.

definition: Conjunction: (to the fact) that, introducing a clause after verbs of knowing; also 'although'.
Persian بـ with اینگونه 'this kind, such'.
Preposition ب with báṭil: to or by falsehood, vanity. Root b-ṭ-l.
usage: Opposed to حق 'truth', as in اقبال بباطل 'turning to falsehood'.

definition: Persian bi plus baḥr: to or into the sea, ocean. Root b-ḥ-r.
Preposition bi- 'with' and بدترین 'worst', superlative of بد 'bad'.
Persian bi- 'with' plus burhán 'proof' plus indefinite -í: with a proof. Root b-r-h-n.
usage: برهان 'proof, testimony' is frequent in the Íqán beside دلیل and حجّت.

definition: Preposition bi- plus bisáṭ 'carpet, spread; court, presence'. Root b-s-ṭ.
usage: As in بساط قدس 'the court of holiness' and بساط قرب 'the court of nearness'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with, by' + bishárat 'good news, glad tidings'. Root b-sh-r.
Bi- 'with' plus baṣar 'sight, eye': with the eye. Root b-ṣ-r.
bi- with ba‘ḍ: in some, in part of. Root b-‘-ḍ.
usage: Used in the Persian Hidden Words address ای پسر رماد, literally 'O son of ashes'.

definition: Preposition bi- with tadbír: planning, contriving, scheming. Root d-b-r.
usage: In the Íqán تدبیر و ریا 'scheming and hypocrisy' of the divines.

definition: Ba/bi "with, to" + turáb "dust, earth". Root t-r-b.
usage: HW: بتراب فانی قانع شده 'content with perishable dust'.

definition: Preposition bi with taṣdíq 'confirming, acknowledging as true'. Root ṣ-d-q.
usage: In the Íqán: منوط بتصدیق 'dependent upon recognition' of the Manifestation.

definition: Preposition ب with تفصیل 'detailed exposition': in detail. Root f-ṣ-l.
Preposition bi- with tanzíl: by the sending down, revelation. Root n-z-l.
usage: Tanzíl is the sending down of divine verses.

definition: Persian bi- 'to' plus Arabic thamar 'fruit': bi-thamar ámadan or rasídan 'to bear fruit, ripen'.
usage: 'To fruit'; in بثمر رسیدن 'to bear fruit', of deeds or the tree of existence yielding results.

definition: Preposition bi- "to, by" plus jabarút, the realm of divine power, the Dominion. Root j-b-r.
usage: To the Dominion; jabarút is the realm of divine power, between malakút and láhút.

definition: Preposition bi- with dual janáḥay "two wings" (construct state). Root j-n-ḥ.
usage: 'On two wings', an image of the soul's flight, e.g. soaring on the wings of detachment.
notes: bi-janáḥayi’l-íqán "on the two wings of certitude".

definition: Phrase bi + junún "madness, insanity". Root j-n-n.
usage: Madness; the Manifestations were accused of madness by their peoples, as the Íqán recounts.
notes: nisbat bi-junún dádan to impute madness.

definition: Preposition bi- with jawhar: with the essence, substance or jewel (of).
usage: Jawhar 'essence, substance, gem'; e.g. the essence of a thing or jewel-like hearts.

definition: bi- 'by, with' + ḥijáb 'veil, covering'. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: By a veil; حجاب is the barrier of self, learning or idle fancy that hides the truth.

definition: Preposition bi- + ḥujubát, plural of ḥujub 'veils'. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: 'By veils', the veils (حجبات) of learning, attachment and imitation that hide the truth.

definition: bi + ḥudúdát (Persian double plural of ḥadd): limits, conventions. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: By limitations, human conventions which veil people from Truth.

definition: Preposition bi + plural of ḥarf 'word, talk' with izáfih: to the words (talk) of. Root ḥ-r-f.
usage: Words or talk, often idle talk of men set against the Word of God.

definition: Prepositional phrase: according to, in respect of; bi-ḥasab-i ẓáhir 'outwardly'. Root ḥ-s-b.
usage: Common in بحسب ظاهر 'outwardly, in appearance'.

definition: Preposition bi + ḥusbán 'reckoning, computation'. Root ḥ-s-b.
usage: The Qur'anic verse الشّمس و القمر بحسبان (55:5), which the Íqán applies to the Manifestations.
notes: In the Persian sentence read bi-ḥusbán.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with khák 'dust, earth': to the dust, to the ground.
usage: Mortality and humility, as in بخاک راجع فرمایم 'unto dust shall I return thee'.

definition: Proper noun: Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon who destroyed Jerusalem.
Verb, imperative of khirámídan: walk gracefully, stride, proceed with elegance.
Preposition بـ with دخان 'smoke'. Root d-kh-n.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse یوم تأتی السّماء بدخان مبین 'the day when the heaven shall give out a palpable smoke', interpreted in the Íqán.

definition: Adjective: new, originated, primal; pertaining to fresh creation. Root b-d-‘.
usage: بروز بدعیه 'new and wondrous emergence' of the Manifestation.
notes: Rendering inferred; exact wording in the authorized Íqán not confirmed.

definition: Persian bi plus dalíl "proof, guide" with indefinite -í: by or to a proof. Root d-l-l.
Noun: body. Root b-d-n.
Persian bi- 'to' plus dunyá, the world, this present life. Root d-n-w.
usage: دنیا in the Writings is the world of self and attachment, set against the hereafter.

definition: Verb, passive of bada’a 'to begin, originate': was begun, came into being. Root b-d-’.
usage: In the Íqán و منها بدئت الممکنات 'and from it all created things were originated'.
notes: Written بدئت.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with, in' + ráḥat 'rest, comfort, ease'. Root r-w-ḥ.
Subjunctive of bar-ávardan 'to raise, utter': (that/if) they raise (a cry).
usage: In the Íqán of the Manifestations voicing claims: ندای ... برآرند 'should they raise the call'.

definition: bi- with rabb: by or to the Lord. Root r-b-b.
usage: Oath فلا اقسم برب المشارق و المغارب 'I swear by the Lord of the East and the West'; in Persian بربّ الارباب 'to the Lord of lords'.

definition: Verb, imperative of barbastan: shut, close, bind up.
usage: In the Hidden Words چشمی بربند و چشمی برگشا 'Close one eye and open the other'.

definition: Past 3pl of برخاستن "to rise up, stand up": they arose.
usage: As in برای جانان برخاستند 'they arose for the sake of the Beloved'.

definition: Indefinite pronoun or adjective: some, a few, certain ones.
Persian verb برخاستن 'rise up', imperative: arise.
Preposition bi- with ridá’: mantle, robe, cloak. Root r-d-y.
usage: Figurative, as in ردآء التقوی 'the robe of godliness'.

definition: Present subjunctive, third person singular, of bar-dáshtan 'to lift, remove, take': (that) he remove or take.
usage: '(That) he take away, lift'; as in removing the veils from eyes or lifting a burden.

definition: Preposition bi- plus ridá "cloak, robe, mantle" (here with izáfih). Root r-d-y.
usage: With the robe; ridá 'cloak, mantle', used figuratively of robes of honour or virtue.

definition: Preposition bi- with risálat "messengership, mission". Root r-s-l.
usage: Messengership or mission of a Manifestation of God.
notes: mab‘úth bi-risálat raised up with a mission.

definition: Phrase bi + rashḥ "sprinkling, drop" + indefinite -í: by a drop. Root r-sh-ḥ.
usage: A drop or sprinkling, as of a drop from the ocean of divine knowledge; رشحات is a common image of grace.

definition: Imperative 2nd sing. of raftan with bi-: go!
notes: Could elsewhere be bar ú (upon him).

definition: Imperative of bar-gushádan: open (up).
usage: Open; e.g. open the eye or the tongue.

definition: Noun: desert, wilderness. Root b-r-r.
usage: 'Wilderness', as in فی بریّة یهودا 'in the wilderness of Judaea', in quotations about John the Baptist.
notes: 'fí barríyyati Yahúdá' in the wilderness of Judaea. Distinct from bariyyah 'creation'.

definition: Adjective (poetic): highest, supreme; "firdaws-i barín" the highest paradise.
usage: Highest, supreme; in فردوس برین "the highest paradise".

definition: Noun from buzurg 'great': greatness, grandeur.
usage: Greatness or grandeur, of God or of the Cause; also worldly grandeur.

definition: Noun bisáṭ 'carpet, spread, couch' with -ka 'thy'. Root b-s-ṭ.
usage: Also بساط قرب 'the court of nearness', the presence of God.

definition: Persian bi- 'to' + surádiq 'pavilion, great tent, tabernacle'.
usage: سرادق قرب 'the pavilion of nearness'; سرادق غیب 'the tabernacle of the unseen'.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with salṭanat 'sovereignty, dominion'. Root s-l-ṭ.
usage: Earthly against divine sovereignty, as in سلطنت فانیه 'fleeting sovereignty'.

definition: Preposition bi 'to' with samá' 'heaven, sky'. Root s-m-w.
usage: Figurative heavens, as سماء عز 'heaven of glory'.

definition: Verb, present subjunctive 3rd sing. of súzándan: burn, consume (with fire).
Preposition بـ with سیاط, plural of sawṭ 'whip, scourge'. Root s-w-ṭ.
usage: In the Aqdas بسیاط الحکمة و الأحکام 'with the scourges of wisdom and laws'.

definition: Verb, imperative of شتافتن: hasten, hurry. Persian.
usage: بکویش بشتابید 'hasten unto His street'.

definition: Persian bi plus sharaf: with or to the honour of. Root sh-r-f.
usage: بشرف لقا مشرّف شدن "to attain the honour of the presence".

shift: Here: to the stream, the watering place one is called to. Today: shari'a, religious law (شریعت).
definition: Preposition bi- with sharí‘ih, literally a watering place or path to water; usually religious law. Root sh-r-‘.
usage: Usually 'law, Dispensation' (شریعت); here in its literal sense, a stream or shore one is called to.
notes: Here literal: شریعهٔ قرب 'the stream of nearness'; exact authorized rendering not confirmed.

definition: Imperative 2nd person singular of shinídan 'to hear', with prefix bi-: hear, listen.
usage: In the Hidden Words a call to attention, پس بشنو 'hearken then'.

definition: Verb, 3rd singular present subjunctive of shinídan 'to hear'.
Imperative 2nd plural of shanídan 'to hear': hear ye, hearken.
Bi- 'to' plus plural of ṣaḥrá 'open plain, field' in construct.
bi- with ḍiyá': with or by light, radiance. Root ḍ-w-'.
usage: In the Íqán ضیاء is the light of the sun, from Qur'an 10:5 الشمس ضیاء.

definition: Verbal noun: falsity, invalidity, nullity. Root b-ṭ-l.
usage: In استدلال بر بطلان 'arguing the falsity' of the Manifestation.

definition: Belly, womb; inner part, hidden meaning. Root b-ṭ-n.
usage: In the Hidden Words بطن امّ 'thy mother's womb'; elsewhere the inner meaning of verses.

definition: Verbal noun: being hidden, inwardness; also plural of baṭn 'womb, inner part'. Root b-ṭ-n.
usage: Paired with ظهور: سماء بطون 'the heaven of concealment'; بطون الله 'the hidden essence of God'.

definition: Preposition ب with ظنّ 'supposition, conjecture'. Root ẓ-n-n.
usage: Íqán: علم بظنّ تبدیل گردد 'knowledge be turned into conjecture'.

definition: Noun: sending forth, the beginning of a Prophet's mission; also resurrection. Root b-‘-th.
usage: The declaration of a Prophet's mission; with رجعت, the return and resurrection.

definition: In min ba‘dihim: ba‘d 'after' (genitive after min) plus -him 'them (masculine)'. Root b-‘-d.
Preposition bi- plus ‘adháb "torment, punishment" with indefinite -í. Root ‘-dh-b.
usage: With a torment; ‘adháb is divine punishment.

definition: Preposition bi- with ‘ulamá "learned men, divines" (izáfih form). Root ‘-l-m.
usage: The divines or clerics, often criticized in the Kitáb-i-Íqán for rejecting the Manifestation.

definition: Phrase bi + ‘ulúm (plural of ‘ilm): with sciences, branches of learning. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Sciences or learning; the Íqán contrasts the acquired learning of the divines with divine knowledge.

definition: Preposition bi- with ‘ahd: (fulfil) the covenant, pledge. Root ‘-h-d.
usage: 'Ahd 'covenant'; in Bahá'í usage the Covenant (عهد و میثاق), as in اوفوا بعهدی 'fulfil My covenant'.
notes: Awfá bi-: to fulfil.

definition: bi- 'to, into' + ‘aválim, plural of ‘álam 'world, realm'. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Into the worlds or realms, as in عوالم الهی 'the divine worlds'.

definition: Proper noun: Baghdad, capital of Iraq, called Dár as-Salám; where the Íqán was revealed.
usage: Baghdad, called دار السلام 'the Abode of Peace', where Bahá'u'lláh lived in exile (1853-63), revealed the Íqán and the Hidden Words, and declared His mission.

definition: bi + ghamám (clouds). Root gh-m-m.
usage: Clouds; the Íqán explains "coming in the clouds" as signs that veil the Manifestation.

definition: Noun: transgression, oppression, wrongdoing. Root b-gh-y.
usage: Transgression and oppression, as in بغی و طغیان 'transgression and rebellion'.

definition: Preposition bi- plus ghíbat 'backbiting, speaking ill of the absent'. Root gh-y-b.
usage: Strongly forbidden in the Hidden Words: بغیبت میالائید 'defile it not with detraction'.
