notes: Distinguish ghaybat 'absence, occultation'.

definition: Persian bi- 'by, in, to' + fi‘l 'deed, action; (grammar) verb'. Root f-‘-l.
usage: Paired with قول: از قول بفعل 'from word to deed'; also بفعل ماضی 'in the past tense'.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with falak 'celestial sphere, heaven'. Root f-l-k.
usage: Íqán: Jesus ascending بفلک چهارم 'to the fourth heaven'.

definition: Preposition bi 'with' and qadam 'foot, step'. Root q-d-m.
usage: Also figurative step on the spiritual path, as قدم گذاشتن 'to set foot'.

definition: Preposition bi with qalam: with or by the pen. Root q-l-m.
usage: القلم الأعلی 'the Most Exalted Pen' is the Pen of Bahá'u'lláh's Revelation.
notes: In idáfa read bi-qalami.

definition: Preposition بـ with قول 'saying, word' and 'his'. Root q-w-l.
usage: Introduces scriptural quotations, as in بقوله تعالی 'with His words, exalted be He'.

definition: Preposition ب with qiyámat: to or in the Day of Resurrection. Root q-w-m.
usage: The Íqán explains قیامت 'the Resurrection' as the advent of the new Manifestation.

definition: Persian bi plus lá-makán "placelessness": to the placeless realm beyond space.
usage: In the Writings لامکان is the spiritual realm beyond all place, as in لامکان الهی "the divine placeless realm".

definition: Plural of balá 'trial, affliction': tribulations, calamities; the final ی links the izáfih. Root b-l-w.
usage: In the Writings the tribulations borne by the Manifestations, as in بلایای لاتحصی 'countless afflictions'.

definition: Noun balá’ 'trial, affliction, calamity' with -í: My trial, My calamity. Root b-l-w.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words بلائی عنایتی 'My calamity is My providence'.
notes: Spelled بلائی; the search form writes ئ as ی.

definition: Noun: town, land, country. Root b-l-d.
usage: Echoes the Qur'anic بلدة طیّبة 'a goodly land', as in بلدهٔ طیّبه.

definition: Preposition bi- 'for, with, by' + Arabic má’ 'water'. Root m-w-h.
Bi- plus mathába 'degree, place': like, as, in the manner of. Root th-w-b.
Adverbial phrase: as soon as, merely by, upon. Root j-r-d.
Preposition bi- 'by' with murabbí 'educator, nurturer'. Root r-b-b.
usage: In the oath قسم بمربّی وجود 'By Him Who educateth all being'.

shift: Here: the goal, the object of desire (مقصود). Today: a topic, subject or article.
definition: Ba/bi "to" + maṭlab "aim, object of desire, goal". Root ṭ-l-b.
usage: HW: ناطلبیده بمطلب 'without seeking hast attained the goal'.
notes: In modern Persian مطلب usually means "topic, matter".

definition: Preposition bi with maẓhar 'place of appearance, manifestation'. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: مظهر in the Writings is the Manifestation of God, as in مظهر نفس او 'the Manifestation of His Self'.

definition: Preposition ب with معانی 'meanings, inner senses'. Root ‘-n-y.
usage: عارف بمعانی 'knowing the meanings of'.

definition: Preposition bi- with mafátíḥ, plural of miftáḥ: with or by keys. Root f-t-ḥ.
bi- 'to, of' plus maqṣúd 'aim, purpose, intended meaning', passive participle of qaṣada. Root q-ṣ-d.
usage: 'To the purpose, intended meaning'; in the Íqán of reaching the true meaning of scripture.

definition: Preposition bi- plus munásabat "relation, fitness": in keeping with, on account of. Root n-s-b.
usage: According to, on account of; ordinary expression.

definition: Preposition bi- with manzila "rank, station": in the position of, like, as. Root n-z-l.
usage: 'As, like, in the position of', a common comparative phrase.
notes: bi-manzilih-yi shams like unto the sun.

definition: Verb, present subjunctive 3rd person singular of bastan: (he) binds, ties; iḥrám bastan to don the pilgrim's garb.
usage: To bind or tie; in compounds such as احرام بستن 'to don the pilgrim's garb' and دل بستن 'to set one's heart on'.

definition: Noun: servant, slave, bondsman; also a humble way of saying I.
usage: Servant or bondsman, especially of God (بندهٔ خدا); also a humble substitute for 'I'.
notes: Ay bandih-yi man = O My servant.

definition: bi- + hádhihi 'this' (fem. demonstrative).
Preposition bi- + halákat 'destruction, perdition'. Root h-l-k.
usage: 'Into perdition', of those who cast themselves into ruin by turning from God.

definition: bi + hamán (that very, the same).
Preposition bi + hayákil, plural of haykal 'temple, form, body'. Root h-k-l.
usage: Temples or bodies; the Manifestations are the هیاکل 'temples' of God, and the Temple (هیکل) is a theme of the Writings.

definition: Preposition bi- plus hích 'any, none': in no (way), by no (means); with negative verbs.
usage: Common in بهیچوجه 'in no wise'.

definition: Preposition bi + wáḥida 'one' (feminine).
Preposition bi- with wujúh, plural of wajh: with faces. Root w-j-h.
usage: Aqdas: بوجوه بیضاء 'with radiant (white) faces'.

definition: Imperative of parídan 'to fly, soar'.
Preposition bi with kitáb and indefinite -í: in or to a book. Root k-t-b.
usage: کتاب in the Writings is most often the revealed Book of God.

definition: Noun: virgin, maiden; also first-born. Root b-k-r.
usage: In the Aqdas of taking a maid into one's service.

definition: Preposition ب with Ka‘ba: toward the Kaaba in Mecca.
usage: The change of the qibla from Jerusalem to the Kaaba, cited in the Íqán as a test.

definition: Persian bi plus kawthar, the river of Paradise: to the heavenly stream. Root k-th-r.
usage: کوثر is a frequent image of divine grace, as in کوثر زلال "the crystal stream".

definition: Preposition bi- with kaynúnat 'being, essence'. Root k-w-n.
usage: A philosophical term for the very being of God, as in بکینونت خود 'in His own Essence'.

definition: Imperative 2nd person singular of gudhashtan 'to pass': pass on, pass beyond, give up.
usage: In the Hidden Words از نفس بگذر 'pass beyond self'.

definition: Preposition bi- plus gulhá 'flowers, roses' with izáfih.
usage: Mystical roses, as in گلهای بعد 'flowers of remoteness' and گلهای قرب 'flowers of nearness'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'to, with' + gúsh 'ear'.
Present subjunctive of guftan 'to say': (that) I say.
Subjunctive of گفتن 'to say': (that, if) they say.
Verb, present subjunctive 2nd person singular of áshámídan: that thou drink.
usage: In the Hidden Words تا خمر بقا از عین فنا بیاشامی 'that thou mayest quaff the wine of immortality from the fountain of evanescence'.

definition: Without measure, boundless, immeasurable (bí "without" + andázih "measure").
usage: As in روح بی‌اندازه 'boundless spirit'.

definition: Noun bayán 'utterance, exposition' with the copula -ast 'is'. Root b-y-n.
usage: بیان is utterance or discourse; also the title of the Báb's Book.

definition: Persian verb آمدن 'come', present subjunctive: that they come.
Plural of bí-khabar: the uninformed, unaware, heedless ones.
Persian bí- 'without' plus dalíl 'guide, proof': unguided; without proof or reason.
usage: 'Without guide or proof'; of unfounded claims or souls left unguided.

definition: Adjective: weary of, disgusted with, averse to (az).
usage: Weary of, averse to; as in being weary of the world.

definition: Adjective, feminine/plural of abyaḍ: white, bright, radiant; "wujúh bíḍá’" radiant faces. Root b-y-ḍ.
usage: White or radiant, as in Qur'anic یوم تبیض وجوه 'the day when faces shall be white', and the 'white hand' of Moses.
notes: Diptote; genitive ends in -a.

definition: Adjective (feminine of abyaḍ): white, shining; yad-i bayḍá the radiant hand of Moses. Root b-y-ḍ.
usage: In ید بیضا 'the White Hand' of Moses, a miracle the Writings treat as a symbol of the Manifestation's power.
notes: Final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Verbal noun: selling, sale, trade. Root b-y-‘.
usage: Selling or trade, paired with شراء 'buying' in counsels about commerce.

definition: Imperative of afshándan: scatter, sprinkle, sow.
usage: Scatter, sprinkle; e.g. scatter seeds or shed light.

definition: Adjective: without end, boundless; bí 'without' + Arabic muntahá 'limit'. Root n-h-y.
usage: 'Boundless', used of God's infinite grace and of the endless worlds of God.

definition: Adjective: without share, deprived, bereft (bí "without" + naṣíb "portion").
usage: Deprived, bereft; of those who miss their share of divine grace.

definition: Plural of bí-naṣíb (bí 'without' + naṣíb 'portion'): those without a share, the deprived.
usage: Those deprived of a share, used of souls deprived of divine bounty.
notes: Written بی‌نصیبان.

definition: Present stem bín- of dídan 'to see': ye see, ye behold.
Noun: fatherlessness (bí 'without' + pidar 'father' + -í).
usage: In the Íqán of Jesus, reproached by His people as fatherless.

definition: Active participle: leaving, abandoning; one who forsakes. Root t-r-k.
usage: Hadith: انّی تارک فیکم الثّقلین 'I leave among you two weighty things'.

definition: Verbal noun form II: interpretation, inner meaning, with pronoun 'its'. Root '-w-l.
usage: From the Qur'anic verse و ما یعلم تأویله الا الله 'none knoweth its interpretation but God'.

definition: Verb, form VIII imperfect 2nd masc. sing.: thou seekest, desirest. Root b-gh-y.
Verb: thou leavest, abandonest; with لا, 'neglect not'. Root t-r-k.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: لا تترک اوامری 'neglect not My commandments'.

definition: Verb, form VI imperfect: they fall one after another. Root s-q-ṭ.
usage: The Gospel verse الکواکب تتساقط من السماء 'the stars shall fall from heaven'.

definition: Form V of f-k-r: to reflect, ponder; second plural "ye reflect". Root f-k-r.
usage: In the formula لو انتم تتفکّرون "if ye would but ponder".

definition: Verb: 'they are exchanged as gifts', form VI of h-d-y.
Verbal noun of form VI tajáwaza: going beyond, overstepping, transgression. Root j-w-z.
notes: In the Aqdas الّذی تجاوز عنها it is the verb tajáwaza 'whoso overstepped it'.

definition: Verb, 2nd singular subjunctive of wajada 'to find'. Root w-j-d.
usage: In the Hidden Words لن تجد 'thou shalt never find'.

definition: Imperfect of form VIII iḥtája 'to need, require'. Root ḥ-w-j.
Form V verb: it was delimited, became fixed or determined. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: In the Aqdas of the times of prayer fixed by clocks and of the months: تحدّدت الأوقات.

definition: Verb, jussive after lá: (do not) deprive, withhold. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words لا تحرم نصیبک 'Deprive not thyself of thy share'; لا تحرم وجه عبدی 'turn not away thy face from My servant'.

definition: Verb, form V, past 3rd person singular: it moved, stirred. Root ḥ-r-k.
usage: In the Aqdas of the Pen: اذا تحرّک فاحت نسمة اللّه 'when it moveth, the breeze of God is wafted'.

definition: Taḥríf "alteration, corruption of a text" + ast "is". Form II verbal noun, root ḥ-r-f.
usage: In the Íqán Bahá'u'lláh argues that the taḥríf of scripture means misinterpretation, not alteration of the text.

definition: Jussive 2nd person singular feminine of ḥazina 'to grieve'; with لا a prohibition. Root ḥ-z-n.
usage: Addressed to Ṭihrán in the Aqdas: یا ارض الطاء لا تحزنی 'O Land of Ṭá, grieve thou not'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): you (pl.) guard, protect. Root ḥ-f-ẓ.
usage: Aqdas: کما تحفظون ابنائکم 'even as ye protect your own sons'.

definition: Jussive 2pl of ḥamala used with lá: do not load, burden. Root ḥ-m-l.
usage: Aqdas: لا تحملوا علی الحیوان ما یعجز عن حمله 'burden not an animal with more than it can bear'.

definition: Imperfect of form VIII ikhtára 'to choose': thou choosest, or she chooseth. Root kh-y-r.
usage: 'Thou choosest'; as in the Hidden Words 'choose thou for thyself what I have chosen for thee'.
notes: Second person masculine in the Íqán; third feminine in the Aqdas.

definition: Verb: jussive of kháfa "to fear"; lá takhaf "fear not". Root kh-w-f.
usage: Fear; in lá takhaf 'fear not', the reassurance given to Moses and other Prophets.

definition: Noun tukhm "seed" with plural -há (and izáfih): the seeds of.
usage: Seeds, often figurative of seeds of love, wisdom or faith sown in the heart.

definition: Verb, imperative (form V): consider, ponder, reflect upon. Root d-b-r.
usage: Reflect, ponder; an invitation to meditate deeply on God's verses.
notes: In Persian contexts the verbal noun tadabbur "reflection".

definition: Verbal noun (form II): planning, contrivance, scheme, management. Root d-b-r.
usage: Planning or scheming; of human stratagems set against God's decree (تدبیر vs. تقدیر).

definition: Verb form IV imperfect 3rd fem. sing. + -hu: perceives, attains Him. Root d-r-k.
usage: To perceive, attain; of God Whom no vision perceives (لا تدرکه الابصار, Qur'án 6:103).
notes: Quranic lá tudrikuhu’l-abṣár 'No vision taketh in Him'.

definition: Verbal noun (form V) 'waiting' with suffix -há 'her': her period of waiting. Root r-b-ṣ.
usage: 'Her waiting', in the Aqdas laws on a widow's or divorced woman's waiting period and the year of patience (ایّام تربّص).

definition: Verb, Form VIII imperfect subjunctive 2nd plural: (that) ye commit. Root r-k-b.
usage: To commit (a sin or deed); used in prohibitions in the Aqdas.
notes: Iyyákum an tartakibú: beware lest ye commit.

definition: Verbal noun (form II): preferring; tarjíḥ dádan 'to prefer'. Root r-j-ḥ.
usage: Preferring one thing over another, as in ترجیح دادن 'to prefer'.

definition: Present of ra’á 'to see' with -hu 'it': ye see it. Root r-’-y.
usage: In the Aqdas کما ترونه الیوم 'as ye see it this day'.

definition: Verbal noun: combining, composition, putting together. Root r-k-b.
Arabic verb, imperfect dual of zála: they two pass away, vanish. Root z-w-l.
usage: Of transient states and heaven and earth: السّماء و الأرض تزولان 'heaven and earth shall pass away'.

definition: Verb form V: to adorn oneself, be adorned. Root z-y-n.
usage: Being adorned with divine attributes or virtues, as تزین بخصالی 'adorned with My attributes'.

definition: Verb, form X subjunctive 2nd pl.: that ye use, employ. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: In the Aqdas ایّاکم ان تستعملوا 'beware lest ye use'.

definition: Numeral: nine. Root t-s-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas تسع رکعات 'nine rak‘ahs' of obligatory prayer; nine is significant as the number of Bahá.

definition: Verb, form I imperfect: you hear. Root s-m-‘.
usage: اما تسمعون صریر قلمی الأعلی 'Hear ye not the shrill voice of My Most Exalted Pen?'.

definition: Form III of sh-h-d: to witness, behold; second singular subjunctive. Root sh-h-d.
Verbal noun: clinging, holding fast; تشبّث نمودن 'to cling to'. Root sh-b-th.
Imperfect 2nd person masculine singular of form VIII ishtaghala: be occupied, busy oneself (with bi-). Root sh-gh-l.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words لا تشتغل بالدنیا 'busy not thyself with this world'.
notes: After lá of prohibition it is jussive tashtaghil.

definition: Verb, form IV: to shine, rise, shed light. Root sh-r-q.
Imperfect 2nd plural of sha‘ara 'to perceive, be aware'. Root sh-‘-r.
usage: In the refrain لو انتم تشعرون 'if ye could but perceive it'.

definition: Imagining, conceiving, supposing. Root ṣ-w-r.
usage: In the Íqán تصوّر ننمائی 'think not'.

definition: Verb form VIII: to be agitated, troubled, disturbed. Root ḍ-r-b.
usage: Used in the Persian Hidden Words address ای پسر رماد, literally 'O son of ashes'.

definition: Verb, form VIII, present 2nd person plural: you become acquainted, perceive. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: In لعلّکم بمواقع الأمر تطّلعون 'that haply ye may apprehend the stations of the Cause'.

definition: Form IV imperfect: (it, fem.) grows dark. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: In the Gospel prophecy quoted in the Íqán: تظلم الشّمس 'shall the sun be darkened'.

definition: Jussive 2nd person plural of form VIII i‘taraḍa 'to object, oppose' (with ‘alá). Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: لا تعترضوا علیه 'do not oppose Him' of Him Whom God shall make manifest.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): you (sg.) know. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: In a tradition: أ تعرف الزّوراء 'knowest thou Zawrá?'

definition: Verbal noun: glorifying, honouring, venerating. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
Imperfect passive of form II ‘ammara 'to build, make prosper, inhabit': is built up, made to flourish. Root ‘-m-r.
usage: 'Is built up, made to flourish'; used of lands and cities prospering.

definition: Verbal noun (form V): living, making a living, enjoying life. Root ‘-y-sh.
usage: Living, enjoying life; of worldly ease and luxury.

pos: verb 3sg fem. impf. energetic + pron. suffix
definition: Verb gharra "to deceive", energetic imperfect 3rd feminine singular with -kum: (lest it) deceive you. Root gh-r-r.
usage: Used in warnings that the world or its vanities must not delude you.
notes: iyyákum an taghurrannakumu’d-dunyá beware lest the world deceive you.

definition: Verb (form V) of singing: to sing, warble. Root gh-n-y.
usage: To sing or warble, of the Nightingale or Dove of revelation singing the melodies of God.
notes: Reading uncertain: the spelling تغنّ with subject ḥamámatu'l-baqá’ fits neither a regular past nor imperfect form.

definition: Verb (form I, 2nd pl. jussive) of fariḥa: rejoice, exult. Root f-r-ḥ.
usage: Of rejoicing, as in counsels not to exult over what one has gained.
notes: Lá tafraḥú = Rejoice not.

definition: Verbal noun form II: separating, dividing; with namúdan 'to separate'. Root f-r-q.
usage: Separation, distinguishing between the Manifestations of God, which the Íqán warns against.

definition: Verb, imperfect subjunctive form IV 2nd person plural: to cause corruption, spread disorder. Root f-s-d.
usage: 'To spread corruption', in the command ایّاکم ان تفسدوا فی الارض 'beware lest ye spread disorder in the land'.
notes: After an in 'iyyákum an tufsidú' beware lest ye.

definition: Verb, Form I imperfect jussive 2nd sing.: you do (after in "if"). Root f-‘-l.
Imperfect of faniya 'to pass away, perish': lá tafná 'that perish not'. Root f-n-y.
usage: Passing away, as in لا تفنی 'that perisheth not', of imperishable dominion or treasure; related to فنا 'annihilation' in mystical usage.

definition: Present subjunctive of waqa‘a 'to fall, befall, happen': it may fall. Root w-q-‘.
Noun: piety, fear of God, godliness. Root w-q-y.
usage: Piety joined with deeds: تقوای خالص 'pure piety'; Arabic بالبرّ و التّقوی 'righteousness and the fear of God'.
notes: Final ی is the izáfih glide (taqvá-yi khális).

definition: Noun: piety, fear of God, godliness. Root w-q-y.
usage: As in نور تقی 'the light of godliness' and جوهر التّقی 'the essence of piety'.

definition: Verb: to cover, confuse, clothe (truth with falsehood). Root l-b-s.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse لم تلبسون الحق بالباطل 'why clothe ye the truth with falsehood'.

definition: Verbal noun of form II in the adverbial accusative: allusively, by hint. Root l-w-ḥ.
Verb: that ye withhold, prevent, deprive. Root m-n-‘.
usage: In warnings such as ایّاکم ان تمنعوا انفسکم 'beware lest ye deprive yourselves'.

definition: Verb, form VII imperfect: is attracted, is drawn. Root j-dh-b.
usage: Of hearts drawn to God, as in تنجذب به الافئدة 'whereby hearts are attracted'.

definition: Passive of naṣaba, to set up, raise: is set up, planted. Root n-ṣ-b.
usage: In the Aqdas of banners raised, as in تنصب اعلام النّصر "the standards of victory are planted".

definition: Verb: 'ye look, behold', imperfect 2pl of naẓara. Root n-ẓ-r.
Imperfect of form VII inqalaba: to be turned over, overturned, changed; to turn. Root q-l-b.
usage: In the Aqdas سوف تنقلب فیک الامور 'erelong the state of affairs within thee will be changed'.

definition: Verb, 3rd singular present of tavánistan 'to be able': can.
Imperative plural of tába 'to repent, turn back (to God)'. Root t-w-b.
usage: In the Aqdas, توبوا الی اللّه 'Turn ye unto God in repentance', confession to God alone.

definition: Birth, being born. Root w-l-d.
usage: In the Íqán of the birth of Jesus: تولّد عیسی.

definition: Verb form II: you turn (your faces). Root w-l-y.
usage: Qur'an 2:115 فأینما تولوا فثم وجه الله 'whithersoever ye turn, there is the face of God'.

definition: Verb, form V imperative plural: rely, put your trust. Root w-k-l.
usage: In the Aqdas توکّلوا علی اللّه 'put your trust in God'.

definition: Pride, arrogance, haughtiness. Form V verbal noun, root k-b-r.
usage: As in ثوب تکبّر 'the robe of pride'.

definition: Imperfect 2nd person plural of kafara 'to disbelieve, deny'. Root k-f-r.
usage: In Qur'anic quotations: لم تکفرون بآیات الله 'why disbelieve ye in the signs of God'.

definition: Verbal noun: declaring someone an unbeliever; also expiation of sins. Root k-f-r.
usage: In the Íqán the divines' denunciation of Prophets as infidels: تکفیر نمایند.

definition: Noun: trackless desert, wilderness where one strays. Root t-y-h.
usage: Figurative, as in تیه جهل 'the wilderness of ignorance'.

definition: Feminine of thábit 'firm, established, proven', with Arabic agreement in Persian. Root th-b-t.
usage: 'Firm, established'; in phrases like حجت ثابته 'established proof'.

definition: Noun: weight, burden; also precious thing, as in the hadith of the two weighty things (thaqalayn). Root th-q-l.
usage: Weight, burden; also the 'weighty things' (thaqalayn) of the hadith.
notes: Here thiql-i a‘ẓam/akbar seems to mean the Qur’án; reading thiql vs thaqal not confirmed.

definition: Numeral: three. Root th-l-th.
notes: asfár-i thaláthih the three other Gospels.

definition: Noun, plural of thamara: fruits; results. Root th-m-r.
usage: Fruits; often figurative, the fruits of the tree of existence, of faith or of deeds.

definition: Verb (form I perfect, fem.) of já'a: she or it came. Root j-y-'.
usage: She or it came, as in 'the Hour has come'.
notes: Qur'ánic perfect with future sense.

shift: Here: all-embracing, comprehensive, as in کلمهٔ جامعه. Today: society.
definition: Active participle (fem.): comprehensive, all-embracing, uniting. Root j-m-‘.
usage: All-embracing, comprehensive, as in کلمهٔ جامعه 'the all-embracing Word'; in modern Persian جامعه means 'society'.

definition: Noun: garment, robe, clothing, dress; jámih-yi ghurúr the garment of vainglory.
usage: 'Garment, robe', often figurative, as in جامهٴ غرور 'the garment of vainglory' to be cast off.
notes: Final ٴ marks the izáfih.

definition: Persian plural of jáhil: the ignorant. Root j-h-l.
usage: The ignorant, those without knowledge of God.

definition: Active participle jáhil 'ignorant' with indefinite -í: an ignorant person. Root j-h-l.
usage: Ignorant one; the Writings set the ignorant against the learned and the true seeker.

definition: Noun: compulsion, force, coercion; in theology predestination. Root j-b-r.
usage: In the Íqán paired with ظلم: ظلم و جبر 'oppression and tyranny'.

definition: Adjective: barren, dry, unproductive (of land). Root j-r-z.
usage: In the Íqán اراضی جرزه 'barren lands' of the heart, opposed to the fertile soil of pure hearts.

definition: Adjective (from jarí'): bold, daring; with نمودن 'to embolden'. Root j-r-'.
usage: Hidden Words: بردباری من شما را جری نمود 'My forbearance hath emboldened you'.

definition: Arabic verb, perfect: flowed, ran; proceeded, came to pass. Root j-r-y.
usage: Of revelation flowing from the Pen: ما جری من القلم 'what hath flowed from the Pen'.

definition: Verbal noun jarayán 'flowing, course' with copula ast: is flowing, is current.
Noun, plural of jazírah: islands, isles. Root j-z-r.
usage: In the Íqán فی جزائر علم الفرقان 'in the isles of the knowledge of the Qur'an'.

definition: Noun: boldness, daring, audacity. Root j-s-r.
usage: جسارت نمودن 'to presume, dare'.

definition: Verb, past of جستن: sought, looked for; also leapt. Persian.
usage: استمداد جست 'sought help'; انحراف جسته 'turned away'.

definition: Relative adjective from jasad "body": bodily, physical, corporeal. Root j-s-d.
Verb ja‘ala 'he made, appointed' with -há 'it/her'. Root j-‘-l.
Perfect 3rd person masculine singular of ja‘ala 'to make' with -ki: He hath made thee. Root j-‘-l.
usage: In the Aqdas, of Ṭihrán: قد جعلک الله مطلع فرح العالمین 'God hath made thee the source of the joy of mankind'.
notes: Feminine suffix because a land (Ṭihrán) is addressed.

definition: Noun: cruelty, harshness, unfaithfulness. Root j-f-w.
usage: In the Hidden Words بچنین دوست جفا مکنید 'deal not faithlessly with such a Friend'.

definition: Verbal noun of jalasa: sitting; enthronement. Root j-l-s.
Clear, evident, manifest; of script, bold. Root j-l-w.
usage: In the Hidden Words بخطّ جلیّ مسطور 'inscribed in clear letters' and قلم جلیّ.

definition: Noun jamál 'beauty' with the Persian suffix -am: my beauty. Root j-m-l.
usage: Persian Hidden Words کور شو تا جمالم بینی 'Be blind, that thou mayest behold My beauty'.

definition: Noun: wing; also side; in لا جناح 'no blame, no sin'. Root j-n-ḥ.
usage: In the Qur'anic خفض جناح 'lowering the wing' (humility); in the Aqdas لا جناح علیکم 'there is no blame on you'.

definition: Gardens, paradise; plural of janna. Root j-n-n.
usage: As in عندلیبان جنان 'the nightingales of paradise'.

definition: Noun: madness, insanity. Root j-n-n.
usage: Of the charge of madness levelled at the Prophets: نسبت جنون میدادند.

definition: Noun جهت 'direction, reason, respect' with indefinite ی: for some reason. Root w-j-h.
Adverbial accusative: openly, publicly. Root j-h-r.
usage: Paired as سرّاً و جهراً 'secretly and openly'.

definition: Noun: youth, the time of being young (javán plus abstract -í).
usage: 'Youth'; in exhortations to spend one's youth in God's service.
notes: In the second context javán plus indefinite -í: 'a youth'.

definition: Noun: hunger. Root j-w-‘.
usage: Hunger; ordinary noun, sometimes of spiritual hunger.

definition: Verb justan, imperative 2nd plural: seek ye.
usage: 'Seek ye', a call to search for the truth.

definition: Verb, present subjunctive 1st person plural of justan: (that) we seek; tamassuk justan to cling.
usage: In compounds such as تمسّک جستن 'to cling (to)'; justan 'to seek' also describes the seeker's search for truth.
notes: Written جوئیم.

definition: Interjection: God forbid! far be it! never!
usage: God forbid! Used to reject an unworthy suggestion, e.g. that God's grace could cease.

definition: Noun ḥálat 'state, condition' + indefinite -í; dar ḥálatí ki 'while'. Root ḥ-w-l.
usage: A state or condition; در حالتی که 'while'.

definition: Plural of ḥámil 'bearer, carrier'. Root ḥ-m-l.
usage: 'Bearers', as in حاملان امانت 'bearers of the trust'.

definition: Plural (accusative) of ḥákim: ruler, judge, one who decrees. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: Rulers, judges; in the formula خیر الحاکمین "the best of judges" of God.
notes: Inná kunná ḥákimín: We, verily, ordain (majestic plural).

definition: Active participle of ḥaká 'to relate, imitate': telling of, reflecting, indicative of. Root ḥ-k-y.
usage: Reflecting or telling of, as in حاکی از 'indicative of'.

definition: Noun: rope, cord; figuratively a bond or covenant. Root ḥ-b-l.
usage: Qur'anic حبل الله 'the cord of God'; in the Íqán حبل مستحکم 'a firm cord', of the divine law.

definition: Noun plural: seeds, grains (ḥabba + Persian plural -há). Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: حبّه‌های حکمت و علم 'the seeds of wisdom and knowledge'.

definition: Noun: proof, argument, testimony. Root ḥ-j-j.
usage: God's proof, as in تمّت حجّة اللّه 'the proof of God is fulfilled'; in Shí‘ih usage also a title of the Imám.

definition: Plural of ḥujjat: proofs, arguments, testimonies. Root ḥ-j-j.
usage: Divine proofs of a Revelation, as حجج الهیه 'divine proofs'.

definition: Noun: stone, rock. Root ḥ-j-r.
Verb: it happened, occurred, arose. Root ḥ-d-th.
usage: In conditional laws of the Aqdas: ان حدث بینهما کدورة 'should resentment arise between them'.

definition: Adjective: sharp, keen; as a noun, iron. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: بصر حدید 'keen sight', echoing Qur'an 50:22.

definition: Persian plural of ḥarf "letter, word": words, talk, sayings. Root ḥ-r-f.
notes: Final ی is the izáfih.

definition: Plural of ḥarf 'letter': letters. Root ḥ-r-f.
usage: As in حروف مقطّعه 'the disconnected letters' of the Qur'an and حروف حیّ 'the Letters of the Living'.

definition: Double plural (ḥurúf plus Persian -át) of ḥarf 'letter': letters; figuratively the chosen holy souls. Root ḥ-r-f.
usage: حروفات احدیّه 'the Letters of Unity' denote the holy souls, such as the Imams; cf. حروف حیّ 'Letters of the Living'.

definition: Noun: fortress, stronghold. Root ḥ-ṣ-n.
usage: God's protection, as in حصن حفظ 'the stronghold of His protection'.

definition: Noun ḥiṣn 'fortress, stronghold' with -í 'my'. Root ḥ-ṣ-n.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: حبّی حصنی 'My love is My stronghold'.

definition: Guarded, preserved; also a divine name, the Protector. Root ḥ-f-ẓ.
usage: In the Aqdas لوح حفیظ 'a Tablet preserved' (cf. اللّوح المحفوظ).

definition: Noun ḥaqq with -hi; فی حقه 'concerning him, with regard to him'. Root ḥ-q-q.
notes: Persian حُقّه 'casket' is unrelated.

definition: Noun: reality, truth, essence. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: In the Íqán حقیقة الحقائق 'the Reality of Realities', a title of the Manifestation.

definition: Ḥaqíqat "truth, reality" with -and "they are". Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: Here شمسهای حقیقتند 'they are Suns of Truth'.

definition: Noun: sweetness, delight. Root ḥ-l-w.
usage: حلاوة البیان 'the sweetness of the utterance' of God.

definition: Noun: dove, pigeon; in the Writings a symbol of the voice of Revelation. Root ḥ-m-m.
usage: Íqán: حمامهٔ ازلی 'the eternal Dove'.

definition: Adjective in accusative: wise, All-Wise. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: Qur'anic formula کان علی کل شئ حکیماً.

definition: Adjective: living, alive; al-Ḥayy 'the Ever-Living' as a divine name. Root ḥ-y-y.
usage: 'Living'; as the divine name الحی 'the Ever-Living', often in الحی القیوم.

definition: Noun: bewilderment, perplexity, astonishment. Root ḥ-y-r.
usage: Bewilderment, wonderment; in mystical usage the Valley of Wonderment (ḥayrat).

definition: Noun/interjection: pity, shame, a regrettable thing; "ḥayf ast" it is a pity.
usage: 'Pity', as in حیف است 'it is a pity', lamenting wasted opportunity.

definition: Adverb (from Arabic feminine kháṣṣa): especially, particularly. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
Active participle (accusative): humble, submissive, lowly. Root kh-ḍ-‘.
usage: Humble or submissive before God, e.g. standing in prayer kháḍi'an kháshi'an.
notes: Kun lí kháḍi‘an = Be humble before Me.

definition: Imperative masc. pl. of kháfa: fear ye. Root kh-w-f.
usage: 'Fear ye', as in خافوا الله 'fear God'.

definition: Adjective, feminine form: wicked, foul, malignant. Root kh-b-th.
usage: 'Wicked, foul', as in شجرهٴ خبیثه 'the evil tree', the Qur'anic image opposite the goodly tree.

definition: Adjective / divine name: well-informed, aware; al-Khabír the All-Informed. Root kh-b-r.
usage: Divine name الخبیر "the All-Informed", often paired with العلیم "the All-Knowing".

definition: Perfect third feminine singular of kharaja 'to go out, come forth'. Root kh-r-j.
usage: Used of a word or decree coming forth, as in خرجت من فمه 'came forth from His mouth'.

definition: Past of kharaqa: We tore, rent asunder, pierced. Root kh-r-q.
usage: In the Aqdas خرقنا الاحجاب 'We have rent the veils asunder'.

definition: Noun: sins, plural of khaṭí’a, with suffix -ka 'thy'. Root kh-ṭ-'.
usage: In the Íqán's Gospel quotation مغفورة خطایاک 'thy sins are forgiven thee'.

definition: Arabic verb, perfect 1st plural of khalaqa with -kum: We created you. Root kh-l-q.
usage: God speaking: خلقناکم من تراب واحد 'We created you all from the same dust'.

definition: Noun: close friend; الخلیل 'the Friend (of God)', title of Abraham. Root kh-l-l.
usage: Title of Abraham, as جمال خلیل 'the beauty of the Friend'.

definition: Numeral in the accusative: five; خمساً و تسعین 'ninety-five'. Root kh-m-s.
usage: In the Aqdas the 95 repetitions of the Greatest Name.

definition: Numeral: five. Root kh-m-s.
usage: In خمسة و تسعین 'ninety-five'.

definition: Verb, past of خواستن: wanted, asked for; summoned. Persian.
usage: کهنه را خواست 'summoned the soothsayers'.
notes: The و is silent.

definition: Past participle of خواندن "to read, recite, call": read, recited, called.
notes: The و is silent.

definition: Verbal noun khawḍ 'wading; plunging into vain talk' with -him 'their'. Root kh-w-ḍ.
usage: Qur'an 6:91 ذرهم فی خوضهم یلعبون 'leave them to sport in their vain discourse'.

definition: Khayál 'imagination, fancy, thought' with indefinite -í: a thought, a fancy, an idea. Root kh-y-l.
Noun, plural of khaymih: tents, pavilions. Root kh-y-m.
usage: As in خیام غیب 'the tabernacles of the Unseen'.

definition: Proper noun: Khaybar, oasis north of Medina conquered by Muḥammad in 628 AD.
usage: In the Íqán the people of Khaybar's question on adultery and غزوهٔ خیبر 'the battle of Khaybar'.

definition: Indicating, pointing to, signifying; with بر 'indicative of'. Root d-l-l.
usage: In the Íqán دالّ است بر 'betokeneth'.

definition: Noun: smoke. Root d-kh-n.
usage: The Íqán interprets the 'smoke' of Qur'an 44:10 as the dissension enveloping the people.

definition: Verb, past 3rd person singular: he entered. Root d-kh-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words حبّی حصنی من دخل فیه نجا 'My love is My stronghold; he that entereth therein is safe'.

definition: Present subjunctive 3pl of درآمدن "to enter, come in"; with برنگ "to take on the colour of".
usage: HW: کسانی که برنگ من درآیند 'those who take on My colour'.

definition: Present subjunctive of درآمدن 'to come in, enter'.
usage: ببحر اثبات درآئیم 'enter the sea of affirmation'.

definition: Persian verb درآمدن 'enter', negative subjunctive: may not enter.
Present subjunctive of dar-guzashtan: pass beyond, pass over; overlook, forgive.
notes: In the second context the sense is 'forgive'.

definition: Present subjunctive, third person plural, of dar-guzashtan 'to pass over, give up, forgo': they forgo.
usage: '(That) they forgo'; in calls to pass beyond self and the world for the sake of God.

definition: Verb: subjunctive 2nd singular of dar-gudhashtan "to pass over, renounce; to forgive".
usage: Pass beyond, renounce; also to forgive, as of passing over the faults of others.

definition: Noun dast "hand" with plural -há: hands.
Verb, imperative of wada‘a: leave, let alone. Root w-d-‘.
usage: Leave, let alone; in exhortations to leave behind worldly attachments and idle fancies.
notes: da‘i'l-mawtá let the dead bury their dead.

definition: Noun du‘á' with izáfih: prayer, supplication, invocation. Root d-‘-w.
usage: Prayer or supplication, as in دعای سحر 'dawn prayer'.
notes: Du‘á-yi Nudbih = the Prayer of Lamentation.

definition: Present subjunctive 2nd sing. of dádan 'to give'; forms compound verbs (tamíz dihí 'distinguish').
Adverb dúna 'below, short of, other than' with suffix -há: what is below it.
dún (other than, below) + dual suffix humá: other than those two; "wa má dúnahumá" and the like.
usage: In و ما دونهما "and the like", in the lists of laws in the Aqdas.

definition: Simple past third plural of davídan 'to run'.
Present perfect of dídan 'to see': they have seen.
Noun: dinar, a gold coin; money in general.
Noun dín 'religion, faith' with indefinite -í: a religion. Root d-y-n.
usage: Dín is religion or Faith; دین اللّه 'the Religion of God'.

definition: Imperative of yadharu 'to leave', with object 'them': leave them. Root w-dh-r.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse قل الله ثم ذرهم فی خوضهم یلعبون 'Say: God! then leave them to divert themselves'.

definition: Noun dhikr 'mention' with 3rd sing. suffix: its or his mention. Root dh-k-r.
Noun رأس 'head' with 'his'. Root r-’-s.
Noun ra’s 'head' with suffix: thy head. Root r-’-s.
usage: ارفع رأسک عن النوم 'Lift up thy head from slumber'.

definition: Plural of ráshid: rightly guided, upright. Root r-sh-d.
Active participle: content, well-pleased, satisfied. Root r-ḍ-y.
usage: In the Writings contentment with God's will, as in راضیاً عنّی 'well-pleased with Me'.

definition: Active participle of raqada 'to sleep', accusative as predicate of kána: sleeping, lying asleep. Root r-q-d.
usage: In the Hidden Words الی متی تکون راقداً علی بساطک 'how long wilt thou lie asleep upon thy bed?'

definition: Noun ráh 'way, path' with indefinite -í: a way, access.
Noun: scent, fragrance, odour. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Figurative, as رائحهٔ وفا 'the fragrance of fidelity' and رائحهٔ ایمان 'the fragrance of faith'.
notes: Spelled with final ە (U+06D5) in the source.

definition: Form I verb ra’á 'to see' with suffix: We have seen thee. Root r-’-y.
usage: In the Aqdas addresses to Constantinople and the Rhine: قد رأیناک 'We behold thee'.

definition: Noun: spring, the season. Root r-b-‘.
usage: ربیع الهی 'the divine springtime' of a new Revelation.

definition: Noun, accusative indefinite: a man. Root r-j-l.
usage: In Qur'an 40:28 أ تقتلون رجلاً ان یقول ربّی اللّه 'Will ye slay a man because he saith My Lord is God?'.

definition: Raḥma "mercy" with -hu "his": his mercy. Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: In the saying سبقت رحمته کلّ شیء 'His mercy hath surpassed all things'.

definition: Adjective and divine name: merciful, compassionate. Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: Divine attribute: غفور رحیم 'Forgiving, Merciful'; مشفق رحیم 'Compassionate, Merciful'.

definition: Noun: cloak, mantle, outer garment. Root r-d-y.
usage: HW: فاجعلها رداء لهیکلک 'make it the garment of thy temple'.

definition: Plural of rasúl: messengers, Apostles of God. Root r-s-l.
Noun: elevation, loftiness, high rank. Root r-f-‘.
usage: 'Loftiness, high rank'; used of the exaltation of the Cause or of station.

definition: Verb: past 1st plural of rafa‘a "to raise, lift; to remove, abolish". Root r-f-‘.
usage: We removed, abolished; in the Aqdas, of laws God has removed; also 'raised'.

definition: Verb raqama "to write, inscribe", perfect passive 3rd masculine singular: was written, recorded. Root r-q-m.
usage: 'Was inscribed', of what is written by the Pen of God.
notes: In Persian also the noun raqam "figure, number".

definition: Noun ramz "symbol, hint, allusion" + indefinite -í. Root r-m-z.
usage: A symbol or hint; the Íqán explains that scripture speaks in symbols (رمز) whose inner meaning must be understood.

definition: Verb (form I perfect) of ramá: he threw, cast, shot. Root r-m-y.
usage: He threw or cast, e.g. stones or accusations cast at the Manifestation.
notes: Qur'án 8:17.

definition: Verb, perfect 2nd masc. sing. of ramá: thou threwest, castest. Root r-m-y.
usage: From Qur'án 8:17, ما رمیت اذ رمیت 'thou threwest not when thou threwest', i.e. God acted through the Prophet.
notes: Quran 8:17 wa má ramayta idh ramayta.

definition: Noun: soul, spirit; also adjective 'flowing'.
usage: 'Soul, spirit', as in جان و روان 'heart and soul'; also 'flowing', of streams.
notes: ján u raván: heart and soul.

definition: Noun (accusative indefinite): spirit, breath of life. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Spirit, breath of life; the Hidden Words speak of God breathing into man "a breath of My Spirit".

definition: Feminine form of rúḥání: spiritual. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Spiritual, as in نفوس روحانیه 'spiritual souls' and محافل روحانیه 'Spiritual Assemblies'.

definition: Arabic plural of rúḥání 'spiritual': spiritual beings, the spiritually minded. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: In the Íqán اخلاق روحانیین 'the attributes of the spiritual ones'.

definition: Noun: heads, plural of ra’s, with suffix -kum 'your'. Root r-'-s.
usage: Aqdas: لا تحلقوا رؤسکم 'shave not your heads'; زینوا رؤسکم 'adorn your heads'.

definition: Noun: garden, meadow; Paradise garden. Root r-w-ḍ.
usage: Figurative gardens, as in روضهٴ قلب 'the garden of thy heart'.
notes: ٴ marks the izáfih.

definition: Plural of ra's 'head' with pronoun 'their'. Root r-'-s.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse فسینغضون الیک رؤوسهم 'they will wag their heads at thee'.

definition: Noun: hypocrisy, ostentation in religious acts. Root r-’-y.
usage: In the Hidden Words غبار ریا 'the dust of hypocrisy'.

definition: Noun: doubt, suspicion; with Persian indefinite -í. Root r-y-b.
usage: Often negated: ریبی در آن نیست 'there is no doubt therein', echoing لا ریب فیه.

definition: Past participle of زدن 'to strike'; in compounds: struck, done; بر هم زده 'having broken up'. Persian.
Persian zamán "time, age" with indefinite -í: a time, an age.
Noun: adultery, fornication; the final ی links the izáfih. Root z-n-y.
Persian exclamatory interjection of wonder, praise or irony: how great, what, bravo.
usage: In the Hidden Words زهی حسرت 'what regret!', lamenting the heedless.

definition: Proper noun: Zawrá’, a place named in Islamic traditions; often an epithet of Baghdad.
usage: In the Íqán a tradition from روضهٔ کافی interprets Zawrá’, applied to Ṭihrán (Rayy).

definition: Feminine of zakí 'pure, chaste, sinless'. Root z-k-w.
usage: In نفوس زکیّه 'pure souls'.

definition: Visiting; pilgrimage; a Tablet or prayer of visitation; beholding someone's face. Root z-w-r.
usage: In the Íqán both 'attaining the presence' and a prayer of visitation: در زیارت میفرماید.

definition: Preposition and noun: under, beneath, below.
Active participle (Arabic feminine with a plural): preceding, former, past. Root s-b-q.
usage: In امم سابقه 'past peoples', the earlier religious communities.

definition: Hour, moment; also the Hour of Judgment. Root s-w-‘.
usage: In the tradition تفکّر ساعة خیر من عبادة سبعین سنة 'an hour's reflection is better than seventy years of pious worship'.

definition: Noun: wine-cup, goblet; in poetry the cup of divine love or knowledge.
usage: ساغر معانی 'the cup of inner meanings'; the Cupbearer giving the cup only to the seeker.

definition: Proper noun: Sheba, the land of the queen visited by Solomon's hoopoe, with izáfih.
usage: HW: ای هدهد سلیمان عشق جز در سبای جانان وطن مگیر 'O hoopoe of Solomon's love! Seek thou no home except in the Sheba of the well-beloved'.

definition: Noun: the Sabbath, Saturday. Root s-b-t.
usage: In the Íqán Jesus abrogated the law of the Sabbath.

definition: Feminine relative adjective from subḥán 'glory (be to God)': divine, of the All-Glorious. Root s-b-ḥ.
usage: 'Divine'; in phrases like نفحات سبحانیه 'divine breezes'.

definition: Numeral: seventy (oblique case of sab‘ún). Root s-b-‘.
Numeral (oblique case): sixty; "sanih-yi sittín" the year sixty (AH 1260, 1844). Root s-t-t.
usage: Sixty; سنهٔ ستین 'the year sixty' (AH 1260, 1844) marks the Declaration of the Báb.

definition: Noun: magic, sorcery, enchantment. Root s-ḥ-r.
usage: Sorcery, magic; the Manifestations were called sorcerers (ساحر) when they showed God's signs.
notes: siḥrun mubín manifest sorcery.

definition: Noun: the time before dawn, early morning. Root s-ḥ-r.
usage: The hour before dawn, a time for prayer and remembrance, often with the nightingale's song in Persian imagery.

definition: Adverbial plural of saḥargáh: at dawn, at many a daybreak.
usage: At dawn, the hour of prayer and communion, as in سحرگاهان in the Hidden Words.
notes: Basá saḥargáhán = at many a dawn.

definition: Noun: hardship, severity, difficulty.
usage: Hardship, difficulty; the tribulations endured in God's path.

definition: Verb, perfect 3rd person plural of sakhira: they mocked, ridiculed. Root s-kh-r.
usage: 'They mocked', used of peoples who ridiculed the Prophets sent to them.

definition: Noun: lote-tree; the Divine Lote-Tree, symbol of the Manifestation. Root s-d-r.
usage: The Divine Lote-Tree, symbol of the Manifestation; in phrases such as سدرهٴ منتهی.
notes: The hamza marks the izáfih (sidrih-yi irtifá‘).

definition: Adverbial accusative of sirr 'secret': secretly, in private; paired with jahran 'openly'. Root s-r-r.
usage: Secretly, chiefly in سرّاً وجهراً 'secretly and openly'.

definition: Plural of siráj: lamps. Root s-r-j.
usage: In the Aqdas اوامری سرج عنایتی 'My commandments are the lamps of My loving providence'; Íqán سرج یقین 'lamps of certitude'.

definition: Adjective: verdant, fresh and green, flourishing (sar 'head' + sabz 'green').
Persian noun sar 'head', plural with -há: heads.
notes: The final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Noun: happiness, felicity, good fortune. Root s-‘-d.
usage: Usually paired with شقاوت 'misery'.

definition: Noun: effort, endeavour; سعی نمودن 'to strive'. Root s-‘-y.
Noun: sickness; of a report, unsoundness, falsity. Root s-q-m.
usage: In صحّت و سقم 'authenticity and falsity' of traditions.

definition: Verbal noun: falling, fall, collapse. Root s-q-ṭ.
usage: سقوط انجم 'the falling of the stars', interpreted as the fall of religious leaders.

definition: Accusative of sulṭán: authority, power, sovereignty; also sovereign. Root s-l-ṭ.
usage: In the Writings سلطان is sovereignty or a title of God as Sovereign; here "power on earth to forgive sins".

definition: Noun sulṭán 'sovereignty, power, authority' with -hi 'His'. Root s-l-ṭ.
usage: In the Writings God's sovereign authority, as in امر الله و سلطانه 'the Cause of God and His sovereignty'.

definition: Proper name: Salmán the Persian, an early companion of Muḥammad, formerly named Rúzbih.
usage: The Íqán tells his story and cites a saying of ‘Alí addressed to him.

definition: Noun samá’ 'heaven, sky' with -í 'my'. Root s-m-w.
usage: In the Hidden Words اذکرنی فی ارضی لأذکرک فی سمائی 'make mention of Me on My earth, that I may remember thee in My heaven'.
notes: Written سمائی.

definition: Noun: spearhead, lance, spear. Root s-n-n.
usage: Of the martyrs in the Íqán, whose heads adorned the spears of the infidels.

definition: Plural of sunna 'way, practice, ordinance' with -hu: His ordinances. Root s-n-n.
usage: In the Aqdas حدود اللّه و سننه 'the ordinances and laws of God'.

definition: Preposition: other than, except, apart from (Arabic siwá with the izáfih ending). Root s-w-y.
Verb, simple past 3rd person plural of súkhtan: they burned, consumed.
notes: In صفات بشریّه را بنار محبّت الهی سوختند 'burned away human attributes in the fire of God's love'.

definition: Past 1pl of سوختن "to burn": we burned, we were consumed.
usage: In the verse quoted in the Íqán: بنار محبّت یار سوختیم 'we were consumed in the fire of the Friend's love'.

definition: Noun: market, marketplace, bazaar. Root s-w-q.
Preposition: other than, except; in ما سوی 'all that is other than'. Root s-w-y.
usage: HW: فقر از ما سوی الله 'poverty in all save God'.

definition: Persian noun سو 'side, direction' with izáfih: toward, to.
Noun: intoxication, drunkenness. Root s-k-r.
usage: Figurative, as in سکر الهوی 'the intoxication of passion'.

definition: Future prefix sa- plus yafná, imperfect of faniya 'to perish, pass away': will perish. Root f-n-y.
usage: 'Will perish'; in reminders that the world and all on it shall pass away.

definition: Proper noun: Mount Sinai; here with izáfih (the Sinai of light).
usage: Sinai; the mount of Moses's revelation, used figuratively of the place of revelation, as in Síná-yi núr 'the Sinai of light'.

definition: Active participle shárib "drinking" with Persian plural copula -and: they drink. Root sh-r-b.
usage: Drinking, often figurative of drinking from the cup of divine knowledge.

definition: Noun: evening, nightfall; supper.
usage: Evening; often paired with صبح or سحر, 'morning and evening'.
notes: shám-i ḍalálat the night of error.

definition: Plural of sháhid (accusative/genitive): witnesses, beholders. Root sh-h-d.
usage: Witnesses, as in Qur'anic formulas 'We were witnesses' and those who bear witness.

definition: Plural of shab 'night'; adverbially 'at night, nightly'.
Noun, plural of shubhah 'doubt, ambiguity': doubts, specious arguments. Root sh-b-h.
usage: 'Doubts, specious arguments', the misgivings raised by divines against the new Revelation.

definition: shibh (likeness, similar) + indefinite -í: any likeness. Root sh-b-h.
usage: Likeness; used to deny any likeness to God, as in لا شبه له.

definition: Simple past third singular of shitáftan 'to hasten, hurry'.
Noun: tree. Root sh-j-r.
usage: Often the Manifestation as the divine Tree; اثمار شجرة 'the fruits of the Tree'.

definition: Verb: past 1st singular of shudan, 'to become'; also forms passives.

shift: Here: a draught, a drink (figurative, of knowledge). Today: a sweet syrup drink, sherbet.
definition: Noun: a drink, draught; modern Persian 'sweet syrup drink'. Root sh-r-b.
usage: Figurative draughts, as in شربت زلال معرفت 'the limpid draught of knowledge'.

definition: Adjective: pertaining to the religious law, legal. Root sh-r-‘.
usage: Religious ordinances, as حدودات شرعیه.

definition: Adjective: noble, honourable, eminent. Root sh-r-f.
usage: With وضیع 'lowly' in وضیع و شریف 'high and low'.

definition: Adjective (fem.): noble, honoured, holy. Root sh-r-f.
usage: Of sacred texts, as in آیهٔ شریفه 'the blessed verse' and بیانات شریفه 'noble utterances'.

definition: Noun: partner, associate, sharer. Root sh-r-k.
usage: Recalls لا شریک له 'He hath no peer'; ascribing partners to God is شرک.

definition: Persian sharík "partner, sharing" with -and "they are": they share, are partners. Root sh-r-k.

shift: Here: wretchedness, damnation, the opposite of سعادت. Today: cruelty, villainy.
definition: Noun: wretchedness, misery, damnation (opposite of سعادت); in modern Persian mostly 'cruelty'. Root sh-q-w.
usage: In the Íqán paired with سعادت 'felicity' as the outcome of rejecting or accepting the Manifestation.

definition: Persian plural of shaqá’iq, the anemone or wild poppy: anemones; figuratively flowers of spiritual truth. Root sh-q-q.
usage: In the Íqán شقایقهای حقایق 'the anemones of inner truths' blossoming in the gardens of hearts.

definition: Verb, present perfect 3rd plural of shumurdan 'to count, to deem'.
Present 3rd singular of shanídan (shinúdan) 'to hear': hears, would hear.
The visible world, that which is witnessed; also testimony, martyrdom. Root sh-h-d.
usage: Paired with غیب: ملکوت غیب و شهاده 'the realm of the unseen and the seen'.

definition: Plural of shahíd: witnesses; martyrs. Root sh-h-d.
usage: انا کنا شهداء 'We were witnesses'; شهداء الله 'the witnesses of God'.
notes: Accusative in the first context, nominative in the second.

definition: Noun, plural of shahr: cities, towns.
Shawq "longing, yearning" in the accusative: out of longing. Root sh-w-q.
usage: HW: شوقاً للقائی 'in thy longing to meet Me'.
notes: Accusative of cause.

definition: Noun: complaint, grievance. Root sh-k-w.
Noun شکّ 'doubt' with indefinite ی: any doubt. Root sh-k-k.
Noun shay' (thing) with 3pl copula: they are a thing; یک شیء‌اند 'they are one'. Root sh-y-’.
Noun: Satan, devil, the tempter; figuratively an evil influence. Root sh-ṭ-n.
usage: 'Satan'; in the Writings understood as the lower nature of man rather than an independent being.

definition: Adjective (feminine): satanic, devilish. Root sh-ṭ-n.
usage: Satanic; used of the promptings of the self and evil suggestions (vasávis-i shayṭáníyyih).

definition: Verb ṣáḥa "to shout, cry out", perfect 3rd feminine singular: she/it cried out. Root ṣ-y-ḥ.
notes: bihi ṣáḥati’ṣ-ṣakhra through Him the Rock hath shouted.

definition: Proper noun (accusative): Ṣáliḥ, the prophet sent to Thamúd; as adjective righteous. Root ṣ-l-ḥ.
usage: Ṣáliḥ, the prophet sent to Thamúd, cited in the Íqán among the Messengers rejected by their people.

definition: Noun: morning. Root ṣ-b-ḥ.
usage: Morning, as in صبح و شام; dawn imagery for the new Revelation.

definition: Broken plural of ṣaḥífa: pages, scrolls, scriptures. Root ṣ-ḥ-f.
usage: Scriptures, sacred scrolls, as in صحف و کتب 'scrolls and books' of past Revelations.
notes: Written صحائف.

definition: Noun: intention, purpose; dar ṣadad-i ... bar ámadan: to set out to.
usage: 'Intent', in در صدد ... بر آمدن 'to set out to', describing someone's purpose or design.

definition: Plural of ṣarráf: money-changers, assayers who test coin. Root ṣ-r-f.
usage: Assayers of coin; figuratively, those who discern true from false.

definition: Feminine of ṣirf 'pure, sheer, unmixed', agreeing with an abstract noun. Root ṣ-r-f.
usage: Pure or sheer, as in عنایت صرفه 'pure bounty' and فضل صرف 'sheer grace'.

definition: Adjective: difficult, hard, arduous. Root ṣ-‘-b.
usage: In the tradition حدیثنا صعب مستصعب 'Our Word is abstruse, exceedingly abstruse'.

definition: Noun: righteousness, rectitude; welfare, what is right. Root ṣ-l-ḥ.
usage: راه صلاح و رستگاری 'the path of righteousness and salvation'.

definition: Adjective, feminine: of aṣ-Ṣamad, the Eternal, Self-Sufficient God (Qur'an 112). Root ṣ-m-d.
usage: Qualifies divine realities: حکمت صمدیّه 'eternal wisdom', عزّ صمدیّه 'eternal glory'.

definition: Verb: to make, fashion, craft; I fashioned thee. Root ṣ-n-‘.
Proper noun: Ṣúriyá, in Ibn Ṣúriyá, a Jewish rabbi of Medina in Muḥammad's time.
usage: In the Íqán Ibn Ṣúriyá is asked by Muḥammad about the punishment for adultery.

definition: Noun: harm, hurt, injury, adversity. Root ḍ-r-r.
Noun ḍaw’ 'light' with suffix: its light. Root ḍ-w-’.
usage: Gospel verse القمر لا یعطی ضوئه 'the moon shall not give her light'.
notes: Accusative ending; normalized from ضوئه.

definition: Verb ṭára, to fly; third feminine singular past: it flew, soared. Root ṭ-y-r.
usage: In the Aqdas of souls taking flight and of the Dove winging away (اذا طارت الورقاء).

definition: Plural of ṭálib 'seeker': seekers. Root ṭ-l-b.
usage: In the Íqán the true seekers of God.

definition: Arabic active participle ṭá’ir 'flying' with the Persian copula -and: they are flying, they soar. Root ṭ-y-r.
usage: In the Íqán در هواهای قرب طائرند 'they soar in the atmosphere of nearness'.

definition: Noun: embroidered border, ornament, adornment; also mode or style.
usage: The Tablet of Ṭarázát (Ornaments) takes its name from it; in the Íqán the splendour bestowed on a mote.

definition: Noun: road, way, path; manner, method. Root ṭ-r-q.
usage: The spiritual path, as in برادران طریق 'brethren in the way'; also manner, باین طریق 'in this way'.

definition: Food, meal. Root ṭ-‘-m.
Noun ṭal‘at with indefinite -í: a face, countenance; a Manifestation of God. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: طلعت 'Countenance' is a title of the Manifestation, as in طلعت منیر.

definition: Verb, form II imperative plural: purify, cleanse. Root ṭ-h-r.
usage: In the Aqdas طهّروا کلّ مکروه بالمآء 'Wash ye every soiled thing with water'.

definition: Good, pure, wholesome, fragrant. Root ṭ-y-b.
usage: As in دل طیّب 'a pure heart'; also کلمه طیّبه 'a goodly word'.

definition: Feminine of ṭayyib: good, pure, goodly. Root ṭ-y-b.
usage: کلمة طیّبة کشجرة طیّبة 'a goodly word, like a goodly tree' (Qur'an 14:24); بلدهٔ طیّبه 'the goodly land'.

definition: Persian plural of ظالم: oppressors, tyrants, wrongdoers. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: HW: ای ظالمان ارض 'O oppressors on earth!'

definition: Adjective ẓáhir (apparent) with 3pl copula: they are manifest, they appear. Root ẓ-h-r.
ẓuhúr 'appearance, manifestation, Revelation' plus -and 'they are'. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: ظهور is 'Manifestation, Revelation', the appearance of God's Messenger, as in ظهور الله.
notes: muntaẓir-i án ẓuhúr-and 'they await that Revelation'.

definition: Adjective (feminine): customary, habitual, ordinary. Root ‘-w-d.
usage: Customary, ordinary; ordinary adjective.

definition: Verb form III imperative masculine plural: associate with, consort with, live together. Root ‘-sh-r.
usage: 'Consort ye', in the command عاشروا مع الادیان بالروح والریحان 'Consort with the followers of all religions in a spirit of friendliness and fellowship'.

definition: Noun, Persian plural of ‘áṣí: the disobedient, sinners, rebels. Root ‘-ṣ-y.
usage: Sinners, the disobedient; contrasted with the faithful and named as objects of God's forgiveness.

definition: Noun: the common people, the generality; ‘ámmih-yi nás = the generality of men. Root ‘-m-m.
usage: The generality of people, as in عامهٔ ناس; often contrasted with the learned or the elect.

definition: Broken plural of ‘abd + -ka 'thy': Thy servants. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: 'Thy servants', in prayers addressing God.

definition: Proper name 'servant of God'; here ‘Abdu’lláh ibn Ubayy, leader of the Hypocrites at Medina.
usage: 'Servant of God'; here ‘Abdu'lláh ibn Ubayy, chief of the Hypocrites at Medina, cited in the Íqán among those who opposed the Prophet.

definition: Noun: kindred, family, especially the Prophet's household. Root ‘-t-r.
usage: The family of the Prophet Muḥammad, especially the Imams.

definition: Noun: wonder, astonishment; adjective: strange, marvellous. Root ‘-j-b.
usage: Wonder and astonishment, as in عجب است 'it is a wonder'.

definition: Adjective: wonderful, marvellous, strange; Arabic feminine agreeing with a plural noun. Root ‘-j-b.
usage: In the Íqán تلویحات عجیبه 'wondrous allusions'.

definition: Noun: number, count; also the waiting period of a widow or divorcee. Root ‘-d-d.
usage: Aqdas: انّ عدّة الشّهور تسعة عشر شهراً 'the number of the months is nineteen'.
notes: Case varies with context.

definition: Noun, accusative indefinite used adverbially: as justice, justly. Root ‘-d-l.
usage: Aqdas: عدلاً من عندنا 'as a justice from Us'.

definition: Verb form II: to punish, torment; he tormented them. Root ‘-dh-b.
Noun: excuse, valid reason, justification. Root ‘-dh-r.
Adjective (fem.): Arabic, Arab. Root ‘-r-b.
usage: In الواح عربیّه 'Arabic Tablets'.

definition: Noun ‘arsh 'throne' with suffix: My throne. Root ‘-r-sh.
usage: ای رفیق عرشی 'O Companion of My Throne!'.
notes: Could also be read as the adjective 'heavenly' in Persian.

definition: Noun: presentation, offering; عرضه داشتن "to present, submit humbly". Root ‘-r-ḍ.
Plural of ‘árif 'knower, gnostic': mystics, Sufi gnostics. Root ‘-r-f.
Perfect 2nd person masculine plural of ‘arafa 'to know' with linking -ú and suffix -hu: you knew it. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: In the Aqdas ما لا عرفتموه من الکتاب 'whatsoever ye understand not in the Book' is to be referred to the Branch, ‘Abdu'l-Bahá.

definition: Verb ‘arafa 'to know, recognize' with -ní 'me'. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: In the Aqdas من عرفنی یقوم علی خدمتی 'whoso hath known Me shall arise to serve Me'.

definition: Perfect 3rd plural of ‘arafa 'to know, recognize'. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: Of recognizing the Manifestation: فلمّا جآءهم ما عرفوا کفروا به 'when there came to them that which they recognized, they disbelieved'.

definition: Bride.
usage: In عروس معانی 'the Bride of inner meaning', the veiled mysteries of the Word.

definition: Numeral: ten; in compounds -teen, as ثمانی عشرة 'eighteen', تسع عشرة 'nineteen'. Root ‘-sh-r.
usage: Aqdas ثمانی عشرة مرة 'eighteen times', تسع عشرة سنة 'nineteen years'.
notes: Feminine compound form, used with a feminine noun.

definition: Verbal noun: disobedience, rebellion, sin. Root ‘-ṣ-y.
usage: In the Hidden Words سیف عصیان 'the sword of rebellion' that cuts down the tree of hope.

definition: Thirst; ardent longing. Root ‘-ṭ-sh.
usage: In the Íqán of the fish whose thirst all the oceans cannot quench.

definition: Noun ‘aṭiyya 'gift' with suffix 'My'. Root ‘-ṭ-w.
usage: عظمتی عطیّتی الیک 'My majesty is My gift to thee'.

definition: Noun عظمة 'greatness, majesty' with the suffix 'my'. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: HW: عظمتی عطیّتی الیک 'My majesty is My gift to thee'.

definition: Adjective in accusative: great, mighty; with nahy 'a strict prohibition'. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: Aqdas: نهیناکم عن ذلک نهیاً عظیماً 'We have strictly forbidden you this'.

definition: Noun: mountain pass, steep ascent, height; obstacle. Root ‘-q-b.
usage: 'Steep pass, height'; used of the stages of the spiritual path, as in the 'heights' a seeker must cross.
notes: Hidden Words: 'the emerald height of fidelity'.

definition: Noun: dual of ‘aqib "heel" plus suffix "his"; yanqalibu ‘alá ‘aqibayhi "turns back on his heels". Root ‘-q-b.
usage: His heels; in yanqalibu ‘alá ‘aqibayhi 'turns back on his heels', said of those who turn away from faith.

definition: Noun: attachment, tie, bond; interest. Root ‘-l-q.
usage: Attachment or tie, especially attachment to the world, which the Writings call the seeker to sever.

definition: Noun ‘alámat "sign, token" + indefinite -í: a sign. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: A sign or token, especially the signs foretold for the coming of the Promised One.

definition: Verb (form II perfect): he hung, suspended; with bi-: made dependent upon. Root ‘-l-q.
usage: Made something dependent upon, as in God making acceptance of deeds dependent upon recognition.

definition: Plural of ‘ilm 'knowledge, science' + relative -í. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Learning, sciences; the Íqán contrasts acquired learning with divine knowledge.

definition: Adjective: lofty, heavenly, celestial. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: 'Celestial, lofty', of the heavenly realm, contrasted with سفلی 'lower, earthly'.

definition: Adjective: high, exalted, sublime. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: Exalted; in phrases of high spiritual station.
notes: Taqdísan ‘aliyyan: an exalted sanctification. Elsewhere ‘ulyá (feminine elative) is also possible.

definition: Preposition ‘alá 'upon, to' with the relative pronoun alladhína 'those who' (masculine plural).
notes: Written علی‌الّذین.

definition: Intensive adjective: all-knowing, well-informed; a divine name. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Qur'anic formula انّه کان … علیماً 'He is All-Knowing'.

definition: Verb: imperative plural of ‘ammara, 'to build, to make prosperous, to cultivate'. Root ‘-m-r.
usage: Aqdas: عمّروا بیوتاً 'build ye houses (of worship)' and عمّروا دیار اللّه و بلاده 'build ye the lands of God'.

definition: Noun, accusative indefinite: deed, work, action. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: Qur'anic: احسن عملاً 'best in deeds', فلیعمل عملاً صالحاً 'let him work a righteous work'.

definition: Contraction of ‘an 'from' and man 'who': from whom, from whomsoever.
Preposition ‘inda 'with, at' with 2nd masc. suffix; من عندک 'from Thee'.
Adjective: elemental, material, physical. Root ‘-n-ṣ-r.
usage: Contrasted with the spiritual, as in آب عنصری 'elemental water'.

definition: Preposition عن with first-person suffix: from me; with راضی 'pleased with me'.
usage: راضیاً عنّی 'well pleased with Me'.

definition: Noun: fault, defect, shortcoming. Root ‘-y-b.
usage: The Hidden Words warn against magnifying the faults of others, عیب مردم را بزرگ مدان.

definition: Noun: life, living; joy, delight, pleasure. Root ‘-y-sh.
Plural of ‘ayb: faults, defects, failings. Root ‘-y-b.
usage: The Hidden Words bid one look to one's own faults, not those of others: کیف نسیت عیوب نفسک.

definition: Noun, plural of ‘ayn: springs, fountains; also eyes. Root ‘-y-n.
usage: Springs of divine knowledge, as in عیون صافیه 'pure springs'; also eyes, as in از عیونم عیون جاری بود 'from mine eyes rivers flowed'.

definition: Plural of gháfil 'heedless, unaware, negligent'. Root gh-f-l.
usage: Common in و انتم غافلون 'and ye are heedless'.

definition: Plural of gháfil: the heedless, the unaware. Root gh-f-l.
usage: In Qur'anic quotations کانوا عنها غافلین 'they were heedless of them'.

definition: Active participle: absent, hidden, vanished. Root gh-y-b.
notes: Written غائب; the hamza seat is normalized.

definition: Verbal noun: planting; also a plant. Root gh-r-s.
usage: In the Hidden Words شجرهٔ انیسا که در فردوس اعظم غرس شده 'the Tree of Anísá planted in the Most Great Paradise'.

definition: Upper rooms, chambers, lofty mansions; plural of ghurfa. Root gh-r-f.
usage: Íqán: باعلی غرف یقین 'the loftiest mansions of certitude'.

definition: Persian plural of ghurfih 'upper room, chamber'. Root gh-r-f.
usage: غرفه‌های حکمت 'the chambers of wisdom' where the maidens of inner meaning are hidden.
notes: Final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Adjective: strange, wondrous, rare; also foreign. Root gh-r-b.
usage: Íqán: اشارات غریبه 'strange allusions'.

definition: Noun: adulteration, dross; deceit. Root gh-sh-sh.
Noun: sheath, scabbard; covering, case. Root gh-l-f.
usage: 'Sheath'; in images of the soul's veils, or a sword returned to its sheath.

definition: Noun: youth, young man, servant; in these texts a title of the Manifestation. Root gh-l-m.
usage: Youth; in these texts a title of Bahá'u'lláh, the Youth (ghulám), e.g. in the Aqdas.

definition: Noun ghayr "other" with -kum: others than you. Root gh-y-r.
Noun ghayr "other than" + -í "me": other than me.
usage: Other than Me; in the Arabic Hidden Words God bids the heart turn from all save Him.

definition: Verb (form I perfect): it passed by, was missed, escaped. Root f-w-t.
usage: Of something lost or missed, e.g. the opportunity to recognise the Manifestation.

definition: Active participle: sinner, profligate, wicked. Root f-j-r.
usage: Wicked, profligate, often paired with فاسق or contrasted with ابرار 'the righteous'.

definition: fa- 'so' + imperative of ja‘ala 'make' + -há 'it': so make it. Root j-‘-l.
usage: 'So make it', in prayers asking God to make something a means of blessing.

definition: fa + Form I imperative of dakhala: so enter. Root d-kh-l.
usage: So enter, as in the Hidden Words "enter therein", calling the soul into God's presence.

definition: Conjunction fa 'and, then' + idhá 'when, if'.
Proper noun: Paran, a mountain and wilderness near Sinai, scene of divine revelation.
usage: In جبل فاران 'Mount Paran' and the Covenant made there, a symbol of revelation.

definition: Proper noun: Fáṭimih, daughter of Muhammad; also a woman's name.
usage: In the Íqán لوح فاطمه 'the Tablet of Fáṭimih' and the tradition of the 'thousand Fáṭimihs'.

definition: Conjunction fa with imperative of ‘arafa and -hu: so know it, recognize it. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: Hidden Words: حبّی فیک فاعرفه 'My love is in thee, know it'.

definition: Active participle: one who splits, cleaves; فالق الاصباح 'He Who causeth the dawn to break'. Root f-l-q.
usage: Divine title from Qur'án 6:96.

definition: Conjunction fa with form VI perfect: exalted then is He (above). Root ‘-l-w.
usage: A Qur'anic formula of praise, تعالی عمّا یذکرون 'exalted is He above what they describe'.

definition: Noun, plural of fájir: the wicked, the ungodly. Root f-j-r.
usage: Paired against ابرار 'the righteous', as in نقمت برای فجّار 'vengeance for the wicked'.

definition: Noun: dawn, daybreak. Root f-j-r.
usage: Image of a new Revelation's appearance, as in انوار عیسی از فجر روح 'the lights of Jesus from the dawn of the spirit'.

definition: Past participle of فراگرفتن "to surround, envelop, cover": enveloped, filled.
Adjective (feminine) from Furqán 'the Qur'an': Qur'anic. Root f-r-q.
usage: In the Íqán آیات فرقانیّه 'the verses of the Qur'án'.

definition: Noun: cry, shout, outcry, lament; faryád bar-ávardan, to cry out.
Noun: a group, party, faction. Root f-r-q.
usage: Qur'anic ففریقاً کذّبتم و فریقاً تقتلون 'some ye treated as impostors, and others ye slew'.

definition: Perfect 1st plural of form II faḍḍala 'to prefer, cause to excel'. Root f-ḍ-l.
usage: From Qur'an 2:253 تلک الرّسل فضّلنا بعضهم علی بعض 'Some of the Apostles We have caused to excel others'.

definition: Accusative of fi‘l 'deed': in deed, in action; paired with قولاً 'in word'.
Verb: you did (masc. sg.). Root f-‘-l.
usage: Qur'an 26:19, Pharaoh to Moses: و فعلت فعلتک التی فعلت 'thou didst commit that deed of thine'.

definition: Verb, past 3rd person plural: they did. Root f-‘-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words انّا کنّا شهدآء علی ما فعلوا 'We were witnesses of what they did'.

definition: Fa "then" + ‘alá "upon" + -hi "him": then upon him (be).
notes: In curses and obligations: فعلیه لعنة منّی 'upon him rest My curse'.

definition: Conjunction fa- 'and so' with faríq 'party, group' in the accusative. Root f-r-q.
usage: ففریقاً کذّبتم و فریقاً تقتلون 'some ye charged with imposture, others ye slew' (Qur'an 2:87).

definition: Conjunction ف 'and so' with قال 'he said'. Root q-w-l.
usage: Qur'anic: فقال الملأ الّذین کفروا 'the chiefs who disbelieved said'.

definition: Plural of fiqra: passages, clauses, items. Root f-q-r.
Plural of faqíh 'jurist, doctor of religious law'. Root f-q-h.
usage: 'Jurists'; often the clergy who opposed the Manifestation, as in the Íqán's account of the فقهاء.

definition: Noun: success, prosperity, salvation. Root f-l-ḥ.
usage: Success, salvation; in the call ḥayya ‘alá'l-faláḥ 'hasten to salvation'.

definition: Particle fa- and jussive l- with form IV aqbala: then let him turn towards (accept). Root q-b-l.
usage: 'Let him turn towards' God; part of the vocabulary of اقبال 'turning to the Faith'.
notes: fa-man shá’a falyuqbil whoso willeth, let him turn.

definition: Particle fa- + hani’an (accusative of hanī’ "wholesome"): happy is, well is it with. Root h-n-’.
usage: A formula of blessing, 'well is it with', as in فهنیئا لمن 'well is it with him who'.
notes: Written فهنیئاً.

definition: Noun: heart, inner heart, mind. Root f-'-d.
usage: The inner heart, as in افئدة 'hearts'; seat of recognition of God in the Writings.

definition: Broken plural of fáris: horsemen, knights, champions. Root f-r-s.
usage: Horsemen, champions, e.g. champions in the arena of knowledge or love.

definition: Conjunction fa- + kullamá 'whenever, every time that'.
notes: Preceded by interrogative a- in a-fa-kullamá.

definition: fa + kayfa (how): how then; how much more, or less.
Preposition fí 'in, for' + Alláh 'God'; mujáhidín fi'lláh 'those who strive for God'.
usage: Combines في with الله; found in phrases such as المجاهدون فی الله 'those who strive for God'.
notes: Written فی‌اللّه.

definition: Noun: group, party, band of people. Root f-y-’.
usage: Qur'anic: کم من فئة قلیلة غلبت فئة کثیرة 'how oft hath a small band vanquished a large host'.

definition: Preposition fí 'in, among' with suffix -ná 'us': among us; for Our sake.
notes: In و الّذین جاهدوا فینا 'they who strive for Us' it means 'in Our path'.

definition: Arabic preposition fí 'in' with -kum: in you, among you.
Fa 'so that' with yakúna 'he would be'; also in کن فیکون 'Be, and it is'. Root k-w-n.
Active participle in the accusative: receptive, capable, worthy. Root q-b-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words لتکون قابلاً للقائی 'that thou mayest be worthy to meet Me'.

definition: Active participle: killing, deadly; a killer. Root q-t-l.
usage: In سمّ قاتل 'deadly poison'.

definition: Active participle, accusative: able, powerful. Root q-d-r.
usage: قائماً قادراً مقتدراً قیّوماً 'mighty, powerful and self-subsisting'.

definition: Active participle of qaṣara: falling short, inadequate, incapable. Root q-ṣ-r.
usage: Often of words or minds unable to describe God, as in از ذکر آن عاجز و قاصر.

definition: Noun: rule, principle, custom; also base. Root q-‘-d.
Active participle of qáma 'to stand', accusative: standing, steadfast, self-subsisting. Root q-w-m.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words لتجدنی فیک قائماً 'that thou mayest find Me standing within thee'; القائم is also the title of the promised One.

definition: Active participle qá’im 'one who arises' with -ná 'our': our Qá’im. Root q-w-m.
usage: The Qá’im, 'He Who shall arise', promised in Shí‘ih tradition, for Bahá'ís the Báb.
notes: Written قائمنا.

definition: Active participle qá’im 'standing, subsisting, upright' with -and 'they are'. Root q-w-m.
Grasping, seizing, taking hold; قبض روح 'taking the soul', i.e. causing death. Root q-b-ḍ.
Noun: direction of prayer, Qibla; object of devotion. Root q-b-l.
usage: In the Writings the Qiblih is the Point of Adoration; Qur'an 2:144 فلنولینک قبلة ترضاها.

definition: Verb, form II, past 1st person plural: We ordained, decreed, destined. Root q-d-r.
usage: In the Aqdas انّا قدّرنا العلوم لعرفان المعلوم 'We have ordained the sciences for the recognition of the Known One'.

definition: Relating to qadar, divine measure or predestination; feminine agreeing with a plural. Root q-d-r.
usage: Íqán: تقدیرات قدریّه 'His decrees of destiny'.

definition: Adjective and divine name: powerful, all-powerful. Root q-d-r.
usage: In the formula کان الله علی کل شیء قدیرا 'God hath power over all things'.

definition: Adjective: ancient, eternal, without beginning. Root q-d-m.
usage: HW: ملکاً دائماً باقیاً ازلاً قدیماً 'a sovereignty eternal, imperishable, everlasting, ancient'.

definition: Adjective, feminine form: ancient, eternal, without beginning. Root q-d-m.
usage: Used of the Manifestations and divine verses, as in آیات قدیمه 'the ancient verses'.

definition: Past tense, third person feminine singular, of qarra 'to be cool, refreshed' (of the eye): qarrat ‘ayn 'the eye was gladdened'. Root q-r-r.
usage: In قرّت عین 'the eye was gladdened', the Qur'anic image of delight.

definition: Noun: Persian plural of qarn "century, age": ages, centuries. Root q-r-n.
usage: Ages, centuries; used of the long ages of earlier dispensations.

definition: Adjective qaríb "near" in the accusative: near, close at hand; also soon. Root q-r-b.
usage: Near or soon, as in قریباً 'erelong'.
notes: HW "litajidaní qaríban" that thou mayest find Me nigh.

definition: Noun qismat "share, portion, lot" + indefinite -í. Root q-s-m.
usage: A share or portion, often one's lot of God's bounty.

definition: Noun qism (kind, manner) with indefinite -í; ḥattá qismí or bi-qismí ki = to such an extent that. Root q-s-m.
usage: In phrases like بقسمی که 'in such wise that'.

definition: Verb, perfect 2nd masc. sing. of qaṣada: thou didst purpose, head for. Root q-ṣ-d.
usage: To purpose, head for; e.g. setting out toward God or His presence.
notes: Aqdas, address to the Emperor of Austria.

definition: Noun: divine decree, destiny; az qaḍá: by chance, as it happened. Root q-ḍ-y.
usage: 'Divine decree, destiny', as in قضا و قدر 'fate and decree'; in narrative از قضا 'as it happened'.

definition: qaṭrih (drop) + indefinite -í: a drop. Root q-ṭ-r.
usage: A drop; often contrasted with the ocean, the creature against the Creator's grace.
notes: Normalized from قطره‌ئی.

definition: Noun qalb 'heart' (accusative) with suffix -hu 'his'. Root q-l-b.
usage: The heart as seat of faith and divine knowledge, as in Hidden Words' call to purify one's heart.

definition: Persian plural of Arabic qalb 'heart', in construct: the hearts of. Root q-l-b.
Verb: perfect 2nd plural of qála, 'to say': ye said. Root q-w-l.
usage: In Qur'anic verses quoted in the Íqán, e.g. بالّذی قلتم 'with that whereof ye speak'.

definition: Noun qalam 'pen' with 1st singular suffix: My Pen. Root q-l-m.
usage: Bahá'u'lláh's Pen of revelation, as in قلمی الأعلی 'My Most Exalted Pen'.

definition: Plural of qalb 'heart' with pronoun 'your'. Root q-l-b.
Verb, imperative masc. sing. of qáma: arise, stand up. Root q-w-m.
Noun: contentment, being satisfied with little. Root q-n-‘.
usage: قناعت نمودن 'to be content with'; a praised virtue, though in the Íqán also of being content with mere 'dust'.

definition: Plural of qá‘ida: foundations; rules, principles. Root q-‘-d.
usage: ارتفاع قواعد و رسوم 'the abolition of rules and customs'.

definition: Accusative of qawl "word, saying", used adverbially: in word, verbally. Root q-w-l.
usage: Paired with فعلاً "in deed".

definition: Noun qawl 'saying, word' with -hum 'their'. Root q-w-l.
Noun qawm 'people, folk' with -hi: his people. Root q-w-m.
usage: In Qur'anic accounts of the prophets: الملأ ... من قومه 'the chiefs of his people'.

definition: Adverb or predicate 'there is no escape': necessarily, inevitably, must. Root b-d-d.
Arabic lá zála 'has not ceased', used in Persian as an adverb: always, ever. Root z-w-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words: لازال حریص محروم بوده 'the covetous hath ever been deprived'.

definition: Li- 'for' plus iṣghá’ 'listening attentively'. Root ṣ-gh-w.
usage: In افتحوا آذانکم لاصغآء کلمة اللّه 'open your ears to the Word of God'.

definition: Plural of lálih 'tulip' with izáfih: tulips.
usage: E.g. لاله‌های معرفت 'tulips of knowledge'.
notes: Written with a joiner (لاله‌های).

definition: Noun: lip, mouth; also edge.
usage: In the Hidden Words لب نمکینم 'My honeyed lips'; لب گشودن 'to open the lips, speak'.

definition: Clothing, garment, dress; figuratively outward form or appearance. Root l-b-s.
usage: As in لباس اهل علم 'the garb of the learned'.

definition: Preposition li- with bariyya 'creation, creatures' and suffix 'My'. Root b-r-’.
usage: مخاطباً لبریتی 'addressing My creatures'.

definition: Noun: confusion, obscurity, doubt. Root l-b-s.
usage: Qur'anic: بل هم فی لبس من خلق جدید 'yet are they in doubt about a new creation'.

definition: Li- with subjunctive tajida and -ní: that you may find me. Root w-j-d.
usage: HW: لتجدنی قریباً 'that thou mayest find Me near unto thee'.

definition: li- 'so that' plus subjunctive of form X istaráḥa 'to rest, find repose'. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: 'That thou mayest rest'; of the soul finding repose in God.

definition: Verb: li- "so that" plus passive subjunctive of ṣarafa "to spend, expend". Root ṣ-r-f.
usage: To be spent; of funds to be expended, e.g. in Aqdas provisions.
notes: The second context reads li-taṣarrufi’l-qulúb "to take possession of hearts" (form V verbal noun).

definition: Noun: grave, niche in the side of a grave (Arabic laḥd). Root l-ḥ-d.
usage: The grave, often in reminders of mortality.

definition: Noun laḥn "melody, tone" + -í (indefinite in Persian, "my" in Arabic). Root l-ḥ-n.
usage: Melody; the Writings speak of the melodies (الحان) of the Nightingale of Paradise, the voice of revelation.

definition: Adjective ladunní (divine, from God's presence) with -am (my): of My divine (wisdom).
usage: 'My divine' wisdom or knowledge, divinely given, as in حکمت لدنیّه.
notes: Tukhmhá-yi ḥikmat-i ladunníyam = the seeds of My divine wisdom.

definition: li- 'for' + riḍá 'good pleasure' + -í 'my'. Root r-ḍ-w.
usage: 'For My good pleasure'; God's رضا is the believer's highest goal.
notes: Written لرضائی.

definition: Noun lisán 'tongue, language' with indefinite -í: a tongue. Root l-s-n.
usage: 'A tongue', of speech, as in لسانی 'a tongue' to praise God or teach His Cause.

definition: li + ṣadr (breast; chief seat, place of honour): for the place of honour. Root ṣ-d-r.
usage: Breast, chief seat; in the Aqdas صدر of a gathering as the seat of honour.

definition: Preposition li 'for' + ẓuhúr 'appearance, manifestation'. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: Appearance, especially the appearance of a Manifestation, as in ظهور الله 'the Manifestation of God' and لظهوره 'for His Revelation'.

definition: Emphatic particle la- plus qad before a past verb: verily, indeed (it has happened).
Preposition li 'for, to' + al-insán 'man, human being'. Root '-n-s.
usage: Aqdas: ما ینبغی للانسان 'that which beseemeth man', in its teaching on true liberty.

definition: Preposition li- with sámi‘ín 'hearers': for those who hear. Root s-m-‘.
usage: In طوبی للسّامعین 'Well is it with them that hearken'.

definition: Preposition li 'for' and liqá' 'meeting, encounter' with 'My': for meeting Me. Root l-q-y.
usage: لقاء الله 'attainment unto the Presence of God', interpreted in the Íqán as attaining the presence of His Manifestation.

definition: Emphatic la with maẓhar: verily the manifestation, the place of appearing. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: مظهر in the Writings is the Manifestation of God, as in مظهر امر 'Manifestation of the Cause'.
notes: Nominative la-maẓharu.

definition: Preposition لـ with نفس 'self' and 'his': for himself, for itself. Root n-f-s.
usage: In بنفسه لنفسه 'by Itself and for Itself', of the Manifestation's self-sufficiency.

definition: Preposition ل with dual suffix: for the two of them.
Proper noun: Luke, the Evangelist, author of the third Gospel.
Conditional particle lawlá 'were it not for' with -hu: 'but for him'.
Emphatic la- introducing the result clause of law or lawlá, plus kána: (then) it would be, would have been. Root k-w-n.
usage: In the Aqdas لولا المفتاح لکان مکنوناً 'were it not for the key, it would have remained concealed'.

definition: Conjunction: so that, in order that.
Plural of layla 'night'. Root l-y-l.
Plural of lu’lu’ 'pearl' (search form of لئالی). Root l-’-l-’.
usage: In the Aqdas of the laws: قذف لئالی الأحکام 'cast forth the pearls of its laws'.
notes: Aqdas context.

definition: Li- 'so that' plus form V subjunctive: that (fragrance) may be diffused. Root ḍ-w-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas لیتضوّع منکم 'that there may be diffused from you' the fragrance God desires.

definition: li- with subjunctive of thabata: that it may stand firm, endure. Root th-b-t.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words لیثبت نوره الی الابد 'that its light may endure for ever'.
notes: In the Aqdas context read li-yuthbita (form IV, 'to establish').

definition: Particle li- 'so that' with the subjunctive 3rd person plural: that they may thank. Root sh-k-r.
usage: In the Aqdas لیشکروا ربّهم 'that they may give thanks to their Lord'.
