definition: Li "so that" + ya‘lama "he may know" (subjunctive of ‘alima). Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Íqán: لیعلم کلّ اناس مشربهم 'that every people may know their drinking-place'.

definition: Energetic imperfect of kána 'to be', with emphatic la-: 'they shall surely be'. Root k-w-n.
notes: The Íqán context (لیکوننّ سلطاناً) is 3sg m., la-yakúnanna 'He shall surely be'.

definition: Noun: matter, substance; also an item or article. Root m-d-d.
usage: Íqán: مادّهٔ نحاسی 'a substance of copper'.

definition: Pronoun má (we) with 3sg copula: is ours, belongs to us.
Arabic má siwá 'what is other than', used in Persian as a noun with izáfih: all besides, everything other than.
usage: 'All besides (God)'; in the call to detach from ماسوی الله 'all save God'.

definition: Active participle: past, bygone; in grammar the past (perfect) tense. Root m-ḍ-y.
usage: Past, bygone; also the grammatical past tense in discussions of scriptural wording.

definition: Noun mál "property, wealth" with -him: their property, their portion. Root m-w-l.
notes: Aqdas: "We doubled their share".

definition: Verb, present perfect 2nd person plural of mándan: you have remained.
usage: 'You have remained', often of remaining deprived or behind a veil.
notes: dúr mándih-íd ye are far removed.

definition: Feminine adjective (passive participle, form III): blessed, auspicious. Root b-r-k.
usage: Blessed, as in آیهٔ مبارکه 'the blessed verse' and the epithet for holy Tablets.
notes: Final ٴ marks the izáfih.

definition: Verbal noun form III: mutual sale, transaction; also pledge of allegiance. Root b-y-‘.
usage: Transaction, mutual sale; also a pledge of allegiance.

definition: Verb, negative imperative 2nd person plural of burdan 'to carry'; gumán mabarid: do not suppose.
usage: Used in گمان مبرید 'do not suppose', a common admonition.

definition: Form II active participle of b-sh-r (herald, bearer of glad tidings) + "my": my Herald (the Báb).
usage: My Herald, Bahá'u'lláh's title for the Báb, المبشّر.

definition: Negative imperative plural of bastan 'to bind, tie'; dil ma-bandíd 'set not your hearts'.
usage: Used in the counsel دل مبندید 'set not your hearts' on the world.

definition: Verbal noun: following, obedience, adherence. Root t-b-‘.
usage: In the Íqán following a Prophet or His law.

definition: Adjective: attached to, related to, pertaining; feminine of muta‘alliq. Root ‘-l-q.
Active participle (form V), accusative: holding fast, clinging. Root m-s-k.
usage: Holding fast to God or His Cause: متمسّکاً باسمه 'holding fast to His Name'.

definition: Active participle plural form V: those who hold fast, cling, adhere to something. Root m-s-k.
usage: Those who hold fast to a proof or a Cause, as متمسکین بحجت 'those who hold fast to the proof'.

definition: Active participle plural of form V: relying, trusting (upon God). Root w-k-l.
usage: In متوکّلین علی اللّه 'relying upon God'.

definition: Noun: likeness, example, image, pattern. Root m-th-l.
usage: With لا: خمر لا مثال 'the peerless wine'; in Persian also 'example'.
notes: Rendering 'peerless' is for the phrase لا مثال.

definition: Noun: a unit of weight (in the Aqdas 19 nákhuds, about 3.6 grams). Root th-q-l.
usage: In the Aqdas laws of Ḥuqúqu'lláh, dowry and fines, as in تسعة عشر مثقالاً 'nineteen mithqáls'.

definition: Persian mithl "like, equal" with indefinite -í: a likeness, an equal. Root m-th-l.
usage: Of God or the Manifestation having no peer: مثلی و شبهی نداشت.

shift: Here: those who strive in the path of God. Today: fighters, militants.
definition: Plural active participle of jáhada: those who strive, especially in God's path; modern 'fighters'. Root j-h-d.
usage: In the Íqán the true strivers and seekers, as in مجاهدین فی الله 'those who strive for God'.

definition: Passive participle of junna 'to be possessed': mad, possessed, insane; also Majnún, the lover of Laylá. Root j-n-n.
usage: In the Íqán the Qur'anic charge against Muḥammad, شاعر مجنون 'a mad poet'.

definition: Verbal noun: warfare, fighting. Root ḥ-r-b.
Adjective muḥál 'impossible, absurd' with -ast 'is'. Root ḥ-w-l.
Beloved, loved one. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: In the Hidden Words احبّ ان اکون محبوباً 'I love that I be loved' and طلبت محبوباً سوائی 'sought a beloved other than Me'.

definition: Active participle form VIII: burning, burnt. Root ḥ-r-q.
usage: With نمودن 'to burn away', of veils consumed by the fire of the Tree of knowledge.

definition: Passive participle (Arabic feminine with a plural): veiled, screened, shut out. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: In the Writings those veiled from recognising God, as in افکار محجوبه 'veiled minds'.

definition: Newly brought about, invented, contingent; in theology a reprehensible innovation. Form IV passive participle, root ḥ-d-th.
usage: Íqán: امورات محدثه 'these innovations' arising from selfish souls.

definition: Passive participle maḥsúb 'counted, reckoned' with copula -ast. Root ḥ-s-b.
محسوب 'reckoned, counted' with Persian -and 'they are': they are accounted. Root ḥ-s-b.
usage: HW: از اموات محسوبند 'are numbered with the dead'.

definition: Passive participle: married (in Islamic law, of adultery by a married person); also chaste, protected. Root ḥ-ṣ-n.
notes: Also read muḥṣin.

definition: Noun of place from ḥaḍara: presence; assembly, gathering place. Root ḥ-ḍ-r.
usage: 'Presence'; of the presence of God or the Manifestation, as in محضر انور 'the luminous presence'.

definition: Adjective muḥammadí "of Muḥammad" plus Persian -st "is". Root ḥ-m-d.
usage: Is of Muḥammad; in phrases about the Muḥammadan Dispensation.

definition: Active participle form IV (accusative): encompassing, surrounding, all-embracing. Root ḥ-w-ṭ.
usage: All-encompassing, of God's knowledge or power.

definition: Noun, Arabic plural of mukhálif: opponents, adversaries. Root kh-l-f.
usage: Opponents, especially those who oppose the Manifestation or the Cause of God.

definition: Participle (form VIII): specific, restricted or peculiar to. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: Specific or restricted to, e.g. a bounty not restricted to any one people.

definition: Noun of place: storehouse, treasury. Root kh-z-n.
usage: Treasury, storehouse, e.g. the treasuries of divine knowledge.

definition: Passive participle, feminine form: stored, treasured, hidden. Root kh-z-n.
usage: 'Treasured, hidden', as in the Hidden Words' title کلمات مکنونه and in phrases like اسرار مخزونه 'treasured mysteries'.

definition: Passive participle: extinguished, quenched, dead (of a fire). Root kh-m-d.
usage: Extinguished, quenched; of the fire of love or faith dying out.

definition: Active participle (form IV) mudbir 'turning the back' with Persian -and 'they are'. Root d-b-r.
usage: Those who turn away, set against مقبل 'one who turns towards' God and His Cause.

definition: Persian plural of Arabic muddat 'period of time': periods; ba‘d az muddat-há 'after a long time'. Root m-d-d.
Active participle mudrik 'one who perceives, comprehends' (form IV of d-r-k) + Persian -í: any perceiver.
usage: In the Íqán ادراک هر مدرکی 'the comprehension of every understanding heart', beyond which God's essence remains.

definition: Active participle (form VIII): claimant, pretender; plaintiff, adversary. Root d-‘-w.
usage: One who makes a claim, as in مدّعی بآن شده 'hath laid claim to it'.

definition: Passive participle form II: proven, demonstrated by proof. Root d-l-l.
Proper noun: Madyan (Midian), the town where Moses dwelt with Jethro.
usage: In the Hidden Words اصحاب مدین بقا 'the companions of the City of Eternity'; in the Íqán the story of Moses.

definition: Active participle mudh‘in 'submitting, acknowledging' with -and 'they are'. Root dh-‘-n.
usage: Paired with مقرّ, as in مقرّ و مذعنند 'they acknowledge and confess'.

definition: Noun: way, creed, religious school or denomination. Root dh-h-b.
usage: ملّت و مذهب 'religion and creed'.

definition: Persian murád "desire, aim, will" with indefinite -í: a desire, an aim. Root r-w-d.
Active participle (feminine): raised, lofty, established. Root r-f-‘.
Noun: mercy, compassion, kindness; marḥamat farmúdan, to bestow graciously. Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: In the Hidden Words نیسان مرحمت 'the April showers of My mercy'.
notes: In شانه مرحمت فرمودم it means 'I graciously gave'.

definition: Noun, plural of murdih 'dead person': the dead.
usage: In the Íqán's rendering of 'Let the dead bury their dead', the spiritually dead.

definition: Feminine of mardúd 'rejected, repudiated, vain'. Root r-d-d.
Plural of mursal: those sent, messengers, apostles of God. Root r-s-l.
usage: Paired with انبیا or نبیّین: نبیّین و مرسلین 'Prophets and Messengers'.

definition: Passive participle, accusative: written, inscribed, recorded. Root r-q-m.
usage: Aqdas formula کان الامر من قلم الوحی بالحق مرقوما 'inscribed by the Pen of Revelation'.

definition: Verbal noun: passing, going by, passage. Root m-r-r.
usage: In the Hidden Words نسیم عنایت من بر تو مرور نمود 'the breeze of My loving-kindness passed over thee'.

definition: Causing doubt or suspicion, disquieting. Form IV active participle, root r-y-b.
usage: Qur'anic phrase in the Íqán: انّنا لفی شکّ ممّا تدعونا الیه مریب 'we are in disquieting doubt about that to which thou callest us'.

definition: Active participle of form X: seeking proof, arguing; مستدل شدن 'to adduce as proof'. Root d-l-l.
usage: Of divines who argued against the Báb: بدلائلی چند مستدلّ شدند.

definition: Adjective: very difficult, arduous, hard to grasp. Root ṣ-‘-b.
usage: In the tradition حدیثنا صعب مستصعب 'our words are difficult, perplexing'.

definition: Passive participle: He Who is invoked for help; a Bábí term for the coming of the Promised One. Root gh-w-th.
usage: In the Báb's writings, the time of Mustagháth (numerically 2001) marks the advent of Him Whom God shall make manifest.

definition: Active participle of form X istaqalla: independent, self-standing. Root q-l-l.
usage: 'Independent'; in phrases like the independent investigation of truth and an independent revelation.

definition: Active participle (form X): straight, upright; ṣiráṭ-i mustaqím "the straight path". Root q-w-m.
usage: Straight, upright; in ṣiráṭ-i mustaqím 'the straight Path'.

definition: Active participle form IV: one who exceeds bounds, prodigal, transgressor. Root s-r-f.
usage: One who exceeds bounds or is prodigal; in the Qur'an and the Writings a transgressor.
notes: Qur'an 40:28 "man huwa musrifun kadhdhábun".

definition: Passive participle (form II, feminine): handed over, delivered, paid. Root s-l-m.
usage: In the Aqdas's law of blood money, دیة مسلّمة 'blood money to be paid', echoing Qur'an 4:92.
notes: diyatun musallamatun a fine to be paid.

definition: Passive participle (form II): named, specified, appointed (of a term). Root s-m-w.
usage: Appointed or fixed, as in اجل مسمّی 'an appointed term'.
notes: Ilá ajalin musamman = to an appointed term.

definition: Noun of place: dwelling, abode; with namúdan 'to dwell'. Root s-k-n.
usage: Dwelling, abode; e.g. the heart as God's dwelling.

definition: Arabic mushriq 'shining, radiant' (form IV participle) + Persian -ast 'is'. Root sh-r-q.
usage: 'Shining, radiant', of the Sun of Truth dawning, as in مشرق 'shining' from the horizon of God's will.

definition: Persian plural of mushrik: those who join partners with God, idolaters. Root sh-r-k.
usage: Those who join partners with God; rendered "infidels" or "idolaters".

definition: Feminine of mushrik (agreeing with anfus): idolatrous, joining partners with God. Root sh-r-k.
usage: Idolatrous, of souls who join partners with God or reject His Manifestation.

definition: Passive participle: famous, well-known, renowned; feminine agreeing with a plural noun. Root sh-h-r.
usage: In the Íqán کتب مشهوره 'well-known books'.

definition: Adjective: difficult, obscure, perplexing; feminine of mushkil. Root sh-k-l.
usage: مسائل مشکله 'abstruse questions' which the divines could not solve.

definition: Noun: will, volition, especially the divine Will. Root sh-y-'.
usage: The Primal Will of God, as in سماء مشیّة ربّکم 'the heaven of your Lord's Will'.

definition: Passive participle: spent, devoted, applied to. Root ṣ-r-f.
Verb, perfect 3rd fem. sing. of maḍá: passed, went by, were spent. Root m-ḍ-y.
Active participle (fem.): agitated, troubled, disturbed. Root ḍ-r-b.
usage: In انفس مضطربه 'troubled souls'.

definition: Noun: racecourse, arena, field of contest. Root ḍ-m-r.
usage: مضمار الحکمة و التبیان 'the arena of wisdom and utterance'.

definition: Verb maḍá, to pass, elapse, go by. Root m-ḍ-y.
Active participle (feminine): shining, luminous, resplendent. Root ḍ-w-'.
Feminine active participle of iṭma’anna: tranquil, at peace, assured. Root ṭ-m-’-n.
usage: Qur'anic نفس مطمئنّه 'the soul at rest' (89:27); in the Íqán قلوب مطمئنّه 'assured hearts'.
notes: Spelled مطمئنّه; the search form writes ئ as ی.

definition: Active participle: obedient, submissive. Root ṭ-w-‘.
Passive participle of form II ‘abbara: expressed, denoted, referred to as. Root ‘-b-r.
usage: In the Íqán in معبّر گشتن به 'to be designated as'.

definition: Esteemed, reputable, valid, authoritative. Root ‘-b-r.
Active participle form VIII with Persian -and: they acknowledge, confess. Root ‘-r-f.
Noun: miracle, a wonder that disables opponents. Root ‘-j-z.
usage: In the Íqán the demand for miracles is a recurring objection; Bahá'u'lláh holds the revealed verses to be the greatest proof.

definition: Counted, numbered; few, limited in number. Root ‘-d-d.
usage: As in غیر محدود و معدود 'without limit or number'.

definition: Passive participle ma‘rúf 'known, renowned' with copula -ast. Root ‘-r-f.
Plural of معضلة: thorny problems, perplexities. Root ‘-ḍ-l.
usage: Íqán: معضلات مسائل الهیّه 'the abstruse questions of divine knowledge'.

definition: Passive participle: exalted, honoured, great. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
ma‘lúm 'known, evident' plus -ast 'is': it is evident, it is known. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: 'It is evident'; introduces a self-evident statement in reasoning.

definition: Passive participle: done, practised, customary; ma‘múl dáshtan "to practise". Root ‘-m-l.
usage: Practised, customary; ma‘múl dáshtan 'to practise', of laws or customs.

definition: Noun ma‘ná "meaning" with Persian indefinite -í: a meaning, a sense. Root ‘-n-y.
usage: Meaning or inner sense of words of scripture.

definition: Preposition ma‘a "with" + -í "me": with me.
Passive participle (fem.): forgiven, pardoned. Root gh-f-r.
usage: Forgiven, as in sins being forgiven by God's grace.

definition: Passive participle (fem.): fettered, chained up. Root gh-l-l.
usage: Fettered; alludes to Qur'án 5:64, the claim that 'the hand of God is chained up', which the Íqán refutes.
notes: Quran 5:64 yadu’lláhi maghlúlatun.

definition: Noun mafarr 'place of flight, escape' with indefinite -í: any escape. Root f-r-r.
usage: 'Any escape', as in no escape (مفرّی) from the decree of God.

definition: Plural of maqálah: sayings, discourses, statements. Root q-w-l.
usage: Sayings, discourses; of the statements of divines and of the Prophets.

definition: Noun maqám 'station, rank, place', indefinite accusative. Root q-w-m.
usage: Station or rank, often spiritual stations and the station of the Manifestation, as in مقاماً محموداً 'a praiseworthy station'.

definition: Arabic plural of maqám 'station, rank' with Persian -ast 'is'. Root q-w-m.
usage: مقام is a station or spiritual rank; the Íqán explains the differing words of the Prophets by their different stations.

definition: Active participle of aqbala: turning towards, facing. Root q-b-l.
usage: مقبل 'one who turns' to God, often 'the faithful', opposed to معرض 'one who turns away'; یقعد مقبلاً الی اللّه 'let him sit turned towards God'.

definition: Passive participle maqbúl 'accepted, acceptable' with است: is acceptable. Root q-b-l.
Passive participle plural form II: the holy, the sanctified ones. Root q-d-s.
Passive participle of form II: placed first, preferred, foremost. Root q-d-m.
Passive participle plural: those brought near (to God), the favoured ones. Root q-r-b.
usage: Of Prophets and saints, as in انبیای مقرّبین 'the favoured Prophets'.

definition: Active participle مقر 'acknowledging' with Persian -and: they acknowledge. Root q-r-r.
usage: مذعن و مقرند 'acknowledge and confess'.

definition: Plural active participle of form IV aqarra: those who acknowledge, confess, affirm. Root q-r-r.
Passive participle (feminine): cut into pieces; disconnected; tailored. Root q-ṭ-‘.
usage: حروف مقطّعه 'the disconnected letters' opening some súras of the Qur'an.
notes: In البسهٔ مقطّعه it means cut, tailored garments.

definition: Construct plural of muláqí, active participle of form III láqá: meeting, those who will meet. Root l-q-y.
usage: The Íqán cites Qur'an 2:46 on 'meeting' God (لقاء الله), interpreted as attaining the presence of His Manifestation.
notes: The final alif is orthographic.

definition: Noun malá’ikah 'angels' (plural of malak) with -hu 'his'. Root m-l-k.
usage: In the Íqán's Arabic Gospel quotation و یرسل ملائکته 'and He shall send His angels'.
notes: Written ملائکته.

shift: Here: a religion or religious community. Today: a nation, a people.
definition: Noun: religion, religious community; in modern Persian 'nation, people'. Root m-l-l.
usage: In the Writings usually a religion or religious community, as ملّت و مذهب 'religion and creed'.

definition: Cursed, accursed. Root l-‘-n.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words ملعون انت 'accursed art thou'.

definition: Passive participle, accusative: extended, stretched out. Root m-d-d.
usage: Of the outstretched shadow and the path laid out (صراط ... ممدودا).

definition: Noun, plural of manzil: stopping places, stages of a journey, dwellings. Root n-z-l.
usage: In mystical usage stages of the spiritual journey, as in منازل هفتادساله 'the stages of seventy years'.

definition: The Bestower of favours, the Most Bountiful; a name of God. Root m-n-n.
usage: As in جمال حضرت منّان 'the beauty of the All-Bountiful'.

definition: Plural of manhaj: clear paths, ways, methods. Root n-h-j.
usage: مناهج العلم و الحکمة 'the paths of knowledge and wisdom'.

definition: Adjective: spread out, extended, all-pervading. Root b-s-ṭ.
usage: Íqán: رحمت منبسطه 'His all-encompassing mercy'.

definition: Noun: end, utmost limit, extremity. Root n-h-y.
Past passive, second person masculine plural, of mana‘a 'to forbid, prevent'. Root m-n-‘.
usage: 'Ye were forbidden'; in Aqdas passages on what was forbidden in earlier laws.

definition: Noun man‘ "prevention, hindering" plus Persian suffix -ash "him, his". Root m-n-‘.
usage: Hinder him; man‘ 'prevention', ordinary noun.

definition: Active participle form VII: separated, detached; negated, never ceasing. Root f-k-k.
usage: Separated; negated (منفک نشدن) it means never ceasing or inseparable.

definition: Verb, negative imperative 2nd person singular of namúdan: do not (do); auxiliary in compound verbs.
usage: Auxiliary in negative commands of compound verbs in the Persian Hidden Words, e.g. 'do not turn away'.
notes: farámúshash manumá forget it not.

definition: Active participle (form IV): one who denies or rejects. Root n-k-r.
usage: A denier or rejecter, especially of the Manifestation of God.
notes: Munkar = reprehensible is a different reading.

definition: Plural active participle form IV: deniers, rejecters. Root n-k-r.
usage: Deniers, those who reject the Manifestation of God.

definition: Adjective munír 'luminous, radiant' with suffix -ash 'his, its'. Root n-w-r.
usage: 'Luminous', as in قامت منیرش 'its luminous form', of the radiance of the beloved or of the Manifestation.
notes: qámat-i-munírash: its luminous form.

definition: munír (luminous, enlightened) + -shán (their). Root n-w-r.
usage: Their luminous; describes hearts or souls illumined by the light of God.

definition: Persian plural of muhájir 'emigrant, one who forsakes his home'. Root h-j-r.
usage: Emigrants for God's sake, recalling the Prophet's companions and the exiles of the Cause.

definition: Participle: watching over, guarding, dominant over all; al-Muhaymin, a divine name.
usage: A divine name, as in المهیمن القیّوم 'the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting'; also 'supreme over'.

definition: Relative adjective from Músá 'Moses': Mosaic, of Moses.
usage: طلعت موسوی 'the Person of Moses'; نار موسوی 'the fire of Moses' (the Burning Bush).

definition: Noun of place: place, spot; in a text, a passage. Root w-ḍ-‘.
usage: In the Íqán در موضع دیگر 'in another passage' introducing quotations.

definition: Noun mawlá 'lord, master' with pronoun 'his'. Root w-l-y.
usage: مولی الوری 'the Lord of all men' is a divine title.

definition: Noun, plural of makman: hiding places, hidden retreats. Root k-m-n.
Active participle plural: those who give the lie, deniers, rejecters. Root k-dh-b.
usage: Of those rejecting the signs, as in مکذّبین آیات 'deniers of the verses'.

definition: Passive participle, form II: repeated; as adverb, repeatedly. Root k-r-r.
Active participle of form II kammala: completing, perfecting, one who completes. Root k-m-l.
Noun of place: hiding place, hidden retreat. Root k-m-n.
usage: As in مکمن قرب 'the hidden retreat of nearness'.

definition: Passive participle of kanna 'to conceal', accusative: hidden, concealed, treasured. Root k-n-n.
usage: Common for hidden mysteries: سرّ مکنون 'the hidden secret', کنز مکنون 'the hidden treasure'.

definition: Negative imperative 2nd plural of kardan 'to do': do not.
Negative imperative of giriftan 'to take'; in compounds وطن گرفتن 'to dwell', الفت گرفتن 'to befriend'.
Dead; a dead person. Root m-w-t.
usage: In the tradition in the Íqán قد اشتری میّت عن میّت 'a dead man hath bought from a dead man'.

definition: Adjective, accusative: dead. Root m-w-t.
usage: Qur'an 6:122 أو من کان میتاً فأحییناه 'Can he who was dead, whom We have quickened...'.
notes: In the Aqdas context (dead game) read maytan.

definition: Verb, present 3rd person singular of khándan: calls, summons; also reads, recites.
notes: Here 'summons': مردم را بانقطاع تمام میخواند.

definition: Past continuous 3pl of دانستن "to know; consider": they knew, they deemed.
Present 2nd person plural of راندن 'to drive, ride, urge on'; with بر زبان 'to utter'.
usage: بر زبان میرانید 'ye utter with your tongue'; بر مراکب نار میرانید 'ye ride upon steeds of fire'.

definition: Persian verb رساندن 'cause to reach, bring', present: brings to.
Present 2pl of shanídan: you hear.
Present tense, second person singular, of shudan 'to become': thou becomest.
usage: 'Thou becomest'; auxiliary use with adjectives.

definition: Verb: present 3rd singular of vazídan "to blow" (of wind or breezes).
usage: Blows; of the breezes of God (nasá'im) that blow upon the world.

definition: Verb kardan "to do, make", present 2nd plural: you do; "mushahidih míkuníd" ye observe.
Verb, past progressive 3rd person plural of gashtan: they became; turned, wandered.
usage: Auxiliary meaning 'became' in compound verbs; also 'turned, wandered'.

definition: Past continuous 3rd sing. of guftan: he or she was saying, would say.
Present 3rd sing. of giriftan 'to take, seize'; furú giriftan 'to envelop'.
Arabic nár 'fire' + indefinite -í + Persian -st 'is': is a fire. Root n-w-r.
usage: 'Is a fire', in the image of the tongue as a smouldering fire, from the counsels against backbiting.
notes: zabán náríst afsurdih: the tongue is a smouldering fire.

definition: Active participle (Arabic náshi'): arising, originating, resulting from. Root n-sh-'.
usage: Arising or resulting from; in ناشی از "stemming from".

definition: Active participle: deficient, imperfect, incomplete. Root n-q-ṣ.
usage: Deficient, set against کامل 'perfect'.

definition: Noun: moaning, wailing, lament.
usage: With نمودن or کردن: ناله نمودن 'to lament'.

definition: Noun: wailing, moaning, lament.
usage: نالهٴ سحرگاهی فقرا 'the midnight sighing of the poor'.
notes: ٴ marks the izáfih (nálih-yi).

definition: Persian past participle of námídan 'to name, call': named, called.
Noun: tidings, news, announcement. Root n-b-'.
usage: The divine Message; النبأ العظیم 'the Great Announcement' is a title of the Revelation.

definition: Verb, negative present subjunctive of bakhshídan: does not give or bestow.
Verb: he threw away, cast aside, rejected. Root n-b-dh.
usage: In the Aqdas: من نبذ الوری 'he who hath cast away the world'; also نبذ ... وراء ظهره 'cast behind his back'.

definition: Negative past participle of بردن: not having carried; with فیض 'without having partaken'. Persian.
usage: از نغمهٔ ورقا فیض نبرده 'without having partaken of the melody of the Dove'.

definition: Negative past of بودن "to be": they were not.
Negative present of توانستن 'to be able': 'he/she cannot'.
Imperfect 1st person plural of form V takallama: we speak. Root k-l-m.
usage: A tradition in the Íqán: نحن نتکلّم بکلمة 'We speak one word ...'; in the Aqdas لو نتکلّم 'were We to speak'.

definition: Verb ja‘ala 'to make, appoint' 1st plural subjunctive with -hum 'them'. Root j-‘-l.
usage: Qur'anic و نجعلهم ائمّة و نجعلهم الوارثین 'and make them leaders and make them heirs'.

definition: Negative present 2nd singular of dáshtan 'to have'.
Negative present perfect of dáshtan 'to have': they have not had.
Negative present of دانستن: they do not know; also do not consider.
notes: In the second context از اهل ایمان ندانند 'do not count among the faithful'.

definition: Verb, negative present perfect 3rd person plural of dídan: they have not seen.
notes: Written with a joiner as ندیده‌اند.

definition: Warner, one who warns; a Qur'anic title of prophets. Root n-dh-r.
usage: Qur'an 25:7 in the Íqán: فیکون معه نذیراً 'to be a warner with him'.

definition: Imperfect 1st person plural of ra’á 'to see' with suffix 'you'. Root r-’-y.
usage: نراکم من افقی الابهی 'We behold you from Our Most Glorious Horizon'.

definition: Persian verb رسیدن 'reach', negative subjunctive: may not reach.
Negative past of rasídan: did not reach, did not arrive.
Negative past tense, third person plural, of rasídan 'to reach, attain': they did not reach.
usage: 'They did not reach'; of those who did not attain recognition of the Manifestation.

definition: Verb: negative subjunctive 3rd plural of sákhtan "to make"; with maḥrúm "not deprive".
usage: Make not; with maḥrúm 'deprive', as in prayers not to be deprived of grace.

definition: Verb nasiya "to forget", perfect 3rd masculine plural: they forgot. Root n-s-y.
usage: 'They forgot', often of those who forgot God or His Covenant.
notes: ka’lladhína nasu’lláh like those who forgot God.

definition: Noun: forgetfulness, oblivion. Root n-s-y.
usage: Forgetfulness, especially of God; paired with غفلت 'heedlessness'.

definition: Negative present 3rd sing. of shanídan: does not hear; of fragrances, does not smell.
usage: From شنیدن 'to hear'; also used of not perceiving fragrance, as of those who perceive not the fragrance of God.

definition: Negative subjunctive 1st sing. of shudan 'to become'.
Verb, negative present subjunctive 2nd person singular of shudan 'to become': (that) thou be not.
Noun: toil, fatigue, weariness. Root n-ṣ-b.
usage: Toil, weariness; Qur'anic, as in God's not being touched by weariness.
notes: Lá naṣabun wa lá lughúb: neither toil nor weariness.

definition: Verbal noun: setting up, erecting, installing, appointing. Root n-ṣ-b.
usage: Setting up, appointing; used of appointing an official or erecting a sign.

definition: Verbal noun: sincere advice, counsel, admonition. Root n-ṣ-ḥ.
usage: Sincere counsel, as in Bahá'u'lláh's counsels to the kings and peoples.

definition: Noun naṣíb 'share, portion, lot' with indefinite -í. Root n-ṣ-b.
usage: One's portion of divine grace, e.g. از این کأس نصیبی نیست 'have no portion of this cup'.

definition: Verb: imperfect 1st plural of aẓhara 'to manifest', with suffix -hu: We manifest him/it. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: من نظهره 'Him Whom We shall manifest', i.e. Him Whom God shall make manifest; ما نظهره 'that which We shall manifest'.

definition: Arabic verb, passive perfect of nafakha: was blown, was breathed. Root n-f-kh.
usage: Qur'anic نفخ فی الصّور 'the trumpet is blown'; the Aqdas speaks of the spirit breathed into the Pen.

definition: Verb form II: to separate, make a distinction between. Root f-r-q.
usage: From Qur'án 2:285 لا نفرق بین احد من رسله 'We make no distinction between any of His Messengers', cited for the oneness of the Prophets.

definition: Verb, negative past 3rd pl. of farmúdan 'to say, command' (respectful).
usage: فرمودن is used of God, the Prophets and the Imams.

definition: Negative past participle of فرمودن, the honorific 'to do, say, command'.
usage: فرمودن replaces کردن/گفتن for God and holy persons, as in ذکر فرمودند 'He mentioned'.

definition: Adjective: of the carnal self, sensual, selfish. Root n-f-s.
usage: Describes the lower self, as in غفلت نفسانیه 'selfish heedlessness'.

definition: Noun nafs "soul, self" with suffix "her": her soul, herself. Root n-f-s.
Persian plural of nafs 'soul, self': souls; the final ی links the izáfih. Root n-f-s.
Persian plural of nafas 'breath': breaths. Root n-f-s.
notes: As in نفسهای انفس مشرکه 'the breaths of idolatrous souls'.

definition: Perfect 3rd person masculine singular of nafa‘a 'to profit, benefit' with -hu: it profited him. Root n-f-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas ما نفعه حرف منها 'not a letter thereof profited him'.

definition: Noun: expenditure, maintenance, support. Root n-f-q.
usage: In the Aqdas a husband's duty to provide نفقة سنة کاملة 'a full year's maintenance'.

definition: Noun: dot, point; in the Writings a title of a Manifestation. Root n-q-ṭ.
usage: نقطهٔ اولی 'the Primal Point' (the Báb), نقطهٔ فرقان 'the Point of the Qur'án' (Muḥammad).
notes: Spelled with final ە (U+06D5) in the source.

definition: Form VIII imperfect: We test, try, prove. Root m-ḥ-n.
usage: In the Hidden Words بالنّار نمتحن الذّهب و بالذّهب نمتحن العباد 'Gold is tested by fire, and by gold We test Our servants'.

definition: Proper noun: Nimrod, the tyrant king who opposed Abraham.
usage: The archetype of the tyrant who opposes a Manifestation.

definition: Infinitive: to do, make (light verb in compounds); also to show.
usage: In Bahá'í Persian the usual light verb for کردن, as in تفسیر نمودن 'to interpret'.

definition: Negative present 3sg of آمدن "to come"; with صادق "to be not true of, not apply".
usage: As in صادق نمیآید 'is not true of it'.

definition: Negative present of دانستن 'to know'.
Persian auxiliary نمودن 'do', negative past continuous: would not do.
Negative present of kardan: does not do; forms negative compound verbs.
Negative present subjunctive, second person singular, of namúdan 'to do, make' (auxiliary): (that) thou do not.
usage: Negative auxiliary, as in prohibitions such as غفلت ننمایی 'be not heedless'.

definition: Verb: negative subjunctive 1st plural of namúdan, formal light verb "to do".
usage: We do not do; formal light verb namúdan, where everyday Persian has kardan.
notes: Normalized from ننمائیم.

definition: Noun: shame, disgrace; "nang dáshtan" to be ashamed of.
usage: Shame or disgrace, often of what dishonours the human station.

definition: Verb, past 3rd person singular of nihádan: put, placed, set; qadam nihádan to step.
usage: To place or set, as in قدم نهادن 'to set foot (on a path)', a frequent image of the seeker's journey.
notes: Also a noun "nature, disposition".

definition: Noun: end, limit, extremity; má lá niháyih = the infinite. Root n-h-y.
usage: End or limit, as in ما لانهایه 'the infinite'; of God's bounty without end.

definition: Verb, perfect 1st pl. of nahá + -kum: We forbade you. Root n-h-y.
usage: 'We forbade you', in the prohibitions of the Aqdas.

definition: Noun: melody, song, tune; also provision, means.
usage: 'Melody, song', of the melody of the Nightingale of holiness, the voice of the Manifestation.
notes: Final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Noun: turn, occasion, one's time in a sequence. Root n-w-b.
usage: Turn, occasion; used of each Manifestation's turn in the succession of Revelations.

definition: Feminine adjective: shining, luminous; bi-qulúbin nawrá’a 'with radiant hearts'. Root n-w-r.
usage: Radiant or luminous, as in قلوب نوراء 'radiant hearts'.

definition: Past participle of nivishtan 'to write': written.
Verb: past 3rd singular of núshídan, 'to drink'; after باید the short infinitive 'one must drink'.
usage: Of drinking spiritual wine or water: صهبای انقطاع 'the wine of renunciation'.

definition: Persian verb, 3rd plural present perfect of núshídan 'to drink': they have drunk.
Phrase: na 'not', chunán 'so, such' and ast 'is': it is not so, it is not such.
notes: Usually written نه چنانست.

definition: Verb, negative present perfect 3rd pl. of gudháshtan 'to put'; قدم گذاشتن 'to set foot'.
notes: Written as one word in the source (نگذاشته‌اند).

definition: Negative subjunctive of گردیدن 'to become': that I not become.
Negative past of گشتن 'to become, to turn': did not become, was not. Persian.
usage: مشهود نگشت 'was not seen'.

definition: Negative subjunctive of یافتن "to find": (that/until) they not find.
Negative present of یافتن 'to find': 'thou findest not'.
Negative simple past 3rd person singular of yáftan 'to find'; with nouns it forms phrases: did not attain, did not last.
Negative past participle or perfect of ámadan 'to come'.
usage: With بظهور, 'hath not appeared'.

definition: Negative past 3rd singular of ávardan 'to bring'; with ثمر 'to yield fruit'.
Dual of nayyir 'luminary': the two lights, sun and moon. Root n-w-r.
usage: In the Íqán of Shaykh Aḥmad and Siyyid Káẓim, نورین نیّرین 'twin resplendent lights'.

definition: Relative adjective from Nísán (April): vernal, of the spring rain.
usage: E.g. غیث نیسانی 'vernal showers' of divine mercy.

definition: Proper noun: Aaron, brother of Moses.
usage: In the Íqán in Qur'an 19:28 یا اخت هارون 'O sister of Aaron', addressed to Mary.

definition: Hidáyat "guidance" with indefinite -í: a guidance. Root h-d-y.
usage: Persian rendering of Qur'an 2:2 in the Íqán: هدایتی است برای پرهیزکاران 'a guidance unto the God-fearing'.

definition: Verbal noun: demolition, destruction; of customs, abolition. Root h-d-m.
usage: نسخ و هدم رسومات 'abrogation and abolition of customs' at each new Revelation.

definition: Perfect of hadama 'to demolish, tear down'. Root h-d-m.
usage: In a tradition quoted in the Íqán: کما هدم رسول الله امر الجاهلیة 'as the Apostle of God abolished the ways of the days of ignorance'.

definition: Persian adverb: surely, certainly, verily.
usage: Used in translating Qur'anic emphatic particles.

definition: Numeral: seventy, the number 70.
Past tense, third person masculine singular: to perish, die, be destroyed. Root h-l-k.
usage: 'Perished'; of peoples destroyed for denying the Messengers.

definition: Adverb/preposition: like, such as, thus.
usage: Like, such as; bookish word for 'like, thus'.

definition: Noun: air, atmosphere, sky. Root h-w-y.
usage: Air, atmosphere or sky; هوای قرب 'the atmosphere of nearness' in mystical imagery.
notes: Not to be confused with hawá "desire".

definition: Noun hawá "desire, caprice" + -hu "his": his desire. Root h-w-y.
usage: Selfish desire; in Qur'anic and Bahá'í usage one who follows his own desire (هواه) instead of God's will.

definition: Proper noun: Húd, an ancient Arabian prophet; title of Súrah 11 of the Qur'án.
usage: Húd, a prophet of the Qur'án; cited in the Íqán among Prophets rejected by their peoples.

definition: Noun: predominance, sovereign power, ascendancy. Root h-y-m-n.
usage: Ascendancy, sovereign dominion, of God's Cause or power.

definition: Interjection: far be it, how far, impossible!
notes: Often doubled: hayháta hayháta.

definition: Adjective (feminine of vási‘): wide, vast, all-embracing. Root w-s-‘.
usage: Vast, all-embracing; of God's mercy, رحمت واسعه "all-embracing mercy".

definition: Feminine of váfí: complete, ample, sufficient. Root w-f-y.
usage: Complete or ample, as in بهرهٔ وافیه 'an ample portion'.

definition: Active participle: occurring, happening; as a noun, an event or incident. Root w-q-‘.
usage: In the Íqán امور واقعه 'events that occurred', حکایات واقعه 'accounts of past events'.

definition: Plural of váqif 'standing; acquainted with, aware of'. Root w-q-f.
usage: واقفین اسرار 'those initiated into the mysteries'.

definition: Arabic oath formula wa + Alláh: by God! I swear by God.
usage: An oath of emphasis in Persian prose of the Writings.

definition: Noun: face, aspect, way; here a meaning or sense. Root w-j-h.
usage: Tradition لکل علم سبعون وجهاً 'every knowledge hath seventy meanings'; وجه الله 'the Face of God'.

definition: Noun wujúd 'existence, being' with 3rd masc. suffix: His being. Root w-j-d.
usage: In the Íqán وجوده اثباته 'His being is His proof'.

definition: Noun, plural of wajh 'face', with 'your (pl.)'. Root w-j-h.
usage: In ولّوا وجوهکم 'turn your faces', of the Qiblih.

definition: Noun: fear, dread, dismay; desolation. Root w-ḥ-sh.
Noun: deposit, trust, something entrusted. Root w-d-‘.
usage: ودیعه گذاشتن "to deposit, entrust"; ودیعهٔ ربّانیّه "a divine trust".

definition: Preposition: behind, beyond; از ورای 'from behind'. Root w-r-y.
Perfect 3rd person masculine singular of warada: arrived, came; with ‘alá, befell. Root w-r-d.
usage: In the Aqdas ما ورد علینا 'what hath befallen Us'.
notes: Not ward 'rose' or wird 'litany'.

definition: Past participle or perfect of vazídan 'to blow (of wind)'.
usage: Of divine breezes, as in نسمة اللّه وزیده 'the breeze of God hath wafted'.

definition: Perfect 1st plural of form II waṣṣá 'to enjoin, counsel' with -kum 'you'. Root w-ṣ-y.
Waṭan 'homeland, native place' with -hi: his home. Root w-ṭ-n.
usage: In the Aqdas law on travel: من اراد الخروج من وطنه 'whoso desireth to leave his home'.

definition: Oath formula wa + ‘amr + -í: by My life! Root ‘-m-r.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words وعمری 'By My life!'.

definition: Noun: death, decease. Root w-f-y.
Perfect of wafá "to fulfil, keep (a promise)"; with bi: fulfilled. Root w-f-y.
usage: Aqdas: وفی بالوعد 'fulfilled the promise', of those who keep their appointed term.

definition: Noun: province, region, homeland; also guardianship, sainthood. Root w-l-y.
notes: First context (ولایت پدرم) reads best as 'my father's province'; see the second row for the religious sense.

definition: Noun: guardianship, vicegerency, divine friendship (sainthood), especially of the Imams. Root w-l-y.
usage: In the Íqán among the stations of the Manifestation: ربوبیّت و نبوّت و رسالت و ولایت و امامت.

definition: Noun: children, offspring, descendants. Root w-l-d.
usage: من ولد فلان 'of the descendants of so-and-so'.
notes: May also be read waladi 'child'.

definition: Noun pidar (father) with 'my': my father.
Superlative of past 'low, base, mean': lowest, basest, most contemptible.
usage: 'Lowest, basest'; of the basest conditions, e.g. the lowest of men.
notes: Hidden Words: 'The basest of men are they that yield no fruit on earth'.

definition: Verb: present perfect 3rd plural of púshídan "to cover, wear"; chashm púshídan "to close one's eyes, renounce".
usage: Have closed, have covered; chashm púshídan 'to close one's eyes', i.e. to renounce or ignore.
notes: Normalized from پوشیده‌اند.

definition: Past participle of píchídan: twisted, rolled up, folded.
Active participle: lying, false; a liar. Root k-dh-b.
usage: False or lying; of false claimants and the false dawn (صبح کاذب).

definition: Interjection: would that, if only; ay kásh = O would that.
usage: Would that, as in ای کاش, expressing longing or regret.

definition: Káfí 'sufficient' + ast 'is': is enough, suffices. Root k-f-y.
usage: Is sufficient; e.g. a proof or sign that suffices.

definition: Active participle, feminine form: sufficient, adequate. Root k-f-y.
usage: 'Sufficient', as in حجّت کافیه 'a sufficient proof', of the Revelation's evidence.
notes: ḥujjat-i-káfiyih: a sufficient proof.

definition: Noun: sulphur, brimstone; "kibrít-i aḥmar" red sulphur, the philosopher's stone.
usage: Sulphur; کبریت احمر "red sulphur", the philosopher's stone, symbol of a rare transforming power.
notes: Rendering refers to the phrase with aḥmar.

definition: Noun kitáb 'book, record', indefinite accusative. Root k-t-b.
usage: Book or record, often the Book of God or a decree written, as in کتاباً 'a Book'.

definition: Arabic kitáb 'book, scripture' with Persian -ast 'is'. Root k-t-b.
usage: In نصّ کتابست 'it is the text of the Book', i.e. the Qur'an.

definition: Verb: perfect 2nd plural of kadhdhaba, 'to call a liar, to deny'. Root k-dh-b.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse quoted in the Íqán: ففریقاً کذّبتم و فریقاً تقتلون 'some ye accused of imposture, and others ye slew'.

definition: Persian adjective: deaf.
usage: Hidden Words: کر شو 'become deaf', to all save God's word.

definition: Plural of karrúbí: the cherubim, angels nearest to God.
usage: Spiritual beings or holy souls near to God.

definition: Adjective: noble, generous, bountiful; a name of God. Root k-r-m.
Verb imperative: break ye, shatter ye. Root k-s-r.
usage: In the Aqdas: کسّروا الصّحیح الظّالم 'crush the oppressor who flourisheth'.

definition: Noun: shroud, winding-sheet. Root k-f-n.
usage: دفن و کفن 'burial and shrouding'.

definition: Plural of kalb: dogs. Root k-l-b.
usage: In the Writings a figure of the enemies of the holy, as in کلاب ارض "the dogs of the earth".

definition: Plural kalimát 'words' with indefinite -í and است 'is': 'they are words (which...)'. Root k-l-m.
Noun kalima 'word' with -í: My Word. Root k-l-m.
usage: In the Aqdas ارتفاع کلمتی 'the exaltation of My Word'; cf. کلمة الله 'the Word of God'.

definition: Noun kull 'all' with -kum 'you': all of you. Root k-l-l.
Plural of kanz 'treasure, hoard' (search form of کنائز). Root k-n-z.
usage: In کنائز امری 'the treasuries of My Cause'.

definition: Short. دست کوتاه نمودن 'to withhold one's hand'.
usage: In the Hidden Words از ظلم دست خود را کوتاه نمائید 'stay the hand of tyranny'.

definition: Plural of kaynúna: beings, essences, inner realities. Root k-w-n.
usage: Íqán کینونات قدیمه 'these ancient Beings', of the Manifestations.

definition: Noun: being, existence, essential self. Root k-w-n.
usage: In the Writings the essential being of God or the Manifestation, as in کینونة ازلی 'the eternal Being'.

definition: Present 2sg of گذاشتن or گذاردن "to put, place"; with قدم "to set foot".
usage: Íqán: اگر قدری بعوالم انقطاع قدم گذاری 'if thou set foot in the realms of detachment'.

definition: Present subjunctive of گذاشتن 'to put, set, place'; قدم گذاریم 'set foot', فرق گذاریم 'distinguish'.
Persian verb گذشتن 'pass; give up', past: they passed, renounced.
usage: Íqán: از کون و امکان در سبیل جانان گذشتند 'renounced the world for the Beloved'.

definition: Past participle of giriftan: taken, seized; with farú or ghubár, enveloped, covered.
Present perfect, third person plural, of giriftan 'to take'; with a predicate 'have taken as, regarded as'.
usage: 'Have taken (as)'; as in those who have taken idols or the world as their goal.

definition: Noun: warmth, heat (from garm "warm").
usage: Heat, warmth; figuratively of the warmth of love.

definition: Noun from gurikhtan: flight, escape; "dar gurízand" they are fleeing.
usage: Flight or escape, e.g. fleeing from the truth.

definition: Verb, past 3rd person singular of girístan: wept, cried.
usage: To weep; of the weeping of lovers, of the Concourse on high, or of the Manifestation over His people.

definition: Noun: rose garden, flower garden.
usage: Rose garden, a frequent image of the spiritual garden, as in گلستان معانی.

definition: Past 1st sing. of gumáshtan: I appointed, set (someone or something) to a task.
usage: I appointed, set to a task; e.g. God setting someone over a work.

definition: Plural of gumráh 'astray, misguided': those who have gone astray.
usage: 'The misguided', those who have strayed from the path of God.

definition: Noun: witness; "guváh giriftan" to take as witness.
usage: Witness; in calling God to witness.

definition: Noun gúsh 'ear' with indefinite -í: an ear.
usage: Ear, often the inner ear, as in گوش جان 'the ear of the soul' and calls to hear the divine Call.

definition: Noun: plant, herb, grass.
usage: In the Hidden Words ای گیاه خاک 'O weed that springeth out of dust'.

definition: Verb: present subjunctive 2nd plural of yáftan, 'to find, to obtain'.
usage: In compounds such as اطّلاع یابید 'that ye may be informed'.

definition: Persian verb, 1st plural present subjunctive of yáftan 'to find, attain'.
Verb: to take, seize, lay hold of. Root '-kh-dh.
Verb, subjunctive 3rd masc. pl. of akhadha: that they take. Root ’-kh-dh.
Noun: memory, remembrance, mention; قسم یاد کردن 'to swear an oath'.
usage: In the Writings یاد often the remembrance of God or of the Friend.
notes: Rendering 'sworn' is for the phrase قسم یاد نموده‌ام 'I have sworn'.

definition: Verb, past of یافتن: I found. Persian.
Verb amara, to command, bid; third singular present. Root ’-m-r.
Verb: 'he interprets (allegorically), explains away', form II of '-w-l.
usage: The Aqdas condemns whoever interprets the revealed verses contrary to their evident meaning.

definition: Imperfect of form II bashshara with -ka: he gives thee glad tidings. Root b-sh-r.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words روح القدس یبشّرک بالانس 'the Holy Spirit bringeth thee glad tidings of reunion'; Qur'an 3:39 of John the Baptist.

definition: Verb ba‘atha 'to send, raise up' subjunctive. Root b-‘-th.
usage: Qur'anic لن یبعث اللّه من بعده رسولاً 'God will not raise up a Messenger after him'.

shift: Here: dryness. Today: mainly constipation.
definition: Noun: dryness; in modern Persian mainly 'constipation'. Root y-b-s.
Form VIII: to follow, obey. Root t-b-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas ینبغی لکلّ نفس ان یتّبع ما امر به 'It behoveth every soul to observe that which he hath been bidden'.

definition: Verb form VI, with ‘an: to go beyond, exceed. Root j-w-z.
usage: Aqdas ان یتجاوز عن حد 'to exceed the limit'.

definition: Verb, form VIII, 3rd person plural jussive with the suffix 'it': (do not) take it. Root a-kh-dh.
usage: In Qur'an 7:146 ان یروا سبیل الرّشد لا یتّخذوه سبیلاً 'if they see the path of rectitude, they will not take it for their path'.

definition: Imperfect of talá "to recite, read aloud"; subjunctive after an. Root t-l-w.
usage: Aqdas: خیر له من ان یتلو بالکسالة صحف اللّه 'better than wearily reciting all the Holy Books of God'.

definition: Imperfect 3rd person plural of form V takallama 'to speak'. Root k-l-m.
usage: Of the Manifestations and the people of Bahá who speak only by God's leave.

definition: Arabic verb (form IV): he establishes, confirms. Root th-b-t.
usage: Qur'anic: یمحو اللّه ما یشاء و یثبت 'God effaceth and confirmeth what He pleaseth'.

definition: Present of ijtama‘a: gathers, comes together, is combined. Root j-m-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas of the House of Justice: یجتمع فیه النفوس 'souls shall gather therein'.

definition: Imperfect, third person masculine plural, of wajada 'to find, experience'. Root w-j-d.
usage: 'They find'; of souls finding sweetness or proof.

definition: Verb: imperfect 3rd singular of jará "to flow, run, proceed". Root j-r-y.
usage: Flow, run; of rivers or of utterance flowing from the Pen, as in yajrí min qalamí 'flows from My Pen'.

definition: Verb jála "to roam, circle", imperfect 3rd masculine singular: roams, courses about. Root j-w-l.
usage: 'Roams, courses about', of a heart or eye that wanders.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd person masculine plural: they judge, rule, decide. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: To judge or rule, as in the Qur'anic ساء ما یحکمون 'evil is their judgment', of those who judge by their own fancies.

definition: Verb (form IV imperfect) with 2nd pl. object: he informs you, tells you. Root kh-b-r.
usage: He informs you, of God or the Manifestation telling what was hidden.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd masc. sing.: comes out, goes forth. Root kh-r-j.
usage: Comes forth, as of the dead from their graves or plants from the earth.

definition: Verb, imperfect form IV: he perceives, comprehends, overtakes. Root d-r-k.
usage: 'Perceives', from the Qur'an 6:103 لا تدرکه الابصار وهو یدرک الابصار 'no vision taketh in Him, but He taketh in all vision'.
notes: Quran 6:103 'He taketh in all vision'.

definition: Verb, Form I imperfect: he calls, summons, invites. Root d-‘-w.
usage: To call or summon; of God and His Manifestation calling people to Him.

definition: Imperfect of da‘á 'to call, summon' with suffix -kum 'you (pl.)'. Root d-‘-w.
usage: Used of God or the Manifestation summoning people, as in یدعوکم الی الله 'He calleth you unto God'.

definition: Present of form VIII idda‘á: he claims, lays claim to. Root d-‘-w.
usage: In the Aqdas منهم من یدّعی الباطن 'among them is he who layeth claim to inner knowledge'.

definition: Verb: imperfect of dhakara, 'to remember, to mention', with suffix -ní 'Me'. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Aqdas: of the Báb, الّذی یذکرنی فی اللّیالی و الأسحار 'Who maketh mention of Me in the night season and at dawn'.

definition: Arabic verb, form II imperfect with -kum: he reminds, admonishes you. Root dh-k-r.
usage: God or His Messenger reminding people of the Covenant.
notes: In the Aqdas context it may be read yadhkurukum 'maketh mention of you'.

definition: Verb: to hope for, long for. Root r-j-w.
Verb, imperfect 3rd sing. of warada: arrives, comes upon, befalls. Root w-r-d.
Verb: he sends. Root r-s-l.
usage: In the Íqán's Arabic rendering of the Gospel: یرسل ملائکته 'He shall send His angels'.

definition: Verb, form IV imperfect: they want, desire. Root r-w-d.
usage: Qur'an 61:8 یریدون ان یطفئوا نور الله 'Fain would they put out God's light'.

definition: Verb zála, to pass away, cease; third singular present, usually negated لا یزول. Root z-w-l.
usage: In the Writings لا یزول "shall not pass away" describes God's sovereignty and Word.

definition: Passive verb: 'he is asked, called to account'. Root s-'-l.
usage: Qur'an 21:23 لا یسأل عمّا یفعل 'He shall not be asked of His doings'.

definition: Imperfect 3rd person feminine plural of form II sabbaḥa: they (women) glorify God, say 'Glorified be God'. Root s-b-ḥ.
usage: In the Aqdas women exempt from prayer یتوضّأن و یسبّحن 'perform their ablutions and glorify God' ninety-five times.
notes: The second context has energetic یسبّحنّ.

definition: Verb, form X jussive: to be able, to afford. Root ṭ-w-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas من لم یستطع 'whoso is unable'.

definition: Imperfect 3rd plural of sami‘a 'to hear'. Root s-m-‘.
Form IV of ṣ-w-b: to befall, strike, reach; with -ka: befall thee. Root ṣ-w-b.
usage: In the Hidden Words ان لا یصیبک البلآء فی سبیلی 'If adversity befall thee not in My path'.

definition: Verb form IV: to extinguish, put out. Root ṭ-f-'.
usage: Qur'an 9:32 یریدون ان یطفئوا نور الله بأفواههم 'Fain would they put out God's light with their mouths'.
notes: Written یطفئوا.

definition: Verb, present 3rd person singular: circles, circumambulates. Root ṭ-w-f.
usage: In the Aqdas یطوف حول اوامری 'circleth around My commandments'.

definition: Imperfect 3pl of ẓanna "to think, suppose; be sure": they think. Root ẓ-n-n.
usage: Qur'an 2:46 in the Íqán: الّذین یظنّون انّهم ملاقوا ربّهم 'who bear in mind that they shall attain unto their Lord'.

definition: Imperfect of form III ‘ádala 'to equal, be equivalent to' with suffix 'it'. Root ‘-d-l.
usage: لا یعادله 'nothing can equal it', of the Cause and of the joys of the spirit.

definition: Arabic verb (form II): he teaches you. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Qur'anic: اتّقوا اللّه یعلّمکم اللّه 'Fear God; God will instruct you'.

definition: Present of faṣṣala: expounds in detail, makes distinct and clear. Root f-ṣ-l.
usage: Qur'anic یفصل الآیات 'He maketh His signs plain'.

definition: Imperfect, third person masculine plural, of fa‘ala 'to do'; with kánú 'they used to do'. Root f-‘-l.
usage: 'They do'; in the Qur'anic formula بما کانوا یفعلون 'for what they used to do'.

definition: Verb: imperfect 3rd masculine plural of faqiha "to understand, comprehend". Root f-q-h.
usage: They understand; in the Qur'anic lá yafqahún 'they do not understand', of the heedless.

definition: Verb qatala "to kill", imperfect passive 3rd masculine singular: is killed, will be slain. Root q-t-l.
Verb, imperfect 3rd person singular + -hum: he kills them. Root q-t-l.
usage: To kill; in traditions cited in the Íqán about the Qá'im who will slay the oppressors.

definition: Verb (form I imperfect) with 3rd masc. object: he casts it, throws it. Root q-dh-f.
usage: Casting or throwing, e.g. casting something into the fire or sea.
notes: Al-‘ilmu núrun yaqdhifuhu Alláhu fí qalbi man yashá'.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd masc. pl.: they play, sport. Root l-‘-b.
usage: They play, sport; in Qur'anic phrases like فی خوضهم یلعبون 'sporting in their vain talk'.

definition: Verb, imperfect of marra: to pass, pass by, waft. Root m-r-r.
usage: 'Passes, wafts', of the breezes of God passing over the world.

definition: Verb, Form I imperfect 3rd plural: they pass by. Root m-r-r.
usage: They pass by; echoes Qur'anic passages about those who pass by God's signs heedlessly.

definition: Imperfect (form IV): it is possible; hal yumkinu 'is it possible, can'. Root m-k-n.
usage: It is possible, as in هل یمکن 'is it possible'; in arguments on what can be known of God.

definition: Present of nádá 'to call aloud' with -kum 'you': He calleth you. Root n-d-w.
usage: In the Aqdas من ایّ افق ینادیکم ربّکم الابهی 'from what horizon your Lord, the All-Glorious, calleth you'.

definition: Verb: imperfect of nabba’a, 'to inform, to announce', with suffix -kum. Root n-b-'.
usage: Aqdas: کذلک ینبّئکم العلیم الخبیر 'thus informeth you the All-Knowing, the All-Informed'.

definition: Arabic verb, form VIII imperfect: benefits, profits (with bi- 'from'). Root n-f-‘.
usage: In ما ینتفع به 'that which profiteth', of useful works.

definition: Verb: to benefit, profit; benefits them. Root n-f-‘.
Verb, form VII imperfect: turns over, turns back. Root q-l-b.
usage: Qur'anic, ینقلب علی عقبیه 'turns on his heels', of apostasy.

definition: Verb: he gives it. Root ’-t-y.
usage: Qur'anic formula ذلک فضل الله یؤتیه من یشاء 'that is God's grace; He bestoweth it on whom He will'.

definition: Proper noun: John, especially John the Baptist or John the Evangelist.
usage: کان یوحنا یکرز 'John was preaching' (John the Baptist).

definition: Form II of ’-l-f: to unite, bring together, reconcile; with بین القلوب "unite hearts". Root ’-l-f.
usage: In the Aqdas God wishes to unite hearts, انّ اللّه اراد ان یؤلّف بین القلوب.

definition: Verb: 'he writes', imperfect of kataba. Root k-t-b.
notes: The first context may be passive yuktabu 'is written'.

definition: Adverb (yik 'one' plus Arabic martaba 'time, degree'): suddenly, all at once; also once.
Verb ya’isa 'to despair', past 3rd plural. Root y-’-s.
usage: Qur'anic اولئک یئسوا من رحمتی 'these despair of My mercy'.
notes: Written یئسوا.

definition: Interrogative particle a- 'is it that ...?', here written as a detached hamza.
notes: Aqdas: ءاخذکم سکر الهوی 'Hath the intoxication of passion seized you?'

definition: Apparently a misprint for آثار 'traces, marks': here traces of dirt on clothing. Root ’-th-r.
usage: In the Aqdas لا یری من ثیابکم آثار الأوساخ 'that no trace of dirt be seen upon your garments'.
notes: The source reads اآار with a missing letter, likely for آثار.

definition: Noun, construct accusative of ab: father. Root '-b-w.
usage: Qur'an 33:40 ما کان محمد ابا احد من رجالکم 'Muḥammad is not the father of any man among you'.

definition: Noun ibtidá 'beginning' with the indefinite -í: a beginning. Root b-d-a.
usage: Paired with انتها 'end' of God's endless revelation.
notes: Written ابتدائی in the source.

definition: Form VIII perfect of b-s-m: he (it) smiled. Root b-s-m.
usage: Aqdas: ابتسم ثغر الوجود 'the mouth of creation smiled'.

definition: Verbal noun of form VIII: seeking, desiring; accusative of purpose 'in quest of'. Root b-gh-y.
usage: ابتغاء لرضائی 'seeking My good-pleasure', echoing Qur'anic ابتغاء مرضاة الله.

definition: Arabic verb (form VIII), imperative: seek ye. Root b-gh-y.
usage: Aqdas: ابتغوا امراً بین الأمرین 'seek ye a middle course'.

definition: Passive of ibtalá: was afflicted with, was tested by. Root b-l-w.
Noun: eternity, endless time; ilá abadi al-abad 'for ever and ever'. Root '-b-d.
usage: 'Eternity'; in phrases like الی ابد الآباد 'for ever and ever'.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV) ibdá‘ "bringing into being, original creation" plus -í "my". Root b-d-‘.
usage: My creation; ibdá‘ is original creation out of nothing, God's creative act.

definition: Verb form IV abda‘a, perfect 1st singular with -há: I originated it. Root b-d-‘.
usage: 'I originated it', of God's creation without precedent; related to بدیع 'new, wondrous' and the Badí‘ calendar.

definition: Relative adjective: eternal, perpetual, lifelong. Root ’-b-d.
usage: Eternal, perpetual; of everlasting life and God's eternal dominion.
notes: ḥabsan abadiyyan life imprisonment.

definition: Feminine adjective: eternal, everlasting, without end. Root '-b-d.
usage: Eternal, as in حیات ابدیه 'eternal life' and سلطنت ابدیه.

definition: Noun abr 'cloud' + indefinite -í.
usage: A cloud; in the Íqán clouds symbolise whatever veils people from recognising the Manifestation.

definition: Verb, imperfect form II 1st person singular with -ka: I give thee glad tidings. Root b-sh-r.
usage: 'I give thee glad tidings', in God's voice announcing the good news of His nearness or reward.

definition: Plural abṣár (eyes) + "their". Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: Their eyes; of eyes veiled from seeing the Truth.

definition: Elative of baṣír: more seeing, more discerning. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: More seeing or discerning; related to بصیرت 'insight' and the divine name البصیر 'the All-Seeing'.
notes: Arabic elative used with the Persian verb ending (abṣar va a‘raf-íd 'ye know better').

definition: Elative of balígh 'eloquent': more eloquent, more effective, more far-reaching. Root b-l-gh.
usage: In the Íqán تلویح … ابلغ از تصریح 'an allusion more eloquent than explicit statement'.

definition: Noun: son. Root b-n-y.
usage: Aqdas: انّ الّذی ربّی ابنه او ابناً من الأبنآء 'he that bringeth up his son, or the son of another'.

definition: Noun abná', plural of ibn 'son', with -hum: their sons, their children. Root b-n-y.
Plural of ibn 'son' with feminine plural pronoun: their (women's) sons. Root b-n-y.
Noun, plural of ibn with 2nd pl. suffix: your sons, your children. Root b-n-w.
Noun, plural of ibn 'son', with 'my'. Root b-n-y.
usage: In the Aqdas احد ابنائی 'one of My sons', of a member of Bahá'u'lláh's family.
notes: Normalized from ابنائی.

definition: Plural of آب 'water' in construct: the waters of. Persian.
usage: آبهای بیان 'the waters of utterance'.
notes: Not أبهی 'Most Glorious'.

definition: Double plural of báb "door, gate": Arabic plural abváb plus Persian -há; doors, gates. Root b-w-b.
notes: Double plural; final ی is the izáfih.

definition: Plural of báb 'door, gate' with indefinite -í: 'some doors, means'. Root b-w-b.
Proper name: Abú ‘Ámir the Monk (ar-Ráhib), a Medinan opponent of Muḥammad.
usage: The Íqán lists him among the divines who opposed the Prophet.

definition: Proper noun, kunya 'father of ‘Abdu’lláh': title of the sixth Imám, Ja‘far aṣ-Ṣádiq.
usage: Introduces many Shí‘ih traditions cited in the Íqán.

definition: Noun ab 'father' in the nominative construct with -ki 'thy' (feminine). Root ’-b-w.
usage: From Qur'an 19:28, addressed to Mary: ما کان ابوک امرء سوء.

definition: Abú-‘Abdi’lláh, kunya of the Sixth Imám Ja‘far aṣ-Ṣádiq, in genitive after ‘an.
usage: Common in chains of transmission of Shí‘ih traditions quoted in the Íqán.

definition: Verb atá with -há: (it) came to her, reached her. Root '-t-y.
Verb, form VIII, past 3rd person plural with 'thee': they followed thee. Root t-b-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas الّذین اتّبعوک بوهم مبین 'them who follow thee in manifest delusion'.

definition: Form VIII perfect of t-b-‘ "to follow" with -ka: (he) followed you.
usage: Qur'an 11:27 in the Íqán: ما نراک اتّبعک الّا الّذین هم اراذلنا 'we see not any that have followed thee save our meanest'.

definition: Perfect 3rd person singular feminine of atá 'to come'. Root ’-t-y.
usage: اتت الساعة و انشق القمر 'the Hour hath come and the moon is cleft', an echo of Qur'an 54:1.

definition: Arabic verb (form VIII): he took it (as). Root ’-kh-dh.
usage: Qur'anic: اتّخذها هزواً 'he turneth it into a jest'.

definition: Imperative plural of ittakhadha with 'it': take it, adopt it. Root ’-kh-dh.
Imperative, masculine plural, of taraka 'to leave, abandon'. Root t-r-k.
usage: 'Abandon'; in commands to forsake idle fancies and the world.

definition: Verb: imperative plural of taraka "to leave, abandon" plus -há "them". Root t-r-k.
usage: Leave them; command to abandon, e.g. forbidden things.

definition: Noun: fire.
usage: Fire, often of the fire of love or of tests; written آتش.
notes: Written آتش; madda removed in the search form.

definition: Noun átash "fire" + indefinite -í: a fire.
usage: Fire; the fire of the love of God and of the Burning Bush, also the fire of trials or of hell.

definition: Imperative 2nd masc. sing. (form VIII) of ittaqá: fear (God), be godly. Root w-q-y.
usage: Command to fear God, as in اتّق الله, i.e. be God-fearing.
notes: Ittaqi Alláha = Fear God.

definition: Interrogative a- + imperfect 2nd masc. pl. of qatala: do ye kill? Root q-t-l.
usage: From Qur'án 40:28, اتقتلون رجلا ان یقول ربی الله 'Will ye slay a man because he saith My Lord is God?'.

definition: Verb, energetic imperative masculine plural of ittaqá (form VIII): fear ye, be mindful of. Root w-q-y.
usage: 'Fear ye', in the command اتّقنّ الله 'fear God', meaning mindfulness and reverence toward God.
notes: Reading assumed from context 'ittaqunna’lláha yá ‘ibádí'; could be a variant spelling.

definition: Verb, Form IV past 1st sing.: I completed, perfected. Root t-m-m.
usage: Completed, perfected; echoes Qur'án 5:3 "I have perfected for you your religion".

definition: Verbal noun (form VIII) ittikál 'reliance, trust' + -ka 'thy'. Root w-k-l.
usage: Reliance on God, as in توکّل and اتّکال علی الله 'reliance upon God'.

definition: Present of form VIII ittakala 'to rely upon': I rely, I put my trust. Root w-k-l.
usage: In the formula علی الله اتّکل و به استعین 'in God I put my trust, and Him I implore for help'.

definition: Verb: perfect 2nd singular of atá, 'to come'. Root '-t-y.
notes: In the dialogue of a tradition: اتیت سوق الدّوابّ 'didst thou come to the market of beasts?'.

definition: Arabic verb, form IV perfect 1st plural: We gave, granted. Root '-t-y.
usage: Qur'an 2:253: آتینا عیسی بن مریم البیّنات 'We gave Jesus son of Mary clear signs'.

definition: Plural of athar: traces, signs, works, effects; with pronoun 'its, His'. Root '-th-r.
usage: آثار also means the sacred writings, as آثار قلم اعلی 'the writings of the Supreme Pen'.

definition: Noun, plural of athar 'trace' with 3rd pl. suffix: their traces, footsteps. Root ’-th-r.
usage: Qur'anic, انّا علی آثارهم مقتدون 'we follow in their footsteps'.

definition: Noun, plural of athar: traces, signs, effects; with Persian indefinite -í. Root ’-th-r.
usage: In the Writings آثار also means the sacred writings, as in آثار قلم اعلی.
notes: Normalized from آثاری.

definition: Verbal noun, form IV, with suffix: his affirmation, his proof. Root th-b-t.
usage: دلیله آیاته و وجوده اثباته 'His proof is His signs; His being is His evidence'.

definition: Form IV of th-b-t: to establish, confirm, affirm. Root th-b-t.
Verb: 'We confirmed, established them', form IV of th-b-t, with -há.
Imperfect of form II thabbata with -ka: I make thee firm, establish or confirm thee. Root th-b-t.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words, God remembers and confirms the soul that remembers Him.
notes: Subjunctive, coordinated with kay adhkuraka.

definition: Noun athar 'trace, effect, influence; work' with -ash 'its'. Root ’-th-r.
Plural of thiql 'burden, load': burdens, baggage, belongings. Root th-q-l.
In the course of, midst; در آن اثنا 'in the meantime'. Root th-n-y.
Noun: midst, course; در اثنای 'in the course of, during'. Root th-n-y.
Noun, plural of thawb: garments, pieces of cloth. Root th-w-b.
usage: In the Aqdas burial law ان تکفنوه فی خمسة اثواب 'shroud him in five sheets of silk or cotton'.

definition: Sinful, guilty, wicked (one). Root ’-th-m.
usage: Aqdas: کلّ مشرک کان فی اللّوح اثیماً 'every ungodly one, a sinner in the Tablet'.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV: answering, responding, granting a call or prayer. Root j-w-b.
usage: احدی او را اجابت ننمود 'none responded to His call'.

definition: Adjective: bitter, brackish (of water). Root ’-j-j.
usage: Qur'anic ملح اجاج 'salt and bitter', contrasted with عذب فرات 'sweet and fresh'.

definition: Adjective ujáj (bitterly salt) with copula: is bitter, brackish. Root ’-j-j.
usage: Echoes the Qur'anic ملح اجاج 'salt and bitter'.

definition: Imperative plural of jabara 'to set (a bone), restore, mend'. Root j-b-r.
usage: 'Mend, restore'; in calls to heal and restore.
notes: Aqdas: 'Bind ye the broken with the hands of justice'.

definition: Verb (form IV): past 1st plural of ajába "to answer" plus -hu "him". Root j-w-b.
usage: We answered him; of God answering a question or prayer.

definition: Verb form IV ajába "to answer", perfect 1st plural with -hum: We answered them. Root j-w-b.
Verb (form VIII, past) 3rd person masculine plural: they gathered, assembled, united. Root j-m-‘.
usage: To gather or combine; echoes Qur'an 17:88, that men and jinn combined could not produce the like of God's verses.
notes: The verb carries a plural ending before its plural subject (mulúku'l-arḍ).

definition: Noun: wage, reward, recompense. Root '-j-r.
usage: Reward or recompense, as in اجر الهی and God not letting the reward of the doers of good be lost.

definition: Arabic broken plural ajsád (of jasad) with a redundant Persian plural -há and izáfih: bodies.
usage: Bodies, physical frames as against souls.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): majesty, glorification, exaltation. Root j-l-l.
usage: 'Majesty, glorification', often paired with عزّت 'glory', of the honour of God and His chosen ones.

definition: Verb, Form I imperative 2nd plural: gather, assemble. Root j-m-‘.
usage: Gather, assemble; an exhortation to unity.
notes: Could also be Form IV ajmi‘ú (resolve, agree); the object an-nás favours Form I.

definition: Emphatic plural: all together, one and all. Root j-m-‘.
usage: Emphatic 'all together', in phrases such as الخلق اجمعون 'all creation, one and all'.

definition: Emphatic plural adjective: all together, one and all. Root j-m-‘.
usage: After a noun: للخلائق اجمعین 'for all created things'.

definition: Elative adjective: more beautiful, fairer, more excellent. Root j-m-l.
Arabic verb, form IV imperative plural: answer, respond, accept (an invitation). Root j-w-b.
usage: Aqdas: invited to banquets, اجیبوا بالفرح و الانبساط 'respond with joy and gladness'.

definition: Plural of ḥadíth 'tradition, report' with relative -í: (those) traditions which. Root ḥ-d-th.
usage: Traditions of the Prophet and the Imáms, often cited and interpreted in the Íqán.

definition: Verb, form IV perfect 3rd fem. sing.: encompassed, surrounded. Root ḥ-w-ṭ.
Verbal noun: encompassing, comprehending, all-embracing power. Root ḥ-w-ṭ.
usage: In the Íqán احاطهٔ باطنیّه 'inner ascendancy', one of the forms of the Manifestation's sovereignty.
notes: Final ە (U+06D5) carries the izáfih.

definition: Plural of ḥabíb with suffix: his beloved ones, his friends. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: احبّا 'the loved ones' is the usual term for the believers, as in احبّای الهی 'the friends of God'.

definition: Form IV of ḥ-b-b: to love; first singular past "I loved". Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: احببت خلقک فخلقتک "I loved thy creation, hence I created thee".

definition: Imperative of aḥabba 'to love' with -ní 'me': 'love Me'. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words 5: احببنی لأحبّک 'Love Me, that I may love thee'.

definition: Perfect of form IV aḥabba 'to love' with -hu: He loved it. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: In the Aqdas ما احبّه الله 'that which God loveth', of rose-water and pure perfume.

definition: Verb aḥabba 'to love' 1st singular with -ka 'thee'. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: In the Hidden Words احببنی لأحبّک 'Love Me, that I may love thee'.

shift: Here: arguments, adducing proofs, disputation. Today: protests (احتجاج).
definition: Plural of iḥtijáj 'adducing proofs, arguing, disputation'; in modern Persian 'protest'. Root ḥ-j-j.
Form VIII: you (pl.) were veiled, shut yourselves off. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: In the Aqdas احتجبتم بها عن مشرقها 'ye have allowed it to shut you out from Him Who is its Dayspring'.

definition: Plural of ḥajar: stones. Root ḥ-j-r.
usage: E.g. احجار ظنونات 'the stones of idle fancies'.

definition: Noun, accusative indefinite: anyone, one. Root a-ḥ-d.
usage: In the Aqdas من یحزن احداً 'whoso causeth sadness to anyone'.

definition: Aḥad "one" with -humá "of the two": one of the two. Root ’-ḥ-d.
usage: Aqdas: لا یقبل احدهما دون الآخر 'neither is acceptable without the other'.

definition: Noun aḥadiyya 'absolute oneness, singleness' with suffix 'My'. Root ’-ḥ-d.
usage: احدیّة is the divine Oneness; in the Writings اسم و ظهور احدیّت 'the Oneness of God'.

definition: Plural of حرّ: the free, the noble, the detached. Root ḥ-r-r.
usage: HW: با احرار مصاحب شو 'associate with the righteous'.
notes: Rendering in the Hidden Words not verified.

definition: Verbal noun: entering the consecrated state of pilgrimage, the pilgrim garb. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: Figurative in the Íqán: احرام حرم دوست بندد 'gird himself for the sanctuary of the Friend'.

definition: Past tense, third person masculine singular, of form IV aḥraqa 'to burn, set on fire'. Root ḥ-r-q.
usage: 'Burned'; in Aqdas laws on arson, and images of the fire of love.

definition: Verb (form IV): imperative plural: burn, set aflame. Root ḥ-r-q.
usage: Burn, set aflame; of setting hearts aflame or burning away veils.

definition: Verb form IV aḥṣá "to count, record", perfect 1st plural with -hu: We have recorded it. Root ḥ-ṣ-y.
usage: 'We have recorded it', of God's record of all things, a Qur'anic expression.
notes: Qur'an 78:29 "kulla shay’in aḥṣaynáhu kitában".

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): summoning, calling into one's presence. Root ḥ-ḍ-r.
usage: Summoning into one's presence, as of the Manifestation summoned before the authorities.

definition: Verb (form IV perfect, 1st pl.): We encompassed, comprehended. Root ḥ-w-ṭ.
usage: God's encompassing knowledge, as in قد احطنا 'We have encompassed'.

definition: Imperative masc. pl. of ḥafiẓa + -há: preserve, guard them. Root ḥ-f-ẓ.
usage: Guard them, e.g. the laws or a trust.

definition: Verb, imperative masculine plural of ḥafiẓa with suffix -hum: guard them, protect them. Root ḥ-f-ẓ.
usage: 'Guard them', in commands to protect the believers, or the weak and the orphans.

definition: Verb, Form IV past: he made lawful, permitted. Root ḥ-l-l.
usage: Made lawful; used in the Aqdas of what God has permitted.

definition: Perfect (form IV) aḥalla 'to make lawful' + -hu 'it'. Root ḥ-l-l.
usage: Used of making something lawful in the law of God, as in ما احلّه الله 'what God hath made lawful'.

definition: Elative of ḥulw 'sweet': sweeter, sweetest. Root ḥ-l-w.
Proper noun: Aḥmad; here Shaykh Aḥmad-i-Aḥsá’í, founder of the Shaykhí school.
usage: With کاظم (Siyyid Káẓim) one of the نورین نیّرین 'two luminous lights' who heralded the Báb.

definition: Arabic verb, imperative plural of ḥamida: praise ye. Root ḥ-m-d.
usage: Aqdas: احمدوا اللّه 'praise ye God'.

definition: Plural of ḥukm 'law, ordinance, ruling' with Persian pronoun -ash 'its, his'. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: The laws and ordinances of a religion; احکام الله 'the laws of God'.

definition: Noun, plural of ḥukm with 3rd masc. suffix: His laws, ordinances. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: In the Aqdas, often paired with اوامر 'commandments'.

definition: Noun, plural of ḥukm, with dual 'their': their rulings, their laws or penalties. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: In the Writings احکام usually 'the laws' or ordinances of God.

definition: Plural of ḥín: times, moments. Root ḥ-y-n.
usage: در جمیع احیان 'at all times'.

definition: Form IV of ḥ-y-y: to give life, quicken; with suffix "him". Root ḥ-y-y.
Noun akh 'brother' (accusative akhá) with -hum 'their'. Root '-kh-w.
Perfect 1st person plural of form IV akhbara: We informed, announced (with bi-). Root kh-b-r.
Verb akhbara 'to inform' with -hu 'him': We informed him. Root kh-b-r.
Perfect 1st plural of form IV akhbara 'to inform, tell' with -kum 'you'. Root kh-b-r.
Form IV verb: he informed you, told you beforehand. Root kh-b-r.
usage: In the Aqdas of the Báb's foretelling: قد اخبرکم من قبل.

definition: Imperative plural form VIII: choose ye! select. Root kh-y-r.
usage: Aqdas اختاروا لغة من اللغات 'choose one language'.

shift: Here: origination, creation (paired with ابداع). Today: invention.
definition: Verbal noun of form VIII: origination, creation; in modern usage invention. Root kh-r-‘.
usage: Paired with ابداع 'creation' in metaphysical language about the worlds of creation.

definition: Form VIII perfect 1sg of kh-r-‘ "to invent, devise" with -há "it": I devised it.
usage: HW: احدیّتی احداثی اخترعتها لأجلک 'My unity is a design of Mine; I have devised it for thee'.

definition: Perfect 2nd person plural of form VIII ikhtalafa 'to differ, disagree'. Root kh-l-f.
usage: اذا اختلفتم فی امر فارجعوه الی الله 'if ye differ upon a matter, refer it to God'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): she/it seized us. Root ’-kh-dh.
usage: Aqdas: قد اخذتنا الأحزان 'sorrows have seized Us'.

definition: Past 3sg feminine of akhadha with 'her/them': took hold of them, seized them. Root ’-kh-dh.
Past tense, first person plural, of akhadha 'to take, seize'. Root '-kh-dh.
usage: 'We took, seized'; God's royal 'We', of seizing the rebellious or taking a covenant.

definition: Verb: past 3rd singular of akhadha "to take, seize" plus -hu "him". Root ’-kh-dh.
usage: Seized him; of God's seizing the wrongdoer, a Qur'anic expression.

definition: Verb akhadha "to take", perfect 3rd masculine plural: they took. Root '-kh-dh.
Verbal noun (form IV): expulsion, banishment, bringing out. Root kh-r-j.
usage: Expulsion or banishment, as of prophets driven from their homes; in modern Persian also 'dismissal'.

definition: Verb (form IV perfect): he brought out, brought forth, produced. Root kh-r-j.
usage: He brought forth, as in God bringing forth creation or the dead.
notes: Future sense after idhá.

definition: Energetic imperative of kharaqa: rend, tear apart. Root kh-r-q.
usage: Rend, tear apart, as of rending the veils (الاحجاب).

definition: Noun ákhir 'last' with suffix -ná 'us': the last of us. Root ’-kh-r.
usage: 'The last of us', from the tradition 'the first of us is Muḥammad, the last of us is Muḥammad', cited to show the oneness of the Manifestations.
notes: Tradition: 'awwaluná Muḥammad, ákhiruná Muḥammad'.

definition: Verb, Form IV past 1st sing. + "it": I stored it, laid it up. Root kh-z-n.
usage: I treasured it; of God storing up hidden gifts or knowledge.
notes: Classical Arabic usually uses Form I khazantuhu.

definition: Plural of elative akhsar: the greatest losers, utterly lost. Root kh-s-r.
usage: The greatest losers, describing those who turn away from God's Revelation.

definition: Verbal noun of akhfá: hiding, concealing; concealment, disappearance. Root kh-f-y.
usage: In the Íqán اخفای جمال محمّدی, the passing of Muḥammad from sight.

definition: Verb: imperative of khala‘a, 'to take off, to cast off'. Root kh-l-‘.
notes: In a mystical verse quoted in the Íqán: اخلع الحیا 'cast off shame'; read ikhla‘i'l-ḥayá.

definition: Noun, plural: the good, the righteous, the chosen. Root kh-y-r.
usage: Paired with ابرار 'the righteous'.

definition: Noun: performance, discharge, expression; ادا شدن 'to be expressed, performed'. Root '-d-y.
Verbal noun: payment, discharge, performance of a duty. Root ’-d-y.
usage: In the Aqdas اداء حقّ اللّه 'payment of the Right of God'.

definition: Noun, plural of adab: manners, customs, observances; with Persian indefinite -í. Root ’-d-b.
usage: In the Íqán of the customs and observances renewed in each Dispensation.
notes: Normalized from آدابی.

definition: Noun: courtesy, good manners, refinement; (also) literature. Root '-d-b.
usage: Courtesy is praised in the Writings as the lord of virtues.

definition: Imperative plural of dakhala, to enter: "Enter!". Root d-kh-l.
Verb: 'ye attained, grasped', form IV of d-r-k.
Verbal noun of form VIII idda‘á: claim, pretension, assertion. Root d-‘-w.
usage: In the Íqán every claim must be weighed by the touchstone of the Book.

definition: Verbal noun: claim, pretension. Root d-‘-w.
usage: Of the claim to prophethood, as in ادّعای مسیحی 'the claim to be the Christ'.

definition: Imperative plural of da‘á 'to call, summon, invoke'. Root d-‘-w.
usage: From Qur'an 2:23 و ادعوا شهدائکم 'and call upon your witnesses'.
notes: After و it is read wad‘ú.

definition: Form I imperative of dafana 'to bury' with -hu: bury him. Root d-f-n.
usage: In the Aqdas burial law: ادفنوه بالرّوح و الرّیحان 'inter him with radiance and serenity'.

definition: Plural of dalíl: guides, proofs, those that point to something. Root d-l-l.
notes: Here 'all things point to the truth that there is no God but Him'.

definition: Noun, plural of dalíl: proofs, evidences, arguments. Root d-l-l.
usage: In the Íqán ادلّه بر اثبات این امر 'proofs establishing this Cause'.

definition: Proofs, arguments: Arabic plural adilla of dalíl with Persian -há added, plus izáfih. Root d-l-l.
Elative of daní: lower, meaner, nearer, lesser. Root d-n-w.
usage: بالذی هو ادنی 'that which is meaner' (Qur'an 2:61).

definition: ادیان 'religions' (plural of دین) with است 'is'. Root d-y-n.
usage: Íqán: سماء ادیانست 'is the heaven of the divine religions'.

definition: Plural of udhun (ear) with 'their': their ears. Root ’-dh-n.
usage: Qur'anic یجعلون اصابعهم فی آذانهم 'they thrust their fingers into their ears'.

definition: Plural of udhun 'ear' plus -kum 'your (plural)'; accusative here. Root '-dh-n.
usage: 'Your ears'; in calls to purify one's ears from idle talk and hear the divine call.

definition: Verb: past 1st plural of adhina "to permit" plus -kum "you". Root ’-dh-n.
usage: We permitted you; a common formula in Aqdas laws, adhinnákum 'We have permitted you'.
notes: The source shows the shadda on ذ; the reading is adhinná-kum.

definition: Noun, plural of dhikr "mention, remembrance" with -kum: your mention. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Mentions or remembrances of God; ذکر 'remembrance' is a central devotional term.

definition: Verb, imperative (form I) + -ní "me": remember me, make mention of me. Root dh-k-r.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: make mention of Me on My earth, that I may remember thee in My heaven.

definition: Imperative pl. of dhakara with 3rd masc. object: remember ye Him, make mention of Him. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Remember Him, make mention of Him.

definition: Verb, imperfect subjunctive 1st sing. of dhakara + -ka: that I may mention, remember thee. Root dh-k-r.
usage: That I may mention or remember Thee, in prayers.

definition: Noun adhíyyat 'harm, injury, persecution' with Persian plural -há. Root ’-dh-y.
usage: 'Persecutions', of the afflictions inflicted on the Manifestation and His followers.

definition: Short imperative of ávardan (to bring): bring! "bírún ár" bring forth.
usage: Bring!; in poetic forms such as برون آر "bring forth".

definition: Perfect (form IV) third plural of aráda 'to want, intend'. Root r-w-d.
usage: They desired or intended, often of those who sought to harm the Cause.

definition: Plural: the vilest, the lowliest of people, the rabble. Root r-dh-l.
