usage: In the Íqán the unbelievers' scorn that only the abject follow the Prophet (Qur'an 11:27).

definition: Noun: the basest, meanest, plural of ardhal, with suffix -ná 'our'. Root r-dh-l.
usage: In Qur'an 11:27, words of Noah's people about his followers.

definition: Persian past participle of árástan 'to adorn': adorned, decked out.
usage: Hidden Words: بظاهر آراسته 'outwardly adorned'.

definition: Numeral: four (form used with feminine nouns). Root r-b-‘.
Numeral 'forty'; here the title of a collection of forty traditions. Root r-b-‘.
notes: In the Íqán در اربعین 'in the Arba‘ín'.

definition: Verbal noun: rising, elevation, exaltation. Root r-f-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas ارتفاعاً لمقاماتکم 'for the elevation of your stations'.

definition: Verbal noun, form VIII: ascending, rising, promotion. Root r-q-y.
usage: ارتقاء بمعارج معانی 'ascent to the heights of inner meaning'.

definition: Verbal noun of form VIII irtaqá: ascent, rising, advancement. Root r-q-y.
usage: ارتقای روح "the ascent of the soul" at death.
notes: Final ی is the izáfih.

definition: Verb: 'ye committed (a wrong)', form VIII of r-k-b.
Perfect of form VIII irtakaba 'to commit (a sin or crime)' with resumptive -hu: committed it. Root r-k-b.
usage: In the Aqdas ما ارتکبه اولو الطغیان 'what the perverse have committed'.

definition: Elative: preferable, weightier, more excellent. Root r-j-ḥ.
Perfect 1st plural of form IV arja‘a 'to return, refer, assign'. Root r-j-‘.
notes: Aqdas: one third of all fines is assigned to the Seat of Justice.

definition: Plural of rijl 'foot, leg'. Root r-j-l.
usage: In the Aqdas لو یغسل احد ارجل العالم 'Were any man to wash the feet of all mankind'.

definition: Plural of rijl 'foot' with -kum: your feet. Root r-j-l.
usage: Aqdas اغسلوا ارجلکم 'Wash your feet'.

definition: Adjective: precious, honoured, noble, eminent.
usage: In مرتبهٔ ارجمند ابهی 'the glorious station of the All-Glorious'.

definition: Of Ardabil, a city in Azerbaijan; part of a person's name.
usage: In the Íqán ملّا یوسف اردبیلی, Mullá Yúsuf-i-Ardibílí, a Letter of the Living.

definition: Perfect 2nd person plural of form IV aráda 'to want, intend'. Root r-w-d.
usage: اذا اردتم الصلوة 'when ye desire to perform the prayer'.

definition: Plural of رزق: provisions, sustenance, daily bread. Root r-z-q.
usage: Íqán: in the cities of the Holy Books ارزاق مقدّر است 'sustenance is ordained'.

definition: Past of arsala: sent, dispatched (messengers). Root r-s-l.
usage: Aqdas: هو الذی ارسل الرسل 'He it is Who hath sent the Messengers'.

definition: Past tense, first person singular, of form IV arsala 'to send'. Root r-s-l.
usage: 'I have sent'; of God sending Messengers or of Bahá'u'lláh sending tablets.

definition: Verb (form IV): past 2nd masculine plural of arsala "to send". Root r-s-l.
usage: You send; ordinary verb.
notes: After idhá, read in the present sense.

definition: Verb form IV arsala "to send", perfect 1st plural: We sent. Root r-s-l.
usage: 'We sent', of God sending the Messengers, a Qur'anic formula.

definition: Book title "Guidance for the Common People" (by Karím Khán-i-Kirmání) + Persian copula -ast "is".
usage: Title of a work by Karím Khán-i-Kirmání, criticised in the Kitáb-i-Íqán.
notes: Joined spelling of Irshádu'l-‘Awámm ast.

definition: Energetic imperative pl. of rafa‘a: raise ye up, elevate, exalt. Root r-f-‘.
usage: Raise ye, e.g. raise your voices in praise or raise up the Cause.
notes: After wa- read wa-rfa‘unna.

definition: Broken plural of raqíq: slaves, bondsmen. Root r-q-q.
usage: Slaves, bondsmen; used of humanity as God's bondslaves.

definition: Noun: gift, present, souvenir brought from a journey.
usage: 'Gift, souvenir', of the gift the wayfarer brings back from the spiritual journey.

definition: Plural arwáḥ (spirits, souls) + "their". Root r-w-ḥ.
Plural of rúḥ 'spirit, soul' (accusative) + -kum 'your'. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Souls or spirits, as in ارواحکم 'your souls'; also the familiar ارواحنا فداه 'may our souls be a sacrifice'.

definition: Imperative of rakaḍa: run, race, speed on. Root r-k-ḍ.
usage: In the Hidden Words ارکض فی برّ العماء 'speed through the wilderness of the celestial realm'.

definition: Verb: imperfect 1st singular of aráda, 'to will, to desire'. Root r-w-d.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words: انت ترید الذّهب و انا ارید تنزیهک عنه 'thou dost wish for gold and I desire thy freedom from it'.

definition: Persian verb, 1st plural present subjunctive of ávardan 'to bring': (that) we bring, offer.
Preposition az 'from' joined to jamál 'beauty'. Root j-m-l.
usage: جمال often denotes the Manifestation, as جمال ابهی 'the Abhá Beauty'.

definition: Verb, form VIII perfect: increased, grew more, exceeded. Root z-y-d.
Adjective: eternal, without beginning, pre-existent. Root ’-z-l.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words نوراً ازلیّاً 'a light eternal'; ازل is eternity without beginning.

definition: Abstract noun: eternity without beginning, pre-existence. Root '-z-l.
usage: کنت فی قدم ذاتی و ازلیة کینونتی 'Veiled in My immemorial being and in the ancient eternity of My essence'.

definition: Abstract noun from azal "eternity without beginning", with suffix "my": My eternity. Root ’-z-l.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words ازلیّتی ابداعی "My eternity is My creation".

definition: Adjective azalí 'eternal' with است 'is'. Root a-z-l.
Relative adjective azalí 'eternal, without beginning' with the Persian copula -and: they are eternal. Root ’-z-l.
usage: ازلی 'eternal, pre-existent' describes the Manifestations' divine reality in the Íqán.

definition: Noun, plural of zamán: times, ages, eras. Root z-m-n.
Plural of zawj 'spouse, husband or wife; pair'. Root z-w-j.
notes: Aqdas: ye are forbidden to marry your fathers' wives.

definition: Plural of usṭúra: fables, legends, old tales. Root s-ṭ-r.
usage: In the Qur'anic charge اساطیر الاوّلین 'tales of the ancients' levelled at the Prophets.

definition: Plural asámí 'names' with Persian -shán: their names. Root s-m-w.
Arabic elative asbaq 'earlier, foremost' with Persian -and 'they are'. Root s-b-q.
notes: In امم سابقه اولی و اسبقند 'the former peoples are worthier and prior'.

definition: Week, a period of seven days. Root s-b-‘.
usage: Aqdas: فی کلّ اسبوع 'every week', on bathing.

definition: Perfect 2nd person plural of form X: to exchange, take in exchange. Root b-d-l.
usage: فبئس ما استبدلتم 'evil is that which ye have exchanged'.

definition: Arabic verb (form X): We answered (a prayer). Root j-w-b.
usage: Aqdas: قد استجبنا ما اراد 'We have answered his request'.

definition: Verbal noun: drawing in, procuring, attracting. Root j-l-b.
Past tense, third person feminine singular, form X of ḥ-ṣ-n: to become married, be protected by marriage. Root ḥ-ṣ-n.
usage: 'Became married'; a technical term in the Aqdas laws on marriage.
notes: Unsure whether active istaḥṣanat or passive ustuḥṣinat; sense from context (marriage ties).

definition: Verbal noun (form X): deserving, merit, entitlement. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: Merit, deserving; of worthiness for grace.

definition: Noun istidlál "reasoning, argument" (form X verbal noun) with Persian plural -há. Root d-l-l.
usage: Arguments or reasonings, often in contrast to direct recognition of the truth.

definition: Verb (form X, past) 3rd person feminine singular: she inferred, adduced proof. Root d-l-l.
usage: To adduce proof; in the Íqán of proofs drawn from God's verses (استدلال).

definition: Verb (form X perfect, fem.): it found rest, was at ease. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Of finding rest, as in souls finding rest in God's remembrance.
notes: Subject nafs (self, feminine).

definition: Verb, perfect 2nd masc. pl. form X: ye rested. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Ye rested; e.g. reproach of those who take their ease while others suffer.

definition: Verbal noun (form X): seeking someone's good pleasure, propitiating. Root r-ḍ-y.
usage: 'Seeking to please', as in seeking God's good pleasure (رضا) rather than that of people.
notes: Final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Verbal noun, Form X: seeking a cure, seeking healing. Root sh-f-y.
usage: Seeking a cure, seeking healing, from God or from His Revelation.

definition: Imperative (form X): seek martyrdom, be martyred. Root sh-h-d.
usage: Seeking martyrdom; related to شهادت 'martyrdom' and the martyrs of the Faith.

definition: Passive past of form X istaḍ‘afa: they were deemed weak, were oppressed. Root ḍ-‘-f.
usage: Qur'an 28:5 نرید ان نمنّ علی الذین استضعفوا فی الارض 'We desire to show favour to those who were brought low in the land'.

definition: Verb: perfect of istaṭá‘a, 'to be able'. Root ṭ-w-‘.
usage: Aqdas: لمن استطاع منکم حجّ البیت 'for those of you who are able, pilgrimage to the House'.

definition: Arabic verb, form X perfect 2nd singular: thou art able. Root ṭ-w-‘.
usage: Qur'an 6:35: فان استطعت 'if thou canst'.

definition: Verb form X: to use, employ; ye have used it. Root ‘-m-l.
Verb, form X imperative pl.: use ye, employ. Root ‘-m-l.
Verb imperative: seek ye refuge, take refuge. Root ‘-w-dh.
usage: In the Aqdas: استعیذوا بالله یا معشر العلماء 'seek ye refuge with God, O concourse of divines'.

definition: Verb, form X imperfect: I seek help. Root ‘-w-n.
usage: Echoes Qur'an 1:5 ایّاک نستعین; و به استعین 'and Him I implore for assistance'.

definition: Verbal noun of form X istaghátha: crying for help, imploring aid. Root gh-w-th.
Verbal noun: immersion, absorption, being drowned (in contemplation). Root gh-r-q.
Formula 'I ask forgiveness of God', from form X istaghfara 'to seek pardon'; also disavows an unfitting statement. Root gh-f-r.
usage: In the Íqán it retracts even a limiting comparison: استغفرالله از این تحدید 'I beg forgiveness of God for such a limitation'.

definition: Verb, form X: became rich, independent, free from need. Root gh-n-y.
usage: In the Aqdas به استغنی کلّ فقیر 'through Him every poor one hath been enriched'.

definition: Perfect 3rd plural of form X istaqáma 'to be upright, remain steadfast'. Root q-w-m.
usage: From Qur'an 41:30 قالوا ربّنا اللّه ثمّ استقاموا 'say Our Lord is God and continue steadfast'; steadfastness (استقامة) is a key virtue in the Writings.

definition: Settling, becoming firmly established, stability. Root q-r-r.
Verbal noun form X with -í: my settling, being established upon something. Root q-r-r.
notes: Paired with استوائی 'My being seated'.

definition: Verbal noun of form X: asking for help, seeking assistance. Root m-d-d.
usage: In استمداد جستن 'to seek help', of the man who asked Moses' aid.

definition: Form VIII imperative plural of s-m-‘: listen ye, hearken. Root s-m-‘.
usage: Aqdas: ثمّ استمعوا ما ینصحکم به 'then hearken unto that wherewith ye are counselled'.

definition: Verbal noun of form X: inhaling, breathing in, scenting. Root n-sh-q.
usage: Of the true seeker: رائحهٔ حق را... استنشاق نماید 'inhale the fragrance of truth from distances afar'.

definition: Verbal noun: mockery, ridicule, scorn. Root h-z-’.
usage: Of the people mocking the Prophets: استهزا مینمودند 'they scoffed'.

definition: Compound agent noun from istihzá' kardan: one who mocks, scoffer. Root h-z-’.
Past tense of form X of k-b-r: to be arrogant, consider oneself great. Root k-b-r.
usage: 'Grew proud'; Qur'anic verb for arrogant rejection of God's signs.

definition: Verbal noun (form X): mastery, dominance, ascendancy. Root w-l-y.
usage: Ascendancy, mastery; of the domination of the self or of a power over the world.

definition: Verb sajada "to prostrate", imperative masculine singular: prostrate thyself, bow down. Root s-j-d.
usage: 'Prostrate thyself, bow down', in worship before God.

definition: Noun, plural of saḥar: early mornings, the hours before dawn. Root s-ḥ-r.
usage: The hours before dawn, prized for prayer and the recitation of God's verses.

definition: Plural of sirr (secret, mystery) with 1st sing. suffix: My secrets, My mysteries. Root s-r-r.
usage: My mysteries, divine secrets confided to the pure in heart.

definition: Compound agent noun: isráf 'excess' + kunandih 'doer': one who transgresses, is extravagant.
usage: One who transgresses or is extravagant; اسراف 'excess' is condemned.

definition: Verb, imperative form IV: hasten, speed. Root s-r-‘.
usage: 'Hasten', in calls to hasten to God and His Cause.

definition: Verb, Form IV imperative 2nd plural: hasten! Root s-r-‘.
usage: Hasten!; summons to hasten towards God and His Cause.

definition: Imperative plural of salaka 'to tread, walk a path'. Root s-l-k.
usage: Treading the spiritual path, as in اسلکوا سبل 'tread ye the paths'.

definition: Noun ism 'name' in the indefinite accusative: in name, by name. Root s-m-w.
usage: In the Íqán اسماً و رسماً 'in name and in form'.

definition: Plural of ism 'name' in Persian spelling: names, especially the divine names. Root s-m-w.
usage: In عالم اسما 'the Kingdom of names' and مالک اسما 'the Lord of Names'.
notes: Second reading, Persian spelling of اسماء.

definition: Noun: names, plural of ism, with suffix -hi 'His'. Root s-m-w.
usage: مطلع اسمائه الحسنی 'the Dayspring of His most excellent names'.

definition: Noun asmá', plural of ism 'name', with -kum: your names. Root s-m-w.
Adjective: pertaining to the divine names. Root s-m-w.
usage: Paired with صفاتیه: ظهورات صفاتیه و اسمائیه 'manifestations of the attributes and names'.

definition: Noun ism 'name' with 3rd pl. suffix: their name. Root s-m-w.
Verb imperative: hear, listen, hearken. Root s-m-‘.
usage: In the addresses to kings: یا ملک برلین اسمع النّداء 'O King of Berlin! Give ear unto the Voice'.

definition: Noun ism 'name' with suffix: his name. Root s-m-w.
usage: اسمه الأعظم 'His Most Great Name'.

definition: Active participle of asana: (of water) stagnant, foul, altered in taste. Root ’-s-n.
usage: From Qur'an 47:15 ماء غیر آسن "water that corrupteth not", the incorruptible waters of Paradise.

definition: Imperative plural of sa'ala 'to ask': 'ask ye'. Root s-'-l.
notes: Spelled اسئلوا, with the hamza on a yá' seat.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV ashára: pointing, indication, allusion, sign. Root sh-w-r.
usage: In ‘Alí's saying quoted in the Íqán: کشف سبحات الجلال من غیر اشارة 'the dispersion of the clouds of glory without allusion'.

definition: Noun ishárat 'sign, hint, allusion' with -ash 'its'. Root sh-w-r.
Verbal noun of form IV ashára: pointing, sign, indication, allusion. Root sh-w-r.
Past tense of áshámídan 'to drink, quaff': he/it drank.
usage: Often in imagery of martyrdom or divine wine.

definition: Present perfect of آشامیدن 'to drink': you have drunk.
notes: Written آشامیده‌ئی; madda and hamza seat normalized.

definition: Verb, form VIII, past 3rd person singular: he bought, purchased. Root sh-r-y.
usage: In the Íqán the deed قد اشتری میّت عن میّت 'a dead man hath bought from a dead man'.

definition: Form VIII perfect 3sg fem. of sh-‘-l: (it) blazed, was kindled.
usage: Aqdas: اشتعلت فیک نار البغضاء 'the fire of hatred hath been kindled within thee'.

definition: Verbal noun ishtighál 'occupation, being busied' with suffix 'your'. Root sh-gh-l.
usage: Aqdas: جعلنا اشتغالکم بها نفس العبادة 'We have exalted your engagement in such work to the rank of worship'.

definition: Arabic verb (form VIII), imperative: busy yourselves. Root sh-gh-l.
usage: Aqdas: اشتغلوا بما ینتفع به انفسکم 'occupy yourselves with that which profiteth yourselves'.

definition: Verbal noun: becoming famous or widely known, publicity. Root sh-h-r.
Plural of sharáb 'drink, beverage': drinks. Root sh-r-b.
usage: 'Drinks'; in the Aqdas prohibition of intoxicating drinks.
notes: Paired aṭ‘imih va ashribih 'food and drink'.

definition: Verb: imperative plural of shariba "to drink". Root sh-r-b.
usage: Drink; often figuratively, drink the wine of love or the water of life.

definition: Verbal noun form IV: difficulty, problem, perplexity; "raf‘-i ishkál" resolving doubts. Root sh-k-l.
usage: Difficulty or perplexity, as in رفع اشکال 'resolving a difficulty' in understanding scripture.
notes: Distinct from ashkál "forms".

definition: Verb, imperative (form I): give thanks, be grateful. Root sh-k-r.
usage: Give thanks; a command in the Hidden Words and prayers to thank God for His bounties.
notes: After thumma read thumma'shkur.

definition: Imperative pl. of shakara: thank ye, give thanks. Root sh-k-r.
usage: A call to give thanks to God for His bounty.

definition: Noun: nest; poetically the home of the soul.
usage: Nest; poetically the soul's true home, often the divine nest from which it flew.
notes: Written آشیان.

definition: Noun áshyán 'nest' + -ast 'is'.
usage: 'Is a nest', in the image of the bird of the soul whose true nest is the realm of God.

definition: Verb, Form IV past 3rd fem. + "you": it befell you. Root ṣ-w-b.
usage: Befell you; of trials or blessings that befall the believer.
notes: After in ("if") the past has future sense.

definition: Perfect (form IV): to become; literally to enter upon the morning. Root ṣ-b-ḥ.
usage: To become, as in اصبح 'he became'; literally to enter upon the morning.

definition: Noun: finger. Root ṣ-b-‘.
usage: In the Hidden Words اصبع مالک اسماء 'the finger of the Lord of Names'.

definition: Noun: companions, plural of ṣáḥib, with Persian -í before a relative clause. Root ṣ-ḥ-b.
Arabic verb, form IV perfect: persisted, insisted (with ‘alá). Root ṣ-r-r.
Verbal noun form VIII: patient endurance, fortitude, with Persian -shán 'their'. Root ṣ-b-r.
Verbal noun of form VIII with 3rd pl. suffix: their endurance, patience. Root ṣ-b-r.
Verb imperative: ascend, rise up. Root ṣ-‘-d.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: اصعد الی سمائی 'ascend unto My heaven'.

definition: Verbal noun, form IV: listening attentively, giving ear. Root ṣ-gh-w.
usage: حلّلنا لکم اصغاء الاصوات و النغمات 'We have made it lawful for you to listen to music and singing'.

definition: Elative of ṣaghír: smaller, lesser, least. Root ṣ-gh-r.
Plural of ṣafí 'chosen, pure friend' with -í 'my': 'My chosen ones'. Root ṣ-f-w.
Verbal noun of form IV aṣlaḥa 'to set right, reform' with -há: its reform, its being set right. Root ṣ-l-ḥ.
usage: In the Aqdas, echoing Qur'an 7:56: لا تفسدوا فی الارض بعد اصلاحها 'commit not disorder on earth after it hath been set in order'.

definition: Verb, form IV imperative plural: set right, reconcile, reform. Root ṣ-l-ḥ.
usage: Qur'anic اصلحوا ذات بینکم 'compose your differences'.

definition: Feminine of aṣlí 'original, innate, fundamental'. Root ’-ṣ-l.
usage: In فطرت اصلیّه 'innate nature'.

definition: Plural of ṣanam: idols. Root ṣ-n-m.
usage: In the Aqdas اصنام اهوائکم 'the idols of your evil passions'.

definition: Noun: late afternoon, evening (pl. آصال). Root '-ṣ-l.
usage: Aqdas فی کل اصیل و بکور 'at every eventide and dawn'.
notes: Distinct from Persian اصیل 'noble, pure-bred'.

definition: Verb, form IV, past 3rd person feminine singular: it shone, gave light. Root ḍ-w-’.
usage: In the Aqdas اضآئت شمس البیان 'the Sun of Utterance hath shone'.
notes: Written اضآئت in the source.

definition: Opposites, contraries; plural of ḍidd. Root ḍ-d-d.
usage: Íqán: مقدّس از عناصر و اضداد 'sanctified from elements and contraries'.

definition: Verbal noun of form VIII iḍṭiráb 'agitation, anxiety' with Persian suffix -shán 'their'. Root ḍ-r-b.
usage: Paired with اطمینان: anxiety turned into tranquillity.

definition: Elative of ضالّ: more astray, further from the path. Root ḍ-l-l.
usage: Qur'anic: بل هم اضلّ سبیلا 'nay, they are even further astray'.

definition: Plural of ṭa‘ám: foods, victuals. Root ṭ-‘-m.
Past tense, first person plural, of form IV aṭá‘a 'to obey'. Root ṭ-w-‘.
usage: 'We obeyed'; in the Qur'anic formula سمعنا و اطعنا 'we hear and obey'.
notes: Qur'an: sami‘ná wa aṭa‘ná 'we have heard and we obey'.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): extinguishing, quenching; iṭfá namúdan "to extinguish". Root ṭ-f-’.
usage: Extinguishing; iṭfá namúdan 'to extinguish', of attempts to put out the light of God.

definition: Verbal noun form IV iṭfá’ "extinguishing" with -ka: thy extinction. Root ṭ-f-’.
Noun, plural of iṭláq: applications or usages of a term. Root ṭ-l-q.
usage: The various applications of a term; in the Íqán of words such as 'heaven' or 'sun' bearing many meanings.

definition: Noun iṭmínán (assurance, confidence, tranquillity) with -ishán (their). Root ṭ-m-n.
usage: Assurance, certitude, as in hearts finding assurance (اطمینان قلب) through God's Word.

definition: Imperative fem. sing. of iṭma’anna: be at peace, be reassured. Root ṭ-m-'-n.
usage: Be at peace, recalling یا ایتها النفس المطمئنة 'O soul at peace' (Qur'án 89:27).
notes: Written اطمئنّی.

definition: Verb, perfect form IV 1st person singular: I made manifest, revealed. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: 'I revealed', in God's voice, of making His Self or His Cause manifest.

definition: Verb, Form IV past 1st sing. + "you": I made you appear, brought you forth. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: I made you appear, brought you into being; of God creating and manifesting.

definition: Perfect (form IV) first plural of aẓhara 'to make manifest' + -hu 'it'. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: The divine 'We' who manifested or revealed something, as in اظهرناه 'We revealed it'.

definition: Verbal noun i‘ánat 'help, assistance' with indefinite -í. Root ‘-w-n.
Verb: imperative plural of ‘abada, 'to worship, to serve'. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: In the Qur'anic call of the prophets: یا قوم اعبدوا اللّه 'O my people! Worship God'.

definition: Verbal noun (form VIII): esteem, prestige, credit; also taking heed. Root ‘-b-r.
usage: Worldly prestige given up for God, as in اعتبار ظاهری 'outward esteem'.

definition: Verb form VIII imperative: take warning, learn a lesson, reflect. Root ‘-b-r.
Verb, form VIII perfect: offered an excuse, apologized. Root ‘-dh-r.
Noun with Persian plural -há: objections, protests, cavils. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: In the Íqán of the objections raised against the Prophets.

definition: Verb, form VIII perfect: he confessed, acknowledged. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: اعترف بانّه لا یسئل عمّا یفعل 'acknowledged that He shall not be asked of His doings'.

definition: Form VIII of ‘-z-l: to withdraw, seclude oneself, retire. Root ‘-z-l.
usage: In the Aqdas of ascetics in India who secluded themselves.

definition: Verb: 'ye devoted yourselves, clung to', form VIII of ‘-k-f.
Perfect of form IV a‘adda: he prepared, made ready. Root ‘-d-d.
usage: Qur'anic formula اعدّ لهم ... عذاباً 'He hath prepared for them a torment'.

definition: Noun, plural of ‘arsh: thrones. Root ‘-r-sh.
usage: In the Aqdas استوی علی اعراش الأسماء 'mounted the thrones of the names'.

definition: Verbal noun of a‘raḍa 'to turn away' with -hum 'their'. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: From Qur'an 6:35 و ان کان کبر علیک اعراضهم 'and if their aversion be grievous unto thee'.

definition: A‘raf 'better knowing' with Persian -íd 'you are': you know better. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: In the Hidden Words بنفس خود ابصر و اعرفید 'ye are better acquainted with your own selves'.

definition: Elative adjective: dearer, mightier, more glorious. Root ‘-z-z.
Noun, plural of ‘azíz: the honoured, notables, dignitaries. Root ‘-z-z.
usage: In the Íqán علما و اعزّه 'the divines and notables' who rose against the believers.

definition: Ages, epochs (plural of ‘aṣr) with -kum "your". Root ‘-ṣ-r.
usage: Aqdas: این اعصارکم الخالیة 'where are your bygone ages?'.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV: giving, bestowing. Root ‘-ṭ-w.
usage: قمر از اعطای نور بازمیماند 'the moon shall not give her light'.
notes: Final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Arabic elative اعظم with the Persian comparative -tar: greater, mightier. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
Plural of ‘aqib (heel) with 'their'; نکصوا علی اعقابهم 'they turned back on their heels'. Root ‘-q-b.
Plural of ‘aqib 'heel' plus -kum; ‘alá a‘qábikum 'on your heels, after you'. Root ‘-q-b.
usage: 'Your heels'; in the Qur'anic image of turning back on one's heels, of apostasy.

definition: Verb: imperative plural of ‘alima "to know". Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Know; common opening of counsels, i‘lamú 'know ye'.

definition: Noun, plural of ‘amal "deed" with -ka: thy deeds. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: Deeds, as in calls to account for one's deeds each day.

definition: Verb, imperative (form I): do, act, carry out. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: Do, act; of acting upon God's commandments, as in walking in His statutes.
notes: i‘mal ḥudúdí walk in My statutes.

definition: Plural of ‘ahd: ages, eras, times; also covenants. Root ‘-h-d.
usage: Ages or eras, as in اعهاد و اعصار; also covenants.

definition: Verb, imperfect 1st sing. of ‘ádha: I seek refuge. Root ‘-w-dh.
usage: 'I seek refuge', as in اعوذ بالله 'I seek refuge in God'.

definition: Adjective: one-eyed, blind in one eye. Root ‘-w-r.
usage: 'One-eyed', used in the Writings of the Antichrist (the One-eyed Dajjál) and of a particular opponent.

definition: Plural a‘yun (eyes) + "your". Root ‘-y-n.
usage: Your eyes; of the eyes of the heart that must be cleansed to see.

definition: Perfect (form VIII): to be enraged, grow angry. Root gh-y-ẓ.
usage: Being enraged, used of those angered by the Cause.

definition: Verbal noun: disorder, confusion, turmoil. Root gh-sh-sh.
Verb: imperative plural of ightamasa, 'to plunge, to immerse oneself'. Root gh-m-s.
usage: Aqdas: اغتمسوا فی بحر بیانی 'immerse yourselves in the ocean of My words'.

pos: verb 3sg fem. perfect (form IV) + 2sg fem. obj.
definition: Arabic verb, form IV perfect with -ki: it deluded thee, made thee vain. Root gh-r-r.
usage: Aqdas, addressing a city: اغرّتک زینتک الظّاهرة 'hath thine outward splendour made thee vain?'.

definition: Imperative plural of ghasala 'to wash'. Root gh-s-l.
Verb, form IV perfect with 2nd masc. suffix: led thee astray. Root gh-w-y.
Verbal noun: conveying, signifying a meaning; imparting benefit. Root f-y-d.
usage: افاده شدن 'to be conveyed, signified', of grammatical meaning.

definition: Plural verbal noun, form IV: outpourings, effusions of grace. Root f-y-ḍ.
usage: افاضات الهی 'divine outpourings'.

definition: Relative adjective from áfáq "horizons": of the outer world, external.
usage: آیات آفاقیّه و انفسیّه "signs in the horizons and in the souls" (Qur'an 41:53).

definition: Plural of آفتاب 'sun': suns; the final ی links the izáfih.
Simple past 3rd person plural of uftádan 'to fall'; in dar ṣadad-i ... uftádan, to set about, undertake.
Verb, present perfect 3rd plural of uftádan 'to fall'.
Verbal noun of form VIII iftatana: being tried or seduced; temptation, turmoil. Root f-t-n.
usage: Paired with امتحان 'test' of the trials accompanying each Revelation.

definition: Form I imperative of fataḥa 'to open'. Root f-t-ḥ.
usage: In the Aqdas افتح البصر 'open thine eyes'.
notes: Kasra before the following article for liaison.

definition: Imperative plural: open ye! Root f-t-ḥ.
notes: Arabic sentence inside the Persian Hidden Words.

definition: Verbal noun of form VIII with 'thy': thy pride, thy glorying. Root f-kh-r.
usage: In the Hidden Words ان یکون افتخارک باسمی لا باسمک 'thy glory should be in My name, not in thine'.

definition: Form VIII perfect 2pl of f-kh-r: you boasted, prided yourselves (with bi).
usage: Aqdas: قد افتخرتم باسمی و غفلتم عن نفسی 'ye have prided yourselves on My Name, yet ye have been heedless of My Self'.

definition: Compound agent noun: one who fabricates a lie, a slanderer; Arabic iftirá + Persian -kunandih. Root f-r-y.
usage: Charge laid against the Prophets: افتراکننده بر پروردگار 'one who forgeth a lie against God'.

definition: Verbal noun: slander, false accusation, fabrication. Root f-r-y.
usage: Íqán: کذب محض و افترای صرف 'sheer falsehood and pure calumny'.

definition: Imperative of fadá: ransom, sacrifice, offer up. Root f-d-y.
usage: From the Báb: افد احب الاشیاء الیک فی سبیل الله 'Sacrifice the thing thou lovest most in the path of God'.

definition: Imperative, masculine singular, of fariḥa 'to rejoice, be glad'. Root f-r-ḥ.
usage: 'Rejoice'; in the Hidden Words 'rejoice in the gladness of thine heart'.

definition: Verb: imperative plural of fariḥa "to rejoice, be glad". Root f-r-ḥ.
usage: Rejoice; call to rejoice in God's bounty or Day.

definition: Verb fariḥa "to rejoice", imperative 2nd feminine singular: rejoice thou. Root f-r-ḥ.
usage: 'Rejoice thou', addressed to a personified land or soul, as in Bahá'u'lláh's addresses.
notes: Aqdas addresses the land of Ṭá (Ṭihrán).

definition: Verb, past 3rd person plural of afrúkhtan: they kindled, lit.
usage: To kindle; of kindling the fire of the love of God, or of opponents kindling the fire of hatred.

definition: Verb (form IV perfect): he corrupted, spread mischief. Root f-s-d.
usage: Of spreading corruption or mischief in the land (الفساد فی الارض), strongly condemned in the Writings.

definition: Interjection/noun: alas; regret, sorrow.
usage: Alas; regret, a lament over heedlessness.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): bestowal of favour, bounty, beneficence. Root f-ḍ-l.
usage: 'Bounty', often paired with فضل 'grace', of God's bestowals on His servants.
notes: Paired with faḍl 'grace'.

definition: Elative: better, more excellent, most eminent. Root f-ḍ-l.
usage: Most excellent; used of the best deeds and virtues.

definition: Plural of fi‘l 'deed, act' + -him 'their'. Root f-‘-l.
usage: Deeds and acts, often contrasted with words, as in the call for deeds not words.

definition: Plural of fi‘l 'deed, action' with -kum 'your'. Root f-‘-l.
usage: Often paired with اعمال 'works' and اقوال 'words'.

definition: Noun ufuq 'horizon' with suffix -í 'My'. Root '-f-q.
usage: الافق الأبهی 'the Abhá (Most Glorious) Horizon', the realm of Bahá'u'lláh's glory.
notes: Read ufuqiya'l-abhá before the article.

definition: Noun, plural of fanan: branches, twigs. Root f-n-n.
usage: Branches of the divine Tree, as in افنان سدرة البهاء; Afnán also names the Báb's kindred.

definition: Plural of fam 'mouth'. Root f-w-h.
usage: In السن و افواه 'the tongues and mouths' of people, i.e. common talk.

definition: Compound agent noun from Arabic ifk 'lie' and Persian kunandih 'doer': liar, slanderer.
Noun: lie, calumny, slander; with Persian indefinite -í. Root ’-f-k.
Adjective: lying, slanderous, false. Root '-f-k.
usage: ظنونات افکیه 'false imaginings'.

definition: Plural of fu’ád: hearts, inmost hearts. Root f-’-d.
usage: In the Writings افئده are hearts as seats of perception, as in طیور افئده "the birds of men's hearts".
notes: Written افئدهٴ; ٴ marks the izáfih.

definition: Plural of fu'ád 'heart': hearts. Root f-'-d.
Verbal noun of form IV aqáma: residing, dwelling, sojourn; in Arabic also establishing (prayer). Root q-w-m.
Verbal noun: establishing, setting up, performing. Root q-w-m.
usage: In the Íqán اقامهٔ حدود اللّه 'establishing the laws of God'.
notes: Written اقامئ: the final ی with hamza carries the izáfih.

shift: Here: turning towards God and His Manifestation, opposite of اعراض. Today: fortune, luck.
definition: Verbal noun of form IV aqbala 'turning towards' with -ishán 'their'; in modern Persian 'fortune'. Root q-b-l.
usage: اقبال in the Writings is turning to God and His Manifestation, opposed to اعراض 'turning away'.

definition: Iqbál 'turning towards, approach' with -ka: thy turning (to). Root q-b-l.
usage: Iqbál in the Writings is turning to God and His Manifestation, the opposite of i‘ráḍ.

definition: Verbal noun form VIII with -hu: his power, might. Root q-d-r.
usage: E.g. سلطنة الله و اقتداره 'the sovereignty and power of God'.

definition: Verb, form VIII, past 3rd person singular: drew near, approached. Root q-r-b.
usage: In John the Baptist's words توبوا فقد اقترب ملکوت السّموات 'Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand'.

definition: Requirement, exigency; اقتضا نمودن "to require, call for". Form VIII verbal noun, root q-ḍ-y.
Plural of qadaḥ: cups, drinking-bowls, chalices. Root q-d-ḥ.
usage: خذوا اقداح الفلاح 'take ye the chalices of salvation'.

definition: Verbal noun: undertaking, taking steps; with نمودن 'to set about'. Root q-d-m.
usage: Íqán: بر منعش اقدام نمودند 'arose to hinder Him'.

definition: Plural of qadam (foot) with 'your': your feet, footsteps. Root q-d-m.
Elative adjective of qadusa: most holy. Root q-d-s.
usage: 'Most Holy'; as in کتاب اقدس 'the Most Holy Book' and قلم اقدس 'the Most Holy Pen'.
notes: Sufi term fayḍ-i aqdas 'the Most Holy Outpouring'.

definition: Verb (form IV): past of aqarra "to acknowledge, confess". Root q-r-r.
usage: Acknowledged, confessed; of acknowledging God and His Manifestation.

definition: Noun, plural of qarn: centuries, ages, generations. Root q-r-n.
usage: Ages or centuries, often of the long ages and generations that preceded a revelation.
notes: a‘ṣár va aqrán ages and centuries.

definition: Verb, imperative masculine plural (form I): read, recite. Root q-r-’.
usage: Read ye, recite; the Aqdas bids the believers recite the verses of God morning and evening.
notes: Written اقرؤا.

definition: Verb (form IV imperfect, 1st sing.): I swear, take an oath. Root q-s-m.
usage: 'I swear', an oath formula, often 'I swear by God' or 'by the Beauty of God'.
notes: Fa-lá uqsimu = Nay, I swear.

definition: Imperative masc. pl. of qasama: divide, apportion. Root q-s-m.
usage: Divide, apportion, as in the Aqdas's laws of inheritance.

definition: Verb, imperfect form IV 1st person singular with -ka: I adjure thee, I implore thee by oath. Root q-s-m.
usage: 'I adjure thee', in prayers beseeching God by His Name or His Beauty.

definition: Verb, Form IV imperfect 1st sing. + "you": I adjure you. Root q-s-m.
usage: I adjure you; solemn formula addressing the people.

definition: Plural of quṭr: regions, sides, quarters (of the world). Root q-ṭ-r.
usage: Regions or quarters of the world, as in اقطار عالم 'the regions of the world'.

definition: Past of form IV aq‘ada 'to seat' with -hu 'him': We seated him. Root q-‘-d.
usage: In the Aqdas اقعدناه علی سریر القبول 'We have seated him upon the throne of acceptance'.

definition: Verb: perfect 1st plural of aqmaṣa, 'to clothe with a shirt', with suffix -hu. Root q-m-ṣ.
usage: Prologue of the Hidden Words: اقمصناه قمیص الاختصار 'clothed it in the garment of brevity'.

definition: Noun aqvál, plural of qawl 'word, saying', with indefinite -í: sayings, words. Root q-w-l.
usage: Paired with افعال 'deeds'.

definition: Verbal noun form IV: sunrise, dawning, shining forth. Root sh-r-q.
usage: Also the shining forth of divine light; اشراقات 'Splendours'.
notes: Hamza is written as a separate letter in this edition.

definition: Verbal noun of form VIII with article: honour, dignity, being held in esteem. Root ‘-z-z.
notes: Spelled with a separate hamza after the alef in the source.

definition: Noun: possibility; in philosophy contingency, the contingent world of created beings. Root m-k-n.
usage: In the Writings عالم امکان 'the world of being', all created things as contingent on God.
notes: The ء in the form is a hamza seat written on the line.

definition: Plural of ab: fathers, forefathers. Root '-b-w.
usage: کما یربّی الآباء ابنائهم 'as fathers educate their children'.

definition: Relative adjective from abad "endless time": everlasting, eternal. Root ’-b-d.
Adjective (feminine): everlasting, eternal without end. Root '-b-d.
Plural of barr: the righteous, the pious. Root b-r-r.
usage: Qur'an 76:5 in the Íqán: انّ الابرار یشربون من کأس 'the righteous shall drink of a cup'.

definition: Noun: needle. Root ’-b-r.
usage: In the Aqdas سمّ الابرة 'the eye of a needle'.

definition: Noun or adjective: pure, refined gold; used after dhahab.
notes: Aqdas: تسعة عشر مثقالاً من الذّهب الابریز 'nineteen mithqáls of gold'.

definition: Plural of ibn: sons, children. Root b-n-y.
Dual of ab: the two parents, father and mother. Root '-b-w.
usage: Aqdas makes marriage conditional on باذن الابوین 'the consent of the parents'.

definition: Noun, plural of álah: tools, instruments. Root a-w-l.
usage: In the Aqdas حرّم علیکم حمل آلات الحرب 'it is forbidden you to carry arms'.

definition: Union, unity, unification. Form VIII verbal noun, root w-ḥ-d.
usage: A cardinal Bahá'í theme; in the Aqdas a universal language is سبب الاتّحاد 'the cause of unity'.

definition: Plural of tall: hills, mounds. Root t-l-l.
usage: علی القنن و الاتلال 'upon the summits and the hills'.

definition: Noun: household goods, possessions, furnishings. Root ’-th-th.
usage: Aqdas: لا ینفع النّاس ما عندهم من الأثاث 'their possessions profit men nothing'.

definition: Feminine dual numeral: two (women). Root th-n-y.
usage: In the Aqdas on marriage: not to exceed two wives.

definition: Adjective: sinful; as a noun, sinner. Root '-th-m.
usage: 'Sinful, sinner'; Qur'anic epithet for the transgressor.
notes: Qur'an 44:44 ṭa‘ámu al-athími 'the food of the sinner'.

definition: Noun with article: plural of ḥadíth: sayings, traditions, narratives, events. Root ḥ-d-th.
usage: Sayings, traditions; the hadith of the Prophet and Imams, frequently cited in the Íqán.

definition: Noun, plural of ḥibr with article: learned men, rabbis, divines. Root ḥ-b-r.
usage: Learned men or rabbis, often in Qur'anic allusions to the divines of former religions.
notes: HW Prologue: "as a token of grace unto the righteous".

definition: Noun, plural of ḥurr: free men, the noble-minded. Root ḥ-r-r.
usage: The free and noble-minded, those detached from self.

definition: Adjective of colour: red, crimson. Root ḥ-m-r.
usage: Red, as in السفینة الحمراء 'the Crimson Ark' and الورقة الحمراء; crimson denotes the Cause of God.
notes: Al-midád al-aḥmar = the crimson ink.

definition: Noun: brother. Root '-kh-w.
usage: Brother, one of the inheritance categories in the Aqdas.

definition: Noun: sister, female sibling; plural akhawát. Root ’-kh-w.
usage: 'The sister', in the Aqdas's laws of inheritance and of marriage.

definition: Verbal noun, Form VIII: abridgement, brevity, conciseness. Root kh-ṣ-r.
usage: Brevity; in the formula علی الاختصار "briefly".

definition: Plural of khashab 'wood, timber': kinds of wood. Root kh-sh-b.
usage: Woods or timber, in practical matters.

definition: Elative of khafí 'hidden': most hidden, most secret. Root kh-f-y.
usage: Of the innermost mystery or goal; in Sufi terms the 'most hidden' subtlety of the soul.

definition: Noun: character, morals, manners; plural of khulq. Root kh-l-q.
usage: Aqdas: طوبی لمن تزیّن بطراز الآداب و الأخلاق 'happy is he who is adorned with goodly manners and character'.

definition: Noun, plural of khál: maternal uncles. Root kh-w-l.
usage: Aqdas inheritance law, beside الأعمام 'paternal uncles'.

definition: Verbal noun form IV: perception, comprehension, understanding. Root d-r-k.
Noun, plural of daghal with article: thickets, dense jungles. Root d-gh-l.
Noun, plural of udhun: ears. Root ’-dh-n.
usage: In the Aqdas law on hair: حدّ الآذان 'the limit of the ears'.
notes: Not al-adhán 'the call to prayer'; the snippet reads الآذان.

definition: Verbal noun, form VIII: rising, elevation, exaltation. Root r-f-‘.
usage: میدان المشاهدة و الارتفاع 'the arena of vision and exaltation'.

definition: Verbal noun of form VIII irtaqá: ascending, climbing. Root r-q-y.
usage: In the Aqdas the prohibition of ascending pulpits, الارتقآء الی المنابر.

definition: Elative plural: the basest, the most abject. Root r-dh-l.
Sound plural of arḍ: earths, lands; with as-samáwát, the heavens and the earth. Root ’-r-ḍ.
usage: In the Aqdas السموات و الارضون 'the heavens and the earth'.

definition: Noun, plural of rukn: pillars, supports; limbs. Root r-k-n.
usage: In the Aqdas کالأصابع فی الید و الأرکان للبدن 'as the fingers of one hand, the members of one body'.

definition: Plural of ríḥ 'wind'. Root r-w-ḥ.
notes: Aqdas: تمرّ ایام حیوتکم کما تمرّ الاریاح 'the days of your life pass away as the winds'.

definition: Eternity without beginning, pre-existence.
usage: In the Tradition of Kumayl نور اشرق من صبح الأزل 'a light which shone from the Morn of eternity'.

definition: Relative adjective, feminine: pre-eternal, without beginning (from azal). Root '-z-l.
usage: Paired with ابدی 'everlasting'; describes God's beginningless Essence and gifts.

definition: Noun: foundation, basis. Root a-s-s.
usage: In the Aqdas هو الاسّ الأعظم 'it is the Most Great Foundation', of a sign of the world's maturity.

definition: Veils, curtains, coverings; plural of sitr. Root s-t-r.
usage: Aqdas: ما هو خلف الأستار 'that which lieth hid behind the veils'.

definition: Apparently al-asfár, plural of safar: journeys, travels. Root s-f-r.
notes: The form lacks a final ر; probably the corpus split or truncated الأسفار 'journeys', which fits the Aqdas context (limits on travel set by the Bayán).

definition: Plural of سفر: journeys, travels. Root s-f-r.
usage: Aqdas law of prayer and fasting on journeys: فی الأسفار.

definition: Noun: submission to God; the religion of Islam. Root s-l-m.
Adjective, masculine: black; feminine sawdá’. Root s-w-d.
usage: 'Black'; in the Aqdas reference to the Black Stone (الحجر الاسود) or in images of darkness.

definition: Noun with article: plural of shaqí: the wretched, the wicked. Root sh-q-w.
usage: The wicked, the wretched; contrasted with the blessed (su‘adá).

definition: Noun, plural of aṣíl with article: late afternoons, evenings. Root '-ṣ-l.
usage: Evenings, in the Qur'anic pair بالغدو والآصال 'morning and evening', of times for remembering God.
notes: al-bukúr wa’l-áṣál morning and evening.

definition: Verbal noun (form VIII): patient endurance, forbearance. Root ṣ-b-r.
usage: Patient endurance in trials, a quality God enjoins on His lovers in the Hidden Words.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): listening, hearkening, giving ear. Root ṣ-gh-w.
usage: Listening or hearkening, of giving ear to God's call.

definition: Elative of ṣáfí: purest, clearest. Root ṣ-f-w.
usage: Purest, e.g. the purest wine or stream.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV): reform, putting right, reconciliation. Root ṣ-l-ḥ.
usage: 'Reform, reconciliation', of putting right the affairs of the world and of men.

definition: Plural of ṣawt: voices, sounds. Root ṣ-w-t.
usage: Voices, sounds; the Aqdas permits listening to music and voices.
notes: Iṣghá' al-aṣwát wa'n-naghamát: listening to music and singing.

definition: Plural of ṭabíb: physicians, doctors. Root ṭ-b-b.
usage: Physicians, as in the Aqdas's counsel to consult skilled physicians.

definition: Plural of ṭaraf 'side, edge': sides, regions, the outlying parts of a land. Root ṭ-r-f.
usage: In the Aqdas سبب الاختلاف فی الاطراف 'a cause of dissension in the regions'.

definition: Noun: nails (of fingers and toes), plural of ẓufr. Root ẓ-f-r.
usage: Aqdas: تقلیم الاظفار 'the paring of the nails', an ordinance of cleanliness.

definition: Noun/adjective, plural of ‘azíz: the mighty, the honoured, the dear. Root ‘-z-z.
usage: Aqdas: لا تبقی عزّة الأعزّاء 'the glory of the mighty shall not endure'.

definition: Plural of ‘aṣr: ages, eras, epochs. Root ‘-ṣ-r.
Verbal noun of form IV with article: giving, bestowal. Root ‘-ṭ-w.
usage: In the Aqdas ایّام الاعطاء 'the Days of Giving', the intercalary days (Ayyám-i-Há) before the Fast.

definition: Elative dual: the two greatest. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: In العیدین الأعظمین 'the two Most Great Festivals', Riḍván and the Báb's Declaration.

definition: Plural of ghuṣn 'branch': branches; in Bahá'í usage the male descendants of Bahá'u'lláh. Root gh-ṣ-n.
usage: Aqdas: یرجع الحکم الی الأغصان 'authority shall pass to the Aghṣán', i.e. the Branches.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV aghmaḍa: closing the eyes, connivance, wilful disregard. Root gh-m-ḍ.
Verbal noun: calumny, slander, false accusation. Root f-r-y.
usage: In the Aqdas forbidden with backbiting: الغیبة و الافتراء 'backbiting or calumny'.

definition: Plural of faraḥ: joys, rejoicings, festivities. Root f-r-ḥ.
usage: In the Aqdas طویت زرابی الافراح 'the carpets of joy are rolled up'.

definition: Verbal noun: bestowal of favour, bounty, beneficence. Root f-ḍ-l.
Plural of fanan 'branch, bough'. Root f-n-n.
usage: Literally boughs, as here; as a proper name the Afnán, the Báb's kindred.

definition: Setting (of the sun or stars). Root ’-f-l.
usage: In the Aqdas fasting law: من الطّلوع الی الأفول 'from sunrise to sunset'.

definition: Verbal noun form VIII: union, conjunction; in law, marriage. Root q-r-n.
usage: Aqdas لا یحل الاقتران ... 'marriage is not permitted...', in the law of marriage.

definition: Noun, plural of qadam: feet. Root q-d-m.
usage: In Qur'an 55:41 فیؤخذ بالنّواصی و الأقدام 'they shall be seized by their forelocks and their feet'.

definition: Most holy; elative of quds "holiness". Root q-d-s.
usage: In المقام الأقدس 'the Most Holy Spot', the Qiblih, and in the title کتاب اقدس 'the Most Holy Book'.

definition: Verbal noun of form IV: acknowledging, confessing, affirming. Root q-r-r.
usage: طوبی لمن ایّده الله علی الاقرار بالستّة 'well is it with him whom God aideth to acknowledge the Six'.

definition: Plural of قمر: moons. Root q-m-r.
usage: In the Lament (Nudbih): این الأقمار المنیرة 'where are the shining moons?'

definition: Plural of qút: foodstuffs, provisions, sustenance. Root q-w-t.
usage: Aqdas: تزکیة الاقوات 'Zakát on produce'.

definition: Elative of qawím 'straight, upright': straightest, most upright. Root q-w-m.
usage: 'Straightest'; in Qur'anic phrasing of the most upright path.

definition: Arabic al-albáb "minds" (plural of lubb) plus Persian -ast "is"; ulu’l-albáb "people of understanding". Root l-b-b.
usage: Of understanding is; in ulu'l-albáb 'people of understanding', a Qur'anic phrase.

definition: Noun, plural of libás with article: garments, clothes. Root l-b-s.
notes: Aqdas inheritance: "the residence and personal clothing".

definition: Noun, plural of lisán: tongues, languages. Root l-s-n.
usage: Tongues, languages; the Aqdas calls for choosing one language from among all languages to be taught everywhere.

definition: Noun: alif, first letter of the alphabet, an upright stroke.
usage: The letter alif, the upright stroke; symbol of unity and the first point from which letters unfold.
notes: Not al-alf (thousand).

definition: Verbal noun form IV: inspiration. Root l-h-m.
usage: Inspiration; claims to inspiration are weighed against the Revelation.

definition: Intensive adjective: one who commands much; as a divine name, the Ordainer. Root ’-m-r.
usage: 'The Ordainer', a divine name; also of the self that incites to evil (النفس الامّارة).

definition: Plural of amal: hopes, desires, aspirations. Root '-m-l.
usage: Hopes and aspirations, worldly or spiritual.

definition: Noun: trustworthiness, faithfulness; a trust. Root ’-m-n.
usage: Trustworthiness, extolled in the Writings as a chief virtue and 'the greatest portal' to tranquillity.

definition: Plural of mithl or mathal: likenesses, similitudes, parables. Root m-th-l.
usage: In the Aqdas لا بالصور و الامثال 'not by forms and likenesses'.

definition: Noun: rulers, princes, commanders; plural of amír. Root '-m-r.
usage: Aqdas: یا معشر الأمرآء 'O concourse of rulers'.

definition: Noun, dual of amr: the two matters or conditions. Root '-m-r.
Verbal noun form IV: abstaining, restraint; fasting. Root m-s-k.
usage: In the Aqdas the Fast, before which the Intercalary Days (ایام الاعطاء) are kept.

definition: Noun: safety, security, peace. Root ’-m-n.
Adjective: unlettered, untaught by men; a Qur'anic title of the Prophet. Root ’-m-m.
usage: In the Aqdas Bahá'u'lláh calls Himself هذا الأمّی 'this Unlettered One'.

definition: Plural noun: females, women. Root '-n-th.
usage: Aqdas inheritance law: من الذکران دون الاناث 'to the males, not the females'.

definition: Plural of anmula: fingertips, finger-ends. Root n-m-l.
usage: From Qur'an 3:119 عضّوا علیکم الأنامل من الغیظ "they bite their fingers' ends at you in rage".

definition: Verbal noun: waiting, expectation. Root n-ẓ-r.
Plural of najm: the stars. Root n-j-m.
usage: The Du‘á-yi-Nudbih in the Íqán: این الانجم الزاهرة 'where are the resplendent stars?'; stars symbolize the divines.

definition: Noun, plural of naẓar: looks, eyes; insight, discernment. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: In the Aqdas یا اولی الانظار 'O ye who are endued with insight'.

definition: Plural of na‘am 'cattle, livestock'; figuratively brutish people. Root n-‘-m.
usage: Qur'anic image of the heedless, کالأنعام بل هم اضلّ 'like the brutes, nay, further astray'.
notes: The tradition عزیز بین الأنعام is hard to read; perhaps anám 'people' was intended.

definition: Plural of nahr: rivers. Root n-h-r.
usage: In the Aqdas قد انفجرت من الأحجار الأنهار 'rivers have gushed forth from rocks'.

definition: Elative adjective: most luminous, brightest. Root n-w-r.
usage: E.g. المنظر الانور 'the Most Luminous Spot'.

definition: Noun, plural of waqt: times. Root w-q-t.
usage: In the Aqdas, of reckoning prayer times by clocks and shadows: تحدّدت الأوقات 'the times are fixed'.

definition: Endowments: property devoted to charitable or religious purposes; plural of waqf. Root w-q-f.
usage: Aqdas: قد رجعت الاوقاف المختصّة للخیرات الی اللّه 'all endowments dedicated to charity revert to God'.

definition: Verbal noun: eating, food. Root ’-k-l.
usage: In the law of the fast: کفّوا انفسکم عن الاکل و الشرب 'abstain from food and drink'.

definition: Plural of ید: hands; also favours. Root y-d-y.
usage: Aqdas: حرّم علیکم تقبیل الأیادی 'the kissing of hands hath been forbidden'.
notes: In Bahá'í usage ایادی امرالله is 'Hands of the Cause'.

definition: Plural of yatím: orphans. Root y-t-m.
Dual of áyah 'verse, sign' in the accusative or genitive. Root '-y-y.
usage: 'The two verses'; refers to two particular verses cited in a passage.
notes: Hadith shayyabatní al-áyatayni 'the two verses made me grey'.

definition: Noun: pollution, defilement, contamination (from álúdan "to stain").
usage: Defilement, contamination; of worldly or selfish defilement from which the heart must be purified.

definition: Verbal noun form IV with article: faith, belief. Root '-m-n.
usage: Faith or belief in God and His Messengers.
notes: Genitive in "rúḥ al-ímán".

definition: Noun: the letter bá (ب), numerical value 2.
usage: The letter bá; in mystical and Bahá'í writings the first letter of بسم and of بهاء, with symbolic meaning.

definition: Active participle: one who gives freely; divine epithet the Generous. Root b-dh-l.
usage: Divine epithet 'the Bountiful', one who gives freely.

definition: Active participle (fem.): remaining, everlasting. Root b-q-y.
usage: Everlasting, abiding; contrasted with الفانیة 'perishing'.

definition: Noun, plural of baḥr 'sea': seas; here the hadith compilation Biḥár al-Anwár. Root b-ḥ-r.
usage: 'The seas', and as a title the Shí‘í hadith compilation بحار الانوار, which the Íqán quotes for traditions on the Qá'im.
notes: fí’l-Biḥár: in the Biḥár.

definition: Noun: beginning, origin, first appearance. Root b-d-'.
usage: The beginning; in the pairing البدء و العود "the Beginning and the Return".

definition: Proper noun: Berlin, capital of Prussia and Germany, addressed in the Kitáb-i-Aqdas.
usage: Berlin, named in the Kitáb-i-Aqdas in the passage addressed to the banks of the Rhine, which foretells that 'the lamentations of Berlin' will be heard.
notes: Proper noun with the Arabic article.

definition: Noun: blessing, abundance, divine grace. Root b-r-k.
usage: In the Aqdas ینزل علیه البرکة من السماء 'blessings descend upon him from heaven'.

definition: Noun: creation, created beings, mankind. Root b-r-'.
usage: In the divine title مالک البریة 'the Lord of creation'.

definition: Noun: carpet, spread; figuratively a court or presence. Root b-s-ṭ.
usage: The court of divine presence, as in بساط القرب 'the court of nearness'; also بساط عزّکم 'the carpet of your glory' rolled up.

definition: Plural of libás: garments, clothes. Root l-b-s.
Verb, imperative pl. of labisa: wear ye, put on. Root l-b-s.
Adjective and divine name: the All-Seeing. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: Paired with السّمیع, as in السّمیع البصیر 'the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing'.

definition: Verbal noun: injustice, wrongdoing, transgression. Root b-gh-y.
usage: نبذوا البغی و الغوی 'have cast away wickedness and error'.

definition: Plural of buq‘a: spots, places, localities. Root b-q-‘.
Noun: spot, place, tract of land. Root b-q-‘.
usage: In the Writings the holy places, as in البقعة المبارکة الحمراء 'the blessed and crimson Spot'.

definition: Noun: the land, the country, the town. Root b-l-d.
usage: Qur'an 7:58 in the Íqán: البلد الطیّب یخرج نباته باذن ربّه 'the good land bringeth forth its plants by permission of its Lord'.

definition: Noun: crystal (of Greek origin).
usage: In the Aqdas, burial of the dead in coffins of crystal or stone.

definition: Verbal noun of balagha 'to reach': attainment, maturity, coming of age. Root b-l-gh.
usage: In the Aqdas the age of maturity (fifteen) at which prayer and fasting become obligatory; also بلوغ العالم 'the maturity of the world'.

definition: Plural of bint: daughters, girls. Root b-n-w.
Adjective: glorious, splendid; a name of God. Root b-h-w.
usage: Opening of the Arabic Hidden Words: هو البهی الابهی 'He is the Glory of the Most Glorious'.

definition: Noun: owl, a bird of ill omen.
usage: In the Aqdas to Constantinople: نسمع بینکم صوت البوم 'We hear the hooting of the owl among you'.

definition: Early morning, dawn; rising early. Root b-k-r.
usage: Aqdas: فی البکور و الآصال 'at morn and eventide'.

definition: Dual of bayt 'house'. Root b-y-t.
usage: In the Aqdas the two sacred Houses: of the Báb in Shíráz and of Bahá'u'lláh in Baghdád.

definition: Adjective fem. of ابیض: white. Root b-y-ḍ.
usage: In the tradition النّهج البیضاء و الرّکن الحمراء 'the snow-white Path and the Crimson Pillar'.

definition: Active participle plural of tába: those who repent, the penitent. Root t-w-b.
Noun: trade, commerce. Root t-j-r.
usage: 'Trade'; in Aqdas laws, and in the image of a trade with God that never fails.

definition: Verbal noun (form V) with article: remembering, calling to mind. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Remembrance, calling to mind; of remembering God and taking heed.

definition: Verbal noun form II with article: arrangement, order, sequence. Root r-t-b.
Proper noun (collective): the Turks.
usage: The Turks, named among the nations and languages of the world.
notes: Paired with ad-Daylam.

definition: Noun: prudent concealment of one's faith, dissimulation. Root w-q-y.
usage: Taqíyyah, concealing one's faith under threat; the Writings forbid such dissimulation for believers.

definition: Broken plural of timthál: images, statues, likenesses. Root m-th-l.
Verbal noun (form V): civilization, refinement. Root m-d-n.
usage: 'Civilization', a theme of 'Abdu'l-Bahá's writings, as in رسالهٔ مدنیّه 'The Secret of Divine Civilization'.

definition: Verbal noun, Form VI (tanádí): mutual calling; "yawm at-tanád" the Day of Judgment. Root n-d-w.
usage: In یوم التناد "the Day of Summoning", the Day of Judgment.

definition: Verbal noun (form V): awakening, taking heed, attentiveness. Root n-b-h.
usage: Awakening and heedfulness, set against غفلت 'heedlessness'.

definition: Verbal noun: turning upside down, inverting, reversal. Root n-k-s.
usage: In the Aqdas قد ظهر سرّ التنکیس لرمز الرئیس 'the mystery of the Great Reversal in the Sign of the Sovereign hath now been made manifest'.

definition: Verbal noun: humility, lowliness. Root w-ḍ-‘.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words: الّا بالخضوع لأمرنا و التّواضع لوجهنا 'save by submission unto Our command and humbleness before Our Face'.

definition: Ordinal adjective: third. Root th-l-th.
Ordinal: second, the other. Root th-n-y.
Noun with article: moist earth, soil, the ground. Root th-r-y.
usage: In مالک العرش و الثّری 'Lord of the Throne and of earth'.

definition: Noun: praise, laudation. Root th-n-y.
usage: In the Aqdas ایک الثّناء 'the Sanctuary of Praise' from which the Mystic Dove takes flight.

definition: Active participle: ignorant person, fool. Root j-h-l.
usage: الجاهل یحکم علی العاقل 'the foolish ruling over the wise'.

definition: Plural of jáhil: the ignorant. Root j-h-l.
usage: In the tradition العلم نقطة کثّرها الجاهلون "knowledge is a single point which the foolish have multiplied".

definition: Plural of jabal 'mountain': mountains. Root j-b-l.
Verbal noun of form III jádala: disputation, quarrelling, contentious argument. Root j-d-l.
usage: In the Aqdas قد منعتم ... عن الجدال و النزاع 'ye have been forbidden contention and conflict'.

definition: Adjective: new. Root j-d-d.
usage: In a tradition السّلام علی الحقّ الجدید 'peace be upon the new Truth'.

definition: Noun with article: the body, the flesh. Root j-s-d.
usage: From John 3:6 in Arabic: المولود من الجسد جسد هو 'that which is born of the flesh is flesh'.

definition: Group, congregation; in law, congregational prayer. Root j-m-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas قد رفع حکم الجماعة 'congregational prayer hath been annulled' save for the prayer for the dead.

definition: Noun: the public, the multitude; republic. Root j-m-h-r.
usage: Aqdas رؤساء الجمهور 'Presidents of the Republics' (of America).

definition: Adjective: beautiful, gracious; as a divine name 'the All-Beauteous'. Root j-m-l.
usage: A divine name, as in هو العزیز الجمیل 'He is the Mighty, the All-Beauteous'.

definition: Garden; Paradise. Root j-n-n.
usage: Paired with النّار 'the Fire', as in امّا الی الجنّة و امّا الی النّار; in the Íqán Paradise is nearness to God and recognition of His Manifestation.

definition: Plural of jáhil: the ignorant, the foolish. Root j-h-l.
usage: یا ملأ الجهّال 'O concourse of the ignorant'.

definition: Noun: effort, exertion, endeavour. Root j-h-d.
usage: Aqdas: فی غایة الجهد 'with utmost endeavour'.

definition: Plural of járiḥa: hunting animals and birds of prey; also limbs. Root j-r-ḥ.
usage: In the Aqdas on hunting with trained animals.

definition: Noun: generosity, liberality, munificence. Root j-w-d.
usage: 'Generosity'; of divine munificence, as in بحر الجود 'the ocean of generosity'.

definition: Noun with article: name of the letter ج, numerical value 3.
usage: The letter jím (ج); letters are named in numerical and symbolic discussions.
notes: Abjad notation for numbers of shares in the inheritance law.

definition: Noun: the letter ḥá’ (ḥ), numerical value 8 in abjad reckoning.
usage: The letter ḥá', used in abjad numerology.
notes: Aqdas inheritance: wives receive from "the book of Ḥ".

definition: Active participle, divine name: the Guardian, Protector, Preserver. Root ḥ-f-ẓ.
usage: God as the Protector and Preserver, invoked in prayers and in His guardianship of His Cause.

definition: Noun: state, condition, situation. Root ḥ-w-l.
usage: State or condition, as in 'in this state'.

definition: Active participle: carrying; of a woman, pregnant. Root ḥ-m-l.
usage: Pregnant woman, in the Aqdas's exemptions from fasting.

definition: Noun: imprisonment, confinement. Root ḥ-b-s.
usage: 'Imprisonment', of the imprisonment of Bahá'u'lláh in ‘Akká, often referred to as the Most Great Prison.

definition: Noun: veil, curtain, screen. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: Veil; the Writings frequently speak of veils that hide the Truth from people.

definition: Noun: report, saying; a tradition of the Prophet or the Imáms. Root ḥ-d-th.
usage: Report or tradition, usually a Tradition of the Prophet or the Imáms quoted to explain Qur'anic prophecies.
notes: Ilá ákhir al-ḥadíth 'to the end of the tradition'.

definition: Adjective: sharp, keen (of sight); as a noun, iron. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: In البصر الحدید 'keen sight', after Qur'an 50:22.
notes: Also al-ḥadíd 'iron', title of Qur'an 57.

definition: Noun: skilled, competent persons; plural of ḥádhiq. Root ḥ-dh-q.
usage: Aqdas: ارجعوا الی الحذّاق من الأطبّآء 'refer to competent physicians'.

definition: Adjective: sacred, inviolable; also forbidden. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: المسجد الحرام 'the Sacred Mosque' in Mecca.

definition: Noun: war, warfare. Root ḥ-r-b.
usage: In the Aqdas, آلات الحرب 'arms'.

definition: Noun, dual of ḥarf with article: the two letters. Root ḥ-r-f.
usage: In a tradition quoted in the Íqán: knowledge has 27 letters, of which only two were revealed before the Qá'im.

definition: Adjective (fem.): good, fair, beautiful; as a noun, a good deed. Root ḥ-s-n.
usage: In الأعمال الحسنة 'goodly deeds' and الموعظة الحسنة 'goodly exhortation'.

definition: Proper noun: Imám Ḥusayn, grandson of Muḥammad, martyred at Karbilá.
usage: Often with علیه السلام 'upon him be peace'; the Íqán cites his martyrdom.

definition: Noun: pebble, small stone. Root ḥ-ṣ-y.
Noun: zeal, fierce pride, partisan fervour. Root ḥ-m-y.
Intensive form from ḥakama 'to judge, decree': the One Who ordains, the supreme Judge, as a divine epithet. Root ḥ-k-m.
notes: Elsewhere حکّام is the plural of ḥákim, 'rulers'; here it qualifies ربّکم.

definition: Noun: modesty, shame, bashfulness. Root ḥ-y-y.
usage: In verse quoted in the Íqán اخلع الحیا 'cast off shame'.
notes: Written without final hamza (for حیاء).

definition: Noun: bewilderment, perplexity, confusion. Root ḥ-y-r.
usage: In the Aqdas paired with الرّیب 'doubt'.

definition: The letter khá; ارض الخآء 'the Land of Khá', i.e. Khurásán.
usage: In the Aqdas یا ارض الخآء 'O Land of Khá'.

definition: Active participle plural: those who deceive. Root kh-d-‘.
Active participle plural: losers, those who are lost. Root kh-s-r.
usage: Qur'anic formula لا تکوننّ من الخاسرین 'be not of them that are lost'.

definition: Maternal aunts; plural of khála. Root kh-w-l.
usage: Among the heirs listed in the Aqdas inheritance law.

definition: Active participle plural of khalaqa 'to create': creators, makers. Root kh-l-q.
usage: تبارک الله احسن الخالقین 'blessed be God, the most excellent of Makers' (Qur'an 23:14).

definition: Adjective fem.: past, bygone; also empty. Root kh-l-w.
usage: Aqdas: این اعصارکم الخالیة 'where are your bygone ages?'

definition: Noun: news, report, tidings. Root kh-b-r.
Verbal noun of kharaja 'to go out': going out, departure. Root kh-r-j.
usage: 'Going out, departure'; in laws about leaving a place or a state.

definition: Noun with article: silk, silk fabric. Root kh-z-z.
usage: Silk; in the Aqdas the wearing of silk is permitted.

definition: Noun with article: line, handwriting, the art of writing. Root kh-ṭ-ṭ.
usage: Writing or handwriting; the Aqdas encourages the study of writing.

definition: Verbal noun (form III): address, discourse; faṣlu'l-khiṭáb the decisive utterance. Root kh-ṭ-b.
usage: Address or utterance, notably فصل الخطاب 'the decisive utterance' (Qur'an 38:20), applied to the Manifestation's word.

definition: Plural of khaṭṭ: scripts, writings, lines. Root kh-ṭ-ṭ.
usage: Scripts or writings, e.g. diverse scripts, and the call for one universal script.

definition: Noun: succession, vicegerency, caliphate. Root kh-l-f.
usage: Succession, vicegerency, the caliphate.

definition: Numeral: five, feminine-marked form used with masculine nouns. Root kh-m-s.
notes: al-khamsata wa’l-‘ishrín: the twenty-five.

definition: Plural of khátam: rings, signet rings, seals. Root kh-t-m.
usage: Rings, signets; in the Aqdas the law on engraving rings.

definition: Noun: good, goodness, welfare. Root kh-y-r.
usage: Good or welfare, as in خیر العالمین 'the good of the world'.

definition: Noun: house, dwelling, abode; ad-dár al-ákhirah 'the abode hereafter'. Root d-w-r.
usage: In the Aqdas inheritance law الدار المسکونة 'the residence', assigned to the eldest son.

definition: Noun: the two abodes, this world and the next; dual of dár. Root d-w-r.
usage: The tradition المؤمن حیّ فی الدّارین 'the true believer liveth in both worlds'.

definition: Active participle (shortened form of ad-dá‘í): the caller, summoner. Root d-‘-w.
usage: Qur'an 54:6: یوم یدعو الدّاع 'the day when the Summoner shall summon'.
notes: Final ی dropped as in the Qur'anic text.

definition: Name of the letter د (Dál), numerical value 4 in the abjad system.
notes: The Aqdas names inheritance shares by letters whose abjad values give their numbers.

definition: Verbal noun with article: burial, interment. Root d-f-n.
Noun: proof, evidence, guide. Root d-l-l.
usage: In the saying طلب الدّلیل عند حصول المدلول قبیح 'to seek proof when the thing proved is attained is unseemly'.

definition: Noun: blood. Root d-m-y.
usage: Aqdas: حین ما یجدن الدم 'during their courses' (menstruation).

definition: Plural of dábba: beasts, animals, beasts of burden. Root d-b-b.
Plural of dawlah 'state, dynasty': states, governments, nations. Root d-w-l.
Plural of diya: blood-money, indemnity for injury or death; fines. Root w-d-y.
usage: In the Aqdas a third of all fines is assigned to the seat of the House of Justice.

definition: Noun, plural of dár: dwellings, homes, lands. Root d-w-r.
Proper noun: Daylam, highland region south-west of the Caspian, and its people.
usage: In a tradition in the Íqán: رؤوس التّرک و الدّیلم 'the heads of the Turks and Daylamites'.

definition: Religion, faith; also judgment. Root d-y-n.
usage: In ائمّة الدّین 'the Imáms of the Faith' and یوم الدّین 'the Day of Judgment'.

definition: Plural of dayn: debts. Root d-y-n.
usage: Aqdas: inheritance is shared after paying حق الله و الدیون 'Ḥuqúqu'lláh and debts'.

definition: Noun, plural of dhurriyyah: offspring, descendants. Root dh-r-r.
usage: In the Aqdas ضجیج الذّرّیات فی الأصلاب 'the clamour of the children as yet unborn', in the law of inheritance.

definition: Offspring, descendants, progeny. Root dh-r-r.
usage: In the Aqdas inheritance law: یرجع الثّلثان ممّا ترکه الی الذّرّیة 'two thirds revert to the offspring'.

definition: Plural of dhakar: males. Root dh-k-r.
usage: In the Aqdas inheritance law: للذریة من الذکران دون الاناث 'to the male offspring, not the female'.

definition: Plural active participle: those who are content, well pleased. Root r-ḍ-y.
usage: HW: سبل الرّاضین فی رضائی 'the ways of them that are resigned to My will'.

definition: Noun: tenderness, compassion, pity. Root r-’-f.
Noun: opinion, view, judgment; bádiya ar-ra’y 'at first sight, without reflection'. Root r-’-y.
usage: 'Opinion, judgment'; in the Writings often against following one's own opinion over God's word.

definition: Noun with article: plural of rajul: men; also heroes, men of valour. Root r-j-l.
usage: Men; also heroes or men of valour, as in rijál 'men' of God.

definition: Noun with article: pure, choice wine; "ar-raḥíq al-makhtúm" the sealed choice Wine. Root r-ḥ-q.
usage: Choice wine, as in الرحیق المختوم 'the sealed choice Wine', symbol of revelation unsealed by Bahá'u'lláh.
notes: Aqdas: "We have unsealed the choice Wine".

definition: Noun: right conduct, rectitude, right guidance. Root r-sh-d.
usage: Right guidance, as opposed to error, as in Qur'an 2:256 قد تبیّن الرشد من الغیّ.

definition: Noun: contentment, consent, good pleasure, satisfaction. Root r-ḍ-w.
usage: Contentment, God's good pleasure, as in مقام الرضاء 'station of contentment'; radiant acquiescence to God's will.

definition: Noun: parchment, scroll. Root r-q-q.
usage: Parchment, as in رق منشور 'an outspread parchment' (Qur'án 52:3).
notes: Distinct from ar-riqq 'slavery'.

definition: Noun: wailing, cry of grief. Root r-n-n.
usage: 'Wailing, lament', of the cry of grief over the afflictions of the Cause.

definition: Plural of rásikh: firmly rooted, steadfast; "ka'l-jibál ar-rawásikh" like the firm mountains. Root r-s-kh.
usage: Firmly rooted; in کالجبال الرواسخ "like the firm mountains", describing steadfast believers.

definition: Feminine adjective: spiritual. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Spiritual, as in the realities and qualities of the spirit.

definition: Noun: garden, meadow; a garden of Paradise. Root r-w-ḍ.
usage: A garden of Paradise; later also the Shrine gardens, روضهٔ مبارکه 'the Blessed Shrine'.

definition: Proper noun: ar-Rúm, the Romans or Byzantines; in Ottoman usage the Turkish lands and their capital.
notes: Aqdas: یا معشر الرّوم, addressed to the people of the Ottoman capital; rendering not confirmed.

definition: Noun: pillar, corner, support. Root r-k-n.
usage: Hadith: الرّکن الحمراء 'the Crimson Pillar'.

definition: Proper noun: Rayy, an ancient city near present-day Tehran.
Noun, plural of riyáḍah with article: ascetic exercises, austerities. Root r-w-ḍ.
usage: In the Aqdas of ascetics who endure hardships unbidden by God.

definition: Noun: doubt, suspicion, uncertainty. Root r-y-b.
usage: In the Aqdas paired with الحیرة 'perplexity'.

definition: Proper noun: the river Rhine.
usage: یا شواطی نهر الرّین 'O banks of the Rhine!'.

definition: Noun: head, chief, ruler. Root r-’-s.
usage: In the Aqdas رمز الرّئیس "the Sign of the Sovereign", in the passage on the mystery of the Great Reversal.
notes: Written الرّئیس.

definition: Active participle: adulterer, fornicator. Root z-n-y.
Feminine active participle of zaná: adulteress, fornicatress. Root z-n-y.
usage: The Íqán recounts a question on the punishment of the married adulterer and adulteress in the Torah.

definition: Active participle (feminine): shining, radiant, brilliant. Root z-h-r.
usage: In the Íqán's tradition این الأنجم الزّاهرة 'where are the resplendent stars?'

definition: Feminine of zá’id 'additional, exceeding, surplus'. Root z-y-d.
usage: In the Aqdas الأیام الزّائدة عن الشّهور 'the days in excess of the months', the Intercalary Days (Ayyám-i-Há).

definition: Passing away, transient, perishing. Root z-w-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words الدّولة الفانیة الزّائلة 'this fleeting, evanescent dominion'.

definition: Plural of zabúr: scriptures, writings, books. Root z-b-r.
usage: E.g. فی الزبر و الالواح 'in the Scriptures and Tablets'.

definition: Noun: Zaqqúm, the bitter infernal tree of the Qur'an.
usage: In the Íqán انّ شجرة الزّقّوم طعام الأثیم 'the tree of Zaqqúm shall be the food of the sinner' (Qur'an 44:43).

definition: Earthquakes, convulsions, upheavals; plural of zalzala. Quadriliteral root z-l-z-l.
usage: Aqdas: ظهرت الزّلازل 'the earthquakes appeared', of the upheaval at the Revelation.

definition: Noun: adultery, fornication. Root z-n-y.
usage: قد حرّم علیکم القتل و الزنا 'murder and adultery are forbidden you'.

definition: Noun: spouse, husband (or wife). Root z-w-j.
usage: Aqdas laws of marriage: اختیار الزّوج 'choosing a husband'.

definition: Verbal noun: increase, addition, more. Root z-y-d.
Active participle of saraqa: thief. Root s-r-q.
usage: 'The thief'; in the Aqdas law on punishment of theft.

definition: Noun with article: hour; the Hour of judgement. Root s-w-‘.
usage: The Hour; the Hour of judgement, which the Writings identify with the advent of the Manifestation.

definition: Noun with article (from Hebrew shofar): trumpet, ram's horn.
usage: The trumpet of the Day of Resurrection, interpreted in the Writings as the call of the new Manifestation.
notes: Íqán quoting Matthew 24:31.

definition: Active participle: traveller, wayfarer on the spiritual path. Root s-l-k.
usage: The wayfarer on the spiritual path, a Sufi term central to the Seven Valleys and the Íqán's portrait of the true seeker.

definition: Active participle (fem.): pleasant to drink, palatable, easily swallowed. Root s-w-gh.
usage: Pleasant to drink, of the sweet waters of divine knowledge.

definition: Verbal noun: reviling, abuse, cursing. Root s-b-b.
usage: Reviling, cursing, which the Aqdas forbids.

definition: Noun: cause, means, instrument. Root s-b-b.
usage: 'Means, cause', as in السبب الاعظم 'the highest means', for example of unity as the greatest means of the world's well-being.
notes: as-sabab al-a‘ẓam: the highest means.

definition: Plural of subḥah: glories; in mystical usage the veils of glory, idle fancies that obscure truth. Root s-b-ḥ.
usage: Veils of glory; in the Writings the idle fancies and mists of learning, as in سبحات جلال "veils of glory".

definition: Noun: glorification, praise; here a name of God, the All-Glorious. Root s-b-ḥ.
usage: Glorification, and as a divine name the All-Glorious; related to سبحان الله 'glorified be God'.

definition: Dual of sabíl 'path, way': the two paths. Root s-b-l.
usage: An allusion to the two ways shown to man (Qur'an 90:10).

definition: Numeral: sixty. Root s-t-t.
usage: In the tradition فی سنة السّتّین 'in the year sixty' (AH 1260), the year of the Báb's declaration.

definition: Noun, plural of sarír: couches, thrones, raised seats. Root s-r-r.
usage: Aqdas: جلوسکم علی السّرر و الکراسی 'your sitting on couches and chairs'.

definition: Noun: throne, couch, raised seat or platform. Root s-r-r.
Noun with article: ship, ark. Root s-f-n.
usage: In the Writings the Ark of the Cause, as in السّفینة الحمراء 'the Crimson Ark'.

definition: Noun: clear, sweet, flowing water. Root s-l-s-l.
usage: In the Aqdas زلال هذا السّلسال 'the crystal waters of this fountain'.

definition: Noun: sable, sable fur. Root s-m-r.
usage: البسوا السمور 'wear ye the fur of sables'.

definition: Intensive adjective: all-hearing; with the article a divine name. Root s-m-‘.
usage: Usually paired as السّمیع البصیر "the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing".

definition: Plural of lisán 'tongue': tongues; در السن و افواه 'on the tongues and lips of people'. Root l-s-n.
notes: Not the article al- with sinn 'age, tooth'.

definition: Noun: brilliance, radiance, splendour; also loftiness. Root s-n-w.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words روح السناء فی سیناء قلبک 'the spirit of radiance into the Sinai of thy heart'.
notes: Wordplay with سیناء 'Sinai'.

definition: Noun: year. Root s-n-w.
Noun (from Persian): squirrel; squirrel fur.
notes: Aqdas permits wearing furs such as sable and squirrel.

definition: Plural of sunna: ways, practices, ordinances. Root s-n-n.
usage: In the tradition لتجدید الفرائض و السّنن 'to renew the obligations and ordinances'.

definition: Plural alsun of lisán 'tongue' with -kum: your tongues. Root l-s-n.
usage: Aqdas: adorn السنکم بالصدق 'your tongues with truthfulness'.

definition: Noun, plural of sahm: arrows, darts; also shares. Root s-h-m.
usage: In the Aqdas یستقبل بعینه السّهام 'he will face the darts with his own eyes'.

definition: Plural of sádhij "simple, pure, unmixed"; in ساذج السّواذج "the purest of pure essences".
usage: Íqán: ساذج السّواذج ازلیند, of the Manifestations as the Essence of essences.

definition: Plural of sayyi’a: evil deeds, sins. Root s-w-’.
usage: یبدّل الله السیّئات بالحسنات 'God will change evil deeds into good' (Qur'an 25:70).

definition: Plural active participle: drinkers, those who drink. Root sh-r-b.
usage: من کوثر الفضل ... من الشّاربین 'among them that have quaffed from the Kawthar of grace'.

definition: Noun: matter, affair; rank, station, dignity. Root sh-’-n.
Plural of shubhah 'doubt, ambiguity, misgiving'. Root sh-b-h.
usage: 'Doubts, misgivings'; of the doubts raised by opponents against the Faith.

definition: Noun with article: winter. Root sh-t-w.
Noun, plural of shajja with article: head wounds, injuries. Root sh-j-j.
usage: Head wounds, in the Aqdas laws on injuries.
notes: Aqdas: "Regarding wounding and beating".

definition: Noun (collective): trees, the tree. Root sh-j-r.
usage: Trees; often the Divine Tree, the Burning Bush or the Sadratu'l-Muntahá that speaks God's word.

definition: Noun: partnership, association. Root sh-r-k.
usage: Partnership, e.g. in commerce or in associating partners with God.
notes: Maḥall ash-sharákah: the stage of partnership, apparently the age at which an orphan may share in the business; exact sense uncertain.

definition: Verbal noun: drinking. Root sh-r-b.
usage: Drinking, e.g. of wine and intoxicants, forbidden in the Aqdas.

definition: Noun: the east, the place of sunrise. Root sh-r-q.
usage: 'The East', paired with الغرب 'the West', standing for the whole world.

definition: Noun: religious law, revealed path. Root sh-r-‘.
usage: Religious law; the revealed Law of a Dispensation.

definition: Noun: hair. Root sh-‘-r.
usage: Hair, in Aqdas laws on shaving the head and on the length of hair.
notes: Not shi‘r 'poetry', which is spelled the same.

definition: Noun: barley. Root sh-‘-r.
usage: In the Aqdas القمح و الشعیر 'wheat and barley'.

definition: Noun: suns, plural of shams. Root sh-m-s.
usage: Suns as symbols of the Manifestations (شموس حقیقت 'Suns of Truth'); in the Prayer of Nudbih این الشّموس الطّالعة 'where are the rising suns?'.

definition: Noun, plural of shunkhúb: mountain peaks, summits. Rare classical word.
usage: Aqdas list of places for praising God: mountains, peaks and summits.

definition: Plural of shahíd: martyrs; also witnesses. Root sh-h-d.
usage: سید الشهداء 'Prince of Martyrs', title of the Imám Ḥusayn, here applied to Ḥamzih.

definition: Noun, plural of shahwah with article: desires, lusts, passions. Root sh-h-w.
Noun plural: valleys or ravines thick with trees. Root sh-j-n.
usage: In the Aqdas listing wild places where ascetics worship.
notes: Rare word; exact sense and the authorized rendering are uncertain.

definition: Intensive adjective: very grateful; as divine name, the Appreciative. Root sh-k-r.
usage: Qur'an 34:13 قلیل من عبادی الشکور 'few of My servants are thankful'.

definition: Noun: old man, elder; title of a learned religious man. Root sh-y-kh.
Noun: Satan, the devil; any evil one. Root sh-ṭ-n.
usage: In the Writings a symbol of the lower self and its promptings, as in مظاهر الشیطان 'the manifestations of Satan'.

definition: Name of the letter ش, numerical value 300 in the abjad reckoning.
usage: In the Aqdas law of inheritance shares are counted by letter values, e.g. عدد الشین 'the number of Shín'.

definition: Active participle, feminine plural: patient women. Root ṣ-b-r.
usage: In the Aqdas انّه یحبّ الصّابرات و الصّابرین 'He loveth those women and men who are patient'.

definition: Feminine of ṣáfí 'clear, pure, limpid'. Root ṣ-f-w.
Morning, dawn. Root ṣ-b-ḥ.
usage: In the Aqdas خذوا اقداح الفلاح فی هذا الصّباح 'take the chalices of salvation in this Dawn'.

definition: Noun: patience, endurance, fortitude. Root ṣ-b-r.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words علامة الحب الصبر فی قضائی 'the sign of love is fortitude under My decree'.

definition: Noun, plural of ṣaḥfah: large dishes, bowls. Root ṣ-ḥ-f.
usage: In the Aqdas forbidding plunging hands into food: فی الصّحاف و الصّحان 'into bowls and platters'.

definition: Platters, dishes, bowls; plural of ṣaḥn. Root ṣ-ḥ-n.
usage: Aqdas: ان تنغمس ایادیکم فی الصّحاف و الصّحان 'lest your hands be plunged in the bowls and platters'.

definition: Plural of ṣaḥífa: scrolls, sheets, scriptures. Root ṣ-ḥ-f.
usage: فی الصحائف و الالواح 'in the Books and Tablets'.

definition: Plural of صحیفة: pages, books, scriptures. Root ṣ-ḥ-f.
usage: Aqdas: of the world's scriptures, none availeth الّا بهذا الکتاب 'save this Book'.

definition: Adjective: sound, healthy, whole; correct. Root ṣ-ḥ-ḥ.
notes: Paired with الکسیر 'the broken'.

definition: Noun: rock, large stone; aṣ-Ṣakhrah, the Rock of Jerusalem. Root ṣ-kh-r.
usage: 'The Rock'; the Rock of Jerusalem, in the Aqdas's address to it, or a symbol of hard hearts.

definition: Adjective with article: pure, unmixed, sheer. Root ṣ-r-f.
usage: Pure, sheer; as in al-‘adam aṣ-ṣirf 'sheer nothingness'.

definition: Verbal noun with article: ascent, rising; also the passing of a holy soul. Root ṣ-‘-d.
usage: Ascent; in Bahá'í usage the passing of a holy soul, as in صعود حضرت بهاء الله 'the Ascension of Bahá'u'lláh'.

definition: Adjective: small, little, minor. Root ṣ-gh-r.
usage: Small, lesser; in contrasts such as the lesser and the greater (الصغیر والکبیر).

definition: Adjective and noun: empty, void; zero. Root ṣ-f-r.
usage: Empty or void, e.g. empty-handed (صفر الیدین).
notes: Al-kaff aṣ-ṣifr = the empty hand.

definition: Adjective (fem.): hard, solid, firm. Root ṣ-l-b.
Noun, plural of ṣiná‘ah 'craft': crafts, trades, arts. Root ṣ-n-‘.
usage: 'Crafts, arts', in the Aqdas's command to learn sciences and crafts that profit humanity.

definition: Noun: marriage, kinship by marriage. Root ṣ-h-r.
usage: Marriage, kinship by marriage; used in the Aqdas law of marriage.

definition: Proper noun: Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
usage: Zion, the hill of Jerusalem, invoked in the Writings as rejoicing at the appearance of the Lord.

definition: Noun: the horn or trumpet sounded at the Resurrection. Root ṣ-w-r.
