usage: Qur'anic نفخ فی الصور 'the trumpet shall be blown', interpreted in the Íqán as the Call of the new Manifestation.

definition: Noun: hunting; game, prey. Root ṣ-y-d.
usage: Aqdas law of hunting: اذا ارسلتم الجوارح الی الصّید 'if ye send beasts or birds of prey to the chase'.

definition: Noun: summer. Root ṣ-y-f.
Active participle plural: those who go astray, the erring. Root ḍ-l-l.
Noun with article: necessity, need, compulsion. Root ḍ-r-r.
Noun: rancour, malice, hidden hatred. Root ḍ-gh-n.
usage: Paired with البغضاء 'hatred' in the Aqdas.

definition: Noun: hospitality, entertainment of guests. Root ḍ-y-f.
usage: In the Aqdas the basis of the Nineteen Day Feast: قد رقم علیکم الضیافة فی کل شهر 'once in every month'.

definition: Plural of luṭf "kindness, favour" with suffix "thy": Thy favours, bounties. Root l-ṭ-f.
notes: The initial ا belongs to the plural pattern, not the article.

definition: Plural of luṭf 'kindness, favour' with -í 'my': 'My favours, loving-kindness'. Root l-ṭ-f.
notes: Not the article al-: الطاف is a broken plural.

definition: Feminine active participle of ṭala‘a 'to rise (of a star)': rising, dawning. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: The Du‘á-yi-Nudbih in the Íqán: این الشموس الطالعة 'where are the rising suns?'

definition: Noun: nature, natural disposition. Root ṭ-b-‘.
Noun: embroidered border, ornament, style, fashion. Root ṭ-r-z.
usage: Also the title of the Tablet of Ṭarázát (Ornaments).

definition: Dual of ṭaraf 'side, party': the two parties. Root ṭ-r-f.
usage: In the Aqdas marriage law برضآء الطّرفین 'the consent of both parties'.

definition: Plural of ṭaríq: roads, streets, ways. Root ṭ-r-q.
usage: Aqdas یمشی فی الطرق و الاسواق 'walketh in the streets and marketplaces'.

definition: Noun: road, way, path. Root ṭ-r-q.
usage: In a tradition عن یمین الطّریق 'to the right of the road'.

definition: Food, meal. Root ṭ-‘-m.
usage: Qur'an 25:7 in the Íqán: ما لهذا الرّسول یأکل الطّعام 'what manner of apostle is this? He eateth food'.

definition: Verbal noun: seeking, search, quest. Root ṭ-l-b.
usage: First valley of the mystic journey; Arabic saying in the Íqán: السبیل مسدود و الطلب مردود 'the way is barred and the quest rejected'.

definition: Noun: face, countenance, appearance. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: Aqdas: سبحان اللّه ذی الطّلعة و الجمال 'glorified be God, Lord of the countenance and beauty'.
notes: Also a Bahá'í title (Ṭal‘at) for the Báb and Bahá'u'lláh.

definition: Verbal noun: rising, especially of the sun. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: Aqdas on fasting: من الطلوع الی الافول 'from sunrise to sunset'.

definition: Active participle of ẓalama: wrongdoer, oppressor, tyrant. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: 'Oppressor'; the Writings condemn the oppressor and promise his downfall.

definition: Active participle with article, feminine: outward, apparent, manifest. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: Outward, manifest; contrasted with báṭin 'inward', of outward meanings or signs.

definition: Noun with article: darkness, gloom. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: Darkness, contrasted with light, figuratively of ignorance and heedlessness.

definition: Noun, plural of ẓulma: darknesses, darkness. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: Darkness, contrasted with النور 'light'; the darkness of error and heedlessness.

definition: Noun: thirst. Root ẓ-m-'.
usage: Thirst, especially for divine knowledge, quenched by the water of life.

definition: Double plural of ẓann: suppositions, vain imaginings. Root ẓ-n-n.
usage: Vain imaginings, idle fancies that veil people from the truth, often paired with الاوهام.

definition: Active participle: just, equitable; a divine name. Root ‘-d-l.
usage: 'The Just', a divine name; also of a just ruler, in the Writings' praise of justice.

definition: Active participle: disobedient one, sinner, rebel. Root ‘-ṣ-y.
usage: Sinner, rebel against God.

definition: Noun: end, outcome, final consequence. Root ‘-q-b.
usage: The end or outcome, as in العاقبة للمتّقین 'the end is for the God-fearing'.

definition: Active participle: rational, intelligent; a wise person. Root ‘-q-l.
usage: In the Aqdas الجاهل یحکم علی العاقل 'the foolish rule over the wise'.

definition: Active participle plural of ‘amila: those who act, work, do. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: Aqdas: بها یقبل عمل العاملین 'through it the deeds of all who act are accepted'.

definition: Noun: worship, service of God. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: Aqdas: work done in service is نفس العبادة 'worship itself'.

definition: Noun: punishment, torment, chastisement. Root ‘-dh-b.
Adjective, feminine with article: sweet, fresh (of water). Root ‘-dh-b.
Collective noun: the Arabs. Root ‘-r-b.

pos: noun with article + prep. + rel. pronoun
definition: Two words run together: العرش 'the Throne' and بما 'with that which'. Root ‘-r-sh.
usage: لدی العرش 'before the Throne', i.e. in the presence of the Manifestation.
notes: Words joined in the source text; read العرش بما.

shift: Here: invitations, festive gatherings. Today (Arabic): resolutions, firm intentions; in Persian also incantations.
definition: Plural of ‘azíma: invitations, festive gatherings; more usually resolutions, firm intentions. Root ‘-z-m.
usage: In the Aqdas paired with الولآئم "banquets": believers should accept invitations with joy.
notes: Written العزائم.

definition: Cardinal number 'twenty' (accusative/genitive form). Root ‘-sh-r.
Noun: protection, immunity from sin or error; infallibility. Root ‘-ṣ-m.
usage: In the Aqdas العصمة الکبری 'the Most Great Infallibility', unique to the Manifestation of God.

definition: Noun: giving, gift, bestowal. Root ‘-ṭ-w.
usage: In the Aqdas, giving to one who begs is forbidden.

definition: Noun: perfume, scent, attar. Root ‘-ṭ-r.
notes: Aqdas: استعملوا ماء الورد ثمّ العطر الخالص 'use rose-water and pure perfume'.

definition: Greatness, grandeur, majesty. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words اسرار العظم 'the mysteries of greatness'.

definition: Noun: punishment, retribution. Root ‘-q-b.
usage: Qur'anic شدید العقاب 'severe in punishment'.

definition: Noun: reason, intellect, mind. Root ‘-q-l.
usage: In the Aqdas the ban on what deprives of reason: ما یذهب به العقل 'that which depriveth him of his reason'.

definition: Pure native gold. Root ‘-q-y.
usage: Aqdas: سریر العقیان 'a throne of gold'.

definition: Noun: cause, reason; also illness. Root ‘-l-l.
usage: العلة الکبری للاتفاق و التمدن 'the greatest cause of unity and civilization'.

definition: Plural of عمّة: paternal aunts. Root ‘-m-m.
usage: Aqdas inheritance law: الأعمام و الأخوال و العمّات و الخالات.

definition: Present 1sg of la‘ana: I curse. Root l-‘-n.
notes: Unclear whether verb al‘anu or another reading; no matching authorized passage confirmed.

definition: Verbal noun of form III ‘ánada: obstinacy, stubborn opposition, enmity. Root ‘-n-d.
usage: 'Obstinacy, stubborn opposition'; of those who opposed the Manifestation out of enmity.

definition: Noun with article: feast, festival. Root ‘-y-d.
usage: Festival, feast; of the holy days in the Aqdas, such as Riḍván and Naw-Rúz.

definition: Noun ‘íd "festival" in the dual oblique with article: the two festivals. Root ‘-w-d.
usage: 'The two festivals', e.g. the Twin Holy Days.

definition: Active participle, divine name: the Forgiver, the Pardoner. Root gh-f-r.
usage: God the Forgiver, as in غافر الذنب 'Forgiver of sin'.

definition: Active participle: heedless, negligent, unaware. Root gh-f-l.
usage: The heedless one, unaware of God, a frequent object of admonition in the Hidden Words.
notes: Yá ayyuhá al-gháfil = O heedless one.

definition: Active participle: prevailing, victorious, dominant. Root gh-l-b.
usage: Prevailing, a divine name, as in الغالب القدیر 'the Prevailing, the Almighty'.

definition: Active participle, masculine plural: victorious, prevailing. Root gh-l-b.
usage: 'The victorious', echoing the Qur'anic promise that God's party shall prevail.

definition: Noun: dust. Root gh-b-r.
usage: Dust; often the dust of self or of the world that clouds the heart.

definition: Intensive adjective of gharra 'to deceive': deceiver, beguiler; one much deluded. Root gh-r-r.
usage: Deceiver or beguiler, often of the world itself or Satan.
notes: Unsure whether the authorized rendering takes it as 'deceiver' or 'deluded'.

definition: Noun: the west. Root gh-r-b.
usage: Paired with الشرق: اهل الشرق و الغرب 'the peoples of East and West'.

definition: Noun: a white blaze on a horse's forehead; the best or brightest part of anything. Root gh-r-r.
notes: Aqdas: الغرّة الغرآء لجبین الانشآء 'the shining blaze on the brow of creation'; rendering not confirmed.

definition: Noun, plural of ghurfa: rooms, chambers. Root gh-r-f.
usage: Aqdas: chambers within the Mashriqu'l-Adhkár where Tablets are chanted.

definition: Noun: foul discharge, festering fluid (food of the damned, Qur'án 69:36). Root gh-s-l.
Noun with article: heedlessness, negligence, forgetfulness of God. Root gh-f-l.
usage: A key moral term of the Writings, the opposite of awareness of God.

definition: Noun: wealth, sufficiency, independence. Root gh-n-y.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: عرفت الغناء فی تقدیسک منه 'I have recognized wealth in thy sanctity therefrom'.
notes: Not al-ghiná’ 'singing'.

definition: Noun: error, straying from the right path. Root gh-w-y.
usage: نبذوا البغی و الغوی 'cast away wickedness and error'.

definition: Noun: error, straying, deviation. Root gh-w-y.
usage: From Qur'an 7:146 سبیل الغیّ "the path of error".

definition: Noun: backbiting, slander of the absent. Root gh-y-b.
usage: In the Aqdas forbidden with calumny; backbiting is often condemned in the Writings.

definition: Noun: fury, rage, wrath. Root gh-y-ẓ.
usage: Qur'an 3:119 in the Íqán: عضّوا علیکم الانامل من الغیظ 'they bite their fingers' ends at you out of rage'.

definition: Noun, plural of ghayb: hidden things, the unseen. Root gh-y-b.
usage: In غیب الغیوب 'the Unseen of the unseen', the innermost divine Essence.

definition: Feminine of fání 'perishing, transient, mortal'. Root f-n-y.
usage: Of the world and its dominion, contrasted with باقیة 'abiding'.

definition: Bed, couch. Root f-r-sh.
usage: In the Hidden Words أ تحبّ ان تموت علی الفراش 'Wouldst thou die upon thy bed'.

definition: Plural of faríḍa: religious obligations, ordinances. Root f-r-ḍ.
usage: E.g. لتجدید الفرائض و السنن 'to renew the ordinances and laws'.
notes: Written الفرائض.

definition: Noun: branch, offshoot. Root f-r-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas الفرع المنشعب من هذا الأصل القویم 'Him Who hath branched from this mighty Stock', ‘Abdu'l-Bahá.

definition: Passing away, extinction, annihilation; in Sufism the annihilation of self. Root f-n-y.
usage: Contrasted with البقاء 'everlasting life', as in ادعوک الی البقاء و انت تبتغی الفناء.

definition: Noun: heart, inmost heart. Root f-’-d.
usage: جوهر الفؤاد 'the essence of thy heart'; plural افئدة 'hearts'.

definition: Plural of فاکهة: fruits. Root f-k-h.
usage: HW: قدّرت لک من الشّجر الأبهی الفواکه الأصفی 'I have ordained for thee from the most glorious tree the purest fruits'.

definition: Name of the letter qáf, numerical value 100 in abjad.
Active participle of qahara and divine name: the Subduer, the Irresistible. Root q-h-r.
usage: 'The Subduer'; divine name of God's irresistible power.

definition: Verbal noun (form IV) ilqá’: casting, throwing, instilling; here with izáfih. Root l-q-y.
usage: Casting, instilling; of instilling doubts (ilqá-yi shubuhát) or words into hearts.

definition: Active participle feminine with article: standing, upright. Root q-w-m.
usage: Standing or upright; from the same root as قیامت 'Resurrection' and قائم 'He Who ariseth'.
notes: al-alif al-qá’ima the upright Alif.

definition: Noun: grave, tomb. Root q-b-r.
usage: The grave; in the Íqán those 'in the graves' are interpreted as the spiritually dead.

definition: Verbal noun: acceptance, reception, approval. Root q-b-l.
usage: Acceptance, especially God's acceptance of deeds, which depends on recognition of the Manifestation.

definition: Noun: drinking cup, goblet. Root q-d-ḥ.
usage: Cup, goblet; the cup of divine wine or of knowledge.

definition: Adjective, feminine: ancient, eternal, pre-existent. Root q-d-m.
usage: 'Ancient, eternal', of God's pre-existence, as in جمال القدم 'the Ancient Beauty', a title of Bahá'u'lláh.

definition: Noun: nearness, proximity. Root q-r-b.
usage: Nearness to God, the goal of the spiritual life.

definition: Plural of qarya: villages, towns. Root q-r-y.
usage: Villages and towns, in phrases such as المدائن والقری 'cities and villages'.

definition: Noun: balance, scales, just measure. Root q-s-ṭ.
usage: In the Aqdas بهذا القسطاس الاعظم 'by this most great Balance', the Revelation itself as the standard of judgement.

definition: Noun: husks, shells, rinds; plural of qishr. Root q-sh-r.
usage: Aqdas: انّه من القشور ترکناها لکم کما تترک العظام للکلاب 'it is but husks which We have left to you as bones are left to dogs'.

definition: Noun, plural of qaṣr: palaces, castles. Root q-ṣ-r.
usage: Aqdas: من القصور الی القبور 'from palaces to graves'.

definition: Noun: decree, divine ordinance, judgment. Root q-ḍ-y.
usage: God's decree, often paired with قدر 'destiny'.

definition: Noun with article: cotton. Root q-ṭ-n.
Noun: wheat. Root q-m-ḥ.
Plural of qunna: mountain peaks, summits. Root q-n-n.
usage: In the Aqdas list of wild places of the earth.
notes: Rendering in the authorized Aqdas not confirmed.

definition: Plural of qunna: summits, mountain-tops. Root q-n-n.
Plural of qá‘idah 'rule, principle, foundation'. Root q-‘-d.
Adjective: straight, upright, firm, sound. Root q-w-m.
usage: In the Aqdas الفرع المنشعب من هذا الاصل القویم 'the Branch that hath branched from this mighty Stock'.

definition: Verb, form IV: I cast, placed, bestowed. Root l-q-y.
usage: In the Hidden Words القیت علیک مثالی 'I have engraved on thee Mine image'.

definition: Perfect 1st plural of form IV alqá 'to cast, impart, reveal'. Root l-q-y.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: اکتب کلّ ما القینا الیک 'Write all that We have revealed unto thee'.

definition: Form IV of l-q-y: We cast to thee, imparted, dictated to thee. Root l-q-y.
usage: In the Aqdas ما القیناک من آیات اللّه 'what We have dictated unto thee of the verses of God'.

definition: Plural of lu'lu': pearls.
usage: Pearls of hidden meaning, e.g. اللآلئ المخزونة 'the treasured pearls'.
notes: Written with a high hamza.

definition: Active participle plural: those who slander, scoff, find fault. Root l-m-z.
usage: In the Aqdas اعین اللّامزین 'the eyes of the slanderers'.

definition: Clothing, dress, garment. Root l-b-s.
usage: Aqdas: رفع اللّه عنکم حکم الحدّ فی اللّباس 'God hath relieved you of the restrictions in clothing'.

definition: Noun: grave, niche in the side of a grave. Root l-ḥ-d.
Plural of لحیة: beards. Root l-ḥ-y.
usage: Aqdas: رفعنا عنکم حکم الحدّ فی اللّباس و اللّحی 'We have relieved you of restrictions in dress and beards'.

definition: Adjective, feminine: fine, delicate, subtle, refined. Root l-ṭ-f.
Plural of lughah 'language, tongue'. Root l-gh-w.
usage: 'Languages'; in the Aqdas command to choose a universal language (لغة من اللغات).

definition: Adjective with article: gleaming, shining, resplendent. Root l-m-‘.
usage: Resplendent; an epithet of light or of the divine.

definition: Active participle feminine with article: past, bygone, elapsed. Root m-ḍ-y.
Active participle, plural: plotters, schemers, deceivers. Root m-k-r.
usage: Schemers; echoes Qur'an 3:54 والله خیر الماکرین, of those who plot against God's Cause.

definition: Plural of mabḥath: topics of discussion, learned disputations, treatises. Root b-ḥ-th.
usage: Learned disputations or treatises of the divines, often set against true understanding.

definition: Passive participle (fem.): built, erected. Root b-n-y.
usage: Built, of houses or edifices.

definition: Active participle form V, masculine plural: those who perceive, discerning. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: 'Those of insight', the discerning who perceive the truth with inner sight.

definition: Passive participle, Form V: chosen, selected. Root kh-y-r.
usage: The Chosen One; a title of a Manifestation.

definition: Plural active participle (form V): those who remember, take heed. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Those who heed and remember, as in a reminder for the mindful.

definition: Active participle: one who subjugates and makes all things serve; a divine epithet. Root s-kh-r.
usage: A divine name in a list of attributes of God in the Aqdas.
notes: Exact authorized rendering of this epithet not verified.

pos: active participle pl. (form VIII) def. gen.
definition: Plural of muttaqí, 'one who fears God, pious'. Root w-q-y.
usage: Aqdas: اتّقوا اللّه و کونوا من المتّقین 'fear God, and be of the God-fearing'.

definition: Active participle (form V): supreme in greatness (of God); of humans, arrogant. Root k-b-r.
usage: A Qur'anic divine name in lists of attributes; of men it means proud.

pos: active participle pl. (form V) with article
definition: Active participle plural form V: the proud, the arrogant. Root k-b-r.
Adjective with article: firm, strong, steadfast. Root m-t-n.
usage: In حبل ... المتین 'the firm cord'.

definition: Passive participle: established, confirmed, fixed. Root th-b-t.
usage: In the Aqdas القضاء المثبت 'the irrevocable decree'.

definition: Verbal noun, form III: disputing, arguing. Root j-d-l.
usage: Aqdas: لا ما ینتهی الی المجادلة 'not what leadeth to idle disputation'.

definition: Plural of majlis: assemblies, councils, parliaments. Root j-l-s.
Plural active participle of ajrama: the guilty, sinners. Root j-r-m.
Active participle of form IV ajába: one who answers; al-Mujíb, He Who answers prayer, a divine name. Root j-w-b.
usage: In the Aqdas انّه لهو المحبوب المجیب 'He is the Well-Beloved, the Answerer'.

definition: Active participle: one who loves, lover. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: In the Hidden Words المحبّ الصّادق 'the true lover'.

definition: Plural of muḥbar 'made joyful, delighted', cf. yuḥbarún in Qur'an 30:15. Root ḥ-b-r.

pos: active participle pl. with article (form VIII)
definition: Those veiled or shut out (from recognizing God's Manifestation). Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: In لا تکوننّ من المحتجبین 'be not of those who are veiled'.

definition: Active participle plural form IV: those who do good, the righteous. Root ḥ-s-n.
usage: In the formula کان من المحسنین 'he is of the righteous'.

definition: Passive participle of form IV: protected; in law, married (of an adulterer). Root ḥ-ṣ-n.
usage: In a tradition on Moses' law of retribution for الزّانی المحصن 'the married adulterer'.

definition: A married (and so protected) woman; in Islamic law one whose adultery incurs the full penalty. Form IV, root ḥ-ṣ-n.
usage: In a legal tradition cited in the Íqán: قصاص الزّانی المحصن و الزّانیة المحصنة.

definition: Active participle of form IV aḥṣá 'to count, reckon': He Who reckons all things; divine name. Root ḥ-ṣ-y.
usage: In the formula کذلک یخبرکم المحصی العلیم.

definition: Adjective: guarded, preserved. Root ḥ-f-ẓ.
usage: In لوح محفوظ 'the Guarded (Preserved) Tablet', the heavenly archetype of revelation.

definition: Passive participle: firm, strong, well-established. Root ḥ-k-m.
Active participle of form IV aḥáṭa: encompassing; divine name the All-Encompassing. Root ḥ-w-ṭ.
usage: 'All-Encompassing'; divine name, and of God's knowledge encompassing all things.

definition: Participle (form VIII), feminine with article: specially assigned, dedicated, particular. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: Dedicated, particular; specially assigned, e.g. to a purpose.

definition: Active participle form VIII feminine with article: different, various, diverse. Root kh-l-f.
notes: al-alsun al-mukhtalifa divers languages.

definition: Passive participle: sealed, stamped. Root kh-t-m.
usage: Sealed, as in الرحیق المختوم 'the sealed choice Wine' (Qur'an 83:25), whose seal Bahá'u'lláh declares broken in this Day.
notes: ar-raḥíqu'l-makhtúm the choice sealed Wine.

definition: Noun of place: exit, way out, outlet; a resolution or interpretation. Root kh-r-j.
usage: A way out or release, as in Qur'an 65:2 'He will make for him a way out'.

definition: Passive participle: stored, treasured, hidden. Root kh-z-n.
usage: Treasured, hidden, as in السر المخزون 'the hidden secret'.

definition: Passive participle, feminine: stored, treasured, hidden. Root kh-z-n.
usage: 'Treasured, hidden', of hidden mysteries and pearls of wisdom stored in God's words.

definition: Passive participle (feminine): special, particular, personal. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
Plural of madrasa: schools, colleges. Root d-r-s.
usage: Schools, in the Aqdas's references to learning and education.

definition: Passive participle of iddakhara: stored up, treasured, reserved. Root dh-kh-r.
usage: In the Prayer of Nudbih quoted in the Íqán: این المدّخر لتجدید الفرائض 'where is He Who is reserved for renewing the ordinances', the promised Qá'im.

definition: Active participle of form IV of d-l-l: pointing to, indicating, testifying. Root d-l-l.
notes: Aqdas: بفعله المدلّ علی فضله 'by his deed which testifieth to His grace'; the form reading is not certain.

definition: Participle, feminine (from dalla 'to indicate'): pointing to, signifying. Root d-l-l.
usage: Aqdas: the letter Ṭá المدلّة علی الاسم المخزون 'pointing to the Hidden Name'.
notes: Reading (mudillah vs. dállah) and exact sense uncertain.

definition: Passive participle: that which is indicated or proven, the object of a proof. Root d-l-l.
usage: In the maxim طلب الدلیل عند حصول المدلول قبیح 'to seek proof when the thing proven is attained is unseemly'.

definition: Noun with article: the city; also the city of Medina. Root m-d-n.
Active participle: sinner, wrongdoer. Root dh-n-b.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: as the sinner longeth for mercy.

definition: Noun with article: creed, school of thought. Root dh-h-b.
usage: In مختلف المذهب 'differing in creed'.

definition: Active participle of form VIII irtafa‘a: high, elevated, rising. Root r-f-‘.
Active participle (feminine): raised, exalted, lofty. Root r-f-‘.
Passive participle of radda 'to reject, turn back': rejected, repudiated. Root r-d-d.
usage: In the Aqdas یا ایها المردود 'O thou rejected one'.

definition: Noun: illness, sickness. Root m-r-ḍ.
Active participle of form IV arḍa‘a 'to suckle': a nursing mother. Root r-ḍ-‘.
notes: Aqdas: exempt from fasting with the traveller, the sick and the pregnant.

pos: active participle pl. with article (form IV)
definition: Those who doubt or sow doubt. Root r-y-b.
usage: In the Aqdas شبهات المریبین 'the doubts of the suspicious'.

definition: Adjective and noun: sick, ill person. Root m-r-ḍ.
usage: Aqdas exemptions from fasting: المسافر و المریض 'the traveller, the sick'.

definition: Noun: temperament, disposition, constitution. Root m-z-j.
usage: In مختلف المزاج 'of diverse temperament', of the various believers.

definition: Traveller, wayfarer. Form III active participle, root s-f-r.
usage: Aqdas: لیس علی المسافر و المریض 'the traveller and the sick are exempt' from fasting.

definition: Passive participle of form X ista‘mala 'to use': used, already employed. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: In the Aqdas bath law: المستعمل منه لا یجوز الدخول فیه 'water already used may not be entered'.

definition: Passive participle: He Who is called upon for help; a title whose numerical value foretells the time of the Promised One. Root gh-w-th.
usage: In the Báb's writings and the Íqán: زمن المستغاث 'the time of Mustagháth'.

definition: Active participle: settled, established, firmly seated. Root q-r-r.
Feminine active participle of form X istaqáma: straight, upright, sound. Root q-w-m.
usage: 'Straight, sound'; of sound minds or the straight path.

definition: Noun with article: musk. Root m-s-k.
usage: Musk; in the Writings, the fragrance of the divine, as in al-misk al-makhtúm 'the sealed musk'.

definition: Passive participle feminine with article: dwelt in, inhabited; "ad-dár al-maskúna" the residence. Root s-k-n.
Noun/adjective: poor, needy, wretched. Root s-k-n.
usage: The poor and needy, whose care the Writings enjoin; the believer also calls himself a lowly one before God.

definition: Proper noun: the Messiah, Christ. Root m-s-ḥ.
usage: The Messiah, Christ, as in روح المسیح; often cited in the Íqán.

definition: Broken plural of mashkhaṣ: fixed objects or landmarks by which time is reckoned. Root sh-kh-ṣ.
usage: Landmarks or fixed indicators by which the times of prayer and fasting are reckoned (Aqdas).
notes: Aqdas: prayer times fixed by clocks and such markers in lands of long days and nights.

definition: Verbal noun (form III): beholding, contemplation, direct vision. Root sh-h-d.
usage: 'Beholding, contemplation', the direct vision of God's signs, a station of the mystic way.

definition: Plural (nominative) of mushrik: those who join partners with God. Root sh-r-k.
usage: Those who join partners with God; rendered "the infidels".

definition: Plural of mushrik: idolaters, those who join partners with God. Root sh-r-k.
usage: Those who join partners with God, in the Writings also those who reject the Manifestation.

definition: Plural of mashaqqa: hardships, toil, troubles. Root sh-q-q.
usage: In the Aqdas حمل الریاضات و المشقات 'bore austerities and hardships'.

definition: Noun: hardship, toil, trouble. Root sh-q-q.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words: ان لا تمسّک المشقّة 'that no hardship should touch thee'.

definition: Noun: will, volition, especially the divine Will. Root sh-y-'.
usage: The Primal Will, as in سماء المشیّة 'the heaven of the Will'.

definition: Plural of muṣíbah: calamities, misfortunes. Root ṣ-w-b.
Noun, plural of maṭla‘ with article: rising-points, dawning-places, daysprings. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: مطلع امر 'Dayspring of the Cause' is a title of the Manifestation.

definition: Passive participle plural: the purified, the pure. Root ṭ-h-r.
usage: In the Aqdas کونوا من المطهّرین 'be ye of the pure', on cleanliness.

definition: Active participle, form IV: that which manifests, the revealer. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: From the prayer of Imám Ḥusayn quoted in the Íqán: حتّی یکون هو المظهر لک 'that it should be the revealer of Thee'.
notes: Distinct from مَظْهَر 'Manifestation' (place of appearing).

definition: Passive participle of ‘abada: worshipped; the One who is worshipped, God. Root ‘-b-d.
Plural active participle of a‘raḍa: those who turn away, reject. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: In the Writings those who have turned away from the Manifestation of God.

definition: Plural of maghrib: places of sunset, the wests. Root gh-r-b.
usage: The Íqán explains Qur'an 70:40 ربّ المشارق و المغارب: each sun has its own rising and setting.

definition: Noun: forgiveness, pardon. Root gh-f-r.
Noun of instrument: key. Root f-t-ḥ.
notes: Aqdas: لولا المفتاح لکان مکنوناً 'Were it not for the Key, it would have remained concealed'.

definition: Mufaḍḍal ibn ‘Umar, companion of the Imám Ja‘far aṣ-Ṣádiq and transmitter of traditions.
usage: In the Íqán حدیث المفضّل 'the tradition of Mufaḍḍal'.

definition: Dual of maqám: the two places, stations. Root q-w-m.
usage: Aqdas: raise up the two Houses (of Bahá'u'lláh and the Báb) فی المقامین 'in the twin holy Sites'.

definition: Noun: hatred, loathing; here used for its abjad value 540. Root m-q-t.
usage: In the Aqdas inheritance law علی عدد المقت 'corresponding to the number of the Maqt' (540 shares).
notes: The letters m-q-t total 40+100+400 = 540.

definition: Sanctified, holy; feminine agreeing with a plural noun. Form II passive participle, root q-d-s.
usage: Aqdas: اوامرنا المقدّسة 'Our holy commandments'.

definition: Passive participle plural of form II: sanctified, purified, holy ones. Root q-d-s.
usage: کونوا من المقدّسین 'be ye of the sanctified'.

definition: Noun: aim, goal, destination. Root q-ṣ-d.
usage: Aqdas: قصدت المقصد الأقصی 'it hath sought the most distant goal'.

shift: Here: religion, a religious community or creed. Today in Persian: nation (ملت).
definition: Noun: religion, religious community, creed; modern Persian 'nation'. Root m-l-l.

shift: Here: religions and their peoples, as in ملل عالم. Today: nations (as in سازمان ملل).
definition: Plural of millah 'religious community, nation, people'. Root m-l-l.
usage: 'Peoples, religious communities'; in the Writings the religions and their followers, as in ملل عالم.

definition: Noun with article: plural of mamlúk: slaves, bondsmen, vassals. Root m-l-k.
usage: Vassals, slaves; of subjects or bondsmen of a ruler.

definition: Active participle form VIII feminine with article: impenetrable, resistant, unyielding. Root m-n-‘.
usage: 'Impenetrable', of a lofty or inaccessible place.
notes: Aqdas burial: coffins of hard, resistant stone.

definition: Noun: manna; also favour, bounty. Root m-n-n.
usage: Manna sent to the Israelites, in the Íqán a symbol of the heavenly food of divine knowledge; also God's favour.

definition: Plural of minbar: pulpits. Root n-b-r.
usage: Pulpits of the clergy, from which the Manifestation was denounced; also 'pulpits' to be raised in praise.

definition: Active participle form VIII, a divine name: the Avenger. Root n-q-m.
usage: 'The Avenger', a divine name.

definition: Noun: utmost limit, end; Sidratu’l-Muntahá the Lote-Tree beyond which there is no passing. Root n-h-y.
usage: 'The utmost limit', chiefly in سدرة المنتهی 'the Lote-Tree beyond which there is no passing', a symbol of the Manifestation.
notes: Final ی carries the Persian izáfih.

definition: Active participle, Form VII (feminine): frozen, congealed, hardened. Root j-m-d.
usage: Frozen, hardened; of hearts hardened against God's love.

definition: Passive participle of nazala (beside the usual munzal): sent down, revealed. Root n-z-l.
usage: Sent down, of revealed verses and books, as in the Word sent down from heaven.
notes: Unusual form, in a quoted Arabic passage.

definition: Active participle: branching off, ramifying. Root sh-‘-b.
usage: In the Aqdas الفرع المنشعب من هذا الاصل القویم 'Him Who hath branched from this mighty Stock', i.e. 'Abdu'l-Bahá.

definition: Passive participle of naṣṣa: explicitly stated, laid down in a text. Root n-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: Aqdas: ما هو المنصوص فی اللّوح 'that which is explicitly set forth in the Tablet'; Bahá'í law distinguishes the explicitly revealed (منصوص) from what the House of Justice enacts.

definition: Passive participle, feminine: engraved, inscribed. Root n-q-sh.
usage: Aqdas: الخواتیم المنقوشة 'engraved rings'.

definition: Dual of manhaj 'clear path, way'. Root n-h-j.
Active participle of form IV, feminine with article: shining, luminous. Root n-w-r.
Proper noun: the Mahdí, 'the rightly guided one', the promised redeemer in Islam.
usage: In the Íqán identified with the Qá'im, fulfilled in the Báb; Shoghi Effendi spells it Mihdí.

definition: Plural of míráth: inheritances, estates. Root w-r-th.
usage: قد قسمنا المواریث علی عدد الزّآء 'We have divided inheritance into seven categories'.

definition: Passive participle of waḍa‘a: placed, set; in modern use "subject, topic". Root w-ḍ-‘.
Active participle: the one who fulfils (a promise) completely; a divine title. Root w-f-y.

pos: active participle pl. (form IV) with article
definition: Plural of múqin, active participle of form IV ayqana: those who are certain, firm in faith. Root y-q-n.
usage: Aqdas formula ان انتم من الموقنین 'if ye be of them that are assured'.

definition: Active participle: believer, one who has faith. Root ’-m-n.
usage: In the tradition المؤمن حیّ فی الدّارین 'the true believer is alive in both worlds'.
notes: Written المؤمن.

definition: Plural of mu’min, active participle of ámana 'to believe': the believers, the faithful. Root ’-m-n.
School, place of writing or learning. Root k-t-b.
usage: In the Aqdas Bahá'u'lláh's 'School' of the unseen, where He taught the Báb: قد خلق اللّه ذلک المکتب.

definition: Passive participle: written, recorded; letter. Root k-t-b.
Adjective/noun plural: the dead. Root m-w-t.
usage: Spiritually dead souls, as in Aqdas الا انّهم من المیتین 'they, verily, are of the dead'.

definition: Gambling, games of chance (originally the arrow game of pre-Islamic Arabia). Root y-s-r.
usage: Aqdas: حرّم علیکم المیسر و الأفیون 'gambling and the use of opium have been forbidden unto you'.

definition: Name of the letter م; in abjad reckoning its value is 40.
usage: Used in the Aqdas for numerical values: عدد الراء و المیم 'the number of Rá’ and Mím' (240).

definition: Plural active participle: the devout, ascetics, pious worshippers. Root n-s-k.
usage: In a verse quoted in the Íqán: خلّ سبیل النّاسکین 'abandon the way of the pious'.

definition: Active participle: speaking, the one who speaks. Root n-ṭ-q.
Noun (from Greek nomos): law, revealed law; also an epithet of Gabriel.
usage: 'The Law'; the revealed law of God, as in ناموس اکبر 'the Most Great Law'.
notes: Aqdas: 'the Most Great Law is come'.

definition: Noun with article: news, tidings, announcement; an-naba’ al-a‘ẓam "the Most Great Announcement". Root n-b-’.
usage: Tidings; an-naba' al-a‘ẓam 'the Most Great Announcement', the Bahá'í Revelation.

definition: Noun with article: prophet; the Prophet. Root n-b-'.
usage: The Prophet, usually Muhammad, as in النبی الأمّی.

definition: Noun: call, summons, proclamation. Root n-d-w.
usage: The Call of God raised by the Manifestation, as in نداء الله; Bahá'u'lláh's proclamation to the world.

definition: Verbal noun (form III): dispute, strife, conflict. Root n-z-‘.
usage: Strife or conflict, which the Writings forbid among the believers and peoples.

definition: Noun: drop of fluid; seminal fluid, semen. Root n-ṭ-f.
usage: Drop of seminal fluid, from Qur'anic descriptions of human creation.

definition: Noun: croaking of ravens, clamorous outcry. Root n-‘-q.
usage: 'Croaking', of the raucous cries of ravens, an image for the clamour of the enemies of God.

definition: Plural of naghmah: melodies, tones, songs. Root n-gh-m.
usage: Melodies; of the songs of the Nightingale of Paradise and the chanting of verses.

definition: Verbal noun: banishment, exile; also negation. Root n-f-y.
usage: Banishment or exile, in Aqdas penalties; also negation in theology.

definition: Proper noun: Austria, the Austrian Empire.
usage: In the Aqdas یا ملک النمسة 'O Emperor of Austria', addressed to Francis Joseph.

definition: Noun: open road, clear path, way. Root n-h-j.
usage: In the Íqán's tradition السّالک فی النّهج البیضآء 'the wayfarer in the snow-white path'.

definition: Noun: the letter nún (N).
usage: Aqdas: before الکاف joined النّون, the letters of کن 'Be'.

definition: Noun: marriage, the marriage contract. Root n-k-ḥ.
usage: In the Aqdas, marriage is prescribed: کتب الله علیکم النکاح.

definition: Proper noun: Naw-Rúz, the Persian New Year at the spring equinox.
usage: In the Aqdas Naw-Rúz is made a feast after the Fast.

definition: Active participle plural: those who perish, the lost, the doomed. Root h-l-k.
usage: In من الهالکین 'of them that perish'.

definition: Plural of iláh with suffix: our gods. Root '-l-h.
usage: Qur'an 37:36 أئنّا لتارکوا آلهتنا لشاعر مجنون.

definition: Noun: extreme old age, decrepitude. Root h-r-m.
Proper noun: India.
Noun iláh 'god' with -hu: his god. Root ’-l-h.
usage: Qur'an 45:23 in the Íqán: افرأیت من اتّخذ الهه هواه 'hast thou seen him who taketh his own desire as his god?'
notes: Not the plural آلهة.

definition: Noun: air, atmosphere, sky. Root h-w-y.
usage: Distinct from الهوی 'passion'.

definition: Abstract noun from huwa 'He': ipseity, the divine Essence, selfhood.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words یا ابناء الهویّة فی الغیب 'O Children of the Divine and Invisible Essence'; in the Íqán غیب هویّه 'the unseen Essence'.

definition: Iláhíyya 'divine' with Persian -and 'they are'.
usage: In مطالع اسرار الهیّه‌اند 'they are the daysprings of the mysteries of God'.

definition: Noun: temple; body, form; in the Writings the human Temple of the Manifestation. Root h-y-k-l.
usage: Aqdas هذا الهیکل المبین 'this manifest Temple'; سورة الهیکل 'Súratu'l-Haykal'.

definition: Active participle plural: heirs, inheritors. Root w-r-th.
usage: In Qur'an 28:5 و نجعلهم ائمّة و نجعلهم الوارثین 'make them spiritual leaders and the heirs'.

definition: Occurring, happening, actual; reality. Root w-q-‘.
usage: Íqán: بذلک السّرّ الواقع 'this mystery which hath come to pass'.

definition: Plural of lawn: colours, kinds, varieties. Root l-w-n.
Noun: the Arabic letter wáw (numerical value 6).
usage: Aqdas inheritance: کتاب الواو 'Váv', six parts, using letter numerals.

definition: Feminine elative: firmest, most secure; in العروة الوثقی 'the sure handle'. Root w-th-q.
Noun: face, countenance; aspect, direction. Root w-j-h.
usage: 'Face'; often the Face of God, the Manifestation, as in وجه الله.

definition: Noun with article: plural of wajh: faces; also aspects, ways, parts. Root w-j-h.
usage: Faces, aspects; also 'in no way' in negative phrases.
notes: In the hadith on the twenty-seven letters of knowledge, "the remaining parts".

definition: Noun with article: love, affection, amity. Root w-d-d.
usage: Love or affection, often in counsels to fellowship.

definition: Noun, plural of wárith: heirs, inheritors. Root w-r-th.
usage: Heirs; in the Aqdas's laws of inheritance dividing the estate among the heirs.

definition: Noun: rose, roses. Root w-r-d.
usage: Rose, an image of beauty and spiritual spring in the Writings.
notes: Máʼ al-ward = rose-water.

definition: Verbal noun: joining, connection, union. Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: Union with the Beloved, opposed to الفصل and الهجر 'separation'.

definition: Verbal noun: arrival, attainment, reaching. Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: 'Attainment', of reaching the presence of God or the goal of the seeker.

definition: Noun: will, testament; injunction. Root w-ṣ-y.
usage: Will, testament; the Aqdas enjoins every person to write a will.

definition: Noun: faithfulness, loyalty, keeping one's pledge. Root w-f-y.
usage: Faithfulness and loyalty, especially to the Covenant, as in اهل الوفاء 'the people of faithfulness'.

definition: Verbal noun: agreement, harmony, concord. Root w-f-q.
usage: In the Aqdas انّ الله احبّ الوصل و الوفاق 'God loveth union and concord', said of marriage.

definition: Noun: guardianship, authority; in Shi‘i doctrine the spiritual authority of the Imams. Root w-l-y.
usage: Aqdas: warns lest mention of الولایة 'vicegerency' debar people from ولایة اللّه 'the sovereignty of God'.

definition: Noun, plural of walíma: banquets, feasts. Root w-l-m.
usage: Aqdas: اذا دعیتم الی الولائم 'when ye are invited to banquets'.

definition: Abstract noun: divinity, godhead. Root '-l-h.
usage: Paired with ربوبیه 'Lordship': the attributes of Divinity and Lordship shown forth by the Manifestations.

definition: Noun, plural of liwá’: banners, standards, ensigns. Root l-w-y.
notes: Not the article: the initial alef belongs to the broken plural.

definition: Noun: woe, distress, lamentation. Root w-y-l.
usage: Also in the Qur'anic cry ویل 'woe unto'.

definition: Active participle: the sufficient; divine name, the All-Sufficing. Root k-f-y.
usage: Divine name in closing formulas, as in انّه لهو الکافی الباقی 'He is the All-Sufficing, the Ever-Abiding'.

definition: Noun: grandeur, majesty, supreme greatness, belonging to God. Root k-b-r.
usage: In the Writings مطلع الکبریآء "the Dayspring of Grandeur" and سلطان الکبریاء.

definition: Intensive adjective: great liar, impostor. Root k-dh-b.
Plural of kursí: chairs, seats; also thrones. Root k-r-s.
usage: The Aqdas permits sitting on chairs: جلوسکم علی السرر و الکراسی.

definition: Noun: chair, seat; throne. Root k-r-s.
usage: In the Aqdas, the reader of verses sits on a chair placed upon a platform.

definition: Adjective: broken, fractured; one who is broken. Root k-s-r.
usage: In the Aqdas اجبروا الکسیر بایادی العدل 'Bind ye the broken with the hands of justice'.

definition: Collective plural of kalima: words. Root k-l-m.
usage: In Qur'an 4:46 quoted in the Íqán یحرّفون الکلم عن مواضعه 'they pervert the text of the Word'.

definition: Noun: interlocutor; the title of Moses, who conversed with God. Root k-l-m.
usage: Aqdas هذا یوم فیه فاز الکلیم 'This is the Day whereon He Who conversed with God hath attained'.

definition: Noun: treasure, hidden treasure. Root k-n-z.
usage: In the Aqdas مفتاح الکنز 'the key of the treasure', echoing the tradition of the Hidden Treasure (کنز مخفی).

definition: Dual of kawn "being, world": the two worlds, this world and the next. Root k-w-n.
usage: HW: اکبر عندی عن خلق الکونین 'greater in My sight than the creation of both worlds'.

definition: Noun: hand; figuratively power. Root y-d-y.
usage: کونوا کالاصابع فی الید 'be ye as the fingers of one hand'.

definition: Preposition الی 'to' with the suffix 'her/it'.
Preposition ilá with 'you' (plural): to you.
Noun: leadership, the office of Imam. Root '-m-m.
usage: 'Imamate'; in the Íqán's discussions of the Shí‘í Imams and the station of leadership.

definition: Noun: plural of amána "trust, deposit" plus -hi "his". Root ’-m-n.
usage: His trusts; the trusts (amánát) God has deposited with man.

definition: Verb form VIII, perfect 3rd masculine singular: he tested, tried, proved. Root m-ḥ-n.
usage: 'He tested', of God testing His servants; related to امتحان 'test', a frequent theme.
notes: ‘abdun imtaḥana’lláhu qalbahu li’l-ímán whose heart God hath tested for faith.

definition: Verbal noun (form VIII): extension, prolongation, duration. Root m-d-d.
usage: Extension or duration, of time or of a period.

definition: Plural of mithl with 3rd masc. suffix: those like him, his kind. Root m-th-l.
usage: Those like him, his kind.

definition: Broken plural of mithl 'like' + -ka: the likes of thee. Root m-th-l.
usage: The likes of thee.

definition: Verb, perfect 3rd person plural of ámadan 'to come': they have come.
usage: 'They have come', of the Prophets who have come and of peoples who came before.

definition: Past 2nd sing. of ámadan (to come): you came.
Noun: man, person (imru’, accusative imra’a). Root m-r-’.
usage: Man or person, as in لکلّ امرء 'for every man'.
notes: Qur'anic má kána abúki imra’a saw’in.

definition: Noun from ámurzídan 'to forgive': forgiveness, divine pardon, remission of sins.
usage: In the Íqán's Gospel quotation, power on earth برای آمرزش ذنوب 'to forgive sins'.

definition: Verb: perfect 1st plural of amara, 'to command', with suffix -hu 'him'. Root '-m-r.
Noun amr 'Cause, command' with Persian copula -and: (they) are ... of the Cause. Root '-m-r.
usage: Íqán: مطالع امرند 'they are the Daysprings of the Cause'.

definition: Verb: to command, bid; He hath commanded you. Root '-m-r.
Proper noun: America (the Americas).
usage: In the Aqdas the address یا ملوک امریقا 'O Rulers of America'.

definition: Active participle plural: those who command, ordain. Root ’-m-r.
usage: In the Aqdas انّا کنّا آمرین 'verily We have been commanding'.
notes: Normalized from آمرین; not the dual amrayn 'two matters'.

definition: Relational adjective from amr: pertaining to the Cause or the divine command. Root '-m-r.
usage: مصادر امریه 'the Sources of His Cause', i.e. the Manifestations.

definition: Form IV of m-s-k: to hold, seize; third feminine plural "they (the beasts) caught". Root m-s-k.
Verb: 'We held back, withheld', form IV of m-s-k.
Imperative 2nd person masculine singular of mashá 'to walk': walk, proceed. Root m-sh-y.
usage: In the Íqán ثمّ امش علی ما تختار لنفسک 'then walk the path thou choosest for thyself'.
notes: The final yá' drops in the imperative.

definition: Verb, 1st singular present of mashá 'to walk'. Root m-sh-y.
usage: In the Hidden Words لأنّی امشی قدّامه 'for I walk before him'.

definition: Imperative of malaka 'to own, possess'. Root m-l-k.
usage: First Arabic Hidden Word: املک قلباً جیّداً حسناً منیراً 'Possess a pure, kindly and radiant heart'.

definition: Form IV of ’-m-n: you (pl.) believed. Root ’-m-n.
usage: In the Aqdas لو آمنتم باللّه حین ظهوره 'had ye believed in God when He revealed Himself'.

definition: Noun amn 'safety' with indefinite -í; محل امنی 'a safe place'. Root '-m-n.
Active participle plural: secure, safe, in peace. Root a-m-n.
usage: In the Hidden Words الّذینهم دخلوا فیه آمنین 'them that have entered therein in safety'.

definition: Umm "mother, source, origin" with Arabic suffix -há "its": its mother, its source. Root ’-m-m.
notes: Read as Arabic umm + -há "its", paralleling نفسها, ذاتها, جوهرها in the same phrase; could also be Persian plural امّها "mothers".

definition: Plural of umm: mothers; also sources, principal things. Root ’-m-m.
usage: بطن امّهات 'the wombs of mothers', of the outward birth of the Manifestations.

definition: Plural of موج 'wave' with indefinite ی: waves. Root m-w-j.
usage: Íqán: از بحر قدم صمدانی امواجی ظاهر نگردد 'no waves surge from the ocean of eternity'.

definition: Plural of mál with 'your': your wealth, possessions. Root m-w-l.
Plural of amr 'affair, matter' plus -him 'their'. Root '-m-r.
usage: 'Their affairs'; of administering people's affairs in justice.

definition: Noun: plural of amr "matter, affair" plus Persian indefinite -í: such things, certain matters. Root ’-m-r.
usage: Matters, certain affairs; plural of amr in its sense 'matter'.

definition: Noun umúr (plural of amr, matter) with indefinite -í and copula ast: it is things (that). Root '-m-r.
usage: Matters or things; امور is the plural of امر in its sense of 'matter'.

definition: Noun umm "mother" + -ki "thy" (feminine): thy mother. Root ’-m-m.
usage: Mother; ordinary 'thy mother' here; elsewhere ام الکتاب 'the Mother Book' is a title of the Aqdas.
notes: Qur'an 19:28, addressed to Mary.

definition: Feminine adjective: contingent, of the world of being, earthly. Root m-k-n.
usage: Contingent, of the world of contingency (عالم امکان), as distinct from God's necessary being.

definition: Adjective (accusative): faithful, trustworthy; trustee. Root '-m-n.
usage: Trustworthy, faithful; trustworthiness (امانة) is a praised virtue.

definition: Plural of ummí 'unlettered, untaught'. Root ’-m-m.
usage: 'The unlettered', used of the Arabs before Islam and of unschooled people to whom God's Messenger was sent.

definition: Plural of Injíl: Gospels (from Greek euangelion).
usage: The Gospels; the Íqán interprets Gospel prophecies.

definition: Perfect (form IV) third feminine singular of anára 'to illumine, shine'. Root n-w-r.
usage: Shining, used of lights, horizons or hearts illumined by God.

definition: Noun: people, folk; kull unásin 'every group of people'. Root a-n-s.
usage: Qur'an 2:60 قد علم کلّ اناس مشربهم 'every tribe knew its drinking-place'.

definition: Verb: imperative of intabaha, 'to wake up, to take heed'. Root n-b-h.
usage: Aqdas: انتبه و لا تکن من الرّاقدین 'awake, and be not of them that sleep'.

definition: Arabic verb, form VIII perfect 3rd plural: they awoke, became aware. Root n-b-h.
usage: Aqdas, echoing a hadith: انّ النّاس نیام لو انتبهوا 'men are asleep; should they awake'.

definition: Verbal noun form VIII: vengeance, retribution. Root n-q-m.
Verb, form VII perfect 3rd fem. sing.: was drawn, attracted, enraptured. Root j-dh-b.
Verbal noun: deviation, turning aside. Root ḥ-r-f.
usage: In the Íqán, of the Prophet turning from Jerusalem towards the Ka‘bah.

definition: Verb, present of انداختن: throws, casts. Persian.
usage: بخاک اندازد 'lay him in the dust'.

definition: Persian noun: measure, size, extent, capacity.
Imperative of اندرآمدن 'to come in, enter': 'enter!'.
Present subjunctive 2nd person singular of andar-ámadan 'to come in, enter' (archaic andar 'in'): (if) thou enter.
usage: In the Hidden Words ساحت هستی اگر اندرآئی 'the realm of being, wert thou to attain thereto'.
notes: Spelled اندرآئی; the search form writes ئ as ی.

definition: Verb nazala 'to descend, alight, halt' past 2nd plural. Root n-z-l.
notes: The text probably reads اذا نزلتم 'when ye halt', the alef split from اذا; read as form IV anzaltum 'ye sent down' it makes no sense here.

definition: Perfect 1st plural of form IV anzala 'to send down, reveal'. Root n-z-l.
usage: Of divine revelation, as in انّا انزلنا علیک الکتاب 'We have sent down unto thee the Book'.

definition: Form IV of n-z-l: he brought them down. Root n-z-l.
usage: In the Aqdas قد انزلهم الرّحمن من القصور الی القبور 'the All-Merciful brought them down from their palaces to the graves'.

definition: Noun insán 'man' with Persian copula: is man (here 'of creating man').
Verbal noun of form VII: being closed, blocked. Root s-d-d.
usage: In انسداد باب رحمت 'the closing of the gate of mercy', which the Íqán denies.

definition: Form VII perfect of sh-‘-b: branched off, issued forth.
usage: Aqdas, of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá: من اراده اللّه الّذی انشعب من هذا الأصل القدیم 'Him Whom God hath purposed, Who hath branched from this Ancient Root'.

definition: Perfect of form VII inshaqqa 'to be split, cleft asunder'. Root sh-q-q.
usage: انشقّ القمر 'the moon is cleft asunder' (Qur'an 54:1), a sign of the Hour.

definition: Plural: helpers, supporters (the Anṣár of Medina). Root n-ṣ-r.
usage: Aqdas: اولئک انصار اللّه فی الأرض 'they are the helpers of God on earth'.

definition: Imperative plural of naṣara with 'it': help it, assist it. Root n-ṣ-r.
Past tense of form VII inṣa‘aqa: to be thunderstruck, swoon away. Root ṣ-‘-q.
usage: 'Swooned'; echoing the Qur'anic account of Moses swooning on Sinai, also of all creation at the Revelation.

definition: Verb (form IV): imperative plural: be just, judge fairly. Root n-ṣ-f.
usage: Be fair, judge fairly; common call to the reader to judge justly.

definition: Verbal noun form VII: being knotted, concluded; formation, conception (of a fetus). Root ‘-q-d.
usage: Formation or conception, as of an embryo; also the convening of a gathering (انعقاد محفل).

definition: Verb (form VII, past) 3rd person feminine singular: was plunged, immersed. Root gh-m-s.
usage: To be immersed, of souls plunged in the ocean of God's mercy or in the waters of heedlessness.

definition: Verb (form VII perfect, fem.): burst forth, gushed out. Root f-j-r.
usage: Gushing forth, of springs and rivers of divine knowledge.

definition: Adjective (fem.) from anfus 'souls, selves': pertaining to the soul; inner. Root n-f-s.
usage: Inner, pertaining to the self, as in آیات انفسیه 'signs within the soul', paired with آفاقیه.
notes: Paired with áfáqíyyih 'of the horizons, outer'.

definition: Verb, perfect form VII feminine: it was cleft, split asunder. Root f-ṭ-r.
usage: From Qur'an 82:1 'When the heaven shall be cloven asunder', interpreted in the Íqán symbolically of the heaven of former religions.
notes: Quran 82:1 'When the heaven shall be cloven asunder'.

definition: Verb, Form IV imperative: spend, expend, bestow. Root n-f-q.
usage: Spend; bestow in the path of God, as in the Hidden Words.

definition: Verbal noun (form VII): separation, detachment. Root f-k-k.
usage: Separation or detachment, as in لا انفکاک 'inseparable'.

definition: Past of form VII: he was cut off; he detached himself from. Root q-ṭ-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas انقطع عن سوائی 'detached himself from all else but Me'.

definition: Demonstrative án 'that' with enclitic -am 'I am': I am that.
notes: In غیر آنم 'I am other than that'.

definition: Arabic particle inna 'verily' with 1st plural pronoun: verily we.
Verb form VII: to be routed, put to flight. Root h-z-m.
Noun inkár 'denial' with Persian plural -há: denials, rejections. Root n-k-r.
Particle إنّ 'verily, that' with pronoun 'you (pl.)'.
Verb, present perfect of انگاشتن: they have supposed, deemed. Persian.
usage: کأن لم یکن انگاشته‌اند 'have regarded as a thing of naught'.
notes: Written انگاشته‌اند; joiner removed.

definition: Present perfect of انگاشتن "to suppose, deem": ye have supposed, considered.
notes: Written انگاشته‌اید.

definition: Proper noun: Anísá, name of the Tree of Life in the Persian Hidden Words; from anís 'companion'.
usage: Persian Hidden Words: در ظلّ شجرهٔ انیسا 'in the shade of the Tree of Anísá'.

definition: Perfect of form IV ahdá 'to give as a gift' with -hu: he presented it. Root h-d-y.
Verbal noun: destroying, annihilation. Root h-l-k.
Plural of hilál 'crescent, new moon'. Root h-l-l.
usage: From Qur'an 2:189 on the question about the new moons.
notes: Íqán context.

definition: Noun ahl 'people, family, those worthy' with -hi 'his, its'. Root ’-h-l.
Ahl 'people, family' with -há: its/her family. Root ’-h-l.
usage: In the Aqdas blood-money law: دیة مسلّمة الی اهلها 'an indemnity to be paid to the family'.

definition: Plural of hawá 'desire, passion' with -kum: your desires. Root h-w-y.
usage: Aqdas اصنام اهوائکم 'the idols of your evil desires'.
notes: Written اهوائکم.

definition: Noun, plural of ávárih: wanderers, homeless ones.
usage: In آوارگان صحرای جهل 'the wanderers in the wilderness of ignorance'.

definition: Commands (plural awámir of amr "command") with -ná "our". Root ’-m-r.
usage: Aqdas: ما اردناه لکم من اوامرنا المقدّسة 'what We desire for you through Our holy commandments'.

definition: Noun: time, season, the proper moment. Root ’-w-n.
usage: اوقات و اوان 'times and seasons'.

definition: Plural of آنیة: vessels, utensils. Root ’-n-y.
usage: Aqdas: اوانی الذّهب و الفضّة 'vessels of gold and silver'.

definition: Passive past 3pl of átá: they were given. Root ’-t-y.
Past passive of form IV átá 'to give': was given, endowed with. Root '-t-y.
usage: 'Was given'; in Qur'anic phrases like اوتی الکتاب 'were given the Book'.

definition: Verb: passive past of ádhá "to hurt": he was hurt, harmed. Root ’-dh-y.
usage: Was harmed; of the sufferings of the Manifestation, as in 'no Prophet was harmed as I have been'.

definition: Verb ádhá "to hurt", form IV perfect passive 1st singular: I was harmed, persecuted. Root '-dh-y.
usage: 'I was harmed', of the Manifestation's sufferings at the hands of His opponents.
notes: Hadith "má údhiya nabíyyun bi-mithli má údhítu".

definition: Verb, past 3rd person plural of ávardan: they brought; with várid "to inflict".
usage: Common verb 'they brought'; in compounds such as وارد آوردند 'they inflicted' (afflictions on the prophets).

definition: Past 1st pl. of ávardan: we brought; ímán ávardan = to believe.
usage: From آوردن; in ایمان آوردن 'to believe'.

definition: Imperative 2nd pl. of ávardan 'to bring'; yád ávardan 'to remember, call to mind'.
usage: Bring; یاد آورید 'call to mind'.
notes: Written آورید.

definition: Elative awsaṭ 'middle' with suffix -ná: the middle of us. Root w-s-ṭ.
usage: 'The middle of us', in the tradition on the oneness of the Imams and Prophets (first, middle and last of us is Muḥammad).

definition: Elative of vási‘: wider, more spacious. Root w-s-‘.
Plural of waṣí: legatees, appointed successors of the Prophets. Root w-ṣ-y.
usage: The legatees or successors of the Prophets, especially the Imáms, as in انبیا و اوصیا 'Prophets and their successors'.

definition: Plural of vaṭan: homelands, native places, homes. Root w-ṭ-n.
usage: In the Íqán the Manifestations driven from اوطان 'their homes'.

definition: Noun: times, plural of waqt, with suffix -kum 'your'. Root w-q-t.
usage: Aqdas: لا تضیعوا اوقاتکم بالبطالة و الکسالة 'waste not your time in idleness and sloth'.

definition: Noun, plural of walad: children, sons, descendants. Root w-l-d.
usage: Hadith: اولاد العجم 'the sons of Persia'.

definition: Adjective awwal 'first' with pronoun 'us': the first of us. Root '-w-l.
usage: In the tradition اولنا محمد و آخرنا محمد 'the first of us is Muḥammad, the last of us is Muḥammad'.

definition: Noun awwal 'first' with 3rd fem. suffix: its first. Root ’-w-l.
Noun, plural of walí: friends, protectors, helpers; saints. Root w-l-y.
usage: In the Writings the chosen friends of God, as in اولیاء الله; in the Aqdas اولیاء النّصر.
notes: The authorized rendering of اولیاء النّصر is uncertain.

definition: Plural of walí 'friend (of God), saint' with Persian است. Root w-l-y.
usage: اولیا are the chosen ones of God; in Shí‘í usage also the Imáms.

definition: Plural of walí with suffix "my": My friends, saints, loved ones. Root w-l-y.
Plural of awwal 'first': the first ones, the ancients. Root '-w-l.
usage: In the Qur'anic phrase اساطیر الأوّلین 'fables of the ancients'.
notes: In ordinary Persian avvalín is 'the first'.

definition: Feminine relative adjective from avval 'first': primal, primary, original. Root ’-w-l.
usage: In the Íqán the Manifestations are مرایای اوّلیّهٔ ازلیّه 'the primal mirrors of eternity'.
notes: The form ends in U+06D5 as given.

definition: Elative akbar 'greater' with Persian copula -and 'they are'. Root k-b-r.
Imperative of kataba 'to write'. Root k-t-b.
Earning, acquiring; gainful work. Root k-s-b.
usage: In the Hidden Words بصنایع و اکتساب مشغول گردند 'engage in crafts and professions'; work is enjoined on all.

definition: Verb form VIII: it (fem.) earned, acquired, wrought. Root k-s-b.
usage: E.g. ما اکتسبت ایدی ... 'what the hands of ... have wrought'.

definition: Elative akthar 'most' with the suffix 'them': most of them. Root k-th-r.
usage: In Qur'an 25:44 ام تحسب انّ اکثرهم یسمعون 'Thinkest thou that the greater part of them hear?'.

definition: Akthar "most, the greater part" with -kum "of you". Root k-th-r.
usage: Qur'an 5:59 in the Íqán: و انّ اکثرکم فاسقون 'and most of you are evil-doers'.

definition: Elative of karím: most noble, most generous, most bountiful. Root k-r-m.
usage: فجر اقوم اکرم 'the most upright, most bountiful dawn'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I), imperative: be satisfied, be content. Root k-f-y.
usage: HW: اکف بنفسی عن دونی 'be thou content with Me and seek no other'.
notes: Read as imperative of کفی; the Hidden Word renders 'Be thou content with Me'.

definition: Verbal noun: eating, food. Root ’-k-l.
Noun ukul 'fruit, produce' plus -há 'its (feminine)'. Root '-k-l.
usage: 'Its fruit'; in the Qur'anic image of the good tree giving its fruit in every season.
notes: Qur'an 14:25 'yielding its fruit in every season'.

definition: Verb (form IV): past 1st singular of akmala "to complete, perfect". Root k-m-l.
usage: I perfected; from the Qur'anic al-yawma akmaltu lakum dínakum 'today I have perfected your religion'.

definition: Noun, plural of kúb: cups, goblets. Root k-w-b.
usage: Cups or goblets, Qur'anic paradise imagery for the cups of divine knowledge.

definition: Noun, plural of kawn: beings, existent things, worlds. Root k-w-n.
usage: All beings and worlds of existence, as in عالم اکوان 'the world of beings'.

definition: Adjective: aware, informed, cognizant.
usage: Aware or informed, as in آگاه شدن 'to become aware'; of God as all-aware.

definition: Verbal noun: return, coming back (often paired with dhaháb 'going'). Root '-w-b.
usage: Return, often in ذهاب و ایاب 'going and coming'.

definition: Noun ayádí 'hands' (plural of yad) with suffix -kum. Root y-d-y.
usage: 'Your hands', of what your hands have wrought.

definition: Plural ayyám (days), accusative indefinite. Root y-w-m.
usage: Days; also the Days of the Manifestation.

definition: Plural of yawm 'day' + -kum 'your'. Root y-w-m.
usage: Your days, the days of God's Revelation, as in ایّام الله.

definition: Independent object pronoun: me; here 'for Me' after a verbal noun.
usage: In the Hidden Words حبّک ایّای 'thy love for Me'.

definition: Verb: imperative plural of atá, 'to come'; with bi 'bring'. Root '-t-y.
usage: Qur'an 45:25 in the Íqán: ائتوا بآبائنا 'bring back our fathers'.

definition: Arabic verb, form II perfect 1st plural with -hu: We strengthened, aided him. Root '-y-d.
usage: Qur'an 2:253: ایّدناه بروح القدس 'We strengthened him with the Holy Spirit'.

definition: Verb form II: to strengthen, aid, confirm; He aided him. Root '-y-d.
usage: تأیید 'confirmation' is the divine aid to the believers.

definition: Adjective from Ízad 'God': divine, of God.
Verb: he awakened you. Root y-q-ẓ.
usage: In the Aqdas: ایقظکم من نسمات الوحی 'He awakened you through the breezes of Revelation'.

definition: Verb, form IV imperative: be certain, know assuredly. Root y-q-n.
usage: یا ابن الروح ایقن 'O Son of Spirit! Know thou of a truth'.

definition: Interrogative ayy "which" with má: which (of the two), whichever.
notes: In the Gospel passage ایّما اسهل "Whether is easier".

definition: Verbal noun ímán 'faith, belief' with -hu 'his'. Root '-m-n.
Relative adjective ímání 'pertaining to faith' with the Persian copula -st: is (the life or death) of faith. Root ’-m-n.
usage: In the Íqán the 'life' and 'death' of scripture are the life and death of faith (موت و حیات ایمانیست).

definition: Adjective: right-hand; blessed, auspicious. Root y-m-n.
usage: In وادی ایمن, the Qur'anic blessed Vale where God spoke to Moses.

definition: Adjective: safe, secure, protected.
Plural of imám 'leader, Imám'. Root ’-m-m.
usage: The Shí‘ih Imáms, as in ائمّهٔ هدی 'the Imáms of guidance'.
notes: Search form of ائمّهٔ; final ە (U+06D5) in the source.

definition: Interrogative a- plus inná 'verily we': are we indeed...?
usage: In Qur'an 37:36 ائنّا لتارکوا آلهتنا لشاعر مجنون 'shall we abandon our gods for a mad poet?'

definition: Proper noun: Job, the prophet known for his patience.
usage: صبر ایوب 'the patience of Job'.

definition: Noun: dense thicket, grove of trees. Root a-y-k.
usage: In the Aqdas اذا طارت الورقاء عن ایک الثّنآء 'When the Mystic Dove will have winged its flight from its Sanctuary of praise'.

definition: Ayy "which?" with -kum: which of you.
usage: Qur'an 67:2 in the Íqán: لیبلوکم ایّکم احسن عملاً 'to prove which of you excelleth in deeds'.

definition: Persian bá 'with' plus Arabic iqtidár 'power': powerful, mighty. Root q-d-r.
usage: ملیک بااقتدار 'the mighty Sovereign'.

definition: Preposition ب with آباء 'fathers' and the suffix 'our'. Root ’-b-w.
usage: Qur'anic: ائتوا بآبائنا 'bring back our fathers'.

definition: Noun used in از بابت: on account of, by way of, regarding.
Persian bi- 'with, by' plus ibríq 'ewer, pitcher' plus indefinite -í: with a ewer.
usage: 'With a ewer'; in descriptions of washing or pouring.

definition: Preposition bi- plus ittibá‘ (form VIII) "following, obedience". Root t-b-‘.
usage: To follow; ittibá‘ 'following, obedience' to God's laws.

definition: Preposition bi- with athar "trace, track": in the track of, following. Root '-th-r.
usage: 'Following in the track of', e.g. following the footsteps of the Prophets.

definition: Phrase bi + athmár (plural of thamar): with fruits. Root th-m-r.
usage: With fruits, as of the tree of the soul bearing the fruits of good deeds.

definition: Persian bi- with aḥad (one, anyone) and indefinite -í: to or with anyone. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: Aḥad 'anyone', usually in negatives, 'to anyone'.

definition: bi- + ikhtiṣár 'brevity, abridgement' (form VIII verbal noun). Root kh-ṣ-r.
usage: 'For brevity', a phrase closing an explanation.

definition: Preposition bi- + akhláq 'traits, character', plural of khulq. Root kh-l-q.
usage: 'With attributes', in exhortations to adorn oneself with the attributes of God and goodly character.

definition: bi + ádáb (plural of adab): manners, customs, rules of conduct. Root '-d-b.
usage: Customs, manners; also good conduct, the courtesy that the Writings praise.

definition: Active participle of badá 'to appear': apparent; bádiya'r-ra’y 'at first thought, without reflection'. Root b-d-w.
usage: Apparent, in بادی الرّأی 'at first sight, without reflection'.
notes: Qur'an 11:27.

definition: Adjective: lofty, towering, high. Root b-dh-kh.
usage: In the Aqdas کلّ جبل باذخ رفیع 'every lofty and towering mountain'.

definition: Persian bi- 'with, in' + adhkár 'remembrances, invocations', plural of dhikr. Root dh-k-r.
usage: In the Íqán's counsel to the seeker: در اسحار باذکار مشغول شود 'at dawn let him commune with God'.

definition: Preposition bi- with adhyál, plural of dhayl: (to) the skirts, hems. Root dh-y-l.
usage: Holding to the skirts (hem) of someone, as in تمسّک بأذیال 'cling to the skirts'.

definition: Preposition bi with irtifá' 'rising, exaltation, ascendancy'. Root r-f-‘.
Proper adjective: of Bárfurúsh (Babol), Mázindarán.
usage: In the Íqán the Báb's disciples are listed with such town names.

definition: Verb: they remained behind, were left out, were deprived (از).
Verb, present perfect of بازماندن: they have been left behind, deprived. Persian.
Present of بازماندن "to be held back, cease, fall short": it ceases, is kept from.
Negative present of بازداشتن 'to hold back, prevent'.
Simple past 2nd person plural of báz-gardídan 'to return': ye returned; the same form is also the plural imperative.
usage: In the Hidden Words بآب و گل بازگردید 'ye have returned to water and clay'.

definition: Verb, past 3rd singular of bázgashtan 'to return'; also the noun 'return'.
Noun: play, game; in compounds staking or gambling away, as جانبازی 'self-sacrifice'.
notes: Context جان بازی: staking one's life.

definition: Misfortune, distress, adversity. Root b-’-s.
usage: Paired with ḍarrá’: بأساء و ضرّاء 'adversity and affliction' (Qur'anic).

definition: bi- with asbáb 'causes, means' and -há: upon their causes or means. Root s-b-b.
usage: ان الامور معلقة باسبابها 'all matters are dependent upon their means'.

definition: Preposition bi- with istighráq: being wholly absorbed, immersion. Root gh-r-q.
usage: In استغراق در شئونات نفسیّه 'absorption in selfish pursuits'.

definition: Bi "with" + istiqáma "steadfastness, constancy" (form X). Root q-w-m.
usage: Aqdas: یذکروننی باستقامة 'they will make mention of Me with steadfastness'.

definition: Preposition bi with istiqámat 'steadfastness, uprightness'. Root q-w-m.
usage: استقامت 'steadfastness' in the Cause is a frequent virtue in the Writings.

definition: Preposition ب with استماع 'listening, hearing'. Root s-m-‘.
Bi- with istiwá' (being seated, established) and 'his'. Root s-w-y.
notes: Rendering in this Aqdas passage not confirmed.

definition: bi- plus istílá’ 'domination, mastery', verbal noun of form X istawlá, with izáfih -y. Root w-l-y.
usage: 'By dominion, mastery'; of the ascendancy of the Cause or of self over the soul.

definition: Preposition bi- plus asfal "lowest, nethermost". Root s-f-l.
usage: To the lowest; of the nethermost depths of abasement.

definition: Preposition bi- with asmá’ (plural of ism, name) and -ná: by Our names. Root s-m-w.
usage: 'By Our names'; the divine names (اسماء) are a major theme in the Writings.
notes: bi-asmá’ina’l-ḥusná Our most excellent names.

definition: Phrase bi + asmá’ (plural of ism "name") + -hi "his": by his names. Root s-m-w.
usage: By His names; God's names and attributes (اسماء و صفات) are manifested in the Manifestations and in creation.
notes: bi-asmá’ihi'l-ḥusná His most excellent names; written باسمائه.

definition: Preposition bi- with ism and 3rd masc. suffix: by or to His Name. Root s-m-w.
usage: Everlasting, as in its everlasting dominion; باقی contrasted with فانی 'perishable'.

definition: bi- 'in, by' + ism 'name' + -ka 'thy'. Root s-m-w.
usage: 'By Thy name', opening prayers and invocations.

definition: Noun ba’s 'harm' with indefinite -í; ba’sí nist: there is no harm. Root b-’-s.
usage: 'Harm', in باسی نیست 'there is no harm', used in permissions in the laws.

definition: bi + ishárát (plural of ishárah): signs, allusions, indications. Root sh-w-r.
usage: Allusions; used of hints and allusions in scripture.

definition: Preposition bi + ishtiyáq (form VIII) 'longing, yearning'. Root sh-w-q.
usage: Longing or yearning, often for meeting God or reaching His presence.

definition: Preposition bi- 'to' plus áshiyán 'nest, abode of a bird'.
usage: A figure for the soul's true home, as in آشیان وحدت 'the nest of unity'.

definition: Persian bi- 'to' + áshyánih 'nest' + plural -há.
usage: Image of souls as birds returning to the divine nest.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with ashyá, plural of shay' 'thing'. Root sh-y-'.
notes: The final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Preposition bi 'with' and aṣábi', plural of iṣba' 'finger'. Root ṣ-b-‘.
usage: As in باصابع القدرة 'with the fingers of might'.

definition: Preposition bi with aṣl: to the root, origin, essence. Root ’-ṣ-l.
Adjective (fem.): vain, false, void. Root b-ṭ-l.
usage: In ظنونات باطله 'vain imaginings'.

definition: Preposition ب with iṭmínán: to or with tranquillity, assurance. Root ṭ-m-’-n.
usage: اضطرابشان باطمینان تبدیل میشد 'their agitation was changed to calm'.

definition: Adverbial accusative of báṭin "inner": inwardly; paired with ظاهراً "outwardly". Root b-ṭ-n.
Noun báṭin 'inside, inner self' with -shán 'their'. Root b-ṭ-n.
Relative adjective from báṭin: inward, inner, hidden, spiritual. Root b-ṭ-n.
usage: In the Íqán سلطنت باطنی 'inner (spiritual) sovereignty' of the Manifestation, as opposed to outward rule.

definition: Preposition bi- plus i‘tiráḍ 'objection, protest, opposition'. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
Preposition bi- + i‘ráḍ 'turning away' (form IV) + -ka 'thy'. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: rest is ordained only باعراضک عن نفسک 'through thy turning away from thyself'.

definition: Bi- 'with' plus a‘mál 'deeds'. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words باعمال خود را بیارائید نه باقوال 'adorn yourselves with deeds, not words'.

definition: bi- with a‘yun 'eyes' and -him: with their eyes. Root ‘-y-n.
Noun bágh 'garden' with the indefinite -í: a garden.
usage: In the Hidden Words شاخهٔ باغی 'the bough of a garden'.
notes: Not the Arabic bághí 'rebel'.

definition: Ba/bi "by" + ifáḍa "outpouring, bestowal of grace" (form IV). Root f-y-ḍ.
usage: Íqán: متحرّکند بافاضه ایشان 'they move through their outpouring of grace'.

definition: Preposition bi- with iftikhár 'boasting, glorying'. Root f-kh-r.
usage: لا تفتخر علی المسکین بافتخار نفسک 'boast not over the poor in thine own glory'.

definition: Preposition ب with افکار, plural of فکر 'thought'. Root f-k-r.
Active participle: remaining, abiding, everlasting. Root b-q-y.
bi- plus iqbál 'turning toward, acceptance', verbal noun of form IV aqbala. Root q-b-l.
usage: اقبال is 'turning toward, acceptance' of the Cause, a key term for embracing the Faith.

definition: Preposition bi- plus iqtiráf (form VIII) "earning, acquiring through work". Root q-r-f.
usage: By earning, acquiring; also of committing sins (iqtiráf).
notes: Elsewhere iqtiráf often means committing (a sin).

definition: Proper name Báqir (lit. "one who splits open", i.e. knowledge); here Mullá Báqir, a Letter of the Living.
usage: Báqir, a name; here a Letter of the Living; also the fifth Imám, Muhammad al-Báqir.

definition: Phrase bi + aqall "least": with the least. Root q-l-l.
usage: With the least; often of the least time, as in less than a moment (اقلّ من آن).

definition: Feminine adjective báqíyih (enduring, everlasting) with -ash (its). Root b-q-y.
usage: By or in His Name, as in 'in His Name' openings and invocations.
notes: Athmár-i báqíyih-ash = its everlasting fruits.

definition: Active participle (fem., izáfih form): lasting, everlasting. Root b-q-y.
notes: Final ە (U+06D5) carries the izáfih hamza in the source.

definition: Preposition bi- + article + athwáb, plural of thawb 'garment'. Root th-w-b.
usage: 'In garments', in Aqdas permissions about clothing.

definition: bi + al-ijlál (Form IV verbal noun): honouring, glorifying, exaltation. Root j-l-l.
usage: In glory, honour; of God's glory and of honouring Him.

definition: Preposition bi + al-adhkár, plural of dhikr 'mention, praise, remembrance'. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Mentions and praises of God, as in remembering God with adhkár.
notes: Lá túṣafu bi'l-adhkár 'beyond all description'.

definition: Preposition bi- with al-istiqámah 'uprightness, steadfastness, constancy'. Root q-w-m.
usage: In the Aqdas فاز بالاستقامة الکبری 'hath attained unto supreme steadfastness'.

definition: Preposition bi 'with' + al-ism 'the name'. Root s-m-w.
usage: Aqdas: بالاسم الأعظم 'with the Most Great Name', which adorns the head of a will.

definition: Preposition bi- with ishára: by sign, gesture or allusion. Root sh-w-r.
usage: Aqdas: realms that لا تشار بالإشارة 'cannot be alluded to by sign'.

definition: Preposition bi 'with' and al-a'mál, plural of 'amal 'deed, work'. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: Goodly deeds, as بالاعمال الحسنة.

definition: Preposition bi with article and iqbál: (to) turning toward. Root q-b-l.
usage: اقبال in the Writings is turning toward the Manifestation, opposed to اعراض 'turning away'.

definition: Preposition بـ with الامر 'the Cause, the command'. Root ’-m-r.
usage: In the Writings الامر is usually 'the Cause' of God, the Faith itself.

definition: Preposition ب with verbal noun: by giving a dowry. Root m-h-r.
usage: Aqdas: لا یحقّق الصهار الاّ بالامهار 'marriage is dependent upon payment of a dowry'.

definition: bi "with" plus plural of mál: with possessions, wealth. Root m-w-l.
Preposition bi- with al-uns 'intimacy, fellowship, companionship'. Root '-n-s.

pos: prep. + verbal noun (form VII) with article
definition: Bi- plus al-inqiṭá‘, verbal noun of form VII inqaṭa‘a: by detachment, complete severance from worldly things. Root q-ṭ-‘.
usage: انقطاع 'detachment' is a central virtue; the Íqán opens: none attain the shore of true understanding الّا بالانقطاع 'except they be detached'.

definition: Arabic adverbial phrase: self-evidently, obviously. Root b-d-h.
Preposition bi- + al-baṣar 'sight, vision, eye'. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: In لو انتم بالبصر الحدید تنظرون 'if ye would behold with a keen eye'.

definition: Bi- 'in' plus baṭála 'idleness, unemployment'. Root b-ṭ-l.
usage: In the Aqdas لا تضیّعوا اوقاتکم بالبطالة و الکسالة 'waste not your time in idleness and sloth'.

definition: bi- with al-baghy: (prompting) to wickedness, transgression. Root b-gh-y.
Preposition bi- with ath-thaláth 'the three'. Root th-l-th.
usage: In the Aqdas الماء الّذی لم یتغیّر بالثّلٰث 'water that hath not been altered in any of the three respects' (colour, taste, smell).

definition: Ba/bi "with" + alḥán "melodies, tones" (plural of laḥn). Root l-ḥ-n.
usage: Íqán: در رضوان انجیل بالحان جلیل 'in the Riḍván of the Gospel with glorious melodies'.

definition: Preposition bi- with al-ḥujja 'proof, evidence'. Root ḥ-j-j.
usage: اتی الرحمن بالحجة و البرهان 'the All-Merciful hath come with proof and testimony'.

definition: Preposition ب with the plural of حسنة 'good deed'. Root ḥ-s-n.
usage: Qur'anic: یبدّل اللّه السّیّئات بالحسنات 'God will change evil deeds into good'.

definition: Bi- with al-ḥikma: with wisdom, prudently. Root ḥ-k-m.
bi- plus al-khuḍú‘ 'submission, humility'. Root kh-ḍ-‘.
usage: 'With submission, humility'; in calls to approach God with humility.

definition: Preposition bi- plus al-khalq "the creation". Root kh-l-q.
usage: With the creation; of God's dealings with creation.

definition: Preposition bi- with article and daraja "degree, rank". Root d-r-j.
notes: iqtana‘a bi’d-darajati’l-úlá contented himself with the first degree.

definition: Phrase bi + ad-dimá’ (plural of dam "blood"): with blood. Root d-m-w.
usage: With blood; of lands and paths reddened with the blood of martyrs.

definition: Preposition bi- with ad-dunyá: with or in the world, worldly life. Root d-n-w.
usage: The world, worldly life, as in attachment to the world (الدنیا), contrasted with the next life.
notes: Lá tashtaghil bid-dunyá = Busy not thyself with this world.

definition: bi- + adh-dhahab 'gold'. Root dh-h-b.
usage: By or with gold.

definition: Preposition bi- + article + rifq 'gentleness, kindness'. Root r-f-q.
usage: 'With gentleness', in the injunction to deal with others with kindness and forbearance.

definition: bi + az-zakát: obligatory alms, a purifying levy on property. Root z-k-w.
usage: Zakát, obligatory alms, which the Aqdas retains with new provisions.

definition: Preposition bi + plural of sá‘a 'hour; timepiece, clock'. Root s-w-‘.
usage: Hours, also clocks or timepieces, as in Aqdas counsel on the reckoning of time.

definition: Preposition bi- with as-sittah 'the six'. Root s-d-s.
usage: In the Aqdas الاقرار بالستة التی ارتفعت بهذا الالف القائمة 'acknowledging the "Six" raised up by this "Upright Alif"'.

definition: Preposition bi + as-sitr 'veil, covering, concealment'. Root s-t-r.
Preposition bi- with sha‘r 'hair'. Root sh-‘-r.
usage: Aqdas law on not shaving the head: زیّنها اللّه بالشّعر 'God hath adorned it with hair'.

definition: Preposition bi and shiyá' 'common report, public knowledge'. Root sh-y-‘.
Preposition bi with article and ṣidq: with truthfulness, sincerity. Root ṣ-d-q.
Preposition بـ with صدید 'pus, festering matter'. Root ṣ-d-d.
usage: In the Aqdas, of opium-like intoxicants compared to the drink of hell, with الغسلین.

definition: Preposition ب with plural of ṣúra: with pictures, images. Root ṣ-w-r.
usage: Aqdas: adorn Houses of Worship لا بالصور و الامثال 'not with images and effigies'.

definition: bi "with" plus the letter name Ṭá (ط, value 9).
Preposition bi- with aṭ-ṭahárah 'purity, ritual cleanness'. Root ṭ-h-r.
Bi- plus al-‘ibára, expression, wording: by words, in expression. Root ‘-b-r.
usage: In the Aqdas worlds لا تعبّر بالعبارة و لا تشار بالاشارة 'which cannot be expressed in words nor indicated by allusion'.

definition: Preposition bi- plus dual of ‘adl 'just (witness)': by two just witnesses. Root ‘-d-l.
usage: In the Aqdas, a husband's death confirmed by report or by two just witnesses.

definition: Preposition bi- + al-‘urwa 'handle, loop, firm hold'. Root ‘-r-w.
usage: Qur'anic العروة الوثقی 'the firm handle', in the Aqdas تمسّکوا بالعروة الوثقی 'Lay hold on the most firm Handle'.

definition: Bi- plus ‘izz 'might, glory'. Root ‘-z-z.
usage: In the Aqdas کذلک کان الأمر بالعزّ مسطوراً 'thus hath it been inscribed by the Pen of glory'.

definition: bi- with al-‘izza: with honour, dignity, glory. Root ‘-z-z.
usage: E.g. بالعزة و الاعتزاز 'with honour and dignity'.

definition: Active participle feminine: reaching, complete, abundant. Root b-l-gh.
usage: In the Hidden Words جعلت النّعمة علیک بالغة 'made My bounty full unto thee'.

definition: Bi "with" + al-ghamám "the clouds". Root gh-m-m.
usage: Qur'an 25:25 in the Íqán: یوم تشقّق السّماء بالغمام 'the day when the heaven shall be rent asunder with the clouds'.

definition: Feminine active participle of balagha 'to reach': consummate, perfect, far-reaching. Root b-l-gh.
usage: حکمت بالغه 'consummate wisdom' (from Qur'an 54:5 حکمة بالغة).
notes: Written with ٴ for the izáfih.

definition: Plural active participle: mature, accomplished, consummate. Root b-l-gh.
usage: Íqán: فقهای بالغین 'consummate jurists'.

definition: Bi- with al-far': to or by the branch, offshoot. Root f-r-‘.
bi- plus al-faḍl 'bounty, grace, favour'. Root f-ḍ-l.
usage: 'With bounty'; of God's grace, as in God deals with His servants بالفضل not by justice alone.

definition: Preposition bi- plus al-fiṭra "innate nature": by nature, instinctively. Root f-ṭ-r.
usage: By nature, instinctively; fiṭra is innate God-given nature.

definition: Preposition bi- with article and lisán "tongue, language". Root l-s-n.
Phrase bi + al-ma‘rúf: what is known to be good, decency, right conduct. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: According to what is right and seemly, as in the Qur'anic الامر بالمعروف and rulings in the Aqdas to act بالمعروف.

definition: Preposition bi- with an-nár: by or with fire. Root n-w-r.
usage: By fire, of the fire of hell or the fire of love.

definition: bi- + an-nawáṣí, plural of náṣiya: forelock. Root n-ṣ-y.
usage: 'By the forelocks', from Qur'án 55:41, the guilty seized by their forelocks and feet.

definition: Preposition bi- + article + hawá’ 'air'. Root h-w-y.
usage: 'By the air', of the movements of the air or breezes.

definition: bi + al-kasálah: laziness, sloth, lassitude. Root k-s-l.
usage: Lassitude, sloth; used of laziness the Writings condemn.

definition: Preposition bi + al-kaff 'palm of the hand'; bi'l-kaffi'ṣ-ṣifr 'with empty hand'. Root k-f-f.
usage: Palm, as in بالکفّ الصّفر 'with empty hands'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'by, with' plus al-yad 'the hand'. Root y-d-y.
Preposition bi + al-yawm 'the day'. Root y-w-m.
