usage: Aqdas: طوبی لمن فاز بالیوم الأوّل من شهر البهآء 'happy is he who attaineth the first day of the month of Bahá'.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with ámál, plural of amal 'hope, desire'. Root '-m-l.
usage: Worldly desires, as in آمال و آرزو 'hopes and longings'.

definition: Preposition bi 'with' and amthál 'the like of, such'. Root m-th-l.
Preposition bi with umúr, plural of amr: with or to matters, affairs. Root ’-m-r.
Preposition بـ with امورات 'affairs, matters', a double plural of amr. Root ’-m-r.
Preposition ب with plural of anmula: with the fingertips. Root n-m-l.
usage: خلقتک بأنامل القدرة 'fashioned thee with the fingers of power'.

definition: Persian bi plus anbiyá, plural of nabí: to the Prophets. Root n-b-’.
Preposition bi- with anbiyá 'prophets'; the final ی links the izáfih. Root n-b-'.
Persian bi- 'in, with' plus andak 'little, few'; باندک زمانی 'in a short time'.
Preposition bi- 'for' plus inzál with indefinite -í; apparently 'for a fleeting pleasure'. Root n-z-l.
notes: Reading and sense uncertain: inzál literally 'sending down, emission'; the authorized translation renders the phrase 'for that which perisheth'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'to, with' + insán 'human being, man'. Root ’-n-s.
Bi- 'to' plus án 'that' plus ast 'is': is to that.
bi- with anfus, plural of nafs: to or with souls; possibly anfás 'breaths'. Root n-f-s.
notes: Reading unclear: anfus 'souls' or anfás 'breaths' (در نفسی بانفس الهیه).

definition: Preposition bi- with anfus 'selves' and 'their': with themselves, in person. Root n-f-s.
usage: In the Aqdas ینصرونه بأنفسهم 'assist Him with their own selves'.

shift: Here: with detachment from all save God, a key Bahá'í virtue. Today: being cut off, interruption.
definition: Ba/bi "with" + inqiṭá‘ "detachment, severance from all save God" (form VII). Root q-ṭ-‘.
usage: Inqiṭá‘ is a key Bahá'í virtue, 'detachment'; here بانقطاع تمام 'with absolute detachment'.
notes: In modern Persian انقطاع usually means "interruption, cut-off".

definition: Preposition bi- with ahwá’, plural of hawá 'desire, passion'. Root h-w-y.
usage: لا تعتدوها باهواء انفسکم 'transgress them not at the behest of your passions'.

definition: Persian ب 'to' + او 'him' + است 'is': is unto Him.
usage: Íqán: راجع باوست 'are referable unto Him'.

definition: Bi- with awṣáf, plural of waṣf: with qualities, attributes. Root w-ṣ-f.
bi- plus awhám (plural of wahm 'fancy, illusion') plus -kum 'your'. Root w-h-m.
usage: 'With your fancies'; in warnings not to measure God's Cause by vain imaginings.

definition: Preposition bi- plus conjunction anna "that", introducing a clause (after verbs of knowing).
notes: ٴ is the source's high hamza.

definition: Preposition bi- with elative akmal "most perfect". Root k-m-l.
notes: Aqdas: build houses "in the most perfect manner".

definition: Phrase bi + áyát (plural of áya "sign, verse") + -ná "our". Root ’-y-y.
usage: With Our signs or verses; آیات means both signs and revealed verses, the chief proof of the Manifestation.

definition: Persian bi- with ayyám (plural of yawm): to or at the days. Root y-w-m.
usage: Ayyám 'days', as in ایّام الله 'the Days of God', the age of the new Revelation.

definition: bi- 'to, by' + áya 'verse, sign'. Root '-y-y.
usage: Verse, sign; آیه means both a verse of scripture and a sign of God.

definition: Preposition bi- + áyih 'verse, sign' + indefinite -’í. Root ’-y-y.
usage: 'To a verse', of a verse (آیه) of the Revelation, cited as proof.
notes: Spelled ه‌ئی in the source.

definition: bi + aywán (portico, palace hall, court).
usage: Hall, court; used of the court of a palace.

definition: Preposition bá 'with' + yagánih 'the One, unique; kin': one familiar with the One.
usage: One familiar with the Unique One; also kin or intimate, set against بیگانه 'stranger'.
notes: Wordplay with bígánih 'stranger'; the authorized rendering of this phrase is not certain to me.

definition: Preposition bi- 'to' plus bád 'wind'; bi-bád dádan 'to cast to the winds, squander'.
Persian bi- 'with, by' + bád 'wind' + plural -há.
usage: Persian Hidden Words: ببادهای مخالف نفس و هوی 'with the contrary winds of self and passion'.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with báṭin 'inner, inward part': inwardly. Root b-ṭ-n.
usage: Contrasted with ظاهر 'outward'.

definition: Preposition bi 'with' and badá'i' 'wonders, wondrous things'. Root b-d-‘.
usage: Wondrous melodies or words of the Revelation.

definition: Preposition bi with birkih: with a pool, pond. Root b-r-k.
usage: In the Íqán content with a brackish pool, ببرکهٔ شور.

definition: Persian بـ with بزرگی 'greatness, grandeur'.
Preposition ب with bishára: with the good news. Root b-sh-r.
usage: ببشارة النور ابشّرک 'I give thee the glad tidings of light'.

definition: Persian bi plus baṣar "sight, eye" with indefinite -í: with an eye, with a sight. Root b-ṣ-r.
Preposition bi- with bay‘ah 'oath of allegiance' and -hi 'his'. Root b-y-‘.
Present subjunctive 3rd person plural of dídan 'to see': (that, if) they see.
Preposition bi- plus tajallí 'manifestation, effulgence, revelation'. Root j-l-w.
usage: Tajallí is the shining forth of God's light upon creation and in the Manifestations.

definition: Preposition bi- + taḥrír 'writing, composing; freeing'. Root ḥ-r-r.
Bi- plus taḥqíq 'verification': truly, verily; used in translating Arabic qad. Root ḥ-q-q.
bi- with tarannumát 'melodies, chantings'. Root r-n-m.
usage: Aqdas: remember God بترنمات المقربین 'with the melodies of the favoured ones'.

definition: Preposition bi- with taṣríḥ 'declaring plainly': explicitly. Root ṣ-r-ḥ.
usage: In بتصریح تمام 'in clear terms'.

definition: Ba/bi "with" + taghanniyát "songs, warblings" (plural of the form V verbal noun taghanní). Root gh-n-y.
usage: Íqán: بتغنّیات خوش عراقی 'with sweet melodies of ‘Iráq'.

definition: Preposition bi with talvíḥát, plural of talvíḥ 'hint, allusion'. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: تلویحات عجیبه و اشارات غریبه 'wondrous allusions and strange intimations'.

definition: Preposition ب with تماثیل 'images, statues' (plural of تمثال) and indefinite/relative ی. Root m-th-l.
usage: Íqán: معتکف بودند بتماثیلی 'they clung to images'.

definition: Bi- with tamám and 'his/its': entirely, in full. Root t-m-m.
bi- plus tamám 'entirety' plus -him 'them': all of them, in their entirety. Root t-m-m.
usage: 'All of them, entirely'.

definition: Verb: subjunctive 3rd plural of tavánistan "to be able".
usage: They could; ordinary verb form.

definition: Preposition bi- with tavajjuh "turning toward, attention" (form V verbal noun). Root w-j-h.
usage: Turning toward or attention, as in توجه بالله 'turning to God' in prayer.

definition: Phrase bi + tawḥíd "affirming the oneness of God". Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: توحید, affirming God's oneness, is the foundation of faith; in the Íqán it includes the oneness of the Manifestations.

definition: Persian bi- with jám: with or to a cup, goblet.
usage: Jám 'cup', in the image of the cup of divine wine or knowledge.

definition: bi- 'to' + já 'place' + indefinite -í; kár bijá’í kashíd 'it came to such a pass'.
notes: Written بجائی.

definition: Preposition bi- + jidál 'dispute, contention'. Root j-d-l.
usage: 'In contention', in the prohibition of disputation and contention about religion.

definition: bi + jadhvih (ember, burning brand) + indefinite -í: with an ember. Root j-dh-w.
usage: With an ember; a spark of the fire of divine love.
notes: Normalized from بجذوه‌ئی.

definition: Preposition bi + jur’at 'courage, boldness'. Root j-r-’.
Preposition bi- plus jazá’ 'recompense, requital': as recompense for. Root j-z-y.
Persian bi- 'to' + ju‘al 'dung-beetle' + plural -há; a figure for base, ignoble men.
notes: Íqán: تمسّک بجعلهای ظلمانی 'clung to beetles of darkness'; could instead be ja‘l 'fabrication'.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with jins 'kind, genus, sort'. Root j-n-s.
Preposition bi and javáhir, plural of jawhar 'gem, essence'. Root j-w-h-r.
usage: Gems of knowledge and wisdom, as جواهر علم.

definition: Proper noun: Biḥáru'l-Anwár, 'Oceans of Lights', Majlisí's great collection of Shí‘ih traditions.
Persian بـ with حال 'state, present time'; تا بحال 'until now'.
Preposition ب with ḥubb: to, by or with love. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: نظر بحب ریاست 'out of love of leadership'.

definition: bi plus ḥubb "love" with suffix "my": (with/unto) My love. Root ḥ-b-b.
Adjective (feminine): pure, sheer, absolute. Root b-ḥ-t.
Arabic baḥt 'pure, sheer, absolute' with the Persian copula -and: they are utterly (lost, nonexistent). Root b-ḥ-t.
usage: In the Íqán معدوم صرف و مفقود بحت 'utter nothingness', paired with صرف.

definition: Adjective: pure, unmixed, absolute. Root b-ḥ-t.
usage: In هویّهٔ بحته 'the pure Essence'.

definition: Preposition bi- + ḥujjat 'proof, argument, testimony'. Root ḥ-j-j.
usage: حجّت in the Íqán is the proof of a Manifestation, chiefly His revealed verses.

definition: Bi- plus ḥujjat 'proof, testimony' with indefinite -í. Root ḥ-j-j.
Phrase: to such a degree; تا بحدی که 'to such an extent that'. Root ḥ-d-d.
Preposition bi- with ḥadíth: tradition, report of the Prophet or Imáms. Root ḥ-d-th.
usage: In the Íqán Bahá'u'lláh cites many traditions (احادیث), as in حدیث مشهور 'the well-known tradition'.

definition: Ba/bi "to" + ḥadíqa "garden, walled orchard". Root ḥ-d-q.
usage: Metaphorical, as in حدیقه عرفان 'the garden of divine knowledge'.

definition: Preposition bi 'to' with ḥaram 'sanctuary, sacred precinct'. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: حرم جانان 'the sanctuary of the Beloved'.

definition: Arabic بحر 'sea, ocean' with the Persian plural -há and izáfih. Root b-ḥ-r.
usage: Íqán: بحرهای حکمت 'oceans of wisdom'.

definition: Bi- with ḥaraka: by a movement, motion. Root ḥ-r-k.
Noun baḥr 'sea, ocean' plus indefinite -í: an ocean. Root b-ḥ-r.
usage: 'An ocean'; the ocean is a frequent image of divine knowledge and bounty.

definition: Preposition bi- plus ḥusn "beauty, excellence"; bi-ḥusni’l-alḥán "in the most melodious of tones". Root ḥ-s-n.
usage: With beauty; in bi-ḥusni'l-alḥán 'in the most melodious of tones', of chanting verses.

definition: Preposition bi- with ḥaqárat "contempt, lowliness": disdainfully. Root ḥ-q-r.
usage: 'With contempt', of how the people regarded the Manifestations.

definition: Phrase bi + ḥamd "praise" + -hi "his": with his praise. Root ḥ-m-d.
usage: In the formula سبحان الله وبحمده 'glorified be God, and with His praise'.

definition: Preposition bi- with ḥawl (might, power) and 3rd masc. suffix: by His might. Root ḥ-w-l.
usage: 'By His might', as in the formula بحوله وقوته 'by His might and power'.

definition: bi- + ḥaythu 'where': in such a way that, so that. Root ḥ-y-th.
Preposition bi- + khátam 'seal, signet ring'. Root kh-t-m.
usage: 'With the seal', as in خاتم النبیّین 'Seal of the Prophets', discussed in the Íqán.

definition: bi (emphatic after laysa) + khárij (going out, coming forth). Root kh-r-j.
usage: Coming forth; used in negative sentences with لیس.
notes: Qur'án 6:122.

definition: Preposition bi + khákdán 'dust-heap, the earthly world' (khák 'dust' + -dán 'place').
usage: The dust-heap, the earthly world, as in Hidden Words' contrast of the heavenly realm with the khákdán.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with' plus khabar 'news, report, tidings'. Root kh-b-r.
Present subjunctive 2nd singular of kharáshídan, 'to scratch, to scrape'.
Persian noun bakhshish 'gift, bounty, forgiveness', plural with -há: bounties.
notes: The final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Noun bakhshish 'gift, bounty, forgiveness' with indefinite -í.
Past participle of bakhshídan: given, bestowed; with auxiliary 'has given'.
Preposition بـ with خصال 'qualities, traits' and 'my'. Root kh-ṣ-l.
usage: In the Persian Hidden Words: فهنیئاً لمن تزیّن بخصالی 'well is it with him who is adorned with My virtues'.

definition: Adverbial phrase: especially, particularly. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
bi plus khaṭa’ "sin, error". Root kh-ṭ-’.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words لا تنفّس بخطإ احد "Breathe not the sins of others".
notes: Written بخطإ.

definition: Preposition bi- with khamr 'wine'. Root kh-m-r.
usage: In the Writings wine is often figurative, as in خمر کدرهٔ فانیه 'the turbid wine of mortality'.

definition: Imperative 2nd person plural of khándan 'to read, recite; to call': call ye, read ye.
usage: In the Íqán, translating Qur'an 2:23: بخوانید شهدای خود را 'call upon your witnesses'.
notes: The و of خوا is silent.

definition: Preposition bi- plus khváhish 'wish, request'.
Subjunctive 1st singular of khástan 'to want, wish': (if) I wish.
Present subjunctive of khwástan 'to want, seek': (if) we want.
bi- with khayál 'thought, image' and -ash: to his image or thought. Root kh-y-l.
Preposition bi- with khayál 'fancy, imagination' and the indefinite -í: by some fancy. Root kh-y-l.
Ba/bi "to" + khiyám "tents, pavilions" (plural of khayma). Root kh-y-m.
usage: Íqán: بخیام قرب و وصال 'to the tabernacle of nearness and reunion'.

definition: Preposition bi 'to' with dár 'house, abode'. Root d-w-r.
usage: دار السلام 'the Abode of Peace', also a name of Baghdád.

definition: Persian ب 'to' + دامن 'skirt, hem': to the hem (of).
usage: HW: دستت بدامن یار نرسید 'thy hand reached not the hem of the Friend's robe'.

definition: Imperative of dánistan, to know: know thou!
Preposition bi- with án, written bidán: to that, by that.
Present subjunctive, third person plural, of dánistan 'to know': (that) they know.
usage: '(That) they know'; in purpose clauses, as in that people may know the truth.

definition: Verb: subjunctive 1st plural of dánistan "to know".
usage: We know; ordinary verb form.

definition: Verb dar ámadan "to come out", subjunctive 2nd singular with bi-: that thou come forth.
usage: 'That thou come forth', in addresses calling the soul to come out of the prison of self.

definition: Adverbial phrase (bi + durustí "correctness"): truly, verily; renders Arabic inna.
usage: Truly, verily; Persian rendering of Arabic إنّ, opening solemn statements.

definition: Persian bi- with dirham (silver coin) and indefinite -í: for a single coin, for a trifle.
usage: For a single coin, i.e. a trifle, of selling the Beloved or faith for a paltry price.

definition: bi- 'with' + dasthá 'hands' (plural of dast) + izáfih.
Preposition bi- 'with, to' + dil 'heart'.
usage: 'With the heart', as in جان بدل 'with heart and soul'.
notes: ján bi-dil: life with the heart.

definition: Noun: substitute, exchange, equivalent. Root b-d-l.
usage: 'Substitute, exchange', as in بدل 'in exchange for', of the transient world in place of the eternal.

definition: bi + dalá'il (plural of dalíl): proofs, evidences. Root d-l-l.
usage: By proofs; of the proofs of a Manifestation's truth.

definition: Preposition bi + dalá’il (plural of dalíl 'proof, argument') with indefinite -í. Root d-l-l.
usage: Proofs and arguments, often of the truth of the Manifestation.

definition: Preposition bi- 'to, by' plus dalíl 'proof, evidence'. Root d-l-l.
usage: Often paired as دلیل و برهان 'proof and testimony'.

definition: Preposition bi + dimá’ 'blood', plural of dam, + -him 'their'. Root d-m-y.
usage: In a tradition in the Íqán: تصبغ الأرض بدمائهم 'the earth shall be dyed with their blood'.

definition: Noun badan 'body' with -hu: his body. Root b-d-n.
Preposition bi 'with' and duhn 'oil'. Root d-h-n.
usage: Image of the lamp of the spirit kindled with the oil of wisdom.

definition: Verb, present subjunctive 2nd sing. of dádan 'to give'; also 'attribute, ascribe'.
Persian بـ with دود 'smoke' and indefinite -í.
Adjective: evil-doing; (of a woman) unchaste. Persian.
usage: Persian rendering of Qur'an 19:28 ما کانت امّک بغیّاً.

definition: Persian bad "bad, wicked" with indefinite -í: a bad (man); also badí "evil, wickedness".
Adjective badí‘ 'wondrous, new' with -ash 'its'. Root b-d-‘.
Feminine of badí‘: new, wondrous, unprecedented; the hamza sign marks the izáfih. Root b-d-‘.
usage: In the Hidden Words اثمار بدیعهٴ منیعه 'wondrous and goodly fruits'; بدیع also names the Badí‘ calendar.
notes: The final ٴ is the written izáfih.

definition: Adjective (feminine form in agreement): new, unprecedented, wondrous. Root b-d-‘.
usage: As in حیات بدیعه 'a new life'.

definition: Literary contraction of bi-ín 'to this, by this, with this'.
Bi- plus dhát 'essence, self' with -hi: by himself, self-subsistent.
usage: In the Hidden Words یا ابن من قام بذاته 'O Son of Him that stood by His own Entity'.

definition: bi- with dharra 'atom, mote' and indefinite -í: with a particle, a tiny amount. Root dh-r-r.
Preposition bi- with dhanb 'sin' and 'their': for their sin. Root dh-n-b.
usage: In کذلک اخذهم اللّه بذنبهم 'thus God seized them for their sins'.

definition: Present 2sg of برآوردن "to raise, bring forth"; with خروش "to raise a cry".
usage: Íqán: اگر صدهزار خروش برآری 'though thou raise a hundred thousand cries'.
notes: Not Arabic barárí "deserts".

definition: Imperative plural of برآوردن 'to bring out, take off'.
usage: جامهٔ غرور را از تن برآرید 'divest yourselves of the robe of vainglory'.

definition: Persian verb برافراختن 'raise, hoist', past: they raised.
usage: Íqán: علم فساد برافراختند 'raised the standard of sedition'.

definition: Present perfect of bar-afrákhtan: they have raised, hoisted.
Past tense, first person plural, of bar-afrákhtan 'to raise, pitch, set up'.
usage: 'We raised'; of God raising a banner or tabernacle, as in خیمه برافراختیم.

definition: Verb: past 3rd plural of bar-afráshtan "to raise, hoist (a banner)".
usage: Raised, hoisted; of raising banners of rebellion or of guidance.

definition: Past participle of bar-afrúkhtan "to kindle, light up", with izáfih sign: kindled (by).
usage: Kindled or lit, often of the fire of love kindled in the heart.
notes: HW: "The lamp of thy heart is lighted by the hand of My power".

definition: Verb, imperative 2nd person singular of bar-afrúkhtan: kindle, light up.
usage: Kindle; in the Persian Hidden Words, of kindling the lamp of the heart or the fire of love.

definition: Present subjunctive 2nd sing. of barafrúkhtan: (that) you kindle, light up.
usage: From برافروختن 'to kindle'; of kindling the lamp of the heart or fire of love.

definition: Imperative 2nd pl. of bar-afrúkhtan: light up, kindle.
usage: Kindle, light up; e.g. kindle the flame of love.

definition: Verb, past 3rd person singular of bar-ámadan 'to come forth, rise'.
usage: 'Came forth, rose', of the sun rising or a cry going up.

definition: Past 3rd plural of bar-ámadan (to rise, come up); "dar ṣadad-i ... bar-ámadan" to set about.
usage: They arose; in در صدد ... برآمدند "they set about".

definition: Imperative singular of rándan 'to drive, drive away, expel'.
Subjunctive of rándan 'to drive, drive away': that he drive away.
Preposition bi + ráyát 'banners, standards', plural of ráya.
usage: Aqdas: جنود العرفان برایات البیان 'the hosts of divine knowledge with the banners of utterance'.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with rá'iḥih 'fragrance, scent'. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: Spiritual fragrance, as in روائح قدس 'holy fragrances'.

definition: Subjunctive of bar-ámadan 'to come forth, rise up'.
Preposition bi with rabb and 2nd pl. suffix: by your Lord. Root r-b-b.
Adjective: higher, superior, beyond.
Noun: superiority, preeminence, precedence. Persian.
usage: برتری نجستم 'sought no preeminence'.

definition: Subjunctive of برخاستن "to rise, arise": (that) they rise up.
Present subjunctive of برداشتن 'to lift, remove': 'that I remove'.
Present subjunctive 2nd person singular of bar-dáshtan 'to take up, lift, obtain': (that) thou take, obtain.
usage: In the Hidden Words قسمت بیزوال برداری 'that thou mayest obtain an imperishable share'.

definition: Verb, imperative 2nd plural of bardáshtan 'to lift, remove'; dil bardáshtan 'to detach one's heart'.
usage: In the Hidden Words از دنیا دل بردارید 'detach your hearts from the world'.

definition: Past 3rd singular of bar-dáshtan 'to lift, take up'; with نصیب 'to receive a share'.
Past of bar-dáshtan 'to lift, remove': they removed.
Past participle of برداشتن 'to lift, pick up': having taken up.
Adjective: patient, forbearing, long-suffering.
notes: Written بردبار; a Persian compound of burd and bár.

definition: Forbearance, patience, long-suffering (from بردبار "patient").
usage: HW: بردباری من شما را جری نمود 'My forbearance hath emboldened you'.

definition: Past 1st person singular of بردن 'to carry'; بسر بردم 'I spent (time)'.
Persian verb بردمیدن 'dawn, break forth', subjunctive: that it dawn.
usage: HW: صبح نورانی از افق قدس صمدانی بردمد 'the luminous morn breaketh from the horizon'.

definition: Past 3pl of burdan; with tashríf, a respectful 'he went'.
Present subjunctive, third person singular, of rasándan 'to cause to reach, convey': (that) he convey.
usage: '(That) he convey'; of conveying a message or bringing someone to the goal.

definition: Preposition bi- plus rasúl "messenger, apostle" plus -him "their"; hamma bi- "to plot against". Root r-s-l.
usage: Against their Messenger; in hammat kullu ummatin bi-rasúlihim 'every nation plotted against its Messenger'.

definition: Preposition bi- with rasúl "messenger" and indefinite -í: in a messenger. Root r-s-l.
usage: 'In a messenger'; رسول 'Messenger' is the title of a Manifestation, especially Muhammad.

definition: Phrase bi + riḍá’ "consent, good pleasure": by consent. Root r-ḍ-w.
usage: رضاء is consent or good pleasure, especially God's; in the Aqdas also the consent of parties, as in marriage.

definition: Persian bi- with riḍá and izáfih: to the good pleasure (of). Root r-ḍ-w.
usage: To God's good pleasure, as in برضای الهی 'to the good pleasure of God'.

definition: bi- 'to' + riḍá 'good pleasure' + -yash 'his'; riḍá bi-riḍáyash dádan 'to be content with His will'.
usage: His good pleasure; contentment with God's will (رضا).

definition: Preposition bi- + riḍván 'paradise; good pleasure' + -ash 'his'. Root r-ḍ-w.
usage: 'To His paradise', from رضوان 'paradise, good pleasure', which also names the Garden of Riḍván and the Festival of Riḍván.

definition: bi + rafíq (companion); "rafíq-i a‘lá" the Supreme Companion, God. Root r-f-q.
usage: Companion; رفیق اعلی "the Supreme Companion", said of a soul's ascent to God at death.

definition: Nisba adjective: of Baraqán near Qazvín; surname of Mullá ‘Alíy-i-Baraqání.
usage: Surname of Mullá ‘Alíy-i-Baraqání, mentioned in the Kitáb-i-Íqán among the learned of the age.

definition: Proper noun: Berlin, capital of Prussia and the German Empire.
usage: In the Aqdas یا ملک برلین 'O King of Berlin', addressed to William I.

definition: Prohibitive imperative of bar-ávardan, 'to bring up, to raise': do not raise.
usage: Persian Hidden Words: عویل برمیار 'raise not the voice of lamentation'.

definition: Persian compound verb, 3rd plural present of bar-ámadan 'to rise, come forth; set out to'.
notes: Exact sense depends on the wider sentence.

definition: Negative present of bar-dáshtan 'to lift, raise'.
Verb, negative present perfect 3rd pl. of bardáshtan 'to lift, take up'.
notes: Written as one word in the source (برنداشته‌اند).

definition: Adjective (present participle of بریدن): cutting, sharp.
Preposition ب with رنگ 'colour': in the colour of; برنگ ... درآمدن 'to take on the hue of'. Persian.
usage: برنگ من درآیند 'who take on My colour'.

definition: Negative imperative of برگردیدن/برگشتن "to return": return not.
Negative present of برآوردن 'to bring up, draw (breath)'.
Bi- 'with' plus rúḥ 'spirit' plus -í 'my': with My spirit. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words آنس بروحی 'commune with My spirit'.

definition: Adjective, plural of barí’: free, innocent, quit of. Root b-r-’.
usage: In the Aqdas نحن برآء منه 'We are clear of him'.
notes: Written with high hamza (برٴآء).

definition: Adverb: upright, set up; برپا نمودن 'to raise, stir up'.
Present subjunctive of bar-parídan 'to fly up': (that) thou soar.
Past of برکشیدن 'to draw out, raise': he drew forth (a cry).
notes: Of Noah raising his plea from the depths of his soul.

definition: Preposition bi- with rukn 'pillar, letter-support' and 'its'.
usage: In the Aqdas قبل ان یقترن الکاف برکنها النّون 'ere the letters B and E were joined and knit together', of the creative word کن 'Be'.
notes: The kāf joins its 'pillar', the nún, to make کن.

definition: Past participle of برگزیدن "to choose, select": chosen, elect.
usage: Of God choosing a Messenger from among His servants.

definition: Present subjunctive of برگزیدن 'to choose, select'.
usage: Of God choosing a soul for the guidance of mankind.

definition: Persian verb برگرفتن 'take up', imperative: take up.
usage: HW: کؤوس باقیه برگیر 'take the cups of immortality'.

definition: Bi- with riyásat: leadership, chieftainship. Root r-’-s.
Present subjunctive or imperative, second person plural, of burdan 'to carry, take'; búy-í burdan 'to catch a scent'.
usage: In بوی ... برید 'catch a scent', of perceiving the fragrance of God's Cause.

definition: Verb: past participle of burídan "to cut"; with auxiliary omitted, "has cut".
usage: Cut, cut down; ordinary verb form.

definition: Preposition bi- with zujáj "glass": with the glass (chimney of a lamp). Root z-j-j.
usage: Glass, alluding to the Qur'anic Light Verse: the lamp within a glass.
notes: Íqán: "shield it within the globe of understanding".

definition: Verb, present subjunctive 3rd person singular of zudúdan: polishes away, removes (rust).
usage: To polish away rust, as from the mirror of the heart, a recurring image in the Writings.

definition: Plural of buzurg: great ones, elders, notables, leaders.
usage: The great ones or leaders, often the religious and civil leaders who opposed the Manifestation.

definition: Comparative of buzurg 'great': greater.
Adjective buzurg 'great, big' + -ast 'is'.
usage: 'Is great', of the greatness of God's Cause or of a matter.

definition: bi + zukám (head cold, catarrh); here inability to perceive spiritual fragrance.
usage: A head cold; figuratively the inability to perceive the fragrance of the Revelation.

definition: Preposition bi + sáḥir 'sorcerer, magician' + indefinite -í. Root s-ḥ-r.
usage: Sorcerer, the charge the opponents laid on every Prophet, as recounted in the Kitáb-i-Íqán.

definition: Noun bisáṭ 'carpet, spread; court, presence' with indefinite -í. Root b-s-ṭ.
usage: بساط is the spread or court of a king; in the Writings بساط قرب 'the court of nearness'.
notes: Authorized rendering in this Hidden Word not verified.

definition: Persian bi- 'in' + sá‘at 'hour' + indefinite -í: in an hour, in a moment. Root s-w-‘.
Persian preposition bi- with sabb 'reviling, cursing'. Root s-b-b.
usage: Paired with لعن 'cursing'.

definition: Preposition bi and subuḥát 'glories, veils (of glory)'. Root s-b-ḥ.
usage: In سبحات الجلال 'the veils of glory', the barriers of learning and fancy that hinder recognition.

definition: Noun: garden, orchard; in poetry a pleasure-garden of flowers.
Noun: bed, couch.
Verb, present perfect of بستن: you have tied, bound. Persian.
usage: دل محکم بسته‌اید 'ye have firmly set your hearts'.
notes: Written بسته‌اید; joiner removed.

definition: Persian bi plus sidrih "lote-tree": to the Lote-Tree, the Divine Tree beyond which none may pass.
usage: سدرهٴ منتهی "the Sadratu’l-Muntahá", the Tree beyond which there is no passing (Qur'an 53:14), a symbol of the Manifestation.
notes: ٴ marks the izáfih.

definition: Preposition bi- with سر 'end, head', in بسر بردن 'to spend (time)'.
Bi- 'with, of' plus siráj 'lamp': with, of the lamp. Root s-r-j.
usage: In the Íqán یبشّرکم بسراج الله 'giveth you the glad tidings of the Lamp of God'.

definition: Verb, 3rd singular present subjunctive of saráyídan 'to sing, chant'.
Preposition bi- + surúr 'joy, gladness'. Root s-r-r.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: افرح بسرور قلبک 'Rejoice in the gladness of thine heart'.

definition: Of Bisṭám; here Mullá ‘Alí Bisṭámí, a Letter of the Living.
bi- with Saqar, a Qur'anic name of Hell: in hell-fire. Root s-q-r.
Preposition bi- with sulṭán 'power, sovereignty' and 'His'. Root s-l-ṭ.
usage: In یفعل بسلطانه کیف اراد 'doeth through His sovereignty as He willeth'.

definition: Bi "in" + ism "name" + -hi "his": in His Name; a heading formula. Root s-m-w.
usage: Opening of the Aqdas: بسمه الحاکم علی ما کان و ما یکون 'In the name of Him Who is the supreme Ruler over all that hath been and all that is to be'.

definition: Preposition bi with سه 'three'.
Preposition ب with سؤال 'question'. Root s-’-l.
Past of súkhtan with prefix bi-: burned.
bi- plus súrah 'chapter of the Qur'an' in the indefinite genitive.
usage: 'A surah'; in the Qur'anic challenge to produce a surah like it, cited as proof of revelation.
notes: Qur'an 2:23 'produce a Súrah like it'.

definition: Preposition bi- plus símá "countenance, distinguishing mark". Root s-w-m.
usage: By the countenance; símá 'mark, countenance', in the Qur'anic 'known by their marks'.

definition: Preposition bi- with símá "mark, sign on the face" and -hum: by their mark. Root s-w-m.
usage: 'By their mark', the Qur'anic سیماهم 'their mark' on the faces of the faithful or the guilty.
notes: Qur'an 55:41.

definition: Noun: good news, glad tidings. Root b-sh-r.
usage: Glad tidings; the good news of God's Day, and the title of Bahá'u'lláh's Tablet of Glad-Tidings (لوح بشارات).
notes: Accusative bisháratan in context.

definition: Persian bi- with sha'n (rank, standing, affair): to the station or standing of. Root sh-'-n.
usage: Sha'n 'station, rank, affair'; of the standing or station of a soul.

definition: bi- + shubha 'doubt, misgiving'. Root sh-b-h.
usage: Doubt, misgiving; the Íqán sets out to dispel such doubts.

definition: Noun bashar 'human being, mortal', indefinite accusative. Root b-sh-r.
usage: 'A mortal', from the Qur'anic objection that the Prophet is only a human being (بشراً مثلنا).

definition: bi + sharáfat (nobility, honour, excellence). Root sh-r-f.
usage: By nobility, honour; of man's station and nobility.

definition: Adjective from bashar 'mankind': human. Root b-sh-r.
usage: Human, as in نفوس بشری 'human souls' and set against divine.
notes: Not Arabic bushrá 'glad tidings', spelled the same.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with' plus sharí‘at 'religious law, dispensation'. Root sh-r-‘.
usage: شریعت is the law or dispensation of a Prophet, e.g. شریعت فرقان 'the Dispensation of the Qur'an'.

definition: Persian bi- 'to' + shu‘úr 'awareness, perception'. Root sh-‘-r.
usage: بشعور آمدن 'to come to one's senses'.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with shaqávat 'wretchedness, damnation'. Root sh-q-w.
usage: Opposed to سعادت 'felicity', as spiritual ruin.

definition: Subjunctive of shinákhtan 'to know, recognize', third person plural.
Verb, present subjunctive 1st pl. of shinákhtan 'to know, recognize'.
Persian بـ with شهر 'city' and indefinite -í.
Preposition ب with shahvat 'lust, desire' and indefinite ی: for a passing desire. Root sh-h-w.
usage: شاهنشهی فردوس را بشهوتی از دست مده 'barter not the sovereignty of paradise for a fleeting desire'.

definition: Subjunctive of شستن "to wash": (that) he wash, cleanse.
notes: Could also be read bishú’íd "wash ye" (2pl imperative); context requires 3sg.

definition: Preposition bi- with شکر shakar 'sugar'.
notes: آلوده بشکر 'smeared with sugar'.

definition: Preposition bi- with shukr 'gratitude, thanksgiving'. Root sh-k-r.
Present subjunctive 3rd person singular of shikuftan 'to blossom, bloom': (that) it may blossom.
Verb, imperative 2nd singular of shikastan 'to break'.
usage: In the Hidden Words قفس بشکن 'break thy cage'.

definition: Preposition bi- + shay’ 'thing, anything'. Root sh-y-’.
notes: Search form of بشئ.

definition: Bearer of good news, herald. Root b-sh-r.
usage: In the Íqán بشیر معنوی 'the mystic Herald'.

definition: bi- with ṣáḥibán 'owners, possessors': to those possessing. Root ṣ-ḥ-b.
Noun, plural of baṣírah: insights, inner perceptions. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: In the Aqdas الّذین اوتوا بصآئر من اللّه 'They whom God hath endued with insight'.
notes: Written بصآئر in the source.

definition: Ba/bi "with" + ṣabr "patience, endurance". Root ṣ-b-r.
usage: In the Íqán's passage on the true seeker: بصبر و اصطبار دل بندد 'with patience and resignation'.

definition: Preposition bi with صد هزار 'a hundred thousand'.
Preposition ب with صراط 'path, way'. Root ṣ-r-ṭ.
usage: Íqán: بصراط حقّ الیقین 'upon the path of absolute certitude'.

definition: Bi- with ṣirf (pure, mere): through sheer, by mere. Root ṣ-r-f.
Noun baṣar 'sight, eyesight' plus -hi 'his'. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: 'His sight'; of inner and outer vision, as in clearing one's sight to see the truth.

definition: Noun baṣar "sight, eye" plus -ka "thy". Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: Thine eye; of spiritual sight, as in 'cleanse thine eye'.

definition: Preposition bi- with ṣifát (plural of ṣifa): qualities, attributes. Root w-ṣ-f.
usage: Attributes, as in اسماء و صفات 'the names and attributes' of God.

definition: Phrase bi + ṣafá "purity, clearness". Root ṣ-f-w.
usage: Purity and clearness, of the heart or the mirror of the soul.
notes: Final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Persian bi- with ṣaná'i‘, plural of ṣaná‘ah: (occupied) with crafts, trades, arts. Root ṣ-n-‘.
usage: Crafts and trades; the Aqdas makes engaging in a craft or profession obligatory.

definition: bi- 'with' + ṣúr 'trumpet' (of the Resurrection). Root ṣ-w-r.
usage: The trumpet of the Resurrection, interpreted in the Íqán as the call of the Manifestation.
notes: Here ṣúr 'trumpet', not ṣuwar 'forms'.

definition: Preposition bi- + ṣayḥih 'cry, shout, blast' + indefinite -’í. Root ṣ-y-ḥ.
usage: 'By a cry', the blast or cry (صیحه) of the Day of God that terrifies the heedless.
notes: Spelled ه‌ئی in the source.

definition: Adjective / divine name: all-seeing, perceptive, discerning. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: Divine name البصیر "the All-Seeing", often paired with السمیع.

definition: Noun baṣírat 'insight, discernment' + indefinite -í. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: Inner insight or discernment, as in چشم بصیرت 'the eye of insight'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with' plus ṣayqal 'polish, burnishing'. Root ṣ-q-l.
usage: The heart as a mirror to be burnished: قلب را بصیقل روح پاک کن.

definition: Preposition bi + ḍi‘f 'double, twofold'. Root ḍ-‘-f.
usage: Aqdas: عودوا بضعف الجزآء 'double the penalty'.
notes: Not ḍa‘f 'weakness'.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with ḍalálat 'error, straying'. Root ḍ-l-l.
usage: Opposed to هدایت 'guidance'.

definition: Preposition bi with ḍiyá' 'light, radiance' in izáfih. Root ḍ-w-'.
Proper noun: Baṭḥá, the valley of Mecca; by extension Mecca.
Preposition بـ with طرف 'glance, eye'. Root ṭ-r-f.
usage: In لو انتم بطرف الله تنظرون 'if ye behold with the eye of God'.

definition: Persian بـ with طرف 'side, direction': towards. Root ṭ-r-f.
Noun baṭn 'belly' with Persian suffix: their belly. Root b-ṭ-n.
Persian bi plus ẓunún, plural of ẓann: with, by surmises or idle fancies. Root ẓ-n-n.
Preposition bi- with ẓuhúr 'manifestation' and -shán 'their'. Root ẓ-h-r.
Persian bi- 'to' plus ‘ibád, plural of ‘abd: to the servants (of God), to people. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: عباد 'servants' denotes mankind as servants of God.

definition: Preposition bi- plus ‘ibád 'servants' with -hi 'His'. Root ‘-b-d.
Perfect 1st plural of ba‘atha 'to send, raise up (a prophet)'. Root b-‘-th.
usage: Of God's raising up a Messenger; in the Aqdas of the Báb, who announced the glad tidings of this Name.

definition: Ba‘da 'after' with dual suffix -humá: after the two of them. Root b-‘-d.
Preposition ba‘da 'after' with -hunna: after them (feminine). Root b-‘-d.
Noun bu‘d 'distance, remoteness' with 'thy'. Root b-‘-d.
usage: In the Hidden Words لا تحزن الّا فی بعدک عنّا 'Sorrow not save that thou art far from Us'.

definition: Bi + ‘adháb "torment, punishment, chastisement". Root ‘-dh-b.
usage: Qur'an 45:8 in the Íqán: فبشّره بعذاب الیم 'announce to him a grievous chastisement'.

definition: Preposition bi- with ‘udhr 'excuse'. Root ‘-dh-r.
usage: ان اعتذر بعذر حقیقی 'should he offer a genuine excuse'.

definition: Preposition ب with عروة 'handhold, loop'. Root ‘-r-w.
usage: Qur'anic: العروة الوثقی 'the sure handle'; بعروة الوثقی متمسّک شویم 'let us cling to the sure handle'.

definition: Bi- with ‘izzat: in glory, honour. Root ‘-z-z.
bi- plus Arabic ‘aṣá 'rod, staff' with izáfih -y. Root ‘-ṣ-w.
usage: 'With the rod'; the rod of Moses, symbol of the Manifestation's power.

definition: Preposition bi- plus ‘aqab "back": after, in pursuit of. Root ‘-q-b.
usage: After, in pursuit of; ordinary expression.

definition: Preposition bi- with ‘aql "intellect, reason, understanding". Root ‘-q-l.
usage: Reason or intellect, highly praised in the Writings as God's gift to man.

definition: Phrase bi + ‘ilm "knowledge" + indefinite -í: to any knowledge. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Knowledge; often in confessing no knowledge of God's mysteries, or of learning that veils from Him.

definition: Persian bi- with ‘amal (deed, action, practice): in acting upon, in practice. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: In acting upon, putting the teachings into practice, as in بعمل 'in deeds'.

definition: bi- + ‘ináyát, plural of ‘ináya: care, favour, grace. Root ‘-n-y.
usage: Favours, grace, God's loving care.

definition: Adjective: far, remote, distant. Root b-‘-d.
usage: 'Far', of remoteness from God; often in the phrase ضلالاً بعیداً 'far astray'.

definition: bi + ‘ayn (self, essence) + -há: the very same, exactly. Root ‘-y-n.
usage: The very same, exactly; in بعینها "in like manner".

definition: Preposition bi + ‘ayn 'eye' + -ka 'thy'. Root ‘-y-n.
usage: With thine eye; the Writings call to see with one's own eyes, not those of others.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with' plus ‘ayn 'eye' and -í 'My': with Mine eye. Root ‘-y-n.
Preposition bi + ‘uyúb 'faults, defects', plural of ‘ayb. Root ‘-y-b.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words: کیف نسیت عیوب نفسک و اشتغلت بعیوب عبادی 'how couldst thou forget thine own faults and busy thyself with the faults of others?'.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with ‘uyún, plural of ‘ayn 'spring; eye'. Root ‘-y-n.
usage: Springs of knowledge, as in عیون علم 'the fountains of knowledge'.

definition: Noun: hatred, enmity. Root b-gh-ḍ.
Noun baghḍá’ with indefinite -í: hatred, rancour. Root b-gh-ḍ.
Persian بـ with غفلت 'heedlessness, negligence'. Root gh-f-l.
usage: غفلت is a key vice in the Writings, the opposite of remembrance.

definition: Adjective: unchaste woman, harlot. Root b-gh-y.
usage: Qur'an 19:28 ما کانت امّک بغیّاً 'nor was thy mother unchaste'.

definition: bi plus ghayr "other" with suffix "me": with other than Me. Root gh-y-r.
Preposition bi- with ghayẓ 'rage' and -kum. Root gh-y-ẓ.
usage: Qur'an 3:119 موتوا بغیظکم 'die in your rage'.

definition: Persian bi- plus farághat 'leisure, freedom from care, release': with ease, unburdened. Root f-r-gh.
usage: In the Hidden Words بفراغت از این جسد فانی 'freed from this mortal frame'.

definition: Preposition bi- plus faraḥ 'joy, gladness'. Root f-r-ḥ.
usage: In the Aqdas افرحوا بفرح اسمی الأعظم 'rejoice with the joy of My Most Great Name'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'to' + firdaws 'paradise, garden'. Root f-r-d-s (loan).
usage: Paradise as a spiritual realm, as فردوس معانی 'the paradise of inner meanings'.

definition: Imperative of farmúdan, polite 'do, please'; with a noun forms a compound verb.
bi- with faríḍa 'obligatory duty, prayer': (engaged) in the obligatory prayer. Root f-r-ḍ.
usage: فریضهٔ ظهر 'the noon prayer'.

definition: Preposition bi- with faṣl 'separating, deciding'. Root f-ṣ-l.
usage: In the Qur'anic فصل الخطاب 'the decisive word', as in Aqdas فاز بفصل الخطاب 'attained the Decisive Utterance'.

definition: Ba/bi "with" + fiṭrat "innate nature, original disposition". Root f-ṭ-r.
usage: Íqán: بفطرت اصلیّه تدبّر 'ponder with thine innate nature'.

definition: Preposition bi- with fi‘l 'deed, act' and suffix 'his'. Root f-‘-l.
Preposition ب with فلان 'so-and-so, such-and-such'.
Bi- with fils (small coin) and indefinite -í. Root f-l-s.
bi- plus faná 'annihilation, perishing, mortality'. Root f-n-y.
usage: 'For annihilation'; فنا is mortality, and in mystic terms annihilation of self in God.

definition: Preposition bi- plus favákih, plural of fákiha "fruit". Root f-k-h.
usage: With fruits; of the fruits of paradise or of deeds.

definition: Preposition bi- with fawz "triumph, attainment, success". Root f-w-z.
usage: Attainment or triumph, as in فوز بلقاء الله 'attainment unto the presence of God'.

definition: Phrase bi + fuyúḍát (double plural of fayḍ "grace, effusion"). Root f-y-ḍ.
usage: Outpourings of divine grace, as in فیوضات الهی 'divine bounties'.

definition: Persian bi- with qá‘idih (rule, principle, base): according to the rule (of grammar). Root q-‘-d.
usage: By the rule, as in rules of grammar applied to the revealed Word in the Íqán.

definition: bi- + Qá’im 'He Who ariseth', title of the promised Mahdí. Root q-w-m.
usage: The Qá'im, the promised One of Shí'ih Islam, fulfilled in the Báb.
notes: Written بقائم.

definition: Preposition bi- + qabḍih 'grasp, handful, hold'. Root q-b-ḍ.
usage: 'In the grasp', as in بقبضهٴ قدرت 'in the grasp of power', of all things in God's hand.

definition: bi + qabúl (acceptance) + "my": upon my acceptance. Root q-b-l.
Preposition bi + qadr 'measure, amount' + -í: to such an extent, so much. Root q-d-r.
usage: To such an extent, so much.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with' plus qadam 'foot, step' and indefinite -í: with a single step. Root q-d-m.
Persian bi- 'by' + qará’in 'indications, circumstantial evidence', plural of qarína. Root q-r-n.
Preposition bi- with qurbán 'offering, sacrifice'. Root q-r-b.
usage: Qur'an 3:183: حتّی یأتینا بقربان تأکله النّار 'a sacrifice which fire shall devour'.

definition: Preposition bi 'for' and qarn 'century, age' with indefinite -í. Root q-r-n.
Preposition bi with qalb 'heart': in heart, inwardly. Root q-l-b.
Preposition بـ with قلب 'heart' and 'his'. Root q-l-b.
Preposition ب with qillat 'fewness, scarcity'. Root q-l-l.
usage: نظر بقلت یهود 'in view of the small number of the Jews'.

definition: bi plus plural of qalb: with hearts. Root q-l-b.
Preposition bi- with qalíl 'little'; بقلیل قانع 'content with little'. Root q-l-l.
Persian bi- plus qaná‘at 'contentment, being satisfied with little'. Root q-n-‘.
usage: The Hidden Words contrast حرص 'covetousness' with قناعت 'contentment'.

definition: Preposition bi- plus qawádim 'foremost wing-feathers, pinions'. Root q-d-m.
usage: In the Aqdas طیروا بقوادم الانقطاع 'soar on the wings of detachment'.

definition: Preposition bi- 'by' + quvvih 'power, strength, faculty'. Root q-w-y.
Remnant, what remains; بقیّة اللّه 'the Remnant of God', a messianic title. Root b-q-y.
usage: In the Báb's words یا بقیّة اللّه قد فدیت بکلّی لک 'O Thou Remnant of God! I have sacrificed myself wholly for Thee'.

definition: Plural of balad 'land, city' with -hu: his lands. Root b-l-d.
usage: Aqdas عمروا دیار الله و بلاده 'build ye in the lands and cities of God'.

definition: Noun balá 'calamity, trial, affliction' with izáfih. Root b-l-w.
usage: In the Writings tests and trials, as in بلای ناگهانی 'sudden calamity'; also of the sufferings of the Manifestation.

definition: Nightingales: bulbul with Persian plural -há and izáfih.
usage: A favourite mystical image for souls that sing God's praise.

definition: Noun بلبل 'nightingale' with indefinite -í.
usage: The nightingale is a symbol of the lover longing for the rose.

definition: Preposition ب with لحاظ 'glance, look'. Root l-ḥ-ẓ.
Bi- with lafẓ: in the word, expression, form. Root l-f-ẓ.
Present subjunctive, third person plural, of málídan 'to rub'; sar málídan 'to lay one's head'.
usage: In سر بمالند 'lay their heads', of humble devotion at a holy threshold.

definition: Verb: subjunctive 3rd singular of mándan "to remain, stay".
usage: Remain; ordinary verb form.

definition: Preposition bi- with muḥáriba "fighting, warfare" (form III verbal noun). Root ḥ-r-b.
usage: Warfare; the Writings forbid holy war and enjoin peace.

definition: Phrase bi + maḥbúb "beloved". Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: The Beloved, God or His Manifestation, the goal of the lover in mystical language.

definition: Persian bi- with maḥall (place) and indefinite -í: at or into a place. Root ḥ-l-l.
usage: At or into a place.

definition: bi- + proper name Muḥammad 'praised one'; summiya bi- 'was named'. Root ḥ-m-d.
usage: Muḥammad, the Prophet of Islam.
notes: Aqdas: the Shaykh named Muḥammad-qabl-i-Ḥasan.

definition: Preposition bi- + miḥakk 'touchstone, test'. Root ḥ-k-k.
usage: 'By the touchstone', of tests that separate truth from falsehood, as in محکّ امتحان 'the touchstone of trial'.

definition: bi + madad (help, aid, support). Root m-d-d.
usage: Through the aid; of divine assistance.

definition: Preposition bi + madínih 'city'. Root m-d-n.
usage: City, often the spiritual city of certitude or of God, as in مدینهٔ ایقان.

definition: Preposition bi- 'to' plus madínih 'city'. Root m-d-n.
usage: Spiritual stations as cities, e.g. مدینهٔ رضا 'the city of contentment'; in the Íqán مدینهٔ الهی 'the City of God'.

definition: Persian bi- 'to' + marátib 'ranks, stages, degrees', plural of martaba. Root r-t-b.
usage: Íqán: مراتب عین الیقین و حقّ الیقین 'the stations of the eye and the truth of certitude'.
notes: In modern Persian بمراتب also means 'by far'.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with mardum 'people'.
Preposition bi 'with' and maraḍ 'disease, illness'. Root m-r-ḍ.
Preposition bi with mustami‘: to the listener, hearer. Root s-m-‘.
Preposition بـ with مسمع 'one who makes hear'. Root s-m-‘.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse و ما انت بمسمع من فی القبور 'thou canst not make those in the graves to hear'.

definition: Preposition ب with plural of mashamm: to the organs of smell, nostrils. Root sh-m-m.
usage: رائحهٔ عطر بمشام دیگران رساند 'waft fragrance to others'.

definition: Persian bi plus musháwarih "consultation" (form III verbal noun). Root sh-w-r.
usage: In the Writings مشورت/مشاوره "consultation" is a central principle of Bahá'í administration.

definition: Preposition bi- with mashriq 'east, place of sunrise'. Root sh-r-q.
usage: In the Writings مشرق often means 'Dayspring', the source from which light dawns.

definition: Persian bi- 'to, into' plus Miṣr, Egypt (also a city): into Egypt.
usage: In the Íqán مصر ایقان 'the Egypt of certitude', alluding to the story of Joseph.

definition: Preposition bi- plus maṣlaḥat 'interest, advantage, expedience'. Root ṣ-l-ḥ.
Preposition bi- + maṭáli‘, plural of maṭla‘ 'rising-place, dawning-point'. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: The Manifestations as daysprings of God's light, as in مطالع قدسیّه 'the holy Daysprings'; مطلع الأمر 'the Dayspring of the Cause'.

definition: Bi- plus maṭla‘ 'place of rising'. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: In کفروا بمطلع الآیات 'disbelieved in the Dayspring of the signs'; maṭla‘ is a title of the Manifestation.

definition: bi- with maṭlúb 'object sought, goal': to the goal. Root ṭ-l-b.
Preposition bi- with mu‘áraḍih: opposition, contention. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: In بمعارضه برخیزد 'rise up in opposition'.

definition: Bi "by, through" + ma‘rifa "knowledge, recognition". Root ‘-r-f.
usage: HW: تعرفها بمعرفتک لا بمعرفة احد 'know it through thine own knowledge and not through the knowledge of thy neighbour'.

definition: Preposition bi- with ma‘rifa 'knowledge, recognition' and suffix 'thy'. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: تعرفها بمعرفتک لا بمعرفة احد 'know it through thine own knowledge and not through the knowledge of thy neighbour'.

definition: Preposition ب with معروفیّت 'knownness, being recognized'. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: Íqán: کلّ اشیاء بمعروفیّت او معروفند 'all things are known through His being known'.

definition: Bi- with ma‘ṣiya: sin, disobedience. Root ‘-ṣ-y.
bi- plus ma‘lúm 'known thing, object of knowledge' plus indefinite -í. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: 'To any known thing'; in reasoning about knowledge and its objects.

definition: Preposition bi- plus maqám "station, degree" with indefinite -í. Root q-w-m.
usage: To a degree, station; maqám 'station' is frequent for spiritual ranks.

definition: Preposition bi- with maqarr "seat, abode, resting-place". Root q-r-r.
usage: Seat or abode, as in مقرّ عز 'the seat of glory'.

definition: Phrase bi + mala’ "assembly, concourse": to the (Supreme) Concourse. Root m-l-’.
usage: In ملأ اعلی 'the Concourse on high', the company of holy souls in the spiritual world.
notes: Written بملأ.

definition: Persian bi- with muláḥaẓih (consideration, observation, perusal). Root l-ḥ-ẓ.
usage: To the perusal or consideration of, e.g. presented for perusal.

definition: bi- 'to' + mamálik, plural of mamlaka: kingdoms, realms. Root m-l-k.
Preposition bi- + munásabat 'relevance, occasion' + indefinite -í: in some connection. Root n-s-b.
usage: 'In some connection', of an occasion or reason for mentioning something.

definition: bi + manba‘ (spring, source, fountainhead). Root n-b-‘.
usage: To the Source; of God as the Source of all.

definition: Preposition bi + muntahá 'utmost limit, end' with izáfih. Root n-h-y.
usage: With the utmost, as in بمنتهای خضوع 'with utmost humility'.

definition: Prepositional phrase: in the position of, like, equivalent to. Root n-z-l.
Persian bi- 'with, to' + mavt 'death'. Root m-w-t.
usage: Spiritual death of those who reject the Manifestation: موت دائمی 'everlasting death'.

definition: Persian preposition bi- with mawj 'wave'; بموج آمدن 'to surge'. Root m-w-j.
usage: Oceans of bounty surging, a frequent image.

definition: Preposition bi 'to' and mawṭin 'homeland, abode'. Root w-ṭ-n.
Preposition bi with makán 'place': to, at the place. Root k-w-n.
usage: With لامکان 'the placeless realm' in the Hidden Words.

definition: Causative of مردن: that he make die, extinguish, deaden.
Preposition ب with mayl 'inclination, wish': according to one's desire. Root m-y-l.
usage: بمیل و هوای خود 'according to their own desires and fancies'.

definition: Plural of bint "daughter" with suffix "their": their daughters.
Plural of bint 'daughter' with -humá 'of the two of them'. Root b-n-y.
Plural of bint 'daughter' with -hinna (their, feminine): their daughters. Root b-n-y.
Preposition bi- plus nám 'name': in the name of.
usage: Opens the Persian Hidden Words: بنام گویندهٔ توانا 'In the Name of the Lord of Utterance, the Mighty'.

definition: Perfect of baná 'to build' with -hu 'it'. Root b-n-y.
Bi- plus nubuvvat 'prophethood'. Root n-b-’.
usage: In مبعوث بنبوّت شد 'was raised up to prophethood'.

definition: Noun: daughter, girl. Root b-n-y.
Noun bint 'daughter' with 'his'. Root b-n-w.
usage: In the Aqdas تربیة ابنه و بنته 'to instruct his son and daughter'.

definition: Ba/bi "in" + naḥv "manner, way"; naḥv also means "grammar". Root n-ḥ-w.
usage: Íqán: بنحو اکمل و اشرف 'in the most perfect and exalted manner'.

definition: Preposition bi with naḥv 'manner, way' and indefinite -í. Root n-ḥ-w.
Preposition ب with نصح 'sincere counsel'. Root n-ṣ-ḥ.
Bi- with naṣr: help, aid, victory. Root n-ṣ-r.
bi- plus naẓar 'sight, view' plus plural -há: in (people's) eyes.
usage: 'In (people's) eyes'; of how things appear to people.

definition: Preposition bi- plus na‘íb "croaking of a raven". Root n-‘-b.
usage: With croaking; the raven's croak, an image of the ominous voices of the heedless.

definition: Preposition bi- with naghamát (plural of naghma): melodies, strains. Root n-gh-m.
usage: Melodies, as in the melodies of the Nightingale (the Manifestation).

definition: Phrase bi + nafkha "a breath, blast": with the breath (of life). Root n-f-kh.
usage: A breath or blast, as the breath of life or the Trumpet blast (نفخهٔ صور) of the Day of Judgment.
notes: Izáfih hamza split off.

definition: Present subjunctive 1st pl. of nihádan: (that) we lay, place; sar binihím = we bow our heads, submit.
usage: From نهادن 'to place'; in سر نهادن 'to bow the head, submit'.

definition: Imperative of núshídan: drink.
usage: Drink; e.g. drink the wine of the spirit.

definition: Verb, present subjunctive 3rd person singular of núshídan 'to drink'.
usage: 'Drink', of drinking the wine or water of divine knowledge.

definition: Imperative 2nd sing. of navishtan (stem nivís): write!
Proper noun (Arabic baní 'sons of' + Isrá’íl): the Children of Israel.
usage: The Children of Israel, in the Kitáb-i-Íqán's accounts of past prophets and peoples.
notes: Written بنی‌اسرائیل.

definition: Preposition bi- 'with' plus nísán, the spring month of April and its rain.
usage: In the Hidden Words بنیسان مرحمت 'with the April showers of My loving-kindness'.

definition: Adjective: radiant, brilliant, shining (intensive form). Root b-h-j.
usage: سراج بهّاج 'the radiant lamp'.

definition: Persian noun: spring garden, place of spring blossoms.
usage: Íqán: بهارستان قدس معنوی 'the spiritual springtime of holiness'.

definition: Plural of bahímah: beasts, cattle, dumb animals. Root b-h-m.
notes: Unrelated to بهاء 'glory'.

definition: Superlative adjective of bih 'good': the best.
Persian بـ with هدیه 'gift, offering'. Root h-d-y.
Preposition ب with havá 'desire, fancy' and indefinite ی: to some fancy. Root h-w-y.
usage: بهوائی تمسک جوئیم 'cling to some fancy'.

definition: Persian bi plus vádí "valley": to the valley.
usage: وادی ایمن "the Vale of Aymán", the holy vale of Sinai.

definition: Preposition bi- with wajh 'face' and -í 'my'. Root w-j-h.
Bi- plus waḥdániyya 'oneness, unity (of God)'. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: In the Aqdas یعترف فیه بوحدانیّة الله 'acknowledge the unity of God' in His Manifestation.

definition: Preposition bi- plus vazídan 'to blow (of wind)'; with ámadan 'to begin to blow'.
Preposition bi- + viṣál 'union, reunion with the beloved'. Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: Union with the Beloved, often with قرب 'nearness': حرم قرب و وصال 'the sanctuary of nearness and reunion'.

definition: Bi- plus vaṣf 'description, attribute' with indefinite -í. Root w-ṣ-f.
bi- with waṣl 'union, joining': by union, here a new marriage. Root w-ṣ-l.
Preposition bi- with va‘dih 'promise, appointed time'. Root w-‘-d.
notes: Written with the letter ە (U+06D5) before the izáfih mark in the source.

definition: Ba/bi "to, through" + viláyát "provinces, lands" (plural of viláyat). Root w-l-y.
Preposition bi- with wahm 'fancy, delusion'. Root w-h-m.
usage: بوهم مبین 'in a manifest delusion'.

definition: Persian بو 'scent, fragrance' with indefinite ی: a scent.
usage: Íqán: بوئی برید 'inhale a fragrance'.

definition: Bi- with pádisháhí: kingship, sovereignty.
bi- plus parvardigár 'Lord, Sustainer', from parvardan 'to nurture'.
usage: 'In the Lord'; پروردگار is a common Persian title of God, 'the Sustainer'.

definition: Preposition bi- plus chashmih "spring, fountain" (here with izáfih).
usage: To the spring; chashmih 'spring, fountain', often the fountain of life or knowledge.

definition: Preposition bi- with chashmih "spring, fountain" plus plural -há: (for) springs.
usage: Springs or fountains, often of the springs of divine knowledge.

definition: Phrase bi + chunín "such, so": to such (a).
Persian bi- with kátib (scribe, writer, amanuensis). Root k-t-b.
usage: The scribe or amanuensis, to whom Tablets were dictated.

definition: bi- 'to' + káfirán, Persian plural of káfir 'unbeliever'. Root k-f-r.
usage: Unbelievers, those who rejected the Messengers.

definition: Preposition bi- + kám 'desire, palate'.
usage: 'For desire', as in بکام نفس 'to gratify the self', of acting on the desires of the lower self.
notes: gámí bi-kám-i-nafs: a step to gratify the self.

definition: bi + kitáb (book) + -há (its, feminine). Root k-t-b.
usage: By its Book; each Dispensation and its Book.

definition: Preposition bi + katháfat 'density; filth, defilement'. Root k-th-f.
usage: Grossness or defilement, as in dense veils of the world.

definition: Preposition bi- plus karrát, plural of karrah 'time, turn': repeatedly, many times. Root k-r-r.
Persian bi- 'by, with' + kurúr 'a crore, 500,000' + plural -há: by myriads, countless.
Persian preposition bi- with kasb 'acquiring, earning'. Root k-s-b.
Preposition bi and kasr 'breaking'. Root k-s-r.
Preposition bi with kusúf: by or with the eclipse. Root k-s-f.
Persian بـ with کفر 'unbelief, infidelity, blasphemy'. Root k-f-r.
usage: In نسبت بکفر دادن 'to accuse of unbelief'.

definition: Preposition ب with plural of kalima: with, by or to words. Root k-l-m.
bi plus plural of kalima "word" with suffix "his": by His words. Root k-l-m.
Preposition bi- with kalimih 'word'; the ئ marks the izáfih (بکلمهٔ). Root k-l-m.
notes: Spelling بکلمئ for بکلمهٔ امر 'by a word of His command'.

definition: Bi- plus kull 'all, whole' plus -him: with the whole of themselves, wholly. Root k-l-l.
usage: In the Íqán انقطعوا بکلّهم الی الله 'who have wholly detached themselves unto God'.

definition: Preposition bi- plus kih 'who': to whom, on whom.
Noun: early morning, daybreak. Root b-k-r.
usage: In the Aqdas فی کلّ اصیل و بکور 'at every eventide and dawn'.

definition: Bi- plus kúy 'street, quarter': to the lane (of the beloved).
usage: In the Hidden Words بکوی جانان شتابند 'hasten to the street of the Beloved'.

definition: bi- with kúy 'lane, quarter' and -ash: to his lane, his dwelling.
usage: In Persian poetry the beloved's lane; بکویش بشتابید 'hasten unto His court'.

definition: Verb, present subjunctive 3rd person singular of gudákhtan: melt, consume.
notes: In ارواح و افئده را بگدازد 'consumes souls and hearts'.

definition: Ba/bi "on, to" + gardan "neck" + -há plural + -shán "their": on their necks.
usage: Íqán, of the martyrs: سیفی نماند مگر آنکه بگردنهاشان ممسوح گشت 'no sword but touched their necks'.

definition: Present subjunctive of گسلیدن/گسستن 'to break, sever'.
usage: Of the heart severing itself from the world of dust.

definition: Persian verb گشودن 'open', imperative: open.
usage: HW: چشم حقّ بگشا 'open the eye of God'.

definition: Present subjunctive of gushúdan: open, unveil.
Present subjunctive, second person singular, of gushúdan 'to open': (that) thou open.
usage: '(That) thou open'; as in opening one's eyes or heart.

definition: Preposition bi- plus gul "flower, rose".
usage: With flowers; gul 'rose, flower', a frequent image of beauty and the Beloved.

definition: Preposition bi- with gulkhan "furnace of a bath-house, ash-heap", hence a base, foul place.
usage: A bath-house furnace or ash-heap, figurative of a base, foul place contrasted with the rose-garden.
notes: HW: "Exchange not the garden of eternal delight for the dust-heap of a mortal world".

definition: Verb, present subjunctive 3rd person singular of gunjídan: (should) fit, be contained in.
usage: To fit or be contained; in the Persian Hidden Words two loves cannot be contained in one heart.

definition: Imperative 2nd pl. of guftan: say! tell!
notes: Spelled بگوئید in the text.

definition: Subjunctive 1st pl. of guftan 'to say': (if) we say.
notes: Written بگوئیم.

definition: Preposition bí 'without' + áb 'water'.
usage: 'Without water', of barren land or a parched seeker.

definition: Verb, imperative of yáftan 'to find'.
usage: 'Find', an exhortation to find or attain, as in seek and find.
notes: Same spelling as bí-áb 'without water'.

definition: Subjunctive 2nd sing. of yáftan (stem yáb): (that) you find.
Subjunctive/imperative plural of yáftan 'to find' with the prefix bi-.
Noun from bí- 'without' and adab 'courtesy': discourtesy, insolence.
Imperative of árámídan, 'to rest, to repose, to be at peace'.
Persian verb, 2nd singular present subjunctive of árástan 'to adorn': (that) thou adorn.
Imperative plural of ávardan 'to bring'.
Verb, imperative of áshámídan: drink, quaff.
Imperative of آشامیدن 'to drink'.
Adjective بی‌اصل 'baseless, unfounded' with است: is baseless.
usage: بی‌معنی و بی‌اصلست 'is meaningless and groundless'.
notes: Written بی‌اصلست; joiner removed.

definition: Persian bí "without" plus i‘ánat "help, assistance". Root ‘-w-n.
notes: Written بی‌اعانت.

definition: Adjective: unfair, unjust, from بی 'without' and inṣáf 'fairness'. Root n-ṣ-f.
Conjunction (bí 'without' plus ánkih 'that'): without (doing).
notes: Split from بی‌آنکه.

definition: Verb, imperative 2nd singular of ávardan 'to bring'.
Subjunctive 3rd plural of ávardan 'to bring'; with وارد 'to inflict'.
Imperative of ávardan 'to bring': bring (ye).
Adjective: fearless, reckless, heedless of danger.
notes: Written with a joiner (بی‌باک).

definition: Proper noun: Bethlehem, birthplace of Jesus.
notes: Written with a joiner (بیت‌اللّحم).

definition: Bayt "house" with -hi "his". Root b-y-t.
usage: Aqdas: او فی بیته 'or in his own home', on places for reciting the verses.

definition: Persian bí 'without' with Arabic takallum 'speaking'. Root k-l-m.
Arabic بیت 'house' with Persian indefinite ی; also a verse of poetry. Root b-y-t.
Adjective: without fruit, fruitless, barren.
Persian bí- 'without' plus Arabic thamar 'fruit': fruitless, barren.
usage: 'Fruitless'; of a tree or life without good deeds, as in درخت بی‌ثمر.

definition: Adjective/adverb: without movement, motionless (bí "without" + ḥarakat "motion"). Root ḥ-r-k.
notes: Normalized from بی‌حرکت.

definition: Preposition bi- with the proper name Yaḥyá, John the Baptist.
usage: John the Baptist (یحیی), the herald of Jesus, cited as a parallel to the Báb.
notes: Qur'an 3:39.

definition: Adjective (bí "without" + khabar "news"): uninformed, unaware.
usage: Unaware, heedless, especially of God's Day or of one's own spiritual state.

definition: Plural of bíkhirad (lacking wisdom): fools, the senseless.
usage: The senseless or foolish, lacking خرد 'wisdom'.

definition: Adjective: awake; with namúdan 'to awaken'.
usage: Awake; the heedless are summoned to awake.

definition: Preposition bí 'without' + Arabic dhahab 'gold'.
usage: 'Without gold', of the poor or of one lacking worldly wealth.

definition: Noun: aversion, disgust, disavowal; "bízárí justan" to disavow.
usage: Aversion, disavowal; of disavowing evil.

definition: Persian bí 'without' + subuḥát (plural of subḥa) 'glories, the veils of glory'. Root s-b-ḥ.
usage: The veils of glory, in the call to rend the سبحات جلال 'veils of glory'; بی سبحات means without such veils.
notes: Written بی‌سبحات.

definition: Adverb or adjective: more, more than, over.
Adjective: shepherdless (bí 'without' + shabán 'shepherd').
Persian bí 'without' with ẓuhúr 'appearance, manifestation'. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: Ẓuhúr is the Manifestation or Revelation of God.

definition: Compound adjective: without knowledge, unlearned. Root ‘-l-m.
notes: Used here by Bahá'u'lláh of Himself in humility.

definition: Persian bí 'without' with Arabic faná 'perishing': without death or extinction. Root f-n-y.
notes: Written بی‌فنا in the source.

definition: Persian بی 'without' with Arabic لسان 'tongue'. Root l-s-n.
Phrase بی 'without' + lafẓ 'word': wordlessly, without utterance.
usage: بی‌لفظ رمز معانی کشف مینماید 'without words unveils mysteries of meaning'.
notes: Written بی‌لفظ; joiner removed.

definition: Persian compound of bím "fear" and dihandih "giver": one who warns, a warner (Arabic nadhír).
notes: Written بیم‌دهنده; Persian rendering of the Qur'anic نذیر.

definition: Phrase 'without the sought-for one', from بی 'without' and maṭlúb 'object of desire'. Root ṭ-l-b.
Persian bí 'without' plus ma‘rifat 'knowledge, recognition': without understanding. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: معرفت is the recognition or knowledge of God.
notes: Split from بی‌معرفت.

definition: Preposition bi- plus yamín 'right hand' with -hi 'His'. Root y-m-n.
usage: Qur'anic السّموات مطویّات بیمینه 'the heavens shall be folded together in His right hand'.

definition: Persian bí 'without' + Arabic nár 'fire'.
Imperative of andákhtan 'to throw': cast (ye).
Noun: insight, vision, perception.
usage: اهل دانش و بینش 'men of knowledge and insight'.

definition: Adjective: without trace, sign or mark; untraceable.
usage: In یار بی‌نشان 'the traceless Friend', of God.
notes: Written with a joiner (بی‌نشان); not بین + شان 'between them'.

definition: Clear proofs, evident signs: bayyina with Persian plural -há. Root b-y-n.
usage: Persian paraphrase of Qur'an 40:34 in the Íqán: یوسف از پیش با بیّنه‌ها 'Joseph came to you before with clear signs'.

definition: Preposition bayna 'between' with suffix 'thee'. Root b-y-n.
usage: In the tradition لا فرق بینک و بینهم 'there is no difference between Thee and Them'.

definition: Persian adjective: free of need, independent, self-sufficient.
usage: Íqán: از عرفان کلّ شیء بی‌نیاز 'independent of the knowledge of all things'.

definition: Plural of bayt in accusative: houses. Root b-y-t.
Persian bí- 'without' plus par 'wing, feather': wingless.
usage: 'Wingless'; in the image of the bird of the soul unable to soar.

definition: Adjective: boundless, limitless (bí "without" + karán "shore, limit").
usage: Boundless; of the boundless ocean of God's grace.

definition: Preposition bi- with yakí "one (of them)".
Noun/adjective: stranger, alien, estranged.
usage: Stranger, alien; the soul estranged from God, contrasted with آشنا 'friend, intimate'.
notes: ٴ marks the izáfih.

definition: Verb (form I perfect): he repented, turned back to God. Root t-w-b.
usage: Of repentance, turning back to God; whoso repents is forgiven.
notes: Persian táb (endurance, twist) is unrelated.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd fem. sing. of atá: comes; with bi- 'brings'. Root '-t-y.
usage: Comes; with بـ 'brings'.
notes: Quran 44:10 yawma ta’ti’s-samá’u bi-dukhánin mubín.

definition: Verb, imperfect subjunctive 3rd person feminine singular of akhadha: to take. Root ’-kh-dh.
usage: 'She take', in Aqdas laws on women and inheritance.

definition: Noun: plunder, pillage; "táráj shudan" to be plundered.
usage: Plunder; of the believers' property plundered during persecutions.

definition: Noun táríkh 'history, chronicle, date' + indefinite -í. Root ’-r-kh.
usage: History or chronicle, as in any history of past peoples.

definition: Noun: darkness, obscurity.
usage: In the Íqán تاریکی شمس و قمر 'the darkening of the sun and moon', a sign of the Day.

definition: Verbal noun: following an example, imitation; also consolation. Root '-s-w.
Adjective: complete, entire, perfect. Root t-m-m.
usage: Paired with کامل, as in تام و کامل 'complete and perfect'.

definition: Verb: to go astray, be bewildered, be lost. Root t-y-h.
Verb, imperfect 3rd fem. sing. of akala with 3rd masc. suffix: devours it. Root ’-k-l.
usage: Qur'anic, قربان تأکله النّار 'a sacrifice devoured by fire'.

definition: Verb: ye eat. Root ’-k-l.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words, of unity: تأکلون من فم واحد 'eat with one mouth'.

definition: Verb, form VI perfect: blessed be, exalted be (of God only). Root b-r-k.
usage: Qur'an 23:14 تبارک الله احسن الخالقین 'Blessed, therefore, be God, the most excellent of Makers'.

definition: Passive of form II baddala: to be changed, exchanged. Root b-d-l.
usage: From Qur'an 14:48 یوم تبدّل الأرض غیر الأرض "the day when the earth shall be changed into another earth".

definition: Plural of tabdíl 'change, alteration'. Root b-d-l.
Imperfect 2nd person masculine plural of form IV abṣara: you see, perceive. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: Qur'an 51:21 in the Íqán: و فی انفسکم افلا تبصرون 'and in your own selves: will ye not then behold?'

definition: Verb, present of baqiya 'to remain, endure'. Root b-q-y.
usage: In the Aqdas لا تبقی عزّة الاعزّآء 'the glory of the mighty shall not endure'.

definition: Subjunctive 2nd plural of form II ballagha 'to convey, proclaim'. Root b-l-gh.
usage: Teaching the Faith: تبلیغ; in the Aqdas تبلّغوا امر ربّکم 'proclaim the Cause of your Lord'.

definition: Form I imperfect of baliya 'to become worn out, decay'. Root b-l-y.
usage: In the Hidden Words خزائن مجد لا تبلی 'treasures of glory that perish not'.

definition: Verb: she or it weeps. Root b-k-y.
usage: Aqdas تبکی علیکم عین عنایتی 'the eye of My loving-kindness weepeth sore over you'.

definition: Noun tibyán 'clear exposition' with -ast 'is'. Root b-y-n.
usage: In اصرح از بیان و تبیانست 'clearer than utterance and exposition'.

definition: Dual imperfect of báda "to perish, vanish": both (fem.) will perish. Root b-y-d.
usage: HW: تزولان فی حین و تبیدان فی وقت 'both shall pass away and perish in their time'.

definition: Imperfect of form V taḍawwa‘a 'to spread (of fragrance), be diffused'. Root ḍ-w-‘.
usage: Of fragrances spreading: تتضوّع به نفحات الطافک 'whereby the fragrances of Thy favours are diffused'.

definition: Arabic verb (form V), jussive after لا: do not transgress. Root ‘-d-w.
usage: HW: لا تتعدّ عن حدّک 'overstep not thy limits'.

definition: Present of tafarrasa: discern, perceive by insight. Root f-r-s.
Imperfect, third person feminine singular, of talá 'to recite, read aloud'. Root t-l-w.
usage: 'Recites'; of reciting the verses of God.

definition: Verb (form V): imperfect 2nd masculine plural of tawajjaha "to turn towards". Root w-j-h.
usage: You turn; tawajjuh 'turning towards', e.g. towards God or the Qiblih.

definition: Verb form V tawaqqafa "to pause, hesitate", subjunctive 2nd masculine plural: (lest) ye hesitate. Root w-q-f.
usage: 'Hesitate', in exhortations not to hesitate in recognizing the Cause.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd person feminine singular: becomes firm, is established. Root th-b-t.
usage: To be firm or established, of feet made firm in God's Cause.

definition: Verb (form III, 2nd pl. subjunctive): dispute, contend, argue. Root j-d-l.
usage: Of disputing; the Writings forbid contention and disputation.
notes: Iyyákum an tujádilú = beware lest ye dispute.

definition: Verb form VI subjunctive 2nd masc. pl. (for tatajáwazú): go beyond, exceed. Root j-w-z.
usage: Exceed, transgress; e.g. do not go beyond the bounds God has set.

definition: Verb, imperfect subjunctive 2nd person singular of wajada with -ní 'me': thou find Me. Root w-j-d.
usage: 'That thou find Me', in the Hidden Words' call to turn to God so that the soul may find Him.

definition: Verb, Form I imperfect 2nd plural: you find. Root w-j-d.
Imperfect second plural of wajada 'to find' + -hu 'it'. Root w-j-d.
usage: Ye find it, as in finding something written in the Book.

definition: Present of jadhaba: it draws, attracts. Root j-dh-b.
usage: Divine attraction, as in تجذب القلوب 'draweth the hearts'.

definition: Verb: jussive 2nd plural of jazi‘a, 'to be impatient, to lament'; with lá 'do not'. Root j-z-‘.
usage: Aqdas: لا تجزعوا فی المصائب 'be not dismayed in calamities'.

definition: Arabic verb, imperfect of ja‘ala with -hu: it makes him. Root j-‘-l.
Verb: to make, render; (do not) make it. Root j-‘-l.
Verb, form V perfect 1st pl.: We revealed Ourself, shone forth. Root j-l-w.
usage: تجلّی in the Writings is God's self-revelation or effulgence.

definition: Verb imperative: avoid ye, keep away from. Root j-n-b.
usage: In the Aqdas, warning against what is forbidden: تجنّبوا یا قوم 'avoid it, O people'.

definition: Verbal noun, form II: preparing, equipping, making ready. Root j-h-z.
usage: Aqdas: تجهیز الأسباب للکفن و الدفن 'expenses of the shroud and burial'.

definition: Passive of form III ḥásaba, to hold to account: (before) thou art called to account. Root ḥ-s-b.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words حاسب نفسک ... من قبل ان تحاسب "Bring thyself to account each day ere thou art summoned to a reckoning".

definition: Passive verb: 'ye are made joyful, delighted'. Root ḥ-b-r.
usage: Echoes Qur'an 30:15 فهم فی روضة یحبرون 'they shall be made glad in a garden'.
notes: Reading as passive tuḥbarún is inferred from the Qur'anic echo.

definition: Imperfect subjunctive of ḥabiṭa, agreeing with a plural noun: to come to nothing, be rendered vain. Root ḥ-b-ṭ.
usage: In the Aqdas لئلّا تحبط اعمالکم 'lest your deeds be brought to naught'.

definition: Verb aḥabba 'to love' 2nd singular with -ní 'me'. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: In the Hidden Words ان لم تحبّنی 'if thou lovest Me not'.

definition: Imperfect of form IV aḥabba 'to love, like' with -hu 'it'. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: ما لا تحبّه لنفسک 'that which thou wouldst not have for thyself'.

definition: Form VIII: thou art veiled. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: In the Hidden Words کیف تحتجب 'how canst thou be veiled'.

definition: Verb form VIII: to be veiled, shut out. Root ḥ-j-b.
notes: After لا a jussive would be expected; written here with nún.

definition: Verb, form VIII, present 3rd person feminine: is burned, burns. Root ḥ-r-q.
usage: In a tradition عذاباً تحترق به اجسادهم 'a torment by which their bodies burn'.

definition: Passive imperfect 2sg of ḥajaba "to veil": you are veiled, shut out. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: HW: جعلت النّور لک ضیاء کیف تحجب عنه 'I have made the light thine illumination; how canst thou be veiled from it?'.
notes: Read as passive; an active reading taḥjubu "you veil" is less likely.

definition: Jussive of ḥajaba 'to veil, screen' with suffix 'them'; with لا a negation. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: لا تحجبهم شبهات المریبین 'nor shall the doubts of the doubters shut them out'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I), subjunctive: that you veil, shut out. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: Aqdas: ایّاکم ان تحجبوا النّاس بحجاب آخر 'beware lest ye shut out the people by yet another veil'.

definition: Subjunctive of ḥajaba with 'you': veil you, shut you out. Root ḥ-j-b.
Plural of taḥdíd 'limitation, restriction', verbal noun of form II. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: 'Limitations'; of the limitations of the human world transcended by the spirit.

definition: Verb: jussive 2nd plural of ḥarama "to deprive"; lá taḥrimú "deprive not". Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: Deprive; in lá taḥrimú 'deprive not', e.g. yourselves of grace.

pos: verb 3sg fem. impf. (form II) + pron. suffix
definition: Verb form II ḥarraka "to move, stir", imperfect 3rd feminine singular with -hu: (it) moves it. Root ḥ-r-k.
Verb, imperfect 2nd person masculine singular of ḥasiba: you think, suppose. Root ḥ-s-b.
usage: In Qur'anic warnings 'do not think' (لا تحسب), e.g. that God is unaware of what the wrongdoers do.
notes: Qur'an 25:44.

definition: Verb (form I energetic, 2nd sing.): (do not) think, suppose. Root ḥ-s-b.
usage: 'Think not', a Qur'anic-style warning against false suppositions.
notes: Lá taḥsabanna = Think not.

definition: Imperative form V: fortify thyself, take refuge. Root ḥ-ṣ-n.
usage: Take refuge, fortify thyself in God's stronghold.

definition: Verb, imperfect subjunctive form IV with -hu: to count, reckon it. Root ḥ-ṣ-y.
usage: 'To reckon it', in the formula that God's bounties can never be counted (لن تحصیه).
notes: After lan 'never'.

definition: Verb, Form I imperfect 3rd fem. + "him": it protects him. Root ḥ-f-ẓ.
usage: Protects him; of God protecting the believer.

definition: Jussive second plural of ḥalaqa 'to shave': lá taḥliqú 'shave not'. Root ḥ-l-q.
usage: Used in the Aqdas law لا تحلقوا رؤوسکم 'shave not your heads'.

definition: Subjunctive of ḥakama: ye judge, pass sentence. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: In the Aqdas ان تحکموا لهما حبساً ابدیّاً 'should ye condemn them to life imprisonment'.

definition: Verb: imperfect 2nd plural of ḥakama, 'to judge, to decree'. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: In the Qur'anic question کیف تحکمون 'how judge ye?'.

definition: Arabic verb, form V perfect: (they) were bewildered, perplexed. Root ḥ-y-r.
Verb form IV passive: to be quickened, brought to life. Root ḥ-y-y.
Verb, imperfect 2nd masc. sing. of kháfa: thou fearest. Root kh-w-f.
Verb: it differs, varies. Root kh-l-f.
Verb, form VIII subjunctive: that you differ, disagree. Root kh-l-f.
usage: ایّاکم ان تختلفوا فیه 'beware lest ye dispute about it'.

definition: Form IV of kh-r-b: to destroy, lay waste; with لا "do not destroy". Root kh-r-b.
Verb: 'it brings out, drives out', form IV of kh-r-j.
Imperfect of form II khaḍḍaba 'to dye, tinge (with henna or blood)': (that) thou dye. Root kh-ḍ-b.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: to tinge thy hair with thy blood is greater in God's sight than the creation of both worlds.
notes: Could also be read passive tukhaḍḍaba with sha‘ruka as subject; the voice is not certain.

definition: Noun: seed; egg.
Imperfect of khamada 'to die down, be extinguished'. Root kh-m-d.
Form I of kh-w-n 'to betray'; after lá: do not betray. Root kh-w-n.
usage: In the Aqdas لا تخونوا فی حقوق اللّه 'be not unfaithful in the Right of God'.

definition: Plural of takhayyul: imaginings, fancies. Root kh-y-l.
Verb, form V imperative plural: reflect, ponder. Root d-b-r.
usage: In the Aqdas تدبّروا فیه 'ponder ye upon it'.

definition: Plans, measures, schemes; plural of tadbír (form II verbal noun). Root d-b-r.
usage: Íqán: در تدبیرات امورات دانیه 'in contriving their sordid affairs'.

definition: Energetic imperfect 2nd person plural of dakhala 'to enter'. Root d-kh-l.
Arabic verb (form I), subjunctive: that you enter. Root d-kh-l.
usage: Aqdas: ایّاکم ان تدخلوا بیتاً 'enter not a house'.

definition: Present of adraka: perceive, grasp, comprehend. Root d-r-k.
Jussive, second person masculine singular, of form VIII idda‘á 'to claim'. Root d-‘-w.
usage: 'Claim'; in warnings against making false claims.
notes: Hidden Words: 'claim not that which beseemeth thee not'.

definition: Verb: subjunctive 2nd plural of wada‘a "to leave, abandon". Root w-d-‘.
usage: Abandon, leave; ordinary verb.
notes: Not from da‘á "to call".

definition: Verb wada‘a "to leave", imperfect 2nd masculine plural: ye leave, abandon. Root w-d-‘.
notes: Could also be tad‘úna "ye call" (d-‘-w); context favours "leave".

definition: Verb, imperfect 2nd person singular of da‘á + -ná "us": you call us (to). Root d-‘-w.
usage: From the Qur'anic dialogue in which a people tell their prophet they doubt that to which he calls them, quoted in the Íqán.

definition: Verb (form I imperfect, 2nd sing.) with 3rd masc. object: you call upon him, invoke him. Root d-‘-w.
usage: Calling upon or invoking someone.

definition: Verbal noun form II: burying, burial. Root d-f-n.
usage: Burial; the Aqdas sets laws for burying the dead.

definition: Verb, imperfect 2nd person singular of dára: to turn, circle around. Root d-w-r.
usage: 'Circles, turns around', of revolving around the will of God or around the Centre of the Cause.

definition: Verb (defective wadhara), jussive 2nd sing.: leave; "lá tadhar" leave not. Root w-dh-r.
usage: Leave; in لا تذر "leave not".

definition: Subjunctive second singular of dhakara 'to mention, recount' (after an). Root dh-k-r.
usage: Mentioning or recounting, as in a call to mention God.

definition: Verbal noun (form V): remembering, taking heed, reminder. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Remembrance and taking heed, as in reminders to the heedless.

definition: Present of form V tadhakkara: ye take heed, are mindful, are admonished. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Qur'anic refrain أ فلا تذکّرون 'will ye not then be admonished?'

definition: Noun: dust, earth. Root t-r-b.
usage: Qur'anic question of the unbelievers: أ ئذا کنّا تراباً 'what! when we have become dust...'.

definition: Arabic verb, imperfect of ra'á with -ka: it sees thee. Root r-'-y.
usage: Prayer: عمیت عین لا تراک 'blind be the eye that seeth Thee not'.

definition: Noun turbah 'soil, tomb' with dual pronoun 'their (two)'. Root t-r-b.
usage: In the formula قدس الله تربتهما 'may God sanctify their resting-place'.

definition: Verbal noun of form V: waiting, waiting period. Root r-b-ṣ.
usage: In the Aqdas a wife's waiting period before remarrying.

definition: Verbal noun: upbringing, education, training. Root r-b-w.
usage: In the Aqdas every father must see to تربیة ابنه و بنته 'the instruction of his son and daughter'; a central Bahá'í duty.

definition: Verb, form VIII imperfect: quakes, is shaken. Root r-j-j.
usage: Gospel verse قوّات الارض ترتجّ 'the powers of the earth shall be shaken'.

definition: Form VIII of r-f-‘: to rise, be raised, be exalted. Root r-f-‘.
Verb: 'ye return', imperfect 2pl of raja‘a. Root r-j-‘.
Accusative of purpose of taraḥḥum, verbal noun of form V: showing compassion; out of mercy. Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words تلطّفاً لعبادی و ترحّماً لخلقی 'as a token of My grace unto My servants and My mercy unto My creatures'.

definition: Verb arāda 'to want, desire', 2nd singular jussive. Root r-w-d.
