usage: In the Hidden Words ان ترد رضائی 'if thou seekest My pleasure'.

definition: Passive imperfect 2nd plural of razaqa 'to provide, sustain'. Root r-z-q.
One who frightens or warns (from tarsándan 'to frighten').
usage: In the Íqán's rendering of Qur'anic verses بیم‌دهنده و ترساننده 'a warner'.

definition: Present of ترسیدن without mí-: I fear (that).
usage: Persian Hidden Words ترسم که 'I fear lest'.

definition: Verbal noun of form V: oozing, trickling, sprinkling. Root r-sh-ḥ.
usage: In ترشّح نمودن 'to be sprinkled', of the Imám Ḥusayn's blood upon the earth.

definition: Seepings, oozings, effusions; plural of tarashshuḥ (form V). Root r-sh-ḥ.
usage: Íqán: غلبه ترشّحات دم آن حضرت 'the copious shedding of His blood'.

definition: Relational name: from Turshíz in Khurásán.
usage: Áqá Siyyid Ḥusayn-i-Turshízí, a martyr named in the Íqán.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): you are pleased with it. Root r-ḍ-y.
usage: Qur'anic: قبلةً ترضاها 'a Qiblih that shall please thee'.

definition: Jussive of raḍiya with lá: do not be content with, do not wish. Root r-ḍ-w.
Imperfect, second person masculine plural, of raḍiya 'to be pleased with' plus -hu 'it'. Root r-ḍ-w.
usage: 'Ye approve it'; as in choose for others what you would approve for yourselves.

definition: Verb: jussive of ragiba; with ‘an "to shun, turn from", with fí/ilá "to desire". Root r-gh-b.
usage: Turn away, desire; with ‘an 'to shun', with fí 'to desire'.

definition: Verb rafa‘a "to raise", imperfect 2nd masculine plural: ye raise, exalt. Root r-f-‘.
Verb, imperfect 2nd person masculine plural of ra’á: you see. Root r-’-y.
usage: You see; in exhortations to look upon the signs of God.

definition: Verb (form I perfect, 2nd masc. sing.) with 1st sing. object: you left me, forsook me. Root t-r-k.
usage: Forsaking, of those who forsook God or His Manifestation.

definition: Verb, perfect 1st pl. of taraka + -há: We left it, them. Root t-r-k.
Verb, perfect of taraka with -hu: he left it (behind). Root t-r-k.
usage: 'He left', in the inheritance laws: ممّا ترکه 'of what he left'.
notes: Inheritance: mimmá tarakahu 'of what he left'.

definition: tark-kunandih (one who abandons) + -ím (we are): are we to be forsakers.
usage: Are we to be forsakers; rhetorical question in the Íqán.

definition: Imperfect second singular of aráda 'to want, desire'. Root r-w-d.
usage: Thou desirest, as in prayers 'what Thou desirest'.

definition: Present of form IV aráda: ye wish, desire, intend. Root r-w-d.
usage: In the Hidden Words هیهات عمّا انتم تریدون 'far is this from that which ye desire'.

definition: Verb: jussive 2nd plural of zajara, 'to rebuke, to restrain', with suffix -hu. Root z-j-r.
usage: Aqdas: الّذی زجرکم لا تزجروه 'he who rebuketh you, rebuke him not'.

definition: Arabic verb, form IV subjunctive with -kum: cause you to slip, stumble. Root z-l-l.
usage: Aqdas: لئلّا تزلّکم اشارات المعرضین 'lest the insinuations of the rejecters cause you to slip'.

definition: Verb: to weigh, measure. Root w-z-n.
usage: In the Aqdas, لا تزنوا کتاب الله بما عندکم 'weigh not the Book of God with such standards as are current amongst you'.

definition: Verb, form V imperative pl.: marry ye. Root z-w-j.
usage: In the Aqdas تزوّجوا یا قوم 'Enter into wedlock, O people'.

definition: Noun plural: forgeries, deceptions, frauds. Root z-w-r.
usage: In the Íqán تزویرات نفسانی 'deceits of the self'.

definition: Verbal noun, form II: purifying; paying the alms of zakát. Root z-k-w.
usage: Aqdas: تزکیة الاقوات 'to purify your substance' by paying zakát.

definition: Verbal noun of form II zakká: purifying, cleansing, sanctifying. Root z-k-w.
usage: تزکیهٔ نفوس "the purification of souls", a condition of true understanding in the Íqán.

definition: Verbal noun: glorifying God, praise. Root s-b-ḥ.
Imperfect 2nd person masculine plural of form X istabdala: you exchange, take in place of. Root b-d-l.
usage: Qur'an 2:61 in the Íqán: أتستبدلون الّذی هو ادنی بالّذی هو خیر 'will ye exchange the better for the worse?'

definition: Verb, form X: to become married, be protected by wedlock. Root ḥ-ṣ-n.
usage: In the Aqdas, a divorced woman may be remarried to her husband ما لم تستحصن 'so long as she hath not taken another husband'.

definition: Imperfect of form X istadhalla 'to abase, deem lowly'. Root dh-l-l.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: صنعتک عزیزاً بم تستذلّ 'Noble I made thee, wherewith dost thou abase thyself?'

definition: Form X passive: to be martyred. Root sh-h-d.
usage: In the Hidden Words او تستشهد فی سبیلی 'or be a martyr in My path'.

definition: Verb form X: to be lit up, seek light. Root ḍ-w-'.
usage: Aqdas تستضیء افئدة المقبلین 'the hearts of the faithful are illumined'.
notes: Written تستضئی.

definition: Verb, form X, 2nd person singular subjunctive: thou be able. Root ṭ-w-‘.
usage: In the Hidden Words و ان لن تستطیع 'and if thou canst not'.

definition: Form X imperfect of ‘-l-m: you seek knowledge, inquire. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: HW: من جوهر العلم اظهرتک لم تستعلم عن دونی 'out of the essence of knowledge I gave thee being; why seekest thou enlightenment from anyone beside Me?'.
notes: Preceded by لِمَ "why".

definition: Imperfect of form X istanára 'to be lit up, illumined'. Root n-w-r.
usage: الا بذکره تستنیر الصدور 'through His remembrance are breasts illumined'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): you mock, scoff at. Root s-kh-r.
usage: Qur'anic (Noah): ان تسخروا منّا فانّا نسخر منکم 'though ye scoff at us, we scoff at you'.

definition: Present 2pl of sakhira: you mock. Root s-kh-r.
Subjunctive, second person masculine plural, of form IV asrafa 'to be excessive, waste'. Root s-r-f.
usage: 'Be excessive'; Qur'anic injunction against excess and waste, echoed in the Aqdas.

definition: Verb: imperfect 3rd feminine singular of saṭa‘a "to rise, spread (of light or fragrance)". Root s-ṭ-‘.
usage: Be diffused, spread; of light or fragrance diffused, as of the fragrance of God.

definition: Verb wasi‘a "to hold, contain", subjunctive 3rd feminine singular with -ní after lan: (shall never) contain Me. Root w-s-‘.
usage: Used in the tradition that neither earth nor heaven can contain God, but the heart of the believer can.

definition: Verb, imperfect 2nd person masculine singular: you travel, tread (a path). Root s-l-k.
usage: To tread a path, as the seeker treads the path of God (سلوک).

definition: Verb (form I imperfect, 2nd pl.): you walk, travel, tread (a path). Root s-l-k.
usage: Treading a path, the spiritual journey (سلوک) of the seeker.

definition: Energetic imperfect 2nd masc. pl. of sakana: that ye dwell. Root s-k-n.
Verb, imperfect 2nd person masculine plural of sakana: ye dwell. Root s-k-n.
usage: 'Ye dwell', of dwelling in the earth or in God's houses.

definition: Verb, Form I imperfect 2nd plural: you ask. Root s-'-l.
Imperfect second singular of shá’a 'to will, wish'. Root sh-y-’.
usage: God's will, as in تفعل ما تشاء 'Thou doest what Thou willest'.

definition: Passive present of form IV ashára: it is pointed to, alluded to. Root sh-w-r.
usage: In the Aqdas لا تعبّر بالعبارة و لا تشار بالاشارة 'which can neither be expressed nor alluded to'.

definition: Verbal noun: likening, comparison, simile. Root sh-b-h.
Arabic verb, energetic imperfect of shariba: (she, it) surely drinks. Root sh-r-b.
Verbal noun form II: honouring; in تشریف بردن 'to go' and تشریف آوردن 'to come', said of exalted persons. Root sh-r-f.
Verb, form V imperfect: is split, is cleft (contracted from tatashaqqaqu). Root sh-q-q.
usage: Qur'anic, یوم تشقّق السّماء بالغمام 'the day the heaven shall be cloven with clouds'.

definition: Adjective: thirsty.
usage: Often figurative, the soul athirst for divine knowledge.

definition: Verb, form I: thou doubtest. Root sh-k-k.
usage: لا تشکّ فیه 'doubt it not'.

definition: Verbal noun of form II shakkaka: raising doubts, causing to doubt. Root sh-k-k.
Verb: 'be patient, wait', jussive after lá. Root ṣ-b-r.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words 6: فادخل فیها و لا تصبر 'enter therein and tarry not'.

definition: Passive imperfect 3rd person feminine of ṣabagha 'to dye': it is dyed, stained. Root ṣ-b-gh.
usage: A tradition in the Íqán on the companions of the Qá'im: تصبغ الارض بدمائهم 'the earth shall be dyed with their blood'.

definition: Verb ṣadda 'to turn aside, hinder', present 2nd plural. Root ṣ-d-d.
usage: Qur'anic لم تصدّون عن سبیل اللّه 'why turn ye aside from the way of God?'

definition: Jussive 2nd plural of form V taṣarrafa 'to dispose of, deal with'. Root ṣ-r-f.
notes: Aqdas: do not dispose of the Rights of God except with His leave.

definition: Explicitly, plainly; paired with تلویحاً 'by allusion'. Root ṣ-r-ḥ.
Verb, energetic form: (that) ye may surely attain, reach. Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: In the formula لعل تصلن الی ... 'that haply ye may attain unto...'.

definition: Verb, present 2nd person plural: you reach, attain. Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: In لعلّکم بمواقع العلم تصلون 'that haply ye may attain the stations of knowledge'.

definition: Form IV imperfect of ṣ-w-b "to befall, reach" with -ka: (it) will reach you.
usage: HW: لا تخف لأنّ العزّة تصیبک 'fear not, for glory shall one day be thine'.

definition: Persian plural of taḍarru‘ 'humble supplication, entreaty'. Root ḍ-r-‘.
usage: Paired with دعاها 'prayers'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): it harms us. Root ḍ-r-r.
usage: Aqdas: لن تضرّنا سیّئاتکم 'your evil doings can never harm Us'.

definition: Jussive of iḍṭaraba with lá: do not be agitated, troubled. Root ḍ-r-b.
Imperfect, second person masculine singular, of ḍalla 'to go astray, err'. Root ḍ-l-l.
usage: 'Go astray'; in warnings lest one go astray from the path.

definition: Verb (form II): jussive 2nd plural of ḍayya‘a "to waste, squander"; lá tuḍayyi‘ú "waste not". Root ḍ-y-‘.
usage: Waste; in lá tuḍayyi‘ú 'waste not', e.g. your lives or deeds.

definition: Verb ṭala‘a "to rise (of the sun)", imperfect 3rd feminine singular: it rises. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: 'Rises', of the sun of truth rising from the horizon.

definition: Verbal noun (form II): purification, cleansing. Root ṭ-h-r.
usage: Purification of body and heart; the Aqdas speaks of the purification of things and of souls.

definition: Verb (form I imperfect, 3rd fem.): she circles around, circumambulates. Root ṭ-w-f.
usage: Circling, as in circumambulating the Kaaba or the holy shrine; souls circling around the Cause.

definition: Verbal noun form II: lengthening, prolonging. Root ṭ-w-l.
usage: Prolonging; often in 'to avoid prolixity' (از تطویل).

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd person feminine of ṭára: to fly, soar. Root ṭ-y-r.
usage: 'Soar', of the bird of the soul soaring in the atmosphere of nearness to God.

definition: Verb, Form IV imperfect subjunctive + "me": be able to bear or contain me. Root ṭ-w-q.
usage: Be able to bear or contain Me; of the creature's inability to comprehend God.

definition: Imperfect second plural of ẓanna 'to think, suppose, imagine'. Root ẓ-n-n.
usage: Ye imagine, of vain imaginings set against certitude.

definition: Imperative: come ye. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: In the Aqdas هلمّوا و تعالوا 'hasten and come'.

definition: Verb: subjunctive 2nd plural of ‘abada, 'to worship'. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: In the Qur'anic formula الاّ تعبدوا الاّ اللّه 'that ye worship none but God'.

definition: Arabic verb, form II passive imperfect: is expressed, described. Root ‘-b-r.
usage: Aqdas: worlds that لا تعبّر بالعبارة 'cannot be described in words'.

pos: verb 2pl masc. impf. jussive (form VIII) + pron.
definition: Verb form VIII: to transgress, overstep. Root ‘-d-w.
usage: From تلک حدود الله فلا تعتدوها 'These are the bounds of God; transgress them not'.

definition: Verbal noun of form V: multiplicity, plurality. Root ‘-d-d.
usage: In the Íqán the Manifestations are sanctified from multiplicity (تعدّد).

definition: Verbal noun: transgression, aggression, oppression. Root ‘-d-w.
usage: Paired with ظلم و جبر 'tyranny and oppression'.

definition: Verb, form II jussive: strip, bare. Root ‘-r-y.
usage: لا تعرّ نفسک عن جمیل ردائی 'Divest not thyself of My beauteous robe'.

definition: Accusative of ta‘arruḍ (form V): opposing, confronting, reproaching. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
notes: Reading and sense of the quoted verse uncertain without the full passage.

definition: Verb: 'thou knowest, recognizest' with -ná 'Us'. Root ‘-r-f.
Imperfect subjunctive 2nd person masculine singular of ‘arafa with -há: (that) thou know them. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: see things with thine own eye and know them through thine own knowledge.

definition: Verb ‘arafa 'to know' present 2nd plural with -hu 'it'. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: In the Aqdas ما لا تعرفونه الیوم 'that which ye know not today'.

definition: Verbal noun of form II ‘aṭṭala: leaving idle, suspending, hindering; in modern Persian 'holiday, closure'. Root ‘-ṭ-l.
Attachment, belonging, dependence. Root ‘-l-q.
usage: In the Íqán of detaching the soul from worldly things: روح را از تعلّق باسباب ظاهره.

definition: Plural of ta‘alluq: attachments, ties. Root ‘-l-q.
usage: Worldly attachments from which the heart must be sanctified, as in از همهٔ تعلقات مقدس.

definition: Verb, present 3rd person feminine: returns. Root ‘-w-d.
usage: In the tradition منهم خرجت الفتنة و الیهم تعود 'from them hath sedition gone forth, and to them it shall return'.

definition: Delay, postponement, hindrance. Form II verbal noun, root ‘-w-q.
usage: Íqán: ذکر تفصیل مایه تعویق ... 'a detailed account would delay the purpose'.

definition: Verbal noun of form VI: mutual cheating, mutual loss and gain. Root gh-b-n.
usage: یوم التغابن 'the Day of mutual loss' (Qur'an 64:9), a name of the Day of Judgement.

definition: Arabic verb (form V): it became dusty, soiled. Root gh-b-r.
usage: Aqdas: تغسیل ما تغبّر من الغبار 'washing what is soiled with dust'.

definition: Past of tagharrada: sang, warbled (of birds). Root gh-r-d.
Verbal noun of form II ghassala: washing thoroughly. Root gh-s-l.
usage: 'Washing'; in the Aqdas laws on washing the body of the dead.

definition: Verb: jussive of ghafala "to be heedless, neglect"; lá taghful "be not heedless". Root gh-f-l.
usage: Be heedless; in lá taghful 'be not heedless', against neglecting God.

definition: Verbal noun form V: singing, warbling, chanting. Root gh-n-y.
usage: Singing or warbling, of the nightingale of the spirit.

definition: Noun, plural of taghanní: singings, warblings, melodies. Root gh-n-y.
usage: The warblings of the Nightingale or Dove of revelation.

definition: Verb (form IV imperfect, 3rd fem.) with 2nd pl. object: (will not) avail you, profit you. Root gh-n-y.
usage: 'Will not avail you', of worldly goods and learning at the Day of God.

definition: Verb, perfect form V 3rd masc. sing.: it changed, was altered. Root gh-y-r.
Noun, plural of taghyír 'change, alteration'. Root gh-y-r.
usage: 'Changes', of changes in laws and conditions with each new Dispensation.

definition: taghyír (Form II verbal noun: change, alteration) + indefinite -í. Root gh-y-r.
usage: Any change; of the unchanging Faith of God.

definition: Plural of tafsír: commentaries, interpretations. Root f-s-r.
usage: Commentaries and interpretations of scripture; the Kitáb-i-Íqán criticises literal تفاسیر of the divines.

definition: Jussive of form VIII iftakhara 'to boast, glory'; with lá: boast not. Root f-kh-r.
usage: In the Hidden Words لا تفتخر علی المسکین 'vaunt not thyself over the poor'.

definition: Verb: imperfect of iftaqara, 'to become poor, to be in need'. Root f-q-r.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words: خلقتک غنیّاً کیف تفتقر 'I made thee rich, why dost thou bring thyself down to poverty?'.

definition: Verbal noun (form V): sightseeing, strolling, contemplating with delight. Root f-r-j.
usage: With نمودن 'to gaze upon, behold'.

definition: Verb: to rejoice, be glad. Root f-r-ḥ.
Verb, form V perfect 3rd fem. sing.: dispersed, were scattered. Root f-r-q.
Verb: that it divide you. Root f-r-q.
usage: In the Aqdas: ایّاکم ان تفرّقکم شئونات النّفس و الهوی 'beware lest the desires of self divide you'.

definition: Noun tafṣíl 'detail' with indefinite ی: a detailed account. Root f-ṣ-l.
Plural of tafaqqud: solicitous care, kindly attentions. Root f-q-d.
usage: تفقّدات ربّانیّه "divine favours, loving-kindness".

definition: Verb: 'it receives, accepts him', subjunctive. Root q-b-l.
Verbal noun of form II qabbala: kissing. Root q-b-l.
usage: In the Aqdas قد حرّم علیکم تقبیل الایادی 'the kissing of hands hath been forbidden you'.

definition: Verb qadara 'to be able', 2nd singular subjunctive after lan. Root q-d-r.
Verbal noun of form V taqaddama: going before, precedence; progress. Root q-d-m.
Sanctification, holiness. Root q-d-s.
usage: In the Hidden Words لتشهد فی سرّک لی تقدیساً علیّاً 'that thou mayest attest My lofty sanctity'.

definition: Verbal noun form II with -ka: your sanctification, holding you above. Root q-d-s.
Verb, 2nd person plural subjunctive: (that) you approach. Root q-r-b.
usage: In the Aqdas ایّاکم ان تقربوا خزائن حمامات العجم 'Beware lest ye enter the pools of Persian baths'.

definition: Taqarrub "drawing near, approach" (form V) with -kum "your". Root q-r-b.
usage: Aqdas on Ḥuqúqu'lláh: اراد تطهیر اموالکم و تقرّبکم 'He desireth to purify your possessions and to enable you to draw nigh'.

definition: Subjunctive 2nd person plural of qara’a 'to read, recite, study'. Root q-r-’.
usage: اذّناکم بان تقرؤوا من العلوم ما ینفعکم 'We have permitted you to study such sciences as are of benefit'.

definition: Verbal noun: statement, oral exposition, speech; also confirmation. Root q-r-r.
usage: Paired with تحریر 'writing': تقریر و تحریر 'speech and writing'.

definition: Taqṣír with indefinite -í: a fault, shortcoming. Root q-ṣ-r.
Imperfect of form IV aq‘ada 'to make sit, hold back' plus -hu 'it'. Root q-‘-d.
usage: 'Make it sit, hold it back'; in images of what keeps a soul from rising.

definition: Verb: subjunctive 2nd plural of qa‘ada "to sit". Root q-‘-d.
Verb qála "to say", jussive 2nd masculine singular: (do not) say. Root q-w-l.
notes: lá taqul má lá taf‘al say not that which thou doest not.

definition: Verbal noun (form V): turning about, fluctuation. Root q-l-b.
usage: Turning about or fluctuation, of the changing conditions of the world or of the heart.
notes: Qur'an 2:144.

definition: Verb (form II imperfect, 3rd fem.) with 3rd masc. object: turns it about, overturns it. Root q-l-b.
usage: Turning or overturning, as of hearts turned by God.

definition: Arabic accusative adverb of taqlíd 'imitation': by imitation, blindly following. Root q-l-d.
usage: By imitation; blind imitation (تقلید) of forebears is condemned in favour of independent search.

definition: Adjective, feminine form: imitative, based on blind tradition. Root q-l-d.
usage: 'Imitative', of beliefs held by blind imitation (تقلید), which the Writings call on seekers to abandon for independent investigation.

definition: Verbal noun, Form II: paring, trimming (of nails). Root q-l-m.
usage: Paring of nails, a hygiene law in the Aqdas.

definition: Subjunctive second plural of qála 'to say' (after an): that ye say. Root q-w-l.
usage: That ye say, often in warnings against saying what ye do not know.

definition: Present of qáma 'to stand, rise': thou standest; taqúmu ‘alá'l-ḥisáb 'thou shalt stand to give account'. Root q-w-m.
Noun: piety, fear of God, godliness. Root w-q-y.
usage: زهد و تقوی 'asceticism and piety'; Arabic بالبرّ و التّقوی 'righteousness and piety'.

definition: Arabic verb, jussive 2nd plural of qása: measure, compare. Root q-y-s.
usage: Aqdas: لا تقیسوا کتاب اللّه بأهوائکم 'measure not the Book of God by your desires'.

definition: Noun: effort, striving, struggle.
Noun, plural of tilmídh: pupils, disciples. Root t-l-m-dh.
Verb: that she remain, tarry, wait. Root l-b-th.
usage: In the Aqdas, of a wife waiting after news of her husband's death or absence.

definition: Verbal noun, form II: deceit, imposture, disguising falsehood as truth. Root l-b-s.
usage: تلبیس باطل 'the deception of falsehood'.

definition: Persian adjective: bitter, harsh to the taste; figuratively painful.
Verbal noun (accusative of purpose): showing kindness, graciousness. Root l-ṭ-f.
Verbal noun of form II laṭṭafa: refining, making delicate or graceful. Root l-ṭ-f.
Verbal noun talṭíf 'refining, making delicate' with -kum 'your'. Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: In the Aqdas انّه اراد تلطیفکم 'He hath desired your refinement'.

definition: Imperfect 2nd plural of la‘iba 'to play, sport'. Root l-‘-b.
usage: In the Aqdas: لیس هذا امر تلعبون به 'This is not a Cause which ye may make a plaything'.

definition: In front of, towards, by oneself. Root l-q-y.
usage: In the Aqdas توبوا الی اللّه تلقآء انفسکم 'return unto God and repent before your own selves'.

definition: Verbal noun form II: instilling, prompting, teaching by repetition. Root l-q-n.
usage: With نمودن 'to impart, teach'.

definition: Noun: watching, sightseeing, spectacle.
notes: From Arabic tamáshí 'walking about', fully Persian in use.

definition: The whole, entirety, all (tamám with abstract -í). Root t-m-m.
usage: HW: از تمامی نعیمم غفلت نمودی 'thou didst neglect all My bounties'.

definition: Imperfect 2nd person plural of mashá 'to walk'. Root m-sh-y.
usage: تمشون علی رجل واحدة 'walk with the same feet'.

definition: Arabic verb (form V): he came to own, possessed. Root m-l-k.
usage: Aqdas (Ḥuqúqu'lláh): الّذی تملّک مأة مثقال من الذّهب 'whoso possesseth a hundred mithqáls of gold'.

definition: Verbal noun: wish, longing, desire. Root m-n-y.
Jussive, second person masculine singular, of mana‘a 'to prevent, withhold'. Root m-n-‘.
usage: 'Withhold'; in commands not to withhold oneself from grace.

definition: Verb: imperfect 3rd feminine singular of mana‘a "to prevent, hinder" plus -hu "him". Root m-n-‘.
usage: Hinder him; ordinary verb, of what prevents a soul from turning to God.

definition: Verb mana‘a "to prevent", imperfect 3rd feminine singular with -hum: (it) hinders them. Root m-n-‘.
Verb, imperfect 2nd person masculine plural: you prevent, withhold, deny. Root m-n-‘.
usage: To withhold or deprive, in rebukes to those who keep others from God's grace.

definition: Verb (form I subjunctive, 3rd fem.) with 2nd masc. object: prevent you, hinder you. Root m-n-‘.
usage: Of something hindering one from God, e.g. 'let nothing hinder thee'.

definition: Verb, perfect form V 1st sing.: I wished, longed for. Root m-n-y.
usage: I wished, longed for.

definition: Verb, imperfect subjunctive 2nd person singular of máta: to die. Root m-w-t.
usage: 'Die', of death, physical or spiritual, as in exhortations not to die in heedlessness.

definition: Verb, Form V past: it surged, billowed, rolled in waves. Root m-w-j.
usage: Surged; in the image of the Ocean of the Revelation surging.

definition: Verbal noun (form II): submission, obedience; empowerment. Root m-k-n.
usage: Submission and obedience, also empowerment.

definition: Arabic tamíz 'discernment, distinguishing' with Persian -and 'they are'. Root m-y-z.
usage: In the Íqán بی ادراک و تمیزند 'they are devoid of understanding and discernment'.

definition: Verb: imperfect of nádá, 'to call, to proclaim'. Root n-d-w.
usage: Aqdas: فیها تنادی سدرة المنتهی 'wherein the Sadratu'l-Muntahá calleth aloud'.

definition: Arabic verb, form VIII imperfect: ends, leads (with ilá 'to'). Root n-h-y.
usage: Aqdas: liberty تنتهی عواقبها الی الفتنة 'must in the end lead to sedition'.

definition: Verb: to descend, come down. Root n-z-l.
Verbal noun of form II: sending down, revelation of scripture. Root n-z-l.
Verbal noun with 'thy': keeping thee pure, sanctifying thee. Root n-z-h.
usage: In theology تنزیه is declaring God free of all likeness; in the Hidden Words, detachment.

definition: Verb, form I jussive: thou forgettest. Root n-s-y.
usage: لا تنس وصایای 'forget not My counsels'.

definition: Verb nasaba, to ascribe, attribute; with لا "ascribe not". Root n-s-b.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words لا تنسب الی نفس ما لا تحبّه لنفسک "Ascribe not to any soul that which thou wouldst not have ascribed to thee".

definition: Verb: 'ye are thunderstruck, swoon away', form VII of ṣ-‘-q.
Subjunctive 2nd person masculine plural of naẓara (after an): that ye look, consider. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: In the Aqdas بان تنظروا ... بعین الانصاف 'to look ... with the eye of fairness'.

definition: Verbal noun: cleaning, cleansing. Root n-ẓ-f.
usage: In the Aqdas تنظیف ابدانکم 'the cleansing of your bodies'.

definition: Subjunctive of form VII inghamasa 'to be immersed, plunge'. Root gh-m-s.
notes: Aqdas: beware lest ye plunge your hands into the food.

definition: Form V: to breathe; لا تنفّس 'breathe not (a word of)'. Root n-f-s.
usage: In the Hidden Words لا تنفّس بخطإ احد 'breathe not the sins of others'.

definition: Verb form VII: to be split, cleft asunder. Root f-ṭ-r.
usage: Echoes Qur'an 82:1 اذا السماء انفطرت.

definition: Verb, present 3rd person feminine with 'us': benefits us. Root n-f-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas لن تضرّنا سیئاتکم کما لا تنفعنا حسناتکم 'Your evil deeds can never harm Us, neither can your good works profit Us'.

definition: Imperfect of nafa‘a "to benefit" with -kum: (it) benefits you. Root n-f-‘.
usage: Aqdas: الحرّیة الّتی تنفعکم 'the liberty that profiteth you'.

definition: Imperfect of form VII inqaṭa‘a 'to be cut off, cease'. Root q-ṭ-‘.
usage: لا تنقطع عنک لحظات الالطاف 'the glances of loving-kindness shall not cease'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): you find fault, resent, take vengeance. Root n-q-m.
usage: Qur'anic: هل تنقمون منّا الّا ان آمنّا باللّه 'do ye find fault with us only because we believe in God?'
notes: Rendering in the Íqán translation not verified.

definition: Present of nahá with 'us': you forbid us. Root n-h-y.
Imperfect, third person feminine, of náḥa 'to lament, wail'. Root n-w-ḥ.
usage: 'Laments'; of the dove or nightingale lamenting, an image of the soul's longing.

definition: Verb (form IV): imperfect of ankara "to deny, disapprove" plus -hu "it". Root n-k-r.
usage: Reject it, deny it; inkár is denial of truth.

definition: Verb form IV ankara "to deny", imperfect 2nd masculine plural: ye deny, reject. Root n-k-r.
usage: 'Ye deny', of those who reject the signs of God.

definition: Verb, imperfect 2nd person masculine plural (form IV) + -hu: you deny him. Root n-k-r.
usage: To deny Him; the rebuke of those who deny the new Manifestation though they believe in the former ones.

definition: Verbal noun (form II): threat, menace; tahdíd farmúdan = to threaten. Root h-d-d.
usage: Threat or menace, as in تهدید فرمودن.

definition: Persian plural of tuhmat 'accusation, slander'. Root w-h-m.
usage: Calumnies, false accusations, especially those levelled at the Manifestations.

definition: Adjective: powerful, mighty, able; from tavánistan to be able.
usage: 'Mighty, powerful', a divine attribute, as in the invocation بنام گوینده توانا 'In the Name of the Lord of Utterance, the Mighty'.
notes: bi-nám-i-gúyandih-yi taváná: In the Name of the Lord of Utterance, the Mighty.

definition: Verb, Form IV imperfect 3rd fem.: it gives, yields. Root '-t-y.
usage: Yields; of a tree yielding its fruit, echoing Qur'án 14:25.
notes: Qur'án 14:25.

definition: Passive imperfect of waṣafa 'to describe': lá túṣafu 'cannot be described'. Root w-ṣ-f.
usage: Cannot be described, of God's essence beyond all description.

definition: Imperative of form V tawaḍḍa’a: perform ritual ablutions. Root w-ḍ-’.
usage: In the Aqdas توضّأوا للصلوة 'perform ye your ablutions for prayer'.

definition: Verb: passive imperfect 2nd plural of wa‘ada, 'to promise'. Root w-‘-d.
usage: Qur'an 51:22: و فی السّمآء رزقکم و ما توعدون 'and in heaven is your sustenance and that which ye are promised'.

definition: Arabic verb, form II passive imperfect: thou art enabled, granted success. Root w-f-q.
Verb form II passive: to be granted success, be enabled. Root w-f-q.
Verb, form V subjunctive 2nd pl.: that ye pause, hesitate. Root w-q-f.
Noun: signed letter, rescript, especially of a religious authority. Root w-q-‘.
usage: In the Íqán of a letter of the Imám; later used for Shoghi Effendi's letters.

definition: Noun: royal signature; a signed epistle; a Tablet of the Báb. Root w-q-‘.
usage: For the Báb's letters, as in توقیعی صادر فرمودند 'He addressed an epistle'.

definition: Passive of walada: to be born; second plural subjunctive. Root w-l-d.
usage: In the Gospel words quoted in the Íqán لا بدّ لکم بأن تولدوا مرّة اخری "ye must be born again".

definition: Verb: 'it became enraptured, distraught with love', form V of w-l-h.
Subjunctive 2nd person masculine plural of form IV ámana 'to believe'; after lan, ye will not believe. Root ’-m-n.
usage: In the Aqdas ان لن تؤمنوا به لا تعترضوا علیه 'if ye believe not in Him, rise not against Him'.
notes: Spelled تؤمنوا; the search form writes ؤ as و.

definition: Verb ámana 'to believe', present 2nd plural. Root ’-m-n.
usage: Qur'anic أ تؤمنون ببعض الکتاب و تکفرون ببعض 'believe ye part of the Book and deny part?'
notes: Written تؤمنون.

definition: Verbal noun of form V tawahhama: imagining, fancy, supposition. Root w-h-m.
Plural of takbír 'magnifying God'; in Bahá'í law the repetitions of اللّه ابهی in the Prayer for the Dead. Root k-b-r.
usage: In the Aqdas ستّ تکبیرات 'six times Alláh-u-Abhá'.

definition: Verb: you conceal, hide. Root k-t-m.
usage: Qur'an 3:71 و تکتمون الحق 'and hide the truth'.

definition: Verb, present 3rd person feminine with 'it': dislikes, abhors it. Root k-r-h.
usage: In the Aqdas علی ما تکرهه انفسکم 'upon that which your souls abhor'.

definition: Honouring, showing reverence and respect. Form II verbal noun, root k-r-m.
usage: Paired with تعظیم, as in بکمال تعظیم و تکریم 'with the utmost reverence and honour'.

definition: Imperfect of kasila 'to be lazy, sluggish'. Root k-s-l.
usage: ما تکسل به هیاکلکم 'what induceth sluggishness in your bodies'.

definition: Arabic verb (form II): that you shroud him. Root k-f-n.
usage: Aqdas burial law: ان تکفّنوه فی خمسة اثواب 'shroud him in five sheets'.

definition: Verbal noun: wrapping a corpse in a shroud. Root k-f-n.
Noun: arrow, dart.
usage: 'Arrow'; used of arrows of affliction or of the glance of the Beloved.

definition: Noun: Persian plural of tír "arrow, dart" (here with izáfih).
usage: Arrows; often figuratively the arrows of affliction or of the enemies.

definition: Adjective tírih "dark, murky" with the izáfih sign: dark (of something).
Noun tír "arrow" + indefinite -í: an arrow.
usage: An arrow or dart, figurative of the darts of opponents and of afflictions.

definition: Comparative of thábit (firm, steadfast): firmer, more steadfast. Root th-b-t.
usage: Firmer, more steadfast; ثابت connotes firmness in the Covenant.

definition: Active participle (fem., izáfih form): fixed, firm, established. Root th-b-t.
notes: Final ە (U+06D5) carries the izáfih hamza in the source.

definition: Ordinal number: third, the third one. Root th-l-th.
usage: 'Third', in enumerations and in the counting of signs or stages.

definition: thání (second; Arabic) + -st (is).
Noun: wealth, riches. Root th-r-w.
usage: Wealth and riches, as in counsels on the right use of wealth.

definition: Noun: large serpent; the serpent into which Moses' rod was turned. Root th-‘-b.
usage: In the Íqán ثعبان قدرت 'the serpent of power' of Moses.

definition: Noun: mouth, front teeth; also frontier post. Root th-gh-r.
usage: Aqdas: ابتسم ثغر الوجود 'the lips of existence smiled'.

definition: Numeral: three (used with feminine nouns). Root th-l-th.
Noun: one third. Root th-l-th.
Numeral: three (written defectively ثلثة). Root th-l-th.
Numeral: eighty. Root th-m-n.
Numeral: eight; with عشرة, eighteen. Root th-m-n.
usage: Aqdas: ثمانی عشرة مرّة 'eighteen times'.

definition: Persian thamar "fruit" with suffix -ash "its": its fruit. Root th-m-r.
Noun: fruit; result. Root th-m-r.
Persian plural of thamar 'fruit': fruits, results. Root th-m-r.
usage: In the Íqán ثمرهای شهادت 'the fruits of martyrdom'.

definition: Noun: price, value. Root th-m-n.
usage: Qur'anic لیشتروا به ثمناً قلیلاً 'that they may sell it for a mean price'.

definition: Proper noun: Thamúd, ancient Arabian people to whom the prophet Ṣáliḥ was sent.
usage: In the Íqán from Qur'an 11:61 و الی ثمود اخاهم صالحاً 'and unto Thamúd We sent their brother Ṣáliḥ'.

definition: Thaná’ 'praise' with -hi: His praise. Root th-n-y.
Noun: garment, robe. Root th-w-b.
usage: Persian Hidden Words ثوب تکبر 'the robe of pride'.

definition: Noun, plural of thawb 'garment' with 'your'. Root th-w-b.
usage: In the Aqdas on cleanliness: لا یری من ثیابکم آثار الأوساخ 'no trace of dirt be seen upon your garments'.

definition: Perfect of já’a "to come": he/it came. Root j-y-’.
usage: Aqdas: لمّا جاء الوعد 'when the Promise came', of the fulfilment of prophecy.

definition: Perfect of já’a 'to come' with suffix 'them'. Root j-y-’.
usage: فلما جاءهم ما عرفوا کفروا به 'when there came unto them what they recognized, they disbelieved it' (Qur'an 2:89).

definition: Proper noun: Jábir (Jábir ibn ‘Abdi'lláh al-Anṣárí), companion who related the Tablet of Fáṭimih.
usage: Íqán: حدیث جابر در لوح فاطمه 'the tradition of Jábir concerning the Tablet of Fáṭimih'.

definition: Past of jádala: they disputed, argued. Root j-d-l.
Feminine active participle of jará 'to flow, run': flowing, running. Root j-r-y.
usage: 'Flowing'; as in انهار جاریه 'flowing rivers' of divine bounty.

definition: Noun: garment, robe, clothing.
usage: Garment; figuratively the robe of virtue or of the body.

definition: Noun jám "cup, goblet" with plural -há: cups.
usage: Cups or goblets, often of the cups of divine wine or love.
notes: Not jámih "garment".

definition: Noun ján "soul, life" + -ishán "their": their souls.
usage: Their souls; ján is soul and life, often offered in sacrifice for the Beloved.

definition: Compound adjective (ján, soul, with fazá, increasing): life-giving, soul-refreshing.
usage: Life-giving or soul-refreshing, of breezes and melodies of the Revelation.

definition: Plural of ján 'soul, life'.
usage: Souls, lives; often offered in sacrifice.

definition: Verb, perfect form III 3rd person plural: they strove, made efforts. Root j-h-d.
usage: From Qur'an 29:69 'whoso maketh efforts for Us', cited in the Seven Valleys and Íqán of the seeker's striving.
notes: Quran 29:69 'whoso maketh efforts for Us'.

definition: Adjective/adverb (literary): eternal, everlasting, for ever.
usage: Eternal, everlasting; often in poetic phrases of everlasting life.

definition: Intensive adjective/noun: tyrant, oppressor; as a name of God, the Compeller. Root j-b-r.
usage: Tyrant, and as divine name the Compeller (الجبّار).

definition: Adjective: cowardly, faint-hearted; a coward. Root j-b-n.
Noun: dominion, omnipotence; the realm of divine power, with suffix -ná 'Our'. Root j-b-r.
usage: One of the realms of mystical cosmology with ملکوت and لاهوت: فی ملکوتنا الأعلی و جبروتنا الأسنی 'in Our Kingdom on high and Our Dominion most exalted'.

definition: Noun jabarút 'dominion, realm of divine power' with 1st singular suffix. Root j-b-r.
usage: A realm above the material world, often paired with ملکوت 'Kingdom', as in جبروت باقی 'everlasting dominion'.

definition: Noun jabín 'forehead, brow' with pronoun 'his'. Root j-b-n.
Noun: earnestness, diligence, seriousness. Root j-d-d.
Noun plural: attractions, raptures, ecstatic transports. Root j-dh-b.
usage: In جذبات ذوق صمدانی 'raptures of divine delight'.

definition: Verb, form I perfect: it flowed, ran. Root j-r-y.
usage: قد جرت دموعی علی خدودی 'My tears have flowed down My cheeks'.

definition: Adjective: (of land) barren, without vegetation. Root j-r-z.
usage: From the Qur'anic الأرض الجرز "the barren land" (32:27).

definition: Noun: courage, daring; جرئت داشتن 'to dare'. Root j-r-'.
Noun: requital, reward, recompense. Root j-z-y.
usage: Qur'an 76:9 in the Íqán: لا نرید منکم جزاءً و لا شکوراً 'we seek from you neither recompense nor thanks'.

definition: Noun: recompense, reward or punishment. Root j-z-y.
Noun: impatience in grief, anguish, lamentation. Root j-z-‘.
usage: Paired with فزع in جزع و فزع 'consternation and alarm'.

definition: Partial, particular, minor; paired with کلّی 'universal'. Root j-z-’.
usage: In از کلّی و جزئی 'in every respect, great and small'.

definition: Adjective (feminine form): partial, minor, trivial. Root j-z-'.
usage: E.g. امور جزئیه 'trivial matters'.
notes: Written جزئیّه.

definition: Verb, simple past 1st person plural of justan 'to seek'; with تمسّک 'to hold fast'.
notes: In تمسّک جستیم 'we held fast'.

definition: Bodily, corporeal, physical; feminine agreeing with its noun. Root j-s-m.
usage: Íqán: منافی هوای جسمانیّه 'contrary to carnal desire'.

definition: Perfect 1st person plural of ja‘ala 'to make, appoint' with suffix 'her/them'. Root j-‘-l.
usage: Of the intercalary days: جعلناها مظاهر الهاء 'We have ordained them the manifestations of the letter Há'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): he made me. Root j-‘-l.
usage: Qur'anic (Moses): جعلنی من المرسلین 'and made me one of His Apostles'.

definition: Past of ja‘ala with 'you': he made you. Root j-‘-l.
Plural of ja‘lí 'invented, fabricated': fabrications, forgeries. Root j-‘-l.
usage: 'Fabrications'; of fabricated traditions and man-made inventions in religion.

definition: Noun: plural of jughd "owl".
usage: Owls; image of the ill-omened who dwell in ruins, contrasted with the nightingale.

definition: Verb jalasa "to sit", perfect 3rd masculine singular: he sat. Root j-l-s.
Verb (form I, past) 3rd person masculine plural of jalla: they were great, exalted. Root j-l-l.
usage: To be exalted, in doxologies such as جلّ جلاله 'exalted be His glory'.
notes: wa in jallú even though they be of high rank.

definition: Verbal noun julús (sitting) with 2nd pl. suffix: your sitting. Root j-l-s.
usage: Your sitting, e.g. in assemblies.
notes: God loves you to sit upon chairs.

definition: Noun: display, splendour, manifestation (of beauty).
usage: Manifestation, splendour of divine beauty; جلوه کردن 'to shine forth'.
notes: Final ە (U+06D5) carries the izáfih hamza in the source.

definition: Noun jamál 'beauty' with suffix -ishán 'their'. Root j-m-l.
usage: 'Their beauty', of the beauty of souls or of the Manifestations.

definition: Verb, Form I past 2nd plural + "it": you gathered it. Root j-m-‘.
usage: You amassed it; of worldly riches.

definition: Adverbial accusative: all together, entirely. Root j-m-‘.
usage: All together, as in جمیعاً 'all together'.

definition: Adjective: beautiful, comely, goodly. Root j-m-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words جمیل ردائی 'My beauteous robe'.

definition: Noun: the two wings, dual of janáḥ 'wing'. Root j-n-ḥ.
usage: Íqán: جناحی عین الیقین 'the wings of the eye of certitude'.

definition: Noun janna 'garden, paradise' with -ka: thy paradise. Root j-n-n.
usage: Hidden Words: جنّتک وصلی 'thy heavenly home, reunion with Me'.

definition: Noun jund 'army, host' with pronoun 'Our'. Root j-n-d.
Noun: soldier, one of an army. Root j-n-d.
notes: Reading uncertain from the short context.

definition: Abstract noun from جند 'army' with 'his': his soldiership, his hosts. Root j-n-d.
notes: Sense in the context is uncertain.

definition: Verbal noun, form III: striving, struggle; holy war. Root j-h-d.
usage: Bahá'u'lláh abolished holy war; the word survives in the sense of striving in the path of God.

definition: Plural of jáhil: the ignorant, the foolish. Root j-h-l.
usage: In the Persian Hidden Words ای جهلای معروف بعلم "O ye that are foolish, yet have a name to be wise".
notes: Final ی is the izáfih.

definition: Persian plural of jahl 'ignorance': acts or charges of ignorance. Root j-h-l.
Adjective and noun: young; a young man, a youth.
usage: In the Íqán, the words of Jesus' opponents: این جوان ناصری 'this Nazarene youth'.

definition: Noun, plural of jánib: sides, directions. Root j-n-b.
usage: As in اطراف و جوانب 'every side'.

definition: Plural of jawhar 'jewel, essence, substance' with -hu 'its'.
usage: In the Hidden Words prologue: اخذنا جواهره 'We have taken the inner essence thereof'.

definition: Jawhar 'essence, substance' with -há.
usage: In the Íqán's reading of امّها و نفسها و ذاتها و جوهرها.

definition: Plural of javharí: jewellers, assayers of gems.
Adjective: seeking, inquiring; with شدن 'to ask, inquire'.
Present 2sg of جستن "to seek": you seek (written جوئی).
usage: HW: معاشرتم را جوئی 'thou seekest My companionship'.
notes: Normalized from جوئی.

definition: Noun jayb 'bosom, opening of a garment' with suffix 'thy'. Root j-y-b.
usage: ادخل یدک فی جیبی لارفع رأسی عن جیبک 'put thy hand into My bosom, that I may rise above thee'.

definition: Noun جیب 'bosom, breast of a garment' with the suffix 'my'. Root j-y-b.
usage: HW: ادخل یدک فی جیبی 'put thy hand into My bosom'.

definition: Adjective in accusative: good, excellent, sound. Root j-w-d.
Feminine of jayyid 'good, excellent, fertile'. Root j-w-d.
usage: 'Goodly, fertile'; as in ارض جیده 'goodly soil', the image of the receptive heart.

definition: Verb: past 1st plural of já’a "to come". Root j-y-’.
usage: We have come; of the Manifestation's coming, as in ji'ná bi'l-ḥaqq 'We have come with the truth'.
notes: Normalized from جئنا.

definition: Adjective: sharp, keen, cutting. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: Sharp, as in بصر حاد 'keen sight'.

definition: Active participle (feminine): occurring, arising; as noun event. Root ḥ-d-th.
usage: Occurring, arising; as a noun an event, especially afflictions that come to pass (حوادث).

definition: Proper noun: Ḥárith, an Arabic personal name (ploughman). Root ḥ-r-th.
usage: An Arabic personal name; cited in Tablets and stories as the name of an individual.
notes: Naḍr ibn Ḥárith, an opponent of Muḥammad.

definition: Imperative form III of ḥásaba: call to account, reckon with. Root ḥ-s-b.
usage: Call to account, as in حاسب نفسک 'bring thyself to account' each day (Hidden Words).
notes: HW: ḥásib nafsaka 'Bring thyself to account'.

definition: Arabic ḥáṣil 'resulting, attained' + Persian -ast 'is'. Root ḥ-ṣ-l.
usage: 'Is attained', of a result or goal reached.

definition: ḥáḍir (present, ready; Arabic) + -am (I am). Root ḥ-ḍ-r.
Noun ḥál 'state, condition' + -ka 'thy'. Root ḥ-w-l.
usage: Thy state or condition.

definition: Active participle: bearing; as feminine, pregnant, with child. Root ḥ-m-l.
Active participle ḥákí 'telling, relating, indicative' with Persian -and 'they are'. Root ḥ-k-y.
Active participle: intervening, a barrier; with شدن 'to come between, prevent'. Root ḥ-w-l.
Interjection of praise: how excellent!, how good is ...! Root ḥ-b-b.
Verbal noun in the accusative: imprisonment. Root ḥ-b-s.
Noun حبّ 'love' with 'his'. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: حبّ is a key term, as in نار حبّ 'the fire of love'.
notes: Not Ḥabash 'Abyssinia' here.

definition: Noun ḥubb 'love' with suffix: thy love. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: فاسترح فی حبّک ایّای 'rest thou in thy love for Me'.

definition: Accusative of ḥabíb: beloved, friend, lover. Root ḥ-b-b.
Noun: pilgrimage. Root ḥ-j-j.
usage: In the Aqdas pilgrimage to the sacred House, obligatory on men who are able.

definition: Noun ḥijáb 'veil, screen, barrier', accusative as second object of ja‘ala. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: Veils are what keep the soul from God; the Aqdas warns the divines not to become a veil between God and His creatures.

definition: Noun, plural of ḥajar: stones. Root ḥ-j-r.
usage: Qur'anic فأمطر علینا حجارةً من السّمآء 'rain down stones upon us from heaven'.

definition: Proper noun: the Ḥijáz, region of western Arabia containing Mecca and Medina.
Of the Ḥijáz, i.e. Arabic; ببدایع نغمات حجازی 'in wondrous Arabian melodies'.
Plural of ḥijáb: veils, coverings. Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: Veils that hide the truth; Aqdas فی حجب الغیب 'behind the veils of the unseen'.

definition: Noun, Persian plural of ḥujjat: proofs, arguments, testimonies. Root ḥ-j-j.
usage: In the Writings the proof of God, chiefly the revealed verses; حجّت also a title of the Manifestation.

definition: Ḥujja "proof, argument" with -hum "their". Root ḥ-j-j.
usage: Qur'an 45:25 in the Íqán: ما کان حجّتهم الّا ان قالوا 'their only argument was to say'.

definition: Abstract noun: authority as proof, conclusive force. Root ḥ-j-j.
usage: حجّیّت آیات 'the proof of the verses', their authority as testimony.

definition: Plural of حدیقة: gardens. Root ḥ-d-q.
usage: Íqán: حدائق علم و قدرت 'the gardens of knowledge and power'.

definition: Ḥadd with 'their': their limit, bound, rank. Root ḥ-d-d.
notes: Reading and case in this hadith quotation unclear.

definition: Noun ḥadd 'limit, bound' plus -ka 'thy'. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: 'Thy limits'; in admonitions to know and not transgress one's limits.

definition: Noun ḥadd "limit, degree" plus indefinite -í. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: A degree, limit; in bih ḥaddí 'to such a degree'.

definition: Noun ḥadíth "saying, tradition" with -ná: our saying. Root ḥ-d-th.
usage: A saying or tradition (حدیث), often quoted from the Prophet or the Imáms.
notes: ḥadíthuná ṣa‘bun mustaṣ‘ab Our Word is abstruse.

definition: Noun ḥadíth "tradition, saying" + indefinite -í; chand ḥadíthí a few traditions. Root ḥ-d-th.
usage: A tradition of the Prophet or the Imams; the Íqán cites many traditions to show their inner meaning.

definition: Noun ḥadíqih (garden) with indefinite -’í: a garden. Root ḥ-d-q.
usage: A garden, image of the heart or spiritual garden in the Writings.
notes: Spelled حدیقه‌ئی in the text.

definition: Noun: difficulty, constraint, blame. Root ḥ-r-j.
usage: Blame, difficulty, as in لا حرج علیکم 'no blame upon you'.

definition: Noun: greed, covetousness, avidity. Root ḥ-r-ṣ.
usage: 'Greed', condemned in the Hidden Words as one of the veils of the soul, paired with آز and هوی.

definition: Dual (nominative) of ḥarf: two letters. Root ḥ-r-f.
usage: Two letters; of the letters ک and ن (Be!) through which God created.

definition: Passive perfect (form II) third feminine singular of ḥarrama 'to forbid': was made unlawful. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: Was made unlawful, in Aqdas laws such as حرّمت علیکم 'is forbidden you'.

definition: Noun: sanctity, inviolability, honour, respect. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: Sanctity and honour, as in حرمت 'the sanctity' of holy places or of the Cause.

definition: Noun: freedom, liberty. Root ḥ-r-r.
usage: True liberty lies in obeying God's commandments, as the Aqdas explains.

definition: Adjective: covetous, greedy, eager. Root ḥ-r-ṣ.
usage: Persian Hidden Words: لازال حریص محروم بوده 'the covetous hath ever been deprived'.

shift: Here: a sect or faction (each sect with what it hath). Today: a political party.
definition: Noun: party, faction, sect; modern Arabic and Persian 'political party'. Root ḥ-z-b.
usage: Echoing Qur'an 23:53, کلّ حزب بما لدیهم 'each sect with what it hath'; also حزب اللّه 'the party of God'.

definition: Persian plural of ḥuzn 'grief, sorrow'. Root ḥ-z-n.
Noun ḥasad 'envy' with indefinite -í. Root ḥ-s-d.
Noun: sorrow, regret, grief. Root ḥ-s-r.
usage: In the Qur'anic cry یا حسرةً علی العباد 'Oh, the misery of men!'.

definition: Adjective, accusative indefinite: good, beautiful, fair. Root ḥ-s-n.
usage: املک قلباً جیّداً حسناً منیراً 'possess a pure, kindly and radiant heart'.

definition: Plural of ḥasana: good deeds, merits. Root ḥ-s-n.
usage: Contrasted with سیّئات "evil deeds".

definition: Plural of ḥasanah 'good deed' with -kum. Root ḥ-s-n.
Ḥusn 'beauty, goodness' with indefinite -í: any good, a benefit. Root ḥ-s-n.
notes: Not al-ḥusná 'most beautiful', as in اسماء حسنی.

definition: Verb: came about, was obtained, accrued. Root ḥ-ṣ-l.
Adjective: chaste, abstaining from women; said of John the Baptist (Qur'an 3:39). Root ḥ-ṣ-r.
Accusative of ḥifẓ used adverbially: for the protection of. Root ḥ-f-ẓ.
usage: In the Aqdas حفظاً لانفسکم 'to protect you'.

definition: Noun ḥifẓ 'keeping, protection' with -ash: its keeping; حفظش نما 'preserve it'. Root ḥ-f-ẓ.
Noun, plural of ḥaqíqat 'reality' with Persian -shán 'their'. Root ḥ-q-q.
notes: Written حقائقشان in the source.

definition: Ḥaqq "true, right, real" + ast "is": is true. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: Íqán: ولایت و امامت و عبودیّت همه حقّست 'Guardianship, Imamate and servitude are all true'.

definition: Compound adjective: ungrateful to God or to truth; Arabic ḥaqq + Persian násipás.
Plural of حقّ 'right, due' with the suffix 'their': their rights, portions. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: Aqdas inheritance: ترجع حقوقهم الی بیت العدل 'their shares revert to the House of Justice'.

definition: Verbal noun: solving, untying, resolving. Root ḥ-l-l.
Noun ḥaláwah 'sweetness' plus -há 'its (feminine)'. Root ḥ-l-w.
usage: 'Its sweetness'; of tasting the sweetness of God's word.

definition: Verb (form II): past 1st plural of ḥallala "to make lawful, permit". Root ḥ-l-l.
usage: We made lawful; Aqdas formula for what God permits.

definition: Noun: dove, pigeon. Root ḥ-m-m.
usage: The dove, a poetic symbol of the soul or of the Manifestation singing God's praise.
notes: ḥamámatu’l-baqá’ the Dove of eternity.

definition: Noun: dove, pigeon. Root ḥ-m-m.
usage: Dove, a symbol of the Manifestation or the Holy Spirit, as in the Dove of holiness singing God's melodies.
notes: ٴ marks the izáfih.

definition: Plural of ḥimár: donkeys, asses. Root ḥ-m-r.
usage: Donkeys, as in the Qur'anic simile of those 'like asses' who carry books without understanding.
notes: Qur'án 74:50, ḥumurun mustanfiratun = affrighted asses.

definition: Broken plural of aḥmaq 'fool' + izáfih: the foolish of. Root ḥ-m-q.
Verb, perfect 3rd person feminine singular of ḥamala: it bore, carried. Root ḥ-m-l.
usage: 'Bore', of a woman bearing a child or of bearing a burden.

definition: Verbal noun ḥaml (carrying, bearing) + "it". Root ḥ-m-l.
usage: To bear; of bearing God's trust.
notes: Not Persian ḥamlih (attack).

definition: Noun: zeal, fervour, partisan pride; ḥamiyyat al-jáhiliyya 'the zeal of the Age of Ignorance'. Root ḥ-m-y.
usage: Zeal or partisan pride, as in حمیّة الجاهلیّة 'the zealotry of the Age of Ignorance'.

definition: Verbal noun: yearning, moaning, plaintive crying. Root ḥ-n-n.
usage: In the Aqdas نسمع حنین البرلین 'We hear the lamentations of Berlin'.

definition: Noun: events, incidents, vicissitudes; plural of ḥáditha. Root ḥ-d-th.
Noun: fish, great fish, whale. Root ḥ-w-t.
usage: A lover's image: the fish whose thirst no ocean quenches.

definition: Plural of ḥúriyyah: heavenly maidens. Root ḥ-w-r.
usage: Symbol of hidden meanings, as حوریات معانی 'the maidens of inner meaning'.

definition: Noun: maiden of paradise, houri. Root ḥ-w-r.
usage: In the Writings the Maid of Heaven (حوریّه) who personifies the Spirit of God.

definition: Preposition حول 'around' with 'him, it'. Root ḥ-w-l.
Verbal noun: narration; indication, reflection. Root ḥ-k-y.
usage: اشدّ دلالةً و اعظم حکایةً 'more potent in its testimony and greater in revealing'.
notes: Accusative of specification in a Persian sentence.

definition: Plural of ḥakím: the wise, sages, philosophers. Root ḥ-k-m.
notes: Final ی is the izáfih.

definition: Persian plural of ḥikmat 'wisdom' with است: 'there are wise purposes'. Root ḥ-k-m.
Plural ḥikam of ḥikma 'wisdom' with -há: its wisdoms. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: In a saying quoted in the Íqán: الی کنائز حکمها عادت 'unto the treasuries of its wisdom they return'.
notes: Could also be ḥukmuhá 'its ruling'; the context favours ḥikam.

definition: Noun, Persian plural of ḥukm 'law, decree' with izáfih. Root ḥ-k-m.
Perfect 3rd plural of ḥakama 'to judge, rule, govern'. Root ḥ-k-m.
Pertaining to wisdom or philosophy. Root ḥ-k-m.
Noun ḥukúmat with indefinite -í: rule, dominion; in modern Persian 'government'. Root ḥ-k-m.
Noun, plural of ḥawḍ 'pool, basin' with 'their'. Root ḥ-w-ḍ.
usage: In the Aqdas حیاضهم المنتنة اترکوها 'their foul-smelling pools; avoid them'.

definition: Pools, cisterns (plural of ḥawḍ) with -í "my". Root ḥ-w-ḍ.
usage: HW: لا تحرم نصیبک من بدیع حیاضی 'deprive not thyself of thy portion from My wondrous fountains'.

definition: Noun: stratagem, trick, device, cunning. Root ḥ-y-l.
Noun حیاة 'life' (old spelling حیوة) with the suffix 'your'. Root ḥ-y-y.
usage: Aqdas: تمرّ ایّام حیوتکم 'the days of your life pass'.

definition: Noun: end, conclusion, close. Root kh-t-m.
Noun: thorn, bramble.
usage: 'Thorn'; contrasted with the rose, of the trials of the path.

definition: Noun: Persian plural of khár "thorn".
usage: Thorns; image of afflictions, as in the thorns on the path of love.

definition: Noun khár "thorn" with indefinite -í: a thorn.
usage: A thorn, often contrasted with the rose; thorns of tests and adversity.

definition: Noun khár "thorn" + copula -íd "you (plural) are".
usage: Thorn, contrasted with the rose (گل) in the Persian Hidden Words.
notes: názir-i khár-íd ye gaze upon the thorn.

definition: Plural of kháshák: brushwood, chaff, rubbish, thorns.
usage: Brushwood or chaff, of vain things or the obstructing rubbish of worldly desires.

definition: Active participle (accusative, circumstantial): humble, submissive. Root kh-sh-‘.
usage: Humble, submissive before God.

definition: Adjective: special, particular, specific. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: 'Special, particular', as in خاص و عام 'high and low, everyone'.

definition: Active participle (accusative): sinner, one who errs. Root kh-ṭ-'.
Persian plural of kháṭi’ 'sinner, wrongdoer'. Root kh-ṭ-’.
usage: Sinners, as in prayers for forgiveness of sinners.

definition: Feminine active participle used as noun: what is hidden; a secret. Root kh-f-y.
usage: In the Aqdas یعلم خافیة القلوب 'He knoweth the secrets of the hearts'.

definition: Adjective used adverbially: purely, sincerely, solely. Root kh-l-ṣ.
usage: Íqán: خالصاً للّه 'purely for the sake of God'.

definition: Active participle: creator, maker; God as the Creator. Root kh-l-q.
usage: God as Creator, as in خالق کن فکان 'the Creator of "Be, and it was"'.

definition: Adjective: empty, void, devoid of. Root kh-l-w.
Noun: being put out, extinction; also silence.
Noun: house, home.
Noun: dustbin, heap of dust; figuratively this earthly world. Persian.
usage: خاکدان ترابی 'this mortal world'.

definition: Plural of khá’if: fearing, fearful, afraid. Root kh-w-f.
notes: Written خائفین.

definition: Verb: 'it was bad, corrupt'. Root kh-b-th.
usage: Qur'an 7:58 و الّذی خبث لا یخرج الّا نکدا 'and from the bad land naught cometh forth but scantily'.
notes: In Persian prose خبث is the noun khubth 'wickedness'.

definition: Adjective khabíth (Arabic 'foul, wicked, malicious') with a final -í and the izáfih: wicked, evil. Root kh-b-th.
usage: In the Íqán ظنون خبیثهٔ شیطانیّه 'evil and satanic fancies'.
notes: Spelled خبیثئ in the source; the ending is unusual and may be a variant of خبیثهٔ.

definition: Noun khitám 'seal, end' with -hu 'its'. Root kh-t-m.
usage: Qur'anic ختامه مسک 'whose seal is musk', cited in the Íqán.

definition: Plural of khádim 'servant, attendant'. Root kh-d-m.
usage: In the Íqán خدّام درگه او 'the servants at His threshold', who hold sway over all.

definition: Plural of khudá 'god': gods.
Noun khidmat 'service' with -shán: their service, attendance upon them. Root kh-d-m.
Noun: a hard white-poplar wood used for arrows; an arrow.
usage: In a verse quoted in the Íqán: the lame ass mounted on the wind, swift as an arrow.

definition: Cheeks (plural of khadd) with -í "my". Root kh-d-d.
usage: Aqdas: قد جرت دموعی علی خدودی 'My tears have flowed down My cheeks'.

definition: Plural of khurṭún: earthworms; contemptuous of base men. Root kh-r-ṭ-n.
usage: خراطین ارض 'worms of the dust', of those who cling to the letter.

definition: Persian verb خرامیدن 'walk gracefully, stride', 2sg: that thou stride.
usage: HW: اگر از ملک فانی برتر خرامی 'if thou soarest above the mortal realm'.

definition: Verbal noun: tearing, rending, piercing. Root kh-r-q.
Arabic kharq 'rending, tearing' plus Persian -ash 'its'. Root kh-r-q.
usage: 'Its rending'; in the image of rending the veils.

definition: Verbal noun kharq "tearing, rending" plus -há "its". Root kh-r-q.
usage: Its rending; of rending veils (kharq al-ḥujubát).

definition: Noun: freshness, joy, cheerfulness.
usage: Freshness or joy, of spiritual verdure.

definition: Noun khar "donkey, ass" + plural -há.
usage: Donkeys, figurative of the foolish, a term of rebuke for the heedless.
notes: Final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Noun: autumn. Root kh-r-f.
usage: Autumn, contrasted with spring as the season of withering; image of spiritual decline.

definition: Broken plural of khizána + -í: My treasuries. Root kh-z-n.
usage: My treasuries, the treasuries of God's bounty.
notes: Written خزائنی.

definition: Noun: treasury, storehouse. Root kh-z-n.
usage: 'Treasury', of God's treasuries of grace and knowledge.

definition: Noun (accusative): loss, perdition. Root kh-s-r.
usage: Loss; of those in manifest loss.
notes: Qur'án 35:39.

definition: Verbal noun: eclipse (of the moon). Root kh-s-f.
usage: Eclipse, especially the lunar eclipse; also in signs of the Day of God.

definition: Persian plural of Arabic khashab 'wood, timber'. Root kh-sh-b.
usage: In the Íqán خشبهای مسنّده 'propped-up blocks of wood', after Qur'an 63:4, of lifeless followers.

definition: Verb: perfect of khaṣṣa, 'to single out, to reserve for'. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: Aqdas: قد خصّ اللّه هذا المقام لنفسه 'God hath reserved this station unto Himself'.

definition: Noun khiṣál, plural of khaṣla 'trait', with -í: My qualities. Root kh-ṣ-l.
usage: Hidden Words: الکرم و الجود من خصالی 'generosity and bounty are attributes of Mine'.

definition: Verb form II: to single out, set apart, assign. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
Verb, perfect of khaṣṣa with 3rd masc. suffix: He reserved it, singled it out. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
Verb: he submitted, humbled himself, bowed. Root kh-ḍ-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas: هذا الأمر الّذی خضع له الملأ الأعلی 'this Cause before which the Concourse on High hath bowed'.

definition: Verbal noun: humility, lowliness, submissiveness. Root kh-ḍ-‘.
usage: Often with خشوع, as in بتمام خضوع 'in utter humility'.

definition: Persian plural of khaṭá: errors, faults, wrongs. Root kh-ṭ-’.
Plural of khaṭí'ah 'sin, error'; the final ی links the izáfih. Root kh-ṭ-'.
Plural of khuṭba: sermons, orations, homilies. Root kh-ṭ-b.
usage: In the Íqán the Báb's writings are listed as آیات و خطب و صحائف و مناجات 'verses, homilies, treatises and prayers'.

definition: Adjective (Arabic khaṭar + Persian -nák): dangerous, perilous. Root kh-ṭ-r.
Adjective khaṭír 'grave, momentous, weighty' with indefinite -í. Root kh-ṭ-r.
Imperative of kháfa 'to fear': fear! Root kh-w-f.
usage: In the Aqdas خف عن اللّه 'fear God'.

definition: Past participle of خفتن 'to sleep': asleep, sleeping.
Verb, past 1st person singular with 'you': I feared you. Root kh-w-f.
usage: In Moses' words (Qur'an 26:21) ففررت منکم لمّا خفتکم 'I fled from you when I feared you'.

definition: Lowering, humbling; خفض جناح "lowering the wing", i.e. humility and kindliness. Root kh-f-ḍ.
usage: From the Qur'anic command to lower one's wing (15:88, 17:24); here of humility toward the believers.

definition: Perfect 1st person plural of form II khaffafa 'to lighten, make easy'. Root kh-f-f.
usage: خفّفنا ما اردناه لکم 'We have lightened that which We desired for you'.

definition: Adjective: hidden, secret, concealed. Root kh-f-y.
usage: HW: در لوح یاقوتی از قلم خفیّ ثبت شده 'inscribed by the pen of the hidden on the ruby tablet'.

definition: Plural of khafiyya: hidden things, secrets. Root kh-f-y.
Imperative, masculine singular, of form II khallá 'to leave, let go'. Root kh-l-w.
usage: 'Leave'; in commands to leave the world and turn to God.

definition: Noun: deliverance, release, salvation. Root kh-l-ṣ.
usage: Deliverance, release; ordinary word for being freed.

definition: Noun, plural of khil‘a: robes of honour, bestowed garments. Root kh-l-‘.
usage: Robes of honour, figurative of divine bestowals.
notes: Reading uncertain: khila‘ (robes) or khal‘ (taking off); the context (singled out "bi-ín khila‘") favours robes.

definition: Noun khalf "back, rear" + -hi "him": behind him. Root kh-l-f.
usage: Behind him, as in turning one's back on or casting something behind.

definition: Verb (form I perfect passive, 2nd pl.): you were created. Root kh-l-q.
usage: 'Ye were created', of the purpose for which humanity was created.

definition: Noun khalq 'creation, creatures' + -hi 'his'. Root kh-l-q.
usage: His creatures, His creation.

definition: Verb, perfect of khalaqa with -kum: He created you. Root kh-l-q.
usage: 'He created you', of God as Creator, in reminders of the purpose of creation.

definition: Verb, Form I past 3rd plural: they were alone, withdrew in private. Root kh-l-w.
usage: They are alone; of people in private.

definition: Noun: solitude, privacy, retreat; khalvat kardan 'to be alone'. Root kh-l-w.
usage: Solitude or private retreat, as in خلوت with God.

definition: Numeral: five (with feminine nouns). Root kh-m-s.
usage: In the Aqdas یذکر خمس مرّات 'repeat five times'.

definition: Numeral: fifty. Root kh-m-s.
Persian noun khváb 'sleep, dream' with indefinite -í: a dream.
notes: The و after خ is silent.

definition: Compound adjective: humiliating, abasing (one who makes contemptible).
notes: Persian rendering of Qur'anic عذاب مهین.

definition: Verb, past 3rd pl. of khástan: they wanted, sought.
Noun plural: special properties, qualities; also the elite. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
Noun: table, tablecloth spread with food. Persian.
usage: بر یک خوان مجتمع میشوند 'gather at one table'.
notes: The و is silent.

definition: Persian plural of kháhish "desire, wish": desires, cravings.
notes: The و is silent; final ی is the izáfih.

definition: Noun خورشید 'sun' with -í: 'a sun; sunlike'.
Nisba of the town of Khuy in Azerbaijan; Mullá Mihdíy-i-Khu’í, a Bábí martyr named in the Íqán.
Noun khayál 'fancy, imagination' with Persian copula -íd 'ye are'. Root kh-y-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words ساجد خیالید 'ye bow down before a fancy'.

definition: Noun: the choice, the best, the elite. Root kh-y-r.
usage: In the Aqdas of the God-fearing: اولئک من خیرة الخلق 'these are among the best of creation'.

definition: Thread, cord. Root kh-y-ṭ.
usage: In the Íqán خیط محکم و حبل مستحکم 'the firm cord and the mighty rope'.

definition: Noun: tent, pavilion. Root kh-y-m.
usage: خیمه 'tabernacle', e.g. خیمهٔ امر 'the tabernacle of the Cause'.

definition: Noun: tent, pavilion. Root kh-y-m.
usage: In the Hidden Words خیمهٔ یک‌رنگ تراب 'the tabernacle of dust, of one colour'.
notes: Written with the letter ە (U+06D5) in the source.

definition: Any creature that moves on the earth; beast, animal. Root d-b-b.
usage: Qur'an 35:45 in the Íqán: ما ترک علی ظهرها من دابّة 'He would not leave on its back a single creature'.

definition: Past 1st person singular of دادن 'to give'; آبش دادم 'I watered it'.
Persian verb داشتن 'have, hold', present perfect: you have held; with محسوب 'have accounted'.
usage: HW: از دوستان خالص محسوب داشته‌اید 'ye have accounted yourselves among the sincere friends'.

definition: Past of dáma; with má, as long as. Root d-w-m.
Short infinitive of dánistan 'to know'; after báyad 'one must know'.
usage: In باید دانست 'it must be known', a common formula introducing an explanation.

definition: Verb: present perfect 2nd plural of dánistan "to know; to deem, consider".
usage: Have deemed, have known; ordinary verb form.
notes: Normalized from دانسته‌اید.

definition: Verb dánistan "to know", past 1st plural: we knew, we considered.
Verb, present 2nd person singular of dánistan: you know; deem, consider.
usage: You know or deem; often in rhetorical questions, 'dost thou deem...'.

definition: Active participle (fem., accusative): low, base, near. Root d-n-w.
usage: Low or near, of fruits hanging low within reach (Qur'an 69:23), or of base things.
notes: Ja‘alta nafsaka dániyatan = thou hast abased thyself.

definition: Active participle (fem.) of daná: low, near, base. Root d-n-w.
usage: Low, lowly, near at hand.

definition: Proper noun: David, the prophet-king.
usage: David, the prophet-king, mentioned among the Prophets of Israel and as author of the Psalms.

definition: Active participle: lasting, permanent, perpetual. Root d-w-m.
Feminine of dá’im: lasting, everlasting, perpetual. Root d-w-m.
usage: Everlasting, as in نعمت دائمه 'everlasting bounty'.

definition: Adjective: permanent, perpetual, everlasting. Root d-w-m.
usage: In the Íqán موت دائمی 'everlasting death', spiritual death.

shift: Here: a school of any kind. Today: a primary school (دبستان).
definition: Noun dabistán 'school' with indefinite -í: any school. In modern Persian دبستان means primary school.
Arabic verb, perfect 2nd singular of dakhala: thou didst enter. Root d-kh-l.
Verb: to enter; ye entered. Root d-kh-l.
Verb, perfect 3rd masc. pl. of dakhala: they entered. Root d-kh-l.
Noun: entry, connection, relevance; دخل داشتن 'to bear upon'. Root d-kh-l.
Verb, imperative of درآوردن: bring in; بنظر درآرید 'call to mind, picture'. Persian.
Subjunctive of درآوردن "to bring in, bring into": (that) I bring into.
Present subjunctive of درآمدن 'to enter, come in': 'that ye enter'.
Simple past 3rd person singular of dar-bákhtan 'to lose (at play), stake': he lost, gave up (his life).
usage: In the Íqán جان را درباخت 'he laid down his life'.

definition: Verb, present subjunctive of darbákhtan 'to stake, lose (in play)'; ján darbákhtan 'to lay down one's life'.
Subjunctive 3rd plural of dar-bákhtan 'to stake, give up, sacrifice'.
usage: In جان دربازند 'they lay down their lives'.

definition: Present subjunctive of dar-bastan 'to bind, fasten': that he bind (himself) to.
notes: Possibly to be read as part of the phrase بربّ الارباب دربندد 'cleave unto the Lord of Lords'.

definition: Plural of daraja: degrees, ranks. Root d-r-j.
usage: Qur'an 2:253 و رفع بعضهم درجات 'and some He raised in rank'.

definition: Adjective: painful, grievous.
usage: In عذابی دردناک 'a grievous chastisement'.

definition: Grasping, comprehension, perception; attaining. Root d-r-k.
usage: Íqán: فهم کلمات الهیّه و درک بیانات 'understanding the divine words and apprehending the utterances'.

definition: Plural of daraka: descending levels, depths (of hell), opposite of daraját. Root d-r-k.
usage: اسفل درکات نیران 'the nethermost depths of the fire'.

definition: Persian verb درکشیدن 'draw over, draw through', subjunctive: that he draw.
usage: Íqán: بر عاصیان قلم عفو درکشد 'draw the pen of forgiveness over the sinful'.

definition: Noun, poetic short form of dargáh: threshold, court.
Relative adjective of durr 'pearls': pearly, glittering like a pearl. Root d-r-r.
usage: 'Pearly, glittering'; Qur'anic كوكب درّی, a glittering star.

definition: Noun: sea, ocean (here with izáfih).
usage: Sea, ocean; often the ocean of God's knowledge or grace (daryá-yi ‘ilm).

definition: Relational adjective, feminine: pearl-like, brilliant, glittering. Root d-r-r.
usage: Pearl-like or brilliant, often of verses or words of God.

definition: Noun dast "hand" + -at "your (singular)": thy hand.
usage: Thy hand; of deeds done by one's own hand.

definition: Plural of dast (hand) with -ash (his): his hands.
Noun dast 'hand' + indefinite -í.
Noun du‘á 'prayer, supplication' with Persian plural -há. Root d-‘-w.
usage: 'Prayers, supplications', of prayers to God; the obligatory prayer is صلوة.

definition: Plural of da‘vá: claims, pretensions, assertions. Root d-‘-w.
usage: Claims; of the divines' pretensions.

definition: Noun du‘á’ 'prayer, supplication' + -hu 'his'. Root d-‘-w.
usage: Prayer or supplication, as in دعا 'prayer'.

definition: Past of da‘á 'to call, invoke' with -hu 'him': ye called upon Him. Root d-‘-w.
usage: In the Aqdas الّذی دعوتموه فی العشیّ و الاشراق 'Him Whom ye invoked at eventide and at dawn'.

definition: Verb: perfect 1st plural of da‘á, 'to call, to summon', with suffix -hu. Root d-‘-w.
Arabic imperative plural of yada‘ 'to leave' with -hu: leave him. Root w-d-‘.
usage: Aqdas: دعوه بنفسه 'leave him to himself'.

definition: Persian plural of da'vá 'claim, pretension' with izáfih. Root d-‘-w.
Verb, passive perfect 2nd pl. of da‘á: ye were invited. Root d-‘-w.
Noun: book, register, record.
Verbal noun: repelling, warding off, pushing away. Root d-f-‘.
usage: در دفع کوشیدند 'strove to repel Him'.

definition: Persian daf‘ "repelling, removing" with -shán "them": their removal, repelling them. Root d-f-‘.

shift: Here: subtleties, fine points. Today: minutes (دقیقه).
definition: Plural of daqíqah: subtleties, fine points; in modern Persian 'minutes'. Root d-q-q.
Adjective: fine, precise, careful, minute. Root d-q-q.
usage: In the Íqán بنظر دقیق 'with a discerning eye'.

definition: Noun: indication, guidance, evidence; here accusative of specification. Root d-l-l.
usage: In the Íqán اشدّ دلالةً 'more powerfully indicative'.

definition: Noun: the stealing of hearts, charm, enchantment (dil 'heart' + bar 'taking').
Dil 'heart' with -at 'thy'.
usage: In the Hidden Words شمع دلت 'the lamp of thy heart'.

definition: Adjective: sad, heavy-hearted, homesick.
Noun: giving one's heart, being in love, devotion.
usage: In رمز دلدادگی 'the mystery of devotion', in the lover's journey.

definition: Dil "heart" with -ash "his/her": his heart.
usage: Persian rendering of Qur'an 45:23 in the Íqán: مهر نهاد بر گوش و دلش 'set a seal upon his ears and his heart'.

definition: Compound adjective: gladdening the heart, delightful.
usage: صحراهای دلفزای روح 'the delightsome wilds of the spirit'.
notes: Final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Persian adjective: heart-alluring, delightful, charming.
usage: HW: برضوان دلکش لامکان بخرام 'wing thy flight to the delightsome Paradise of the placeless'.

definition: Dalíl with 'his': his proof, evidence. Root d-l-l.
Plural of dalíl 'proof, evidence' with izáfih -y.
usage: 'Proofs'; of the proofs of the Manifestation.

definition: Noun: brain; in Persian also the nose, sense of smell. Root d-m-gh.
usage: Nostril, sense of smell; in the image of the spiritual nostril that perceives the divine fragrance; in modern Persian dimágh mostly means the nose.
notes: Context: the "nostril" of the soul cleared of a cold.

definition: Verb dáma "to last", perfect 2nd masculine singular; "má dumta" as long as thou art. Root d-w-m.
usage: Used in ما دمت 'as long as thou art', e.g. as long as thou livest.

definition: Noun dumú‘ (plural of dam‘ "tear") + -í "my": my tears. Root d-m-‘.
usage: My tears; of God's sorrow over His servants or the lover's weeping.

definition: Noun dam (blood) with 2nd masc. suffix: your blood. Root d-m-w.
usage: Blood, e.g. of the martyrs' blood shed in God's path.
notes: Persian dam (breath) is unrelated.

definition: Adjective (fem., izáfih form): low, base, contemptible. Root d-n-w.
usage: Base, contemptible, of worldly desires.
notes: Final ە (U+06D5) carries the izáfih hamza in the source.

definition: Verb, present subjunctive 1st person plural of dádan 'to give'; with tamíz: to distinguish.
usage: 'We give', in تمیز دهیم 'we distinguish'.

definition: Noun: medicine, remedy, cure. Root d-w-y.
usage: Remedy; the Manifestation as the Divine Physician who prescribes the remedy.

definition: Ordinal of du 'two': second.
Preposition dún 'other than, besides' with -kum 'you'. Root d-w-n.
usage: In the Aqdas یغنیکم عن دونکم 'make you independent of all else'.

definition: Verb: past 3rd singular of davídan, 'to run'.
Persian numeral: two hundred.
Noun: inhabitant, anyone at all (in negation). Root d-w-r.
usage: From Noah's prayer لا تذر علی الارض من الکافرین دیاراً.

definition: Noun, plural of dár with 3rd masc. suffix: His lands, His dwellings. Root d-w-r.
Noun: silk brocade; ornamented preface of a book.
usage: In the Aqdas دیباج کتاب الوجود 'the brocade of the Book of Being'.

definition: Verb, past of دیدن: they saw. Persian.
Present perfect of دیدن "to see": thou hast seen.
notes: Older spelling دیده‌ئی.

definition: Phrase '(in another place) He says'; دیگر 'other' and میفرماید, honorific 'He says'.
notes: Run-together spelling of دیگر میفرماید.

definition: Noun dhát 'essence, self' with -há: its essence, its very self. Root dh-w.
usage: In the Íqán امّها و نفسها و ذاتها و جوهرها 'its mother, its self, its essence and its substance'.

definition: Active participle (accusative of state): remembering, making mention of God. Root dh-k-r.
usage: In the Aqdas, going to the Mashriqu'l-Adhkár at dawn ذاکراً متذکّراً مستغفراً.

definition: Noun: the sense of taste, palate. Root dh-w-q.
notes: Final ٴ marks the izáfih; search form of ذائقهٴ.

definition: Plural of dharra: atoms, particles. Root dh-r-r.
usage: In ذرّات ممکنات 'the atoms of contingent things', i.e. all created things.

definition: Noun dharra 'atom, mote' with indefinite -í: a particle, the least amount. Root dh-r-r.
Noun, plural of dhurriyyah 'offspring' with 'your'. Root dh-r-r.
usage: In the Aqdas علّموا ذرّیاتکم 'Teach your children' the verses revealed.

definition: Strong smell, stench (classical Arabic). Root dh-f-r.
usage: Aqdas: طهّروا قلوبکم عن ذفر الدّنیا 'cleanse your hearts from the defilements of the world'.

definition: Imperative of dháqa 'to taste'. Root dh-w-q.
usage: ذق انّک انت العزیز الکریم 'Taste! Verily thou art the mighty, the honoured' (Qur'an 44:49).

definition: Noun: abasement, humiliation, lowliness. Root dh-l-l.
usage: HW: از مدارج ذلّ وهم بگذر 'pass on from the low stages of doubt'.

definition: Noun: lowliness, humiliation, abasement. Root dh-l-l.
Noun dhanb 'sin, offence' plus -hi 'his'. Root dh-n-b.
usage: 'His sin'; in passages on repentance and forgiveness.

definition: Noun dhanb "sin, offence" plus indefinite -í. Root dh-n-b.
usage: A sin; dhanb 'sin, offence'.

definition: Noun, plural of dhanb: sins, transgressions. Root dh-n-b.
usage: Sins or transgressions, often in prayers for forgiveness.

definition: Noun, plural of dhát: essences, beings, selves. Root dh-w-w.
usage: Essences or beings; of the holy souls (ذوات مقدّسه), the Manifestations, and of God's Essence.

definition: Plural of dhát (essence, self) with 3rd pl. suffix: their own selves, their persons.
usage: Their own selves, essences.

definition: Verbal noun (accusative): mention, remembrance. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Remembrance, mention of God.

definition: Noun: wolf; figuratively a predator of the flock. Root dh-’-b.
usage: 'Wolf', of those who prey on the flock of God, often said of corrupt clergy, as in Bahá'u'lláh's Epistle to the Son of the Wolf (ابن ذئب).
notes: Spelled ذئب in the source.

definition: Noun: hem, skirt, lower edge of a garment; "dast az dhayl ... bar madár" let not go of. Root dh-y-l.
usage: Hem of a garment; in دست از ذیل ... بر مدار "let not go of the hem", clinging to God.

definition: Feminine of rásikh: firm, deep-rooted, steadfast. Root r-s-kh.
usage: Firm or steadfast, as in steadfast faith.

definition: Noun ra’s 'head' with -í 'My'. Root r-’-s.
Noun: shepherd, guardian; active participle of ra‘á 'to tend, to pasture'. Root r-‘-y.
usage: Aqdas: لابدّ لها من راعٍ لیحفظها 'needs must they have a shepherd to protect them'.

definition: Active participle, accusative: desiring, longing (with ilá 'for'). Root r-gh-b.
usage: Hidden Words: ان تکن الیّ راغباً 'if thou desirest Me'.

definition: Active participle plural: sleeping, asleep. Root r-q-d.
Verb, past 3rd pl. of rándan 'to drive'; بر زبان راندن 'to utter'.
Present perfect of راندن 'to drive, drive away': ye have driven away.
notes: Written without the joiner: رانده‌اید.

shift: Here: one who drives on (rendering Qur'an 50:21 سائق). Today: a car driver.
definition: Agent noun of راندن: one who drives on; (modern) a car driver. Persian.
usage: Persian rendering of Qur'an 50:21 سائق و شهید 'a driver and a witness'.

definition: Noun: monk, Christian ascetic. Root r-h-b.
Noun راه 'way, path' with -ash 'his'.
Agent participle (ráh 'way' plus numáyandih 'showing'): guiding, one who shows the way.
usage: In the Íqán نوری راه‌نماینده 'a guiding light'.
notes: Split from راه‌نماینده.

definition: Noun: banner, flag, standard. Root r-’-y.
usage: In the tradition اذا ظهرت رایة الحقّ 'when the standard of Truth is made manifest'.

definition: Perfect 2nd plural of ra’á 'to see'. Root r-’-y.
Smell, scent, fragrance. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: In the Aqdas year of patience لعلّ تسطع بینهما رائحة المحبّة 'that the fragrance of affection may be renewed between them'.

definition: Noun rá'iḥa 'smell, odour' with -há: its smell. Root r-w-ḥ.
notes: Written رائحتها.

definition: Verb, past 1st person plural: we saw. Root r-’-y.
usage: In the Magi's words قد رأینا نجمه فی المشرق 'we have seen His star in the east'.
notes: Written رأینا in the source.

definition: Perfect 1pl of ra’á "to see" with -kum: we saw you. Root r-’-y.
usage: Aqdas: رأیناکم خلف الحجبات 'We beheld you behind the veils'.

definition: Persian plural of ra’y: opinions, views. Root r-’-y.
Noun ربط 'connection, link' with indefinite ی. Root r-b-ṭ.
usage: Íqán: نسبت و ربطی نبوده 'there hath been no tie or connection'.

definition: Rabb with 'her': her Lord. Root r-b-b.
Past tense, first person plural, of form II rabbá 'to rear, nurture' plus -ka 'thee'. Root r-b-w.
usage: 'We reared thee'; God's address to man, of nurturing his soul.

definition: Verb (form II): past 1st plural of rabbá "to rear, nurture" plus -kum "you". Root r-b-w.
usage: We nurtured you; of God's nurturing (tarbiyat) of His servants.

definition: Noun rutbih "rank, station" with indefinite -í (written -ئی). Root r-t-b.
usage: Rank or station, as in the station of the human soul.

definition: Noun rijál (plural of rajul "man") + -hu "its": its men. Root r-j-l.
usage: Its men; رجال often means 'men' of a kind, as in رجال بیت العدل 'the men of the House of Justice'.

definition: Plural of rajul (man) with 2nd pl. suffix: your men. Root r-j-l.
Broken plural of rajul 'man' + relative -í. Root r-j-l.
usage: Men; e.g. رجال 'men' of God.

definition: Verb, perfect 1st person plural of raja‘a with -hu: We turned him back. Root r-j-‘.
usage: 'We turned him back', in God's voice, of returning someone to his place.

definition: Plural of raḥl: camel saddles, baggage; "shadd-i riḥál" setting out on a journey. Root r-ḥ-l.
usage: Saddles; in شد رحال "setting out on a journey".

definition: Abstract noun from raḥmán 'All-Merciful' + -hi 'His': His mercifulness. Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: God's mercy as the All-Merciful, رحمانیّت, embracing all things.

definition: Arabic raḥmat 'mercy' with Persian suffix -am 'my'. Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: In the Hidden Words ظلّ رحمتم 'the shadow of My mercy'.

definition: Noun raḥmat 'mercy' with Persian -and 'they are'. Root r-ḥ-m.
Persian plural of raḥmat 'mercy': mercies. Root r-ḥ-m.
notes: The final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Noun raḥmah 'mercy' with pronoun 'Thy'. Root r-ḥ-m.
Noun: face, cheek, countenance; رخ گشودن 'to unveil one's face'.
Noun رداء 'cloak, robe' with 'my'. Root r-d-y.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: جمیل ردائی 'My beauteous robe'.
notes: Normalized from ردائی.

definition: Plural of raziyya: calamities, misfortunes. Root r-z-’.
usage: بلایای نازله و رزایای متواتره 'afflictions and repeated calamities'.

definition: Noun: sustenance, provision, daily bread bestowed by God. Root r-z-q.
Noun rizq 'sustenance, provision' with -kum. Root r-z-q.
usage: Qur'an 51:22 و فی السّماء رزقکم 'and in heaven is your sustenance'.

definition: Noun (Arabic risála): treatise, epistle, letter. Root r-s-l.
usage: Bahá'u'lláh calls the Íqán itself a رساله 'epistle'; also the treatises of the divines.

definition: Verb, past 3rd plural of risándan 'to bring, convey'; bih qatl risándan 'to put to death'.
Present perfect 2nd plural of rasándan 'to bring, cause to reach'.
Past of rasánídan 'to cause to reach'; بقتل رسانید 'he put to death'.
Plural of rasúl with -hi: his messengers. Root r-s-l.
usage: Qur'an 2:285 لا نفرق بین احد من رسله 'We make no distinction between any of His Messengers'.

definition: Noun, adverbial accusative: in form, as to outward mark or trace. Root r-s-m.
usage: In the Íqán اسماً و رسماً و فعلاً و قولاً 'in name and form, in deed and word'.
