definition: Being firmly rooted, steadfastness; penetration, influence. Root r-s-kh.
usage: Íqán: ثبوت و رسوخ و انقطاع 'constancy, firmness and detachment'.

definition: Noun rasúl 'messenger, apostle', indefinite accusative. Root r-s-l.
usage: لن یبعث الله من بعده رسولا 'God will not raise up an apostle after him' (Qur'an 40:34).

definition: Arabic رسول 'messenger' with the Persian plural -há and izáfih. Root r-s-l.
Double plural of rasm: customs, rites, conventions. Root r-s-m.
Present perfect, third person plural, of rasídan 'to reach, arrive at'.
usage: 'Have reached'; of attaining a station or goal.

definition: Verb: present perfect 2nd singular of rasídan "to arrive, attain".
usage: Hast arrived, attained; ordinary verb form.
notes: Normalized from رسیده‌ئی.

definition: Verb rashsha "to sprinkle", imperative masculine singular: sprinkle, pour. Root r-sh-sh.
usage: 'Sprinkle', in prayers asking God to sprinkle the waters of His mercy.
notes: Aqdas addresses the Most Great Ocean.

definition: Noun, plural of rashḥa: drops, sprinklings. Root r-sh-ḥ.
usage: Drops or sprinklings of grace from the ocean of God's bounty.

definition: Noun rushd (maturity, right guidance) with 3rd pl. suffix. Root r-sh-d.
usage: Maturity or right guidance, as in reaching maturity.
notes: Yablughú rushdahum = attain maturity.

definition: Noun riḍá 'good pleasure' + -hu 'his'. Root r-ḍ-w.
Noun riḍá 'good pleasure, contentment' with suffix -ka 'thy'. Root r-ḍ-y.
usage: 'Thy good pleasure', in prayers asking God to grant what pleases Him, as in رضاک 'Thy good-pleasure'.
notes: Spelled رضائک in the source.

definition: Riḍván (good pleasure; paradise) + "thy". Root r-ḍ-w.
usage: Riḍván, God's good pleasure and paradise; also the Garden of Riḍván.

definition: Noun: satisfaction, good-pleasure, contentment. Root r-ḍ-w.
usage: God's good-pleasure, as in رضی الله 'the good-pleasure of God'; also contentment.
notes: Fí riḍa'lláh 'in the good-pleasure of God'.

definition: Adjective: moist, fresh, green; opposite of yábis 'dry'. Root r-ṭ-b.
usage: Qur'an 6:59 لا رطب و لا یابس الّا فی کتاب مبین 'nothing green or sere but is in a clear Book'.

definition: Noun: shepherds, plural of rá‘í. Root r-‘-y.
usage: Aqdas: یا رجال العدل کونوا رعاة اغنام اللّه 'O Men of Justice! Be ye shepherds of God's sheep'.

definition: Noun, plural of ra‘íyyat: subjects of a ruler, common people. Root r-‘-y.
Plural of ra'iyyat: subjects, common people, flock; with izáfih. Root r-‘-y.
Verbal noun: care, regard, consideration, observance. Root r-‘-y.
Noun: subjects, the governed people; a subject. Root r-‘-y.
usage: Paired with سلطان 'king'.

definition: Noun raghbat 'desire, inclination' with indefinite ی. Root r-gh-b.
Accusative of rafí‘: lofty, exalted, high. Root r-f-‘.
Noun rafíq 'companion, friend' with indefinite -í. Root r-f-q.
Plural of raqíqa: subtleties, delicate truths, fine points. Root r-q-q.
usage: In the Íqán دقایق رموز و رقایق 'the intricacies of mysteries and subtleties' of love.
notes: Spelled رقائق; the search form writes ئ as ی.

definition: Adjective, plural of ráqid: sleeping, asleep. Root r-q-d.
usage: In the Aqdas اذ کنتم رقدآء 'when ye were asleep'.

definition: Passive perfect of raqama 'to write, inscribe, mark'. Root r-q-m.
Fine, delicate, subtle. Root r-q-q.
Noun: ashes. Root r-m-d.
usage: Used in the Persian Hidden Words address ای پسر رماد, literally 'O son of ashes'.

definition: Noun: lance, spear. Root r-m-ḥ.
usage: In رمی شیاطین و رمح مخالفین 'the darts of devils and the spears of opponents'.

definition: Rumḥ "spear, lance" with indefinite -í: a spear. Root r-m-ḥ.
Persian plural of ramz: symbols, secret signs, mysteries. Root r-m-z.
Persian -há added to رموز, the Arabic plural of رمز: mysteries, symbols. Root r-m-z.
Noun: colour, hue, tint; also outward appearance.
Plural of rang 'colour, hue'.
usage: 'Colours'; in images of the diversity of humankind as flowers of different colours.

definition: Noun: Persian plural of rang "colour" (here with izáfih).
usage: Colours; figuratively the 'colours' of worldly attachment.

definition: Noun raván "soul, spirit" with plural -há: souls.
Noun riváyat "transmitted report, narration" + indefinite -í. Root r-w-y.
usage: A transmitted report from the Imams; the Íqán cites them alongside traditions (حدیث).

definition: Noun rúbáh (fox) with indefinite -í: a fox.
Noun rúḥ 'spirit' + -ka 'thy'. Root r-w-ḥ.
Noun, plural of ra’ís 'head, chief': heads, rulers; ru’asá’ al-jumhúr Presidents of the Republics. Root r-’-s.
usage: 'Heads, rulers', as in رؤساء الجمهور 'Presidents of the Republics', addressed in the Aqdas.

definition: Proper name: Rawḍat al-Káfí, the final part of al-Kulayní's Shí‘ih ḥadíth collection al-Káfí.
usage: Rawḍat al-Káfí, the Shí‘ih ḥadíth collection quoted in the Íqán.

definition: Noun: garden, meadow. Root r-w-ḍ.
usage: Garden, often the garden of God or paradise, as in روضهٔ رضوان.
notes: Here part of the title Rawḍiy-i-Káfí, a section of al-Kulayní's al-Káfí.

definition: Noun: garden, meadow; a garden of Paradise. Root r-w-ḍ.
usage: In the Hidden Words روضهٔ قدس 'the garden of holiness'.

definition: Noun: heads, plural of ra’s. Root r-'-s.
Persian past participle of rú'ídan 'to grow': grown, sprung up.
Present perfect of rú'ídan 'to grow, sprout', third person plural.
Noun, plural of rak‘ah: units of ritual prayer. Root r-k-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas تسع رکعات 'nine rak‘ahs' of the obligatory prayer.

definition: Noun: a unit of ritual prayer with bowing. Root r-k-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas تسع رکعات 'nine rak‘ahs'.

definition: Noun: pillar, corner, essential part. Root r-k-n.
usage: دو رکن اعظم 'two chief pillars', the sun and moon.

definition: Proper noun: Rayy, the ancient city near present-day Ṭihrán.
usage: In traditions quoted in the Íqán, زوراء is identified with ارض ری.

definition: Past of ریختن 'to pour, scatter; fall': 'they fell'.
Past participle of ríkhtan 'to pour, shed': poured, shed; with shud, was shed.
Noun: crow, raven.
usage: Contrasted with the nightingale in the Íqán.

definition: Active participle of zaná 'to commit adultery or fornication'. Root z-n-y.
notes: Aqdas: a fine is set for every adulterer and adulteress.

definition: Fem. of zání: adulteress, fornicatress. Root z-n-y.
usage: In the Aqdas لکلّ زان و زانیة 'adulterers and adulteresses'.

definition: Noun (collective): the guardians of Hell. Root z-b-n.
usage: From Qur'an 96:18; Aqdas زبانیة العذاب 'the angels of torment'.

definition: Relative adjective: of chrysolite or emerald.
usage: In the Hidden Words الواح زبرجدی 'chrysolite tablets'.

definition: Rebuke, restraint; in Persian also torment, harsh treatment. Root z-j-r.
usage: Íqán: نهایت اذیّت و زجر و رجم 'the utmost persecution, affliction and stoning'.

definition: Perfect of zajara 'to rebuke, chide' with suffix 'you'. Root z-j-r.
usage: الذی زجرکم لا تزجروه 'him who rebuketh you, rebuke ye not'.

definition: Plural of زحمت: troubles, labours, toils. Root z-ḥ-m.
Noun: wound, injury; a blow or thrust.
Past tense, first person plural, of záda 'to increase, add'. Root z-y-d.
usage: 'We increased'; of God increasing bounty or trial.

definition: Verb: present perfect 3rd plural of zadan "to strike"; mithál zadan "to liken, give as an example".
usage: Have struck; mithál zadan 'to give an example'.
notes: Normalized from زده‌اند.

definition: Noun, plural of zarbíya: carpets, rich rugs. Root z-r-b.
usage: Rich carpets, Qur'anic paradise imagery.
notes: Aqdas: "the carpets of delight are rolled up".

definition: Adjective: yellow; with surkh "red", gold and finery.
usage: Yellow; with سرخ 'red' signifying gold and finery, or the pale colour of grief.

definition: Noun za‘m (claim, supposition, presumption) with 3rd masc. suffix. Root z-‘-m.
usage: Supposition or claim, of vain imaginings.
notes: ‘Alá za‘mihi = as he supposed.

definition: Verb, perfect 2nd masc. pl. of zála; má ziltum 'ye ceased not, ye continued'. Root z-y-l.
usage: With ما: 'ye ceased not', i.e. ye continued.

definition: Noun zamán 'time, age' with suffix -hi 'his'. Root z-m-n.
usage: 'His time', of the age in which a Prophet appeared.

definition: Adjective: of emerald (zumurrud + relative -í).
usage: Emerald; in imagery of the emerald heights.

definition: Nisba adjective: of Zanján (city in Iran); surname of Mullá Muḥammad-‘Alíy-i-Zanjání.
usage: Surname of Mullá Muḥammad-‘Alíy-i-Zanjání (Ḥujjat), a leading Bábí cited in the Kitáb-i-Íqán for his steadfastness.

definition: Noun: prison, dungeon.
usage: In the Hidden Words the world as a prison from which the soul ascends.

definition: Noun: rust, tarnish; also bell.
usage: Persian Hidden Words: مصاحبت ابرار زنگ دل بزداید 'the company of the righteous cleanseth the rust from the heart'.

definition: Noun: asceticism, abstinence, piety. Root z-h-d.
usage: Outward piety, often paired with تقوی; the Writings warn against pride in it.

definition: Adverb: soon, quickly, early.
Noun: head cold, catarrh. Root z-k-m.
usage: In the Íqán figuratively of a soul whose sense is dulled.

definition: Proper noun: Zacharias, father of John the Baptist.
usage: In the Íqán یحیی بن زکریّا 'John, son of Zacharias'.

definition: Noun: increase, excess, surplus; with نمودن 'to exceed, outweigh'. Root z-y-d.
usage: حسنات او بر سیّئات زیادتی نمود 'his good deeds outweighed his evil ones'.

definition: Form II of z-y-n: to adorn, embellish; "We adorned it". Root z-y-n.
Noun zínah 'adornment, splendour' with -ki 'thy' (feminine). Root z-y-n.
Perfect of form II zayyana 'to adorn' with -há: He adorned it, them. Root z-y-n.
usage: The Aqdas forbids shaving the head: قد زیّنها الله بالشعر 'God hath adorned them with hair'.

definition: Interjection: beware! take heed!; also refuge, quarter.
usage: Opens a Hidden Word: زینهار ای پسر خاک 'O Son of Dust! Beware!'

definition: Imperative plural of form II zayyana 'to adorn' with -há 'them'. Root z-y-n.
notes: Aqdas: adorn the Houses of Worship with what befitteth them, not with images.

definition: Prostrating, bowing in worship. Root s-j-d.
usage: In the Hidden Words ساجد خیالید 'ye worship your idle fancy'.

definition: Noun sáḥat 'courtyard, open space, precinct' with indefinite -í. Root s-w-ḥ.
usage: ساحت قدس 'the court of holiness'.

definition: Verb, simple past 3rd person plural of sákhtan: they made; with an adjective 'made (someone) X'.
notes: In محروم ساختند 'they deprived'.

definition: Present perfect 3pl of ساختن "to make"; with an adjective "to render": they have made.
usage: As in خود را محروم ساخته‌اند 'they have deprived themselves'.

definition: Active participle of sará 'to travel by night, flow, pervade'. Root s-r-y.
usage: ساری گشته 'hath flowed forth', of the water of life from the Pen.

definition: Persian verb ساختن 'make', present subjunctive; with محروم 'to deprive'.
Present of sákhtan: they make, cause; forms compound verbs.
Past tense of form III sáfara 'to travel, journey'. Root s-f-r.
usage: 'Travelled'; in Aqdas laws on travellers and on prayer while travelling.

definition: Verb (form III): past 3rd feminine singular of sáfara "to travel". Root s-f-r.
usage: She travelled; ordinary verb, e.g. in laws for travellers.

definition: Noun (from Hebrew shofar): trumpet, ram's horn.
usage: The trumpet of the Day of Resurrection, interpreted as the call of the new Manifestation.

definition: Adjective (active participle): safe, sound, unharmed. Root s-l-m.
usage: Safe, sound; of a soul kept safe from error or harm.

definition: Active participle (accusative): safe, sound, unharmed. Root s-l-m.
Active participle (accusative): travelling, treading a path; mystic wayfarer. Root s-l-k.
usage: Wayfarer on the spiritual path; the سالک is the seeker of the Seven Valleys.

definition: Arabic sálik 'wayfarer, treading' + Persian -and 'they are'. Root s-l-k.
usage: 'They walk', from سالک 'wayfarer', the seeker on the mystic path of the Seven Valleys.

definition: Proper noun: the Sámirí, maker of the golden calf (Qur'án 20); figuratively a deceiver.
usage: The Sámirí who made the golden calf; figuratively a deceiver.

definition: Active participle of sami‘a: hearer, listener. Root s-m-‘.
usage: Hearer or listener, as in the hearer of the divine Call.

definition: Feminine active participle used as noun: the faculty of hearing, the ear. Root s-m-‘.
usage: In the Íqán سامعهٔ اهل بقا 'the ear of the dwellers of immortality'.

definition: Noun: dwellers, inhabitants; sákin 'dwelling' + Persian plural -án. Root s-k-n.
Active participle sákin 'dwelling' with Persian 2nd singular copula -í: thou art dwelling. Root s-k-n.
Active participle sá'ir 'going, wandering' with copula: they are wandering. Root s-y-r.
Active participle sá’ir 'journeying' with 2nd sing. -í: thou art journeying. Root s-y-r.
notes: Could also be read sá’irí 'any other'; the conditional clause favours 'thou journeyest'.

definition: Active participle: driver, one who drives along. Root s-w-q.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse معها سائق و شهید 'with it a driver and a witness'.
notes: Normalized from سائق.

definition: Plural active participle: those who ask; inquirers, petitioners. Root s-’-l.
usage: جواب سائلین 'replies to the questioners'.

definition: Persian noun: shadow, shade; figuratively something fleeting and insubstantial.
usage: ای سایهٴ نابود "O fleeting Shadow!" in the Persian Hidden Words.
notes: ٴ marks the izáfih.

definition: Noun سایه 'shadow, shade' with indefinite -í.
Noun sabab 'cause, means, reason', indefinite accusative. Root s-b-b.
usage: In the Aqdas قد قدّرنا لکلّ شیء سبباً 'We have ordained for everything a cause'; اسباب 'material means'.

definition: Noun subḥán 'glorification' with -hu: glory be to Him. Root s-b-ḥ.
usage: Formula سبحانه و تعالی 'glorified and exalted be He'.

definition: Noun: meadow, green pasture (sabzih 'greenery' + -zár 'place of').
Of the tribes of Israel; contrasted with قبطی 'Egyptian'. Root s-b-ṭ.
usage: In the Íqán شراب سبطی عدل 'the Israelite wine of justice'.

definition: Numeral: seven; with عشرون 'twenty-seven'. Root s-b-‘.
usage: Hadith العلم سبعة و عشرون حرفاً 'Knowledge is twenty and seven letters'.

definition: Numeral: seventy (nominative). Root s-b-‘.
usage: In the tradition لکلّ علم سبعون وجهاً 'Knowledge hath seventy meanings (aspects)'.

definition: Sabu‘ "beast of prey, wild animal" with indefinite -í; سبعی چند "several wild beasts". Root s-b-‘.
usage: Íqán: سبعی چند را که بر مردارهای نفوس 'beasts of prey upon the carrion of souls'.

definition: Plural of sabíl 'way' with suffix 'Our'. Root s-b-l.
usage: لنهدینّهم سبلنا 'We will surely guide them in Our ways' (Qur'an 29:69).

definition: Arabic سبیل 'path, way' with the Persian suffix -ash 'his'. Root s-b-l.
usage: In the Writings usually در سبیل الهی 'in the path of God', of sacrifice: جانها در سبیلش ایثار.

definition: Sabíl with 'his': his way, path. Root s-b-l.
Plural of sabíl 'path, way' with Persian -há.
usage: 'Paths'; of paths leading to God.

definition: Noun: Persian plural of sabíl "path, way". Root s-b-l.
usage: Paths; sabíl 'path', as in sabíl Alláh 'the path of God'.

definition: Noun sabíl "path" with -ka: thy path. Root s-b-l.
usage: 'Thy path', in prayers: فی سبیلک 'in Thy path'.

definition: Numeral: six (with feminine-gender noun). Root s-d-s.
Plural of sitárih (star) with izáfih: the stars (of).
usage: The stars, sometimes symbols of the divines in the Íqán's interpretation of prophecy.

definition: Noun: star; here with the izáfih hamza.
usage: Star; in the Íqán stars symbolise the divines of a religion.

definition: Verb, passive perfect 3rd person feminine singular of satara: it was veiled, hidden. Root s-t-r.
usage: 'Was veiled', of truths hidden from the eyes of men.

definition: Noun: injustice, tyranny, cruelty; "sitam namúdan" to oppress.
usage: Oppression, injustice; in ستم نمودن "to oppress".

definition: Future (sa-) passive imperfect second plural of mana‘a 'to prevent, hinder'. Root m-n-‘.
usage: Ye will be hindered, in prophecies that people will be prevented.

definition: Noun: a single prostration in prayer. Root s-j-d.
usage: In the Aqdas سجدة واحدة 'a single prostration' in place of a missed prayer.

definition: Verb: passive perfect of sajjara, 'to fill; to set aflame, to make (the sea) surge'. Root s-j-r.
notes: Echoes Qur'an 81:6 و اذا البحار سجّرت; Aqdas: القدح الّذی به سجّرت البحور 'the cup whereby the oceans have been made to surge'; rendering not confirmed.

definition: Noun sijn 'prison' with -hi: His prison. Root s-j-n.
usage: Bahá'u'lláh's imprisonment, as in سجنه الأعظم 'His Most Great Prison' ('Akká).

definition: Noun: innate disposition, nature, character. Root s-j-w.
Proper noun: Sijjín, a Qur'anic name for the register or prison of the wicked. Root s-j-n.
usage: In the Íqán شموس سجّین 'the suns of Sijjín', false luminaries.

definition: Noun: natural disposition, character, trait. Root s-j-w.
Adjective: of the early dawn, pre-dawn. Persian with Arabic saḥar.
usage: نالهٴ سحرگاهی فقرا 'the midnight sighing of the poor'.

definition: Persian siḥr "magic, sorcery" with indefinite -í. Root s-ḥ-r.
usage: The charge of سحر مبین "manifest sorcery" made against the Prophets.

definition: Verb: 'We subjected, subdued', form II of s-kh-r.
Feminine of sakhíf: feeble, foolish, inane. Root s-kh-f.
usage: In the Íqán اقوال سخیفه 'foolish sayings' of the divines.

definition: Verbal noun: stopping, blocking; satisfying (hunger). Root s-d-d.
usage: As in سدّ جوع 'allaying hunger'.

definition: Noun sadd 'barrier, dam, obstruction' with indefinite -í. Root s-d-d.
Sadd 'barrier, dam' with -í 'a' and -st 'is'. Root s-d-d.
usage: In the Hidden Words غنا سدّیست محکم 'riches are a mighty barrier'.

definition: Noun siráj 'lamp' with indefinite -í: a lamp. Root s-r-j.
usage: سراج often the Manifestation as a lamp of guidance.

definition: Noun, plural of saríra 'inner thought, secret' with 'your'. Root s-r-r.
usage: In the Aqdas باستوائه علی سرائرکم 'by His establishing Himself upon your hearts'.
notes: Written سرائرکم in the source.

definition: Red (colour).
usage: HW: باسباب زرد و سرخ 'with yellow and red trappings', i.e. gold and silver finery.

definition: Past participle of سرشتن 'to knead, mould, fashion'.
usage: سرشته شده‌اند 'have been fashioned' of the clay of divine knowledge.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): it hastened, was quick. Root s-r-‘.
usage: Aqdas: هذا یوم فیه سرع کوم اللّه شوقاً للقائه 'this is the Day whereon the Mount of God hasteneth, longing to meet Him'.
notes: Reading and rendering of this rare verb uncertain.

definition: Past 3pl: they hastened. Root s-r-‘.
Noun: theft; sirqat namúdan 'to steal'. Root s-r-q.
usage: 'Theft'; in the Aqdas law on punishment of theft.

definition: Adjective/noun, indefinite accusative: everlasting, eternal. Root s-r-m-d.
usage: Everlasting, eternal; of God's eternity.

definition: Abstract noun: everlastingness, eternity; from sarmad "eternal".
usage: Everlastingness, as in حمامة السرمدیة 'the Dove of eternity'.

definition: Noun sirr "secret, mystery" + -hu "his": his mystery. Root s-r-r.
usage: His mystery; also in formulae such as قدّس سرّه 'may his secret be sanctified' for departed saints.

definition: Plural of sar (head) with -shán (their): their heads.
Noun sirr 'secret, inmost being' + -ka 'thy'. Root s-r-r.
usage: Thy inmost being, the secret heart.

definition: Adjective: wandering, bewildered, at a loss.
usage: 'Bewildered, wandering', of seekers lost in the valleys of search or of peoples astray without guidance; also of the lover's bewilderment in the Valley of Wonderment.

definition: Noun: surface, flat top; "saṭḥ-i zamín" the bare ground. Root s-ṭ-ḥ.
usage: Surface; in سطح زمین "the bare ground".

definition: Noun: might, ascendancy, overwhelming power. Root s-ṭ-w.
usage: Overwhelming might, as in the might of God.

definition: Noun saṭvat 'might, ascendancy, dread power' with indefinite -í. Root s-ṭ-w.
Verb: passive perfect of safaka, 'to shed (blood)'. Root s-f-k.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words: المداد الأحمر الّذی سفک فی سبیلی 'the crimson ink that hath been shed in My path'.

definition: Arabic verb, passive perfect of salla: (a sword) was drawn. Root s-l-l.
Plural of silsilah: chains. Root s-l-s-l.
usage: As in سلاسل الاوهام 'the chains of idle fancies'.

definition: Noun, plural of sulṭán with restrictive -í: kings who, those sovereigns that. Root s-l-ṭ.
Verbal noun: taking away, depriving, stripping. Root s-l-b.
usage: سلب نمودن 'to take away from'.

definition: Noun/adjective: sweet clear flowing water or wine. Root s-l-l.
usage: سلسال خمر ذی الجلال 'the flowing wine of the All-Glorious'.

definition: Persian sulṭán "power, authority" with indefinite -í and -st "is": there is a power. Root s-l-ṭ.
Noun: sovereignty, dominion, kingship. Root s-l-ṭ.
Noun salṭana 'sovereignty, dominion' with -hi: His sovereignty. Root s-l-ṭ.
usage: The Íqán explains the true sovereignty (سلطنت) of the Manifestation as spiritual, not worldly.

definition: Noun, Persian plural of salṭanat 'sovereignty' with copula -ast 'is'. Root s-l-ṭ.
Noun and adjective: those who went before, predecessors; former. Root s-l-f.
usage: In امم سلف 'the peoples of old'.

definition: Ladder, stairway. Root s-l-m.
usage: In Qur'an 6:35 او سلّماً فی السّمآء 'or a ladder into heaven'.

definition: Imperative plural form II: hand over, deliver, entrust. Root s-l-m.
usage: Aqdas: entrust the property of orphans to a trustworthy person.

definition: Proper noun: Solomon, the prophet-king.
usage: In the Hidden Words هدهد سلیمان عشق 'O hoopoe of Solomon of love', after the hoopoe that brought news from Sheba.

definition: Heavenly, celestial; feminine relational adjective from samá’. Root s-m-w.
usage: Íqán: مائده سمائیّه 'the heavenly food' (manna).
notes: Normalized from سمائیّه.

definition: Perfect 1st person singular of sami‘a 'to hear'. Root s-m-‘.
usage: کأنّی سمعت منادیاً 'methinks I heard a Voice calling'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): you (pl.) heard; after ان 'if ye hear'. Root s-m-‘.
usage: In a tradition: فان سمعتم منه شیئاً فاسرعوا الیه 'if ye hear aught of Him, hasten unto Him'.

definition: Sam' with 'his': his hearing, his ears. Root s-m-‘.
Noun sam‘ 'hearing' plus -ka 'thy'. Root s-m-‘.
usage: 'Thy hearing'; in the call to sanctify one's ear to hear the divine melody.

definition: Noun sam‘ "hearing, ear" plus -í "my". Root s-m-‘.
usage: My hearing; God speaking of His hearing.

definition: Verb form II sammá "to name", perfect passive 2nd feminine singular: thou wast named. Root s-m-w.
notes: Addressing the land of Ṭá.

definition: Noun: hyacinth, spikenard; an ear of grain.
usage: Hyacinth; in poetry the hyacinth locks of the Beloved, and in the Writings the hyacinths of knowledge and wisdom.
notes: Sense in "az sunbul-i án maḥfil" not certain: perhaps "the hyacinth of that assemblage".

definition: Noun: custom, wont, way, tradition; sunnat-i iláhí = the way of God. Root s-n-n.
usage: The way or custom, as in سنّت الهی 'the way of God' which does not change.

definition: sa- (future) + form IV imperfect 1st pl. of ará 'show' + -him. Root r-'-y.
usage: From Qur'án 41:53, سنریهم آیاتنا فی الآفاق و فی انفسهم 'We will show them Our signs in the world and in themselves'.
notes: Quran 41:53.

definition: Noun, plural of sanah 'year': years. Root s-n-w.
usage: 'Years', of periods of time, as in the length of a Dispensation.
notes: Oblique plural form after fí.

definition: su'ál (question) + indefinite -í. Root s-'-l.
Perfect (form II) of sawwá 'to fashion, shape harmoniously' + -ka 'thee'. Root s-w-y.
usage: He fashioned thee, recalling the Qur'anic creation of man.
notes: Not siwáka 'other than thee', spelled the same.

definition: Past of súkhtan 'to burn': it burned, consumed.
Noun: chapters of the Qur'an (suras), plural of súra. Root s-w-r.
usage: Íqán: the Qur'anic challenge سوره‌ئی بمثل این سور منزله 'a súrih like unto these revealed súrihs'.

definition: Noun súrih 'chapter of the Qur'an' with indefinite -í: a súrih. Root s-w-r.
usage: The Qur'anic challenge to produce a súrih like it.

definition: Verb form II passive: to be dazed, dazzled, clouded (of eyes). Root s-k-r.
usage: Echoes Qur'án 15:15 سکرت ابصارنا 'our eyes are dazzled'.

definition: Noun sakrah 'intoxication' with 3rd pl. suffix: their drunkenness, frenzy. Root s-k-r.
usage: Qur'anic, لفی سکرتهم یعمهون 'wandering distractedly in their frenzy'.

definition: Verb: it became still, calm. Root s-k-n.
usage: In the Aqdas: سکنت امواج بحر بیانی 'the waves of the ocean of My utterance are stilled'.

definition: Verbal noun: silence, keeping quiet. Root s-k-t.
usage: حضرت سکوت فرمودند 'He remained silent'.

definition: Persian numeral: thirty (the number 30).
Plural of sawṭ 'whip, scourge'. Root s-w-ṭ.
Noun sayyid 'lord, master, chief', indefinite accusative. Root s-w-d.
usage: Qur'an 3:39 in the Íqán, of John the Baptist: مصدّقاً بکلمة من الله و سیّداً و حصوراً.

definition: Title 'Lord of the Martyrs': the Imám Ḥusayn, martyred at Karbilá.
usage: In the Íqán his martyrdom is cited as the greatest of proofs.

definition: Noun: way of life, conduct, manner; biography. Root s-y-r.
Síra 'way of life, conduct' with -hu. Root s-y-r.
usage: In the tradition کیف سیرته 'what will be his conduct'.

definition: Verb with sa-: he will know. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Qur'an 26:227 و سیعلم الذین ظلموا 'and they who act unjustly shall know'.

definition: Noun sayf 'sword' with the indefinite -í: a sword. Root s-y-f.
notes: In سیفی نماند 'there remained no sword'.

definition: Passive perfect of sa’ala "to ask, beg": he was asked. Root s-’-l.
usage: Aqdas: لا یحلّ السّؤال و من سئل حرّم علیه العطاء 'it is unlawful to beg, and it is forbidden to give to him who beggeth'.
notes: Normalized from سئل; distinct from Persian سیل sayl "flood".

definition: Perfect 2nd person singular of sa’ala 'to ask' (with ‘an 'about'). Root s-’-l.
usage: ما سئلت عنه 'thou didst not ask about Him'.
notes: Old spelling with yá seat; could also be read su’ilta 'thou wast asked', but the address fits 'thou didst not inquire'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I), passive: We were asked. Root s-’-l.
usage: Aqdas: کذلک سئلنا من قبل 'We were asked before'.

definition: Past 3pl of sa’ala: they asked. Root s-’-l.
notes: Old spelling with hamza on a yá seat.

definition: Ordinal numeral: third (older spelling of sivvum).
usage: 'Third'; older spelling, as in counting stages or days.

definition: Noun: natural magic, an occult science (sorcery by illusion).
usage: Natural magic, an occult science; listed among the sciences of illusion.

definition: Proper noun: Sinai, the mount and desert where God spoke to Moses.
usage: Sinai, where God spoke to Moses from the Burning Bush; the Writings liken the new revelation to the fire of Sinai.

definition: Proper noun: (Mount) Sinai.
usage: Mount Sinai, where God spoke to Moses; Bahá'u'lláh speaks of His own revelation as a new Sinai.
notes: fí Síná’i qalbika in the Sinai of thy heart.

definition: Plural of sínih (breast, chest) with -shán (their): their breasts.
usage: The breasts, seat of the heart.

definition: Broken plural of sayf: swords. Root s-y-f.
Noun, plural of sayyi’ah 'evil deed, sin'. Root s-w-’.
usage: 'Evil deeds', paired with حسنات 'good deeds', of sins forgiven by God.
notes: Paired with ḥasanát 'good deeds'.

definition: Plural sayyi'át (evil deeds, sins) + "thy". Root s-w-'.
usage: Your sins; of God forgiving sins.

definition: Plural of sayyi’a 'evil deed' + -kum 'your'. Root s-w-’.
usage: Misdeeds or evil deeds, as in prayers for forgiveness.

definition: Noun: branch, bough.
Noun: branch, bough.
Persian plural of Arabic shárib 'drinker': drinkers. Root sh-r-b.
usage: Those who drink spiritual wine of knowledge.

definition: Active participle plural: those who drink, drinkers. Root sh-r-b.
usage: Those who drink from the cups of divine knowledge.

definition: Noun shá‘ir 'poet' with indefinite -í. Root sh-‘-r.
Active participle (fem.): healing; satisfying, conclusive. Root sh-f-y.
usage: In بیانات شافیهٔ کافیهٔ وافیه 'conclusive, sufficient and ample utterances'.

definition: Noun sha’n 'rank, station, affair', accusative of specification. Root sh-’-n.
usage: اعظم منک شأناً 'greater than thee in station'.

definition: Noun sha’n "state, station, rank" with suffix "my": My station. Root sh-’-n.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words علی قدرک و لحنک لا علی شأنی و لحنی "according to thy capacity and understanding, not to Mine".
notes: Written شأنی.

definition: Verb: 'we witnessed, beheld', form III of sh-h-d.
Sound plural of sháhid 'witness': bearing witness, witnesses. Root sh-h-d.
usage: In the Aqdas انّا کلّ له شاهدون 'we all bear witness unto Him'.

definition: Noun sháhid 'witness' with -íst 'is a'. Root sh-h-d.
Noun: kingship of kings, supreme sovereignty.
Thankful, grateful (adverbial accus.). Root sh-k-r.
usage: In the Hidden Words شاکراً لقضائی 'thankful for My decree'.

definition: Noun: tinge, trace, admixture. Root sh-w-b.
usage: Persian Hidden Words شائبهٴ حسد 'the least remnant of envy'.
notes: Written with a hamza for izáfih.

definition: Adjective: worthy, fitting, befitting.
notes: Written with the letter ە (U+06D5) before the izáfih mark in the source.

definition: Youth, the prime of life; young people. Root sh-b-b.
usage: Íqán: در سنّ شباب 'in the age of youth', of the Báb.

definition: Abstract noun: being a shepherd, pastorship.
usage: دعوی شبانی 'claim to be shepherds', of divines who are wolves within.

definition: Noun: likeness, resemblance, similarity. Root sh-b-h.
Relational adjective from shabaḥ: shadowy, spectral, phantom-like. Root sh-b-ḥ.
Noun shabnam 'dew' plus indefinite -í: a dewdrop.
usage: 'A dewdrop'; an image of smallness beside the ocean of God's bounty.

definition: Noun: likeness, the like of, similar. Root sh-b-h.
usage: Likeness; in phrases denying God has any likeness.

definition: Verb shitáftan "to hasten", present subjunctive 3rd singular: hastens.
Verb, present 3rd person plural of shitáftan: they hasten, hurry.
usage: They hasten, of souls hastening to the Beloved or to the Cause of God.

definition: Past 3rd pl. of shitáftan: they hastened, hurried.
usage: Hastening, e.g. hastening toward God or martyrdom.

definition: Adjective (plural): diverse, various, scattered. Root sh-t-t.
Noun: tree; figuratively the tree of hope or of life. Root sh-j-r.
usage: 'Tree', in images such as the tree of hope, the Divine Lote-Tree and the Blessed Tree.
notes: Spelled with final ە (U+06D5) for the izáfih ۀ.

definition: Infinitive: to become; auxiliary of the passive ("naskh shudan" being abrogated).
usage: To become; auxiliary of the passive.

definition: Simple past first plural of shudan 'to become'.
Noun: evil, harm; in construct as elative 'the worst of'. Root sh-r-r.
usage: In the tradition فقهاء ذلک الزمان شرّ فقهاء تحت ظلّ السماء 'the divines of that age shall be the most wicked under the shadow of heaven'.

definition: Verb: perfect 3rd plural of shariba, 'to drink'. Root sh-r-b.
usage: Íqán: الّذینهم شربوا من کأس العلم و العرفان 'they who have quaffed from the cup of knowledge and understanding'.

definition: Noun: explanation, commentary, account. Root sh-r-ḥ.
Noun shar' 'religious law, revealed law' with indefinite -í: a law. Root sh-r-‘.
usage: Each Manifestation brings a new law, as امری بدیع و شرعی جدید.

definition: Noun: honour, nobility, distinction. Root sh-r-f.
Noun شرک 'associating partners with God, idolatry' with 'their'. Root sh-r-k.
Adjective from shirk: associating partners with God, polytheistic. Root sh-r-k.
usage: اشارات شرکیه 'idolatrous allusions'.

definition: Persian sharíf "noble, holy" with -shán "their": their noble, their holy. Root sh-r-f.
Noun shaṭr 'direction, side' with -í: 'towards Me'. Root sh-ṭ-r.
usage: Echoes Qur'an 2:144 فولّ وجهک شطر المسجد الحرام; in the Aqdas the Qiblih: ولّوا وجوهکم شطری الأقدس.

shift: Here: a habit, distinctive practice (making silence one's wont). Today: a slogan.
definition: Noun: inner garment; distinctive mark, habit, practice; in modern Persian mostly 'slogan'. Root sh-‘-r.
usage: In the Íqán the seeker should صمت را شعار خود نماید 'make silence his wont'.

definition: Noun sha‘r 'hair' with -ka 'thy'. Root sh-‘-r.
usage: In the Hidden Words تخضّب شعرک من دمک 'to tinge thy hair with thy blood'.

definition: Proper noun: Shu‘ayb, the prophet of Midian, identified with Jethro, Moses' father-in-law.
Form I verb: it occupied, distracted you. Root sh-gh-l.
usage: In the Aqdas قد شغلتکم الأموال عن المآل 'your riches have kept you from the ultimate end'.

definition: Verbal noun: splitting, cleaving; شق گردیدن 'to be cleft'. Root sh-q-q.
Noun: wretchedness, misery, perversity. Root sh-q-w.
usage: In اهل کفر و شقا 'the people of unbelief and wickedness'.
notes: Persian spelling of شقاء.

definition: Anemones, red poppies (Arabic shaqá’iq an-nu‘mán). Root sh-q-q.
usage: Poetic image, as in اسرار حقایق بر شقایق بستان عشق 'the mysteries of reality to the anemones of the garden of love'.

definition: Plural of shaqíqa 'anemone' with Persian suffix -ash 'its'. Root sh-q-q.
usage: حقائق اسرار عشق را از شقائقش جوئید 'seek the mysteries of love from its anemones'.

definition: Adjective: wretched, miserable, rebellious. Root sh-q-w.
usage: Aqdas (echoing the Qur'an): لا تتّبعوا جبّاراً شقیّاً 'follow not every proud rebel'.

definition: Present of shumurdan: counts, regards as.
Imperative of shumurdan 'to count, reckon'; ghanímat shumur 'count as a blessing'.
usage: In غنیمت شمر 'count it a blessing', urging to seize the opportunity.

definition: Verb: present perfect 2nd plural of shumurdan "to count; to deem, regard".
usage: Have deemed; ordinary verb form.
notes: Normalized from شمرده‌اید.

definition: Verb shumurdan "to count, deem", present subjunctive 2nd singular: thou countest, considerest.
Noun shams "sun" + -há "its": its sun. Root sh-m-s.
usage: Its sun; in the Íqán the sun symbolises the Manifestation of God.

definition: Plural of shamshír (sword) with izáfih: swords (of).
usage: Swords; the Writings abolish holy war, preferring the 'sword of utterance'.

definition: Past 3rd sing. of shinákhtan 'to know, recognize'; also noun 'recognition'.
usage: Recognized; as a noun, recognition (شناخت) of God and His Manifestation.

definition: Verb, perfect 3rd person plural of shinákhtan 'to know, recognize': they have known.
usage: 'They have known, recognized', of recognition of God and His Manifestation, the first duty in the Aqdas.

definition: Imperative of shinídan (stem shinaw): hear! listen!
usage: Hear!; in calls to hear the voice of God.

definition: Present subjunctive third plural of shinídan 'to hear'.
Present perfect of shanídan 'to hear': thou hast heard.
usage: In the Hidden Words هرگز شنیده‌ئی 'hast thou ever heard'.

definition: Adjective: odious, heinous, shameful. Root sh-n-‘.
Arabic verb, perfect: he witnessed, testified, bore witness. Root sh-h-d.
usage: Testimony to God's oneness and Cause.

definition: Plural of shahíd 'witness' with pronoun 'your'. Root sh-h-d.
usage: From Qur'án 2:23 و ادعوا شهداءکم 'and summon your witnesses'.

definition: Verb, perfect 3rd fem. sing. of shahida: witnessed, beheld. Root sh-h-d.
Noun: month. Root sh-h-r.
usage: In the Aqdas تسعة عشر شهراً 'nineteen months', the Badí‘ calendar.

definition: Plural of sháṭi’: shores, riverbanks. Root sh-ṭ-’.
usage: یا شواطی نهر الرّین 'O banks of the Rhine!'.
notes: Hamza of شواطئ not written in the source.

definition: Persian shawq "longing, yearning" with suffix -ash "his". Root sh-w-q.
Noun: might, power, pomp; literally thorn. Root sh-w-k.
Past participle of shikáftan 'to split, cleave': split, rent asunder; with gashtan, to be split.
usage: In the Íqán the heaven of a former religion شکافته میگردد 'is cleft asunder', i.e. abrogated.

definition: Compound agent noun shakk 'doubt' + ávarandih 'bringer': one who doubts, doubter.
usage: In the Íqán's Persian paraphrase of a Qur'anic verse (مرتاب).

definition: Adjective shakarín 'sugared, sweet' with the suffix -am 'my'.
Shakk 'doubt' with -and 'they are': (they) are in doubt. Root sh-k-k.
usage: In the Íqán در ظنّ و شکّند 'are still in doubt and uncertainty'.

definition: Verbal noun, accusative: thanks, gratitude. Root sh-k-r.
usage: Qur'an 76:9 لا نرید منکم جزاء و لا شکوراً 'we seek from you neither recompense nor thanks'.

definition: Noun, plural of shayṭán: devils, satans. Root sh-ṭ-n.
usage: In the Writings evil souls and the promptings of self.

definition: Form II perfect of sh-y-b with -ní: it turned me grey-haired.
usage: The Prophet's saying quoted in the Íqán: شیّبتنی سورة هود 'the Súrih of Húd hath made me grey-haired'.

definition: Noun shayṭán 'devil, Satan', indefinite accusative. Root sh-ṭ-n.
usage: نقیّض له شیطاناً 'We will assign to him a devil' (Qur'an 43:36).

definition: Noun: the Shí‘ih branch of Islam; partisans, followers. Root sh-y-‘.
usage: In the Íqán of the Shí‘ih community and the true followers of the Imams.

definition: Plural: Shí'is, followers, partisans. Root sh-y-‘.
Plural of sha’n 'affair, matter, station, dignity'. Root sh-’-n.
usage: 'Affairs, stations'; in the Writings the stations or conditions of things, as in شئونات.
notes: Spelled شئون; Persian shívan 'lament' has the same normalized letters.

definition: Noun shay’ "thing" plus Persian indefinite -í: something, anything. Root sh-y-’.
usage: Something, anything; ordinary word.
notes: Normalized from شیئی.

definition: Abbreviation of the blessing ṣallá’lláhu ‘alayhi wa álihi, written after the Prophet's name.
usage: Abbreviation of the blessing upon the Prophet Muhammad, written after his name.

definition: Verb (form I, past): he shouted, cried out. Root ṣ-y-ḥ.
usage: To cry out, as the Call of God or a herald cries out to the world.

definition: Noun ṣáḥib (owner, companion) with 3rd masc. suffix: its owner. Root ṣ-ḥ-b.
Active participle (accusative): truthful, sincere. Root ṣ-d-q.
notes: Quran 40:28.

definition: Adjective: pure, clear, limpid. Root ṣ-f-w.
usage: 'Pure, clear', of a pure heart or limpid water, as a condition of reflecting God's light.

definition: ṣáfí (pure, clear; Arabic) + -st (is). Root ṣ-f-w.
usage: Is clear; of the pure, clear water of the Revelation.

definition: Proper noun: Ṣáliḥ, prophet sent to the people of Thamúd; as adjective 'righteous'. Root ṣ-l-ḥ.
usage: Ṣáliḥ, a prophet sent to the people of Thamúd, cited in the Kitáb-i-Íqán among Prophets rejected by their people.

definition: Adjective from the name Ṣáliḥ, the Prophet sent to Thamúd: of Ṣáliḥ.
usage: In the Íqán هیکل صالحی 'the Temple of Ṣáliḥ'.

definition: Active participle of ṣamata, 'to be silent': silent, silently. Root ṣ-m-t.
usage: Aqdas: یقعد صامتا لاصغآء آیات اللّه 'let him sit in silence to hearken to the verses of God'.

definition: Noun ṣabáḥ 'morning' with indefinite -í; چند صباحی 'for a few days, a short while'. Root ṣ-b-ḥ.
Noun ṣabá 'east wind, morning zephyr' with izáfih. Root ṣ-b-w.
usage: Messenger-breeze of the Beloved in mystical poetry.

definition: Adjective: of the morning, at dawn.
Verb: she was patient, she waited. Root ṣ-b-r.
Verb, form I perfect: we were patient, we endured. Root ṣ-b-r.
usage: نصبر کما صبرنا 'We will be patient as We have been patient'.

definition: Noun ṣabr "patience, endurance" with suffix "my". Root ṣ-b-r.
Noun: desert, open plain, wilderness. Root ṣ-ḥ-r.
Persian plural of ṣaḥrá: deserts, plains, open country. Root ṣ-ḥ-r.
Noun: sound, voice, echo. Root ṣ-d-y.
Noun ṣadr 'breast, chest; seat of honour' with -ishán 'their'. Root ṣ-d-r.
Plural of ṣadr 'breast, bosom', in construct. Root ṣ-d-r.
usage: In the Íqán ای کاش صدرهای عباد 'would that the breasts of men'.

definition: Adjective: pure, unmixed; outright, sheer. Root ṣ-r-ḥ.
usage: کفریست صراح 'sheer blasphemy'.

definition: Noun ṣiráṭ 'path, way' with 'his'. Root ṣ-r-ṭ.
usage: In the Aqdas صراطه الأقوم 'His straight Path'.

definition: Money-changer; an assayer who tests coins for purity. Root ṣ-r-f.
usage: HW: بدست صرّاف ذائقه احدی 'in the hand of the assayer of discernment'.

definition: Perfect of form II ṣarraḥa 'to state plainly, declare explicitly'. Root ṣ-r-ḥ.
usage: قد صرّح نقطة البیان 'the Point of the Bayán hath explicitly declared'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I), passive: it was spent. Root ṣ-r-f.
usage: Aqdas: لأوقات صرفت فی ذکره 'for hours spent in His remembrance'.

definition: Noun: scratching sound, creaking. Root ṣ-r-r.
usage: Aqdas: صریر قلمی الاعلی 'the shrill voice of My Most Exalted Pen'.

definition: Past tense of ṣaghura 'to be small, petty'. Root ṣ-gh-r.
usage: 'Became small'; of that which is lowly in the sight of God.

definition: Noun: row, line, rank; ṣaff an-ni‘ál "the row of sandals" by the door, the humblest place. Root ṣ-f-f.
usage: Row, rank; in ṣaff an-ni‘ál 'the row of sandals', the humblest seat by the door.

definition: Noun: clearness, purity, serenity. Root ṣ-f-w.
usage: Purity or serenity, of the heart's purity.

definition: Noun ṣifát (plural of ṣifa "attribute") + -ná "our". Root w-ṣ-f.
usage: Our attributes; God's names and attributes reflected in His Manifestations.

definition: Plural of ṣifah with 3rd masc. suffix: His attributes. Root w-ṣ-f.
usage: His attributes, the divine attributes reflected in the Manifestations.

definition: Adjective (fem.) from ṣifát 'attributes': pertaining to the divine attributes. Root w-ṣ-f.
usage: Pertaining to the divine attributes, as distinct from the station of the Essence.

definition: Noun: attribute, quality. Root w-ṣ-f.
usage: 'Attribute', as in صفة الله 'the Attribute of God', of the divine attributes manifested in the Prophets.
notes: ṣifatu’lláh: the Attribute of God.

definition: Noun: attribute, quality, description. Root w-ṣ-f.
usage: Attribute; the divine attributes reflected in the Manifestation.

definition: Noun ṣifat 'attribute, quality' + indefinite -í. Root w-ṣ-f.
usage: Attribute or quality, as in divine attributes and human qualities.

definition: Noun: surface, page, tablet. Root ṣ-f-ḥ.
usage: In the Hidden Words صفحهٴ دل 'the tablet of the heart'.

definition: Noun: backbone, loins; lineage, descent. Root ṣ-l-b.
usage: Íqán: گویا از یک صلب ظاهر شده‌اند 'as though they had sprung from the same loins'.

definition: Noun ṣalát 'ritual prayer' with -kum: your prayer. Root ṣ-l-w.
usage: The obligatory prayer, as in Aqdas: لا یبطل الشّعر صلوتکم 'hair doth not invalidate your prayer'.
notes: Qur'anic spelling with و.

definition: Noun: silence. Root ṣ-m-t.
usage: A virtue of the true seeker in the Íqán.

definition: Abstract noun of ṣamad 'eternal, self-subsisting' with 3rd masc. suffix: His eternity. Root ṣ-m-d.
Adjective: of the Eternal, self-subsisting (from الصّمد 'the Eternal'). Root ṣ-m-d.
Plural of ṣindíd: brave chiefs, notables. Root ṣ-n-d-d.
usage: صنادید قوم 'the leaders of the people'.

shift: Here: a craft, art, skill. Today: industry.
definition: Noun: craft, art, skill; in modern Persian "industry". Root ṣ-n-‘.
Noun ṣun‘ 'making, handiwork' with -í 'my'. Root ṣ-n-‘.
Ṣúríyá, as in Ibn Ṣúríyá, a Jewish rabbi of Fadak, with the Persian copula -st: is (the story of) Ibn Ṣúríyá.
usage: The Íqán tells his story about the Torah's penalty for adultery.

definition: Noun: the Sufis, the mystics of Islam. Root ṣ-w-f.
Noun: hunter, fowler, fisherman. Root ṣ-y-d.
usage: In the Hidden Words صیّاد اجل 'the fowler of death'.

definition: Harm, affliction, hardship. Root ḍ-r-r.
usage: Paired with بأساء: بأساء و ضرّاء 'adversity and affliction'.

definition: Noun: harm, loss, damage. Root ḍ-r-r.
Noun ḍarar 'harm, loss' with the indefinite -í: some harm. Root ḍ-r-r.
Weak, feeble ones; plural of ḍa‘íf, accusative. Root ḍ-‘-f.
usage: Aqdas, echoing Qur'an 4:9: الّذی ترک ذرّیة ضعافاً 'he who leaveth weak offspring'.

definition: Noun: going astray, error, misguidance. Root ḍ-l-l.
usage: Paired with کفر: اهل کفر و ضلال 'people of unbelief and error'.

definition: Arabic ضلال 'error, straying' with Persian است 'is'. Root ḍ-l-l.
usage: Íqán: هیاکل ضلالست 'the embodiments of error'.

definition: Adjective in accusative: narrow, hard, wretched. Root ḍ-n-k.
Noun ḍawḍá’ 'uproar, clamour' plus indefinite -í.
usage: 'An uproar'; of tumult raised by opponents.

definition: Verb: past 3rd masculine plural of ṭára "to fly, soar". Root ṭ-y-r.
usage: They soared; of souls soaring in the heaven of God's nearness.

definition: Noun: strength, endurance, capacity to bear. Root ṭ-w-q.
usage: Endurance or capacity to bear, of what souls can bear of revelation.

definition: Active participle ṭálib "seeking, desirous" + copula -am "I am". Root ṭ-l-b.
usage: Seeking; طالب is the seeker of truth, and طلب 'search' is the first of the Seven Valleys.

definition: Verb (form I perfect, fem.): became long, lengthened. Root ṭ-w-l.
usage: Became long, e.g. of nights of separation.

definition: Verb, perfect form III 1st pl.: We studied, perused. Root ṭ-l-‘.
Adjective, feminine form: pure, clean, undefiled. Root ṭ-h-r.
usage: 'Pure, undefiled', as in ارض طاهره 'pure earth'; also the title of Ṭáhirih, the Bábí heroine.
notes: Final ٴ marks the izáfih.

definition: ṭá'ir (bird, flier) + indefinite -í. Root ṭ-y-r.
usage: A bird; often the soul as a bird.

definition: Active participle ṭá’if 'circling' + Persian -and 'they are'. Root ṭ-w-f.
usage: Circling, as in circling round the Manifestation or the holy shrine.

definition: Noun: group, party, sect, people. Root ṭ-w-f.
Noun: layer, tier, stage; one of the stacked heavens; also tray, dish. Root ṭ-b-q.
notes: In a verse quoted in the Íqán: امین مخزن هفتم طبق 'trustee of the treasury of the seven heavens'; exact rendering not confirmed.

definition: Noun: expulsion, driving away. Root ṭ-r-d.
usage: Paired with رد 'rejection'.

definition: Verb form II passive: to be embroidered, adorned. Root ṭ-r-z.
usage: طراز 'ornament' gives the title of the Tablet of Ṭarázát.

definition: Noun: manner, style, way.
Noun, dual of ṭaraf: both sides, both parties. Root ṭ-r-f.
Noun: way, path, manner; with Persian indefinite -í. Root ṭ-r-q.
Noun ṭa‘ám 'food' with indefinite ی and است: is a food. Root ṭ-‘-m.
usage: Of spiritual food, the Word of God.

definition: Proper noun: aṭ-Ṭaff, the plain of Karbilá where the Imám Ḥusayn was martyred.
Noun ṭifl 'child' with indefinite -í. Root ṭ-f-l.
Noun: divorce, repudiation of a wife. Root ṭ-l-q.
usage: In the Íqán Jesus abrogated the laws of divorce and the Sabbath.

definition: Verb ṭalaba 'to seek', past 2nd singular. Root ṭ-l-b.
Present 3rd plural of ṭalabídan 'to seek, demand' (from Arabic ṭalab).
Present subjunctive of ṭalabídan 'to seek' (short form): (if) thou seek. Root ṭ-l-b.
usage: In the Hidden Words اگر فیض روح القدس طلبی 'if thou seekest the grace of the Holy Spirit'.

definition: Verb form II: he divorced (his wife). Root ṭ-l-q.
usage: In the divorce laws of the Aqdas.

definition: Noun, plural of ṭalqah: divorces, pronouncements of divorce. Root ṭ-l-q.
usage: In the Aqdas بعد طلقات ثلاث 'after thrice divorcing', a practice abolished.

definition: Passive perfect of form II ṭallaqa "to divorce": she was divorced. Root ṭ-l-q.
usage: Aqdas: و الّتی طلّقت بما ثبت علیها منکر لا نفقة لها 'she who is divorced for proven misconduct hath no maintenance'.

definition: Imperative of form II ṭahhara 'to purify' with suffix 'it'. Root ṭ-h-r.
usage: روحک منظری طهّره لظهوری 'thy spirit is My place of revelation; cleanse it for My manifestation'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I), passive: it was folded, rolled up. Root ṭ-w-y.
usage: Aqdas: کما طوی بساط الأوّلین 'even as the carpet of those who went before was rolled up'.

definition: Passive past of ṭawá: was rolled up, folded. Root ṭ-w-y.
Intensive adjective from ṭára 'to fly': flying swiftly. Root ṭ-y-r.
usage: 'Flying swiftly'; of the bird of the soul soaring.

definition: Adjective (feminine): good, pure, wholesome. Root ṭ-y-b.
usage: Pure, goodly; as in kalimih-yi ṭayyibih 'a goodly word'.
notes: Final ە with izáfih hamza as written in the source.

definition: Verb ṭára "to fly", imperative masculine plural: fly, soar ye. Root ṭ-y-r.
usage: 'Soar ye', a call to soar in the heaven of nearness to God.

definition: Noun ṭayr "bird" + indefinite -í; har ṭayrí every bird. Root ṭ-y-r.
usage: A bird; birds stand for souls, the bird of the heart or spirit seeking its nest.

definition: Noun: clay, mud, earth. Root ṭ-y-n.
usage: Clay, of which man was created.
notes: Min ṭín al-ḥubb = from the clay of love.

definition: Noun: clay; innate nature, disposition. Root ṭ-y-n.
usage: Innate nature, the clay of one's being.

definition: Plural of ẓálim 'oppressor, wrongdoer'. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: 'Oppressors', of the wrongdoers who persecuted the Prophets and the believers.

definition: Plural of ẓánn: those who conjecture or entertain idle suppositions. Root ẓ-n-n.
usage: Those who conjecture; rendered "the idle fanciers".

definition: Adverbial accusative of ẓáhir: outwardly, visibly, apparently. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: Outwardly, set against باطناً 'inwardly'.

definition: Feminine plural of ẓáhir 'manifest, evident'. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: In بیّنات ظاهرات 'manifest signs'.

definition: Noun ẓáhir 'outward, apparent side' with Persian suffix -ishán 'their'. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: Paired with باطن: ظاهرشان و باطنشان مطابق 'their outward and inward conform'.

definition: Noun ẓill 'shade, shadow' with Persian -ash: its shade. Root ẓ-l-l.
Persian plural of ẓulm 'oppression, injustice'. Root ẓ-l-m.
Verb, perfect 3rd masc. pl. of ẓalama: they wronged, acted unjustly. Root ẓ-l-m.
Adjective (fem.): shadowy, of shadows; unreal. Root ẓ-l-l.
usage: In صور ظلّیّه 'shadowy forms' from which the heart must be cleansed.

definition: Noun ẓann 'surmise, opinion' with suffix: thy fancy. Root ẓ-n-n.
usage: هذا علمی و ذلک ظنّک 'This is My knowledge, and that is thy fancy'.

definition: Noun ẓahr "back" with suffix "its (fem.)": its back, i.e. the face of the earth. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: From Qur'an 16:61 ما ترک علی ظهرها من دابّة "He would not leave upon it a moving thing".

definition: Verb: 'they appeared', perfect 3pl of ẓahara. Root ẓ-h-r.
Accusative of specification of ẓuhúr 'appearance, manifestation': in manifestation, in visibility. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: ظهور is the term for a Revelation or Manifestation of God; in the Íqán اشدّ ظهوراً و اعظم نوراً 'more intense in manifestation, mightier in light'.

definition: Verb ‘áda 'to return, repeat', past dual: the two repeated. Root ‘-w-d.
usage: In the Aqdas, of a repeated offence and doubled fine.

definition: Perfect 3rd feminine singular of ‘áda 'to return'. Root ‘-w-d.
notes: Íqán: و الی کنائز حکمها عادت.

definition: Noun: habit, custom, usage. Root ‘-w-d.
Occurring, befalling; with شدن 'to befall'. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
Noun ‘árif 'one who knows (God), mystic' with indefinite -í. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: عارف the knower of God, the mystic seeker.

definition: Active participle plural: those who know; mystic knowers of God. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: In the Writings those with true knowledge of God, as in نزد عارفین 'in the eyes of them that know'.

definition: Naked, bare; devoid of (with از). Root ‘-r-y.
usage: Íqán: عاری از لباس اهل علم 'devoid of the garb of the learned'.

definition: Persian plural of ‘áshiq: lovers. Root ‘-sh-q.
Persian abstract noun from Arabic عاشق 'lover': being a lover, love. Root ‘-sh-q.
usage: Íqán: رسوم عشق و عاشقی 'the ways of love and of the lover'.

definition: Active participle: disobedient, sinner. Root ‘-ṣ-y.
Active participle of ‘aṭila: idle, useless, vain. Root ‘-ṭ-l.
usage: 'Idle'; the Writings condemn idleness and make work a form of worship.

definition: Active participle: rational, wise; a wise man. Root ‘-q-l.
usage: Wise, rational; of the wise man who heeds counsel.
notes: After kam min "how many a".

definition: Noun ‘áqil "intelligent person" with indefinite -í: any wise man. Root ‘-q-l.
usage: Any wise or intelligent person.

definition: Active participle ‘álim "learned man, scholar" + indefinite -í. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: A learned man or divine; the Íqán criticises the divines (علما) who opposed the Manifestation.

definition: Noun ‘álam "world" + indefinite -í: a world. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: A world; the Writings speak of the many worlds (عوالم) of God.

definition: Plural of ‘álim (knower), accusative/genitive: knowing, aware. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Knowing, as in Qur'anic 'if ye are of them that know'.
notes: Inná kunná ‘álimín. Not ‘álamín (worlds).

definition: Plural active participle: exalted ones, those on high. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: Exalted ones, from Qur'án 38:75.
notes: mala’un ‘álún 'the Concourse on high'.

definition: Adjective: high, lofty, exalted; indefinite accusative here. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: 'Lofty, exalted', of the high station of God's Cause; ‘Alí is a related divine name.

definition: Adjective: general, universal, common. Root ‘-m-m.
usage: General, universal; in phrases like فیض عام "universal grace".
notes: Distinct from ‘ám (year).

definition: Active participle in accusative: intentionally, deliberately. Root ‘-m-d.
usage: Deliberately, as in Aqdas laws distinguishing intentional acts.

definition: Active participle: doing, acting; a doer, agent. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: In the Íqán God فاعلست … و عامل است 'doeth whatsoever He willeth'.

definition: Noun: worship, devotion. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: تفکّر ساعة خیر من عبادة سبعین سنة 'one hour's reflection is preferable to seventy years of pious worship'.

definition: Noun: worship, devotion. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: Worship of God, often noting His independence of it.

definition: Plural of 'abd 'servant' with pronoun 'His'. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: From Qur'án 6:18 و هو القاهر فوق عباده 'He is the Supreme over His servants'.

definition: Noun in the accusative: servant, slave. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: عبد in the Writings is usually 'servant' of God; here the Aqdas forbids buying a slave.

definition: Proper noun: ‘Abdu’l-Kháliq, 'servant of the Creator'; here Mullá ‘Abdu’l-Kháliq of Yazd.
Noun ‘abd 'servant' with suffix: our servant. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: Qur'an 2:23 ممّا نزّلنا علی عبدنا 'of that which We have sent down to Our Servant'.

definition: Noun ‘abd "servant" with suffix "my". Root ‘-b-d.
Verbal noun: crossing, passage; محلّ عبور 'path, way'. Root ‘-b-r.
Plural of ‘abd: slaves, servants. Root ‘-b-d.
Noun ‘itrah 'family, descendants' with -í 'my'. Root ‘-t-r.
usage: In the tradition کتاب اللّه و عترتی 'the Book of God and My Family'.

definition: Intensive adjective: wondrous, very strange (Qur'an 38:5). Root ‘-j-b.
‘Ajab 'wonder, strange thing' with ast 'is': it is strange. Root ‘-j-b.
Noun: non-Arabs, especially the Persians; Persia. Root ‘-j-m.
Verb, past 1st person singular with 'thee': I kneaded thee. Root ‘-j-n.
usage: In the Hidden Words من طین الحبّ عجنتک 'out of the clay of love I have kneaded thee'.

definition: Kneaded, mixed, compounded; عجین گشتن "to be kneaded with". Root ‘-j-n.
usage: Íqán: از آب حکمت لدنّی عجین گشته‌اند 'they are kneaded with the water of divine wisdom'.

definition: Noun: hostility, enmity, aggression. Root ‘-d-w.
usage: Paired with کینه: کینه و عدوان 'hatred and enmity'.

definition: Noun: torment, chastisement, punishment. Root ‘-dh-b.
usage: Common in Qur'anic warnings: عذاب الیم 'a grievous torment'.

definition: 'Adháb with indefinite -í: a torment, punishment. Root ‘-dh-b.
‘adháb 'torment, punishment' plus indefinite -í plus -st 'is'. Root ‘-dh-b.
usage: 'Is a torment'; of what constitutes torment for the soul.

definition: Adjective: sweet, fresh (of water), pleasant. Root ‘-dh-b.
usage: Sweet, fresh; of sweet water, figuratively the sweet waters of knowledge.

definition: Adjective/noun: of Iraq; also a Persian musical mode, ‘Iráqí melodies.
usage: Of Iraq; also a Persian musical mode (عراقی) in the melodies of the spirit.

definition: Noun, plural of ‘aríḍa: petitions, letters to a superior. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: Petitions or letters to a superior; of believers' letters to Bahá'u'lláh or 'Abdu'l-Bahá.
notes: Written عرائض.

definition: Verb (form I perfect): he ascended, mounted up. Root ‘-r-j.
usage: Ascending, of the soul's ascent (معراج) to God.
notes: Subject is man aráda: whoso desired to ascend hath ascended.

definition: Verb, perfect 3rd masc. pl. of ‘araja: they ascended. Root ‘-r-j.
usage: Ascended, of souls or spirits rising.

definition: Adjective, feminine form: accidental, contingent, transitory. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: 'Transitory, contingent', of the accidental things of this world, contrasted with the essential (ذاتیّه).

definition: ‘irfán (knowledge, recognition, gnosis) + indefinite -í. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: Knowledge, recognition; in عرفان الله "the recognition of God".

definition: Perfect (form II) of ‘arrafa 'to make known, acquaint' + -kum 'you'. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: He made known to you, of God acquainting people with His Cause.

definition: Noun: handle, loop; al-‘urvat al-wuthqá 'the firm handle'. Root ‘-r-w.
usage: Qur'anic العروة الوثقی 'the sure Handle', faith in God and His Manifestation.

definition: Noun plural: brides (‘arús + Persian plural -há). Root ‘-r-s.
usage: Mystical image عروسهای معانی 'the brides of inner meaning', unveiled from the palace of the spirit.

definition: Noun: handle, loop, firm hold. Root ‘-r-w.
usage: Qur'anic عروة الوثقی 'the sure handle', the Covenant or Faith to hold fast to.

definition: Noun: might, glory, honour. Root ‘-z-z.
Noun ‘izz 'glory, might' with 3rd pl. suffix. Root ‘-z-z.
Noun: seclusion, withdrawal, retirement. Root ‘-z-l.
usage: In the Íqán's counsel to the seeker: withdrawal from the proud and worldly.

definition: Noun ‘izz 'might, glory' with suffix: your glory. Root ‘-z-z.
usage: یطوی بساط عزّکم 'the carpet of your glory shall be rolled up'.

definition: Accusative of ‘azíz: mighty, noble, honoured, precious. Root ‘-z-z.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words صنعتک عزیزاً "I made thee noble".

definition: Comparative of ‘azíz 'dear, precious, mighty'. Root ‘-z-z.
Adjective ‘azíz 'dear, precious, mighty' with object suffix -ash: (hold) it dear. Root ‘-z-z.
usage: In the Hidden Words چون بصر و جان عزیزش دار 'cherish it as thy sight and soul'.

definition: Defective verb: it may be, perhaps. Root ‘-s-y.
usage: Qur'anic قل عسی ان یکون قریباً 'Say: Perchance it is nigh'.

definition: Plural of ‘áshiq 'lover'. Root ‘-sh-q.
usage: The mystic lovers of God, as in صدر عشّاق 'the breast of lovers'.

definition: Twenty. Root ‘-sh-r.
usage: In the tradition العلم سبعة و عشرون حرفاً 'Knowledge is twenty and seven letters'.

definition: Noun: coquetry, flirtatious charm.
notes: Written with a joiner (عشوه‌گری).

definition: Noun ‘aṣr 'age, era' with -and 'they are'.
notes: In علمای عصرند 'are the divines of the age'.

definition: ‘Aṣr "age, time" with -hi "his". Root ‘-ṣ-r.
usage: Aqdas: من اعلم العلماء فی عصره 'among the most learned divines of his age'.

definition: Noun ‘iṣyán 'disobedience, rebellion, sin' with indefinite -í. Root ‘-ṣ-y.
Arabic verb (form I): we disobeyed. Root ‘-ṣ-y.
usage: Qur'anic: سمعنا و عصینا 'we have heard and we rebel'.

definition: Past 3pl of ‘aḍḍa: they bit. Root ‘-ḍ-ḍ.
Noun: gift, bounty, bestowal. Root ‘-ṭ-w.
usage: 'Bounty, gift'; of God's bestowal, as in بحر العطاء.

definition: Noun: perfume, scent, fragrance. Root ‘-ṭ-r.
usage: Perfume, fragrance; in the Aqdas the use of perfume (rose-water) is encouraged.

definition: Noun ‘iṭr "perfume" with indefinite -í and copula ast: it is a perfume (that).
usage: Perfume or fragrance, figurative of spiritual fragrance.

definition: Noun: gift, bestowal. Root ‘-ṭ-w.
usage: A gift or bestowal, especially of God.

definition: Plural of ‘aẓím: the great, dignitaries, notables. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
usage: The notables or dignitaries.

definition: Noun: pardon, forgiveness. Root ‘-f-w.
Noun: punishment, chastisement. Root ‘-q-b.
usage: 'Punishment', paired with ثواب 'reward', of divine chastisement.

definition: Verb, Form I past 3rd plural + "it": they understood it. Root ‘-q-l.
notes: Qur'án 2:75.

definition: Noun ‘aql 'mind, reason' + indefinite -í: any mind. Root ‘-q-l.
usage: Mind or reason, as in that no mind can grasp God's essence.
notes: Also the adjective ‘aqlí 'rational'.

definition: Plural of ‘aql 'mind, reason' with -him 'their'. Root ‘-q-l.
Noun plural: signs, marks, tokens (‘alámat + Persian -há). Root ‘-l-m.
usage: The signs foretold for the Promised One, in the Íqán interpreted spiritually.

definition: Noun, dual of ‘aláma: two signs, two marks. Root ‘-l-m.
Noun used adverbially: addition; علاوه بر 'besides, in addition to'. Root ‘-l-w.
Noun, plural of ‘aláqah: ties, attachments (to worldly things). Root ‘-l-q.
Noun: cause, reason; illness. Root ‘-l-l.

shift: Here: ailments, ills (علّت). Today: causes, reasons.
definition: Plural of ‘illat 'illness; (modern) cause'. Root ‘-l-l.
usage: طبیب جمیع علّتهای تو ذکر من است 'Remembrance of Me is the remedy for all thine ills'.
notes: Modern Persian علت usually means 'cause'.

definition: Form II of ‘-l-q: to suspend, make dependent on; "We made it conditional". Root ‘-l-q.
usage: In the Aqdas marriage is made conditional on the consent of both parents.

definition: Plural ‘ulamá 'learned men, clergy' with -í before a relative clause: 'those divines who'. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Íqán the Muslim divines who opposed the Manifestation.

definition: Perfect 2nd person masculine plural of ‘alima: you knew, you know. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Aqdas هل علمتم من ایّ قلم یأمرکم ربّکم 'know ye from what Pen your Lord commandeth you?'

definition: Noun ‘ilm 'knowledge' with -ishán 'their'. Root ‘-l-m.
Noun ‘ilm 'knowledge' with -am 'my'. Root ‘-l-m.
Form II: We taught them. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Aqdas بما علّمناهم علماً من لدنّا 'through the knowledge We have taught them from Our presence'.

definition: Persian plural of ‘ilm: kinds of knowledge, sciences. Root ‘-l-m.
Noun, Persian plural of ‘ilm 'knowledge, science' with izáfih.
usage: In علمهای مجعوله 'fabricated learning', set against divine knowledge.

definition: Form II imperative plural: teach ye! Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Aqdas: علّموا ذرّیاتکم ما نزّل من سماء العظمة 'teach your children the verses revealed from the heaven of majesty'.

definition: The Amalekites, an ancient people opposed to the Israelites.
Proper noun: ‘Imrán, the father of Moses (and of Mary in Islamic tradition).
usage: Íqán: موسی بن عمران 'Moses, son of ‘Imrán'.

definition: Persian plural of ‘umr (life): lifetimes; adverbially, for ages. Root ‘-m-r.
Oath formula wa ‘amrí or la-‘amrí 'by My life'. Root ‘-m-r.
usage: The oath 'by My life', used by God in the Writings to affirm a statement.
notes: In Persian ‘umrí 'a lifetime' has the same letters.

definition: Verb: past 2nd masculine plural of ‘amila "to do, practise". Root ‘-m-l.
usage: You did; ordinary verb.

definition: Noun ‘amal "deed, work" with -hu: his work, his deeds. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: His deeds or work.
notes: Aqdas: "his works shall be brought to nought".

definition: Noun ‘amal "deed, act" + indefinite -í. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: A deed; the Writings stress deeds over words.

definition: Noun: blindness. Root ‘-m-y.
usage: Blindness, often spiritual blindness.

definition: Verb, perfect 3rd fem. sing. of ‘amiya: it became blind; optative 'may it be blind'. Root ‘-m-y.
usage: Became blind; as an optative, 'may it be blind'.

definition: Preposition ‘an 'from, away from' with suffix -ná 'us'.
Phrase: ‘inda (with, in the presence of) + Alláh: in the sight of God.
usage: In the sight of God; of standing before God.

definition: Persian plural of ‘andalíb 'nightingale'.
usage: Nightingales, a symbol in the Writings of the Manifestation and of lovers singing God's praise.

definition: Noun: the ‘Anqá, a mythical bird dwelling on Mount Qáf; the phoenix. Root ‘-n-q.
usage: In the Hidden Words ای عنقای بقا 'O Phoenix of immortality'.

definition: Preposition ‘an 'from, concerning' with suffix -hunna 'them (feminine)'.
notes: Aqdas: عفا اللّه عنهنّ 'God hath exempted them (women)'.

definition: Noun: responsibility, charge; از عهده برآمدن 'to be capable of, manage'. Root ‘-h-d.
Persian plural of 'ahd 'time, era'; 'ahd also means covenant. Root ‘-h-d.
Noun ‘ahd 'covenant' with indefinite -í and copula ast: is a covenant. Root ‘-h-d.
Noun plural: accidents, contingent qualities, incidental limitations. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: In عوارض بشریّه 'human limitations'.

definition: Double plural of ‘áriḍ: accidents, contingent attributes. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: عوارضات تعدد 'the accidents of multiplicity'.

definition: Plural of ‘áqiba "end, outcome" with suffix "its": its consequences. Root ‘-q-b.
Plural of ‘áqibah 'end, outcome' with -kum. Root ‘-q-b.
Plural of ‘álam 'world' with -í: My worlds. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Aqdas یجدون عرف عوالمی 'they inhale the fragrance of My worlds'.

definition: Verb ‘áda 'to return, repeat', imperative plural. Root ‘-w-d.
usage: In the Aqdas عودوا بضعف الجزآء 'double the penalty'.

definition: Noun: substitute, compensation; از عوض / عوض 'instead of'. Root ‘-w-ḍ.
Wailing, loud lamentation. Root ‘-w-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words عویل برمیار 'lament not'.
notes: The Hidden Word glosses it itself: یعنی بد مگو.

definition: Proper noun: ‘Akká, the prison-city in the Holy Land where Bahá'u'lláh was exiled.
usage: سجن عکاء 'the Prison of ‘Akká', the Most Great Prison.

shift: Here: household, family, dependants. Today: mostly one's wife.
definition: Noun: household, family, dependants; in modern Persian mostly 'wife'. Root ‘-y-l.
usage: In مال و عیال 'possessions and family', which the early believers forsook.

definition: Feast, festival, holiday. Root ‘-w-d.
usage: Aqdas: جعلنا النّیروز عیداً لکم 'We have made Naw-Rúz your Feast'.

definition: Imperative plural of form II ‘ayyana 'to appoint, assign, specify'. Root ‘-y-n.
Noun عین 'eye; spring; essence' with the suffix 'thy'. Root ‘-y-n.
usage: HW: لتقرّ به عینک و تقرّ به عینی 'that thine eyes may be solaced therewith and Mine too'.

definition: Dual of ‘ayn with 'thy': your two eyes. Root ‘-y-n.
Double plural of ‘ayb 'fault, defect' (Arabic ‘uyúb plus Persian -há).
usage: 'Faults'; in calls to see one's own faults rather than others'.

definition: Noun: Arabic plural ‘uyún of ‘ayn "eye, spring" plus Persian -am "my".
usage: My eyes; Arabic plural with Persian suffix.
notes: A play on ‘uyún "eyes" and "springs".

definition: Noun ‘uyún (Arabic plural of ‘ayn, spring) with Persian plural -há: springs, fountains. Root ‘-y-n.
usage: Springs or fountains, often of divine knowledge.
notes: Double plural.

definition: Noun ‘uyún (plural of ‘ayn "eye") + -kum "your". Root ‘-y-n.
usage: Your eyes; of eyes opened to, or veiled from, the beauty of God.
notes: naṣba ‘uyúnikum before your eyes.

definition: Verb (form I perfect): disappeared, set, became hidden or absent. Root gh-y-b.
usage: Vanished or set, as of the sun or the hidden.

definition: Active participle (accusative): heedless, unaware. Root gh-f-l.
usage: Heedless; heedlessness is a chief spiritual fault in the Writings.

definition: Plural of gháfil 'heedless, negligent'. Root gh-f-l.
usage: 'The heedless', those unaware of God and His Day, frequently addressed in the Hidden Words.

definition: Superlative of gháfil (heedless): most heedless.
Adjective gháfil 'heedless, unaware' + indefinite -í. Root gh-f-l.
usage: Heedless, a theme of the Hidden Words' calls to awaken from heedlessness.

definition: Active participle: obscure, abstruse, difficult; feminine agreeing with a plural noun. Root gh-m-ḍ.
usage: In the Íqán مسائل غامضه 'abstruse questions'.

definition: Noun: utmost degree, extreme limit; aim, goal. Root gh-y-y.
usage: فی غایة 'in the utmost degree of': فی غایة الجهد 'with utmost endeavour'.

definition: Noun, plural of ghubár: dust, clouds of dust. Root gh-b-r.
usage: Figurative dust of acquired learning or worldly attachment.

definition: Persian plural of ghubár 'dust' with izáfih. Root gh-b-r.
Noun gharb 'west' with 3rd fem. suffix: its west. Root gh-r-b.
Verb: it deceived, beguiled. Root gh-r-r.
usage: In the Aqdas, of the world: کما غرّت قوماً قبلکم 'as it deceived a people before you'.

definition: Verb, form I perfect with suffix: it deceived him, beguiled him. Root gh-r-r.
usage: من غرّته العلوم 'he whom learning hath deluded'.

definition: Noun: aim, purpose; selfish motive, bias. Root gh-r-ḍ.
usage: In the Íqán the heart must be cleansed of the dust of غرض "self-interest".

definition: Plural of ghurfah 'upper chamber'; Qur'anic for the mansions of paradise. Root gh-r-f.
Ghurfa 'upper chamber, room' with Persian -ash 'its': its chamber. Root gh-r-f.
usage: In the Íqán در هر غرفه‌اش صدهزار حکمت مخزون 'in its every chamber a hundred thousand wisdoms are treasured'.
notes: Split from غرفه‌اش; the alif belongs to the suffix.

definition: Noun ghurúb 'setting (of a heavenly body)' with copula -ast. Root gh-r-b.
Noun: military expedition, battle (especially of the Prophet). Root gh-z-w.
Ritual washing, ablution of the whole body or of the dead. Root gh-s-l.
usage: In the Íqán غسل دهد و کفن نماید 'wash and shroud'.

definition: Noun: covering, veil over the eyes. Root gh-sh-w.
usage: Qur'an 45:23 و جعل علی بصره غشاوة 'and set a veil over his sight'.

definition: Noun: anger, wrath. Root gh-ḍ-b.
usage: In غضب الهی 'the wrath of God'.

definition: Cover, covering, veil. Root gh-ṭ-w.
usage: Íqán: کشف غطا فرمودند 'they lifted the veil', i.e. revealed themselves.

definition: Verbal noun: forgiveness, pardon (of sins). Root gh-f-r.
usage: غفران عباد 'forgiveness of servants'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): he was heedless, neglectful. Root gh-f-l.
usage: Aqdas: الّذی غفل انّه من همج رعاع 'he that is heedless is of the foolish'.

definition: Noun: heedlessness, unawareness. Root gh-f-l.
Past tense, second person masculine plural, of ghafala 'to be heedless, neglect'. Root gh-f-l.
usage: 'Ye were heedless'; of heedlessness toward God.

definition: Noun ghafla "heedlessness" plus -him "their". Root gh-f-l.
usage: Their heedlessness; ghaflat, neglect of God, is a frequent reproach.

definition: Compound noun: those who neglect, the heedless; ghaflat "heedlessness" + kunandih "doer" + plural -án.
usage: The heedless (اهل غفلت); heedlessness is a frequent theme of rebuke.

definition: Verb (form I, past) 3rd person masculine plural: they neglected, were heedless. Root gh-f-l.
usage: To be heedless, especially of God's Day; heedlessness (غفلت) is a constant theme of warning.

definition: Plural of ghalabah: overpowering surges, sway, prevailing force. Root gh-l-b.
usage: Overpowering surges, e.g. of love or longing.

definition: Verb, perfect 3rd fem. sing. of ghalaba: it overcame. Root gh-l-b.
notes: Quran 2:249.

definition: Verb, passive perfect 3rd person feminine of ghalla: were shackled, fettered. Root gh-l-l.
usage: From Qur'an 5:64 on the Jews' claim that the hand of God is fettered, cited in the Íqán of those who think God's grace has ceased.
notes: Quran 5:64.

definition: Noun: grief, sorrow. Root gh-m-m.
usage: Grief, sorrow; often paired with اندوه.

definition: Noun ghamám 'clouds' + -í: that cloud. Root gh-m-m.
usage: Clouds, often the clouds of the Day of God, as in 'coming in the clouds of heaven'.

definition: Arabic ghamám 'clouds' with Persian -í 'a' and -st 'is': is a cloud. Root gh-m-m.
usage: In the Íqán clouds (غمام) are whatever veils the eye from recognizing the Manifestation.

definition: Noun: wealth, riches, sufficiency. Root gh-n-y.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words: انت عرفت غنآء نفسک فیه و انا عرفت الغنآء فی تقدیسک عنه 'thou hast known thy wealth to be in it, and I know wealth to lie in thy freedom from it'.
notes: Distinct from ghiná’ 'singing'.

definition: Comparative of ghaní 'rich, self-sufficient': richer. Root gh-n-y.
Plural of ghámiḍ: obscure, abstruse matters. Root gh-m-ḍ.
Noun ghawghá 'tumult' with indefinite -í: an uproar, a commotion.
Verb: he erred, went astray. Root gh-w-y.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: من اعرض غوی و هلک 'whoso turneth away shall go astray and perish'.

definition: Noun ghayba 'absence, concealment' with suffix: my absence. Root gh-y-b.
usage: Aqdas: فی ظهوری لحکمة و فی غیبتی حکمة اخری 'In My presence there is a wisdom, and in My absence yet another'.

definition: Noun ghayr "other" with suffix "her/it": other than it, and the like. Root gh-y-r.
Abstract noun ghayríyyat 'otherness, difference' with indefinite -í. Root gh-y-r.
Passive perfect of gháḍa 'to sink, subside (of water)': it ebbed, sank away. Root gh-y-ḍ.
usage: In the Aqdas اذا غیض بحر الوصال 'when the ocean of My presence hath ebbed', echoing Qur'an 11:44.

definition: Conjunction fa- 'so' plus imperative of abṣara 'to see'. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: In the Hidden Words بصرک بصری فابصر به 'thine eye is Mine eye, do thou see with it'.

definition: Conjunction fa- 'so, then' + imperative of taraka 'to leave, abandon'. Root t-r-k.
Fa- 'then' plus imperative of atá 'to come'; with bi- 'bring'. Root ’-t-y.
usage: In Qur'an 2:23 فأتوا بسورة من مثله 'produce a Súrah like it'.

definition: Conjunction fa- with imperative of ja‘ala: then make, then set. Root j-‘-l.
Conjunction fa- with the imperative 'make' and 'it': so make it. Root j-‘-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words فاجعله امام عینیک 'set it then before thine eyes'.

definition: Fa "then" + ij‘alú "make, place ye" (imperative plural of ja‘ala). Root j-‘-l.
usage: Aqdas, on theft: فی الثّالث فاجعلوا فی جبینه علامة 'for the third offence place ye a mark upon his brow'.

definition: Conjunction fa- with the imperative of jahada 'to strive, exert oneself'. Root j-h-d.
usage: فاجهد فیه یا عبد 'strive therein, O servant'.

definition: Conjunction ف with the imperative of احبّ 'love' and the suffix 'me'. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: HW: احببت خلقک فخلقتک فاحببنی 'I loved thy creation, hence I created thee. Wherefore, do thou love Me'.

definition: Fa- with imperative of aḥraqa and 'him': then burn him. Root ḥ-r-q.
fa- 'so' plus imperative plural of ḥafiẓa 'to guard, protect' plus -há 'them'. Root ḥ-f-ẓ.
usage: 'So guard them'; of protecting laws or trusts.

definition: Conjunction fa- plus imperative of ḥamala "to carry, bear". Root ḥ-m-l.
usage: And carry, bear; ordinary verb.

pos: particle + verb 1pl perf. (form IV) + pron. suffix
definition: Particle fa- with form IV aḥyá "to bring to life", perfect 1st plural with -hu: and We quickened him. Root ḥ-y-y.
usage: 'And We quickened him', of God giving spiritual life.
notes: Qur'an 6:122.

definition: Particle fa- + imperative of khajila: so be ashamed. Root kh-j-l.
usage: So be ashamed; a rebuke in the Arabic Hidden Words to those who claim love but disobey.

definition: Fa- with imperative pl. of raja‘a: so return ye, refer ye (unto). Root r-j-‘.
usage: 'So return ye' or 'refer ye' unto God or His Book.

pos: conj. + verb imperative masc. pl. + obj.
definition: fa- + imperative masc. pl. of raja‘a (transitive) + -hu: refer it back. Root r-j-‘.
usage: Refer it back, e.g. what is not understood to the Book.

definition: fa- 'so' + imperative of raḍiya: be thou pleased, content. Root r-ḍ-y.
usage: 'Be pleased', in prayers asking God to be pleased with His servant.
notes: The alef is a connecting alef: fa-rḍa ‘anní.

definition: fárigh (free, unoccupied, detached) + indefinite -í. Root f-r-gh.
usage: Free, detached; of detachment from the world.

definition: Imperative of rafa‘a 'to raise, lift' with fa 'so'. Root r-f-‘.
usage: So raise, in prayers raising the call or hands to God.

definition: Fa- 'so' plus imperative of sa’ala: so ask ye. Root s-’-l.
usage: Qur'an 16:43 فاسألوا اهل الذکر 'ask ye them that have the Book of God'.

definition: Conjunction fa 'so' + imperative of istabshara, 'to rejoice at good news'. Root b-sh-r.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words: ببشارة النّور ابشّرک فاستبشر به 'with the joyful tidings of light I hail thee: rejoice!'.

definition: Conjunction fa with form VIII imperative: so hasten, race forward. Root s-b-q.
Fa 'so' and imperative of istaráḥa 'to rest, repose'. Root r-w-ḥ.
Conjunction fa with form X imperative: so be independent, be content (with it alone). Root gh-n-y.
Conjunction فـ with imperative of استقام: so be steadfast, stand upright. Root q-w-m.
usage: Qur'anic فاستقم کما امرت 'be steadfast as thou hast been bidden'; steadfastness is a key virtue.

definition: Conjunction ف with form X imperative: then seek light, be illumined. Root n-w-r.
usage: مصباحی فیک فاستنر به 'My light is in thee. Get thou from it thy radiance'.

definition: fa "then" plus imperative of form IV asra‘a: then hasten! Root s-r-‘.
Active participle: sinner, wicked, transgressor. Root f-s-q.
Fa- 'then' plus the imperative of form IV asqaṭa 'to cause to fall, drop'. Root s-q-ṭ.
usage: Qur'an 26:187 in the Íqán: فاسقط علینا کسفاً من السماء 'cause a part of the heaven to fall upon us'.

definition: Active participle, plural: transgressors, the ungodly. Root f-s-q.
Conjunction fa- + imperative of sami‘a 'to hear'. Root s-m-‘.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: سمعک سمعی فاسمع به 'Thy hearing is My hearing, hear thou therewith'.

definition: Fa- plus imperative of sa’ala 'to ask'. Root s-’-l.
usage: In the Aqdas فاسئلوا اللّه ربّکم 'ask ye God, your Lord'.

definition: Conjunction fa- with imperative of ṣa‘ida: then ascend. Root ṣ-‘-d.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words فاصعد الی ما خلقت له 'ascend unto that for which thou wast created'.

definition: Conjunction fa- with the form VIII imperative plural: so take warning. Root ‘-b-r.
usage: In Qur'an 59:2 فاعتبروا یا اولی الأبصار 'Take ye heed, O people of insight'.

definition: Fa "then" + a‘riḍ "turn away" (form IV imperative). Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: HW: ان تحبّ نفسی فأعرض عن نفسک 'if thou lovest Me, turn away from thyself'.

definition: Conjunction fa- with the imperative of ‘arafa 'to know, recognize'. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: فاعرف یا عبد 'know this, O servant'.

definition: Arabic فاعل 'doer, agent' with Persian است 'is'. Root f-‘-l.
usage: Íqán: فاعلست آنچه را اراده نماید 'He doeth whatsoever He willeth'.

definition: Fa- with imperative of ‘alima: so know ye. Root ‘-l-m.
Arabic fá‘il 'doer, agent' plus Persian -and 'they are': they do, perform. Root f-‘-l.
Conjunction fa- plus imperative of ‘amila "to do" plus -hu "it". Root ‘-m-l.
usage: So do it; command to act.

definition: Particle fa- with form IV imperative afrigh "empty, free": so empty (thyself). Root f-r-gh.
usage: 'So empty (thyself)', of freeing the heart from all but God.
notes: HW: "Free thyself, therefore, from the veils".

definition: Particle fa- + imperative (form IV) of aqbala: so turn towards. Root q-b-l.
usage: So turn towards (God); اقبال 'turning towards' is the believer's response to the Call.

definition: Fa- with imperative pl. of qatala and 3rd masc. object: then put him to death. Root q-t-l.
usage: 'Then slay him', in quotations of hostile decrees against the Manifestation.

definition: fa- + perfect form VIII of lafata: then he turned. Root l-f-t.
Noun and adjective: paralysis; paralysed, palsied. Root f-l-j.
usage: 'Paralysed', of physical palsy and figuratively of a disabled faculty.

definition: fa + an-nár (fire; hell). Root n-w-r.
usage: The Fire, hell; as the state of remoteness from God.

definition: Imperative (form IV) of amṭara 'to rain down' with fa 'then'. Root m-ṭ-r.
usage: Rain down, in prayers asking God to rain down mercy or bounty.

definition: Fa- 'so' plus imperative of intaṣaḥa: accept counsel, heed advice. Root n-ṣ-ḥ.
Conjunction fa 'then' + imperative plural of intaẓara, 'to wait, to expect'. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: Íqán: قل یا ملأ الجهّال فانتظروا 'Say: O ye ignorant ones, wait ye'.

definition: Conjunction fa with form IV perfect and -hum: so He made them forget. Root n-s-y.
usage: Qur'an 59:19: نسوا اللّه فأنساهم انفسهم 'they forgot God, so He made them forget themselves'.

definition: Fa 'so' and imperative of anṣafa 'to be fair, just'. Root n-ṣ-f.
Conjunction fa with the particle inna and 2nd masc. suffix: for verily thou.
Active participle: passing away, annihilated, effaced. Root f-n-y.
usage: In the Sufi pairing فانی و باقی 'effaced and abiding'.

definition: Persian plural of fání 'perishing': mortals; those effaced in God. Root f-n-y.
usage: این فانیان 'these mortal ones'.
