definition: Active participle of faná: perishable, fleeting, transient. Root f-n-y.
usage: Contrasted with باقی "abiding", as in سلطنت فانیه "fleeting sovereignty".
notes: Final ە carries the izáfih.

definition: Imperative of aghmaḍa 'to close the eyes': aghmiḍ ‘an 'disregard'; with fa- 'then'. Root gh-m-ḍ.
notes: Spelled with ٴ (U+0674) for hamza.

definition: Fa- 'then' plus the imperative of kataba 'to write': then write. Root k-t-b.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words فاکتب من المداد الاحمر 'then write with that crimson ink' shed in God's path.

definition: Active participle fá’iz 'attaining, successful' with copula -and. Root f-w-z.
usage: Fá’iz is common for attaining a station or presence.
notes: Written فائزند.

definition: Conjunction fa- + aynamá 'wherever, whithersoever'.
usage: From Qur'an 2:115 فأینما تولّوا فثمّ وجه اللّه 'whithersoever ye turn, there is the face of God'.

definition: Fa- plus báṭil 'false, vain'. Root b-ṭ-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words فباطل ما انتم تظنّون 'vain is that which ye imagine'.

definition: Conjunction fa- with bi- and ayy: in which? by which?
usage: Used in the Persian Hidden Words address ای پسر رماد, literally 'O son of ashes'.

definition: Conjunction fa- with the form II imperative and 'him': so give him tidings. Root b-sh-r.
usage: In Qur'an 45:8 فبشّره بعذاب الیم 'announce to him a painful punishment'.

definition: Perfect 1pl of fataḥa "to open, unseal, conquer". Root f-t-ḥ.
usage: Aqdas: بل فتحنا ختم الرّحیق المختوم 'nay, We have unsealed the choice Wine'.

definition: Conjunction fa- with tis‘a 'nine'; with عشر forms 'nineteen'. Root t-s-‘.
usage: In the law of Ḥuqúqu’lláh: فتسعة عشر مثقالا لله 'nineteen mithqáls are due unto God'.

definition: Conjunction ف with the imperative of تعجّب 'wonder'. Root ‘-j-b.
usage: HW: فتعجّبوا من ذلک یا اولی الأبصار 'marvel at this, O ye that have eyes to see'.

definition: Fa- with imperative of tafakkara: so reflect. Root f-k-r.
fa- plus imperative plural of form V tamanná 'to wish, long for'. Root m-n-y.
usage: Qur'anic challenge 'then long for death if ye are truthful'.
notes: Qur'an 62:6 'wish then for death, if ye are truthful'.

definition: Noun: Persian plural of fitnih "trial, test, sedition". Root f-t-n.
usage: Trials, seditions; fitnih is a test of faith and also tumult.
notes: Normalized from فتنه‌های.

definition: Noun futúḥ "openings, victories; spiritual expansion" with indefinite -í. Root f-t-ḥ.
usage: Opening or spiritual expansion, of a breakthrough of divine grace.

definition: Noun: formal legal opinion or ruling (fatwa). Root f-t-y.
usage: A legal ruling; in the Writings the sentences the divines issued against the Manifestations.

definition: Noun: youth, young man. Root f-t-y.
usage: Youth, chivalrous young man.

definition: fa- + thamma 'there'.
notes: Quran 2:115 fa-aynamá tuwallú fa-thamma wajhu’lláh.

definition: Noun, broken plural of fájir: the wicked, profligate. Root f-j-r.
usage: 'The wicked', as in کفره فجره 'the wicked unbelievers', of those who opposed the Cause.
notes: kafarih-yi fajarih: the wicked unbelievers.

definition: fa + jamí‘ (all, the whole of). Root j-m-‘.
Noun: indecency, abomination, wickedness (Arabic faḥshá’). Root f-ḥ-sh.
usage: Indecency or abomination, as in avoiding فحشا 'lewdness'.

definition: Noun: pride, glory, honour, boast. Root f-kh-r.
Conjunction fa 'so' + khalaqtu 'I created' + -ka 'thee'. Root kh-l-q.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words: احببت خلقک فخلقتک 'I loved thy creation, hence I created thee'.

definition: Noun: ransom, sacrifice; فدا شدن 'to be sacrificed'. Root f-d-y.
usage: Self-sacrifice in the path of God.

definition: Noun fidá' 'ransom' with pronoun 'thy'. Root f-d-y.
usage: In the formula جعلت فداک 'may I be thy ransom', a respectful address.

definition: Verbal noun fidá’ 'ransom, sacrifice' with 1st sing. suffix: my sacrifice. Root f-d-y.
Verb: he ransomed, gave his life as sacrifice. Root f-d-y.
Verb, form I perfect: I ransomed, sacrificed (myself). Root f-d-y.
usage: The Báb's words قد فدیت بکلّی لک 'I have sacrificed myself wholly for Thee'.

definition: Adjective: (of water) sweet, fresh; also the river Euphrates. Root f-r-t.
usage: From the Qur'anic عذب فرات "sweet and fresh" (25:53).

definition: Adverbial plural: one by one, individually. Root f-r-d.
usage: In the Aqdas the obligatory prayer is performed individually (فرادی), congregational prayer being annulled.

definition: Noun and adverb: top, height, summit; bar faráz-i, upon, atop.
usage: In the Íqán ظالمان را بر فراز عدل محل معیّن نموده 'set the oppressors upon the seat of justice'.

definition: Noun: leisure, freedom from cares, detachment. Root f-r-gh.
Adjective farámúsh 'forgotten' with -ash 'it'; فراموش کردن 'to forget'.
The forgotten ones; plural of faramúsh-shudih.
Conjunction fa- with ra'ayta 'you saw'; after a-: have you seen? Root r-'-y.
usage: Used in the Persian Hidden Words address ای پسر رماد, literally 'O son of ashes'.
notes: The interrogative أ is written as a separate word.

definition: Verb, past 3rd person feminine singular: she fled. Root f-r-r.
usage: In Qur'an 74:50-51 حمر مستنفرة فرّت من قسورة 'affrighted asses fleeing from a lion'.

definition: Farsang "league" (about 6 km) with plural -há and izáfih.
usage: Íqán: از فرسنگهای بعیده 'from distant leagues'.

definition: Passive perfect of faraḍa 'to impose, prescribe as obligatory'. Root f-r-ḍ.
usage: تلک حدود الله قد فرضت علیکم 'these are the ordinances of God prescribed unto you'.

definition: Noun فرع 'branch' with the suffix 'its'. Root f-r-‘.
usage: Qur'anic: اصلها ثابت و فرعها فی السّماء 'its root firmly fixed, its branches reaching unto heaven'.

definition: Relational adjective from Fir'awn: Pharaonic, of Pharaoh's people.
Relative adjective of Furqán 'the Criterion', a name of the Qur'an. Root f-r-q.
usage: 'Qur'anic', relating to the Furqán, as in دور فرقان 'the Muhammadan Dispensation'.

definition: Noun: dual of farqad: the two pointer stars near the Pole Star. Root f-r-q-d.
usage: The twin stars; the two pointer stars near the Pole Star, an image of loftiness.
notes: A pun with farq dán "know the difference".

definition: Verb farmúdan, present 1st singular: I command, I do; honorific auxiliary ("rájí‘ farmáyam" I shall return).
usage: Honorific auxiliary used by the Manifestation of Himself in compound verbs, as in راجع فرمایم 'I shall return'.

definition: Verb, present perfect 2nd person plural of farmúdan (honorific "do, command"): you have (done).
usage: Honorific 'have done', an auxiliary in polite address; also used of God's commands.
notes: muláḥaẓih farmúdih-íd ye have observed.

definition: Past 2nd pl. of farmúdan: you said, declared; honorific verb of speaking.
usage: Honorific 'you said', addressing an exalted person.

definition: Past 1st pl. of farmúdan 'to command', honorific auxiliary: názil farmúdím 'We sent down'.
usage: Honorific auxiliary in God's speech, as in نازل فرمودیم 'We sent down'.

definition: Noun: party, group, faction. Root f-r-q.
usage: 'A party, group', of factions among peoples.

definition: Verb, Form I past 2nd plural: you attained, won. Root f-w-z.
usage: You attained, won; of attaining God's good pleasure.

definition: Noun: fright, terror, alarm. Root f-z-‘.
usage: Terror, as in الفزع الاکبر 'the greatest terror' of the Day of God.

definition: Persian plural of Arabic fasád 'corruption, mischief, disorder'. Root f-s-d.
Conjunction fa 'then' + sawfa, particle marking the future: ye shall (soon).
notes: Qur'anic فسوف تعلمون 'ye shall soon know'.

definition: Arabic verb, form IV future 3rd plural: they will shake (their heads) in mockery. Root n-gh-ḍ.
usage: Qur'an 17:51: فسینغضون الیک رؤوسهم 'they will wag their heads at thee'.

definition: Verb form II: to set out in detail, expound. Root f-ṣ-l.
Verb, form II perfect 1st pl. with 3rd fem. suffix: We have set them forth in detail. Root f-ṣ-l.
Noun: season; section, chapter; with Persian indefinite -í. Root f-ṣ-l.
Plural of faṣl: seasons; chapters, sections. Root f-ṣ-l.
usage: فصول اربعه 'the four seasons'.

definition: Noun: open space, expanse; in modern use "space, atmosphere". Root f-ḍ-w.
Plural of fáḍil 'learned, virtuous'; the final ی links the izáfih. Root f-ḍ-l.
Noun faḍl 'grace, bounty, favour, excellence' with -hi: His grace. Root f-ḍ-l.
usage: فضل 'grace, bounty' is often contrasted with عدل 'justice'; in the Aqdas فضله الّذی احاط العالمین 'His bounty that encompasseth the worlds'.

definition: Verb, form II: to prefer, favour above others; with -kum 'you'. Root f-ḍ-l.
Conjunction fa- + ṭúbá 'blessedness, bliss': blessed be, well is it with. Root ṭ-y-b.
usage: A common beatitude, طوبی ل... 'Blessed is ...'.

definition: Fa- plus ‘ajab 'a wonder'. Root ‘-j-b.
usage: In Qur'an 13:5 و ان تعجب فعجب قولهم 'if thou marvellest, marvellous is their saying'.

definition: Noun: deed, act, action; also verb in grammar. Root f-‘-l.
usage: In امر و قول و فعل 'command, word and deed'.

definition: Verb, past 1st person singular with 'it': I did it. Root f-‘-l.
usage: In Moses' reply (Qur'an 26:20) فعلتها اذاً و انا من الضّالّین 'I did it then, and I was of the erring'.

definition: Fa‘la "a single deed, act" with -ka "your". Root f-‘-l.
usage: Qur'an 26:19 in the Íqán: و فعلت فعلتک الّتی فعلت 'and thou didst commit thy deed which thou didst'.

definition: Noun fi‘l 'deed, act' with suffix 'thy'. Root f-‘-l.
usage: تدبّر فی فعلک 'ponder thy deeds'.

definition: Conjunction ف with عیینا 'We were wearied, exhausted'. Root ‘-y-y.
usage: Qur'anic: أ فعیینا بالخلق الأوّل 'were We wearied by the first creation?'

definition: Fa- with farartu: so I fled. Root f-r-r.
Plural of faqír 'poor' (Persian form) with izáfih -y. Root f-q-r.
usage: 'The poor'; in calls to care for the poor.

definition: Noun: plural of faqír "poor" plus -í "my". Root f-q-r.
usage: My poor; God's poor, the needy whom He commends to the rich.
notes: Normalized from فقرائی.

definition: Noun faqr "poverty" with indefinite -í: every poverty. Root f-q-r.
usage: Poverty; in mystical sense spiritual poverty before God, as in the Hidden Words' contrast of فقر and غنا.

definition: Noun, Persian plural of faqír: the poor. Root f-q-r.
usage: The poor, whom the Hidden Words entrust to the care of the rich; فقر also means spiritual poverty before God.

definition: Noun faqír (poor) with indefinite -í: a poor person. Root f-q-r.
usage: A poor one; spiritual poverty (فقر) is detachment from all save God.

definition: fa- + emphatic la- + energetic imperfect 2nd masc. pl. of qariba: ye shall surely approach. Root q-r-b.
notes: Reading and sense in this Aqdas passage not confirmed.

definition: Noun: paralysis, palsy. Root f-l-j.
fils (small copper coin) + indefinite -í: a single penny. Root f-l-s.
usage: A single penny, a farthing.

definition: Conjunction fa 'so' + la‘na 'curse'. Root l-‘-n.
usage: The curse of God, as in لعنة الله 'the curse of God' upon the wrongdoers.

definition: Past of falaqa: he split, cleft asunder. Root f-l-q.
usage: In the Íqán الّذی فلق لکم البحر 'Who clove the sea for you'.

definition: fa 'then' + li 'for, belongs to' + al-umaná’ 'the trustees', plural of amín. Root '-m-n.
usage: Aqdas: فللأمنآء ان یأخذوا منه 'it is for the trustees to take from him'.

definition: Conjunction fa with li- and wukalá', plural of wakíl: then (it is) for the trustees. Root w-k-l.
Fa 'then' and lima 'why': why then?
Conjunction: and when, so when; fa with lammá.
Conjunction فـ with لمسوا 'they touched' and 'it'. Root l-m-s.
usage: In the Qur'anic verse quoted in the Íqán about a Book sent down on parchment.

definition: Phrase: then (it is) for thine own self.
usage: ان اقبلت فلنفسک 'if thou turnest, it is for thine own behoof'.

definition: Form II of w-l-y with emphatic la- and energetic -anna: We shall surely turn thee. Root w-l-y.
usage: From Qur'an 2:144 on the change of the Qiblih.

definition: fa- 'then' with lahá 'for her': 'then she has (the right/duty)'.
Fa- 'then' plus li- 'to, for' plus -hum: then to them belongs.
Conjunction fa- plus li- of command with jussive of anisa 'to be intimate with': let him commune. Root ’-n-s.
usage: In the Hidden Words من اراد ان یأنس مع اللّه فلیأنس مع احبّائه.
notes: Written فلیأنس.

definition: fa- + jussive li- + energetic of dakhala 'to enter': then let him surely enter. Root d-kh-l.
notes: Aqdas: entering upon the Fast after the Intercalary Days.

definition: Fa- plus jussive li-yasma‘: let him hear. Root s-m-‘.
usage: In the Hidden Words من اراد ان یسمع کلام اللّه فلیسمع کلمات اصفیائه.

definition: Verb form II jussive with fa-li-: let them pray. Root ṣ-l-w.
usage: Aqdas: in lands of long days and nights let them pray by clocks.

definition: Conjunction fa- with the jussive li-: let him turn away. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: In فمن شآء فلیقبل و من شآء فلیعرض 'whoso will, let him turn towards it, and whoso will, let him turn away'.

definition: Fa "then" + li (command particle) + ya‘mal: then let him do. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: Qur'an 18:110 in the Íqán: فمن کان یرجو لقاء ربّه فلیعمل عملاً صالحاً 'whoso hopeth to attain the presence of his Lord, let him work a righteous work'.

definition: Jussive of qa‘ada 'to sit' with the command particle li- after fa-: 'then let him sit'. Root q-‘-d.
Conjunction ف 'and so' with ما (negative or relative).
notes: فما زلتم فی شکّ 'yet ye ceased not to doubt'.

definition: Faná' with 'thy': your perishing, extinction. Root f-n-y.
fa- plus imperfect first person plural of ‘ádha 'to seek refuge'. Root ‘-w-dh.
usage: 'We seek refuge (in God)'; formula against evil or error.

definition: Verb: past participle of fahmídan "to understand".
usage: Understood; ordinary verb form.

definition: Particle fa- "then, so" with pronoun huwa "he": and he, then he.
Noun fu’ád "heart, inmost heart" + -ka "thy". Root f-’-d.
usage: Thy heart, the inmost heart where God's love dwells, in the Arabic Hidden Words.

definition: Plural of fákihih: fruits. Root f-k-h.
usage: Fruits of paradise or of the tree of knowledge.

definition: Plural of fawḥa: wafts of fragrance. Root f-w-ḥ.
usage: Fragrances, wafts of the divine springtime.

definition: Verbal noun: boiling, gushing, surging forth. Root f-w-r.
usage: 'Surging, gushing', of the surging of the ocean of utterance or of passion.

definition: fa + Form II imperative of w-l-y: so turn (thy face).
usage: Turn (thy face); echoes Qur'anic فول وجهک.
notes: Qur'án 2:144.

definition: Conjunction fa 'and, then' + perfect of wahaba 'to grant, bestow'. Root w-h-b.
usage: Then granted, of God bestowing gifts.

definition: Fa- 'so' plus wayl 'woe, distress'. Root w-y-l.
usage: Qur'an 2:79 فویل للذین یکتبون الکتاب بایدیهم 'woe unto them who write the Book with their own hands'.

definition: Conjunction fa 'and so' + kána 'it was, it came to be'. Root k-w-n.
usage: In the formula of the creative Word کن فکان 'Be, and it was'.

definition: Arabic phrase fí al-ḥín: at once, immediately. Root ḥ-y-n.
Arabic phrase used in Persian: for example, for instance. Root m-th-l.
Conjunction fa with imperfect 3rd sing. of da‘á: and he summons. Root d-‘-w.
Conjunction فـ with یذلّ 'he becomes abased, humbled'. Root dh-l-l.
usage: In the tradition quoted in the Íqán: His chosen ones shall be abased in His time.

definition: Noun fayḍ 'grace, bounty, outpouring' with Persian suffix. Root f-y-ḍ.
fa "and" plus passive of qatala: and they are slain. Root q-t-l.
fa- 'and so' with yaqúlúna 'they say'. Root q-w-l.
Proper name: Pontius Pilate, the Roman governor who tried Jesus.
usage: In the Íqán Christ in the presence of Pilate and Caiaphas.

definition: Conjunction fa- plus present of láḥa 'to gleam, shine'. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: In the Hadith of Kumayl quoted in the Íqán.

definition: Preposition fí 'in' + -hinna 'them' (feminine plural).
Passive of akhadha 'to take': and he is seized. Root ’-kh-dh.
usage: In Qur'an 55:41 فیؤخذ بالنّواصی و الأقدام 'they shall be seized by their forelocks and their feet'.

definition: Adverb with fa-: then on that day. Root y-w-m.
usage: Qur'an 55:39 فیومئذ لا یسأل عن ذنبه انس و لا جان 'On that day shall neither man nor spirit be asked of his sin'.
notes: Written فیومئذ.

definition: Verb, form III imperative plural with 'him': meet him, respond to him. Root q-b-l.
usage: In the Aqdas من اغتاظ علیکم قابلوه بالرّفق 'whoso is angered with you, meet him with gentleness'.

definition: Cain, son of Adam, who slew his brother Abel (هابیل).
usage: Íqán: معجزه هابیل و قابیل 'the miracle of Abel and Cain'.

definition: Perfect of form III qátala 'to fight' with suffix 'them'; imprecation. Root q-t-l.
usage: قاتلهم الله 'God confound them' (Qur'an 9:30).

definition: Arabic قاتل 'killer' with Persian indefinite ی. Root q-t-l.
usage: Íqán of Moses: یا قاتلی 'or a murderer' who heard the voice from the Tree.

definition: Active participle plural: able, powerful. Root q-d-r.
Proper noun: Qáf, the mythical mountain encircling the world, home of the ‘Anqá.
usage: Mount Qáf, the mythical mountain at the world's end, home of the ‘Anqá; a symbol of the soul's lofty goal.

definition: Verb: past 3rd feminine singular of qála "to say" (with a collective subject). Root q-w-l.
Verb qáma "to stand, arise", perfect 3rd masculine plural: they arose. Root q-w-m.
usage: 'They arose', as in rising to serve the Cause.

definition: Active participle: conquering, overpowering, irresistible. Root q-h-r.
usage: Overpowering, conquering; an attribute of God's might.

definition: Feminine active participle: overpowering, conquering, irresistible. Root q-h-r.
usage: Overpowering, as in قدرت قاهره 'overpowering might'.

definition: Active participle of qála 'say': one who holds, affirms; qá’il shudan 'to accept, acknowledge'. Root q-w-l.
usage: One who holds a view; قائل شدن 'to acknowledge'.
notes: Written قائل.

definition: Active participle of qála, indefinite accusative (circumstantial): saying. Root q-w-l.
usage: 'Saying', introducing a quotation, as in قائلا 'saying'.

definition: Active participle plural (accusative) of qála: saying, those who say. Root q-w-l.
Plural of qubba: domes, pavilions, tabernacles. Root q-b-b.
usage: Domes or pavilions, as in قباب العظمة 'tabernacles of majesty'.

definition: Noun: written contract, title-deed of sale. Root q-b-l.
Noun: grasp, grip, handful; power, control. Root q-b-ḍ.
usage: Íqán: کلّ شیء فی قبضة قدرته اسیر 'all things are held captive in the grasp of His power'.

definition: Noun qabḍa 'grasp, handful' with -hu: His grasp. Root q-b-ḍ.
usage: Qur'an 39:67: الأرض جمیعاً قبضته 'the whole earth shall be His handful'.

definition: Nisba noun: Copt, Egyptian; of Pharaoh's people. Root q-b-ṭ.
usage: Contrasted with سبطی 'Israelite': the Copt (oppressor) and the Israelite (people of Moses).

definition: Arabic qabl 'before' with Persian 1st sing. -am: I am (of) the former.
Verb: we accepted, received. Root q-b-l.
Adverb قبل 'before' with Persian -and: they are (of) the former one. Root q-b-l.
usage: علمای ظهور قبلند 'are the divines of the former Dispensation'.

definition: qabl "before" with suffix "it (fem.)": before it. Root q-b-l.
Preposition qabl 'before' with -hum 'them'. Root q-b-l.
Preposition qabl 'before' with -í: before me. Root q-b-l.
usage: Qur'an 3:183 in the Íqán: قد جاءکم رسل من قبلی بالبیّنات 'apostles before me have come to you with clear signs'.

definition: Adjective: ugly, shameful, reprehensible. Root q-b-ḥ.
Persian plural of qabílih 'tribe, clan'. Root q-b-l.
Fighting, combat. Root q-t-l.
Verb: you (pl.) killed them. Root q-t-l.
usage: Used in the Persian Hidden Words address ای پسر رماد, literally 'O son of ashes'.

definition: Noun qatl 'killing' with Persian -ash 'his'. Root q-t-l.
notes: In فتوی بر قتلش میدهند 'issue a decree for his death'.

definition: Quddám "in front of" with -hu: before him. Root q-d-m.
usage: HW: لأنّی امشی قدّامه 'for I walk before him' (the poor).

definition: Adverb-preposition quddám 'in front of' with suffix 'thee'. Root q-d-m.
usage: نور الوجه یمشی قدّامک 'the light of the countenance walketh before thee'.

definition: Noun: power, might, ability. Root q-d-r.
usage: و ما من قدرة الّا بحوله و قوّته 'there is no power save by His might and strength'.

definition: Qudra with 'his': his power, might. Root q-d-r.
Noun qudrah 'power' plus -í 'My'. Root q-d-r.
usage: 'My power'; God's address of His omnipotence.

definition: Noun qadr "worth, rank" plus Persian -ash "his". Root q-d-r.
usage: His worth, his station; qadr 'worth, rank'.

definition: Verb form II qaddara "to ordain, decree", perfect 1st plural with -hu: We ordained it. Root q-d-r.
usage: 'We ordained it', of God's decree.

definition: Noun qadr "measure, capacity" + -ka "thy". Root q-d-r.
usage: Thy measure or worth; the Hidden Words remind man of his high station.

definition: Noun qadr (measure, capacity, worth) with 2nd pl. suffix. Root q-d-r.
usage: Your capacity or worth, e.g. 'according to your capacity'.

definition: Optative formula: qaddasa 'sanctified' (form II, root q-d-s) + Alláh: may God sanctify.
usage: 'May God sanctify', as in قدس الله روحه 'may God sanctify his soul', after a holy person's name.
notes: Written قدّس‌اللّه; qaddasa’lláhu turbatahumá 'may God sanctify their resting-place'.

definition: Noun quds 'holiness' with suffix -ishán 'their'. Root q-d-s.
usage: 'Their holiness', of the sanctity of holy souls.

definition: Verb, Form II imperative + "it": sanctify it, purify it. Root q-d-s.
usage: Sanctify it; of purifying one's heart.

definition: Imperative plural (form II) of qaddasa 'to sanctify, purify'. Root q-d-s.
usage: Sanctify, as in calls to sanctify the heart from all save God.

definition: Feminine of qudsí 'holy' with Persian -ash 'his'. Root q-d-s.
usage: In the Íqán نفحات قدسیّه‌اش 'His holy breaths'.

definition: Relative adjective from qidam 'eternity, pre-existence': eternal, of the Ancient (God).
usage: نعمت قدمانی 'the bounty of the Ancient One'.

definition: Noun qadam 'step, foot' with indefinite -í: a single step. Root q-d-m.
Adjective: ancient, pre-existent, eternal. Root q-d-m.
Adjective: all-powerful, omnipotent; a name of God. Root q-d-r.
Verb: it threw, cast forth. Root q-dh-f.
usage: In the Aqdas: قذف لئالی الأحکام 'it cast forth the pearls of the laws'.

definition: Noun: sacrifice, offering; with کردن 'to offer sacrifice'. Root q-r-b.
Noun qurb "nearness" with suffix "thy". Root q-r-b.
Noun: parchment, sheet of paper. Quadriliteral root q-r-ṭ-s.
usage: Qur'an 6:7 کتاباً فی قرطاس 'a Book written on parchment'.

definition: Persian plural of qarn: centuries, ages, generations. Root q-r-n.
Noun, plural of qarn: ages, generations; centuries. Root q-r-n.
usage: As in قرون اولی 'former generations'.

definition: Perfect 1st plural of qara’a 'to read, recite' with -hu 'it'. Root q-r-’.
notes: Search form of قرئناه.

definition: Qarína 'consort, wife' with -hu. Root q-r-n.
Noun qarín 'companion, peer' with indefinite -í. Root q-r-n.
usage: Persian Hidden Words هر قرینی قرین خود را جوید 'every companion seeketh his like'.

definition: Verb, past 1st person plural: We divided, apportioned. Root q-s-m.
usage: In the Aqdas قد قسمنا المواریث علی عدد الزّآء 'We have divided inheritance into the number of the Záh'.

definition: Qism "kind, sort, manner" with Persian plural -há: kinds, ways. Root q-s-m.
usage: Íqán: باین قسمها مبتلا 'afflicted in these ways'.

definition: Persian plural of qasam 'oath'. Root q-s-m.
notes: Final ی carries the izáfih.

definition: Noun: lion; also hunters. Root q-s-r.
usage: Qur'anic: حمر مستنفرة فرّت من قسورة 'affrighted asses fleeing from a lion'.

definition: Past of qaṣada with 'it/them': headed for, approached. Root q-ṣ-d.
Feminine elative quṣwá 'farthest, utmost' with izáfih -y. Root q-ṣ-w.
usage: 'Utmost'; as in غایت قصوی 'the utmost goal'.

definition: Adjective (feminine elative): farthest, utmost; gháyat-i quṣvá "the utmost goal". Root q-ṣ-w.
usage: Utmost, farthest; in gháyat-i quṣvá 'the utmost goal'.

definition: Noun: decree, divine destiny, judgment. Root q-ḍ-y.
usage: Decree or divine destiny, often paired with قدر, as in قضاء الله 'the decree of God'.
notes: kullu qaḍá’in maḥtúm every irrevocable decree.

definition: Noun qaḍá’ "decree, destiny" + -í "my". Root q-ḍ-y.
usage: My decree; in the Hidden Words the call to be content with God's decree.
notes: Written قضائی.

definition: Verb (form I perfect, 1st pl.): We decreed, ordained. Root q-ḍ-y.
usage: 'We decreed', of God's ordinances.

definition: Verbal noun: cutting, severing; with namúdan 'to cut off'. Root q-ṭ-‘.
usage: Cutting off; related to انقطاع, detachment from all save God.

definition: Adjective, feminine form: decisive, conclusive, certain. Root q-ṭ-‘.
usage: 'Conclusive', of decisive proofs (ادلّهٴ قطعیّه).

definition: Noun (accusative indefinite): heart. Root q-l-b.
usage: Heart; the seat of faith.

definition: Noun qalb 'heart' + Persian -am 'my'. Root q-l-b.
usage: My heart, as in the Hidden Words' 'thy heart is My home'.

definition: Noun: scarcity, paucity, littleness. Root q-l-l.
usage: In the Aqdas قلّة عقولهم 'the poverty of their understanding'.

definition: Noun qalam 'pen' with suffix -hi 'His'. Root q-l-m.
usage: The Pen of Revelation; Aqdas: بحرکة قلمه قلّب العالمین 'by the motion of His Pen He hath turned the world upside down'.

definition: Noun qulúb, plural of qalb 'heart', with Persian -tán: your hearts. Root q-l-b.
Adjective: little, few, small. Root q-l-l.
usage: From the Qur'anic phrase لیشتروا به ثمناً قلیلاً 'to sell it for a little price'.

definition: Adjective, feminine: few, small, little. Root q-l-l.
usage: Qur'anic, کم من فئة قلیلة 'how often hath a small band'.

definition: Noun, plural of qamíṣ: shirts, garments, robes. Root q-m-ṣ.
usage: In the Íqán the Manifestations appear in different garments (قمایص مختلفه) yet are one.

definition: Noun qamar 'moon' with suffix: its moon. Root q-m-r.
usage: Tradition: الصوم شمسها و الصلوة قمرها 'fasting is its sun, prayer its moon'.

definition: Adverbial accusative of qahr "subjugation, wrath": wrathfully, by force. Root q-h-r.
Noun: power, strength, force. Root q-w-y.
usage: In the formula لا حول و لا قوّة الّا بالله 'there is no power nor strength save in God'.

definition: Noun quwwa 'strength, power' with -hi: His strength. Root q-w-y.
usage: Echoes the formula لا حول و لا قوّة الّا بالله; in the Íqán ما من قدرة الّا بحوله و قوّته.

definition: Noun qawl 'saying, word' with Persian plural -há. Root q-w-l.
Imperative plural of qála 'to say'. Root q-w-l.
Qawl 'saying, word' with indefinite -í. Root q-w-l.
Noun, accusative indefinite: a people, a nation. Root q-w-m.
usage: Aqdas کما غرت قوماً قبلکم 'as it deceived a people before you'.

definition: Noun qawm 'people, folk' with the indefinite -í: a people, a group.
usage: In the Íqán قومی از شیعیان ما 'a people among our Shí‘ahs'.
notes: In Arabic phrases قومی can be 'my people'.

definition: Strong, powerful, firm; accusative of qawí. Root q-w-y.
usage: Aqdas: من کان علی الأمر قویّاً 'one who is strong in the Cause'.

definition: Caiaphas, the high priest before whom Christ was tried.
Arabic قیامة 'resurrection' with Persian indefinite ی. Root q-w-m.
usage: In the Íqán the Resurrection is the advent of the Manifestation: قیامتی اکبر از این قیامت 'a resurrection greater than this'.

definition: Divine name: Self-Subsisting, Ever-Abiding. Root q-w-m.
usage: قیوم الاسماء, the Báb's commentary on the Súrih of Joseph.

definition: Divine name: self-subsisting, all-sustaining; accusative indefinite. Root q-w-m.
usage: 'Self-Subsisting'; divine name, as in الحی القیوم.

definition: Noun qayyúmíyya "self-subsistence, sustaining power" plus -í "my". Root q-w-m.
usage: My self-subsistence; qayyúmíyya, the sustaining power of God (al-Qayyúm).
notes: Shoghi Effendi's exact wording here not confirmed.

definition: Adverb: of necessity, inevitably, perforce; from lá budda "no escape". Root b-d-d.
Preposition li "to, for" + ibn "son". Root b-n-w.
usage: To the Son; ابن recurs in addresses such as یا ابن الانسان 'O Son of Man' in the Hidden Words.
notes: li-bni'l-insán the Son of Man.

definition: Preposition li- (to, for) with plural of ibn and 3rd pl. suffix: to their sons. Root b-n-w.
usage: To their sons, children.

definition: li- 'belonging to' + abí (genitive of ab 'father') + -him. Root '-b-w.
Negation lá + passive imperfect of aṭfa’a: are not extinguished, unquenchable. Root ṭ-f-’.
usage: 'Are not extinguished', of the unquenchable flame of God's love.
notes: Hamza written as ی (tuṭfá for tuṭfa’u).

definition: li + ithbát (Form IV verbal noun: establishing, confirming). Root th-b-t.
usage: To establish; of establishing the truth of a Cause.

definition: Preposition li + ajl 'sake' + -ka: for thy sake, for thee. Root ’-j-l.
usage: For thy sake, as in prayers 'for Thy sake'.

pos: particle + verb 1sg pres. subj. (form IV) + pron. 2sg
definition: Li- 'that, so that' with subjunctive of aḥabba 'to love' and -ka 'thee'. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: In the Hidden Words احببنی لاحبّک 'Love Me, that I may love thee'.

definition: Verb: perfect of láḥa, 'to appear, to gleam, to shine'. Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: Aqdas: لاحت من افقه شمس الحکمة و التّبیان 'from whose horizon the sun of wisdom and utterance hath shone forth'.

definition: Arabic verb, form III perfect 1st plural: We observed, perused. Root l-ḥ-ẓ.
Li 'so that' and adhkura 'I remember' with 'thee'. Root dh-k-r.
Particle li 'so that' with subjunctive 1st sing. of rafa‘a: that I may raise. Root r-f-‘.
Active participle: necessary, needful, binding. Root l-z-m.
Preposition ل with istiwá’ 'being established (upon the throne)' and suffix. Root s-w-y.
usage: Alludes to Qur'an 20:5 علی العرش استوی; the heart as God's throne.
notes: Authorized wording not confirmed.

definition: li "for" plus ism "name" with suffix "our". Root s-m-w.
Negative adjective 'not eastern', from lá 'not' and sharqí 'eastern'. Root sh-r-q.
usage: From Qur'an 24:35 شجرة ... لا شرقیّة و لا غربیّة 'a Tree neither of the East nor of the West'.

definition: Li- 'so that' plus the subjunctive 1st person singular of shahida: that I may bear witness. Root sh-h-d.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words لتشهد ... لاشهد لک 'that thou mayest testify ... that I may testify for thee'.

definition: Particle li- 'so that' plus subjunctive of aẓhara 'to reveal'. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: In the Hidden Words عظّم امری لأظهر علیک من اسرار العظم.

definition: Preposition li- 'for' + i‘áda 'restoring, bringing back'. Root ‘-w-d.
notes: From the Du‘á-yi Nudbih: the one chosen to restore the community and the law.

definition: 'Not of the West'; from Qur'an 24:35 لا شرقیّة و لا غربیّة. Root gh-r-b.
usage: In شجرهٔ لاشرقیّه و لاغربیّه 'the Tree that is neither of the East nor of the West'.

definition: Emphatic la- with ammára 'ever commanding, inciting'. Root '-m-r.
usage: From Qur'an 12:53 ان النفس لامارة بالسوء; Aqdas انها لامارة بالبغی 'they are ever prone to wickedness'.

definition: Preposition li- with amr 'command, Cause' and 'our'. Root a-m-r.
usage: In the Hidden Words بالخضوع لأمرنا 'by submission unto Our command'.

definition: Li "for, to" + amr "Cause, command" + -í "my": for My Cause. Root ’-m-r.
usage: HW: کن لأمری ناصراً 'be thou a helper of My Cause'.

definition: Preposition li- with anna 'that' and suffix 'we': 'because we'.
Preposition ل with انّ 'that' and the suffix 'it/he': because it.
Li-anna with 'them two': because they both.
li- 'because' plus anna 'that' plus -kum 'you (plural)'.
Noun: divinity, the divine realm (contrasted with násút, the human realm).
usage: Realm of divinity; the highest realm, above jabarút and malakút, contrasted with násút.

definition: Adjective: divine, pertaining to láhút, the realm of the Godhead.
usage: Divine, pertaining to لاهوت 'the realm of the Godhead', contrasted with ناسوت.

definition: Preposition li + awqát (plural of waqt "time"): for times, hours. Root w-q-t.
usage: For times or hours; in the Aqdas of set times, as for prayer.

definition: Emphatic la- with iklíl (crown, diadem): verily the crown.
usage: The crown, as in the crown of glory or of Bahá'u'lláh's dominion.

definition: li- 'so that' + subjunctive 1st sing. of kána 'be'. Root k-w-n.
Emphatic la- + áyát, plural of áyah 'sign, verse': surely signs. Root ’-y-y.
usage: 'Surely signs', in the Qur'anic formula ان فی ذلک لآیات 'verily in this are signs'.

definition: li + ayyám (days); "ṭúbá li-ayyámin" blessed are the days. Root y-w-m.
usage: In طوبی لایام "blessed are the days".

definition: Arabic lá yazál 'never ceases', used as a Persian adjective 'everlasting, imperishable', + -am 'my'. Root z-w-l.
usage: Everlasting or imperishable, of God's dominion and the believers' station.

definition: Lá 'not' plus passive of aṭfa’a 'to extinguish': it is not extinguished. Root ṭ-f-’.
usage: In the Íqán نور لایطفی 'a light that is never extinguished'.

definition: lá 'not' + yafná 'perishes': that perisheth not, imperishable. Root f-n-y.
usage: Íqán: ملک لایفنی 'the imperishable dominion'.

definition: Active participle, accusative: fit, worthy, deserving. Root l-y-q.
usage: Hidden Words: لائقاً للّقاء 'worthy of meeting Me'.

definition: Adjective: worthy, befitting, seemly. Root l-y-q.
Compound adjective, 'thirsty-lipped': parched, athirst.
notes: Written لب‌تشنه in the source.

definition: Preposition لـ with بلوغ 'reaching, maturity'. Root b-l-gh.
usage: In the Aqdas علامتین لبلوغ العالم 'two signs of the maturity of the world'.

definition: Emphatic لـ with plural active participle in construct: surely leaving. Root t-r-k.
usage: Qur'an 37:36 أئنّا لتارکوا آلهتنا 'shall we forsake our gods'.

definition: li "so that" plus subjunctive of wajada, to find: that ye may find. Root w-j-d.
Preposition li- 'for' with tajdíd 'renewal'. Root j-d-d.

pos: particle + verb 3sg fem. pres. subj. passive
definition: Li- 'so that' plus the passive subjunctive of dhakara: that (they) be mentioned. Root dh-k-r.
usage: In the Aqdas they would spend all they have لتذکر اسمائهم لدی العرش 'that their names may be mentioned before the Throne'.

definition: Preposition li- plus tarbiyah 'education, rearing' with -himá 'of the two'. Root r-b-w.
Conditional la- + perfect 2nd plural of taraka 'to leave, forsake'. Root t-r-k.
Li- 'that' plus subjunctive of sa’ala 'to ask', joined with má 'what'. Root s-’-l.
usage: In the Aqdas لتسئلوا ما تحتاج به انفسکم 'that ye may ask what your souls need'.
notes: Two words run together in the text.

definition: li- with subjunctive: that you may drink. Root sh-r-b.
Particle li- 'so that' with the subjunctive 'thou witness'. Root sh-h-d.
usage: In the Hidden Words لتشهد فی سرّک لی تقدیساً علیّاً 'that thou mayest testify within thy inmost soul to My exalted sanctity'.

definition: Li "so that" + taṭṭali‘a "you become acquainted, informed" (form VIII subjunctive). Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: Íqán: لتطّلع بما هو المقصود 'that thou mayest apprehend that which is intended'.

definition: li- 'so that' with the subjunctive of ṭára 'to fly'. Root ṭ-y-r.
usage: لتطیر باجنحة الآیات 'that it may soar on the wings of the verses'.

definition: Emphatic ل with the energetic form of طار 'fly': thou shalt surely fly. Root ṭ-y-r.
usage: Íqán: لتطیرنّ بجناحی الانقطاع 'that thou mayest soar on the wings of detachment'.

definition: Li- with subjunctive of ‘áshara: that you may associate with. Root ‘-sh-r.
usage: Aqdas: لتعاشروا مع الادیان 'that ye may consort with the followers of all religions'.

definition: li- 'so that' plus subjunctive second plural of ‘arafa 'to know'. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: 'That ye may know'; in statements of the purpose of creation and revelation.

definition: Particle li- "so that" plus subjunctive 2nd plural of ‘alima "to know". Root ‘-l-m.
usage: That ye may know; common purpose clause.

definition: Emphatic la- with imperfect 2nd masculine plural of fadá "to ransom": ye would surely offer up. Root f-d-y.
usage: 'Ye would surely offer up', of sacrificing life for the Beloved.
notes: la-tafdúna arwáḥakum ye would offer up your souls.

definition: Particle li- "so that" + subjunctive of qarra: that (the eye) be cooled, gladdened. Root q-r-r.
usage: From the Qur'anic phrase کی تقرّ عینها 'that her eye may be cooled', i.e. gladdened.

definition: Li- (so that) with subjunctive 2nd sing. of malaka: so that you may possess. Root m-l-k.
usage: So that you may possess.

definition: li- + subjunctive 2nd masc. sing. of naẓara 'look'. Root n-ẓ-r.
li- 'so that' + imperfect subjunctive form IV of anfaqa: that thou mayest spend. Root n-f-q.
usage: 'That thou spend', of spending in the path of God.
notes: Could also be read passive li-tunfaqa; the authorized text renders 'draw from stores'.

definition: kána (to be), imperfect 2nd plural with purposive li- and energetic -nna: that you may surely be. Root k-w-n.
usage: That you may surely be.
notes: Could also be read la-takúnunna (oath: ye shall surely be).

definition: Noun: obstinacy, stubborn contention, wrangling. Root l-j-j.
usage: Obstinacy or stubborn contention, as in obstinate rejection of the truth.

definition: Preposition li- 'for, of' plus jabín 'brow, forehead'. Root j-b-n.
usage: In the Aqdas الغرّة الغرّاء لجبین الانشاء 'the shining brightness upon the brow of creation'.

definition: Preposition li 'for, to' + jasad 'body'. Root j-s-d.
usage: Aqdas: رأس الکرم لجسد العالم 'the head of generosity for the body of the world'.

definition: Noun: the deep, the fathomless sea, abyss. Root l-j-j.
usage: Figurative depths, as in لجّهٔ ایمان 'the ocean of faith'.

definition: Preposition li 'for' and ḥabíb 'beloved, lover, friend'. Root ḥ-b-b.
Noun, plural of laḥẓah: glances, looks; also moments. Root l-ḥ-ẓ.
Emphatic لـ with حقّ 'truth, right'. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: In انّ هذا لحقّ یقین 'this is indeed the certain truth'.

definition: Noun: melody, tune, tone of voice. Root l-ḥ-n.
usage: لحن و صوت ملیحم 'My sweet melody and voice'.

definition: Noun laḥn "tone, manner of speech, understanding" with suffix "thy". Root l-ḥ-n.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words علی قدرک و لحنک "according to thy capacity and understanding".

definition: Emphatic la- 'verily' with ḥikam, plural of ḥikmah 'wisdom'. Root ḥ-k-m.
notes: Not ḥukm 'ruling': the plural ḥikam fits انّ فی ذلک لحکم و مصالح.

definition: Emphatic la- (after inna) plus ḥikma 'wisdom', accusative: verily there is a wisdom. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: In the Aqdas انّ فی ظهوری لحکمة و فی غیبتی حکمة اخری 'in My presence there is a wisdom, and in My absence yet another'.

definition: Preposition li- plus khidmah 'service'. Root kh-d-m.
usage: In the Aqdas لخدمة الأمر 'for the service of the Cause'.

definition: Preposition li- 'for' + khidma 'service' + -hi 'his'. Root kh-d-m.
Li- 'to' plus khalq 'creation' with -í 'My'. Root kh-l-q.
usage: In the Hidden Words ترحّماً لخلقی 'out of mercy for My creatures'.

definition: Emphatic la- with khayr 'better, good': surely better. Root kh-y-r.
usage: Aqdas: reading one verse with joy لخیر له من ان یقرء کتب الاولین 'is better for him than to read the Books of the past'.

definition: Preposition li- 'for' with dhurriyyát 'offspring' and 'your'. Root dh-r-r.
usage: In the Aqdas inheritance law قدّر لذرّیاتکم 'He hath allotted to your descendants'.

definition: Li "for" + dhikr "remembrance, mention". Root dh-k-r.
usage: Aqdas: فی مقام بنی لذکر اللّه 'in a place built for the remembrance of God'; dhikr is remembrance and praise of God.

definition: Preposition li- with rasúl 'messenger, apostle'. Root r-s-l.
usage: ان لا نؤمن لرسول 'that we should not believe in an apostle' (Qur'an 3:183).

definition: Preposition ل with رضاء 'good-pleasure' and the suffix 'His'. Root r-ḍ-y.
usage: Íqán: خالصاً للّه و طلباً لرضائه 'purely for God and seeking His good-pleasure'.

definition: Li- with ramz: in, for the symbol or sign. Root r-m-z.
Emphatic la- plus rúḥ 'spirit, breath of life'. Root r-w-ḥ.
usage: 'Spirit'; as in the Holy Spirit and the spirit animating the world.
notes: innahu la-rúḥu al-ḥayawán 'it is the breath of life'.

definition: Noun lisán "tongue, language" plus -hu "his". Root l-s-n.
usage: His tongue; tongue or language, as in lisán al-‘aẓamah 'the Tongue of Grandeur'.

definition: Emphatic la- with sulṭán "sovereign, king": is indeed the king. Root s-l-ṭ.
notes: inna’l-‘ída’l-a‘ẓama la-sulṭánu’l-a‘yád the Most Great Festival is indeed the King of Festivals.

definition: Emphatic la- + samá’ "heaven, sky": verily a heaven. Root s-m-w.
usage: Verily a heaven; سماء often bears symbolic meanings in the Íqán, such as the heaven of a religion.

definition: Preposition li- with shá‘ir (poet): for the sake of a poet. Root sh-‘-r.
li- 'for' + ṣáḥiba 'companion, wife' + -hi 'his'. Root ṣ-ḥ-b.
li- 'to, before' + ṭal‘ah 'countenance, aspect'. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: 'Before the countenance', of standing before the Countenance (طلعة) of God or His Manifestation.

definition: laṭíf (subtle, delicate, graceful) + -ash (his, its). Root l-ṭ-f.
Adjective laṭíf 'subtle, delicate, gentle', here before izáfih (لطیفئ). Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: Subtle or gentle, and the divine name اللّطیف 'the Subtle'.

definition: Preposition li- 'for' plus ẓuhúr 'appearance, manifestation' and -í 'My'. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: In the Hidden Words روحک منظری طهّره لظهوری 'thy spirit is My place of revelation; cleanse it for My manifestation'.

definition: Preposition li 'to, for' + ‘ibád 'servants' + -í 'My'. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words: تلطّفاً لعبادی و ترحّماً لخلقی 'as a token of My grace unto My servants and My mercy unto My creatures'.

definition: Preposition li- with ‘abd 'servant, slave': for a slave. Root ‘-b-d.
Preposition li 'for' and 'irfán 'knowledge, recognition'. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: عرفان 'recognition' of God's Manifestation, the first duty of man.

definition: Preposition li with ‘urúj 'ascent': for the ascent of. Root ‘-r-j.
Preposition لـ with عزّ 'glory, honour, might'. Root ‘-z-z.
usage: In the Aqdas, of sitting on chairs in honour of the love of God within believers.

definition: Oath formula: by thy life! Root ‘-m-r.
usage: Qur'an 15:72 لعمرک انهم لفی سکرتهم یعمهون; compare لعمری 'by My life' in the Aqdas.

definition: Noun: curse, damnation. Root l-‘-n.
Verb la‘ana 'he cursed' with -há 'it'. Root l-‘-n.
Passive perfect 3rd person masculine plural of la‘ana 'to curse': they were cursed. Root l-‘-n.
usage: Qur'an 5:64 in the Íqán: غلّت ایدیهم و لعنوا بما قالوا 'their own hands are fettered, and they are accursed for what they said'.

definition: Noun: language, tongue. Root l-gh-w.
usage: In the Aqdas, the choice of one language for all the world, the Bahá'í principle of a universal auxiliary language.

definition: Emphatic la- + ghafúr 'much-forgiving', a divine name. Root gh-f-r.
La- 'surely' plus ghaní 'rich, self-sufficient'. Root gh-n-y.
usage: In فانّ اللّه لغنیّ عن العالمین 'God, verily, is independent of all creatures'.

definition: Noun: weariness, fatigue. Root l-gh-b.
usage: Echoes Qur'an 35:35 لا یمسنا فیها لغوب.

definition: Preposition li- with ghayr 'other' and 'thee': for other than Thee.
usage: In the prayer أ یکون لغیرک من الظّهور ما لیس لک 'Can aught beside Thee possess a revelation which is not possessed by Thee?'.

definition: Li "for" + ghayr "other than" + -kum: for others than you. Root gh-y-r.
usage: Aqdas: تفرحون بما جمعتموه لغیرکم 'ye rejoice in that which ye have amassed for others'.

definition: Emphatic la- with perfect of qála 'to say', in the apodosis of law: 'would have said'. Root q-w-l.
Preposition ل with قضاء 'decree' and the suffix 'my'. Root q-ḍ-y.
usage: HW: شاکراً لقضائی 'thankful for My decree'.

definition: Past 3pl of laqiya with 'you': they met you. Root l-q-y.
li- 'for' plus al-ábá’ (plural of ab 'father'). Root '-b-w.
usage: 'For the fathers'; in Aqdas laws on inheritance and duty to parents.

definition: Preposition li- plus al-ittifáq (form VIII) "agreement, union". Root w-f-q.
usage: For unity, agreement; ittifáq is the concord and union of the people.

definition: Preposition li- with article and akhawát (plural of ukht): to the sisters. Root '-kh-w.
Preposition li + al-ikhwán (plural of akh "brother"): for the brothers. Root ’-kh-w.
usage: For the brothers; اخوان also means brethren in faith.

definition: Li- with al- and plural of zawj: to or for the spouses. Root z-w-j.
usage: Spouses, in marriage laws of the Aqdas.

definition: li- + al-a‘mám, plural of ‘amm 'paternal uncle'. Root ‘-m-m.
usage: Paternal uncles, one of the inheritance categories in the Aqdas.

definition: li- 'for' + article + ummahát, plural of umm 'mother'. Root ’-m-m.
usage: 'To the mothers', in the inheritance laws of the Aqdas.

definition: li + al-amín (trustworthy one, trustee). Root '-m-n.
usage: The trustee; in the Aqdas law on property.

definition: Preposition li 'for' + al-ímán 'faith, belief'. Root ’-m-n.
usage: For faith, in passages on belief.

definition: Preposition li- 'for, of' plus al-badan 'the body'. Root b-d-n.
usage: In the Aqdas کالارکان للبدن 'as the members of the body'.

definition: Preposition li 'for' + al-bashar 'mankind, human beings'. Root b-sh-r.
usage: Aqdas: بمنزلة البصر للبشر 'like unto sight for men'.

definition: Preposition li- with baqá' 'permanence, eternal life'. Root b-q-y.
usage: Baqá' is subsistence in God, opposed to فناء 'passing away'.

pos: prep. + active participle pl. with article
definition: Preposition li 'for' and at-tárikín 'those who leave, neglect'. Root t-r-k.
Preposition li with article and turáb 'dust': for (the) dust. Root t-r-b.
usage: In the proverb ما للتّراب و ربّ الأرباب 'what hath dust to do with the Lord of lords'.

definition: Preposition لـ with الخلائق 'all creatures, mankind'. Root kh-l-q.
Preposition ل with plural of khayr: for good works, charity. Root kh-y-r.
usage: الاوقاف المختصّة للخیرات 'endowments dedicated to charity'.

definition: li "for" plus plural of dhurríyya "offspring, progeny". Root dh-r-r.
usage: In the Aqdas inheritance law, the shares assigned to the offspring.

definition: Preposition li- with adh-dhurríyyah 'offspring, descendants'. Root dh-r-r.
Li- 'to, for' plus alladhína 'those who': for those who, unto them who.
Preposition li- plus rijál 'men' (plural of rajul). Root r-j-l.
Preposition li- + ar-rujú‘ 'returning'. Root r-j-‘.
Li- plus ash-sháribín 'those who drink'. Root sh-r-b.
usage: In طوبی للشّاربین 'Blessed are they that drink'.

definition: li- with aṣ-ṣalát: for prayer. Root ṣ-l-w.
usage: Aqdas توضؤا للصلوة 'perform ablutions for prayer'.
notes: Written with the Qur'anic و spelling.

definition: Preposition li- 'for' with al-‘áqil 'the intelligent person'. Root ‘-q-l.
usage: In the Aqdas لیس للعاقل ان یشرب ما یذهب به العقل 'It is not for him who is endowed with reason to drink that which stealeth away his reason'.

definition: Li "for, to" + al-‘álam "the world". Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Aqdas: هذا کتاب اصبح مصباح القدم للعالم 'this is a Book which hath become the Lamp of the Ancient of Days unto the world'.

definition: Preposition li- with al-‘ámilín 'those who act, doers'. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: طوبی للعاملین 'blessed are they that observe them'.

definition: Preposition ل with لقاء 'meeting, encounter'. Root l-q-y.
usage: HW: لائقاً للّقاء 'worthy of My presence'; لقاء اللّه 'attainment unto the Divine Presence'.

definition: Li- with liqá' and 'his': for meeting him, for his presence. Root l-q-y.
li- 'for' plus al-qurá (plural of qaryah 'village, town'). Root q-r-y.
usage: 'For villages'; in Aqdas passages on towns and villages.

pos: prep. + active participle (form VIII) pl. def.
definition: Preposition li- plus al-muttaqín (form VIII participle) "the God-fearing". Root w-q-y.
usage: For the God-fearing; the muttaqín, the righteous.

pos: prep. + active participle (form IV) pl. def.
definition: Preposition li- with article and mukhliṣín (plural of mukhliṣ): for the sincere. Root kh-l-ṣ.
usage: For the sincere ones; المخلصین 'the sincere' are frequently praised.
notes: fa-ṭúbá li’l-mukhliṣín blessed are the sincere.

definition: Preposition li + al-mudun (plural of madína "city"): for (those of) the cities. Root m-d-n.
usage: For the cities and their dwellers.

definition: Li- with al- and plural of mu‘riḍ: for or to those who turn away. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: Those who turn away from the Manifestation.
notes: Waylun lil-mu‘riḍín = woe unto them that turn aside.

definition: li- + plural of mu‘allim 'teacher' (form II participle). Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Teachers, one of the seven inheritance categories in the Aqdas.

definition: li- 'for' + article + muqbilín, plural active participle form IV 'those who turn towards'. Root q-b-l.
usage: 'To those who turn', in طوبی للمقبلین 'blessed are they that turn' toward God.
notes: ṭúbá li’l-muqbilín: blessed are they that turn.

definition: li + an-nás (people, mankind).
notes: Qur'án 2:189: "times appointed for men".

definition: Preposition li + al-waraqát, plural of waraqa 'leaf'; figuratively women, the female members (of the Holy Family).
usage: The Leaves, in the Writings the women of the Holy Family and female believers.
notes: Exact sense in this passage not verified.

definition: Prepositional phrase: at once, immediately. Root w-q-t.
usage: In the Íqán's Gospel quotation للوقت من بعد ضیق تلک الایام 'immediately after the tribulation of those days'.

definition: Preposition li 'for' + al-kafan 'the shroud'. Root k-f-n.
usage: In the Aqdas laws of inheritance and burial: تجهیز الأسباب للکفن و الدّفن 'the expenses of the shroud and burial'.

definition: Preposition li- with kiláb, plural of kalb 'dog'. Root k-l-b.
Emphatic la- and mabda' 'origin, source, beginning'. Root b-d-'.
Emphatic la with maḥbúb: verily beloved. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: المحبوب 'the Beloved' is often God or the Manifestation.

definition: Emphatic لـ with محبوب 'beloved' and 'his'. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: محبوب is a common title of God and of the Manifestation, the Beloved.

definition: Preposition ل with maghfira 'forgiveness'. Root gh-f-r.
usage: Gospel verse quoted: لابن الانسان سلطاناً علی الارض لمغفرة الخطایا 'the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins'.

definition: li "for" plus plural of maqám with suffix "your": for your stations. Root q-w-m.
Preposition li- 'for' with malik 'king'. Root m-l-k.
usage: In the Aqdas طوبی لملک قام علی نصرة امری 'blessed is the king who will arise to aid My Cause'.

definition: Emphatic la- plus manẓar 'place of looking, object of sight, outlook'. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: In the Aqdas, of hearts: انّها لمنظر البهاء 'they are the object of Bahá's gaze'.

definition: Adjective (feminine form in agreement): shining, resplendent. Root l-m-‘.
Conditional la- + perfect 2nd plural of nabadha 'to throw away, discard'. Root n-b-dh.
Li- plus nuzúl 'descent' with -í 'My'. Root n-z-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words فؤادک منزلی قدّسه لنزولی 'Thy heart is My home; sanctify it for My descent'.

definition: li- with subjunctive: that we may prostrate ourselves, worship. Root s-j-d.
usage: Quoting the Magi (Matthew 2:2) جئنا لنسجد له 'are come to worship him'.

definition: Preposition li- with naẓm 'order, ordering, arrangement'. Root n-ẓ-m.
usage: In the Aqdas السّبب الأعظم لنظم العالم 'the supreme instrument for the order of the world'; نظم also gives نظم بدیع 'the New World Order'.

definition: Li "so that" + na‘lama "we may know" (subjunctive). Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Qur'an 2:143 in the Íqán: ما جعلنا القبلة ... الّا لنعلم من یتّبع الرّسول 'We appointed the Qiblih only that We might distinguish him who followeth the Apostle'.

definition: li- with subjunctive 1st person plural of qála 'to say'. Root q-w-l.
Emphatic ل with the energetic form of هدی 'guide': We shall surely guide them. Root h-d-y.
usage: Qur'anic: و الّذین جاهدوا فینا لنهدینّهم سبلنا 'whoso maketh efforts for Us, in Our ways shall We guide him'.

definition: Adjective: lame, limping, crippled in the leg.
li- 'for' plus haykal 'temple, body' plus -ka 'thy'.
usage: 'For thy temple'; هیکل 'temple' is the body, or a talisman, in the Writings.

definition: Preposition li- plus wajh "face" plus -ná "Our". Root w-j-h.
usage: To Our Face; wajh 'Face', the divine Countenance, as in li-wajh Alláh 'for the sake of God'.

definition: Preposition li- with wajh "face" and -ka: for thy face, for thy sake. Root w-j-h.
usage: 'For Thy sake', in prayers: لوجهک 'for Thy face'.

definition: Noun lawḥ "tablet" + -í "my". Root l-w-ḥ.
usage: My Tablet; لوح is the standard term for a Tablet revealed by Bahá'u'lláh.

definition: Particle: were it not for, but for, if not.
li- + subjunctive 3rd masc. pl. of akhadha 'take' + -hu: that they might seize him. Root '-kh-dh.
usage: That they might seize him, of peoples who plotted against their Messenger (Qur'án 40:5).
notes: Quran 40:5.

definition: li- 'so that' + imperfect subjunctive form II of ballagha: to convey, proclaim. Root b-l-gh.
usage: 'To convey', of delivering God's message (تبلیغ), the Bahá'í word for teaching the Faith.

definition: li (purpose) + Form II imperfect subjunctive + -há: so that he may convey it. Root b-l-gh.
usage: To convey; of conveying God's Message.

definition: Li 'that' + subjunctive of balá 'to test, try' + -kum 'you'. Root b-l-w.
usage: To test you, as in God testing people.

definition: Li- 'that' with subjunctive of ittajara 'to trade, do business': that he may trade. Root t-j-r.
usage: In the Aqdas, orphans' wealth is entrusted to a trustworthy person لیتجر لهم 'to invest in trade for them'.

definition: Particle li 'so that' + subjunctive of taḥarraka, 'to move, to be stirred'. Root ḥ-r-k.
usage: Aqdas: لیتحرّک به العالم 'that the world may be stirred thereby'.

definition: Arabic particle layta 'would that' with -ní: would that I.
usage: Qur'an 19:23: یا لیتنی متّ قبل هذا 'would that I had died ere this'.

pos: prep. + verb 3sg masc. impf. subj. (form V)
definition: Li 'so that' and yatakallama 'he speaks'. Root k-l-m.
Emphatic la with energetic imperfect 3rd pl. of wajada: they shall surely find. Root w-j-d.
Particle لـ 'so that' with یجدوا 'they find, perceive'. Root w-j-d.
usage: In the Aqdas: لیجدوا منکم عرف الرّحمن 'that they may inhale from you the fragrance of the Merciful'.

definition: Verb, form I subjunctive after لـ 'so that', with suffix: to guard it/them. Root ḥ-f-ẓ.
usage: الخلق کالاغنام لابدّ لها من راع لیحفظها 'people are like sheep and need a shepherd to protect them'.

definition: li "so that" plus form IV of d-ḥ-ḍ: that they might refute, overturn. Root d-ḥ-ḍ.
usage: From Qur'an 40:5 جادلوا بالباطل لیدحضوا به الحقّ "they disputed with vain words to refute the truth".

definition: li- 'so that' with yadfinú 'they bury' and -hu. Root d-f-n.
Li- 'so that' plus the subjunctive of dhakara with -hum: that He may mention them. Root dh-k-r.
usage: In the Aqdas, though it be all earth's treasures, لیذکرهم مولیهم بکلمة 'that their Lord might mention them with a word'.

definition: Particle li- 'so that' plus subjunctive of sabaqa 'to precede, surpass, outstrip'. Root s-b-q.
Purpose li- + subjunctive of form VIII ishtará 'to buy, barter'. Root sh-r-y.
usage: From Qur'an 2:79 لیشتروا به ثمناً قلیلاً 'that they may sell it for a mean price'.

definition: Li- plus subjunctive of shahida: that he may testify. Root sh-h-d.
li- with subjunctive: that they may spend, expend. Root ṣ-r-f.
Particle li- with the subjunctive of iṭma’anna: that it may be at rest, assured. Root ṭ-m-’-n.
usage: Echoes Qur'an 2:260 لیطمئنّ قلبی 'that my heart may be assured'.
notes: Written لیطمئنّ in the source.

definition: Li "so that" + yaẓhara "he may appear, come forth". Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: Aqdas: تزوّجوا یا قوم لیظهر منکم من یذکرنی 'enter into wedlock, O people, that from you may appear he who will remember Me'.

definition: Emphatic passive imperfect of gharbala 'to sift'. Root gh-r-b-l.
usage: In the tradition و الله لیمحّصنّ و الله لیغربلنّ 'by God, ye shall be tried; by God, ye shall be sifted'.

definition: Particle ل 'so that' with the subjunctive of فتح 'open, conquer'. Root f-t-ḥ.
usage: Aqdas: لیفتح المدن بمفاتیح اسمی 'that he may open the cities with the keys of My Name'.

definition: Li- with subjunctive of qatala and 'thee': in order to kill you. Root q-t-l.
li- 'so that' plus subjunctive third plural of qara’a 'to read, recite'. Root q-r-’.
usage: 'That they recite'; of reciting the verses of God morning and evening.

definition: Particle la- plus energetic imperfect of qála "to say": they will surely say. Root q-w-l.
usage: They will surely say; emphatic form, often in Qur'anic predictions of what people will say.

definition: Particle li- with energetic imperfect 3rd masculine singular of qáma: that (all) may surely arise. Root q-w-m.
Verb, energetic passive imperfect (form II) with oath la-: they shall surely be tried, purged. Root m-ḥ-ṣ.
usage: They shall surely be tried; from traditions on the tests of believers before the Qá'im, cited in the Íqán.
notes: Paired with la-yugharbalunna "shall be sifted".

definition: Li- with subjunctive of manna: so that He may bestow favour, be gracious. Root m-n-n.
usage: That He may be gracious and bestow favour.

definition: Particle la- (oath) + in 'if': and if indeed.
notes: Written لئن.

definition: li- 'that, let' + imperfect subjunctive form IV of anfaqa: that he may spend. Root n-f-q.
usage: 'That he may spend', of spending wealth in the way of God.

definition: li + Form IV imperfect subjunctive of w-f-y: that they fulfil. Root w-f-y.
usage: That they fulfil, keep faithfully the Covenant.

definition: Preposition li + yawm 'day'; ṭúbá li-yawmin 'blessed is the day'. Root y-w-m.
usage: For a day, as in طوبی لیوم 'blessed is the day'.

definition: Emphatic la- with the present of kafá 'to suffice': it truly suffices. Root k-f-y.
usage: In the Aqdas انّه لیکفی العالمین 'it sufficeth all the worlds'.

definition: Particle li 'so that' + subjunctive of kána, 'to be'. Root k-w-n.
usage: Íqán: لیکون ختامه المسک 'that its seal may be musk'.

definition: Adjective: base, mean, ignoble. Root l-'-m.
Shortened form of má 'what' after a preposition: in الی م 'until when, how long'.
notes: The alif of ما is dropped after a preposition (إلامَ).

definition: Numeral: hundred (old spelling of مائة). Root m-’-y.
Passive participle: brought to pass, fulfilled. Root ’-t-y.
usage: Qur'anic کان وعده مأتیّاً 'His promise was fulfilled'.

definition: Passive participle: transmitted, handed down by tradition. Root '-th-r.
usage: Introduces traditions, as in مأثور است 'it is recorded'.

definition: Passive participle of athara: handed down, transmitted (of traditions). Root ’-th-r.
usage: احادیث مأثوره "transmitted traditions".
notes: Written مأثوره.

definition: Verb: 'it surged, billowed'. Root m-w-j.
Perfect 3rd person feminine singular of mája 'to surge, heave (of waves)'. Root m-w-j.
usage: In the Aqdas قد ماجت بحور الحکمة و البیان 'the oceans of wisdom and utterance have surged'.

definition: Arabic 'what is below': all that is beneath, inferior things. Root d-w-n.
Relative má 'what, who' + dúna 'below, other than' + -há 'them': those other than these.
notes: Aqdas inheritance law: the other categories of heirs.

definition: Plural of ma’rab 'aim, purpose, need'. Root ’-r-b.
usage: In the Aqdas لنا فیه مآرب اخری 'We have other purposes therein' (cf. Qur'an 20:18).

definition: Relative adjective: from Mázindarán, the northern Persian province.
notes: Part of a Bábí name.

definition: Relative má 'what' with ṣadara 'issued, came forth': whatever came forth. Root ṣ-d-r.
notes: Reading uncertain: in از اوّل ماصدر it seems to mean 'from the very first (of what occurred)'.

definition: Mál "property, wealth" with -ash "his". Root m-w-l.
Persian plural of mál: possessions, riches. Root m-w-l.
Noun مالک 'owner, possessor, lord' with the suffix 'its/their'. Root m-l-k.
usage: Aqdas: ایّاکم ان تمنعکم الأسماء عن مالکها 'beware lest the names withhold you from their Lord'.

definition: Mál with 'my': my wealth, property. Root m-w-l.
Arabic ma’múr 'commanded, charged' plus Persian -and 'they are'. Root '-m-r.
usage: 'They are commanded'; of those charged with a duty by God.

definition: Verb: past 1st singular of mándan "to remain"; muntaẓir mándan "to wait".
usage: I remained; muntaẓir mándan 'to wait'.

definition: Noun, plural of mándih "one who remains, is left behind": the stranded, the left-behind.
notes: mándigán-i vádí-yi bu‘d those lost in the vale of remoteness.

definition: Verb, past 2nd person singular of mándan: you remained, stayed.
usage: Thou hast remained, often of remaining behind, deprived of the Beloved.

definition: Past 1st pl. of mándan: we remained, stayed; dúr mándan = to stray far from.
usage: From ماندن; in دور ماندن 'to remain far from'.

definition: Ma’nús 'familiar, intimate' (root '-n-s) + -am 'I am'.
usage: Intimate, familiar; e.g. intimacy with God.

definition: Noun: refuge, shelter, abode. Root ’-w-y.
usage: 'Refuge, abode', of the shelter of God and of the final abode.

definition: Numeral: one hundred. Root m-'-y.
usage: One hundred; used in the Aqdas in amounts and counts.
notes: The alef is orthographic, not pronounced.

definition: Arabic má yaḥtáj 'what is needed', used as a Persian noun: necessities, requirements. Root ḥ-w-j.
usage: Necessities or requirements of life.

definition: Noun: table spread with food; a heavenly table or repast. Root m-y-d.
usage: Qur'an 5:114 ربّنا انزل علینا مائدة من السماء 'send down upon us a table from heaven', taken in the Íqán as spiritual sustenance.

definition: Noun má’idih 'table spread with food' + indefinite -í + -st 'is'. Root m-y-d.
usage: The heavenly Table of Qur'an 5:114 (ربّنا انزل علینا مائدةً), which the Íqán explains as spiritual sustenance.

definition: Active participle: inclined, disposed (with ب 'to'). Root m-y-l.
Arabic phrase 'what he owns' used in Persian: all one's possessions. Root m-l-k.
Noun: source, cause, substance; مایهٔ ... 'the cause of'.
Persian ما 'we' with ایم 'are'.
notes: Normalized from مائیم.

definition: Optative negative of بودن: may it not be; lest. Persian.
Verbal noun of form III bádala: exchange, interchange. Root b-d-l.

shift: Here: direct contact, touching. Today: mainly sexual intercourse.
definition: Verbal noun: direct contact, touching; in modern Persian mainly 'sexual intercourse'. Root b-sh-r.

shift: Here: doing one's utmost, earnest insistence. Today: exaggeration.
definition: Verbal noun of form III bálagha: doing one's utmost, insistence; in modern Persian mostly 'exaggeration'. Root b-l-gh.
usage: In the Íqán هر چه مبالغه در نصیحت فرمود 'however earnestly He exhorted them'.

definition: Passive participle mubtalá 'afflicted, tried' with copula -and. Root b-l-w.
Active participle of form IV abda‘a 'to originate, create from nothing'. Root b-d-‘.
usage: A divine attribute, as in مبدع اسماء و صفات 'the Creator of names and attributes'.

definition: Mabda’ 'origin, beginning' with -há. Root b-d-’.
usage: In the Aqdas of Bahá, the first month: لصدر الشّهور و مبدئها 'the head of the months and their beginning'.

definition: Passive participle with Persian copula: is proven, demonstrated. Root b-r-h-n.
Passive participle, feminine dual: both outstretched, spread wide. Root b-s-ṭ.
usage: In Qur'an 5:64 بل یداه مبسوطتان 'Nay, outstretched are both His hands'.

definition: Those raised up, resurrected: Arabic mab‘úth "raised" + Persian شدگان. Root b-‘-th.
usage: Íqán, of scoffers: آیا مائیم مبعوث‌شدگان 'shall we indeed be raised again?'.

definition: Passive participle plural of ba‘atha 'to raise, resurrect, send'. Root b-‘-th.
usage: انکم مبعوثون من بعد الموت 'ye shall be raised after death' (Qur'an 11:7).

definition: Plural active participle: those who hate, enemies. Root b-gh-ḍ.
usage: Íqán: در مبغضین برودت غفلت آورد 'bring the chill of heedlessness to the hateful'.

definition: Past 1sg of máta: I died. Root m-w-t.
Active participle of form VIII ittaba‘a: following, follower. Root t-b-‘.
usage: 'Follower'; of those who follow a religion or the Manifestation.

definition: Active participle (form VIII), feminine: united, one. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: United, one; of unity, as in the unity of mankind.

definition: Active participle form V: moving, in motion. Root ḥ-r-k.
notes: HW "O moving form of dust".

definition: Active participle (form V) mutaḥarrik "moving" + copula -and "they are". Root ḥ-r-k.
usage: Moving; of all things set in motion by God's will.

definition: Active participle (form V): endowed or adorned with (moral qualities). Root kh-l-q.
usage: Adorned with qualities, as in متخلّق باخلاق الهی 'adorned with divine qualities'.

definition: Active participle form V (accusative): abasing oneself, lowly. Root dh-l-l.
usage: Abasing oneself, lowly before God.

definition: Active participle form V, indefinite accusative: remembering, reflecting. Root dh-k-r.
usage: 'Reflecting, remembering', of one mindful of God.

definition: Active participle, Form V: following, resulting, consequent upon. Root r-t-b.
usage: Resulting; consequences of deeds.

definition: Active participle (form V): clothed, robed in (a mantle). Root r-d-y.
usage: Robed, as in robed in the mantle of glory.

definition: Active participle of tazalzala: shaking, wavering, unsteady. Quadriliteral root z-l-z-l.
usage: In the Íqán انفس متزلزله 'wavering souls'.

definition: Adjective: ambiguous, allegorical, resembling one another; feminine of mutashábih. Root sh-b-h.
usage: From Qur'an 3:7 on محکمات 'perspicuous' and متشابهات 'allegorical' verses; Íqán: محکمهٔ ... غیر متشابهه 'perspicuous and not ambiguous'.

definition: Active participle (form V): clinging, holding fast. Root sh-b-th.
Passive participle form V: conceivable, imaginable. Root ṣ-w-r.
Active participle of form VI with copula ast: is exalted, transcendent. Root ‘-l-w.
Active participle 'exalted, transcendent' with -and 'they are'. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: Of God's transcending all description.

definition: Active participle, form VI: lofty, transcendent, exalted. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: صفات متعالیه 'exalted attributes'.

definition: Active participle of form V ta‘ajjaba: astonished, amazed. Root ‘-j-b.
Active participle muta‘ajjib 'astonished' with -am 'I am'. Root ‘-j-b.
Active participle of form V ta‘addada: numerous, manifold, diverse. Root ‘-d-d.
Active participle, accusative of state: deliberately, intentionally. Root ‘-m-d.
usage: In the Aqdas من احرق بیتاً متعمّداً 'whoso intentionally burneth a house'.

definition: Form V participle mutaghammis 'plunged, immersed' with the Persian plural -án. Root gh-m-s.
Firm, well-founded, precise. Root t-q-n.
notes: The final letter is the hamza/yá of izáfih (text: متقنئ).

definition: Active participle form VIII: pious, God-fearing. Root w-q-y.
Active participle mutamassik 'holding fast' with -ím 'we are'. Root m-s-k.
usage: Common in the Writings: تمسّک 'holding fast' to God's Cause and Covenant.

definition: Firmly established, seated; also wealthy. Form V participle, root m-k-n.
usage: HW: بر عرش غنا متمکّن گردد 'be established upon the throne of wealth'.

definition: Active participle of form VI: finite, limited; غیر متناهی 'infinite'. Root n-h-y.
usage: اسمای غیر متناهیه 'infinite names'.

definition: Adjective: accused, suspected. Root w-h-m.
usage: In a verse quoted in the Íqán: متّهم داری کسانی را که حقّ کرد 'thou accusest those whom God hath made'.

definition: Active participle: successive, continuous, repeated. Root w-t-r.
Active participle of form VI tawáḍa‘a 'to be humble', accusative indefinite. Root w-ḍ-‘.
usage: Humble, lowly; used in the Writings for the believer's posture before God and towards others, as in the counsel to be humble and lowly.

definition: Active participle (form VI): successive, continuous, one after another. Root w-l-y.
usage: Successive, continuous; of successive ages or events.

definition: Active participle form VI, feminine plural: consecutive, successive. Root w-l-y.
usage: 'Successive', of consecutive days or periods.

definition: Active participle plural (form V): those who seek recourse (with ilá). Root w-s-l.
usage: Those who seek recourse to God or cling to Him (with الی).

definition: Plural of mutavahhim: those given to vain imaginings, the deluded. Root w-h-m.
usage: The deluded given to vain imaginings.

definition: Plural active participle form V: arrogant, proud. Root k-b-r.
usage: The proud, the arrogant who reject the truth.

definition: Active participle form VIII: reclining, leaning. Root w-k-’.
usage: 'Reclining, leaning', of resting upon God or reclining on a throne.
notes: Spelled متّکئ in the source.

definition: muttaki' (reclining, leaning upon; Form VIII of w-k-') + -and (they are).
usage: They recline; of relying upon something.

definition: Adjective: firm, strong, solid, steadfast. Root m-t-n.
usage: Firm or steadfast, as in firm cord of God.

definition: Plural of mithqál, a unit of weight used in Bahá'í law. Root th-q-l.
usage: In the Aqdas تسعة مثاقیل من الذهب 'nine mithqáls of gold', e.g. for fines and dowries.

definition: Noun mithál 'likeness, image, pattern' with suffix -í 'My'. Root m-th-l.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words: القیت علیک مثالی 'on thee have I engraved Mine image'.

definition: Noun mithl 'like, similar' with -ná: like us. Root m-th-l.
usage: Qur'an 11:27: بشراً مثلنا 'a man like ourselves'.

definition: Noun mithl 'likeness' with pronoun 'you': like you. Root m-th-l.
usage: In Qur'án 18:110 انما انا بشر مثلکم 'I am but a man like you'.

definition: Noun mathwá 'abode' with 3rd pl. suffix. Root th-w-y.
usage: Qur'anic, النّار مثواهم 'the Fire is their abode'.

definition: Noun: dwelling place, abode. Root th-w-y.
usage: Qur'anic فبئس مثوی الظّالمین 'evil is the abode of the wrongdoers'.

definition: Persian plural of mujáḥid 'one who denies obstinately'. Root j-ḥ-d.
usage: مجاحدان آن جمال 'those who denied that Beauty'.

definition: Plural of majrá: courses, channels, conduits. Root j-r-y.
Noun: scope, room, opportunity. Root j-w-l.
Verbal noun of form III jálasa: sitting together, keeping company, association. Root j-l-s.
usage: In the Hidden Words مجالست اشرار 'the company of the ungodly' turns the light of the soul to fire.

definition: Noun, Persian plural of mujáhid 'one who strives'. Root j-h-d.
Form VIII participle of j-th-th: uprooted, torn out; figuratively baseless (Qur'an 14:26).
Criminal, sinner, guilty. Root j-r-m.
Passive participle: made, set up; fabricated, fictitious. Root j-‘-l.
Passive participle plural: things made up, fabrications. Root j-‘-l.
usage: In مجعولات خاطر 'the fabrications of their minds'.

definition: Bound volume, tome. Form II passive participle, root j-l-d.
usage: Íqán: بیست مجلّد 'twenty volumes'.

definition: Plural of mujallad: bound volumes, books. Root j-l-d.
Active participle: revealing, manifesting, making resplendent. Root j-l-w.
usage: Íqán: آثار اشراق شمس مجلّی 'the effulgence of the revealing Sun'.
notes: Could also be read mujallá 'revealed, place of manifestation'.

definition: Adverbial accusative of mujmal: briefly, in summary. Root j-m-l.
Passive participle of jahila: unknown, obscure. Root j-h-l.
usage: Unknown, obscure; often contrasts the unknown station of a holy soul with worldly fame, or describes what is hidden from people.

definition: Verb: negative imperative of justan "to seek".
usage: Seek not; in Hidden Words counsels, e.g. seek not other than Me.

definition: Collective noun: Magi, Zoroastrians.
usage: The Magi or Zoroastrians.

definition: Active participle (form IV): lover, loving, friend. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: Lover, friend; the lover of God; the related plural احبّاء means 'the believers'.

definition: Noun maḥabbah (love) with 2nd masc. suffix: your love, love for you. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: Thy love, as in the love of God.

definition: Muḥtáj 'needy' + -am 'I am'. Root ḥ-w-j.
usage: Needy, in need of God.

definition: Plural of muḥtajib 'veiled, screened' (form VIII). Root ḥ-j-b.
usage: 'The veiled', those screened from recognizing the Manifestation.

definition: Passive participle, Form IV (feminine): newly made, originated, created in time. Root ḥ-d-th.
usage: Originated, created in time; contrasted with the eternal.
notes: Final letter is U+06D5 carrying the izáfih in the source.

definition: Passive participle: limited, bounded, defined. Root ḥ-d-d.
usage: Bounded or limited, of things created set against the limitless God.

definition: Plural passive participle: bounded, limited, finite beings. Root ḥ-d-d.
Noun maḥram 'intimate, one admitted to the sanctuary, confidant' with indefinite -í. Root ḥ-r-m.
Passive participle maḥrúm 'deprived' with است: is deprived. Root ḥ-r-m.
Passive participle maḥrúm 'deprived' with -ash 'him'. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: محروم 'deprived' of grace or recognition is frequent in the Writings.

definition: Passive participle, feminine: chaste or married woman (legal term). Root ḥ-ṣ-n.
Passive participle: enclosed, besieged, confined, restricted. Root ḥ-ṣ-r.
Noun maḥall 'place' with suffix: its place, destination. Root ḥ-l-l.
usage: لیبلّغها الی محلّها 'to convey it to its destination'.

definition: Persian maḥmal "litter; sense, interpretation" with indefinite -í; محملی بستن "to construe a meaning". Root ḥ-m-l.
notes: Sense in this idiom not fully certain.

definition: Noun: trial, tribulation, hardship. Root m-ḥ-n.
Muḥkam 'firm, solid, unambiguous' with the Persian abstract suffix -í: firmness, explicitness. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: In the Íqán حدیث باین محکمی 'a tradition so firmly established'.

definition: Noun miḥakk 'touchstone' with indefinite -í. Root ḥ-k-k.
Verbal noun of form III kháṣama: disputing, contending, enmity. Root kh-ṣ-m.
Addressing, speaking to (adverbial). Root kh-ṭ-b.
usage: In the Aqdas مخاطباً لبریّتی 'addressing My creation'.

definition: Passive participle form IV: informed, notified. Root kh-b-r.
notes: Not mukhbir 'informant'.

definition: Passive participle of form VIII: brief, abridged; as noun, a short treatise. Root kh-ṣ-r.
usage: In در این مختصر 'in these brief pages', of the Íqán itself.

definition: Sealed, stamped with a seal; concluded. Root kh-t-m.
usage: HW: بخاتم عزّ مختوم 'sealed with the seal of glory'; also رحیق مختوم 'the sealed Wine'.

definition: Feminine passive participle of form II: veiled, secluded lady; honorific for a noble woman. Root kh-d-r.
usage: In the Íqán of Mary: مخدّرهٔ بقا 'that immortal veiled One'.

definition: Passive participle: one who is served; master, respected lord. Root kh-d-m.
usage: Íqán: قسم بخدا ای مخدوم من 'by God, O my esteemed friend'.

definition: Passive participle: forsaken, abandoned. Root kh-dh-l.
Active participle of form II kharraba: destroyer, one who lays waste or abolishes. Root kh-r-b.
usage: Destroyer, one who lays waste; used of those who abolish or ruin what God has built, contrasted with the builder (ma‘mir).

definition: Passive participle, feminine: particular, specific, special. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: Particular, special; ordinary adjective.

definition: Passive participle form II: robed, invested with a robe of honour. Root kh-l-‘.
usage: Robed or invested with a robe of honour.

definition: Passive participle makhlúq "created" + copula -and "they are". Root kh-l-q.
usage: Created, contrasted with God the Creator.

definition: Negative imperative of khwástan: do not desire, seek not.
usage: Desire not, in Hidden Words counsels.

definition: Prohibitive ma- + 2nd pl. of khástan 'to want': do not wish.
Noun: ink, writing fluid; also supply, aid. Root m-d-d.
usage: 'Ink', in the image that the seas as ink would not exhaust God's words.

definition: Negative imperative of dáshtan (stem dár): do not hold; "dast madár" do not let go.
usage: Do not hold; in دست مدار "do not let go".
notes: Distinct from Arabic madár (pivot, orbit).

definition: Noun: forbearance, tolerance, gentle dealing; mudárá namúdan 'to be forbearing'. Root d-r-y.
usage: Forbearance and tolerance, as in counsels to deal with others in forbearance.

definition: Plural of madraj: steps, degrees, stages of ascent. Root d-r-j.
usage: Often paired with معارج 'heights', as in مدارج ذلّ … معارج عزّ.

definition: Prohibitive imperative 2nd plural of dáshtan, 'to have, to hold' (with ma-).
usage: Persian Hidden Words: از ذلّت ننگ مدارید 'be not ashamed of abasement'.

definition: Adverb: constantly, perpetually. Root d-w-m.
Negative imperative of dánistan 'to know, consider': do not consider.
Active participle of form IV in the accusative: turning one's back. Root d-b-r.
Noun: period, length of time. Root m-d-d.
Noun: clods of earth, clay. Root m-d-r.
usage: عند کل حجر و شجر و مدر 'beside every stone, tree and clod'.

definition: Active participle of form VIII idda‘á: claimant, pretender. Root d-‘-w.
usage: In the Aqdas a warning against every impious pretender to a revelation before a thousand years.

definition: Passive participle madfún 'buried' with -and 'they are'. Root d-f-n.
Arabic mudill 'indicating, pointing to' with the Persian copula -ast: is indicative of, signifies. Root d-l-l.
usage: In the Íqán مدلّست بر 'signifieth', of a word's meaning in one sense.

definition: Passive participle: that which is indicated or proven, the thing signified. Root d-l-l.
usage: In the Íqán paired with دلیل: seeking proof after the thing proven is manifest.

definition: Plural of madína 'city'. Root m-d-n.
Negative imperative of dádan 'to give': از دست مده 'do not lose'.
usage: In the Hidden Words از دست مده 'forfeit not'.

definition: Passive participle: bewildered, stupefied, overcome. Root d-h-sh.
Verb, negative imperative 2nd person plural of dádan: do not give.
notes: In گوش... مدهید 'give no ear'.

definition: City, town. Root m-d-n.
usage: Aqdas: قد کتب اللّه علی کلّ مدینة ان یجعلوا فیها بیت العدل 'the Lord hath ordained that in every city a House of Justice be established'.

definition: Noun: city, town. Root m-d-n.
usage: Often figurative: مدینهٔ قدسیّه 'the sanctified city', مدینهٔ رضا 'the city of contentment'.
notes: Source writes the final letter as ە (U+06D5).

definition: Persian plural of مذنب: sinners. Root dh-n-b.
usage: Íqán: آمرزش ذنوب مذنبان 'forgiveness of the sins of sinners'.

definition: Madhhab with indefinite -í: a creed, way. Root dh-h-b.
Passive participle of dhakara 'to mention', accusative indefinite. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Mentioned; in the Qur'anic phrase lam yakun shay'an madhkúran 'he was not a thing to be mentioned', recalling man's nothingness before creation.

definition: Verb: past of marra "to pass"; marra ‘alá "to pass by". Root m-r-r.
Noun: mirror. Root r-'-y.
usage: A mirror; the Writings compare the purified heart and the Manifestation to a mirror reflecting the sun.
notes: HW "wa mir’átan li-jamálí" and a mirror for My beauty.

definition: Noun marátib (plural of martaba "rank, degree") + -kum "your". Root r-t-b.
usage: Your ranks or stations; the Writings distinguish spiritual stations and degrees (مراتب).

definition: Plural of marḥalah: stages, stations of a journey. Root r-ḥ-l.
usage: Stages of the spiritual journey, as in Seven Valleys.

definition: Noun: bitterness, hardship. Root m-r-r.
Verbal noun (form III): companionship, keeping company. Root r-f-q.
usage: 'Companionship', of keeping company with the righteous.

definition: Active participle, Form III: watchful, observant, vigilant. Root r-q-b.
Plural of marqad: beds, resting places; also graves. Root r-q-d.
usage: Beds or resting places, and graves; in phrases about rising from graves.

definition: Plural of markab: mounts, steeds, vehicles. Root r-k-b.
usage: In the Hidden Words مراکب نار نفس 'the steeds of the fire of self'.

definition: Noun: mirrors, plural of mir’át, with Persian -í before a relative clause. Root r-'-y.
usage: The Manifestations as mirrors that reflect the divine names and attributes.

definition: Active participle (form VIII): doubting; a doubter. Root r-y-b.
usage: Qur'an 40:34: مسرف مرتاب 'the transgressor, the doubter'.

definition: Passive participle form II: arranged; with بر: consequent upon, ensuing. Root r-t-b.
Passive participle in the accusative: hoped for, one in whom hopes are placed. Root r-j-w.
Noun: carrion, carcass; with plural -há and izáfih -y.
Noun مردار 'carrion, carcass' with indefinite ی. Persian.
