usage: بعقب مرداری چند 'after a few carcasses' (worldly goods).

definition: Persian plural of mardum: people, mankind.
Infinitive: to die; death.
Mard 'man' with indefinite -í: a man.
Noun mard 'man' with -íst 'is a'.
Perfect 2nd masculine singular of marra 'to pass, pass by'. Root m-r-r.
notes: Aqdas, addressed to the Emperor of Austria.

definition: Sent; a Messenger of God. Root r-s-l.
usage: In the tradition نبیّ مرسل 'a Prophet who is a Messenger'.

definition: Passive participle form IV with Persian -and: they are sent (as Messengers). Root r-s-l.
Verb, past 2nd person plural: you became ill (with اذا, 'when you fall ill'). Root m-r-ḍ.
usage: In the Aqdas اذا مرضتم ارجعوا الی الحذّاق من الأطبّآء 'Resort ye, in times of sickness, to competent physicians'.

definition: Maraḍ "sickness, disease" with Persian plural -há. Root m-r-ḍ.
usage: Íqán: این مرضها عارض نمیشد 'these maladies would not have befallen'.

definition: Passive participle plural of ra‘aba 'to terrify': terrified. Root r-‘-b.
usage: In the tradition quoted in the Íqán: خائفین مرعوبین وجلین 'fearful, affrighted, dismayed'.

definition: Noun: ladder, means of ascent. Root r-q-y.
usage: Aqdas: جعلناه مرقاةً لعروج الأرواح 'We have made it a ladder for the ascent of souls'.

definition: Proper noun: Mark the Evangelist, author of the second Gospel.
Feminine of marmúz 'symbolic, cryptic'. Root r-m-z.
usage: Symbolic, cryptic; used of the allusive words and symbols of earlier scriptures (kalimát-i marmúzih) that need interpretation.

definition: Noun: time, occasion; alf marrih "a thousand times". Root m-r-r.
usage: Time, occasion; in alf marrih 'a thousand times'.

definition: Active participle form II: promoter, one who spreads or propagates. Root r-w-j.
usage: Promoter or propagator, of one who spreads the Faith or a teaching.

definition: Passive participle as noun: mount, riding animal. Root r-k-b.
usage: A mount or steed, often figurative, as the steed of the spirit.

definition: Noun: death.
usage: Death; in the Writings a messenger of joy and gateway to the next world.

definition: Active participle form IV (accusative): doubting, causing doubt. Root r-y-b.
usage: Doubting, disquieting, as in فی شک مریب 'in disquieting doubt'.

definition: Passive participle: seen, visible. Root r-’-y.
usage: 'Visible', of the visible world, contrasted with the unseen.
notes: Spelled مرئی in the source.

definition: Noun: temperament, bodily constitution; mixture. Root m-z-j.
usage: Temperament, constitution; of bodily health.

definition: Noun mizáj 'mixture, tempering' + -há 'its'. Root m-z-j.
usage: Its mixture, as in cups whose mixture is of camphor.

definition: Noun muzd 'wage, reward' with indefinite -í: any reward.
usage: Paired with Arabic اجر: اجر و مزد 'reward and recompense'.

definition: Noun: evening. Root m-s-w.
usage: Aqdas: فی کلّ صباح و مسآء 'every morn and eventide', the time for reciting the verses of God.

definition: Noun: distance, interval. Root s-w-f.
Verbal noun form III musáfarat 'journey, travel' with -am 'my'. Root s-f-r.
notes: Of Bahá'u'lláh's withdrawal to Sulaymáníyyih.

definition: Active participle of form II: causer; مسبّب الأسباب 'the Causer of causes'. Root s-b-b.
Active participle: concealed, hidden. Root s-t-r.
usage: In the Aqdas: ظهر کلّ امر مستتر 'every hidden thing hath been made manifest'.

definition: Passive participle, form X: firm, strong, secure. Root ḥ-k-m.
usage: حبل مستحکم 'the firm cord', with عروه وثقی 'the sure handle'.

definition: Active participle of form X istaḍá'a: seeking light, illumined. Root ḍ-w-’.
Active participle mustaṭí‘ 'able, capable' with -í 'thou art'. Root ṭ-w-‘.
Arabic mustaghraq 'immersed, engrossed' with the Persian copula -íd: ye are immersed. Root gh-r-q.
usage: In the Hidden Words در ابحر شرک مستغرقید 'ye are immersed in the seas of idolatry'.

definition: Active participle, accusative of state: seeking forgiveness. Root gh-f-r.
Active participle of form X istaghná 'to be free of need': self-sufficient, independent. Root gh-n-y.
usage: Of God's independence of His creatures.

definition: The future; in grammar the future tense. Root q-b-l.
Adjective (feminine form): straight, upright, sound. Root q-w-m.
usage: E.g. عقول مستقیمه 'sound minds'.

definition: Active participle of form X, feminine: frightened, fleeing in terror. Root n-f-r.
usage: In Qur'an 74:50 حمر مستنفرة 'affrighted asses'.

definition: Seated, established (upon a throne); level, even. Form VIII participle of s-w-y.
usage: HW: بر عرش جلال مستوی 'established upon the throne of glory', echoing the Qur'anic استوی علی العرش.

definition: Active participle of form X istakbara 'to be arrogant', accusative of state. Root k-b-r.
usage: ثم یصرّ مستکبراً 'then persisteth in his pride' (Qur'an 45:8).

definition: Plural active participle: the arrogant, the proud. Root k-b-r.
usage: Íqán: تبدیل مستکبرین 'the alteration wrought by the proud'.

definition: Noun: drunkenness, intoxication; mystical ecstasy or rapture.
Passive participle of form II sakhkhara: subdued, subjugated; with namúdan 'to conquer'. Root s-kh-r.
usage: Subdued, subjugated; in musakhkhar namúdan 'to conquer', as of hearts or cities won by the Word of God.

definition: Active participle (form IV), plural accusative: hastening, hurrying. Root s-r-‘.
usage: Hastening; of souls hastening to God.

definition: Passive participle: written, inscribed, recorded. Root s-ṭ-r.
usage: Written or inscribed, often of what is recorded in the Books of God.

definition: Passive participle (feminine): written, inscribed, recorded. Root s-ṭ-r.
usage: Written, recorded, of what is inscribed in the Books of God.
notes: Izáfih hamza split off.

definition: Plural of musalmán: Muslims.
Musallam 'acknowledged, accepted' (form II passive participle, root s-l-m) + -and 'they are'.
Passive participle form II, feminine: accepted, indisputable. Root s-l-m.
usage: 'Accepted, indisputable', of facts or doctrines accepted by all.

definition: Active participle, Form IV: one who makes (others) hear. Root s-m-‘.
usage: One who makes others hear; of God.
notes: Qur'án 35:22.

definition: Passive participle masmú‘ 'heard, heeded' + ast 'is'. Root s-m-‘.
Noun: cushion, seat of honour, throne. Root s-n-d.
usage: In the Íqán مسند علم و فضل 'the seat of learning and erudition', of the divines.

definition: Adjective: propped up, supported; feminine of musannad. Root s-n-d.
usage: From Qur'an 63:4 خشب مسنّدة 'propped-up timbers', said of the hollow divines.

definition: Adjective/noun: poor, wretched, humble. Root s-k-n.
Noun miskín 'poor, wretched' with indefinite -í. Root s-k-n.

shift: Here: Messiahship, being the Messiah. Today: Christian.
definition: Noun: Messiahship, being the Messiah; usually today the adjective 'Christian'. Root m-s-ḥ.
Noun, plural of mash‘al: torches, lamps. Root sh-‘-l.
usage: In مشاعل باقیهٔ هدایت 'everlasting torches of guidance'.

definition: Active participle, form VIII: buyer, purchaser; also the planet Jupiter. Root sh-r-y.
Comparative of Persian mushta‘il "aflame, burning": more ablaze. Root sh-‘-l.
Plural of mushtahá 'object of desire': desires, appetites. Root sh-h-w.
Noun of place mashrab 'drinking-place, spring; way, taste' with -hum: their drinking-place. Root sh-r-b.
usage: Qur'an 2:60 in the Íqán: لیعلم کلّ اناس مشربهم 'that every people may know their drinking-place'.

definition: Passive participle musharraf 'honoured' with copula -and; often 'honoured with the presence of'. Root sh-r-f.
Active participle of form IV ashraqa 'to shine, dawn': radiant, shining. Root sh-r-q.
Shining, radiant. Root sh-r-q.
usage: In the Aqdas ما دامت الشّمس مشرقة 'so long as the sun shineth'.

definition: Noun of place mashriq 'place of sunrise' with -há: its dawning-place. Root sh-r-q.
usage: مشرق 'Dawning-Place', a title of the Manifestation as source of Revelation.

definition: Active participle of form IV: shining, radiant. Root sh-r-q.
notes: Written مشرقئ in the source, probably for مشرقهٔ 'shining (ordinances)'; reading uncertain.

definition: One who associates partners with God; polytheist, idolater. Form IV active participle, root sh-r-k.
usage: Aqdas: لا تتّبعوا کلّ مشرک 'follow not every ungodly one'.

definition: Active participle of form IV ash‘ara 'to make known' with copula -and: they betoken. Root sh-‘-r.
usage: Paired with مدلّ: مدلّ و مشعرند بر 'bear witness and testify to'.

definition: Active participle: compassionate, solicitous, kind. Root sh-f-q.
usage: Aqdas: من لدن مشفق رحیم 'from One Who is compassionate, merciful'.

definition: Adjective or adverb: compassionate, loving, kindly. Root sh-f-q.
Negative imperative, second person plural, of shumurdan 'to count, deem'.
usage: Do not count, do not deem; used in counsels such as not to count oneself superior to others.

definition: Verb: negative imperative of shinídan "to hear".
usage: Hear not; in Hidden Words counsels against hearing ill of others.

definition: Verb shudan "to become", negative imperative 2nd singular: do not become, be not.
usage: 'Be not', in counsels such as مشو 'be not heedless'.
notes: qáni‘ mashaw be not content.

definition: Verb, negative imperative 2nd person plural of shudan: do not become, be not.
usage: Be ye not, in the Persian Hidden Words' warnings not to be heedless or deprived.

definition: Noun mishkáh (lamp niche, lamp) with 1st sing. suffix: My lamp.
usage: My lamp; Qur'anic niche-lamp of light (24:35).

definition: Plural of mushkil: difficulties, problems. Root sh-k-l.
usage: Difficulties; e.g. the abstruse passages of the scriptures.

definition: Adjective mushkín 'musky, musk-black' with suffix -am 'my'.
usage: 'Musky', as in گیسوی مشکین 'dark fragrant locks' of the Beloved, a poetic image.
notes: gísú-yi mushkín: dark fragrant locks; the suffix attaches to the phrase.

definition: mashiyyah (will, the divine Will) + "his". Root sh-y-'.
usage: His Will; the divine Will (مشیت), the Primal Will.

definition: Plural of miṣbáḥ: lamps. Root ṣ-b-ḥ.
usage: Lamps, as in the lamps of the Cause and of guidance.

definition: Active participle: companion, associate; muṣáḥib shudan 'to keep company'. Root ṣ-ḥ-b.
usage: In the Hidden Words با احرار مصاحب شو 'consort with the righteous'.

definition: Noun muṣáḥib 'companion' with indefinite -í. Root ṣ-ḥ-b.
Noun, plural of maṣdar: sources, springs. Root ṣ-d-r.
usage: The Manifestations as مصادر امر 'the Sources of the Cause'.

definition: Plural of miṣrá': leaves of a door, portals; also hemistichs. Root ṣ-r-‘.
Noun miṣbáḥ 'lamp' with 1st sing. suffix: My lamp. Root ṣ-b-ḥ.
usage: In the Hidden Words مشکاتی انت و مصباحی فیک, echoing the Light Verse.

definition: Active participle: confirming, attesting the truth of. Root ṣ-d-q.
usage: In the Qur'anic announcement of John: مصدّقاً بکلمة من الله 'confirming a Word from God'.

definition: Active participle مصدق 'confirming' with Persian -íd: you confirm, believe. Root ṣ-d-q.
usage: کلام او را مصدقید 'ye believe his words'.

definition: Passive participle of form VIII iṣṭalaḥa: conventional, agreed upon, current. Root ṣ-l-ḥ.
Plural of maḍmún 'content, purport, theme'. Root ḍ-m-n.
Persian-style plural of maḍmún: contents, purport, meanings. Root ḍ-m-n.
Active participle: shining, luminous. Root ḍ-w-’.
Active participle of form IV aḍá’a 'to shine, illumine': luminous, giving light. Root ḍ-w-’.
notes: Search form of مضیئاً.

definition: Driven away, expelled, outcast. Root ṭ-r-d.
Noun maṭlab 'aim, matter' with indefinite -í. Root ṭ-l-b.
Passive participle plural: folded, rolled up. Root ṭ-w-y.
usage: In Qur'an 39:67 و السّموات مطویّات بیمینه 'the heavens shall be rolled together in His right hand'.

definition: Places or forms of appearance (plural of maẓhar) with -há "its". Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: Maẓhar in Bahá'í usage is the Manifestation of God (مظهر امر اللّه); here simply 'embodiments': مطالع الحرّیة و مظاهرها هی الحیوان.

definition: Feminine active participle of form IV aẓlama 'to grow dark': dark, gloomy. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: کلمات مظلمه 'dark sayings'.
notes: Not the modern mazlamih 'injustice'.

definition: Abstract noun from مظلوم 'wronged': oppressed state, the wrongs suffered. Root ẓ-l-m.
usage: Íqán: بر مظلومی آن حضرت نوحه نمائی 'lament the wrongs He suffered'.

definition: Passive participle feminine: made manifest, revealed. Root ẓ-h-r.
maẓhar 'place of appearance, Manifestation' plus indefinite -í. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: A Manifestation; maẓhar is the technical term for a Manifestation of God, as in maẓhar-i amr 'Manifestation of the Cause' and maẓáhir-i iláhí 'the divine Manifestations'.

definition: Adverb: together, jointly.
Active participle form III: opposing, contrary, conflicting with. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: Opposing or contrary to.

definition: Active participle plural (form III): opponents, objectors. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: Opponents of the Manifestation and His Cause.

definition: Plural of ma‘rifah (knowledge, gnosis) with -ishán (their). Root ‘-r-f.
usage: Their knowledge or learning.

definition: Broken plural ma‘árif 'knowledge, sciences' + relative -í. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: Divine knowledge, spiritual truths.

definition: Noun mu‘áshirat 'association, companionship' (form III) with suffix -am 'my'. Root ‘-sh-r.
usage: 'My companionship', of fellowship with God or with the friends.

definition: ma‘ásh (livelihood, subsistence) + -and (they are). Root ‘-y-sh.
Plural of ma‘ṣiya: sins, acts of disobedience. Root ‘-ṣ-y.
usage: Sins and acts of disobedience, as in prayers for forgiveness.

definition: Verbal noun: exchange, barter, trading one thing for another. Root ‘-w-ḍ.
Proper noun: Mu‘áwiyah; here Mu‘áwiyah ibn Wahb, transmitter of a Shi‘i tradition from Imam Ja‘far aṣ-Ṣádiq.
notes: Diptote: genitive Mu‘áwiyata after عن.

definition: Passive participle (form VIII), feminine: reliable, authoritative. Root ‘-b-r.
Active participle form VIII: one who holds fast; here a refuge or protector. Root ‘-ṣ-m.
notes: Uncertain whether rendered as Protector, Refuge or Stronghold in the authorized Íqán; the participle literally means one who holds fast.

definition: Active participle of form VIII with copula -and: they believe. Root ‘-q-d.
Active participle: attentive, paying heed (with بـ). Root ‘-n-y.
Active participle, form VIII: devoted to, keeping constantly to; in retreat. Root ‘-k-f.
usage: معتکف بودند بتماثیلی 'they clung to images'.

definition: Noun: justice, equity. Root ‘-d-l.
Noun ma‘din 'mine, source' with -ash 'its'. Root ‘-d-n.
Feminine passive participle of ‘adda 'to count': counted, numbered; hence few, limited in number. Root ‘-d-d.
Passive participle mu‘adhdhab 'tormented' with copula -and. Root ‘-dh-b.
Active participle of form IV a‘raḍa 'to turn away'. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: Turning away from God, opposed to مقبلاً 'turning towards'.

definition: Those who turn away (from God's Manifestation). Root ‘-r-ḍ.
Active participle plural form IV: those who turn away. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: Qur'an 38:68 انتم عنه معرضون 'from which ye turn aside'.

definition: Noun ma‘rifat 'knowledge, recognition' with the indefinite -í. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: In the Writings ma‘rifat is above all the recognition of God and His Manifestation.

definition: Presented, submitted; معروض داشتن "to submit respectfully, report". Root ‘-r-ḍ.
usage: Íqán: خدمت حضرت معروض داشت 'he submitted to His presence'.

definition: Passive participle ma‘rúf 'known' with copula -and 'they are'. Root ‘-r-f.
Abstract noun: fame, renown, being known. Root ‘-r-f.
usage: Íqán: شهرت و معروفیّت 'fame and renown'.

definition: Passive participle: honoured, esteemed. Root ‘-z-z.
Plural of ma‘shúq 'beloved' with Persian -há. Root ‘-sh-q.
usage: Beloveds; in mystical imagery the beloved (ma‘shúq) is God or the object of the lover's longing.

definition: Active participle (form IV), feminine: difficult, perplexing, abstruse. Root ‘-ḍ-l.
usage: Used of abstruse or perplexing questions, as in مسائل معضله 'abstruse questions' that the Manifestation alone can resolve.

shift: Here: at a loss, baffled. Today: kept waiting, delayed (معطل شدن).
definition: Passive participle form II: idle, held up, at a loss; "mu‘aṭṭal shudan" to be baffled. Root ‘-ṭ-l.
usage: 'At a loss, held up', as in معطّل شدن 'to be baffled'.

definition: Passive participle (form II, feminine): idle, unused, useless. Root ‘-ṭ-l.
usage: Idle, unused; of faculties, lands or wealth left idle.
notes: ٴ marks the izáfih.

definition: Comparative of mu‘aẓẓam (exalted, magnified): more exalted, greater. Root ‘-ẓ-m.
Passive participle: pardoned, forgiven. Root ‘-f-w.
usage: Pardoned, exempted, as of those excused from a law.

definition: Passive participle form II, feminine: suspended, dependent. Root ‘-l-q.
usage: 'Dependent, suspended', of something conditional upon another.

definition: Plural of ma‘lúm: things known, objects of knowledge; created beings. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: Objects of knowledge; created things.

definition: Adjective ma‘naví 'spiritual, inner' + st 'is'. Root ‘-n-y.
usage: Spiritual, as in spiritual and inner meanings.

definition: Preposition ma‘a 'with' and -há 'her, it'.
Passive participle of ‘ahida: known, agreed upon, covenanted; promised. Root ‘-h-d.
usage: Íqán: آن هیکل معهود 'that promised Temple' awaited by the people.

definition: Arabic preposition ma‘a 'with' with -ka: with thee.
Preposition ma' 'with' with pronoun 'you'.
Noun: livelihood, way of life. Root ‘-y-sh.
usage: Qur'anic, معیشة ضنکاً 'a life of misery'.

definition: Passive participle (fem.): fixed, specified, determined. Root ‘-y-n.
Plural of maghrib: places of setting, wests. Root gh-r-b.
usage: مشارق و مغارب 'the easts and the wests'.

definition: Persian plural of maghrúr "proud, deluded": the proud. Root gh-r-r.
usage: ای مغروران باموال فانیه "O ye that pride yourselves on mortal riches".

definition: Passive participle: planted. Root gh-r-s.
Feminine passive participle of form II ghaṭṭá 'to cover', accusative: covered. Root gh-ṭ-w.
usage: In the Aqdas یا شواطی نهر الرین قد رأیناک مغطّاة بالدماء 'O banks of the Rhine! We have seen you covered with gore'.

definition: Noun: forgiveness, pardon. Root gh-f-r.
Abstract noun from maghlúb 'overcome, defeated': subjugation, defeat. Root gh-l-b.
Erroneous, incorrect. Root gh-l-ṭ.
Passive participle: fettered, chained. Root gh-l-l.
usage: Echoes Qur'an 5:64 ید الله مغلولة 'the hand of God is chained up'.

definition: Active participle plural of form IV: those harbouring rancour or treachery. Root gh-l-l.
usage: In the Íqán تا مغلّین آنچه در قلب پنهان نموده‌اند ظاهر شود 'that the malicious may reveal what is hidden in their hearts'.
notes: Reading mughillín (from ghill, rancour) inferred from context; the authorized rendering is not confirmed.

definition: Keys; plural of miftáḥ. Root f-t-ḥ.
usage: Aqdas: اوامری سرج عنایتی ... و مفاتیح رحمتی لبریّتی 'My commandments are the lamps of My loving providence ... and the keys of My mercy for My creatures'.

definition: Noun: key, the means of opening something. Root f-t-ḥ.
usage: جعل الله مفتاح الکنز حبّی المکنون 'God hath made My hidden love the key to the Treasure'.

definition: مفتخر 'proud, honoured' with Persian -and 'they are': they pride themselves. Root f-kh-r.
Active participle of iftará: liar, fabricator, slanderer. Root f-r-y.
Passive participle of form VIII iftará 'to fabricate, forge'. Root f-r-y.
usage: Forged, fabricated; from the Qur'anic charge sihrun muftaran 'a forged sorcery' levelled against the Prophets' revelations.

definition: Noun: plural of muftará (form VIII passive participle): fabrications, calumnies. Root f-r-y.
usage: Used of the calumnies and fabrications raised against the Manifestations and the Faith by their opponents.

definition: Noun muqábil "counterpart, opposite" with indefinite -í. Root q-b-l.
Verbal noun (form III): fighting, combat. Root q-t-l.
usage: Fighting; the Writings forbid contention and conflict and abolish holy war.

definition: Plural of miqdár (measure, amount) with dual suffix: their (two) measures, degrees. Root q-d-r.
usage: Their measures or degrees.

definition: Noun: speech, saying, statement. Root q-w-l.
usage: Speech, saying; often paired in حال و مقال 'state and speech'.

definition: Noun, plural of maqám 'station, rank' with suffix -hi. Root q-w-m.
usage: 'His stations', of the stations or ranks of the Manifestation.

definition: Plural maqámát (stations, ranks) + "your". Root q-w-m.
Noun maqám 'station, rank' + ast 'is'. Root q-w-m.
usage: Station or rank, as in the station of the Manifestation.

definition: Arabic maqám 'station, rank' with Persian -shán 'their'. Root q-w-m.
Noun maqám 'station, place, rank' with suffix -hi 'His'. Root q-w-m.
usage: المقام المحمود 'the praiseworthy station'; مقام is also a spiritual rank or station.

definition: Comparative of maqbúl 'acceptable': more acceptable. Root q-b-l.
Active participle form VIII: powerful, omnipotent; a divine name. Root q-d-r.
usage: المقتدر 'the Omnipotent' is a divine name.

definition: Active participle plural of form VIII: those who follow an example. Root q-d-w.
Active participle: one who follows an example or leader. Root q-d-w.
usage: مقتدی گشتن 'to follow'; the related مقتدا is one who is followed.
notes: Could be read muqtadá 'the one followed'; context favours 'follower'.

definition: Plural passive participle, form VIII: requirements, exigencies. Root q-ḍ-y.
usage: مقتضیات الطبیعة 'the requirements of nature'.

definition: Passive participle of qatala: killed, slain. Root q-t-l.
Passive participle (feminine): ordained, decreed, predestined. Root q-d-r.
Arabic muqaddas 'sanctified, holy' with the Persian copula -ast: is sanctified, is far exalted. Root q-d-s.
usage: In the Íqán مقدّسست نغمهٔ لاهوت 'sanctified is the melody of the divine realm' above human ears and minds.

definition: Adjective muqaddas 'holy, sanctified' with -ishán 'their'. Root q-d-s.
Adjective muqaddas 'holy, sanctified' with -and 'they are'. Root q-d-s.
Brought near to God; favoured. Root q-r-b.
usage: In ملک مقرّب 'an angel brought nigh'; المقرّبین 'those nigh unto God'.

definition: Passive participle form II: established, settled, prescribed. Root q-r-r.
Noun maqṣúd 'aim, purpose' with Persian -shán 'their'. Root q-ṣ-d.
usage: مقصود also means 'the Desired One', a title of God.

definition: Maqṣúd "aim, purpose; the Desired One" with indefinite -í: any purpose. Root q-ṣ-d.
usage: Maqṣúd is also a title of God, 'the Desired One' (المقصود).

definition: Passive participle of qaḍá 'to decree', accusative indefinite. Root q-ḍ-y.
usage: کان الامر مقضیّا 'the matter was decreed' (Qur'an 19:21).

definition: Passive participle: subdued, overpowered, vanquished. Root q-h-r.
Maqhúr with 3pl copula: they are subdued, overpowered. Root q-h-r.
Verbal noun of form III láṭafa: kindness, tenderness. Root l-ṭ-f.
usage: Tenderness, loving-kindness; used of the gentleness with which believers should treat one another and all people.

definition: Noun mala’ "assembly, chiefs, council" plus -hi "his". Root m-l-’.
usage: In Qur'anic phrasing the chiefs or council of a people who opposed a Prophet, as in ملإه 'his chiefs' of Pharaoh; compare الملأ الأعلی 'the Concourse on High'.
notes: Normalized from ملإه.

definition: Noun malá’ikih (Arabic plural of malak, angel) with Persian plural -há. Root m-l-k.
usage: Angels; the Writings interpret angels as holy souls.
notes: Double plural.

shift: Here: a religion, religious community, as in ملّة ابراهیم. Today in Persian: nation (ملت).
definition: Noun: religion, religious community, creed. Root m-l-l.
usage: A religion or religious community, as in ملّة ابراهیم; in modern Persian ملّت usually means 'nation'.

definition: Active participle (form VIII): one who takes refuge; multají shudan = to take refuge. Root l-j-'.
usage: Seeking refuge in God.

definition: Plural of malzúm: necessary concomitants, requirements. Root l-z-m.
Noun: playground, object of play. Root l-‘-b.
usage: 'Plaything', of those who make religion a plaything.

definition: mal‘ún (accursed, damned) + indefinite -í. Root l-‘-n.
Passive participle (form II), feminine: enigmatic, riddling, abstruse. Root l-gh-z.
usage: Enigmatic, of abstruse sayings and riddles of the past.

definition: Noun: sovereignty, dominion, kingdom. Root m-l-k.
usage: In the Hidden Words لتملک ملکاً دائماً 'that thine may be a sovereignty… everlasting'.

definition: Verb: perfect 2nd plural of malaka, 'to own, to possess', with suffix -hu. Root m-l-k.
usage: Aqdas: لا تفرحوا بما ملکتموه 'rejoice not in the things ye possess'.

definition: Noun malakút 'kingdom, celestial realm' with -ná: Our Kingdom. Root m-l-k.
usage: The Kingdom of God, as in ملکوت الأسماء 'the Kingdom of names'.

definition: Noun malakút 'kingdom, dominion' with pronoun 'His'. Root m-l-k.
usage: The spiritual Kingdom, as ملکوت الاسماء 'the Kingdom of Names'.

definition: Adjective malíḥ 'sweet, comely' with 1st sing. suffix. Root m-l-ḥ.
Noun, plural of mamlakah 'kingdom', with 'your'. Root m-l-k.
usage: In the Aqdas: لا نرید ان نتصرّف فی ممالککم 'We have no wish to lay hands on your kingdoms'.

definition: Active participle, form VIII: inaccessible, unattainable; impossible. Root m-n-‘.
usage: عزّ ممتنع منیع 'an inaccessible and lofty glory'.

definition: Active participle of form VIII imtana‘a: inaccessible, unattainable, impossible. Root m-n-‘.
Passive participle: praised, praiseworthy. Root m-d-ḥ.
Passive participle of masaḥa 'to wipe, stroke, anoint': wiped, touched, passed over. Root m-s-ḥ.
usage: In the Íqán no sword remained بگردنهاشان ممسوح گشت 'that was not laid upon their necks'.
notes: The English rendering is inferred from the context.

definition: Noun mamlakah 'kingdom, realm' with -hi 'His'. Root m-l-k.
Active participle of form II mayyaza 'to distinguish': discerning, able to tell apart. Root m-y-z.
Plural of minbar: pulpits. Root n-b-r.
Active participle form III, accusative: one who calls, a herald. Root n-d-w.
Active participle plural of form III: hypocrites. Root n-f-q.
usage: A Qur'anic term for those outwardly professing faith; in the Íqán ادبار منافقین 'the turning away of the hypocrites'.

definition: Contrary to, incompatible with, opposing. Form III participle, root n-f-y.
usage: Íqán: منافی هوای جسمانیّه 'contrary to carnal desire'.

definition: Plural: forbidden things, prohibitions. Root n-h-y.
usage: Paired with اوامر: امر باوامر و نهی از مناهی 'enjoining commands and forbidding what is prohibited'.

definition: Active participle: benefiting, deriving profit. Root n-f-‘.
usage: HW: تا خود و دیگران از شما منتفع شوند 'that ye and others may profit therefrom'.

definition: Active participle: avenger, punisher. Root n-q-m.
Plural of munajjim 'astrologer, astronomer'. Root n-j-m.
usage: Astrologers, astronomers; the Íqán recounts how astrologers foretold the births of the Manifestations by signs in the heavens.

definition: Arabic phrase min dún: without, apart from, other than.
usage: Arabic phrase meaning 'without' or 'apart from', as in من دون الله 'apart from God'.
notes: Normalized from من‌دون.

definition: Active participle form VII: crushed, levelled, crumbled. Root d-k-k.
usage: Crumbled, alluding to the mountain that crumbled before Moses at Sinai.

definition: Active participle (form IV): warner, one who admonishes. Root n-dh-r.
usage: A warner, a title of the prophets who warn their peoples, as in the Qur'anic انّما انت منذر.

definition: Noun manzil (dwelling, abode) with 1st sing. suffix: My abode. Root n-z-l.
Munazzah 'exalted above, free from' (form II passive participle, root n-z-h) + -and 'they are'.
usage: Sanctified, exalted above; God is منزّه from every description.

definition: Passive participle form II, feminine: sanctified, pure, exalted above. Root n-z-h.
usage: 'Sanctified', of God exalted above all description (منزّه).

definition: man (I, my) + ast (is): is mine.
Passive participle of nasiya 'to forget': forgotten. Root n-s-y.
usage: Forgotten, as in 'a thing forgotten'.

definition: Active participle of anṣafa: fair, just, impartial. Root n-ṣ-f.

Noun najm 'star' with -hu: his star. Root n-j-m.
usage: Gospel quotation (Matthew 2:2) in the Íqán: رأینا نجمه فی المشرق 'we have seen his star in the east'.

definition: Noun: copper. Root n-ḥ-s.
usage: In the Íqán's alchemical image of copper transmuted into gold.

definition: Noun nuḥás 'copper' with copula ast: is copper. Root n-ḥ-s.
usage: In the Íqán copper turned to gold images transformation by faith.

definition: Verb: We love, We desire. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: In the Arabic Hidden Words: بم اعرضت عمّا نحبّ 'wherefore hast thou turned from what We desire'.

definition: Verb, form IV imperfect with suffix: we love it, we wish it. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: لا تطلب منّی ما لا نحبّه لنفسک 'ask not of Me that which We desire not for thee'.

definition: Negative subjunctive of خروشیدن "to cry out, roar": (that) he not cry out.
Negative future auxiliary of خواستن: 'thou wilt not'.
Noun (Arabic nakhwa): haughtiness, conceit, arrogance. Root n-kh-w.
usage: In the Íqán کبر و غرور و نخوت 'pride, arrogance and vainglory'.

definition: Negative past 3rd singular of dádan 'to give'; dast nadád 'was not available'.
Negative past 1st plural of dádan 'to give'; جا ندادن 'to give no place'.
Negative present of dáshtan: we have not.
Negative past participle of دانستن: not having known or deemed.
Noun nidá’ 'call, summons' with 'his'. Root n-d-w.
usage: In the Aqdas ارتفع ندآئه من کلّ الجهات 'Whose Call hath been raised from every direction'.
notes: Written ندآئه in the source.

definition: Imperfect 1pl of da‘á "to call, summon" with -kum. Root d-‘-w.
usage: Aqdas: انّما ندعوکم لوجه اللّه 'We summon you wholly for the sake of God'.

definition: Noun nidd 'equal, rival, peer' with indefinite -í. Root n-d-d.
usage: Of God: no likeness, peer or equal (شبه و مثل و ندّ) is found for Him.

definition: Persian verb دیدن 'see', negative past: I did not see.
Negative present perfect of dídan: I have not seen.
Negative present perfect, second person plural, of dídan 'to see'.
usage: Have not seen; ordinary verb form.

definition: Noun nardubán "ladder" plus indefinite -í.
usage: A ladder, often figurative of a means of ascent to spiritual heights.

definition: Verb raftan "to go", negative past 3rd plural: they did not go.
usage: 'They did not go'; in the Writings of those who did not tread the path of God or follow the truth.

definition: Verb, negative present 3rd person singular of rúyídan: does not grow, sprout.
usage: Does not grow; in images of seeds or flowers of wisdom that do not spring up in barren soil.

definition: Verb, negative imperative 2nd person plural of raftan: do not go.
usage: Negative imperative of رفتن 'to go', in admonitions such as 'go not' after the desires of the self.

definition: Verb (form I imperfect, 1st pl.) with 2nd pl. object: We see you. Root r-'-y.
Negative past 1st pl. of zadan 'to strike'; bar ham zadan 'to overturn, upset'.
Adjective nazdík 'near' + -am 'I am'.
usage: 'I am near', of God's nearness to His servant.

definition: Verbal noun nuzúl (descent, revelation) + "its". Root n-z-l.
usage: Its revelation, the sending down of verses.

definition: Plural of nasím: breezes, gentle winds. Root n-s-m.
usage: Breezes, often the breezes of God's grace or of the Revelation.

definition: Plural noun nisá’ 'women' with -him 'their'. Root n-s-w.
Noun plural: relations; attributions, imputations (nisbat + Persian -há). Root n-s-b.
Persian plural of nisbat 'relation; imputation' with indefinite -í: imputations, accusations. Root n-s-b.
Verb form X: to feel shame, be ashamed. Root ḥ-y-y.
Verb, imperfect 1st pl. of sakhira: we mock. Root s-kh-r.
Verb: it was blown away, crumbled to dust (of mountains). Root n-s-f.
usage: Echoes the Qur'anic image of mountains scattered on the Day of Judgement.
notes: Could also be read active nasafa with the Name as agent.

definition: Noun nasnás 'a fabled half-man creature' with Persian -and: they are like nasnás.
usage: The Íqán uses it of men who have outward form but no spiritual life.
notes: Kept as a transliteration in some English renderings.

definition: Negative subjunctive of سوزاندن "to burn": (unless) thou burn.
Negative present of سوختن 'to burn': 'that it not burn'.
Noun nasy 'a thing forgotten', accusative. Root n-s-y.
usage: Qur'an 19:23, Mary's words in the Íqán: یا لیتنی متّ قبل هذا و کنت نسیاً منسیّاً 'would that I had died ere this, a thing forgotten'.

definition: Verb nasiya 'to forget', past 2nd singular. Root n-s-y.
usage: In the Hidden Words کیف نسیت عیوب نفسک 'how couldst thou forget thine own faults'.

definition: Imperfect 1st plural of sa’ala 'to ask, beseech'. Root s-’-l.
notes: Search form of نسئل.

definition: Nasím 'breeze' with indefinite -í. Root n-s-m.
Verb: we will, wish. Root sh-y-'.
usage: Aqdas لو نشاء نفصلها 'should We so wish, We would expound it'.

definition: Noun: joy, liveliness, exhilaration. Root n-sh-ṭ.
usage: In the Hidden Words نشاط مستی 'the joy of intoxication'.

definition: Signs, marks, tokens: nishánih with plural -há and izáfih.
usage: Íqán Gospel citation: نشانه‌های پسر انسان 'the sign of the Son of man'.

definition: Negative present of شایستن 'to befit, be proper': it is not fitting.
usage: در فقر اضطراب نشاید 'be not troubled in poverty'.

definition: Persian verb شدن 'become', negative past: I did not become.
Negative present perfect of shudan: I have not become.
Negative present perfect, second person plural, of shudan 'to become'.
usage: Have not become; ordinary verb form, often with an adjective.

definition: Verb: negative past 2nd plural of shudan "to become".
Verb shudan, negative past 1st plural; "muta‘arriḍ nashudím" we did not undertake (to mention).
usage: Auxiliary in compound verbs, e.g. متعرض نشدیم 'We have not undertaken (to mention)', a formula by which Bahá'u'lláh passes over a topic.

definition: Verb, present perfect 3rd person plural of nishastan: they have sat, are seated.
usage: From نشستن 'to sit'; used of those seated in a place or station, often figuratively of those who sit in heedlessness.

definition: Negative subjunctive 3rd sing. of shumurdan: (should) not count or regard.
usage: Not count or regard.

definition: Negative subjunctive 3rd pl. of shinídan 'to hear'.
Verb, negative present subjunctive 2nd person singular of shinídan 'to hear'.
Negative present perfect 2nd plural of shinídan (to hear): you have not heard.
usage: Have you not heard.

definition: Negative simple past second singular of shinídan 'to hear'.
Present of shahida: We bear witness, testify. Root sh-h-d.
usage: In the Aqdas نشهد انّه من الفائزین 'We bear witness that he is of them that have attained'.

definition: Verb: negative present subjunctive 2nd plural of shudan, 'to become'.
Persian verb, negative 1st plural present subjunctive of shudan: (that) we not become.
Noun niṣáb 'minimum amount liable to a levy' with pronoun 'its'. Root n-ṣ-b.
Verb, imperfect 1st pl. of ṣabara: We are patient, We endure. Root ṣ-b-r.
Verb: We counselled, admonished you. Root n-ṣ-ḥ.
usage: In the formula کذلک نصحناکم 'thus have We counselled you'.

definition: Noun nuṣḥ 'sincere advice' with suffix: my counsel. Root n-ṣ-ḥ.
usage: هذا نصحی علیکم 'This is My counsel unto you'.

definition: Form II of ṣ-d-q: to confirm, affirm as true; "We confirm it". Root ṣ-d-q.
Noun naṣíb 'share, portion' with -ka 'thy'. Root n-ṣ-b.
Proper name: an-Naḍr ibn al-Ḥárith, a Meccan opponent of Muḥammad.
usage: The Íqán names him among those who opposed the Prophet.

definition: Verb aṭ‘ama 'to feed', present 1st plural with -kum 'you'. Root ṭ-‘-m.
usage: Qur'anic انّما نطعمکم لوجه اللّه 'we feed you only for the sake of God'.

definition: Noun nuṭfih 'sperm-drop, seed' with indefinite -’í. Root n-ṭ-f.
notes: Íqán: the conception of the seed (Abraham) that would destroy Nimrod.

definition: Form II imperative: cleanse it. Root n-ẓ-f.
usage: In the Hidden Words هیکل الوجود عرشی نظّفه 'The temple of being is My throne; cleanse it'.

definition: Verb: we think you (to be). Root ẓ-n-n.
usage: Qur'an 11:27 بل نظنکم کاذبین 'nay, we deem you liars'.

definition: Verb, form IV, present 1st person plural: We reveal, make manifest. Root ẓ-h-r.
usage: In the Íqán کذلک نظهر لک من اسرار الأمر 'Thus do We reveal unto thee the mysteries of the Cause'.

definition: Clean, neat, pure. Root n-ẓ-f.
usage: Íqán: لطیف و نظیف نماید 'make subtle and pure'.

definition: Subjunctive 1st person plural of ‘abada 'to worship'. Root ‘-b-d.
usage: أ تنهانا ان نعبد ما یعبد آبائنا 'forbiddest thou us to worship what our fathers worshipped' (Qur'an 11:62).

definition: Arabic verb (form IV): We give you. Root ‘-ṭ-w.
usage: Íqán: کذلک نعطیکم من اثمار شجرة العلم 'thus do We give you of the fruits of the tree of knowledge'.

definition: Present of ‘allama with 'thee': we teach you. Root ‘-l-m.
Plural of ni‘mat 'blessing, bounty' with izáfih -y. Root n-‘-m.
usage: Blessings, bounties; the bounties of God bestowed on His servants, as in ni‘mat-háy-i iláhí 'divine blessings'.

definition: Noun ni‘mat "blessing, bounty" plus indefinite -í. Root n-‘-m.
usage: Blessing or bounty of God; نعمت often appears in phrases such as نعمت الهی 'divine bounty'.

definition: Noun na‘ím "bliss, bounty" with Persian 1st person suffix -am: my bounty. Root n-‘-m.
usage: Bliss and bounty, especially heavenly bliss; God speaks of His bounties (نعیم) in the Hidden Words, and جنّت نعیم is 'the paradise of bliss'.

definition: Noun na‘ím "bliss, delight" + indefinite -í. Root n-‘-m.
usage: Na'ím is 'bliss', especially the bliss of paradise, as in جنّت نعیم 'garden of bliss'; with -í 'a delight'.

definition: Noun: melody, song, tone. Root n-gh-m.
usage: Melody, the divine melodies of the Revelation.

definition: Naghmih 'melody' (Arabic) + Persian plural -há + -st 'is, are': there are melodies.
usage: Melodies, the songs of the Nightingale (the Manifestation).

definition: Noun: melody, song, strain. Root n-gh-m.
usage: 'Melody', of the melodies of the Revelation, such as the melody of the Dove of holiness.
notes: Final ٴ marks the izáfih.

definition: Noun: melody, song, strain. Root n-gh-m.
usage: Melody, song; of the Nightingale's song, symbol of the Manifestation.
notes: Final letter is U+06D5 carrying the izáfih in the source.

definition: Verbal noun: running out, exhaustion, coming to an end. Root n-f-d.
usage: Running out, as in God's treasuries never being exhausted.

definition: Verbal noun: hypocrisy; also discord, dissension. Root n-f-q.
usage: In the Íqán رایات نفاق 'the standards of discord' raised against the Báb.

definition: Noun: breath, waft, fragrant breeze. Root n-f-ḥ.
usage: Aqdas: فیه تمرّ نفحة الحیات علی الممکنات 'wherein the breath of life is wafted over all created things'.

definition: Arabic verb, perfect 1st singular of nafakha: I breathed, blew. Root n-f-kh.
usage: God breathing spirit into the heart.

definition: Noun nafs 'self, soul' with -ash 'his'. Root n-f-s.
usage: نفس is the self, often the lower self or ego.

definition: Noun nafs 'self, soul' with 3rd pl. suffix: their self, their desires. Root n-f-s.
usage: نفس in the Writings often the selfish self.

definition: Verb: We set forth in detail, specify. Root f-ṣ-l.
usage: In the Aqdas: سوف نفصّل لکم نصابها 'We shall specify for you its limit'.

definition: Verb, form II imperfect with suffix: we set it forth in detail. Root f-ṣ-l.
usage: لو نشاء نفصّلها 'Were it Our wish, We would expound them'.

definition: Noun: benefit, profit, advantage. Root n-f-‘.
Noun: tunnel, underground passage. Root n-f-q.
usage: Qur'an 6:35 نفقاً فی الأرض او سلّماً فی السّماء 'an opening into the earth or a ladder into heaven'.

definition: Negative present perfect 3rd person plural of fahmídan 'to understand': they have not understood.
notes: Split from نفهمیده‌اند.

definition: Noun: penetration, influence, pervasive power. Root n-f-dh.
Plural of nafs 'soul, self, person' with -ishán 'their'. Root n-f-s.
Naqab 'tunnel, underground passage' with indefinite -í. Root n-q-b.
usage: In the Íqán's rendering of Qur'an 6:35 نقبی در زیر ارض 'an opening into the earth'.

definition: Noun: a single blast or stroke; the Trumpet-call (cf. Qur'an 74:8 نقر فی الناقور). Root n-q-r.
usage: In the Íqán نقرهٔ الهی 'the divine Trumpet-blast', the call of the new Revelation.
notes: Homograph of نُقره 'silver'.

definition: Noun naqsh 'design, image, imprint' with the indefinite -í.
notes: In جز نقشی 'nothing but an outward form'.

definition: Perfect 1pl of naqaṣa "to decrease, reduce": we reduced. Root n-q-ṣ.
usage: Aqdas inheritance law: زدنا ضعف مالهم و نقصنا عن الاخری 'We doubled their share and diminished the others'.

definition: Noun naqṣ 'deficiency, defect, loss' with indefinite -í. Root n-q-ṣ.
Arabic نقطة 'point, dot' with Persian indefinite ی. Root n-q-ṭ.
usage: نقطه is also a title of the Báb (نقطهٔ اولی 'the Primal Point').

definition: Noun: vengeance, retribution. Root n-q-m.
Noun: vengeance, retribution. Root n-q-m.
usage: Vengeance, retribution; God's retribution, often paired with ni‘mat 'blessing' as the two faces of His dealing.

definition: Noun niqmat "vengeance, retribution" plus Persian -and "they are". Root n-q-m.
usage: Means vengeance or retribution, often paired with نعمت: what is a blessing to some is a vengeance to others.

definition: Verb form II qayyaḍa "to appoint, assign", jussive 1st plural: We assign. Root q-y-ḍ.
usage: From Qur'an 43:36, quoted in the Writings: whoso turns from the remembrance of the Merciful, نقیّض له شیطانا 'We will chain a Satan unto him'.
notes: Qur'an 43:36. Not naqíḍ "contrary".

definition: Verb, negative present subjunctive 3rd person singular of laghzídan: (may) not slip, stumble.
usage: From لغزیدن 'to slip'; used of the feet of the believer not slipping from the path, i.e. remaining steadfast.

definition: Negative past 3rd pl. of mándan: they did not remain.
Negative subjunctive 3rd pl. of mándan 'to remain'.
Noun: ant; a symbol of the lowly creature. Root n-m-l.
usage: 'Ant', a symbol of the lowly creature, as in the Qur'anic story of Solomon and the ant.

definition: Verb, Form I imperfect subjunctive 1st plural: we bestow favour. Root m-n-n.
usage: That We show favour; echoes Qur'án 28:5.
notes: Qur'án 28:5.

definition: Perfect first singular of namúdan 'to do, make'; qasam yád namúdih-am 'I have sworn'.
notes: Written نموده‌ام.

definition: Adjective namakín 'salty; charming, sweet' with -am 'my'.
usage: In the Hidden Words لب نمکینم 'My sweet lips'.

definition: Verb: negative past continuous 3rd singular of ámadan, 'to come'.
usage: موافق آمدن 'to accord with'.

definition: Persian verb, negative 1st singular present of dídan 'to see': I do not see.
Negative present of dídan 'to see', second person singular.
Verb, negative present 3rd pl. of justan 'to seek'.
notes: Here اقبال نمیجویند 'they turn not'.

definition: Negative present of داشتن 'to hold'; with بر and دست, 'they do not let go'.
notes: In دست از تو بر نمیدارند 'they will not leave thee alone'.

definition: Negative present of دادن: I do not give. Persian.
Negative present of دادن "to give"; گوش نمیدهند "they do not give ear".
Negative past continuous of شدن 'to become': 'they would not have become'.
Negative present 3rd person plural of fahmídan 'to understand': they do not understand.
notes: Split from نمی‌فهمند.

definition: Negative present 3rd singular of mándan 'to remain'.
Negative past progressive 3rd plural of mándan 'to remain'.
Negative present of mándan 'to remain'.
Negative past continuous of نمودن: I would not have (done).
notes: Here conditional: توقف نمینمودم 'I would not have tarried'.

definition: Verb, negative present 3rd person singular of pasandídan: does not like, does not approve.
usage: In the Íqán's counsel to the seeker: آنچه برای خود نمی‌پسندد برای غیر نپسندد 'what he would not wish for himself, not wish for others'.
notes: Written with a joiner as نمی‌پسندد.

definition: Negative present 3pl of گذشتن "to pass, give up": they do not forgo.
usage: Íqán: در سبیل دین الهی نمیگذرند 'they would not forgo (their possessions) in the path of God's Faith'.

definition: Negative present of گرداندن 'to turn, make'; مبعوث نمیگرداند 'will not raise up'.
Persian verb گشتن 'become', negative past continuous: they would not become.
Negative present 2pl of giriftan: you do not take.
Negative past continuous, third person plural, of yáftan 'to find'.
usage: Did not find; ordinary verb form.

definition: Verb: negative of nishándan "to seat; to settle, allay (thirst)".
usage: Used of something that cannot allay or quench the thirst of the seeker.

definition: Verb naṣaḥa "to advise", imperfect 1st plural with -ka: We counsel thee. Root n-ṣ-ḥ.
usage: God counselling the soul, as in the Arabic Hidden Words; نصح 'counsel, admonition' is a recurring form of Bahá'u'lláh's exhortations.

definition: Verb, imperfect 1st person plural + -kum: we counsel, advise you. Root n-ṣ-ḥ.
usage: God's counsel to His servants, as in ننصحکم 'We counsel you' introducing exhortations in the Aqdas and Hidden Words.

definition: Verb (form I imperfect, 1st pl.) with 2nd pl. object: We help you, give you victory. Root n-ṣ-r.
usage: We aid you, of divine assistance.

definition: Negative perfect 2nd sing. of namúdan 'to do'; with tiláwat 'hast thou not read'.
notes: Written ننموده‌ئی.

definition: Verb, negative past 3rd person plural of núshídan 'to drink'.
usage: 'Drank not', of those who did not drink of the wine of knowledge.

definition: Negative present perfect 3rd plural of núshídan (to drink): they have not drunk.
usage: They have not drunk.

definition: Negative present third singular of nigaristan 'to look, regard'.
usage: Looks not or regards not.

definition: Past of nihádan 'to put, place': I placed; sar nihádan 'to set out, wander'.
usage: In the Íqán سر در بیابانهای فراق نهادم, of Bahá'u'lláh's retirement to the wilderness.

shift: Here: day, daytime (opposite of night). Today: lunch (ناهار).
definition: Noun: day, daytime (opposite of night). Root n-h-r. In modern Persian نهار usually means lunch.
usage: لیل و نهار 'night and day'.

definition: Persian noun: sapling, young tree.
usage: Hidden Words: نهال محبّت 'the young tree of your love'.

definition: Verb: to forbid, prohibit; He forbade you. Root n-h-y.
Noun niháyat 'end, limit' with indefinite -í. Root n-h-y.
Noun: river, stream. Root n-h-r.
usage: In the Aqdas: یا شواطی نهر الرّین 'O banks of the Rhine'.

definition: Persian plural of nahr 'river' in construct: the rivers of. Root n-h-r.
usage: نهرهای تبیان 'the rivers of utterance'.

definition: Persian numeral: nine hundred (the number 900).
Plural of náhiyah 'prohibition'; اوامر و نواهی 'commands and prohibitions'. Root n-h-y.
Perfect 1st person plural of form II nawwara 'to illumine': We have illumined. Root n-w-r.
usage: In the Íqán کذلک نوّرنا افق سماء البیان 'thus have We illumined the horizon of the heaven of utterance'.
notes: Not núruná 'our light'.

definition: Noun, dual of núr 'light': two lights. Root n-w-r.
usage: In the Íqán نورین نیّرین 'the twin resplendent lights', Shaykh Aḥmad and Siyyid Káẓim.

definition: Feminine relative adjective from núr 'light': luminous. Root n-w-r.
usage: In هیاکل نوریّه 'luminous Temples', of the Manifestations.

definition: Negative present of vazídan 'to blow (of wind)'.
Verb form IV: we enjoin, exhort, counsel. Root w-ṣ-y.
usage: Aqdas و نوصی رجاله بالعدل الخالص 'We exhort its men to pure justice'.

definition: Verb, form IV, 1st person plural subjunctive: (that) we believe. Root a-m-n.
usage: In Qur'an 3:183 ان لا نؤمن لرسول 'that we should not believe in any Messenger'.
notes: Written نؤمن in the source.

definition: Negative present 3sg of پذیرفتن "to accept, undergo"; with a noun "it does not become".
usage: Íqán: خاموشی نپذیرد 'it will not be quenched'.

definition: Negative of پرداختن 'to occupy oneself with, attend to'.
usage: براحت نفس خود تمام نپردازید 'be not wholly occupied with your own ease'.

definition: Persian verb پسندیدن 'approve, like', negative subjunctive.
usage: Íqán: آنچه برای خود نمی‌پسندد برای غیر نپسندد 'not wish for others what he doth not wish for himself'.

definition: Negative past participle of chishídan: not having tasted.
Negative present perfect, first person singular, of chashídan 'to taste'.
usage: Have not tasted; ordinary verb form, used figuratively of tasting love or knowledge.

definition: Verb: negative present perfect 3rd plural of chishídan "to taste".
usage: Used figuratively of tasting spiritual realities, as of those who have not tasted the wine of divine knowledge.
notes: Normalized from نچشیده‌اند.

definition: Negative na- with chunán "such, so": not so, not in such a way.
notes: Unusual spelling; may be a variant of "nah chunán" or a scribal slip for "ánchunán".

definition: Phrase na "not" + chunín "thus, such": not so.
Noun: marriage, wedlock, marriage contract. Root n-k-ḥ.
usage: Marriage, ordained in the Aqdas.

definition: Nukta 'subtle point, fine meaning' + indefinite -’í. Root n-k-t.
usage: A subtle point, fine meaning.
notes: Written نکته‌ئی.

definition: Verb, perfect 3rd person plural of nakatha: they broke (a covenant). Root n-k-th.
usage: 'They broke' (a covenant); from the same root comes ناقضین / ناکثین 'Covenant-breakers'.

definition: Adjective (accusative): scanty, meagre, grudging. Root n-k-d.
usage: Scanty; of barren soil yielding scantily.
notes: Qur'án 7:58.

definition: Adjective/noun: unknown, dreadful, abhorrent thing. Root n-k-r.
usage: A dreadful or abhorrent thing, recalling the Qur'anic شیء نکر 'a dreadful thing'; related to منکر 'the reprehensible'.
notes: Qur'an 54:6.

definition: Negative present perfect of kardan 'to do, make': they have not done.
Verb: imperfect 1st plural of kashafa, 'to uncover, to remove'. Root k-sh-f.
usage: Aqdas: لو نکشف الحجاب انتم تنصعقون 'were We to lift the veil, ye would swoon away'.

definition: Arabic verb, perfect 3rd plural: they drew back, retreated. Root n-k-ṣ.
usage: In نکصوا علی اعقابهم 'turned back on their heels'.

definition: Negative subjunctive of kardan 'to do', first person plural.
Verb, negative present subjunctive of gudhárdan 'to put'; قدم نگذارد 'set no foot'.
Negative past participle of گذاشتن 'to put, set'; قدم نگذاشته 'not having set foot'.
Negative present of گذشتن: I will not pass over, overlook. Persian.
usage: از ظلم احدی نگذرم 'I will not pass over the wrongdoing of anyone'.

definition: Negative subjunctive of گذشتن "to pass": (that) we not pass over or abandon.
Negative present of گرداندن 'to make, cause to become'.
Negative simple past 1st person plural of gardánídan 'to turn, change' (causative): we did not turn, did not change.
usage: In the Íqán, translating Qur'an 2:143 on the change of the Qiblih.

definition: Negative present 3rd plural of gardídan 'to become'.
Negative subjunctive 2nd singular of gardídan 'to become'; فائز نگردی 'thou shalt not attain'.
Negative present perfect of giriftan 'to take'; تعلیم نگرفته‌اند 'have not been taught'.
Negative past of گزیدن 'to choose': they did not choose.
Verb, negative present subjunctive 3rd person singular of guzídan: does not choose.
notes: In مقرّ نگزیند 'take no abode'.

definition: Negative present 3sg of گشودن "to open"; with چهره "to unveil one's face".
usage: HW: تا ذلّت تو چهره نگشاید 'lest thine abasement be unveiled'.

definition: Negative present subjunctive of گشودن/گشادن 'to open'.
usage: لب نگشایند 'open not their lips'.

definition: Persian verb گشتن 'become', negative present perfect.
Negative past 1sg of gushúdan: I did not open.
Negative present perfect, first person singular, of guftan 'to say'.
usage: Have not said; ordinary verb form.

definition: Verb: negative past 2nd singular of guftan "to say".
Verb gunjídan "to fit, be contained", negative present 3rd singular: does not fit, cannot be contained.
usage: Of what cannot be contained, as in the Persian Hidden Words where love of the world and love of God cannot dwell together in one heart; also of what cannot be contained in words.

definition: Verb, negative present subjunctive 3rd person singular of guftan: (should) not say.
usage: From گفتن 'to say'; in counsels that one should not utter what one does not do, or not speak ill.

definition: Negative subjunctive 3rd sing. of giriftan: does not take; sabqat nagiriftan = not be outstripped.
Noun: need; humble entreaty, supplication; ‘ajz u niyáz 'humility and lowliness'.
usage: Need, humble entreaty; عجز و نیاز 'lowliness and supplication' before God.

definition: Verb, negative past 3rd person plural of ásúdan 'to rest'.
usage: 'Found no rest', of the restless striving of lovers or the suffering of the believers.

definition: Negative past 3rd plural of áshámídan (to drink): they did not drink.
usage: They did not drink.

definition: Negative past participle of áshámídan 'to drink': not having drunk.
Negative past of yáftan 'to find, obtain': they did not find, did not attain.
Verb: negative past 1st plural of yáftan, 'to find'.
Noun/adjective, plural of ná'im: sleeping, asleep. Root n-w-m.
usage: Hadith: النّاس نیام 'men are asleep'.

definition: Negative past of ávardan 'to bring'; with ایمان: did not believe.
Verb, negative present subjunctive 1st pl. of ávardan 'to bring'; ایمان آوردن 'to believe'.
Noun, plural of nár: fires, the fires of hell. Root n-w-r.
usage: In اسفل درکات نیران 'the nethermost depths of the fire'.

definition: Negative present subjunctive of افتادن: (that) they not fall. Persian.
usage: باین خیال نیفتند 'not fall into this fancy'.

definition: Persian adjective: good, fair, beautiful.
Comparative of نیکو 'good, fair': better, fairer.
Adjective níkú 'good, fair' with the copula -st: is good, it is well.
usage: In the Hidden Words نیکوست حال آن غنی 'well is it with that rich man'.

definition: Noun: the Arabic letter há’ (ه).
usage: In the Íqán the Báb's Commentary on the Letter Há (تفسیر هاء).

definition: Perfect of hája 'to be stirred, rise, blow'. Root h-y-j.
Of the clan of Háshim; epithet of Muḥammad.
usage: In نور هاشمی 'the Háshimite Light'.

definition: Noun: abyss, pit; a Qur'anic name of Hell (101:9). Root h-w-y.
usage: E.g. هاویة الجحیم 'the abyss of hell-fire'.

definition: Imperative of wahaba 'give' with 'me', idiomatically 'suppose, grant that'. Root w-h-b.
usage: In the Aqdas هبنی اشتبه علی النّاس امرک 'Grant that the people were confused about thy station'.
notes: The idiomatic sense "suppose, grant that" is inferred; the exact authorized wording is not confirmed.

definition: Blowing (of wind), wafting. Root h-b-b.
usage: Of divine breezes: نسائم جود در هبوب 'the breezes of bounty are wafting'.

definition: Noun: emigration, departure; the Prophet's flight from Mecca to Medina. Root h-j-r.
usage: بعد از هجرت شمس نبوّت محمّدی 'after the migration of the Sun of Muḥammad's Prophethood'.

definition: Persian compound: هدایت 'guidance' + کننده 'doer': guiding, guide. Root h-d-y.
usage: Íqán: سراجی باشد هدایت‌کننده 'a guiding lamp'.

definition: Noun: the hoopoe, Solomon's messenger bird.
Past tense, first person plural, of hadá 'to guide' plus -ka 'thee'. Root h-d-y.
usage: We guided thee; God speaking in the plural of majesty, recalling His guidance (hudá) of the soul.

definition: Demonstrative: oblique dual of hádhá "this": these two.
Noun (accusative): mockery, derision, an object of ridicule. Root h-z-'.
usage: Qur'anic word for mockery; in the Writings of those who take God's verses for a jest, as in اتّخذها هزوا 'he taketh it for a jest'.
notes: ittakhadhahá huzu’an he taketh it for a jest.

definition: Numeral: eighty.
Ordinal numeral: eighth.
Verb, perfect 3rd fem. sing. of haṭala: (rain) poured down. Root h-ṭ-l.
usage: Poured down, of the rain of mercy.

definition: Numeral: seven, the cardinal number 7.
usage: 'Seven', as in the Seven Valleys (هفت وادی) and the seven cities of the mystic path.

definition: Adjective: of seventy years (haftád seventy + sál year + -ih).
Number: seven hundred.
Ordinal number: seventh.
Adjective: deadly, destructive (Arabic halák 'perdition' + Persian kunandih 'doer').
Arabic interjectional imperative plural halumma: come! come hither!
usage: Aqdas: هلمّوا و تعالوا 'Hasten ye and come'.

definition: Hamán 'that very, the same' with copula ast: that is the very one.
Noun: humá, a legendary bird of good fortune; rendered 'phoenix'.
usage: In the Hidden Words همای عشق 'the phoenix of love'.

definition: Compound verb هم رساندن 'to bring about, obtain'; حضور همرساندند 'they were present'.
Reciprocal هم 'each other' with -and: (are) each other. Persian.
usage: غیر همند 'are distinct from one another'.

definition: Persian: such, like this (older form of همچو/چنین).
Plural noun: peers, fellows; all people together.
notes: Authorized rendering of the address ای همگنان not confirmed.

definition: Hama 'all, every', here spelled with ئ for the izáfih (همهٔ): all (of).
notes: Spelled همئ in the source; not the archaic verbal prefix hamí.

definition: Adverb: always, ever; with izáfih همیشهٔ ایّام 'at all times'.
Adjective haní’ 'wholesome, pleasant' as an exclamation: may it do good; well is it with. Root h-n-’.
usage: In the Aqdas هنیئاً لمن شرب رحیق الحیوان 'Well is it with him who hath drunk the choice wine'.
notes: Search form of هنیئاً.

definition: Plural of havá 'air, atmosphere' in construct. Root h-w-y.
usage: In هواهای قرب طائرند 'they soar in the atmosphere of nearness'.

definition: Noun hawá 'desire, passion' with -ka: your desire. Root h-w-y.
usage: هوی usually selfish desire, opposed to the will of God.

definition: Numeral: eighteen (older spelling of هجده).
usage: In هیجده سنه 'eighteen years', of the Báb's dispensation and Bahá'u'lláh's sufferings up to the writing of the Íqán.

definition: Herod, king of Judaea at the time of Christ's birth.
usage: Íqán, in the story of the Magi: مقرّ سلطنت هیرودس 'the seat of Herod's sovereignty'.

definition: Noun: waterless desert where the thirsty wander distraught. Root h-y-m.
usage: فی هیماء الشهوات من الهائمین 'wanderers in the wilderness of passions'.

definition: Persian pronoun: no one, anyone (with negative verb).
Active participle: obligatory, binding, necessary. Root w-j-b.
Arabic wájib 'obligatory' plus Persian -ast 'is'. Root w-j-b.
usage: Is obligatory; wájib marks a religious duty, as in the laws of the Aqdas; also wájib al-wujúd 'the Necessary Being', God.

definition: Numeral, indefinite accusative: one; wáḥidan ba‘da wáḥid "one after another". Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: Means 'one'; in the Writings also in واحداً بعد واحد 'one after another', and linked to the theme of divine oneness (وحدت).

definition: Adjective váḥid "one" with Persian plural copula -and: they are one. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: Expresses the oneness of the Manifestations of God, همه واحدند 'they are all one', a central theme of the Kitáb-i-Íqán.

definition: Active participle váṣif "describer, praiser" + -í; har váṣifí every describer. Root w-ṣ-f.
usage: Used in praise of God as beyond the reach of every describer, as in har váṣifí 'every one that describeth'.

definition: Persian plural of váṣil: those who have arrived at the goal, mystics united with the Beloved. Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: In the Writings 'those who have attained', the mystics who have reached union with the Beloved, often paired with عاشقان 'lovers'.

definition: Plural active participle: those who arrive, attain (union). Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: Those who attain union with God.

definition: Arabic váḍiḥ 'clear, evident' + Persian -and 'they are'. Root w-ḍ-ḥ.
usage: 'Are evident', of clear proofs.

definition: Active participle: ample, sufficient, complete; faithful. Root w-f-y.
Perfect (form III) first plural of wáfá 'to come, arrive'. Root w-f-y.
usage: We have come, as in arrival.

definition: Arabic váqif 'aware, informed' with Persian -and 'they are'. Root w-q-f.
wa 'and' + illá 'otherwise, if not' + ‘afá 'He exempted, pardoned'. Root ‘-f-w.
notes: Two words run together in the source: والاّ عفا اللّه عنه 'otherwise God hath exempted him'.

definition: Noun válid 'father' with Persian -ash: his father. Root w-l-d.
Noun wálid 'father' with pronoun 'his'. Root w-l-d.
Noun (Persian usage): mother. Root w-l-d.
Closing formula: and peace (be with you). Root s-l-m.
Conjunction/adverb: moreover, besides, furthermore.
Conjunction و with plural demonstrative: and those.
usage: Qur'an 29:23 اولئک یئسوا من رحمتی و اولئک لهم عذاب الیم.

definition: Interjection of grief: alas, woe!
Imperative of واگذاشتن 'to leave, abandon, hand over'.
Feminine elative of wathíq 'firm, secure': firmest, most sure. Root w-th-q.
usage: Qur'anic العروة الوثقی 'the sure handle' (2:256); in the Íqán عروهٔ وثقی among names of the divine law.

definition: Verb: became necessary, obligatory. Root w-j-b.
usage: In the Aqdas قد وجب علی کلّ واحدٍ منکم الاشتغال بامر 'it is enjoined upon every one of you to engage in some occupation'.

definition: Perfect 2nd plural of wajada 'to find'. Root w-j-d.
Form I verb wajada 'to find': we found. Root w-j-d.
usage: In Qur'an 43:22 انّا وجدنا آبائنا علی امّة 'we found our fathers with a religion'.

definition: Verb: we found you. Root w-j-d.
Adjective plural: fearful, trembling. Root w-j-l.
usage: In a tradition about the companions of the Qá'im: خائفین مرعوبین وجلین 'fearful, dismayed and trembling'.

definition: Wa (oath "by") + jamál "beauty" + -í "my": by My Beauty! Root j-m-l.
usage: HW: یا ابن الانسان وجمالی 'O Son of Man! By My beauty!'; جمال is also a title of Bahá'u'lláh (جمال مبارک 'the Blessed Beauty').

definition: Noun: direction, point faced in prayer, goal. Root w-j-h.
usage: لکل وجهة هو مولّیها 'every one hath a direction to which he turneth' (Qur'an 2:148).

definition: Arabic وجه 'face' with Persian -shán 'their'. Root w-j-h.
usage: Íqán: از وجهشان وجه اللّه 'their face is the Face of God'.

definition: Noun: face, aspect, direction. Root w-j-h.
Arabic wujúd 'existence, being' plus Persian -ash 'his, its'. Root w-j-d.
usage: Its existence, his being; wujúd 'existence, being' is a key philosophical term for existence and the whole of creation.

definition: Noun: Persian plural of vujúd "being, existence" (here with izáfih). Root w-j-d.
usage: Beings or existences; وجود is a key philosophical term for existence and being in the Writings.

shift: Here: faces, eminent souls. Today: sums of money, religious dues.
definition: Noun, double plural of vajh "face": faces, persons, eminent souls. Root w-j-h.
usage: Here faces or eminent souls; in modern Persian وجوهات usually means sums of money or religious dues, so the older sense must be read from context.
notes: Íqán "jamí‘-i ín vujúhát-i qudsí" all these holy souls.

definition: Noun (relative, feminine): oneness, singleness of God. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: Divine Unity or oneness of God, as in sadhrat-i vaḥdániyyih; a central theme of the Writings on the unity of God.

definition: Adverbial accusative waḥd with 3rd masc. suffix: alone, by himself. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: Used of God's oneness, as in وحده لا شریک له 'He alone, Who hath no partner'.

definition: Noun waḥd 'aloneness' + -í: I alone, by Myself. Root w-ḥ-d.
usage: 'I alone', in God's voice affirming His oneness.

definition: Noun: divine revelation, inspiration. Root w-ḥ-y.
usage: 'Revelation', of divine inspiration sent to the Prophets.

definition: Adjective: sole, unique, unrivalled. Root w-ḥ-d.
notes: Also the title Vaḥíd of Siyyid Yaḥyá Dárábí, who is named here.

definition: Noun waḥy 'revelation' + -hi 'His'. Root w-ḥ-y.
usage: His Revelation, as in divine revelation and inspiration.

definition: Preposition wará’ 'behind' with -hu 'him, it'. Root w-r-y.
usage: In the Aqdas نبذ لوح الله ورائه 'cast the Tablet of God behind his back'.

definition: Preposition wará’ 'behind' with suffix -hum 'them'. Root w-r-y.
usage: Qur'anic idiom نبذوا ... ورآئهم 'cast behind their backs'.

definition: Arabic verb warada 'came, befell' with ‘alá and -ná: befell us. Root w-r-d.
usage: Aqdas: بما ورد علینا منکم 'what hath befallen Us at your hands'.
notes: Two words written together in the source.

definition: Noun: dove, ring-dove. Root w-r-q.
usage: The Mystic Dove, symbol of the Revelation, as نغمهٔ ورقا 'the melody of the Dove'.

definition: Noun, plural of waraqah: leaves. Root w-r-q.
usage: ورقه 'leaf' in the Writings also designates a believing woman.

definition: Noun: leaf, sheet of paper. Root w-r-q.
usage: In the Aqdas فی ورقة اخری 'in another Tablet'; also 'Leaf', a title for holy women, as in الورقة العلیا.

definition: Noun varaq 'leaf' with Persian suffix: its leaf. Root w-r-q.

shift: Here: a leaf; also a woman believer. Today: a sheet of paper, a form or document.
definition: Noun: leaf; in modern Persian "sheet of paper, document". Root w-r-q.
usage: In the Writings ورقه "leaf" also designates a woman believer.

definition: Oath wa 'by' with rúḥ 'spirit' and -í 'my'. Root r-w-ḥ.
Verbal noun wurúd 'arrival, entering' with -hi: his entering. Root w-r-d.
Verb, present subjunctive 3rd singular of vazídan 'to blow'.
Plural of waswasa 'evil whispering, temptation'. Root w-s-w-s.
usage: The promptings of self and Satan, as in وساوس نفسانی 'selfish promptings'.

definition: Dirt, filth, stain. Root w-s-kh.
usage: In the Aqdas الّذی یری فی کسائه وسخ 'he on whose garment dirt is seen'.

definition: Verb: it (fem.) encompassed, embraced. Root w-s-‘.
usage: Qur'an 7:156 و رحمتی وسعت کل شیء 'My mercy embraceth all things'.
notes: Persian وسعت 'breadth' is a different word.

definition: Noun viṣál 'union, reunion with the beloved' with -ast 'is'. Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: In the Hidden Words عاشق صادق را حیات در وصالست و موت در فراق 'The true lover yearneth ... life in reunion, death in separation'.

definition: Wiṣál "union, reunion with the beloved" with -í "my". Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: HW: اصعد الی سمائی لکی تری وصالی 'ascend unto My heaven, that thou mayest behold reunion with Me'.

definition: Plural of vaṣiyyat: counsels, injunctions, testaments. Root w-ṣ-y.
Noun وصف 'description, praise' with the suffix 'their'. Root w-ṣ-f.
usage: Íqán: تعالی عمّا یذکر العباد فی وصفهم 'exalted above the praise men give them'.

definition: Vaṣf with indefinite -í: a description, attribute. Root w-ṣ-f.
Noun waṣl 'union' plus -í 'My'. Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: Union with Me; waṣl, union with the Beloved, is contrasted with firáq 'separation' in the Hidden Words.
notes: Hidden Words: 'thy heavenly home, reunion with Me'.

definition: Noun: counsel, injunction, testament; vaṣíyyat kardan "to enjoin". Root w-ṣ-y.
usage: Counsel, injunction or testament; in the Writings God's counsels to His servants, and the وصیت‌نامه 'Will and Testament' of ‘Abdu'l-Bahá.

definition: Verbal noun: placing, putting; also condition, situation. Root w-ḍ-‘.
usage: Placing or setting down; in the Writings also the laying down of laws, and in Persian commonly 'condition, state'.
notes: Aqdas burial: placing engraved rings on the fingers.

definition: Adjective: low, humble, base (opposite of sharíf). Root w-ḍ-‘.
usage: Lowly, base; paired with شریف 'noble' as in 'high and low', وضیع و شریف.

definition: Verbal noun (accusative): a promise. Root w-‘-d.
usage: A promise, usually God's promise, as in وعد الله 'the promise of God', fulfilled in the new Revelation.

definition: Plural of va‘dih 'promise' + izáfih. Root w-‘-d.
usage: Promises, God's promises in past scriptures now fulfilled.

definition: Noun: threat, warning of punishment; yawm al-wa‘íd the threatened Day. Root w-‘-d.
usage: 'Threat', in یوم الوعید 'the threatened Day', paired with وعد 'promise'.

definition: Noun: faithfulness, fulfilment of a promise. Root w-f-y.
usage: Faithfulness, fidelity to the Covenant.

definition: Perfect (form II) of waffaqa 'to aid, grant success' + -ná 'us'; optative 'may God aid us'. Root w-f-q.
usage: May God aid us, as in prayers for success.

definition: Plural of váqi‘ih: events, incidents, happenings. Root w-q-‘.
Verbal noun: occurrence, happening, taking place. Root w-q-‘.
usage: وقوع یافتن 'to take place'.

definition: Verbal noun vuqú‘ 'occurrence' with Persian -ash: its occurrence. Root w-q-‘.
Noun: guardianship, authority, sovereignty; in Shí'í use the station of the Imáms. Root w-l-y.
notes: Uncertain rendering: the Aqdas context (او الولایة عن ولایة الله) may be rendered 'sovereignty' or 'authority'.

definition: Noun: rapture, ecstatic love, distraction. Root w-l-h.
Verb imperative: turn ye (one's face). Root w-l-y.
usage: In the Aqdas ولّوا وجوهکم شطری الأقدس 'turn your faces towards My Most Holy Court'.

definition: Conjunction و with لکنّ 'but' and suffix: but he (is).
usage: Qur'an 33:40 ولکنّه رسول الله و خاتم النبیین 'but He is the Apostle of God and the Seal of the Prophets'.

definition: Noun walí "protector, friend" with suffix "their". Root w-l-y.
usage: From Qur'an 6:127 و هو ولیّهم بما کانوا یعملون "He shall be their Protector".

definition: Proper noun: Wahb, as in Mu‘áwiyat ibn Wahb, a transmitter of hadith.
notes: As a verb wahaba means 'he gave'.

definition: Plural of wakíl: agents, deputies, trustees, representatives. Root w-k-l.
usage: In the Aqdas the members of the House of Justice are to regard themselves as وکلاء الله 'the guardians appointed of God' for all on earth.

definition: Noun: trustee, guardian, one relied upon. Root w-k-l.
usage: Qur'anic کفی باللّه وکیلاً 'God sufficeth as a Guardian'.

definition: Persian noun: foot, leg; از پا افتادن 'to collapse, be exhausted'.
Plural of pá 'foot' in construct.
Adjective pák 'pure' with indefinite -í; also the noun 'purity'.
Noun, plural of pidar: fathers, forefathers.
Fathers: pidar with plural -há.
usage: Íqán: چه پدرها که از پسرها اعراض نمودند 'how many fathers turned away from their sons'.

definition: Noun: wing, feather; the means of flight.
usage: پر عنایت فرمودم 'I bestowed wings', to soar in holy space.

definition: Adjective: full, filled; also as a prefix 'very'.
Persian adjective: flying, swift in flight.
usage: In a verse quoted in the Íqán: پرّان چون خدنگ 'flying like an arrow'.

definition: Pur-javhar (full of quality, well-tempered) with -í and copula: is a well-tempered one.
Past tense, second person singular, of pardákhtan 'to busy oneself with'.
usage: Thou didst busy thyself; pardákhtan with bih 'to occupy oneself with', often of worldly concerns.

definition: Noun: veil, curtain, screen.
usage: A veil or curtain, frequently figurative of the veils of self and idle fancy that hide the truth from the seeker.

definition: Noun pardih "curtain, veil" with plural -há: veils, curtains.
usage: Veils that hide the truth; Bahá'u'lláh calls on souls to rend the veils (پردهها) of idle fancy, self and learning.

definition: Noun pardih "curtain, veil" + indefinite -í.
usage: Pardih 'veil' is a common image in the Writings for what conceals the truth from the seeker, as in پردهٔ غفلت 'veil of heedlessness'.
notes: Written پرده‌ئی.

definition: Plural of parhízkár: the pious, the God-fearing.
usage: 'The God-fearing', the pious who guard themselves against sin; Persian counterpart of متّقین.

definition: Past 1st sing. of parvardan 'to nurture, rear'.
usage: I nurtured, reared; in the Hidden Words God nurturing the soul.

definition: Adjective: full of malice, rancorous (pur 'full' + kínih 'hatred').
usage: 'Full of hatred, rancorous', of those who bear malice toward others.

definition: Plural of past-fiṭrat: base-natured, mean-spirited people (past low + fiṭrat nature).
Plural of pisar 'son, boy'.
Comparative of pasandídih 'approved, pleasing' with -and 'they are': they are more pleasing.
Verb: past 2nd singular of pasandídan, 'to approve, to choose, to like'.
Persian numeral: fifty.
Subjunctive of púshídan 'to put on, wear'.
Noun: onion, the vegetable; in the Íqán from the Qur'anic story of Israel in the wilderness.
Compound verb پی بردن 'to find the trace, discover, apprehend' (with بـ).
notes: Written without the joiner: پی‌بریم.

definition: Adjective: old, aged; as noun, an elder, a spiritual master. Persian.
usage: پیر نمود مرا 'made me old'.

definition: Persian noun: following, obedience; پیروی نمودن "to follow".
Negative past of پی بردن 'to grasp, discover': 'they did not perceive'.
Simple past 3rd person plural of payvastan 'to join, be united': they joined, attained.
usage: In the Íqán, of martyrs: برضای ذی الجلال پیوستند 'they attained the good pleasure of the Lord of glory'.

definition: Adverb: continually, constantly; adjective 'joined'.
Noun chárih 'remedy, recourse, way out' with indefinite -’í.
Nimble, swift, agile.
usage: In the Hidden Words در سبیل قدس چالاک شو 'be swift in the path of holiness'.

definition: Subjunctive of the causative چشاندن 'to make taste': (that) he give to taste.
Verb, present subjunctive 3rd person singular of chashídan: that he taste.
Chashm "eye" with -at "your": your eye.
Noun چشم 'eye' with suffix -ash 'his'.
Persian noun: spring, fountain, source.
Noun: spring, fountain, fount of water.
Past tense, third person singular, of chashídan 'to taste'.
usage: Tasted; used figuratively of tasting the wine of love or the sweetness of the Word.

definition: Verb: subjunctive 1st plural of chashídan "to taste" (without bi-): let us taste.
usage: Used of tasting spiritual realities, e.g. the wine or fruits of the divine presence.

definition: Variant spelling of chunánchih: as, just as, inasmuch as.
notes: Missing nún; probably a scribal variant of چنانچه.

definition: Numeral: four hundred.
Noun: face, countenance; chihrih gushúdan = to unveil, appear.
usage: Face, countenance; often the face or beauty of the Beloved, as in چهره گشودن 'to unveil the face'.

definition: Numeral: forty.
Noun: thing; chih chíz: what.
Plural of chíz: things.
Plural of chíz 'thing' with indefinite -í.
Interrogative chih 'what' with -st 'is': what is?
Adjective or noun: deep; depth.
usage: Persian Hidden Words: شبنمی از ژرف دریای رحمت 'a dewdrop out of the fathomless deep of My mercy'.

definition: Active participle, accusative: lying; a liar. Root k-dh-b.
usage: Qur'an 40:28: ان یک کاذباً فعلیه کذبه 'if he be a liar, on him be his lie'.

definition: Active participle plural: liars. Root k-dh-b.
Noun kárván 'caravan' with plural -há and izáfih.
Past participle of کاستن 'to diminish': lessened, deficient.
usage: In the Persian Hidden Words contrasted with آراسته 'adorned': fair without, wanting within.

definition: Past participle of کاشتن: sown, planted. Persian.
usage: تخم کینه کاشته بود 'had sown the seeds of hatred'.

definition: Proper noun: Siyyid Káẓim of Rasht, successor of Shaykh Aḥmad and herald of the Báb.
usage: With احمد in the Íqán as نورین نیّرین "two luminous lights".

definition: Noun: camphor; in the Qur'an a fountain of paradise. Root k-f-r.
usage: Qur'an 76:5 کان مزاجها کافوراً 'tempered with camphor'.

definition: Ka- 'like' plus al-aṣábi‘, plural of iṣba‘ 'finger': like the fingers. Root ṣ-b-‘.
usage: In the Aqdas کونوا کالاصابع فی الید 'be ye as the fingers of one hand'.

definition: Preposition ka- 'like' plus aghnám 'sheep' (plural of ghanam). Root gh-n-m.
usage: In the Aqdas فانظروا الخلق کالأغنام 'regard men as a flock of sheep'.

definition: Preposition ka- 'like' + al-an‘ám 'cattle, beasts'. Root n-‘-m.
usage: From Qur'an 25:44 ان هم الّا کالأنعام بل هم اضلّ سبیلاً 'They are but as the brutes; yea, they are further astray'.

definition: Ka- 'like' plus al-barq 'lightning'. Root b-r-q.
usage: In the tradition المؤمنون کالبرق علیه یمرّون 'the believers pass over it like lightning'.

definition: ka- 'like' with al-jibál 'the mountains'. Root j-b-l.
usage: Aqdas کونوا کالجبال الرواسخ 'be ye as firm as the immovable mountains'.

definition: Preposition ka- 'like' with alladhína 'those who'.
usage: In Qur'an 59:19 لا تکونوا کالّذین نسوا اللّه 'Be ye not like those who forget God'.

definition: Ka "like" + ash-shiryán "the artery". Root sh-r-y.
usage: Aqdas: ان یکون نبّاضاً کالشّریان فی جسد الامکان 'to pulsate like an artery in the body of creation'.

definition: Adjective kámil 'perfect, complete' with copula -ast. Root k-m-l.
usage: انسان کامل 'the Perfect Man', a mystical term the Íqán applies to the Manifestation.

definition: Plural of کامل: perfect, accomplished ones. Root k-m-l.
usage: Íqán: فضلای کاملین 'accomplished men of learning'.

definition: Ka-anna with 'he': as if he, as though he.
ka-anna 'as though' plus -hum 'they'.
Particle ka-anna "as if" plus -í "I": as though I. Root ’-n-n.
notes: Normalized from کأنّی.

definition: Noun káh "straw" with indefinite -í; "bi-par-i káhí" (not) a whit.
usage: Straw, proverbial for something worthless, as in به پر کاهی 'not a whit, not a straw's worth'.

definition: Noun kabid "liver" (seat of emotion) + plural -há.
usage: The liver as seat of feeling, in poetic expressions of grief or burning love; rendered 'hearts'.

definition: Noun kibriyá' (grandeur, majesty) with 1st sing. suffix. Root k-b-r.
usage: Divine grandeur and majesty; in the Hidden Words often in God's own voice as 'My grandeur'.

definition: Adjective (accusative): great, grave, grievous. Root k-b-r.
usage: Great, grievous, as in اثما کبیرا 'a grievous sin'.

definition: Noun kitáb 'book' with suffix -ishán 'their'. Root k-t-b.
usage: 'Their Book', of the scripture of each people.

definition: Verb, Form I past 2nd masc. sing.: you wrote. Root k-t-b.
Perfect first singular of kataba 'to write' + -hu 'it'. Root k-t-b.
Past of kataba 'to write; prescribe': We have written, ordained. Root k-t-b.
usage: In the Aqdas قد کتبنا علیکم الصیام 'We have enjoined upon you fasting'.

definition: Verbal noun: concealment, hiding. Root k-t-m.
usage: من غیر ستر و کتمان 'without veil or concealment'.

definition: Noun: abundance, great number, multitude. Root k-th-r.
Verb form II: to multiply, increase. Root k-th-r.
usage: In the tradition العلم نقطة کثرها الجاهلون 'Knowledge is a single point, which the foolish have multiplied'.

definition: Adjective, feminine: many, numerous, large. Root k-th-r.
Adjective (fem.): many, abundant, manifold. Root k-th-r.
Adjective kathír 'many, much' with indefinite ی. Root k-th-r.
usage: جمع کثیری 'a great multitude'.

shift: Here: dense, thick, gross (material). Today: dirty.
definition: Adjective: dense, thick, gross; in modern Persian "dirty". Root k-th-f.
Adjective (feminine): dense, gross; foul, filthy. Root k-th-f.
Noun: kohl, antimony powder applied to the eyes; collyrium. Root k-ḥ-l.
usage: In the Íqán کحل معارف الهی 'the collyrium of divine knowledge' that brightens the eye.

definition: Adjective: turbid, murky, dim. Root k-d-r.
Feminine of kadir 'turbid, muddy, impure'. Root k-d-r.
notes: Spelled with final ە (U+06D5) in the source.

definition: Turbidity; ill-feeling, estrangement. Root k-d-r.
usage: In the Aqdas divorce law ان حدث بینهما کدورة 'should resentment arise between them'.

shift: Here: turbidity, impurity, darkness. Today: ill-feeling, resentment.
definition: Noun: turbidity, impurity; in modern Persian mainly ill-feeling, resentment. Root k-d-r.
Noun kadhib 'lie, falsehood' with 'his'. Root k-dh-b.
usage: In Qur'an 40:28 فعلیه کذبه 'on him will be his lie'.

definition: Form II perfect 3pl: they denied, treated (it) as lies. Root k-dh-b.
usage: Qur'an 7:146 in the Íqán: ذلک بأنّهم کذّبوا بآیاتنا 'this, because they treated Our signs as lies'.

definition: Noun kidhb 'lie, falsehood' with indefinite -í. Root k-dh-b.
Preposition ک 'like' with رجاء 'hope'. Root r-j-w.
usage: HW: یرجو البلاء کرجاء العاصی الی المغفرة 'longeth for tribulation even as the rebel for forgiveness'.

definition: Present perfect 2pl of kardan: you have done.
Plural of karrúb 'cherub': the cherubim, angels near to God.
usage: Cherubim, the angels near to God; used of the denizens of the highest heavens who circle the divine throne.

definition: Noun: Persian plural of kurúr "half a million": countless numbers, myriads.
usage: Means myriads or countless numbers, as in کرورها 'myriads' of years or beings.

definition: Noun kisá’ "garment, cloak" with -hi: his garment. Root k-s-w.
usage: A garment or cloak; in the Aqdas in passages on clothing and personal belongings.
