definition: Verb (form I, past) 3rd person masculine plural: they earned, acquired. Root k-s-b.
usage: Qur'anic idiom for what people have earned or wrought by their deeds, as in بما کسبوا 'for what they have wrought'.

definition: Plural of kisfah (accusative): pieces, fragments (of the sky). Root k-s-f.
usage: Pieces or fragments of the sky, a Qur'anic image (17:92, 52:44) of the heavens falling as a sign of judgment.
notes: Also read kisfan (a piece).

definition: Verbal noun: eclipse, especially of the sun. Root k-s-f.
usage: Eclipse of the sun, a sign interpreted symbolically in the Íqán.

definition: Verb, present subjunctive 3rd person singular of kishándan 'to draw, lead'.
usage: 'Draw, lead', of being drawn toward something.

definition: Past 3rd plural of kushtan: they killed.
usage: They killed; of the Prophets slain by their people.
notes: Not kishtand (they sowed).

definition: Simple past second plural of kushtan 'to kill'.
Preposition ka- 'like' plus shajarah 'tree'. Root sh-j-r.
usage: Qur'an 14:24 کلمة طیّبة کشجرة طیّبة 'a goodly word is as a goodly tree'.

definition: Verb: past 3rd singular of kashídan, 'to draw, to pull'; بجائی کشیدن 'to come to such a pass'.
Proper noun: Ka‘b, as in Ka‘b ibn al-Ashraf, an opponent of the Prophet Muḥammad.
notes: As a common noun ka‘b means 'ankle, heel'.

definition: Proper noun: the Kaaba in Mecca; figuratively any object of adoration or Qiblih. Root k-‘-b.
usage: Figurative goal of adoration, as کعبهٔ لایزال 'the eternal Ka‘bih'.

definition: Noun kufr 'unbelief' with 3rd sing. suffix. Root k-f-r.
Noun, plural of káfir: unbelievers, infidels. Root k-f-r.
usage: In کفرهٔ فجره 'the infidel and wicked'.

definition: Noun kufr 'unbelief' with suffix: their disbelief. Root k-f-r.
usage: Qur'an 35:39 لا یزید الکافرین کفرهم الّا خسارا.

definition: Persian kufr "unbelief, infidelity" with indefinite -í. Root k-f-r.
Noun kufr 'unbelief, blasphemy' with -í and است: 'it is a blasphemy'. Root k-f-r.
Imperative masculine plural of kaffa 'to hold back, restrain': restrain, abstain. Root k-f-f.
usage: In the Aqdas law of fasting: کفّوا انفسکم عن الاکل و الشرب 'abstain from food and drink'.

definition: Noun: crow.
Noun kalám 'speech, word' with -í 'my'. Root k-l-m.
usage: From Matthew 24:35 in Arabic: ولکن کلامی لا یزول 'but my words shall not pass away'.

definition: Kiltá 'both' (fem.) in the oblique case with -himá.
usage: In the Hidden Words لأنّ کلتیهما تزولان 'for both shall pass away'.

definition: Verb form II: he spoke to. Root k-l-m.
usage: Qur'an 2:253 منهم من کلم الله 'of them is he to whom God spake'.

definition: Conjunction: whenever, every time that.
notes: In Qur'an 11:38 کلّما مرّ علیه ملأ من قومه 'whenever a company of his people passed by him'.

definition: Words (plural of kalima) with -hi "his". Root k-l-m.
usage: Aqdas: بحر کلماته 'the ocean of His words'.

definition: Plural of kalimih 'word' with relative -í 'those words which'. Root k-l-m.
Noun کلمة 'word' with the suffix 'his'. Root k-l-m.
usage: Aqdas: کلمته العلیا 'His most exalted Word'; کلمة اللّه 'the Word of God'.

definition: Noun: word, utterance; the creative Word of God. Root k-l-m.
Noun kull 'all, every' plus -hum 'them'. Root k-l-l.
usage: All of them; common expression, as in kulluhum la-hu qánitún 'all obey Him'.

definition: Noun: one who converses; Kalímu’lláh "He Who conversed with God", title of Moses. Root k-l-m.
usage: The one who conversed with God; کلیم الله 'He Who conversed with God' is the title of Moses, and کلیم alone often refers to Him.

definition: Verb kamula "to be complete", perfect 3rd feminine singular: it was completed. Root k-m-l.
usage: To be completed or perfected; said of a period, a number, or God's bounty and word brought to completion.
notes: Aqdas: if the year of waiting is completed.

definition: Particle ka- "like" + man "who": like one who.
notes: Qur'an 6:122.

definition: Noun: lasso, noose; figuratively a snare or reach.
usage: Lasso, noose; in poetic imagery the lasso of love or of the Beloved's tresses that captures the heart.

definition: Kamand 'lasso, noose' (poetic) + -ash 'his, its'.
usage: Kamand 'noose, lasso' appears in poetic imagery of the snare of love or of the world, which captures the seeker.

definition: Noun: quantity, extent, measure. Root k-m-m.
usage: 'Quantity, measure', paired with کیفیّت 'quality'.

definition: Proper name: Kumayl ibn Ziyád, companion of Imám ‘Alí, transmitter of a famous tradition on truth.
usage: Kumayl ibn Ziyád, whose tradition on the truth Bahá'u'lláh quotes.

definition: Noun: allusion, metonymy; insinuation, taunt. Root k-n-y.
usage: Allusion or insinuation, also figurative speech.

definition: Nisba adjective: of Kand, a village near Tehran, as in Mullá Mihdíy-i-Kandí.
Noun: treasure. Root k-n-z.
usage: Aqdas: یکون له کنزاً عند ربّه 'it shall be a treasure for him with his Lord'; the Hidden Treasure (کنز مخفی) tradition.

definition: Arabic verb, perfect 1st singular of kanaza: I treasured, stored up. Root k-n-z.
usage: Hidden Words: فیکم کنزت لآلئ اسراری 'in you I have stored the pearls of My mysteries'.

definition: Preposition ka 'like, as' with nafs 'soul'. Root n-f-s.
usage: From HW: ان تکونوا کنفس واحدة 'that ye may be even as one soul'.

definition: Noun: cup, goblet without handle. Root k-w-b.
Subjunctive of کوشیدن 'to strive, endeavour'.
Proper noun: Kufa, city in Iraq, seat of Imám ‘Alí.
Noun: heap, mound, hill. Root k-w-m.
notes: Reading in this Aqdas verse uncertain; it may be کرم "vineyard".

definition: Plural of کوه 'mountain'.
Comparative of kúchak 'small': smaller, lesser.
Noun kawkab 'star' with indefinite -í: a star. Root k-w-k-b.
Interrogative kí 'who' with -st 'is': who is.
Quality, manner, nature, how something is.
Conjunction (kay + lá): so that not, lest.
Noun: alchemy; the elixir that transmutes base metal.
usage: In the Íqán علم کیمیا 'the science of alchemy'; figuratively the transforming power of the Word.

definition: Kímiyá "alchemy, elixir" with ast "is".
usage: Íqán, in an anecdote about a claimant to صنعت کیمیا 'the art of alchemy'.

definition: Noun: rancour, malice, lasting hatred or grudge.
usage: تخم کینه 'the seed of hatred'.

definition: Plural of کینونة 'being, essence' with the suffix 'your'. Root k-w-n.
usage: HW: حتّی تظهر من کینوناتکم ... آیات التّوحید 'that from your inmost being ... the signs of oneness may appear'.

definition: Kaynúna with 'my': my being, essence. Root k-w-n.
Noun gám 'step, pace' plus indefinite -í.
usage: A step; used in counsels to take a step on the path of God, e.g. gámí bar-dárid 'take a step'.

definition: Adverb: sometimes, at times.
Verb guzárdan "to place, give (a name)", present perfect 2nd plural: ye have put.
usage: In نام گذاردن 'to give a name': Bahá'u'lláh rebukes those who have called things by names devoid of reality.
notes: nám-i án-rá gul guzárdih-íd ye have named it a rose.

definition: Verb, present perfect 3rd person plural of guzáshtan: they have placed; nám guzáshtan to name.
usage: From گذاشتن 'to place, put'; in نام گذاشتن 'to name', of names men have given to things.

definition: Perfect 2nd pl. of guzáshtan: you have placed, set; ism guzáshtan = to give a name.
usage: From گذاشتن 'to place, set'; with اسم 'to give a name'.
notes: Spelled گذاشته‌اید in the text.

definition: Past 2nd sing. of guzáshtan 'to put, leave, hand over'.
usage: In the Hidden Words of handing over or leaving something, as when the soul gives its heart to another than God.

definition: Verb, perfect 2nd person plural of gudhashtan 'to pass': ye have passed.
usage: 'Ye have passed', of passing beyond attachments or along the stages of the path.

definition: Adjective (literary): precious, of great worth (girán dear + máyih substance).
Simple past third singular of gardánídan 'to turn, make'.
Past of the causative gardánídan 'to turn, lead about': they led them round, paraded them.
Noun: neck.
Persian verb, 1st singular past of giriftan 'to take'.
Present perfect of giriftan 'to take', second person plural.
Verb, present perfect 3rd pl. of giravídan 'to believe in, adhere to'.
notes: Written as one word in the source (گرویده‌اند).

definition: Noun: wolf.
usage: In the Íqán's tradition of the wolf and the lamb feeding together.

definition: Adjective گریزان 'fleeing' with -and: they flee, shun. Persian.
Persian guríz "flight, escape" with indefinite -í: any escape.
Past of گریستن 'to weep': 'they wept'.
Infinitive girístan 'to weep' used as a noun with indefinite -í: a weeping (cognate object: wept a weeping).
usage: In the Hidden Words گریست گریستنی که ... 'she wept with such a weeping that ...'.

definition: Verb, past 3rd singular of guzídan 'to choose'; maqarr guzíd 'took up his abode'.
Past participle of guzídan 'to choose'; مقرّ گزیدن 'to take up abode'.
Present perfect of guzídan 'to choose': they have chosen.
Past of گشتن 'to become' (copula): you (pl.) became.
Verb, simple past 1st person plural of gashtan: we became; we turned.
Past participle of گشودن "to open": opened, open.
usage: Íqán: علم نامتناهی را بر وجه خود گشوده یابی 'thou shalt find the gates of infinite knowledge open before thy face'.

definition: Present perfect 1st person singular of گفتن 'to say'.
Persian verb گفتن 'say', past: you (pl.) said.
Noun: rosebush, rose-bower; poetic word for a rose plant.
Plural of guldastih 'minaret' (also 'bouquet').
usage: Minarets; guldastih here means a minaret (from which the call to prayer is raised), whereas today it usually means a bouquet.

definition: Noun gulú "throat" plus -am "my".
Noun gul "rose, flower" with indefinite -í: a rose (bush).
usage: Rose or flower, a frequent image in the Persian Hidden Words for spiritual beauty, alongside the nightingale (بلبل) and the garden (گلزار).
notes: Could also be gilí "of clay"; context favours rose.

definition: Verb, past 3rd person plural of gumáshtan: they appointed, set; himmat gumáshtan to strive.
usage: From گماشتن 'to appoint'; in همّت گماشتن 'to set one's endeavour' on something, to strive.

definition: Past participle of gumáshtan: appointed, directed; himmat gumáshtan = to devote one's effort.
usage: Appointed, set to a task; in همّت گماشتن 'to devote one's endeavour'.

definition: Perfect 3rd pl. of gumáshtan 'to appoint, apply'; himmat gumáshtan 'to strive, resolve'.
usage: Used in the phrase همّت گماشتن 'to strive, set one's endeavour', describing those who have resolved upon a task.

definition: Adjective: astray, misguided; gumráh shudan: to go astray.
usage: 'Astray', as in گمراه شدن 'to go astray'.

definition: Noun: going astray, error (gum lost + ráh way + -í).
Plural of gunáh 'sin'.
usage: Sins, as in forgiveness of sins.

definition: Adjective or noun: sinful, a sinner.
Noun gaváh 'witness' + indefinite -í + -st 'is': is a witness.
Persian noun gúsh 'ear', plural: ears.
Agent noun of guftan: speaker, one who speaks; here God as the Speaker.
usage: Opening invocation of the Persian Hidden Words: بنام گوینده توانا 'In the Name of the Lord of Utterance, the Mighty'.
notes: Final letter written ە (U+06D5) in this edition.

definition: Verb, present 2nd sing. of guftan 'to say': thou sayest.
Adverb: as if, as though, it seems.
Noun گیاه 'plant, herb, grass' with indefinite -í.
Verb, present of گرفتن: they take; انس گیرند 'they become intimate'. Persian.
Imperative of گرفتن "to take"; پند گیرید "take heed, take warning".
Present subjunctive of گرفتن 'to take'; پند گرفتن 'to take heed'.
Noun gísú 'tress, lock of hair', poetic, with the izáfih -yi.
usage: In the Hidden Words گیسوی مشکینم 'My musk-scented locks'.

definition: Fragment of the vocative particle ای 'O', split by a stray space in the source.
notes: Source text reads ا ی for ای.

definition: Adjective: dry, withered. Root y-b-s.
usage: From Qur'an 6:59 و لا رطب و لا یابس الّا فی کتاب مبین 'nor a thing green or sere but is in a clear Book'.

definition: Form VIII of ’-m-r: they take counsel, plot together. Root ’-m-r.
usage: In Qur'an 28:20 انّ الملأ یأتمرون بک لیقتلوک 'the chiefs are plotting to slay thee'.

definition: Verb: he comes; with bi- he brings. Root '-t-y.
usage: Aqdas ولو یأتی بکل الاعمال 'even should he bring forth all good works'.
notes: Written یأتی.

definition: Verb, 3rd person singular subjunctive with 'us': (until) he bring us. Root a-t-y.
usage: In Qur'an 3:183 حتّی یأتینا بقربان تأکله النّار 'until he present us a sacrifice consumed by fire'.
notes: Written یأتینا in the source.

definition: Imperfect of atá "to come" with -ka: it comes to you. Root ’-t-y.
usage: HW: لأنّ الموت یأتیک بغتة 'for death, unheralded, shall come upon thee'.

definition: Jussive of akhadha 'to take, seize' with suffix 'you'; with لا a prohibition. Root ’-kh-dh.
usage: لا یأخذکم الاضطراب 'let not dismay seize you' when the Manifestation is hidden.

definition: Persian verb یافتن 'find', past: you found; with مقرّ 'took up abode'.
Relational adjective from yáqút: ruby, of ruby.
Subjunctive of anisa 'to be intimate, find companionship'. Root '-n-s.
usage: Commune, find intimacy; used of the soul's intimate communion (uns) with God and His remembrance.

definition: Verb: imperfect 3rd singular of akala "to eat". Root ’-k-l.
Verb form III báraka "to bless", imperfect 3rd masculine singular: (He would) bless. Root b-r-k.
usage: To bless; God's blessing in prayers and Tablets, from the same root as تبارک 'blessed be' and برکت 'blessing'.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd person singular (form III): he takes allegiance from, pledges. Root b-y-‘.
usage: Of pledging allegiance (bay'ah) to the Manifestation or to the one from whom allegiance is taken.

definition: Verb (form III imperfect, 3rd pl.): they pledge allegiance, swear fealty. Root b-y-‘.
usage: 'They plight fealty', from Qur'án 48:10, of those who pledge allegiance to the Prophet and so to God.
notes: Qur'án 48:10.

definition: Verb form III imperfect 3rd masc. pl. + -ka: they pledge allegiance to thee. Root b-y-‘.
usage: From the Qur'anic verse of allegiance (48:10), cited in the Writings of those who pledge fealty to the Manifestation of God.
notes: Quran 48:10.

definition: Verb, imperfect of baththa: to spread, disseminate. Root b-th-th.
usage: Used of spreading abroad or diffusing something, as in Bahá'u'lláh's call to spread His teachings and fragrances among people.

definition: Verb, Form II imperfect: he changes, replaces. Root b-d-l.
usage: Changes; of God's unchanging Word.

definition: Imperfect (form II) of baddala 'to exchange' + -há 'it'. Root b-d-l.
usage: Exchanges it, of changing or substituting.

definition: Present of form II bashshara 'to bring good news' with -kum 'you'. Root b-sh-r.
usage: In the Íqán یبشّرکم بسراج الله 'giveth you the glad-tidings of the Lamp of God'.

definition: Verb: imperfect 3rd plural of abṣara, 'to see, to perceive'. Root b-ṣ-r.
usage: Qur'an 7:179: لهم اعین لا یبصرون بها 'they have eyes with which they see not'.

definition: Arabic verb, form IV imperfect: annuls, invalidates. Root b-ṭ-l.
Verb: to send, raise up; من یبعثه الله 'He Whom God shall raise up'. Root b-‘-th.
usage: Variant of the Báb's title for Bahá'u'lláh, من یظهره الله 'Him Whom God shall make manifest'.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd sing. of baqiya: remains, endures. Root b-q-y.
Verb: that they reach, attain. Root b-l-gh.
usage: In the Aqdas الی ان یبلغوا رشدهم 'until they attain maturity'.

definition: Verb, form I imperfect: it wears out, decays. Root b-l-y.
usage: قمیصی لا یبلی 'My garment shall never be outworn'.

definition: Form VIII of t-b-‘: to follow, obey; "that they follow it". Root t-b-‘.
Passive subjunctive: 'they be left (alone)'. Root t-r-k.
usage: Qur'an 29:2 أ حسب النّاس ان یترکوا 'do men think they shall be let alone'.

definition: Imperfect 3rd person masculine plural of taraka: they leave, abandon, forsake. Root t-r-k.
usage: In the Aqdas یطلبون ما یضرّهم و یترکون ما ینفعهم 'they seek what harmeth them and forsake what profiteth them'.

definition: Verb, form V: to dispose of, take possession of. Root ṣ-r-f.
usage: In the Aqdas لیس لأحد ان یتصرّف فیها 'none hath the right to dispose of them'.

definition: Imperfect of form V taḍawwa‘a 'to spread (of fragrance)'. Root ḍ-w-‘.
Form V: to learn. Root ‘-l-m.
usage: In the Aqdas قد اذن اللّه لمن اراد ان یتعلّم الألسن المختلفة 'God hath permitted whoso desireth to learn the various languages'.

definition: Verb form V: they discern, perceive with insight. Root f-r-s.
Verb, form V, present 3rd person plural: they reflect, meditate. Root f-k-r.
usage: In لو کان النّاس فی اسرار الأمر یتفکّرون 'if men would ponder the mysteries of the Cause'.

definition: Jussive of talá "to recite" (after lam): has not recited. Root t-l-w.
usage: Aqdas: انّ الّذی لم یتل لم یوف بعهد اللّه 'whoso reciteth not the verses hath not been faithful to the Covenant of God'.

definition: Imperfect 3rd person plural of talá 'to recite'. Root t-l-w.
usage: یتلون آیات الرحمن باحسن الالحان 'chant the verses of God in the sweetest tones'.

definition: Arabic verb (form V): to hold fast, cling, cleave to. Root m-s-k.
usage: Aqdas: لیس لأحد ان یتمسّک الیوم الّا بما ظهر 'it is not for anyone today to cling to aught save what hath been manifested'.

definition: Subjunctive of tába: repent, turn back to God. Root t-w-b.
Subjunctive, third person feminine plural, of form V tawaḍḍa’a 'to perform ablutions'. Root w-ḍ-’.
usage: Perform ablutions; in the Aqdas laws on ablution (wuḍú') before prayer.

definition: Verb (form V): imperfect 3rd singular of takallama "to speak". Root k-l-m.
usage: Used of the Manifestation speaking with God's voice, as in یتکلم 'He speaketh'.

definition: Proper noun: Yathrib, the old name of Medina.
usage: The old name of Medina, mentioned in the Qur'an (33:13); in the Íqán it recalls the city of the Prophet.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd person singular (form IV) + -há: it weighs it down. Root th-q-l.
usage: Of burdens and loads weighing down the soul, as with sins or worldly attachments.

definition: Verb (form IV jussive, 3rd sing.) with 3rd masc. object: (did not) answer him. Root j-w-b.
usage: To answer; in لم یجبه احد 'none answered him', describing the rejection of a Messenger.
notes: Lam yujibhu aḥad = none answered him.

definition: Verb form VIII imperfect 3rd masc. sing.: avoids, shuns. Root j-n-b.
usage: Used of shunning what God has forbidden, as in the Aqdas's exhortations to avoid evil deeds.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd person masculine plural of jaḥada: they deny, reject. Root j-ḥ-d.
usage: Used of those who deny or reject the signs of God, echoing Qur'anic usage; rendered "deny" or "reject".

definition: Verb, Form I imperfect 3rd fem. plural: they (women) find. Root w-j-d.
Subjunctive third plural of ja‘ala 'to make, set up' (after an). Root j-‘-l.
usage: That they set up or make.

definition: Present of ja‘ala 'to put, make': they put, they place. Root j-‘-l.
usage: Qur'an 2:19 یجعلون اصابعهم فی آذانهم 'they thrust their fingers into their ears'.

definition: Verb: imperfect of jama‘a, 'to gather, to unite'. Root j-m-‘.
usage: Aqdas: یجمع اغنام اللّه الّتی تفرّقت 'Who gathereth the sheep of God that have been scattered'.

definition: Arabic verb, imperfect of jáza: it is permissible, allowed. Root j-w-z.
usage: Legal formula لا یجوز 'it is not permissible'.

definition: Verb form IV: to love. Root ḥ-b-b.
Verb, imperfect of ḥabiṭa: comes to nothing, is nullified. Root ḥ-b-ṭ.
Verb: he loves it. Root ḥ-b-b.
usage: In ما لا یحبّه الله 'that which God loveth not'.

definition: Verb, form VIII imperfect with suffix: bears it, endures it. Root ḥ-m-l.
usage: Tradition: انّ امرنا صعب مستصعب لا یحتمله الّا ملک مقرّب 'Our Cause is grievous, none can bear it save a favoured angel'.

definition: Verb ḥajaba, to veil, screen off; "(lest) it veil thee". Root ḥ-j-b.
Verb: 'it veils, shuts you out', with -kum. Root ḥ-j-b.
Imperfect 3rd person masculine singular of ḥadatha: it happens, arises, comes about. Root ḥ-d-th.
usage: In the Aqdas ما یحدث به العناد بینکم 'that whereby discord would arise among you'.

definition: Verb, form II: to warn, caution, with -kum 'you'. Root ḥ-dh-r.
usage: Qur'anic یحذّرکم اللّه نفسه 'God biddeth you beware of Himself'.

definition: Imperfect of form II ḥarrafa 'to alter, distort, pervert (a text)'. Root ḥ-r-f.
usage: From Qur'an 4:46 یحرّفون الکلم عن مواضعه; the Íqán explains it as perverting the meaning, not the text.

definition: Form II: they alter, distort it. Root ḥ-r-f.
usage: In Qur'an 2:75 ثمّ یحرّفونه من بعد ما عقلوه 'then they pervert it after understanding it'; the Íqán explains taḥríf as misinterpretation.

definition: Passive of form IV: they are burned. Root ḥ-r-q.
notes: Read as passive with یقتلون 'they shall be slain and burned'.

definition: Verb, present 3rd person singular: becomes forbidden, unlawful. Root ḥ-r-m.
usage: In the Aqdas یحرم علی الآخر ما یملک 'it is unlawful for the other...'.
notes: Could also be read yuḥarramu (form II passive).

definition: Form II subjunctive of ḥ-r-k "to move, set in motion". Root ḥ-r-k.
usage: Aqdas: لیس لأحد ان یحرّک لسانه امام النّاس 'it is not seemly to move one's tongue before the people' (recite aloud while walking).

definition: Jussive of form IV aḥzana 'to sadden', in a conditional. Root ḥ-z-n.
usage: من یحزن احداً 'whoso causeth sadness to anyone' must pay a fine.

definition: Arabic verb (form IV), jussive after لم: he (did not) count it. Root ḥ-ṣ-y.
usage: Aqdas: العوالم الّتی لم یحصها الّا لوحی المحفوظ 'worlds which none but My Guarded Tablet hath reckoned'.

definition: Subjunctive of ḥaḍara: be present, attend. Root ḥ-ḍ-r.
Jussive of form IV aḥáṭa 'to encompass, comprehend' (after lam). Root ḥ-w-ṭ.
usage: Encompass, comprehend; used in statements that no one can encompass God or His knowledge.

definition: Verb (form II, passive): is realized, established, made valid. Root ḥ-q-q.
usage: Means to be realized or established, as of a truth or promise being fulfilled.

definition: Verb ḥamala "to carry", imperfect 3rd masculine singular with -hu: carries it. Root ḥ-m-l.
usage: To bear or carry; used of bearing a trust (امانت), the weight of revelation, or a burden.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd person singular: changes, alters; intervenes. Root ḥ-w-l.
usage: Used of nothing intervening between a soul and God, or of states changing; echoes Qur'anic يحول بين المرء وقلبه.

definition: Verb (form IV imperfect): it surrounds, encompasses, covers. Root ḥ-w-ṭ.
usage: To encompass, surround; often of God's knowledge or power encompassing all things.

definition: Verb, passive imperfect 3rd masc. sing. of khána: is betrayed. Root kh-w-n.
usage: Used in the Writings of trust and fidelity, as of one who is betrayed or of the betrayal of a trust (amánat).

definition: Verb, imperfect subjunctive form IV of akhbara: to inform, notify. Root kh-b-r.
usage: To inform or tell; in the Writings often of God informing people of what was hidden, as in ما یخبرکم "what He informeth you of".

definition: Verb, Form VIII imperfect subjunctive 3rd plural: (that) they choose. Root kh-y-r.
Imperfect (form VIII): to single out, choose specially. Root kh-ṣ-ṣ.
usage: Singles out, of God choosing whom He will for His mercy.

definition: Present of form IV akhraja 'to bring out, remove' with -hu 'it'. Root kh-r-j.
usage: In the Aqdas یخرجه عن الظاهر 'diverteth it from its apparent meaning'.

definition: Verb: subjunctive of akhraja, 'to bring out, to take out', with suffix -kum. Root kh-r-j.
usage: Aqdas: ایّاکم ان یخرجکم الاصغآء عن شأن الأدب 'take heed lest listening cause you to overstep the bounds of propriety'.

definition: Arabic verb, form II imperfect with -há: lightens it. Root kh-f-f.
Verb: to be hidden, concealed. Root kh-f-y.
Verb, form II imperfect with 2nd pl. suffix: delivers you, frees you. Root kh-l-ṣ.
Noun dual of yad 'hand', with 'his'. Root y-d-y.
usage: Qur'anic بل یداه مبسوطتان 'nay, outstretched are both His hands'.

definition: Verb, form II imperfect: arranges, directs, governs. Root d-b-r.
usage: Qur'an 13:2 یدبّر الامر یفصّل الآیات.

definition: Verb dakhala, to enter; third plural present. Root d-kh-l.
Verb: 'he comprehends, attains it', form IV of d-r-k.
Imperfect of form IV adraka 'to reach, attain, comprehend' with -há: attains it, them. Root d-r-k.
usage: In the Aqdas مقامات لا یدرکها الّا من شاء الله 'stations none can attain save whom God willeth'.

definition: Verb, form IV: to perceive, attain, comprehend. Root d-r-k.
Noun yad 'hand; power' with -hu 'his'. Root y-d-y.
Yad 'hand' with -ka.
usage: In the Hidden Words ادخل یدک فی جیبی 'Put thy hand into My bosom'.

definition: Dual of yad 'hand' with -hi: his two hands. Root y-d-y.
Particle: when, if (temporal-conditional); here after interrogative a-: 'what, when...?'.
usage: In Qur'an 13:5 أ ئذا کنّا تراباً 'What! When we are dust...'.
notes: The source writes أ ئذا; normalized as یذا.

definition: Imperfect of dhahaba "to go"; with bi "to take away". Root dh-h-b.
usage: Aqdas: ما یذهب به العقل 'that which depriveth him of his reason'.

definition: Imperfect of dhakara 'to mention, remember' with suffix 'him'. Root dh-k-r.
Arabic verb (form I): he mentions, remembers them. Root dh-k-r.
usage: Aqdas: یذکرهم الملأ الأعلی 'the Concourse on high make mention of them'.

definition: Present 3pl of dhakara: they mention, say. Root dh-k-r.
Imperfect, third person masculine plural, of dhakara 'to mention' plus -ní 'Me'. Root dh-k-r.
usage: They mention Me, remember Me; tied to dhikr, the remembrance of God.

definition: Verb (form II): imperfect 3rd singular of rabbá "to rear, nurture, educate". Root r-b-w.
usage: Means to nurture or educate; related to تربیت 'education', a central Bahá'í theme, and to رب 'Lord'.

definition: Verb form VIII irtafa‘a "to rise, be raised", imperfect 3rd masculine singular: rises. Root r-f-‘.
usage: To rise or be raised; in the Writings of the Cause, the Call or the name of God being exalted.
notes: sawfa yartafi‘u’n-na‘áq the croaking shall be raised.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd person singular (form VIII): commits (a sin, crime). Root r-k-b.
usage: Of committing sins or forbidden acts, as in laws of the Aqdas: 'whoso committeth' an offence.

definition: Verb (form VIII imperfect) with 3rd masc. object: he commits it (a wrong). Root r-k-b.
usage: To commit a sin or wrong, as in the Aqdas's laws concerning one who commits an offence.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd masc. sing. of waritha + -hu: inherits from him. Root w-r-th.
usage: Appears in the Aqdas's laws of inheritance, of heirs who inherit from the deceased.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd person masculine plural of waritha: they inherit. Root w-r-th.
usage: Used of heirs inheriting, notably in the inheritance laws of the Kitáb-i-Aqdas, and of the righteous inheriting the earth.

pos: verb 3sg masc. imperf. subj. (form IV) + suffix
definition: Verb, Form IV imperfect subjunctive + "her": (that) he return her. Root r-j-‘.
usage: That he return her; in the Aqdas divorce law.
notes: Form I yarji‘ahá (transitive raja‘a) is also possible.

definition: Imperfect of raḥima 'to have mercy on' + -hu 'him'. Root r-ḥ-m.
usage: Has mercy on him, of God's mercy.

definition: Passive subjunctive of rafa‘a 'to raise, lift up': that it be raised, exalted. Root r-f-‘.
Verb: imperfect of rakaḍa, 'to run, to gallop'. Root r-k-ḍ.
usage: Íqán tradition: هذا فتی ناریّ یرکض فی برّیّة الرّوح 'this is a fiery youth who speedeth through the wilderness of the spirit'.

definition: Arabic yuríd 'He wills' with Persian copula -and, closing the quoted formula یحکم ما یرید. Root r-w-d.
usage: From the formula یحکم ما یرید 'He ordaineth what He pleaseth'.
notes: Persian -and makes the quoted phrase a predicate: they are the manifestation of 'He ordaineth what He willeth'.

pos: verb 3sg masc. impf. subj. (form IV) + pron. 2pl
definition: Verb form IV: to show, cause to see; to show you. Root r-'-y.
Proper adjective: of Yazd, a city of central Iran.
Verb: he increases, adds to. Root z-y-d.
usage: Qur'anic لا یزید الکافرین کفرهم الّا خساراً 'their unbelief shall only increase the unbelievers in loss'.

definition: Verb, form II subjunctive: (that) he adorn. Root z-y-n.
usage: یزین رأسه بالاسم الاعظم 'adorn its head with the Most Great Name'.

definition: Verb sa'ala, to ask; "they ask thee". Root s-’-l.
usage: From Qur'an 17:85 و یسألونک عن الرّوح "They will ask thee of the Spirit".
notes: Written یسألونک.

definition: Verb: 'he glorifies, praises (God)', form II of s-b-ḥ.
usage: Qur'an 17:44 و ان من شیء الّا یسبّح بحمده 'there is nothing but celebrateth His praise'.

definition: Imperfect of form X istadalla: to seek proof, argue, infer (bi- from, ‘alá against). Root d-l-l.
usage: In the Aqdas, of one who یأخذ الکتاب و یستدلّ به علی الله 'taketh the Book and argueth from it against God'.

definition: Verb, form X: to use, employ. Root ‘-m-l.
usage: In the Aqdas, of using vessels of gold and silver.

definition: Imperfect of form X ista‘ádha 'to seek refuge'. Root ‘-w-dh.
Form X: to ask forgiveness. Root gh-f-r.
usage: In the Aqdas لیس لأحد ان یستغفر عند احد 'It is not lawful to confess one's sins to another'.

definition: Verb form X: they seek victory, ask for an opening. Root f-t-ḥ.
usage: Qur'an 2:89 و کانوا من قبل یستفتحون 'they had before prayed for victory'.

definition: Verb, form X, present 3rd person singular: faces, meets, receives. Root q-b-l.
usage: In the Aqdas یستقبل بعینه السّهام 'he will face the darts with his own eyes'.

definition: Form X subjunctive of q-r-r: to settle, come to rest, be established. Root q-r-r.
usage: Aqdas on the Qiblih: متی ینقلب تنقلب الی ان یستقرّ 'whenever It moveth, turn ye towards It, until It cometh to rest'.

definition: Subjunctive of form VIII istanna 'to run a course, race'. Root s-n-n.
usage: هل یقدر احد منکم ان یستنّ معی فی میدان المکاشفة 'is any of you able to race with Me in the arena of mystic vision'.

definition: Arabic verb (form X): they mock, ridicule. Root h-z-’.
usage: Qur'anic: ما یأتیهم من رسول الّا کانوا به یستهزئون 'never came an Apostle unto them but they laughed him to scorn'.

definition: Present of asra‘a: hastens. Root s-r-‘.
Subjunctive of form II sallama 'to hand over, deliver' plus -há 'it'. Root s-l-m.
usage: Hand it over, deliver it; ordinary verb, here of delivering or entrusting something.

definition: Verb: energetic imperfect 3rd masculine plural of sami‘a "to hear". Root s-m-‘.
Verb sami‘a "to hear", jussive 3rd masculine singular with -há: (as if he had not) heard them. Root s-m-‘.
usage: Echoes the Qur'anic picture of one who hears God's verses and turns away كأن لم یسمعها 'as though he had not heard them' (45:8).

definition: Verb, subjunctive 3rd person singular (form II): to make easy, facilitate. Root s-h-l.
usage: To make something easy; of God facilitating His servants' affairs or the path of the seeker.

definition: Adjective: easy, light, slight. Root y-s-r.
usage: Easy, slight, small; often in the Qur'anic formula علی الله یسیر 'easy for God'.
notes: Sahlun yasír = easy and simple.

definition: Verb form III passive imperfect: is witnessed, seen. Root sh-h-d.
usage: Used of what is witnessed or beheld, often of the signs of God seen in the world.

definition: Verb, imperfect subjunctive form III 3rd person plural of sháwara: to consult. Root sh-w-r.
usage: From مشاوره "consultation", a central Bahá'í principle; in the Aqdas the Houses of Justice are bidden to "take counsel together".

definition: Verb, Form III imperfect 3rd plural: they consult. Root sh-w-r.
usage: They consult; of consultation.

definition: Passive imperfect (form II) of shabbaha 'to liken, compare'. Root sh-b-h.
usage: Is likened, as in God being beyond likeness.
notes: With bi this reads best as passive; active yushbihu 'resembles' also possible.

definition: Present of form VIII ishtabaha: it is doubtful, unclear, confused. Root sh-b-h.
Verb: subjunctive of ishtará, 'to buy'. Root sh-r-y.
usage: Aqdas, forbidding slavery: لیس لعبد ان یشتری عبداً 'it is not for any man to purchase another'.

definition: Arabic verb, imperfect 3rd plural of shariba: they drink. Root sh-r-b.
usage: Qur'an 76:5: انّ الأبرار یشربون 'the righteous shall drink'.

definition: Verb: to begin, commence (with فی). Root sh-r-‘.
Verb, form IV imperfect 3rd pl.: they associate partners with God. Root sh-r-k.
Verb: it occupies, distracts him. Root sh-gh-l.
usage: In the formula لا یشغله شأن عن شأن 'no one thing distracteth Him from another'.

definition: Verb, form I imperfect: pours. Root ṣ-b-b.
Verb ṣabara, to be patient, wait patiently; subjunctive. Root ṣ-b-r.
usage: In the Aqdas the year of patience before divorce.

definition: Verb: 'it will befall you', jussive of aṣába. Root ṣ-w-b.
Imperfect of ṣadaqa: to be true, speak truly; with fí, to hold true of. Root ṣ-d-q.
usage: In the Íqán کذلک یصدق فی شأنه بانّه سریع الحساب 'thus is it true of Him that He is swift in reckoning'.

definition: Verb ṣadda 'to turn aside, hinder', subjunctive with -kum 'you'. Root ṣ-d-d.
Imperfect of form IV aṣarra 'to persist, insist'. Root ṣ-r-r.
Form I imperfect of ṣa‘ida 'to rise, ascend'. Root ṣ-‘-d.
usage: In the Aqdas لا یصعد دعائه الی اللّه 'his prayer ascendeth not to God'.

definition: Verb: he describes, attributes. Root w-ṣ-f.
usage: In formulas like سبحان الله عما یصف العباد 'glorified be God above what the servants describe'.

definition: Verb, 3rd person singular subjunctive: (shall never) reach, attain. Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: In لن یصل الی مقام وطنه 'shall never attain the station of his home'.

definition: Imperfect of ṣaluḥa "to be fit, suitable, righteous": he is fit (for). Root ṣ-l-ḥ.
usage: In a tradition cited in the Íqán: کلّهم یصلح الخلافة 'all of them fit for the caliphate'.

definition: Subjunctive 3rd person plural of waṣala 'to arrive, attain'. Root w-ṣ-l.
usage: لن یصلوا الی شاطئ بحر العرفان 'shall never attain the shores of the ocean of true understanding'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): he makes, does. Root ṣ-n-‘.
usage: In a tradition of the Qá'im: یصنع ما صنع رسول اللّه 'He will do as the Apostle of God did'.

definition: Present of ḍarra: harms, injures. Root ḍ-r-r.
Imperfect of ḍarra 'to harm' plus -hum 'them'. Root ḍ-r-r.
usage: Harms them; often in negated phrases that nothing can harm the faithful, echoing Qur'anic usage.

definition: Verb (form IV): imperfect 3rd singular of aḍalla "to lead astray". Root ḍ-l-l.
usage: Used in Qur'anic phrasing that God leads astray or guides whom He will.

definition: Verb form IV aṭ‘ama "to feed", subjunctive 3rd masculine plural: that they feed. Root ṭ-‘-m.
usage: To feed; in the Aqdas of providing good cheer for oneself, one's kindred and the poor during the Intercalary Days (ایّام الهاء).
notes: Aqdas Ayyám-i-Há: "provide good cheer for themselves".

definition: Verb, passive imperfect 3rd person singular (form IV): is extinguished, put out. Root ṭ-f-’.
usage: Of the light of God that cannot be extinguished, echoing Qur'an 9:32 and 61:8 on those who would put out God's light.

definition: Verb (form I imperfect): he seeks, requests; here begs. Root ṭ-l-b.
usage: To seek, request; of the seeker (طالب) who seeks God.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd masc. pl. of ṭalaba: they seek. Root ṭ-l-b.
usage: Used of seekers who search for God or for the truth, and of those who seek worldly things.

definition: Verb, imperfect subjunctive form VIII of iṭṭala‘a: to become aware of, learn of. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: To become aware of or acquainted with something; used of learning of God's Revelation or of hidden matters.
notes: After li-allá 'lest'.

definition: Verb, Form VIII imperfect with energetic -nna: they will surely become acquainted with. Root ṭ-l-‘.
usage: Used of coming to know or being apprised of something, as in اطّلاع یافتن 'to become informed'; in the Writings often of souls becoming acquainted with the Word of God.

definition: Subjunctive (form II) of ṭallaqa 'to divorce' + -há 'her'. Root ṭ-l-q.
usage: Divorce her, in Aqdas laws on divorce.

definition: Jussive of ṭamatha 'to touch' with -hunna 'them' (fem.), after lam. Root ṭ-m-th.
usage: Qur'an 55:56 لم یطمثهنّ انس قبلهم و لا جانّ 'whom neither man nor jinn hath touched before them'.

definition: Verb: imperfect 3rd plural of ṭáfa, 'to circle, to circumambulate'. Root ṭ-w-f.
usage: Aqdas: الّذین یطوفون حول کرسی رفیع 'they who circle round a lofty throne'.

definition: Arabic verb, passive imperfect of ṭawá: is folded, rolled up. Root ṭ-w-y.
usage: Aqdas: یطوی بساط عزّکم 'the carpet of your glory shall be rolled up'.

pos: verb 3sg masc. impf. subj. (form IV) + pron. 3sg
definition: Verb form IV: to obey; obey Him. Root ṭ-w-‘.
Verb, form IV jussive 3rd pl. with 3rd masc. suffix: (not) obey him. Root ṭ-w-‘.
Verb: he supposes, imagines, thinks. Root ẓ-n-n.
usage: In عمّا یظنّ العباد 'from what the servants imagine'.

definition: Verb, form III passive: be equalled, be weighed against. Root ‘-d-l.
usage: لا یعادل بکلمة منک ما نزّل 'nothing ... can compare with a word from thee'.
notes: Active/passive reading uncertain.

definition: Form VIII of ‘-r-f: to confess, acknowledge. Root ‘-r-f.
Verb: 'he is unable, incapable'. Root ‘-j-z.
Imperfect of wa‘ada 'to promise, threaten' with -kum: he promises (or threatens) you. Root w-‘-d.
usage: Qur'an 40:28 in the Íqán: یصبکم بعض الّذی یعدکم 'some of that which he threateneth will befall you'.

definition: Verb, form IV jussive: to turn away, shun. Root ‘-r-ḍ.
Imperfect of ‘arafa 'to know, recognize' with -hu 'it'. Root ‘-r-f.
Form I imperfect of ‘arafa with -há: he knows it. Root ‘-r-f.
Verb form II with -hu: (that) they honour him. Root ‘-z-z.
Verb, jussive 3rd person singular: is blind to, turns away. Root ‘-sh-w.
usage: In Qur'an 43:36 و من یعش عن ذکر الرّحمن 'whoso shall withdraw from the remembrance of the Merciful', closing the Íqán.

definition: Imperfect of ‘afá "to pardon, forgive" (with ‘an). Root ‘-f-w.
usage: Aqdas: و ان کان له عذر یعفو اللّه عنه 'if he hath an excuse, God will pardon him'.

definition: Imperfect 3rd person plural of ‘aqala 'to understand, reason'. Root ‘-q-l.
usage: او یعقلون 'or understand' (Qur'an 25:44).

definition: Arabic verb (form I): it rises, becomes exalted. Root ‘-l-w.
usage: Tradition: فی سنة السّتّین یظهر امره و یعلو ذکره 'in the year sixty His Cause shall be made manifest and His name exalted'.

definition: Subjunctive of ‘amila: do, act. Root ‘-m-l.
Imperfect, third person masculine plural, of ‘amiha 'to wander blindly, be bewildered'. Root ‘-m-h.
usage: Wander blindly; from the Qur'anic fí ṭughyánihim ya‘mahún 'wander blindly in their transgression', said of those who reject the Messengers.

definition: Verb: imperfect 3rd singular of ‘áda "to return". Root ‘-w-d.
usage: Means to return, used of souls or matters returning to their origin.

definition: Verb form II ‘ayyana "to appoint, assign", subjunctive 3rd masculine plural: that they assign. Root ‘-y-n.
usage: To appoint or assign; in the Aqdas of allotting a share, a time or a person for a set purpose.
notes: Could also be yu‘ínú "help" (form IV, ‘-w-n).

definition: Verb, passive imperfect 3rd person singular (form II): is covered, concealed. Root gh-ṭ-w.
usage: Of something veiled or covered, as truth or light hidden from the heedless.

definition: Verb (form IV imperfect): he enriches, makes self-sufficient; also avails. Root gh-n-y.
usage: To enrich, make independent; also 'to avail', as in لا یغنی 'availeth nothing'.

definition: Verb form VIII imperfect 3rd masc. pl.: they boast, take pride. Root f-kh-r.
usage: Used of those who boast or glory, often in admonitions against pride in wealth, learning or descent.

definition: Verb, passive imperfect 3rd person masculine plural of fatana: they are tried, tested. Root f-t-n.
usage: Echoes Qur'án 29:2 "and they shall not be tried?"; in the Writings the believers are tested (فتنه "trial, test") to prove their faith.
notes: Quran 29:2.

definition: Verb, Form I imperfect: he rejoices. Root f-r-ḥ.
usage: Describes rejoicing, often divine or spiritual gladness; compare فرح 'joy' and the warning لا تفرح 'rejoice not' at worldly things.

definition: Imperfect (form II) of fassara 'to interpret, explain' + -há 'it'. Root f-s-r.
usage: Interprets it, of authorised interpretation of the Word.

definition: Present of fashá: it spreads, becomes widespread. Root f-sh-w.
Verb: imperfect of faniya, 'to perish, to pass away'. Root f-n-y.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words: ملکی لا یفنی 'My dominion perisheth not'.

definition: Arabic verb, subjunctive of fáza: attain, win. Root f-w-z.
Verb form VIII: to be joined, coupled, united. Root q-r-n.
usage: Of the letters Káf and Nún, which form کن 'Be!', the creative Word.

definition: Verb, subjunctive 3rd pl. of qadara: (that) they be able. Root q-d-r.
Verb: it is decreed, ordained. Root q-ḍ-y.
Noun: wakefulness, waking. Root y-q-ẓ.
usage: نوم و یقظه 'sleep and waking'.

definition: Verb qani‘a, to be content, satisfied; third plural present. Root q-n-‘.
Verb: 'they say', subjunctive 3pl of qála. Root q-w-l.
Imperfect of qáma: he stands, arises; with ‘alá, to arise to (a task). Root q-w-m.
usage: In the Aqdas من عرفنی یقوم علی خدمتی 'whoso hath known Me shall arise to serve Me'.

definition: Noun: sea, ocean. Root y-m-m.
usage: As in یمّ علم الهی 'the ocean of divine knowledge'.

definition: Energetic imperfect 3rd plural of form II majjada 'to glorify, magnify'. Root m-j-d.
notes: Aqdas, of the Intercalary Days.

definition: Form I imperfect of maḥá 'to erase, efface'. Root m-ḥ-w.
usage: In Qur'an 13:39 یمحو اللّه ما یشآء و یثبت 'God doth blot out and confirm what He pleaseth'.

definition: Verb with -ka: (if) it touches you, befalls you. Root m-s-s.
usage: Arabic Hidden Words ان یمسک الفقر 'If poverty overtake thee'.

definition: Verb, present 3rd person plural: they walk. Root m-sh-y.
usage: In the Hidden Words یمشون علی اعقابکم 'that walk in your ways'.

definition: Imperfect of malaka "to own, possess, rule". Root m-l-k.
usage: Aqdas: یحرم علی الآخر ما یملک 'what he possesseth is forbidden to the other'.

definition: Imperfect of malaka 'to own, possess' with suffix 'it'. Root m-l-k.
Arabic verb (form I): he withholds, prevents, forbids. Root m-n-‘.
usage: Aqdas: یعطی من یشاء ما یشاء و یمنع عمّن یشاء 'He giveth to whom He willeth and withholdeth from whom He willeth'.

definition: Subjunctive of mana‘a with 'thee': prevent you, keep you back. Root m-n-‘.
inna 'verily' plus -ná 'we'; here the second part of a-’inná 'shall we indeed?'.
notes: Hamza written on a ya-seat after interrogative a-; split from أئنّا.

definition: Noun: plural of yanbú‘: springs, fountains, wellsprings. Root n-b-‘.
usage: Springs or wellsprings, often figurative, as in ینابیع الحکمة 'the wellsprings of wisdom'.

definition: Noun: spring, fountainhead; here the title of a hadith compilation cited by name. Root n-b-‘.
usage: A spring or fountainhead; in the Íqán the title of a cited collection of traditions, and elsewhere an image of the source of divine knowledge.
notes: Book title; the exact work cited is uncertain.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd person singular (form II) + -ka: he informs thee. Root n-b-’.
usage: Echoes the Qur'anic 'none can inform thee like One Who is aware' (لا ینبّئک مثل خبیر); God as the one who informs.

definition: Verb (form VIII imperfect, 3rd pl.): they wake up, become aware. Root n-b-h.
usage: To awaken, become aware; used in calls to the heedless to wake.

definition: Verb form VIII imperfect 3rd masc. pl.: they wait, expect. Root n-ẓ-r.
usage: Used of peoples awaiting the promised Manifestation, who fail to recognize Him when He appears.

definition: Verb, imperfect form VIII of intahá: to end, lead to, culminate. Root n-h-y.
usage: To end in or culminate; used of things that lead to a goal, as in the Sadratu'l-Muntahá, "the Tree beyond which there is no passing".

definition: Verb, Form II imperfect + "you": he saves you. Root n-j-w.
usage: Used of God or His Word delivering souls, as in ما ینجیکم 'that which will deliver you'; related to نجات 'salvation'.

definition: Imperfect of nasiya 'to forget' + -hum 'them'. Root n-s-y.
Passive present of nasiya 'to forget': it is forgotten. Root n-s-y.
usage: In the Hidden Words حقّی علیک کبیر لا ینسی 'My claim on thee is great, it cannot be forgotten'.

definition: Verb: imperfect of naṣaḥa, 'to counsel, to advise', with suffix -ka. Root n-ṣ-ḥ.
usage: Aqdas: کذلک ینصحک القلم الأعلی 'thus counselleth thee the Most Exalted Pen'.

definition: Arabic verb, imperfect 3rd plural of naṣara with -hu: they help, assist Him. Root n-ṣ-r.
usage: Aqdas: ینصرونه بأنفسهم 'assist Him with their own selves'.

definition: Verb: to help, aid, assist; aid Him. Root n-ṣ-r.
usage: نصرت 'assistance' of the Cause, in the Writings mainly through deeds and utterance.

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd pl. of naṭaqa: they speak. Root n-ṭ-q.
Verb: he looks, considers. Root n-ẓ-r.
Verb, form I imperfect: it benefits, profits. Root n-f-‘.
usage: لا ینفع الناس ما عندهم 'nothing that men possess shall profit them'.

definition: Verb nafa‘a, to benefit; "it benefits thee". Root n-f-‘.
Verb: 'he spends, pays out', form IV of n-f-q.
Imperfect 3rd person masculine plural of form IV anfaqa: they spend, expend (wealth). Root n-f-q.
usage: In the Aqdas لو یعرفون ینفقون ما عندهم 'did they know, they would spend all they have'.

definition: Verb, passive present of naqasha 'to engrave'. Root n-q-sh.
Imperfect of form VII inqalaba 'to turn back, return, be overturned'. Root q-l-b.
usage: From Qur'an 26:227 ایّ منقلب ینقلبون 'what a reverse they shall experience'.

definition: Form II: to clean, sift (grain). Root n-q-y.
usage: In the Aqdas من ینقّی القمح و الشّعیر 'one who winnowed wheat and barley'.

definition: Verb form IV with -hu: he denies it. Root n-k-r.
Verb, form IV, present 3rd person plural with 'it': they deny it. Root n-k-r.
usage: In the Aqdas یرون برهان اللّه و ینکرونه 'behold God's proof, yet deny it'.

definition: Form VIII imperfect of h-z-z: it trembles, quivers, is stirred. Root h-z-z.
usage: Aqdas: اهتزاز الکلمة علی شأن یهتزّ منه العالم الأعظم 'the stirring of the Word such that the Most Great World is stirred'.

definition: Imperfect of hadama 'to demolish, tear down, abolish'. Root h-d-m.
usage: یهدم ما کان قبله 'He will demolish whatever was before Him'.

definition: Arabic verb (form I): he guides him. Root h-d-y.
usage: Qur'anic: فمن یهدیه من بعد اللّه 'who then shall guide him after God?'

definition: Present of hallala: proclaim the unity of God. Root h-l-l.
notes: Original likely energetic (with shadda on nún).

definition: Noun and adjective: Jew, Jewish.
usage: Jew, Jewish; used of the Jewish people, especially in the Íqán's account of their rejection of Christ.

definition: Verb (form III): imperfect 3rd singular of wájaha "to face, meet". Root w-j-h.
Verb form III ákhadha "to take to task, punish", imperfect 3rd masculine singular. Root '-kh-dh.
usage: To call to account or punish; in the Aqdas of God's judgment or pardon, as in لا یؤاخذ 'shall not be held to account'.
notes: Qur'an 35:45 "If God should punish men for their deeds".

definition: Verb, subjunctive 3rd person singular (form IV) + -há: (that) he give her. Root ’-t-y.
usage: To give or grant; in laws such as giving a wife her dowry or what is due to her.

definition: Proper noun Yúḥanná (John the Evangelist) with ast (is).
usage: John, usually the Gospel writer whose words are quoted in the Kitáb-i-Íqán.

definition: Verb form II imperfect 3rd masc. sing.: postpones, delays. Root '-kh-r.
usage: Used of deferring or postponing, for example an obligation or a promised time.
notes: Written یؤخّر.

definition: Verb, imperfect form II of akhkhara with -hum: He defers, respites them. Root ’-kh-r.
usage: Echoes Qur'án 16:61, God granting respite to the wrongdoers; rendered "respiteth them".
notes: Quran 16:61.

definition: Verb, Form II imperfect subjunctive 3rd plural: (that) they render, discharge. Root '-d-y.
usage: Used of discharging obligations or rendering what is due, as in یؤدّوا حقوق الله 'that they discharge the Right of God'.

definition: Passive imperfect of wazana 'to weigh'. Root w-z-n.
usage: Is weighed, as in the Aqdas's 'weighed in the balance of God'.

definition: Passive subjunctive of waṣafa 'to describe': that it be described. Root w-ṣ-f.
Verb: imperfect of awṣá, 'to enjoin, to charge, to bequeath', with suffix -kum. Root w-ṣ-y.
usage: Aqdas: یوصیکم بالبرّ و التّقوی 'He enjoineth on you righteousness and the fear of God'.

definition: Arabic verb, form IV jussive: fulfil, keep (a pledge). Root w-f-y.
usage: Aqdas: لم یوف بعهد اللّه 'hath not fulfilled the Covenant of God'.

pos: verb 3pl masc. impf. subj. (form II) + pron. 3sg
definition: Verb form II: to revere, honour, treat with reverence. Root w-q-r.
Verb, passive jussive 3rd sing. of walada: be born. Root w-l-d.
usage: In the Gospel verse quoted in the Íqán, 'except a man be born of water and the spirit'.

definition: Verb: they believe. Root ’-m-n.
usage: Qur'anic فبأیّ حدیث بعد الله و آیاته یؤمنون 'in what word after God and His verses will they believe?'.

definition: Adverb: on that day; on the Day (of God). Root y-w-m.
usage: Qur'anic eschatological formula, as in یومئذ یفرح المخلصون 'on that day the sincere shall rejoice'.

definition: Dual of yawm "day", genitive: two days. Root y-w-m.
Verb: 'He strengthens, assists him', form II of '-y-d.
Imperfect of form II ayyada with -ka: he strengthens, confirms, assists thee. Root ’-y-d.
usage: تأیید 'confirmation' is divine assistance; in the Arabic Hidden Words روح الامر یؤیّدک علی الامر 'the spirit of power confirmeth thee in this Cause'.
notes: Spelled یؤیّدک; the search form writes ؤ as و.

definition: Verb, form II: to strengthen, aid, confirm, with -kum 'you'. Root ’-y-d.
usage: In the Aqdas انّه یؤیّدکم 'He will aid you'; ta’yíd 'divine confirmation' is a key Bahá'í concept.
notes: Written یؤیّدکم.

definition: Energetic imperfect 3rd plural of form II kabbara 'to magnify, say Alláh-u-Akbar'. Root k-b-r.
notes: Aqdas, of the Intercalary Days.

definition: Form I imperfect of kataba: they write. Root k-t-b.
usage: In Qur'an 2:79 فویل للّذین یکتبون الکتاب بأیدیهم 'woe to those who write the Book with their own hands'.

definition: Verb form VIII with bi-: to be content with, make do with. Root k-f-y.
Verb, present 3rd person singular: conceals, hides. Root k-t-m.
usage: In Qur'an 40:28 رجل مؤمن من آل فرعون یکتم ایمانه 'a believer of Pharaoh's family who concealed his faith'.

definition: Imperfect of karaza "to preach" (Christian Arabic, from Syriac). Root k-r-z.
usage: Gospel citation in the Íqán: کان یوحنّا یکرز فی برّیّة یهودا 'John preached in the wilderness of Judaea'.

definition: Compound adjective: of one colour, uniform; figuratively sincere.
usage: خیمهٔ یک‌رنگ تراب 'the one-coloured tabernacle of dust'.

definition: Persian یکسان 'equal, the same' with است 'is'.
Subjunctive of kasaba: earn, acquire. Root k-s-b.
Imperfect of form IV aksala 'to make lazy, weary' plus -há 'them'. Root k-s-l.
usage: Makes them sluggish, wearies them; of things that weigh down the soul and make it slothful.

definition: Verb (form II): imperfect of kaffara "to expiate, remit (sins)". Root k-f-r.
usage: Means to expiate or remit sins; related to کفّاره 'expiation'.
notes: Not kafara "to disbelieve".

definition: Verb kafá "to suffice", jussive 3rd masculine singular with -hum: (has it not) sufficed them. Root k-f-y.
usage: Echoes Qur'an 29:51 أولم یکفهم 'is it not enough for them', cited in the Íqán: the revealed verses suffice as proof.
notes: Qur'an 29:51 "Is it not enough for them".

definition: Verb, imperfect 3rd person singular: suffices, is enough. Root k-f-y.
usage: Common in phrases such as 'it sufficeth' and 'God sufficeth'; of what is enough for the believer.

definition: Verb (form I imperfect) with 2nd masc. object: it suffices you. Root k-f-y.
usage: To suffice; e.g. 'this sufficeth thee', closing a counsel.

definition: Verb, subjunctive 3rd masc. pl. of kána: (that) they be. Root k-w-n.
Verb, imperfect 3rd person masculine plural of kána 'to be'. Root k-w-n.
usage: Forms of کان "to be"; very common, often in future or habitual sense "they shall be".

definition: yakí (one) + -st (is).
